Existing synthesis methods often increase apparent difficulty by enriching graph structures, but structural complexity alone does not guarantee realized search difficulty: the intended search process can collapse through a cheaper identifying route. We formalize this gap with a shortcut-aware difficulty framework and identify four actionable shortcut risks: evidence co-coverage, single-clue selectivity, exposed constants, and prior-knowledge binding. To diagnose their realized effects, we use trajectory signatures including solving cost, answer hit time, and prior-shortcut rate. Guided by this framework, we introduce FORT, a Framework of Shortcut-Resistant Training-Data Synthesis. FORT constructs shortcut-resistant training data by controlling shortcut risks across entity selection, evidence graph construction, question formulation, and adversarial refinement. Experiments show that FORT induces longer pre-answer search and fewer shortcut patterns than existing open-source deep search datasets. Using the resulting trajectories, we train FORT-Searcher with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) only, and it achieves the best overall performance among comparable-size open-source search agents on challenging deep search benchmarks. Relevant resources will be made available at this https URL .

item.title: DrivingAgent: Design and Scheduling Agents for Autonomous Driving Systems
item.author: Zhongyu Xia, Wenhao Chen, Yongtao Wang, Ming-Hsuan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DrivingAgent的新型智能体框架，旨在解决自动驾驶系统中基础模型集成带来的设计复杂性和实时调度挑战。该框架在系统设计和实时调度两个阶段分别实现了自动化模块开发和动态模块编排，并在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中展现了优越的速度与精度平衡。

背景: 许多自动驾驶系统正越来越多地采用基础模型以提升泛化能力并处理长尾场景。然而，这一趋势引入了两个关键挑战：一是设计和集成新模型的过程需要大量人工且耗时；二是缺乏智能的动态调度机制来满足严格的实时约束。现有的基于大型语言模型的智能体框架不适合自动驾驶，因为它们未能区分系统设计与实时调度的不同需求，将模块视为不透明的黑盒，且未针对连续运行进行设计。

目的: 解决自动驾驶系统设计和调度双重挑战，实现模块开发的自动化和实时调度的智能化，以克服现有框架在自动化程度、模块透明度和连续运行能力方面的不足。

方法: 提出DrivingAgent框架，包含两个阶段：在设计阶段，通过解析系统架构、生成代码以及利用超网络训练验证模块，实现模块开发的自动化；在调度阶段，采用通过强化学习训练的轻量级大型语言模型，结合集成长期存储和带时间戳短期上下文的结构化记忆，动态编排系统模块以满足实时需求。

主要发现: 在nuScenes和Bench2Drive基准测试中，DrivingAgent实现了优越的速度与精度平衡。

结论: DrivingAgent框架能够有效应对自动驾驶系统设计和调度中的挑战，通过自动化模块开发和动态实时调度，提升了系统的性能和效率。

翻译: Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.

Abstract

Many autonomous driving systems are increasingly incorporating foundation models to improve generalization and handle long-tail scenarios. However, this trend introduces two key challenges: (i) the manual and labor-intensive process of designing and integrating new models, and (ii) the lack of intelligent, dynamic scheduling mechanisms to meet strict real-time constraints. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising avenue for automation, existing frameworks are ill-suited for autonomous driving. Specifically, they fail to distinguish between the fundamentally different requirements of system design and real-time scheduling, treat modules as opaque black boxes, and are not designed for continuous operation. To address these limitations, we propose DrivingAgent, a novel agent framework tailored to the dual challenges of autonomous driving system design and scheduling. In the design phase, DrivingAgent automates module development by interpreting system architecture, generating code, and validating modules via super-network training. In the scheduling phase, it employs a lightweight LLM trained with reinforcement learning to dynamically orchestrate system modules in real time, supported by a structured memory that integrates long-term storage with timestamped short-term context. Experimental results demonstrate that DrivingAgent achieves a superior speed--accuracy trade-off on both the nuScenes and Bench2Drive benchmarks.

item.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
item.author: Xian, Yuchen, He, Yang, Xu, Yunqiu, Yang, Yi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为VIA-SD的新框架，通过模型内部路由技术，利用轻量级子模型对中等置信度的候选词进行验证，从而降低大模型调用成本，提升推理速度。

背景: 推测解码通过轻量级草稿模型生成候选词并由大型验证器并行验证，以解决大语言模型的高推理成本问题。现有方法采用二元决策，即接受或完全重新计算。

目的: 减少昂贵的大模型调用，通过利用从完整验证器派生的轻量级子模型来验证需要中等验证资源的被拒绝词元。

方法: 提出VIA-SD框架，采用分层处理机制：对高置信度情况直接接受，对中等置信度情况使用路由轻量级验证器重新生成，对不确定情况使用完整模型验证。

主要发现: 在四个代表性任务和多个模型系列中，VIA-SD将拒绝率降低了0.10至0.22，相比强推测解码基线实现了10%至20%的加速，相比非草稿解码实现了2.5至3倍的加速。

结论: 多层推测解码可作为可扩展且高效的大语言模型推理的通用范式。

翻译: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel. Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute. Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier. This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resources, reducing expensive large-model calls. We propose Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding (VIA-SD), a multi-tier framework using a routed slim-verifier. Draft tokens are processed hierarchically: direct acceptance for high-confidence cases, slim-verifier regeneration for medium-confidence cases, and full-model verification for uncertain cases. Across four representative tasks and multiple model families, VIA-SD reduces rejection rates by 0.10-0.22 and delivers 10-20% speedups over strong SD baselines, while achieving 2.5-3x acceleration over non-drafting decoding. Moreover, VIA-SD is compatible with existing SD frameworks without modifying their training procedures. Our results suggest multi-tier SD as a general paradigm for scalable and efficient LLM inference. Project page: this https URL

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型推理中推测解码方法效率低下的问题。传统方法采用非此即彼的二元判定规则，导致大量中等置信度的生成结果无法被高效处理，只能依赖昂贵的大模型重新计算。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为大模型推理成本高昂且延迟大，引入分层验证机制能显著降低计算开销并提升速度，从而推动大模型在实际场景中的低成本、规模化部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到传统方法中非黑即白的验证决策无法高效处理中等置信度的生成结果，因此将其重构为分阶段的多层验证流程。在设计上，他们基于信息几何理论证明引入中间验证阶段能降低整体验证成本，并据此通过模型内部路由技术从大模型中派生出轻量级验证器来处理中等难度令牌，仅将最困难的令牌交由大模型。该方法借鉴了现有的推测解码框架与验证策略，但创新性地采用分布几何视角，无需额外训练或修改原有流程即可实现多层加速。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是打破传统大模型直接二选一接受或拒绝的验证方式，引入一个从大模型派生的轻量级中间验证器，专门处理中等把握的生成结果，从而减少昂贵的大模型调用并降低拒绝率。整体流程采用分层验证机制：高置信度的草稿直接通过，中等置信度的由轻量验证器自行修正或处理，只有不确定的困难情况才交由大模型进行最终验证，以此实现计算资源的阶梯式分配。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于模型内部路由的多层验证框架，通过引入轻量级的中间验证器处理中等置信度的生成结果，将传统的二元接受或拒绝规则升级为分层递进的验证流程。相比以往仅依赖小模型起草和大模型直接验证的两阶段方法，该工作从信息几何角度证明了引入中间验证阶段的理论依据，有效降低了大模型的调用频率与拒绝率，且无需修改现有训练流程即可直接兼容部署。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种多层验证框架，通过从大模型中动态路由生成轻量级次级验证器来处理中等置信度的候选词，从而有效降低拒绝率并提升推理速度，且完全兼容现有框架无需额外训练。

Abstract

Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel. Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute. Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier. This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resources, reducing expensive large-model calls. We propose Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding (VIA-SD), a multi-tier framework using a routed slim-verifier. Draft tokens are processed hierarchically: direct acceptance for high-confidence cases, slim-verifier regeneration for medium-confidence cases, and full-model verification for uncertain cases. Across four representative tasks and multiple model families, VIA-SD reduces rejection rates by 0.10-0.22 and delivers 10-20% speedups over strong SD baselines, while achieving 2.5-3x acceleration over non-drafting decoding. Moreover, VIA-SD is compatible with existing SD frameworks without modifying their training procedures. Our results suggest multi-tier SD as a general paradigm for scalable and efficient LLM inference. Project page: this https URL

item.title: PianoKontext: Expressive Performance Rendering from Deadpan Context
item.author: Gavrilev, Dmitrii
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PianoKontext的流匹配渲染模型，用于古典钢琴音乐的表现性表演生成。该模型能够在预训练Music2Latent模型的潜在空间中生成可变长度的表演，并通过动态时间规整技术构建配对数据进行训练，从而有效学习乐谱与表演之间的依赖关系。

背景: 表现性表演渲染旨在生成受音符序列约束的真实表演。然而，现有的流匹配音频编辑模型仅能处理时长相同的同步音乐样本，这限制了其对表现性节奏的理解。

目的: 引入PianoKontext模型，以解决现有模型在理解表现性节奏方面的局限性，并生成可变长度的古典钢琴音乐表演。

方法: 将MIDI乐谱合成为平淡音频，并在预训练Music2Latent模型的潜在空间中使用动态时间规整技术构建配对数据。将对齐的嵌入向量在DiT块中连接，以学习乐谱与表演之间的依赖关系。

主要发现: PianoKontext模型能够在潜在空间中生成可变长度的表演，并通过连接对齐的嵌入向量实现了对乐谱与表演依赖关系的简单有效学习。

结论: PianoKontext是一种有效的流匹配渲染模型，能够生成逼真的古典钢琴音乐表演，并克服了现有模型在表现性节奏理解上的限制。

翻译: Expressive performance rendering (EPR) aims to generate realistic performances constrained on sequences of notes. However, flow matching audio editing models manipulate only synchronized music samples of the same duration, limiting their understanding of expressive timing. We introduce PianoKontext, a flow matching rendering model for classical piano music that generates variable-length performances in the latent space of a pretrained Music2Latent model. We synthesize MIDI scores into deadpan audio and employ Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) in the latent space to construct paired data for training. The aligned embeddings are concatenated in DiT blocks, allowing for a simple and effective learning of the dependencies between the score and performances. Audio samples are available at our demo page: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何根据静态乐谱生成具有真实情感与弹性节奏的钢琴演奏音频的问题。现有模型通常只能处理时长固定的同步音频，难以捕捉演奏中自由变化的速度与时值。该问题在音乐生成领域至关重要，因为它能弥合人类艺术创作与人工智能之间的鸿沟，使模型能够生成更自然、符合音乐家习惯的逼真演奏，对音乐制作、教学及艺术辅助具有实际价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有音频编辑模型难以处理乐谱与演奏时长不一致的问题，设计了在音频潜空间中进行可变长度生成的流匹配方法。该方法先将乐谱合成死板音频并提取特征，利用动态时间规整算法对特征序列进行对齐，再将对齐后的乐谱与演奏特征拼接输入到扩散Transformer模块中，以学习两者间的依赖关系。整体架构明确借鉴了图像编辑模型FLUX Kontext的设计思路，将其处理上下文与目标图像依赖关系的自注意力机制迁移至音乐生成任务中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用流匹配技术，将机械平直的乐谱音频作为上下文，在预训练音频模型的潜在空间中生成具有音乐表现力的可变长度钢琴演奏。整体流程首先使用预训练编码器将乐谱与演奏音频转化为潜在序列，接着通过动态时间规整算法对两者进行时间对齐以提取内容匹配的片段。然后将对齐后的乐谱上下文、带噪声的目标演奏序列及结束标记拼接，输入带有二维位置编码的Transformer网络进行联合建模。最后通过流匹配损失函数训练模型，使其能够根据给定的平直乐谱上下文生成节奏与情感丰富的演奏音频。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于流匹配技术的钢琴演奏生成模型，直接在预训练音频潜空间中进行训练与推理。与以往主要处理固定时长音频对或依赖复杂符号化表示的工作不同，该方法利用动态时间规整算法在潜空间中对齐乐谱与演奏音频，并将两者拼接输入网络。这种设计使模型能够生成时长可变且节奏富有表现力的音频，在保持乐谱内容准确性的同时显著降低了音符幻觉或遗漏的问题，并提升了整体音频质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了PianoKontext模型，通过在音频潜在空间中对齐乐谱与演奏数据并结合注意力网络，实现了从机械乐谱到富有表现力且长度可变的钢琴演奏的高质量生成。

Abstract

Expressive performance rendering (EPR) aims to generate realistic performances constrained on sequences of notes. However, flow matching audio editing models manipulate only synchronized music samples of the same duration, limiting their understanding of expressive timing. We introduce PianoKontext, a flow matching rendering model for classical piano music that generates variable-length performances in the latent space of a pretrained Music2Latent model. We synthesize MIDI scores into deadpan audio and employ Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) in the latent space to construct paired data for training. The aligned embeddings are concatenated in DiT blocks, allowing for a simple and effective learning of the dependencies between the score and performances. Audio samples are available at our demo page: this https URL .

item.title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion
item.author: Xian, Yuchen, Xu, Yunqiu, He, Yang, Yang, Yi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于冻结预训练图像标记器的紧凑一维标记接口，用于多模态图像融合，通过选择性标记编辑机制在保持局部细节的同时实现全局外观一致性。

背景: 多模态图像融合旨在整合不同模态的互补信息，生成既保留丰富局部细节又保持全局外观一致性的融合图像。现有方法在二维特征网格上构建共享表示，擅长建模局部结构，但对图像级全局外观因素的利用有限。

目的: 平衡局部细节保留与全局外观一致性，通过引入一维标记空间作为全局载体，同时保留二维空间路径用于局部结构恢复。

方法: 提出选择性标记编辑机制，稀疏更新或替换少量关键标记，以轻量级方式引导全局外观一致性，同时保持融合主干网络不变且避免额外损失。

主要发现: 在四个常用基准测试上，该方法实现了最佳整体性能，在全局一致性和局部保真度方面均取得一致的、多指标的提升。

结论: 该方法有效解决了多模态图像融合中局部细节与全局一致性之间的平衡问题，具有显著的性能优势。

翻译: Multimodal image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a fused image that preserves rich local details while maintaining globally consistent appearance. Existing approaches build shared representations on 2D feature grids, which excel at modeling local structures but offer limited leverage over image-level global appearance factors. To balance these objectives, we introduce a compact 1D token interface based on a frozen pretrained image tokenizer for modeling non-local appearance/base factors. Rather than using the tokenizer as a reconstruction backbone, our design uses the 1D token space as a global carrier while retaining the 2D spatial pathway for local structure restoration. Specifically, we introduce Selective Token Editing (STE), which sparsely updates/replaces a small set of critical tokens, providing a lightweight mechanism to steer global appearance coherence while keeping the fusion backbone unchanged and avoiding extra losses. Experiments on four commonly used benchmarks show that our method achieves the best overall performance, with consistent, multi-metric improvements in both global coherence and local fidelity.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有图像融合方法依赖二维特征网格，导致全局外观属性与局部细节相互纠缠，难以稳定调控全局一致性的问题。这一问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为多模态图像融合旨在整合不同传感器的互补信息，生成既保留丰富细节又保持全局协调的高质量图像。融合图像的质量直接决定了其在目标检测、语义分割等下游视觉任务中的稳定性与可靠性，因此提升融合效果对实际成像系统和智能感知应用具有关键意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统方法依赖二维特征网格，导致全局外观与局部细节相互纠缠且调控困难。为此，他们提出将两者解耦，利用预训练的压缩图像分词器构建紧凑的一维令牌空间来承载全局外观因素，同时保留二维路径处理局部结构，并设计了轻量级的选择性令牌编辑机制进行调控。该方法借鉴了现有的压缩图像分词器与多模态图像融合技术，但创新地将分词器作为固定的全局接口而非重建主干，仅对少数关键令牌进行编辑以提升融合质量。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将图像的全局外观特征与局部细节解耦，利用压缩的一维词元序列作为全局特征的紧凑载体，同时保留传统的二维特征网格负责局部细节恢复，并通过选择性编辑少数关键词元来高效调控全局外观。整体实现流程首先通过冻结的预训练编码器提取输入图像的一维特征序列，随后将其映射回二维空间与二维融合网络结合，最后经过单模态重建预热与跨模态融合解码两个训练阶段，生成最终的高质量融合图像。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于引入预训练的一维词元序列作为紧凑的全局外观载体，并设计了轻量级的选择性词元编辑机制来调控光照与对比度。相比以往依赖二维特征网格的方法，本文工作明确解耦了全局外观与局部细节的建模过程，避免了全局属性在空间网格中与高频纹理及噪声的纠缠，从而在保持局部结构清晰度的同时显著提升了融合图像的全局一致性与稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种将预训练的一维词元接口与二维融合路径相结合的轻量化框架，通过选择性编辑少数关键词元来独立调控全局光照与色调等基础属性，同时保留二维结构处理局部细节，从而显著提升了多模态图像融合的全局一致性与局部保真度。

Abstract

Multimodal image fusion aims to integrate complementary information from different modalities into a fused image that preserves rich local details while maintaining globally consistent appearance. Existing approaches build shared representations on 2D feature grids, which excel at modeling local structures but offer limited leverage over image-level global appearance factors. To balance these objectives, we introduce a compact 1D token interface based on a frozen pretrained image tokenizer for modeling non-local appearance/base factors. Rather than using the tokenizer as a reconstruction backbone, our design uses the 1D token space as a global carrier while retaining the 2D spatial pathway for local structure restoration. Specifically, we introduce Selective Token Editing (STE), which sparsely updates/replaces a small set of critical tokens, providing a lightweight mechanism to steer global appearance coherence while keeping the fusion backbone unchanged and avoiding extra losses. Experiments on four commonly used benchmarks show that our method achieves the best overall performance, with consistent, multi-metric improvements in both global coherence and local fidelity. Project page: this https URL

item.title: ToolSense: A Diagnostic Framework for Auditing Parametric Tool Knowledge in LLMs
item.author: Hathidara, Ashutosh, Sistla, Sai Shruthi, Schreiber, Sebastian, Bansal, Sahil
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ToolSense的开源诊断框架，用于评估大型语言模型作为智能体在工具目录中检索工具的能力。该框架通过生成三个基准测试（真实检索基准、多项选择题探测基准和问答探测基准）来揭示模型在工具理解方面的不足。研究发现，尽管参数化工具检索在标准基准上表现良好，但在更真实的查询下性能显著下降，且存在知识与检索分离的现象。

背景: 大型语言模型作为智能体部署在大型工具目录中时面临关键的检索瓶颈。基于嵌入的检索方法依赖紧凑的编码器，可能无法充分捕捉专业工具语义。参数化工具检索通过将每个工具编码为附加到大型语言模型词汇表中的虚拟令牌，并在两个阶段进行微调（记忆然后检索监督微调），以使用大型语言模型作为检索器，在标准工具基准上取得了强大性能。然而，这些基准使用冗长且完全指定的查询，并且其评估应用了限制输出的解码，未能揭示模型是否真正理解其工具。

目的: 引入ToolSense框架，以评估大型语言模型在工具检索中的真实理解能力，特别是针对模糊查询和事实性知识的探测。

方法: ToolSense框架接受任何工具目录作为输入，并自动生成三个基准测试：具有三个模糊层级的真实检索基准、多项选择题探测基准和问答探测基准。将ToolSense应用于包含约四万七千个工具的ToolBench，并评估五种参数模型训练配置。

主要发现: 在真实检索基准查询上，几种配置的性能比完全指定的工具基准下降了约百分之五十到六十四个百分点，低于嵌入模型基线。尽管检索性能强劲，但一些模型在事实探测中的得分接近随机，表明存在知识与检索分离的现象。

结论: 参数化工具检索在标准基准上的强大性能可能掩盖了模型在真实场景下对工具理解的不足。ToolSense框架和ToolBench诊断基准已开源。

翻译: The paper introduces ToolSense, an open-source diagnostic framework for evaluating large language models' tool retrieval capabilities. It reveals a knowledge-retrieval dissociation where models perform well on standard benchmarks but poorly on realistic queries and factual probes. The framework and benchmarks are open-sourced.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何准确评估大语言模型在参数化工具检索中是否真正理解工具语义，而非仅仅记忆查询模式与标识符的对应关系。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为大模型作为智能体在实际应用中需处理用户自然且多变的模糊指令，若模型仅依赖表面匹配或受限解码，将在自由生成场景下产生隐蔽的失败风险，严重影响下游任务的可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有参数化工具检索评估依赖冗长查询和受限解码，无法区分模型是真正理解工具还是仅进行表面模式匹配，因此设计了该诊断框架。该框架通过自动解析工具目录，生成涵盖不同模糊程度的真实检索测试集、多项选择事实探测和问答推理探测，并配套自由生成评估协议以检验知识内化程度。在设计上，作者借鉴了早期参数化检索的受限解码机制、知识探测领域的填空式提问传统，以及低秩适应技术，并将这些方法扩展应用于工具检索场景的诊断中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是通过构建贴近真实用户习惯的模糊查询和事实问答测试集，检验大模型在参数化工具检索中是真正理解了工具语义，还是仅靠记忆表面模式进行匹配。整体流程是输入任意工具目录后，自动生成包含不同模糊程度查询的检索基准、多项选择题基准和问答基准，随后在受限解码与自由生成两种模式下评估模型，并通过内部化得分量化其检索能力与真实知识掌握程度之间的差距。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是提出了ToolSense诊断框架，可自动从任意工具目录生成真实检索基准、多项选择探测基准与问答探测基准。相比以往工作依赖冗长明确的查询和受限解码，该框架采用贴近人类习惯的简短模糊查询与自由生成评估协议，并引入内化得分来衡量模型对工具的真实理解程度。这一差异有效揭示了参数化工具检索模型在检索性能与事实知识掌握之间存在的严重脱节现象。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了开源的ToolSense诊断框架以自动生成多种基准测试，公开了相关数据集，并通过实证分析揭示了参数化模型在工具知识掌握与检索能力之间存在脱节及其训练原因。

Abstract

Large language models deployed as agents over large tool catalogs face a critical tool-retrieval bottleneck. As embedding-based retrieval approaches rely on compact encoders that may under-capture specialized tool semantics, parametric tool retrieval addresses this by encoding each tool as a virtual token appended to the LLM vocabulary, fine-tuned in two stages (memorization then retrieval SFT) to use the LLM as a retriever, achieving strong performance on standard ToolBench retrieval benchmarks. Yet these benchmarks use verbose, fully-specified queries, and their evaluation applies constrained decoding that restricts outputs to valid token paths, neither reveals whether the model actually understands its tools. We introduce \textbf{ToolSense}, an open-source LLM-powered diagnostic framework that takes any tool catalog as input and automatically generates three benchmarks: a Realistic Retrieval Benchmark (RRB) with queries at three ambiguity tiers, an MCQ probing benchmark, and a QA probing benchmark. Applying ToolSense to ToolBench (~47k tools) and evaluating five parametric model training configurations reveals a knowledge-retrieval dissociation: on RRB queries, several configurations collapse by ~50-64 percentage points compared to fully-specified ToolBench benchmarks, falling below the embedding-model baseline. Additionally, despite strong retrieval performance, some models score near-random on factual probes, suggesting a knowledge-retrieval dissociation. We open-source the ToolSense framework and the ToolBench diagnostic benchmarks at this https URL .

item.title: A Stationary (and Therefore Compatible) Representation is All You Need
item.author: Niccolò Biondi, Federico Pernici, Simone Ricci, Alberto Del Bimbo
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在模型更新时学习可互换特征表示的问题，提出使用d-Simplex固定分类器结合交叉熵损失和对比损失的凸组合来学习兼容性表示，并通过实验验证了其在模型顺序微调及替换场景下的有效性。

背景: 学习兼容表示旨在当模型更新时，能够随时互换使用特征表示。

目的: 解决在模型顺序微调时，使用d-Simplex固定分类器学习兼容性的挑战，特别是捕捉模型更新间表示的高阶依赖关系。

方法: 使用d-Simplex固定分类器，通过交叉熵损失和对比损失的凸组合进行模型训练，以捕捉高阶依赖关系。

主要发现: 仅使用交叉熵损失可能无法完全捕捉模型更新间表示的高阶依赖关系；结合对比损失的凸组合训练不仅能捕捉高阶依赖关系，而且在兼容性约束下等价于仅使用交叉熵损失；在预训练模型顺序微调及偶尔替换的场景下，固定表示能实现不间断检索服务并提升性能。

结论: 基于d-Simplex固定分类器学习的平稳表示具有兼容性，能够在模型更新和替换期间提升性能并实现不间断检索服务，达到了最先进水平。

翻译: Learning compatible representations aims to learn feature representations that can be used interchangeably over time whenever a model undergoes updates. In this paper, we demonstrate that stationary representations learned by d-Simplex fixed classifiers imply compatibility as in its formal definition. This result establishes a foundation for future works and can be directly exploited in practical learning scenarios. We address the challenge of learning compatibility using d-Simplex fixed classifiers when the model is sequentially fine-tuned. Learning according to a d-Simplex fixed classifier with the cross-entropy loss aligns feature distributions at the first-order statistics. Consequently, it may not fully capture higher-order dependencies in the representation between model updates. To address this issue, we demonstrate that training the model using a d-Simplex fixed classifier through a convex combination of the cross-entropy loss and a contrastive loss not only captures higher-order dependencies, but is also equivalent to learning with the cross-entropy under the compatibility constraints. We confirm our findings with extensive experiments also considering a new scenario where a pre-trained model is sequentially fine-tuned and occasionally replaced with an improved model. We show that stationary representations enable uninterrupted retrieval services (without reprocessing gallery images) while improving performance during model updates and replacements, achieving state-of-the-art. Code at https://github.com/miccunifi/iamcl2r.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决模型在持续更新或微调时，如何学习能够直接兼容新旧特征的表示方法，从而避免每次更新后重新计算历史数据特征的难题。该问题在实际应用中至关重要，因为重新索引海量历史数据不仅计算成本极高，还可能因隐私保护或存储限制而无法实现。解决这一问题能够保障检索服务在模型迭代过程中无缝运行，同时提升模型性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现仅使用交叉熵损失配合固定分类器只能对齐特征的一阶统计量，无法充分捕捉模型更新间的高阶依赖。为了解决这一问题并保证表示的兼容性，他们设计了将交叉熵损失与对比损失相结合的联合训练方法。该方法的设计借鉴了现有文献中关于无约束特征模型、神经坍塌现象以及先前关于固定分类器与兼容性表示的研究成果，并在此基础上完善了理论证明。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用固定分类器保持特征分布的稳定性，确保模型在更新前后特征可以直接比较而无需重新计算。整体实现流程是在模型顺序微调阶段，采用几何结构固定的分类器，并将交叉熵损失与对比损失结合进行联合训练，从而在维持特征兼容性的同时有效捕捉高阶依赖关系。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于从理论上严格证明了由单纯形固定分类器学到的平稳特征表示能够完全满足兼容性的全部条件，而此前相关研究仅证明了部分条件且使用了不同的距离度量。在方法上，论文提出将交叉熵损失与对比损失结合进行顺序微调，以捕捉模型更新间的高阶依赖关系，并证明该方法在兼容约束下与交叉熵训练等价。相比以往工作，本研究不仅完善了理论证明，还验证了模型在顺序微调与定期替换场景下的实用价值。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文从理论上证明了单纯形固定分类器所学习的平稳特征表示能够完全满足模型兼容性要求，并提出结合交叉熵与对比损失的训练方法以捕捉高阶依赖，从而在模型顺序微调场景中实现了无需重新索引的高效兼容学习。

Abstract

Learning compatible representations aims to learn feature representations that can be used interchangeably over time whenever a model undergoes updates. In this paper, we demonstrate that stationary representations learned by d-Simplex fixed classifiers imply compatibility as in its formal definition. This result establishes a foundation for future works and can be directly exploited in practical learning scenarios. We address the challenge of learning compatibility using $d$-Simplex fixed classifiers when the model is sequentially fine-tuned. Learning according to a d-Simplex fixed classifier with the cross-entropy loss aligns feature distributions at the first-order statistics. Consequently, it may not fully capture higher-order dependencies in the representation between model updates. To address this issue, we demonstrate that training the model using a $d$-Simplex fixed classifier through a convex combination of the cross-entropy loss and a contrastive loss not only captures higher-order dependencies, but is also equivalent to learning with the cross-entropy under the compatibility constraints. We confirm our findings with extensive experiments also considering a new scenario where a pre-trained model is sequentially fine-tuned and occasionally replaced with an improved model. We show that stationary representations enable uninterrupted retrieval services (without reprocessing gallery images) while improving performance during model updates and replacements, achieving state-of-the-art. Code at https://github.com/miccunifi/iamcl2r.

item.title: Dolph2Vec: Self-Supervised Representations of Dolphin Vocalizations
item.author: Chiara Semenzin, Faadil Mustun, Roberto Dessi, Pierre Orhan, Alexis Emanuelli, Yair Lakretz, Gonzalo de Polavieja, German Sumbre
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Dolph2Vec的大规模物种特异性自监督学习模型，用于研究海豚通信。该模型基于五年半自然环境下的海豚录音数据训练，在签名哨声分类和哨声检测任务上显著优于通用基线模型。学习到的嵌入和码本结构能够捕捉与海豚哨声类别及子哨声结构对齐的可解释声学单元，为通信模式的细粒度分析提供了科学工具。

背景: 自监督学习通过无需昂贵的人工标注即可实现动物发声的可扩展建模，为生物声学领域带来了新机遇。然而，当前该领域的自监督学习模型侧重于跨物种的广泛泛化，未针对揭示个体通信系统的细粒度结构进行优化。

目的: 开发一种专门针对海豚通信的自监督学习模型，以克服现有模型在细粒度结构分析上的不足，并探索其在动物通信研究中的应用潜力。

方法: 收集并发布了来自半自然海洋环境中五只已知海豚的五年纵向录音数据集。基于Wav2Vec2.0架构进行适配，使用此数据独家训练了Dolph2Vec模型。在签名哨声分类和哨声检测两个生物学相关任务上对模型进行基准测试，并分析学习到的嵌入和码本结构。

主要发现: Dolph2Vec在签名哨声分类和哨声检测任务上显著优于通用基线模型。学习到的嵌入和码本结构捕捉到了与海豚哨声类别及可能的子哨声结构对齐的可解释声学单元，支持对通信模式的细粒度分析。

结论: 自监督学习不仅可以作为建模工具，还可以作为科学工具，用于探索动物通信研究中的假设。

翻译: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has opened new opportunities in bioacoustics by enabling scalable modeling of animal vocalizations without the need for expensive manual annotation. However, current SSL models in this domain prioritize broad generalization across species and are not optimized for uncovering the fine-grained structure of individual communication systems. In this work, we collect and release a novel dataset of over five years of longitudinal recordings, from five known dolphins in a semi-naturalistic marine environment, an unprecedented resource for studying dolphin communication. We adapt the Wav2Vec2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) architecture to this domain and introduce Dolph2Vec, the first large-scale, species-specific SSL model trained exclusively on this data. We benchmark our model on two biologically relevant tasks: signature whistle classification and whistle detection. Dolph2Vec significantly outperforms general-purpose baselines in both tasks. Beyond performance, we show that learned embeddings and codebook structure capture interpretable acoustic units aligned with dolphin whistle categories and possibly sub-whistle structure, enabling fine-grained analysis of communication patterns. Our findings demonstrate how SSL can serve as both a model and a scientific tool to explore hypotheses in animal communication research.

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) has opened new opportunities in bioacoustics by enabling scalable modeling of animal vocalizations without the need for expensive manual annotation. However, current SSL models in this domain prioritize broad generalization across species and are not optimized for uncovering the fine-grained structure of individual communication systems. In this work, we collect and release a novel dataset of over five years of longitudinal recordings, from five known dolphins in a semi-naturalistic marine environment, an unprecedented resource for studying dolphin communication. We adapt the Wav2Vec2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) architecture to this domain and introduce Dolph2Vec, the first large-scale, species-specific SSL model trained exclusively on this data. We benchmark our model on two biologically relevant tasks: signature whistle classification and whistle detection. Dolph2Vec significantly outperforms general-purpose baselines in both tasks. Beyond performance, we show that learned embeddings and codebook structure capture interpretable acoustic units aligned with dolphin whistle categories and possibly sub-whistle structure, enabling fine-grained analysis of communication patterns. Our findings demonstrate how SSL can serve as both a model and a scientific tool to explore hypotheses in animal communication research.

item.title: High-Fidelity Two-Step Image Generation via Teacher-Aligned End-to-End Distillation
item.author: Liu, Dongyang, Du, Ruoyi, Liu, David, Jiang, Dengyang, Li, Liangchen, Wu, Qilong, Li, Zhen, Hoi, Steven C. H., Li, Hongsheng, Gao, Peng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Z-Image Turbo++，一种从八步Z-Image Turbo教师模型蒸馏而来的高质量两步图像生成模型。该方法通过三种针对两步生成量身定制的设计选择，解决了任务难度增加和模型容量有限等核心瓶颈问题。

背景: 少步扩散蒸馏技术对于四到八步的生成已日益成熟，但进一步推至两步生成仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 开发一种高质量的两步图像生成模型，以缩小两步生成与八步生成之间的质量差距，提高生成质量与效率的权衡。

方法: 提出三种设计选择：一是分布对齐对抗学习，使用教师生成的图像而非外部真实图像作为生成对抗网络训练的真实样本；二是步骤解耦参数化，为两个去噪步骤分配独立的模型参数以匹配其不同的容量需求；三是端到端训练结合迭代正则化，使第一步能从最终图像质量中接收梯度，同时通过显式的第一步损失保留有意义的中间生成。

主要发现: 这些设计在定性和定量评估中显著缩小了两步生成与八步生成之间的质量差距。

结论: 精心定制的蒸馏策略具有提高少步生成中质量与效率权衡的潜力。

翻译: Z-Image Turbo++: A High-Quality 2-Step Image Generation Model via Tailored Distillation Strategies

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要致力于将扩散模型图像生成的步数压缩至仅两步，同时克服训练不稳定与模型容量受限的瓶颈以维持高画质。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为传统扩散模型计算成本极高，而两步生成能在最大化推理效率的同时保留必要的迭代结构，有效打破质量与速度的权衡限制，大幅降低AI图像生成的部署门槛。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过实验发现，将生成步数压缩至两步会面临单步覆盖范围过大导致优化困难，以及两步任务差异显著导致共享参数容量不足的两大核心挑战。为此，他们设计了三项关键技术：采用教师模型生成的图像作为对抗训练的真实样本以提升目标可达性，将两步的模型参数独立更新以匹配各自不同的能力需求，以及通过端到端训练配合显式中间步损失来协调两步的生成过程。该方法充分借鉴了现有少步蒸馏工作，直接以成熟的八步模型为教师网络，并吸收了分布匹配蒸馏与生成对抗网络蒸馏的核心思想与损失函数框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过知识蒸馏将多步图像生成模型压缩至仅用两步，并针对两步生成的优化难度和容量限制设计了三项关键技术。整体实现流程分为两个阶段：首先准备一个成熟的八步教师模型，随后以此为基础进行两步学生模型的蒸馏训练。训练过程中采用教师生成的图像作为判别器样本以提升稳定性，将两步的模型参数独立更新以匹配不同任务需求，并通过端到端联合训练与迭代正则化实现两步协同，最终在保持高质量的同时大幅降低推理步数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点主要包括三项：首先提出分布对齐的对抗学习，使用教师模型生成的图像而非外部真实图像作为判别器训练样本，使对抗目标更稳定且易于逼近。其次采用步骤解耦的参数化设计，为两个去噪步骤分配独立的模型参数，以匹配它们截然不同的能力需求并减少相互干扰。最后实施带迭代正则化的端到端训练，使第一步能直接接收最终图像质量的梯度，同时保留中间生成结果。与以往工作相比，本文针对仅两步生成的极端挑战，打破了传统共享参数和使用外部真实数据的默认设置，通过专门适配目标分布、参数结构和优化流程的设计，显著缩小了两步生成与多步生成之间的质量差距。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种高质量的两步图像生成方法，通过教师对齐的对抗学习、步骤解耦参数化以及端到端迭代正则化训练，成功克服了极步数生成的优化与容量瓶颈，显著缩小了两步与八步生成的质量差距。

Abstract

Few-step diffusion distillation has become increasingly mature for 4-8-step generation, yet pushing further to 2 steps remains challenging. In this work, we introduce Z-Image Turbo++, a high-quality 2-step image generation model distilled from the 8-step Z-Image Turbo teacher. Our method addresses the central bottlenecks of increased task difficulty and limited model capacity in 2-step generation through three simple but effective design choices tailored to this regime. First, we propose Distribution-Aligned Adversarial Learning, which uses teacher-generated images rather than external real images as real samples for GAN training, providing a more attainable and informative adversarial target. Second, we adopt Step-Decoupled Parameterization, assigning independent model parameters to the two denoising steps to better match their distinct capacity demands. Third, we perform End-to-End Training with Iterative Regularization, allowing the first step to receive gradients from final image quality while preserving a meaningful intermediate generation through an explicit step-1 loss. Together, these designs substantially narrow the quality gap between 2-step and 8-step generation in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, highlighting the potential of carefully tailored distillation strategies for improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in few-step generation.

item.title: Emerging Flexible Designs for Geospatial Multimodal Foundation Models
item.author: Philipe Dias, Waqwoya Abebe, Abhishek Potnis, Aristeidis Tsaris, Dan Lu, Xiao Wang, Dalton Lunga
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究对用于地理空间多模态推理的基础模型架构进行了全面比较，重点关注其在不同光谱波段配置下的灵活性，为构建下一代地理空间基础模型提供了实践指导。

背景: 基础模型正在通过跨多种无标签地理空间模态的可扩展预训练迅速改变地球观测领域。然而，从仅编码器到编码器解码器以及掩码自编码范式的架构多样性使得难以一致地评估性能权衡。

目的: 对专为地理空间多模态推理设计的主要基础模型架构进行公平比较，特别关注其在不同光谱波段配置下的灵活性。

方法: 使用相同的自监督学习目标和训练数据集标准化预训练过程，并在GEOBench基准测试的分类和分割任务中，以一致的参数化设置评估所有模型。

主要发现: 研究结果揭示了模型灵活性、模态对齐与下游任务性能之间的设计权衡，并突出了在受控条件下各架构的优势与局限性。

结论: 该研究为构建能够进行稳健多模态推理的下一代地理空间基础模型提供了实践指导。

翻译: Foundation models are rapidly transforming Earth observation by enabling scalable pretraining across diverse unlabeled geospatial modalities. However, their architectural diversity ranging from encoder-only to encoder-decoder and masked autoencoding paradigms makes it challenging to assess performance trade offs in a consistent manner. In this work, we present an apples-to-apples comparison of leading FM architectures designed for geospatial multimodal reasoning, with a particular focus on flexibility across varied spectral band configurations. We standardize pretraining using identical self supervised learning objectives and training datasets, and evaluate all models under consistent parameterization on the GEOBench benchmark across classification and segmentation tasks. Our results offer new insights into the design trade-offs between model flexibility, modality alignment, and downstream task performance. By highlighting architectural strengths and limitations under controlled conditions, this study provides practical guidance for building next generation geospatial foundation models capable of robust multimodal reasoning.

Abstract

Foundation models are rapidly transforming Earth observation by enabling scalable pretraining across diverse unlabeled geospatial modalities. However, their architectural diversity ranging from encoder-only to encoder-decoder and masked autoencoding paradigms makes it challenging to assess performance trade offs in a consistent manner. In this work, we present an apples-to-apples comparison of leading FM architectures designed for geospatial multimodal reasoning, with a particular focus on flexibility across varied spectral band configurations. We standardize pretraining using identical self supervised learning objectives and training datasets, and evaluate all models under consistent parameterization on the GEOBench benchmark across classification and segmentation tasks. Our results offer new insights into the design trade-offs between model flexibility, modality alignment, and downstream task performance. By highlighting architectural strengths and limitations under controlled conditions, this study provides practical guidance for building next generation geospatial foundation models capable of robust multimodal reasoning.

item.title: Evoflux: Inference-Time Evolution of Executable Tool Workflows for Compact Agents
item.author: Bhandari, Kushal Raj, Yue, Ling, Ko, Ching-Yun, Patel, Dhaval, Pan, Shaowu, Chen, Pin-Yu, Gao, Jianxi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Evoflux的推理时进化搜索方法，用于提升紧凑型语言模型在工具使用中的执行可行性。

背景: 紧凑型语言模型虽然能降低成本、延迟和部署风险，但在处理MCP风格工具使用时，小规划器常因工具解析、参数验证、依赖跟踪或执行失败而表现不佳。

目的: 解决小规划器在工具使用中的失败模式，特别是在工具目录变化时的计划修复问题。

方法: 引入Evoflux方法，通过结构化编辑、执行反馈、自适应强度、元引导重新设计和多样性剪枝来进化类型化工作流图。

主要发现: 在MCP-Bench任务上，Evoflux将执行可行性从约3%提升至17-24%，优于SFT、SFT+DPO和ReAct方法。

结论: 执行基础的搜索在教师轨迹预算稀缺的情况下更可靠。

翻译: Compact language models (LMs) reduce cost, latency, and deployment risk for tool agents. Yet MCP-style tool use requires more than isolated function calling: an agent must discover tools from live catalogs, satisfy schemas, preserve dependencies across intermediate outputs, and ground final responses in executed evidence. Small planners often generate plausible workflow graphs that fail under tool resolution, parameter validation, dependency tracking, or execution. We argue that this failure mode is poorly handled by small-corpus distillation. A few hundred teacher traces can teach workflow format, but rarely cover the recovery behavior needed to repair failed plans over changing tool catalogs. We introduce Evoflux, an inference-time evolutionary search method that treats compact tool use as the repair of executable tool workflows. It evolves typed workflow graphs through structured edits, execution feedback, adaptive intensity, meta-guided redesign, and diversity pruning. On held-out MCP-Bench tasks spanning live MCP servers and 250 tools, Evoflux raises execution feasibility from roughly 3% to 17-24% across small planners. In contrast, SFT and SFT+DPO on the same search-mined data match, underperform, or collapse below zero-shot performance; ReAct reaches higher peaks, but with higher variance and token cost. These results show that execution-grounded search is more reliable under scarce teacher-trace budgets.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决小型语言模型在调用外部工具时难以构建和修复可执行工作流的问题。当前小型模型虽然成本低、响应快且利于隐私保护，但在面对动态工具目录和复杂依赖时容易生成看似合理却无法运行的计划。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为提升小型模型的可靠工具使用能力，能够在不依赖海量训练数据和昂贵大模型的前提下，实现低成本、低延迟且安全的智能体部署，推动轻量化人工智能在真实场景中的落地。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为小型模型在工具工作流生成中容易出错，且少量教师数据的蒸馏无法覆盖修复失败计划的行为，因此提出在训练与推理时搜索之间进行权衡，将工具使用重新定义为可执行工作流的修复问题。设计上，该方法将计划表示为类型化工作流图，通过执行反馈、自适应强度控制、元引导重构和多样性剪枝等结构化编辑，在推理阶段构建一个受限的执行与修复循环。该方法借鉴了先前的推理时搜索与执行反馈研究，以及将语言模型作为语义变异算子的进化算法，并将评估器引导的进化搜索思想适配到了动态工具目录的工作流图中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将小型模型的工具调用视为推理阶段的持续修复过程，依靠实际执行反馈而非海量训练数据来优化工作流。整体流程为：模型首先生成初始工作流图，系统将其编译并实际运行以获取错误证据与评分；随后根据反馈进行结构化的局部修改（如替换工具、调整参数或修复依赖），并保留表现最优的候选方案；该过程在固定计算预算内循环迭代，直至生成可成功执行的工作流。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种推理阶段的进化搜索方法，将小型语言模型的复杂工具调用转化为可执行工作流的在线修复过程。该方法通过结构化的类型化编辑、基于实际执行反馈的评分机制、自适应搜索强度控制以及元引导重设计，持续迭代并优化工作流。与以往依赖有限教师轨迹进行监督微调或偏好优化的方法不同，它不再依赖离线参数更新，而是将计算资源集中于在线执行与修复，在训练数据稀缺的情况下显著提升了工作流的执行可行性与稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为Evoflux的推理时进化搜索方法，将小型模型的工具调用视为可执行工作流的动态修复过程，通过执行反馈与结构化编辑显著提升了任务可行性，并证明了在训练数据稀缺时推理时搜索比传统微调更为可靠有效。

Abstract

Compact language models (LMs) reduce cost, latency, and deployment risk for tool agents. Yet MCP-style tool use requires more than isolated function calling: an agent must discover tools from live catalogs, satisfy schemas, preserve dependencies across intermediate outputs, and ground final responses in executed evidence. Small planners often generate plausible workflow graphs that fail under tool resolution, parameter validation, dependency tracking, or execution. We argue that this failure mode is poorly handled by small-corpus distillation. A few hundred teacher traces can teach workflow format, but rarely cover the recovery behavior needed to repair failed plans over changing tool catalogs. We introduce Evoflux, an inference-time evolutionary search method that treats compact tool use as the repair of executable tool workflows. It evolves typed workflow graphs through structured edits, execution feedback, adaptive intensity, meta-guided redesign, and diversity pruning. On held-out MCP-Bench tasks spanning live MCP servers and 250 tools, Evoflux raises execution feasibility from roughly 3% to 17-24% across small planners. In contrast, SFT and SFT+DPO on the same search-mined data match, underperform, or collapse below zero-shot performance; ReAct reaches higher peaks, but with higher variance and token cost. These results show that execution-grounded search is more reliable under scarce teacher-trace budgets.

item.title: Two-Layer Linear Auto-Regressive Models Estimate Latent States
item.author: Yahya Sattar, Sunmook Choi, Leo Maynard-Zhang, Yassir Jedra, Maryam Fazel, Sarah Dean
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了自回归模型在部分观测线性动力系统数据上训练时，如何学习潜在表示的问题。

背景: 自回归模型已成为处理从语言到视频等序列数据的强大工具，但理解这些模型如何学习潜在表示仍是一个开放的理论问题。

目的: 探讨自回归模型在训练过程中学习潜在表示的机制，特别是其与最优滤波器的关系。

方法: 通过理论分析，研究两层线性自回归模型在经验风险最小化训练下的行为，结合数值模拟验证。

主要发现: 两层线性自回归模型在训练后自然学习近似卡尔曼滤波；其学习的隐藏表示与最优滤波器的状态估计在相似变换下重合；优化景观是良性的，所有驻点要么是严格鞍点要么是全球最小值。

结论: 自回归模型能够恢复状态估计，理论结果得到了数值模拟的支持，为预测误差、参数估计误差和潜在状态恢复提供了有限样本保证。

翻译: Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video. Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question. In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering. In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state. The result follows from three main insights. First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error. Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima. Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery. Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.

Abstract

Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video. Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question. In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering. In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state. The result follows from three main insights. First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error. Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima. Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery. Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.

item.title: A Tutorial on World Models and Physical AI
item.author: Il-Seok Oh
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 世界建模是构建具备预测、推理和决策能力的智能系统的核心原则。

背景: 世界建模分为显式世界模型和隐式世界模型两种范式。显式模型学习结构化动态以支持基于展开的推理和规划，隐式模型则在可扩展的学习表示中编码预测结构。这两种互补范式为机器人和自动驾驶等领域的物理人工智能奠定了基础，使智能能够超越现实约束下的反应式控制。近期基础模型的发展进一步为整合感知、预测和行动的统一系统提供了路径。

目的: 提出一个连贯的框架，将多样化的世界建模方法通过共享的预测结构统一起来，并区分它们如何表示和利用这种结构。

方法: 通过共享的预测结构统一不同的世界建模方法，并分析这些方法在表示和利用预测结构方面的差异。

主要发现: 尽管世界建模取得了快速进展，但在分层推理、长视距规划和自主目标形成方面仍面临重大挑战，这些挑战对于向通用人工智能迈进至关重要。

结论: 世界建模通过共享预测结构统一了不同方法，为构建智能系统提供了基础，但需解决分层推理、长视距规划和自主目标形成等挑战以推动通用人工智能的发展。

翻译: World modeling is emerging as a central principle for building intelligent systems capable of prediction, reasoning, and decision making. A central distinction can be drawn between explicit world models, which learn structured dynamics for rollout-based reasoning and planning, and implicit world models, which encode predictive structure within scalable learned representations. These complementary paradigms provide a foundation for physical AI in domains such as robotics and autonomous driving, enabling intelligence beyond reactive control under real-world constraints. Recent foundation models further suggest a pathway toward unified systems integrating perception, prediction, and action. Despite rapid progress, major challenges remain in hierarchical reasoning, long-horizon planning, and autonomous goal formation, which are critical for advancing toward artificial general intelligence. This tutorial presents a coherent framework in which diverse world modeling approaches are unified through shared predictive structure and differentiated by how such structure is represented and exploited.

Abstract

World modeling is emerging as a central principle for building intelligent systems capable of prediction, reasoning, and decision making. A central distinction can be drawn between explicit world models, which learn structured dynamics for rollout-based reasoning and planning, and implicit world models, which encode predictive structure within scalable learned representations. These complementary paradigms provide a foundation for physical AI in domains such as robotics and autonomous driving, enabling intelligence beyond reactive control under real-world constraints. Recent foundation models further suggest a pathway toward unified systems integrating perception, prediction, and action. Despite rapid progress, major challenges remain in hierarchical reasoning, long-horizon planning, and autonomous goal formation, which are critical for advancing toward artificial general intelligence. This tutorial presents a coherent framework in which diverse world modeling approaches are unified through shared predictive structure and differentiated by how such structure is represented and exploited.

item.title: A wrong ground-state structure of HfO$_2$ predicted by machine-learning interatomic potentials based on the PBE functional
item.author: Shuqi Tang, Jinchen Wei, Kang Wang, Junjie Zhou, Yihan Zhang, Menglin Huang, Shiyou Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 机器学习原子间势在材料模拟中成为强大工具，但基于PBE泛函训练的模型在预测二氧化铪结构时出现错误，高估了低密度结构的稳定性。

背景: 机器学习原子间势已成为材料模拟的强大工具，许多此类势函数基于使用PBE交换关联泛函生成的密度泛函理论数据集进行训练。

目的: 研究基于PBE泛函的机器学习原子间势在预测二氧化铪晶体结构和相变时的可靠性，并探讨误差来源及抑制方法。

方法: 使用基于PBE泛函的机器学习原子间势对二氧化铪进行模拟，比较不同密度泛函理论泛函的计算结果，并分析极化翻转路径上的能量景观和势垒高度。

主要发现: 基于PBE泛函的模型预测出一种此前未报道的低能量I41/amd结构，该结构被错误地预测为比已知的单斜P21/c基态结构更稳定。这种误差源于PBE泛函高估了包含六配位铪氧八面体单元的低密度结构的稳定性，且广泛使用的PBE基础模型也做出了相同错误预测。其他泛函如PBEsol和局域密度近似可大幅抑制此误差。

结论: 交换关联泛函近似中的误差会严重影响机器学习原子间势在晶体结构和相变模拟中的可靠性，研究对此发出警告。

翻译: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become powerful tools for material simulations. Many MLIPs are trained based on density functional theory (DFT) datasets generated with the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) exchange-correlation functional. Using a PBE-based MLIP for HfO2, we identify a previously unreported low-energy I41/amd structure, which is predicted to be more stable than the well-known ground-state structure, the monoclinic P21/c structure. Since experiments show clearly that HfO2 takes the P21/c structure as the ground state, this is obviously a wrong prediction. Unfortunately, the same prediction is also made by widely used PBE-based foundation models such as NequIP-OAM-L and MatterSim-v1-5M. Comparisons among different DFT functionals show that this error originates from the PBE functional, which overstabilizes low-density structures containing sixfold Hf-O octahedral units, such as the I41/amd and Pbcn phases. The error also affects the calculated energy landscapes and barrier heights along ferroelectric HfO2 polarization switching paths when there are large lattice relaxations. Fortunately, the error can be largely suppressed by other functionals such as PBEsol and local density approximation. Our study serves as a warning about the impact of errors in exchange-correlation functional approximations on the reliability of MLIP simulations of crystal structures and phase transitions.

Abstract

Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become powerful tools for material simulations. Many MLIPs are trained based on density functional theory (DFT) datasets generated with the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) exchange-correlation functional. Using a PBE-based MLIP for HfO2, we identify a previously unreported low-energy I41/amd structure, which is predicted to be more stable than the well-known ground-state structure, the monoclinic P21/c structure. Since experiments show clearly that HfO2 takes the P21/c structure as the ground state, this is obviously a wrong prediction. Unfortunately, the same prediction is also made by widely used PBE-based foundation models such as NequIP-OAM-L and MatterSim-v1-5M. Comparisons among different DFT functionals show that this error originates from the PBE functional, which overstabilizes low-density structures containing sixfold Hf-O octahedral units, such as the I41/amd and Pbcn phases. The error also affects the calculated energy landscapes and barrier heights along ferroelectric HfO2 polarization switching paths when there are large lattice relaxations. Fortunately, the error can be largely suppressed by other functionals such as PBEsol and local density approximation. Our study serves as a warning about the impact of errors in exchange-correlation functional approximations on the reliability of MLIP simulations of crystal structures and phase transitions.

item.title: GeoNatureAgent Benchmark: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Environmental Geospatial Analysis Across Frontier and Open-Weight Foundation Models
item.author: Gabriel Diaz-Ireland, Diego Prieto-Herráez, Mario García Peces, Javier Velázquez, Devika Jain
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了GeoNatureAgent基准测试，这是首个针对通过结构化工具调用操作生产级地理空间API的环境分析AI代理的基准测试。该基准测试包含93个任务，涵盖18个类别，并在西班牙和葡萄牙的开放自托管API上对七个大语言模型进行了评估。研究发现Claude Sonnet 4性能最佳，开放权重模型在成本效益方面表现突出，而比较任务仍存在系统性推理局限。该基准测试比通用地理信息系统基准更具区分度，且所有资源已公开。

背景: 环境科学家在数据整理上花费了不成比例的时间，而自动化地理空间工作流的AI代理尚未得到验证。目前缺乏评估代理通过结构化工具调用与真实API交互的基准测试。

目的: 引入GeoNatureAgent基准测试，作为首个针对通过结构化工具调用操作生产级地理空间API的环境分析AI代理的评估基准。

方法: 构建了包含93个任务、18个类别的基准测试，涵盖市政分析、多轮对话、空间推理等。使用服务于西班牙和葡萄牙三个环境指标的开放自托管API及十六个工具进行评估。对七个大语言模型在三个温度种子下进行了评估，报告能力和案例成本。

主要发现: Claude Sonnet 4以60.8%的准确率领先，DeepSeek V3.2次之。成本效益帕累托前沿主要由开放权重模型占据，DeepSeek V3.2以更低成本提供接近Claude的能力。比较任务普遍未解决，暴露系统性推理局限。结构化工具调用对真实API的评估比通用地理信息系统基准更具区分度，准确率更低。

结论: GeoNatureAgent基准测试、工具包和自托管API已公开。该基准测试能有效评估环境分析代理，并展示了扩展性，如整合土地覆盖数据。

翻译: Environmental scientists spend disproportionate effort on data wrangling rather than analysis, and AI agents that automate geospatial workflows remain unvalidated: no benchmark evaluates agents operating through structured tool calling against real APIs. We introduce the GeoNatureAgent Benchmark, the first benchmark for environmental analysis agents that operate via structured tool calls to a production-style geospatial API. It comprises 93 tasks across 18 categories, covering municipality analysis, multi-turn conversation, spatial reasoning, cross-indicator synthesis, error handling and recovery, ranking, comparison, multilingual understanding, habitat analysis, and task rejection. Tasks are evaluated against an open, self-hostable API serving three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal via sixteen tools. We evaluate seven LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Qwen3-235B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama 4 Scout) under three temperature-1.0 seeds, reporting capability and per-case cost as orthogonal axes. We find: (1) Claude Sonnet 4 leads at 60.8% +/- 0.8%, followed by DeepSeek V3.2 at 56.3% +/- 3.1%, with no other model above 51%; (2) the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is occupied mostly by open-weight models, with DeepSeek V3.2 offering 93% of Claude's capability at 11x lower cost ($0.011/case); (3) comparison tasks remain universally unsolved (0% on close-value comparisons), exposing systematic reasoning limits; and (4) structured tool calling against a real API is more discriminative than general-purpose GIS benchmarks, with accuracies 25-35 points lower. We further show extensibility by integrating BigEarthNet V2 land cover for Portugal alongside Spanish CO2 and erosion indicators. The benchmark, harness, and self-hostable API are publicly available.

Abstract

Environmental scientists spend disproportionate effort on data wrangling rather than analysis, and AI agents that automate geospatial workflows remain unvalidated: no benchmark evaluates agents operating through structured tool calling against real APIs. We introduce the GeoNatureAgent Benchmark, the first benchmark for environmental analysis agents that operate via structured tool calls to a production-style geospatial API. It comprises 93 tasks across 18 categories, covering municipality analysis, multi-turn conversation, spatial reasoning, cross-indicator synthesis, error handling and recovery, ranking, comparison, multilingual understanding, habitat analysis, and task rejection. Tasks are evaluated against an open, self-hostable API serving three environmental indicators across Spain and Portugal via sixteen tools. We evaluate seven LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Qwen3-235B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama 4 Scout) under three temperature-1.0 seeds, reporting capability and per-case cost as orthogonal axes. We find: (1) Claude Sonnet 4 leads at 60.8% +/- 0.8%, followed by DeepSeek V3.2 at 56.3% +/- 3.1%, with no other model above 51%; (2) the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier is occupied mostly by open-weight models, with DeepSeek V3.2 offering 93% of Claude's capability at 11x lower cost ($0.011/case); (3) comparison tasks remain universally unsolved (0% on close-value comparisons), exposing systematic reasoning limits; and (4) structured tool calling against a real API is more discriminative than general-purpose GIS benchmarks, with accuracies 25-35 points lower. We further show extensibility by integrating BigEarthNet V2 land cover for Portugal alongside Spanish CO2 and erosion indicators. The benchmark, harness, and self-hostable API are publicly available.

item.title: HarnessBridge: Learnable Bidirectional Controller for LLM Agent Harness
item.author: Wang, Xiaoxuan, Wang, Haixin, Taylor, Alexander, Cong, Jason, Sun, Yizhou, Wang, Wei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为HarnessBridge的可学习插件模块，用于生成大型语言模型在长程任务中作为智能体时的环境交互接口（harness）。该模块通过双向投影参数化智能体与环境之间的接口，包括将原始轨迹蒸馏为紧凑决策状态的状态投影，以及将提议动作转换为可执行转换或基于轨迹拒绝的动作投影。HarnessBridge通过统一指令调优在监督数据集上进行训练，在Terminal-Bench 2.0和SWE-bench Verified基准测试中表现优异，匹配或超越了强大的专用harness，同时显著减少了token使用量和轨迹长度，并展现出从小型生成器到大型商业模型的泛化能力。

背景: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为执行长程任务的智能体，但其性能不仅取决于模型能力和环境设计，还受到中介智能体与环境交互的harness的影响。现有的harness大多是人工设计的，随着轨迹变长和交互变复杂，难以扩展。

目的: 探讨是否可以通过一个可学习的插件模块来生成harness，并能够以端到端的方式进行训练。

方法: 引入HarnessBridge，一个轻量级的可学习harness控制器，将智能体与环境接口参数化为双向投影。学习两种双向投影：状态投影（将原始轨迹蒸馏为紧凑、与决策相关的状态）和动作投影（将提议的动作转换为可执行的转换或基于轨迹的拒绝）。通过统一指令调优在harness监督数据集上训练HarnessBridge。

主要发现: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0和SWE-bench Verified上，HarnessBridge匹配或超越了强大的专用harness，同时显著减少了token使用量和轨迹长度。它还能从小型生成器泛化到大型商业模型。

结论: HarnessBridge作为一种可学习的harness控制器，能够有效中介智能体与环境的交互，提升效率并具备泛化能力。

翻译: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents for long-horizon tasks, yet their performance is shaped not only by model capability and environment design, but also by the harness that mediates agent--environment interaction. Existing harnesses are largely manually engineered, making them difficult to scale as trajectories grow longer and interactions become more complex. In this work, we ask whether harness can be generated by a learnable plug-in module that can be trained in an end-to-end fashion. We introduce HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection. HarnessBridge learns two bidirectional projections: observation projection, which distills raw trajectories into compact, decision-relevant states, and action projection, which converts proposed actions into executable transitions or trajectory-grounded rejections. We train HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning. On Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-bench Verified, HarnessBridge matches or surpasses strong specialized harnesses while substantially reducing token usage and trajectory length, and generalizes from smaller generators to larger commercial models.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在长程任务中，依赖人工设计的交互中介难以扩展、容易积累冗余信息且无法动态过滤低效动作的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为固定的人工接口会显著增加计算成本、掩盖关键决策信息，并导致智能体执行无效操作。将交互中介转化为可学习的模块能够大幅提升系统效率、降低资源消耗，并增强智能体处理复杂长期任务的能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有智能体交互框架多依赖人工设计且难以扩展，因此思考能否将交互逻辑转化为可全程学习的模块。基于此，他们设计了HarnessBridge，将智能体与环境的接口参数化为双向投影策略，分别通过观察投影压缩历史状态、通过动作投影过滤无效操作，并利用统一指令微调进行训练。在借鉴现有工作方面，作者参考了将框架本身作为优化目标的自动化构建研究，但指出这些工作多聚焦于外部脚手架的搜索，而本文则专注于学习运行时双向信息流转的底层策略。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是用一个可学习的轻量级控制器替代传统的人工设计交互规则，动态管理大模型智能体与环境之间的信息流动。整体流程分为双向处理：首先将原始交互历史压缩并过滤无关信息，提取关键状态供模型决策；随后对模型提出的动作进行实时校验，通过的动作直接执行，不合理的动作则被拒绝并附带基于历史轨迹的修改建议，从而提升长期任务的效率与稳定性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新在于首次将智能体与环境的交互接口转化为可学习的策略，通过统一指令微调训练了双向投影机制，分别负责压缩历史状态和过滤执行动作。与以往依赖人工编写规则或仅优化外部框架的工作不同，该方法能够动态决定哪些信息传递给智能体、哪些动作被环境执行或拒绝，从而在保持甚至提升任务表现的同时显著降低计算资源消耗。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了HarnessBridge，一种可学习的端到端双向交互控制器，通过统一指令微调替代传统人工设计的系统逻辑，在显著降低计算资源消耗的同时实现了与专业人工系统相当或更优的任务性能与泛化能力。

Abstract

Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents for long-horizon tasks, yet their performance is shaped not only by model capability and environment design, but also by the harness that mediates agent--environment interaction. Existing harnesses are largely manually engineered, making them difficult to scale as trajectories grow longer and interactions become more complex. In this work, we ask whether harness can be generated by a learnable plug-in module that can be trained in an end-to-end fashion. We introduce HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection. HarnessBridge learns two bidirectional projections: observation projection, which distills raw trajectories into compact, decision-relevant states, and action projection, which converts proposed actions into executable transitions or trajectory-grounded rejections. We train HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning. On Terminal-Bench~2.0 and SWE-bench Verified, HarnessBridge matches or surpasses strong specialized harnesses while substantially reducing token usage and trajectory length, and generalizes from smaller generators to larger commercial models.

item.title: Where Computation Lives Inside TabPFN: Causal Localisation of Attention Head Function
item.author: Atharva Gupta, Dhruv Kumar, Murari Mandal, Saurabh Deshpande
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对表格基础模型TabPFN 2.5进行了首次因果机制分析，研究了其逐特征注意力头在层间如何分配计算。通过激活修补、消融实验和注意力熵分析，发现存在明显的时序专业化现象：一个注意力头在峰值层的因果必要性是其他头的2到5倍，且其主导层随任务复杂度变化，其余头则呈现对称的晚期层分布。此外，通过对比激活引导研究推理时的可控性，发现该方法无法跨样本迁移，归因于TabPFN的上下文学习机制依赖于上下文依赖的注意力而非稳定的参数方向。

背景: 表格基础模型TabPFN 2.5的机制尚不明确，特别是其注意力头在层间的计算分配方式。

目的: 对TabPFN 2.5进行因果机制分析，探究其逐特征注意力头如何分布计算，并研究推理时的可控性。

方法: 使用激活修补、消融实验和注意力熵分析，在两个合成回归数据集上进行研究；同时通过对比激活引导方法研究推理时的可控性。

主要发现: 存在明显的时序专业化：一个注意力头在峰值层的因果必要性显著高于其他头（2到5倍），其主导层随任务复杂度变化；其余头呈现对称的晚期层分布；激活修补和注意力熵为活跃层提供了收敛证据；对比激活引导无法跨样本迁移。

结论: TabPFN的上下文学习机制通过上下文依赖的注意力编码任务结构，而非像语言模型那样依赖稳定的参数方向，这导致其推理时的可控性难以跨样本迁移。

翻译: We present the first causal mechanistic analysis of a tabular foundation model, investigating how TabPFN 2.5's feature wise attention heads distribute computation across layers. Using activation patching, ablation, and attention entropy across two synthetic regression datasets, we find clear temporal specialisation: one head's causal necessity dominates that of the others by 2 to 5 times at peak layer, with its dominant layer shifting across tasks of different complexity, while the remaining heads exhibit symmetric late layer profiles. Attention entropy and patching provide convergent evidence for the computationally active layers of the dominant head. We additionally investigate inference time steerability via contrastive activation steering, which fails to transfer across samples. We attribute this result to TabPFN's in context learning mechanism, which encodes task structure through context dependent attention rather than the stable parametric directions that make steering tractable in language models.

Abstract

We present the first causal mechanistic analysis of a tabular foundation model, investigating how TabPFN 2.5's feature wise attention heads distribute computation across layers. Using activation patching, ablation, and attention entropy across two synthetic regression datasets, we find clear temporal specialisation: one head's causal necessity dominates that of the others by 2 to 5 times at peak layer, with its dominant layer shifting across tasks of different complexity, while the remaining heads exhibit symmetric late layer profiles. Attention entropy and patching provide convergent evidence for the computationally active layers of the dominant head. We additionally investigate inference time steerability via contrastive activation steering, which fails to transfer across samples. We attribute this result to TabPFN's in context learning mechanism, which encodes task structure through context dependent attention rather than the stable parametric directions that make steering tractable in language models.

item.title: Multi-Modal Agents for Power Distribution Defect Detection: An Evaluation of Foundation Models
item.author: Quan Quan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于配电缺陷检测的多模态智能体框架，系统评估了多模态基础模型在感知、推理和工具使用三个关键能力上的表现，并开发了领域特定的评估数据集和基准测试，为在高风险工业环境中部署自主智能体提供了实证依据。

背景: 配电网络对可靠电力输送至关重要，但传统检查方法在语义理解、泛化能力和闭环自动化方面存在局限性。

目的: 解决传统检查方法的局限性，提出一种专门用于配电缺陷检测的多模态智能体框架，并将多模态基础模型作为统一的认知引擎进行系统评估。

方法: 构建多模态智能体框架，从感知（识别设备并生成缺陷描述）、推理（基于领域知识诊断原因、评估严重性并规划维护策略）和工具使用（作为自主操作员执行查询知识库或生成工单等动作以实现闭环维护）三个维度评估多模态基础模型的性能；开发领域特定的评估数据集和综合基准测试。

主要发现: 当前基础模型在感知、推理和工具使用三个维度上均展现出一定的优势与局限性。

结论: 研究结果为在高风险工业环境中部署自主智能体提供了实证证据。

翻译: The power distribution network is critical to reliable electricity delivery, yet traditional inspection methods face limitations in semantic understanding, generalization, and closed-loop automation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Multi-Modal Agent framework specifically for power distribution defect detection. Central to this study is the systematic evaluation of multimodal foundation models as unified cognitive engines. We rigorously assess their integrated performance across three critical capabilities: (1) Perception, where the model must accurately identify equipment and generate expert-level descriptions of defects; (2) Reasoning, where the model interprets visual findings to diagnose causes, assess severity, and plan maintenance strategies based on domain knowledge; and (3) Tool Usage, where the model acts as an autonomous operator to execute actions -- such as querying knowledge bases or generating work orders -- to achieve closed-loop maintenance. To support this evaluation, a domain-specific evaluation dataset and a comprehensive benchmark are developed. Experimental results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of current foundation models in these three dimensions, providing empirical evidence for deploying autonomous agents in high-stakes industrial environments.

Abstract

The power distribution network is critical to reliable electricity delivery, yet traditional inspection methods face limitations in semantic understanding, generalization, and closed-loop automation. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a Multi-Modal Agent framework specifically for power distribution defect detection. Central to this study is the systematic evaluation of multimodal foundation models as unified cognitive engines. We rigorously assess their integrated performance across three critical capabilities: (1) Perception, where the model must accurately identify equipment and generate expert-level descriptions of defects; (2) Reasoning, where the model interprets visual findings to diagnose causes, assess severity, and plan maintenance strategies based on domain knowledge; and (3) Tool Usage, where the model acts as an autonomous operator to execute actions -- such as querying knowledge bases or generating work orders -- to achieve closed-loop maintenance. To support this evaluation, a domain-specific evaluation dataset and a comprehensive benchmark are developed. Experimental results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of current foundation models in these three dimensions, providing empirical evidence for deploying autonomous agents in high-stakes industrial environments.

item.title: Objects Before Words: Object-First Inductive Biases for Grounding Language in Child-View Video
item.author: Sathira Silva, Abrham Kahsay Gebreselasie, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Kartik Kuckreja, Daniel Harari, Muhammad Haris Khan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BabyMind是一种针对儿童视角对比学习的对象优先偏差方法，旨在从稀疏且嘈杂的监督信号中学习接地词义。

背景: 从自然经验中学习接地词义需要解决婴儿视角记录中的两个歧义：命名指代物何时出现以及它在杂乱框架中的位置。在SAYCam风格的数据中，照顾者的语音稀疏且与第一人称视频弱同步，导致单帧对比配对产生嘈杂的正样本，其中目标对象缺失或与干扰项纠缠。

目的: 提出BabyMind方法，以在稀疏、嘈杂的监督下实现儿童视角的对比学习。

方法: BabyMind使用基于掩码的离线区域接口提取候选对象嵌入，通过跟踪将短话语中心窗口内的候选对象链接成轻量级对象文件，并使用原型空间多实例对比目标将话语与对象文件集合对齐。此外，引入轨迹一致性和全局对象一致性正则化器以稳定学习过程，并将对象文件结构转移到评估时使用的全局帧嵌入中。

主要发现: 在SAYCam-S数据集上，BabyMind在Labeled-S 15强制选择准确率上比CVCL提高了2.6个百分点，并在词汇内分布外基准测试中取得了一致的提升。

结论: BabyMind方法有效解决了稀疏嘈杂监督下的儿童视角对比学习问题，提升了模型性能。

翻译: Learning grounded word meaning from natural experience requires resolving two ambiguities in infant-view recordings: when the named referent appears and where it is in a cluttered frame. In SAYCam-style data, caregiver speech is sparse and weakly synchronized with egocentric video, so single-frame contrastive pairing yields noisy positives in which the intended object is absent or entangled with distractors. We propose BabyMind, an object-first bias for child-view contrastive learning under sparse, noisy supervision. BabyMind extracts candidate object embeddings using an offline mask-based region interface, links candidates across a short utterance-centered window into lightweight object files via tracking, and aligns utterances to bags of object files with a prototype-space multiple-instance contrastive objective. Track-coherence and global-object agreement regularizers stabilize learning and transfer object-file structure into the global frame embedding used at evaluation. On SAYCam-S, BabyMind improves Labeled-S 15 forced-choice accuracy by +2.6 points over CVCL and yields consistent gains on in-vocabulary out-of-distribution benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/sathiiii/BabyMind.

Abstract

Learning grounded word meaning from natural experience requires resolving two ambiguities in infant-view recordings: when the named referent appears and where it is in a cluttered frame. In SAYCam-style data, caregiver speech is sparse and weakly synchronized with egocentric video, so single-frame contrastive pairing yields noisy positives in which the intended object is absent or entangled with distractors. We propose BabyMind, an object-first bias for child-view contrastive learning under sparse, noisy supervision. BabyMind extracts candidate object embeddings using an offline mask-based region interface, links candidates across a short utterance-centered window into lightweight object files via tracking, and aligns utterances to bags of object files with a prototype-space multiple-instance contrastive objective. Track-coherence and global-object agreement regularizers stabilize learning and transfer object-file structure into the global frame embedding used at evaluation. On SAYCam-S, BabyMind improves Labeled-S 15 forced-choice accuracy by +2.6 points over CVCL and yields consistent gains on in-vocabulary out-of-distribution benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/sathiiii/BabyMind.

item.title: CausalMoE: A Billion-Scale Multimodal Foundation Model for Granger Causal Discovery with Pattern-Routed Heterogeneous Experts
item.author: Bo Liu, Di Dai, Jingwei Liu, Jiarui Jin, Xiaocheng Fang, Guangkun Nie, Hongyan Li, Shenda Hong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CausalMoE的十亿级多模态格兰杰因果基础模型，该模型通过显式建模补丁级异质性，动态识别潜在时间模式并将补丁路由到专门的领域专家，从而有效解耦特定机制与共享动态。

背景: 格兰杰因果发现对于分析复杂系统中的时间依赖性至关重要。然而，现有的神经格兰杰因果发现方法主要依赖单一范式，难以捕捉真实世界时间序列中固有的分布偏移和动态状态变化，这通常导致表示纠缠和虚假因果图。

目的: 旨在解决现有方法难以捕捉分布偏移和动态状态变化的问题，通过显式建模补丁级异质性来构建更准确的因果发现模型。

方法: 提出了CausalMoE模型，引入了模式路由的异构专家混合机制，动态识别潜在时间模式并将补丁路由到专门的领域专家；设计了跨变量的因果感知自注意力机制，通过近端优化生成稀疏的格兰杰因果图；首次整合大语言模型和视觉语言模型，将数值信号与文本及视觉先验对齐，以正则化复杂场景下的因果估计。

主要发现: CausalMoE在完全监督基准测试中建立了新的最先进性能，并有效泛化到传统方法失效的少样本设置中。

结论: CausalMoE通过显式建模补丁级异质性和整合多模态先验，成功解决了现有格兰杰因果发现方法的局限性，在监督学习和少样本学习中均表现出色。

翻译: 格兰杰因果发现对于分析复杂系统中的时间依赖性至关重要。然而，现有的神经格兰杰因果发现方法主要依赖单一范式，难以捕捉真实世界时间序列中固有的分布偏移和动态状态变化，这通常导致表示纠缠和虚假因果图。在本文中，我们提出了CausalMoE，这是一种显式建模补丁级异质性的十亿级多模态格兰杰因果基础模型。CausalMoE引入了模式路由的异构专家混合机制，动态识别潜在时间模式并将补丁路由到专门的领域专家，有效解耦了特定机制与共享动态。为了确保可解释的图恢复，我们设计了跨变量的因果感知自注意力机制，通过近端优化生成稀疏的格兰杰因果图。此外，CausalMoE是第一个整合大语言模型和视觉语言模型以将数值信号与文本及视觉先验对齐的模型，从而在复杂场景中正则化因果估计。大量实验表明，CausalMoE在完全监督基准测试中建立了新的最先进性能，并有效泛化到传统方法失效的少样本设置中。

Abstract

Granger Causal Discovery (GCD) is fundamental for analyzing temporal dependencies in complex systems. However, existing neural GCD methods predominantly rely on a "one-size-fits-all" paradigm, struggling to capture distribution shifts and dynamic regime changes inherent in real-world time series. This often leads to entangled representations and spurious causal graphs. In this paper, we propose CausalMoE, a billion-scale multimodal Granger causal foundation model that explicitly models patch-level heterogeneity. CausalMoE introduces a Pattern-Routed Mixture of Heterogeneous Experts, which dynamically identifies latent temporal patterns and routes patches to specialized domain experts, effectively decoupling regime-specific mechanisms from shared dynamics. To ensure interpretable graph recovery, we design a Causality-Aware Self-Attention mechanism operating across variables, yielding sparse Granger causal graphs via proximal optimization. Furthermore, CausalMoE is the first to integrate LLMs and VLMs to align numerical signals with textual and visual priors, regularizing causal estimation in complex scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CausalMoE establishes a new state-of-the-art on fully supervised benchmarks, while effectively generalizing to few-shot settings where traditional methods fail.

item.title: Nous: An Attempt to Extract and Inject the Cognition Behind Prediction-Market Behavior
item.author: Haowei Qian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在预测市场和集体决策中，大型语言模型智能体因使用共享基础模型而导致的认知同质化问题。研究尝试从人类行为中提取认知多样性并将其转移至智能体。通过从真实交易活动中提取结构化行为档案并注入提示，研究发现行为档案提取部分有效，但提示级注入未能有效传递认知多样性，无法降低误差相关性或提升预测准确性。研究指出问题在于提示压缩，建议采用提示级以下的注入方法。

背景: 大型语言模型智能体在预测市场和集体决策中日益普及，但使用共享基础模型导致智能体产生相关性预测，形成认知同质化风险。近期测量显示前沿模型错误的相关性约为0.77。

目的: 探讨是否可以从行为中恢复人类认知多样性，并将其转移至大型语言模型智能体。

方法: 从真实Polymarket交易活动中提取结构化八维行为档案，并通过提示将其注入智能体。使用100个钱包数据验证提取效果，通过语义嵌入指标评估注入效果，并分析提示本身的结构。

主要发现: 行为档案提取部分有效：14个参数中有8个具有时间稳定性，钱包可通过档案识别，部分维度与未来利润相关。但提示级注入无效：结构化注入在语义嵌入上无显著优势，未降低集成误差相关性，未提升Brier分数。问题在于提示压缩，结构到叙述的翻译器发出的提示接近均匀分布。

结论: 研究测量了认知同质化问题及提示级补救措施的局限性，建议采用更深层的提示级以下注入方法，如微调或激活引导。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

As LLM agents proliferate in prediction markets and collective decision-making, they risk a cognitive monoculture: agents built on shared foundation models produce correlated forecasts, and recent measurement finds frontier-model errors correlated at r ~ 0.77. We ask whether human cognitive diversity can be recovered from behavior and transferred to LLM agents. Nous extracts a structured eight-dimension behavioral profile from real Polymarket trading activity and injects it into agents through prompts. Our central finding is a dissociation between the two halves of that pipeline. Extraction works, partially: across 100 wallets, 8 of 14 parameters are temporally stable (split-half ICC >= 0.5, bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.3; contrarian score reaches ICC ~ 0.9); wallets are identifiable from their profiles well above chance (top-1 retrieval 17-22% vs. 1% chance); and two of four pre-specified dimensions rank-correlate with future realized profit out-of-sample, though the correlations do not survive behavioral-confound controls. Prompt-level injection does not measurably transmit it: on a semantic embedding metric, structured injection shows no significant advantage over a length-matched control on any model, and the diversity it induces neither reduces ensemble error correlation nor improves Brier score -- a null that persists across exploratory checks on sampling temperature, profile diversity, and question difficulty. Measuring the prompts themselves locates the compression before the model: the structure-to-narrative translator emits near-uniform prompts whose spread does not track profile spread. We position Nous as measuring the cognitive-monoculture problem and the limits of a prompt-level remedy, motivating deeper, below-the-prompt injection (fine-tuning, activation steering). Code, frozen profiles, prompts, and model outputs: https://github.com/WillChienT/nous-paper

item.title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
item.author: Ioannis Kouroudis, Simon Ternes, Zhaosu Gu, Gohar Ali Siddiqui, Marina Ustinova, Angelo Lembo, Alessio Gagliardi, Aldo Di Carlo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究利用机器学习方法预测溶解度参数，通过迁移预训练模型和不确定性量化，在数据有限的情况下实现了高精度预测，并开发了用于筛选绿色溶剂替代品的工具。

背景: 材料科学和可持续化学中准确预测溶解度仍面临挑战，随着有机和混合光伏、电池及催化等新兴技术的发展，溶剂使用量预计将大幅增加，因此用更环保的替代品替代现有溶剂至关重要。

目的: 利用机器学习提高溶解度预测的准确性，特别是在数据有限的情况下，以支持绿色溶剂替代品的筛选。

方法: 将预训练的基础模型迁移到目标应用，结合不确定性量化以评估预测置信度，并开发了易于使用且可集成到高通量实验室的定制化工具。

主要发现: 模型在汉森溶解度参数和介电常数等已有大量数据库的目标上表现良好，并在古特曼给体和受体数等数据极有限的目标上实现了高性能预测，显著提升了溶解度描述符的数据量。

结论: 该研究通过高精度预测和工具部署，为发现环保型溶剂提供了有效途径，并重新发现了已知的绿色溶剂替代品，提出了新的候选溶剂。

翻译: 准确预测溶解度仍然是材料科学和可持续化学中的一个核心挑战。特别是由于有机和混合光伏、电池以及催化等新兴技术的发展，预计未来几年溶剂的使用量将大幅增加。因此，用更环保的替代品替代溶剂至关重要。这正是机器学习可以发挥重大影响的地方。然而，关于溶解度关键参数的有限数据严重限制了机器学习的效率。在这项工作中，我们将预训练的基础模型迁移到我们的应用中，所需数据量极少。此外，该流程集成了不确定性量化，使用户能够评估预测的置信度。作为基线，我们成功预测了汉森溶解度参数和介电常数，这些参数已有广泛的数据库。重要的是，我们在古特曼给体和受体数等额外目标上实现了高模型性能，而这些目标的数据极其有限。总体而言，我们通过高质量的预测将溶解度描述符的数据量增加了几个数量级。为了有效传播，我们部署了一个易于使用、易于集成到高通量实验室的定制化工具，用于对可能的溶剂替代品进行排序和筛选。最后，我们重新发现了已知的绿色溶剂替代品，并提出了新的候选者，证明了其在寻找环保溶剂方面的相关性。

Abstract

Accurate prediction of solubility remains a central challenge across materials science and sustainable chemistry. In particular due to emerging technologies like organic and hybrid photovoltaics, batteries, and catalysis, solvent usage is expected to increase significantly within the coming years. Therefore, substituting solvents with greener alternatives is vital. This is where machine learning can have substantial impact. However, the limited data on critical parameters of solubility significantly constraints machine learning efficacy. In this work, we transfer a pre-trained foundational model on QM9 targets to our application with minimal data requirements. Additionally, the pipeline integrates uncertainty quantification, allowing the user to gauge the confidence of the predictions. As baseline, we succeed in predicting the Hansen solubility parameters and Dielectric Constant for which extensive databases exist. Importantly, we achieve high model performance on additional targets, such as Gutmann Donor and Acceptor numbers, where the available data is extremely limited. Overall, we augment data on solubility descriptors by orders of magnitude with high quality predictions. For effective dissemination, we deploy easy-to-use, easily integrateable with high throughput labs, customizable tool for ranking and screening possible solvent substitutes. Finally, we rediscovered known green solvent alternatives and proposed new candidates proving its relevance for finding eco-friendly solvents.

item.title: Demystifying Hidden-State Recurrence: Switchable Latent Reasoning with On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Yang, Jiayu, Chen, Chao, Wu, Shengen, Liu, Yinhong, Fan, Yuxuan, Li, Lujundong, Lai, Songning, Qin, Chengwei, Guo, Zhijiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SWITCH的可切换潜在推理框架，通过引入显式的边界标记解决了现有潜在推理方法难以优化和解释的问题。

背景: 现有的潜在推理方法通过连续隐藏状态循环压缩推理过程，但难以使用标准的在线强化学习进行优化，且在因果解释上存在困难。

目的: 旨在解决现有潜在推理方法在优化和因果解释上的局限性，使隐藏状态循环的潜在推理既易于强化学习训练，又便于进行机制分析。

方法: 提出SWITCH框架，使用显式的离散进入和退出标记作为边界锚点，结合可见到潜在的课程学习和Switch-GRPO目标进行训练。

主要发现: SWITCH在同等规模下持续优于先前的隐藏状态循环潜在推理方法；边界标记揭示了三个发现：进入标记是局部化的学习策略而非风格伪影；潜在步骤执行特定于问题的因果重要计算；该计算集中在进入时的单个隐藏状态转换上。

结论: 隐藏状态循环的潜在推理既可以通过强化学习训练，又可以直接进行机制分析，包括分析在线强化学习如何从内部改进模型。

翻译: Latent chain-of-thought compresses reasoning by replacing visible reasoning traces with continuous hidden-state recurrence, but existing formulations are difficult to optimize with standard on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) and hard to interpret causally. Our key insight is that a single pair of explicit boundary tokens can address both issues at once: discrete entry and exit anchors make the latent block compatible with standard on-policy RL, and the same anchors offer a natural foothold for mechanistic analysis. Motivated by this, we propose SWITCH, a switchable latent reasoning framework. The model emits <swi> to enter latent mode and </swi> to exit. Because the boundaries are ordinary discrete tokens, the GRPO policy ratio is well-defined at every decision point. The same anchors also expose the latent steps to direct probing and causal intervention. We train the model with a visible-to-latent curriculum and a Switch-GRPO objective that propagates gradients through recurrent latent computation. SWITCH consistently outperforms prior hidden-state-recurrence latent reasoning approaches at similar scale. Mechanistic analysis through the boundary tokens further reveals three findings: (i) <swi> is a sharply localised, learned switching policy rather than a stylistic artefact; (ii) the latent step it opens performs problem-specific, causally important computation rather than acting as an inert placeholder; and (iii) that computation is concentrated at a single hidden-state transition on entry. Together, these results show that hidden-state-recurrence latent reasoning is both RL-trainable and open to direct mechanistic analysis, including of how on-policy RL itself improves the model from the inside.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决隐藏状态循环式潜在推理难以使用标准强化学习进行训练，且内部计算过程缺乏明确边界导致难以直接分析和解释的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为强化学习是提升大模型推理能力的主流方法，而潜在推理能显著压缩计算开销；若无法有效训练与透明化分析，将严重阻碍高效、可靠且可解释的推理模型的实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统隐状态推理因缺乏明确的起止标记，导致强化学习无法直接优化且难以进行内部机制分析。基于此，他们设计了一对显式的边界标记来划定推理区间，使模型能够自主决定是否进入隐式推理，从而让强化学习在每一步都有明确的策略依据，并为因果干预提供了锚点。在方法设计上，该工作直接借鉴了隐状态循环机制、高熵文本标注技术以及课程学习策略，并在此基础上改进了强化学习算法以适配隐状态计算。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是引入一对显式的边界标记来界定模型内部隐式推理的起止位置，从而将连续的隐藏状态计算转化为可被标准强化学习优化且便于机制分析的结构。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先通过监督微调让模型学会在推理困难处插入边界标记；接着利用课程学习逐步将标记内的文本替换为隐式计算步骤；最后采用在线强化学习对模型进行优化，使其在保持正确率的同时学会何时调用隐式推理。推理时模型会正常生成文本，遇到进入标记后执行隐藏状态循环计算，遇到退出标记后恢复文本生成。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是引入了一对显式的边界标记来明确界定模型内部隐式推理的起始与结束位置。与以往缺乏明确边界的隐状态循环方法不同，这一设计使得基于策略的强化学习算法能够直接应用于隐式推理阶段，同时为内部机制分析和因果干预提供了可靠的观测锚点。此外，论文配套提出了一套完整的训练流程，成功验证了隐状态循环推理不仅可以通过强化学习进行优化，还能实现高度的可解释性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种引入显式边界标记的可切换潜在推理框架，成功解决了传统隐藏状态推理难以进行在线强化学习训练和机制分析的问题，并在数学推理任务上显著提升了模型性能。

Abstract

Latent chain-of-thought compresses reasoning by replacing visible reasoning traces with continuous hidden-state recurrence, but existing formulations are difficult to optimize with standard on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) and hard to interpret causally. Our key insight is that a single pair of explicit boundary tokens can address both issues at once: discrete entry and exit anchors make the latent block compatible with standard on-policy RL, and the same anchors offer a natural foothold for mechanistic analysis. Motivated by this, we propose SWITCH, a switchable latent reasoning framework. The model emits <swi> to enter latent mode and </swi> to exit. Because the boundaries are ordinary discrete tokens, the GRPO policy ratio is well-defined at every decision point.
