The same anchors also expose the latent steps to direct probing and causal intervention. We train the model with a visible-to-latent curriculum and a Switch-GRPO objective that propagates gradients through recurrent latent computation. SWITCH consistently outperforms prior hidden-state-recurrence latent reasoning approaches at similar scale. Mechanistic analysis through the boundary tokens further reveals three findings: (i) <swi> is a sharply localised, learned switching policy rather than a stylistic artefact; (ii) the latent step it opens performs problem-specific, causally important computation rather than acting as an inert placeholder; and (iii) that computation is concentrated at a single hidden-state transition on entry. Together, these results show that hidden-state-recurrence latent reasoning is both RL-trainable and open to direct mechanistic analysis, including of how on-policy RL itself improves the model from the inside.

item.title: MP3: Multi-Period Pattern Pre-training forSpatio-Temporal Forecasting
item.author: Lilan Peng, Yandi Liu, Qingren Yao, Chongshou Li, Tianrui Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为多周期模式预训练（MP3）的即插即用预训练插件，旨在解决时空预测中因短窗口输入不完整周期观测、异质全局空间相关性和跨周期叠加因果关系导致的时空镜像问题。

背景: 时空预测在交通、气候和能源等领域至关重要。城市时空数据表现出时空镜像现象，即相似的短窗口输入可能产生截然不同的未来趋势，反之亦然。现有的时空图神经网络无法有效识别此类镜像。

目的: 解决现有方法无法有效识别时空镜像的问题，通过区分时空镜像来提升预测性能。

方法: 开发了一种名为多周期模式预训练（MP3）的即插即用预训练插件。其核心创新包括：（1）多周期模式学习，利用边缘卷积识别不同多周期模式，通过瓶颈投影和全局记忆库捕捉异质全局空间关系，并使用因果增强Transformer捕获跨周期模式依赖；（2）该插件可无缝集成到现有STGNN骨干网络中，以增强其预测性能。

主要发现: 在五个真实世界数据集（包括大规模数据集CA）上对五种STGNN基线模型的实验验证了MP3的有效性、卓越的可扩展性和强大的适应性。MP3在所有评估的基线模型中带来了持续且稳健的性能提升，平均降低平均绝对误差百分之四点七和均方根误差百分之五。

结论: MP3能够有效区分时空镜像，显著提升现有STGNN模型的预测性能，具有广泛的适用性和鲁棒性。

翻译: Spatio-Temporal forecasting is crucial in diverse fields, such as transportation, climate, and energy. Urban spatio-temporal data exhibits temporal mirage: similar short-window inputs have divergent future trends, and vice versa. Existing spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) cannot effectively identify such mirages. We argue that the core reason lies in the short-window inputs that have incomplete period observation, heterogeneous global spatial correlation, and cross-period superposition causality. To bridge this gap, we develop a novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3), a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages. MP3 presents two core innovations: (1) The multi-period pattern learning is designed to learn multi-period patterns from long time series. Specifically, multi-period temporal modeling leverages edge convolution to identify different multi-period patterns. Multi-period spatial modeling uses a bottleneck project and a global memory bank to capture heterogeneous global spatial relations efficiently. Cross-period pattern interaction employs a causality-enhanced Transformer to capture dependencies across different period patterns. (2) This plugin can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance. The experiment on five STGNN baselines across five real-world datasets (including a large-scale dataset CA) verify the effectiveness, superior scalability and strong adaptability of MP3, which brings consistent and robust performance improvements across all evaluated baselines. On average, MP3 reduces the MAE 4.7% and the RMSE 5.0%. The code can be available at https://github.com/YAN-outlook/MP3.

Abstract

Spatio-Temporal forecasting is crucial in diverse fields, such as transportation, climate, and energy. Urban spatio-temporal data exhibits temporal mirage: similar short-window inputs have divergent future trends, and vice versa. Existing spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) cannot effectively identify such mirages. We argue that the core reason lies in the short-window inputs that have incomplete period observation, heterogeneous global spatial correlation, and cross-period superposition causality. To bridge this gap, we develop a novel Multi- Period Pattern Pre-training (MP3), a plug-and-play pre-training plugin for distinguishing temporal mirages. MP3 presents two core innovations: (1) The multi-period pattern learning is designed to learn multi-period patterns from long time series. Specifically, multi-period temporal modeling leverages edge convolution to identify different multi-period patterns. Multi-period spatial modeling uses a bottleneck project and a global memory bank to capture heterogeneous global spatial relations efficiently. Cross-period pattern interaction employs a causality-enhanced Transformer to capture dependencies across different period patterns. (2) This plugin can seamlessly integrate into existing STGNN backbones to strengthen their forecasting performance. The experiment on five STGNN baselines across five real-world datasets (including a large-scale dataset CA) verify the effectiveness, superior scalability and strong adaptability of MP3, which brings consistent and robust performance improvements across all evaluated baselines. On average, MP3 reduces the MAE 4.7% and the RMSE 5.0%. The code can be available at https://github.com/YAN-outlook/MP3.

item.title: EvoBrowseComp: Benchmarking Search Agents on Evolving Knowledge
item.author: Wang, Yunhan, Wang, Jiaan, Huang, Lianzhe, Zeng, Xianfeng, Meng, Fandong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出EvoBrowseComp，一个包含四百条英文和四百条中文问题的动态基准测试集，旨在解决现有搜索智能体评估基准因静态知识导致的测试集污染和参数记忆问题。

背景: 现有搜索智能体评估基准如BrowseComp依赖静态知识，容易受到测试集污染和参数记忆的影响，导致模型通过事实回忆而非真正检索获得高分，掩盖了真实的浏览能力。

目的: 构建一个防污染、可定期更新且能保持时效性的复杂问题基准测试集，以准确评估搜索智能体的真实浏览能力和推理能力。

方法: 设计一个三智能体协作框架来合成问题：一是问答合成智能体，从实时网络检索新知识并合成问答对；二是信息过滤智能体，根据可信度和流行度过滤检索到的知识以阻断参数捷径；三是高层指导智能体，将问题形式化为推理图以减少逻辑冗余和捷径。

主要发现: 实验表明EvoBrowseComp具有极高的难度，要求模型进行广泛的横向搜索，能够有效防止数据污染并保持时间新鲜度。

结论: EvoBrowseComp建立了一个可扩展的自动更新高难度基准测试范式，能够跟上不断变化的世界知识和不断发展的智能体能力。

翻译: Search Agents -- large language models augmented with search tools -- have intensified the need for future-proof evaluation benchmarks. Existing benchmarks such as BrowseComp rely on static knowledge, making them vulnerable to test-set contamination and parametric memorization. Consequently, models can achieve high scores through fact recall rather than genuine retrieval, obscuring true browsing competence via reasoning shortcuts. In this paper, we introduce EvoBrowseComp, an evolving benchmark of 400 English and 400 Chinese contamination-free complex questions synthesized via live-web traversal. To collect these questions, we design a three-agent collaborative framework: (1) a QA synthesis agent that retrieves fresh knowledge from the live web to synthesize QA pairs; (2) an information filtering agent that filters retrieved knowledge in terms of credibility and popularity to block parametric shortcuts; and (3) a high-level guidance agent that formalizes questions into reasoning graphs to reduce logical redundancy and shortcuts in synthesized QA pairs. Because the framework supports fully automated synthesis, EvoBrowseComp can be regularly updated to prevent data contamination and maintain temporal freshness. Extensive experiments confirm its great difficulty, requiring broad horizontal search. It establishes a scalable paradigm for auto-updatable, high-difficulty benchmarking that keeps pace with both evolving world knowledge and advancing agent capabilities.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有搜索智能体评测基准依赖静态知识，容易因训练数据泄露导致模型通过死记硬背而非真实检索来刷高分的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为随着模型参数扩大和预训练数据增长，静态基准会迅速失效，无法准确衡量智能体真正的网页浏览与多步推理能力。构建能持续更新且防数据污染的动态基准，对于客观评估技术进展和推动智能体发展至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有评测基准依赖静态知识、易受数据污染和模型记忆干扰的缺陷，确立了以引入新鲜知识和全自动持续更新为核心的设计原则。他们构建了一个由问答生成、信息过滤和高层引导三个智能体协作的自动化框架，通过实时网络检索获取新知，并利用推理图结构检测逻辑冗余与推理捷径，从而自动生成高难度且防作弊的复杂问题。在方法设计上，作者充分借鉴了现有研究，例如参考前人工作指出纯文本生成的局限性并引入图结构进行控制，同时借鉴了相关文献的特征混淆策略来提升问题难度，并基于经典集合运算理论构建推理逻辑。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是依托实时网络检索自动构建基于新鲜知识的复杂问答对，以此防止模型依赖训练数据中的静态记忆，实现基准测试的持续更新与防污染。整体实现流程采用全自动的三智能体协作机制：首先由问答生成智能体抓取网络新信息并草拟题目；其次由信息过滤智能体验证信息可信度并剔除过度热门的内容；最后由高层指导智能体将题目转化为推理结构图，检测并消除逻辑冗余与捷径，随后反馈给生成智能体进行迭代优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套完全自动化的三智能体协同框架，能够持续从实时网络中抓取最新知识并生成高难度复杂问答对，同时引入推理图结构来规范逻辑路径。与以往依赖静态数据和人工标注的基准不同，该工作通过强制使用训练截止后的新鲜知识、自动化流水线以及多跳推理设计，有效防止了模型通过参数记忆作弊，真正考验搜索智能体的实时检索与推理能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种全自动的动态评测基准，通过三智能体协作框架持续从实时网络生成基于新鲜知识的复杂问答对，有效防止模型依赖参数记忆，从而精准评估搜索智能体的真实网页浏览与多跳推理能力。

item.title: TerraBench: Can Agents Reason Over Heterogeneous Earth-System Data?
item.author: Dat Tien Nguyen, Thao Nguyen, Fadillah Adamsyah Maani, Huy M. Le, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Numan Saeed, Muhammad Haris Khan, Salman Khan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了TerraBench，这是一个用于接地地球科学推理的基准测试，基于TerraAgent框架构建，该框架结合了大语言模型的规划能力与用于环境检索、地理空间处理、模拟和基于工件计算的科学工具。

背景: 气候和环境决策需要处理异构输入，包括网格化物理数据、卫星图像、地理空间上下文和模拟器输出。现有的天气和气候基础模型擅长预测但缺乏语言交互推理能力，而大语言模型虽具备语言推理能力却无法直接处理高维地球系统数据，导致地球科学的实际工作流程未得到充分服务。

目的: 旨在提供一个统一的基准测试，以评估和促进地球科学中的推理能力，解决现有基准测试将各项能力隔离为狭窄独立任务的问题，并首次将过程级工具使用指标与容差感知的数值评分相结合。

方法: 构建了TerraBench基准测试，基于TerraAgent这一类似ReAct的可执行框架，该框架交错进行推理、工具调用和观察，将大语言模型规划与科学工具耦合。基准测试包含403个广泛的智能体任务，分为三个轨道（基础、模拟器接地、文档接地验证）和八个应用领域，包含24,500个经过验证的执行步骤。

主要发现: 可靠的地球科学智能体必须超越简单的工具访问，需要协调异构工作流程，精确参数化工具，并保留工件的来源信息。

结论: TerraBench通过统一地球观测图像分析、网格数据、地理信息系统推理和模拟，为地球科学推理提供了新的评估标准，强调了智能体在复杂科学工作流中协调能力和精确操作的重要性。

翻译: Climate and environmental decision-making increasingly requires reasoning across heterogeneous inputs, including gridded physical data, satellite imagery, geospatial context, and simulator outputs. Weather and climate foundation models can forecast well, but do not reason interactively in language, while large language models (LLMs) reason in language but cannot operate directly on high-dimensional Earth-system data. As a result, real scientific workflows in Earth-science remain underserved. We introduce TerraBench, a benchmark for grounded Earth-science reasoning, built on TerraAgent, a ReAct-style executable framework that interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and observations to couple LLM planning with scientific tools for environmental retrieval, geospatial processing, simulation, and artifact-backed computation. TerraBench unifies analysis of Earth observation imagery, gridded data, GIS reasoning and simulation in a single executable interface, whereas prior benchmarks isolate these capabilities into narrow individual tasks. It is also the first in this space to pair process-level tool-use metrics with tolerance-aware numeric scoring. The benchmark comprises 403 extensive agentic tasks across three tracks (Fundamentals, Simulator-Grounded, and Document-Grounded Verification) and eight application domains with 24,500 verified execution steps. These results indicate that reliable Earth-science agents must go beyond tool access to coordinate heterogeneous workflows, parameterize tools precisely, and preserve artifact provenance.

Abstract

Climate and environmental decision-making increasingly requires reasoning across heterogeneous inputs, including gridded physical data, satellite imagery, geospatial context, and simulator outputs. Weather and climate foundation models can forecast well, but do not reason interactively in language, while large language models (LLMs) reason in language but cannot operate directly on high-dimensional Earth-system data. As a result, real scientific workflows in Earth-science remain underserved. We introduce TerraBench, a benchmark for grounded Earth-science reasoning, built on TerraAgent, a ReAct-style executable framework that interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and observations to couple LLM planning with scientific tools for environmental retrieval, geospatial processing, simulation, and artifact-backed computation. TerraBench unifies analysis of Earth observation imagery, gridded data, GIS reasoning and simulation in a single executable interface, whereas prior benchmarks isolate these capabilities into narrow individual tasks. It is also the first in this space to pair process-level tool-use metrics with tolerance-aware numeric scoring. The benchmark comprises 403 extensive agentic tasks across three tracks (Fundamentals, Simulator-Grounded, and Document-Grounded Verification) and eight application domains with 24,500 verified execution steps. These results indicate that reliable Earth-science agents must go beyond tool access to coordinate heterogeneous workflows, parameterize tools precisely, and preserve artifact provenance.

item.title: Loss-Shift Transfer via Bayes Quotients
item.author: Vasileios Sevetlidis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在数据分布固定但损失函数变化的情况下，迁移学习出现的一种正交失效模式，称为损失偏移。通过贝叶斯商形式化，发现源域的最小表示对于更细粒度的目标损失可能不足，导致分类等效但日志损失性能不同。

背景: 迁移学习通常被视为分布偏移的结果。

目的: 识别并研究在数据分布固定而损失函数变化时迁移学习的失效模式。

方法: 使用贝叶斯商对损失进行排序和形式化，分析损失之间的细化关系，并通过受控、学习、合成图像和真实图像设置进行实验验证。

主要发现: 在贝叶斯商形式下，严格细化会导致定性障碍，即源域的最小表示对于更细的目标损失不足。对于有限输出的日志损失，这种障碍转化为精确的定量恒等式，即表示丢弃的关于目标变量的条件信息即为多余风险。

结论: 在固定数据分布下，分类等效的表示可能在日志损失性能上存在差异，验证了损失偏移的影响。

翻译: 迁移学习通常被视为分布偏移的结果。本文识别了一种正交的失效模式，其中数据分布固定而损失函数发生变化。这种设置称为损失偏移。损失函数决定了X中的哪些信息是贝叶斯相关的，因此即使联合分布相同，两种损失函数也可能需要不同的表示。该思想通过贝叶斯商进行形式化，贝叶斯商允许按细化程度对损失函数进行排序。在贝叶斯商形式下，严格细化会产生直接的定性障碍。对于较粗损失函数的源最小表示对于严格更细的目标损失函数是不充分的。对于有限输出的日志损失函数，这种障碍转化为精确的定量恒等式。多余风险是表示丢弃的关于Y的条件信息。在受控、学习、合成图像和真实图像设置中的实验显示了预测的效果，即在固定数据分布下，分类等效的表示可能在日志损失性能上有所不同。

Abstract

Transfer learning is usually studied as a consequence of distribution shift. This paper identifies an orthogonal failure mode in which the data distribution is fixed and the loss changes. This setting is called \emph{loss shift}. A loss determines which information in \(X\) is Bayes-relevant, and two losses may therefore require different representations even under the same joint law \(P(X,Y)\). The idea is formalized using Bayes quotients, which allow losses to be ordered by refinement. In the Bayes-quotient formulation, strict refinement gives an immediate qualitative obstruction. A source-minimal representation for a coarser loss is insufficient for a strictly finer target loss. For finite-output log loss, this obstruction becomes an exact quantitative identity. The excess risk is the conditional information about \(Y\) discarded by the representation. Experiments in controlled, learned, synthetic-image, and real-image settings show the predicted effect, i.e., classification-equivalent representations can have different optimal log-loss performance under a fixed data distribution.

item.title: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
item.author: Ruichao Mao, Zhou Fang, Teng Guo, Hao Yang, Yaping Li, Shaohua Peng, Maji Huang, Xiaoyu Lin, Shuoyang Liu, Xuepeng Li, Yuyu Zhang, Hai Rao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出UXBench基准和UI-UX模型，用于评估和提升多模态大语言模型在用户界面推理方面的能力。

背景: 以可用性、感知一致性和功能清晰度为核心的用户体验对真实用户界面至关重要。多模态大语言模型在用户界面领域的应用正在快速发展，但基于用户界面截图评估用户体验的研究尚不成熟。

目的: 解决基于用户界面截图评估用户体验的研究不足，评估多模态大语言模型进行用户界面推理的能力，并提升其性能。

方法: 提出包含两千个视觉问答数据样本的UXBench基准，包含八个基于真实用户界面截图的任务，要求对布局关系、视觉层次和内容一致性进行细粒度诊断。提出基于Qwen三-VL-四-B基础模型并通过强化学习增强的UI-UX模型，包含奖励路由机制和非对称转换奖励。

主要发现: 主流多模态大语言模型在用户界面推理能力上存在根本性局限。UI-UX模型在UXBench上达到最先进性能，准确率为零点七九六三，超越Claude四点五-Sonnet的零点六五五零，并在多样化用户界面任务中展现出强大的泛化能力和低推理延迟。

结论: 需要进一步改进多模态大语言模型在用户界面推理方面的能力，UI-UX模型通过创新机制实现了该领域的最先进性能。

翻译: User experience (UX) centered on usability, perceived consistency, and functional clarity is fundamental to real-world user interfaces (UI). The application of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in the field of user interfaces is evolving rapidly, such as visual element grounding, graphical user interface (GUI) agents, and design-to-code generation. However, research efforts on evaluating UX based on UI screenshots are still immature. To address this, we propose UXBench, a novel multimodal benchmark consisting of 2,000 VQA data samples designed to assess MLLMs' ability to perform UI-based reasoning. UXBench includes 8 tasks based on real-world UI screenshots that require fine-grained diagnosis of UX issues across layout relationships, visual hierarchy, and content consistency. Our extensive evaluation of mainstream MLLMs shows that they remain fundamentally limited in their capacity for UI-based reasoning. The results underscore the need for further advancements in this area. To bridge this gap, we propose UI-UX, an MLLM based on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking foundation model and enhanced via reinforcement learning with two key innovations: a reward routing mechanism that dynamically balances perceptual understanding and logical reasoning during inference, and an asymmetric transition reward that suppresses redundant or insufficient reasoning steps. Experiments demonstrate that UI-UX achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on UXBench, attaining an accuracy of 0.7963 -- surpassing Claude-4.5-Sonnet's 0.6550 -- while exhibiting strong generalization across diverse UI tasks and maintaining low inference latency.

Abstract

User experience (UX) centered on usability, perceived consistency, and functional clarity is fundamental to real-world user interfaces (UI). The application of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in the field of user interfaces is evolving rapidly, such as visual element grounding, graphical user interface (GUI) agents, and design-to-code generation. However, research efforts on evaluating UX based on UI screenshots are still immature. To address this, we propose UXBench, a novel multimodal benchmark consisting of 2,000 VQA data samples designed to assess MLLMs' ability to perform UI-based reasoning. UXBench includes 8 tasks based on real-world UI screenshots that require fine-grained diagnosis of UX issues across layout relationships, visual hierarchy, and content consistency. Our extensive evaluation of mainstream MLLMs shows that they remain fundamentally limited in their capacity for UI-based reasoning. The results underscore the need for further advancements in this area. To bridge this gap, we propose UI-UX, an MLLM based on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking foundation model and enhanced via reinforcement learning with two key innovations: a reward routing mechanism that dynamically balances perceptual understanding and logical reasoning during inference, and an asymmetric transition reward that suppresses redundant or insufficient reasoning steps. Experiments demonstrate that UI-UX achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on UXBench, attaining an accuracy of 0.7963 -- surpassing Claude-4.5-Sonnet's 0.6550 -- while exhibiting strong generalization across diverse UI tasks and maintaining low inference latency.

item.title: Under What Conditions Can a Machine Become Genuinely Creative?
item.author: Yong Zeng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了机器在何种条件下能够具备真正的创造力，以及如何在共享的认知和创造环境中保留人类能动性。基于意义导向的意向性变化科学，提出了一个包含十个要求的要求框架，并将创造力理解为通过递归干预动态对不完整情境的结构化转变。

背景: 最近的系统能够生成看似具有创造性的文本、软件架构、假设、设计和科学工作流程。

目的: 探讨机器在何种条件下能够具备真正的创造力，以及如何在共享的认知和创造环境中保留人类能动性。

方法: 基于意义导向的意向性变化科学，提出一个包含十个要求的要求框架，并通过网络物理和网络生物学的研究案例展示这些要求的计算可行性。

主要发现: 真正的机器创造力不应仅由输出的新颖性、当前性能或临时架构定义，而应理解为通过递归干预动态对不完整情境的结构化转变。该转变依赖于十个要求：环境表征、范围化感知、冲突识别、干预能力、后果观察、知识与环境更新、重新范围化、局部到全局展开、基于价值的范围化以及人机共存。这些要求通过三个定律组织：感知、冲突和能力。

结论: 真正的机器创造力需要满足特定的要求，而主动的人工智能伦理是内在的而非事后的过滤器。基于价值的范围化和人机共存必须塑造创造性机器如何感知环境、识别冲突、选择干预、观察后果、更新知识和重新范围化未来行动。

翻译: Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can become genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.

Abstract

Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can become genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.

item.title: Hallucination in Medical Imaging AI: A Cross-Modality Analytical Framework for Taxonomy, Detection, and Mitigation under Regulatory Constraints
item.author: Omar Alshahrani, Muzammil Behzad
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AI系统在医学影像领域的应用速度超过了对其失效模式的理解速度，其中最具临床关注度的失效模式是幻觉，即生成临床上合理但事实错误的输出。本文通过综合分析五个成像模态的同行评审研究、基准数据集和FDA监管指南，对幻觉的分类、成因、检测和缓解策略进行了跨模态分析。

背景: AI系统在医学影像领域的应用速度超过了对其失效模式的理解速度，其中最具临床关注度的失效模式是幻觉，即生成临床上合理但事实错误的输出。

目的: 本研究旨在回答三个问题：如何统一现有跨模态的幻觉分类框架？医学专用基础模型为何比通用模型产生更少的幻觉？哪些缓解策略有效且符合FDA生命周期监管要求？

方法: 通过综合分析五个成像模态的同行评审研究、基准数据集和FDA监管指南，对幻觉的分类、成因、检测和缓解策略进行了跨模态分析。

主要发现: 三个分类框架共同覆盖了成像流程的各个方面；通用基础模型在特定基准上表现优于医学专用模型，表明窄领域微调可能导致过拟合诱发的虚构；放射科医生的监督仍然至关重要，因为大量AI生成的标记需要专家修正；物理信息架构约束、思维链提示和人在回路的安全机制在结合使用时对不同的失效模式有效。

结论: 所有发现均映射到FDA的总产品生命周期和预定变更控制计划框架中，将幻觉管理视为生命周期义务而非部署前的检查清单。

翻译: AI systems are being deployed across medical imaging faster than their failure modes are understood. At this point in time, the failure of greatest clinical concern is hallucination: clinically plausible but factually incorrect outputs, including fabricated anatomical structures, missed findings, incorrect laterality, and invented measurements in generated reports, with direct consequences, for example, for biopsy decisions, staging, and treatment planning. This structured narrative synthesizes peer-reviewed studies, benchmark datasets, and FDA regulatory guidance across five imaging modalities to produce a cross-modality analysis of hallucination taxonomy, etiology, detection, and mitigation. Specifically, we address three questions in this study: (1) how can existing taxonomies be unified across modalities?, (2) how do medical-specialized foundation models hallucinate less than general-purpose ones?, and (3) which mitigation strategies are effective and compatible with FDA lifecycle oversight? We note that three taxonomic frameworks together cover the imaging pipeline in a way no single framework does alone. We also highlight that general-purpose foundation models outperform medical-specialized models on hallucination-specific benchmarks, indicating that narrow domain fine-tuning can introduce overfitting-induced confabulation. At the same time, the oversight of radiologists remains essential; for instance, a very high percentage of of AI-generated flags required expert correction before clinical use. Physics-informed architectural constraints, Chain-of-Thought prompting, and human-in-the-loop safeguards each address different failure modes and is effective when combined. All findings are mapped to the FDA's Total Product Lifecycle and Predetermined Change Control Plan frameworks, which treat hallucination management as a lifecycle obligation rather than a pre-deployment checklist.

Abstract

AI systems are being deployed across medical imaging faster than their failure modes are understood. At this point in time, the failure of greatest clinical concern is hallucination: clinically plausible but factually incorrect outputs, including fabricated anatomical structures, missed findings, incorrect laterality, and invented measurements in generated reports, with direct consequences, for example, for biopsy decisions, staging, and treatment planning. This structured narrative synthesizes peer-reviewed studies, benchmark datasets, and FDA regulatory guidance across five imaging modalities to produce a cross-modality analysis of hallucination taxonomy, etiology, detection, and mitigation. Specifically, we address three questions in this study: (1) how can existing taxonomies be unified across modalities?, (2) how do medical-specialized foundation models hallucinate less than general-purpose ones?, and (3) which mitigation strategies are effective and compatible with FDA lifecycle oversight? We note that three taxonomic frameworks together cover the imaging pipeline in a way no single framework does alone. We also highlight that general-purpose foundation models outperform medical-specialized models on hallucination-specific benchmarks, indicating that narrow domain fine-tuning can introduce overfitting-induced confabulation. At the same time, the oversight of radiologists remains essential; for instance, a very high percentage of of AI-generated flags required expert correction before clinical use. Physics-informed architectural constraints, Chain-of-Thought prompting, and human-in-the-loop safeguards each address different failure modes and is effective when combined. All findings are mapped to the FDA's Total Product Lifecycle and Predetermined Change Control Plan frameworks, which treat hallucination management as a lifecycle obligation rather than a pre-deployment checklist.

item.title: Decoding Insect Song: A Multitask Semisupervised Orthoptera Bioacoustic Classifier
item.author: Olga Isupova, Danil Kuzin, Ella Browning, Tom Mills, Steven Reece
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 PULSE 的半监督多任务框架，用于直翅目生物声学监测，结合弱监督物种分类、无标签野外音频的自监督学习和从通用生物声学模型的知识蒸馏。该领域自适应专家模型在各项指标上均优于最先进的通用模型，并通过主动学习进一步提升了性能。此外，学习到的嵌入编码了具有生态意义的结构，可通过交互式可视化工具进行生态发现。

背景: 被动声学监测在生态推断方面具有巨大潜力，但现有的自动化工具通常训练范围狭窄且缺乏可迁移性。

目的: 解决现有自动化工具训练范围狭窄和缺乏可迁移性的问题。

方法: 提出 PULSE 框架，这是一种用于直翅目生物声学的半监督多任务框架，结合了弱监督物种分类、无标签野外音频的自监督学习以及从通用生物声学模型进行知识蒸馏。

主要发现: 领域自适应专家模型在宏观 F1 分数、AUC 和 AP 等所有指标上均优于最先进的通用模型。通过主动学习，F1 分数提升至 0.34，AUC 提升至 0.84。学习到的嵌入编码了具有生态意义的结构。

结论: PULSE 框架不仅提高了物种分类的性能，还通过交互式可视化工具促进了生态发现。

翻译: Passive acoustic monitoring holds great promise for ecological inference, yet existing automated tools are typically narrowly trained and non-transferable. We address these limitations with PULSE, a semi-supervised, multi-task framework for Orthoptera bioacoustics, combining weakly-supervised species classification, self-supervised learning on unlabelled field audio, and knowledge distillation from a general-purpose bioacoustic model. Our domain-adapted specialist model outperforms a state-of-the-art general model across all metrics (macro F1: 0.21 vs. 0.07; AUC: 0.74 vs. 0.45; AP: 0.32 vs. 0.19), with active learning further raising F1 to 0.34 and AUC to 0.84. Beyond classification, the learned embeddings encode ecologically meaningful structure, exposed through an interactive visualisation tool for ecological discovery.

Abstract

Passive acoustic monitoring holds great promise for ecological inference, yet existing automated tools are typically narrowly trained and non-transferable. We address these limitations with PULSE, a semi-supervised, multi-task framework for Orthoptera bioacoustics, combining weakly-supervised species classification, self-supervised learning on unlabelled field audio, and knowledge distillation from a general-purpose bioacoustic model. Our domain-adapted specialist model outperforms a state-of-the-art general model across all metrics (macro F1: 0.21 vs. 0.07; AUC: 0.74 vs. 0.45; AP: 0.32 vs. 0.19), with active learning further raising F1 to 0.34 and AUC to 0.84. Beyond classification, the learned embeddings encode ecologically meaningful structure, exposed through an interactive visualisation tool for ecological discovery.

item.title: Extracting Governing Equations from Latent Dynamics via Multi-View Contrastive Learning
item.author: Paolo Muratore, Mackenzie Weygandt Mathis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DYSCO的多视图时间对比学习算法，用于从嘈杂的高维测量数据中识别潜在的动态系统。该算法能够联合恢复潜在轨迹和支配动力学，并通过利用同一底层过程的多个独立嘈杂视图来分离信号与噪声。通过在结构化函数基上参数化动力学，该框架还能够在仿射规范内恢复支配方程的符号形式。理论分析提供了在仿射不确定性下强识别的保证，将先前的可识别性结果扩展到了嘈杂非线性观测的现实场景。实验表明，在包括混沌、振荡和亚稳态在内的多种动态状态下，该算法能够准确恢复潜在轨迹和流场，且适用于高斯和泊松观测噪声，后者对神经记录尤为重要。

背景: 从嘈杂的高维测量中识别潜在动态系统是表示学习、系统识别和科学发现交叉领域的核心问题。

目的: 联合恢复潜在轨迹和支配动力学，从嘈杂的高维观测中分离信号与噪声，并恢复支配方程的符号形式。

方法: 提出DYSCO算法，这是一种多视图时间对比学习算法。它利用同一底层过程的多个独立嘈杂视图来分离信号与噪声，并在结构化函数基上参数化动力学，以在仿射规范内恢复支配方程。

主要发现: DYSCO算法在包括混沌、振荡和亚稳态在内的多种动态状态下，能够准确恢复潜在轨迹和流场。该算法适用于高斯和泊松观测噪声，后者对神经记录尤为重要。

结论: DYSCO算法在嘈杂非线性观测的现实场景下，提供了在仿射不确定性下强识别的理论保证，并成功扩展了先前的可识别性结果。

翻译: Identifying latent dynamical systems from noisy, high-dimensional measurements is a central problem at the intersection of representation learning, system identification, and scientific discovery. We present DYSCO, a multi-view temporal contrastive learning algorithm that jointly recovers latent trajectories and the governing dynamics from such observations, by leveraging multiple independent noisy views of the same underlying process to disentangle signal from noise. By parameterizing the dynamics in a structured functional basis, our framework further enables symbolic recovery of the governing equations within an affine gauge. We offer theoretical guarantees for strong identification up to an affine indeterminacy, extending prior identifiability results to the realistic setting of noisy nonlinear observations. Empirically, we demonstrate accurate recovery of both latent trajectories and flow fields across a diverse set of dynamical regimes (e.g., chaotic, oscillatory, and metastable) under both Gaussian and Poisson observation noise, the latter being particularly relevant for neural recordings.

Abstract

Identifying latent dynamical systems from noisy, high-dimensional measurements is a central problem at the intersection of representation learning, system identification, and scientific discovery. We present DYSCO, a multi-view temporal contrastive learning algorithm that jointly recovers latent trajectories and the governing dynamics from such observations, by leveraging multiple independent noisy views of the same underlying process to disentangle signal from noise. By parameterizing the dynamics in a structured functional basis, our framework further enables symbolic recovery of the governing equations within an affine gauge. We offer theoretical guarantees for strong identification up to an affine indeterminacy, extending prior identifiability results to the realistic setting of noisy nonlinear observations. Empirically, we demonstrate accurate recovery of both latent trajectories and flow fields across a diverse set of dynamical regimes (e.g., chaotic, oscillatory, and metastable) under both Gaussian and Poisson observation noise, the latter being particularly relevant for neural recordings.

item.title: TimeLens: On-Device Artifact Recognition with Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering for the Grand Egyptian Museum
item.author: Rawan Hesham, Ali Ashraf, Amr Ahmed, Malak Alaa, Omar Ahmed, Omar Wagih
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: TimeLens 是一款为埃及大博物馆设计的 AI 驱动的双语移动导览应用。该应用通过实时识别展品并支持用户用英语或阿拉伯语提问来提供导览服务。研究解决了馆内部署中的三个问题：51 件编目文物之间的细粒度视觉相似性、策展训练数据与手持相机条件之间的差距，以及 AI 导览可能陈述无根据历史事实的风险。主要工程贡献包括：通过数据质量驱动的迭代研究开发了设备端文物检测器，最终模型在保持小体积的同时实现了实时运行和高精度；以及基于知识库的双语检索增强生成导览系统，通过优化将端到端延迟从 30 秒以上降低至约 10 秒。两个子系统已集成到具有双语界面、博物馆位置门控和文本转语音支持的生产级 Flutter 应用中。

背景: TimeLens 是一款为埃及大博物馆设计的 AI 驱动的双语移动导览应用。

目的: 解决馆内部署中的三个问题：51 件编目文物之间的细粒度视觉相似性、策展训练数据与手持相机条件之间的差距，以及 AI 导览可能陈述无根据历史事实的风险。

方法: 1. 开发了设备端文物检测器，通过数据质量驱动的迭代研究，从基础模型自动标注、空间标签清理规则到完全手工标注数据集，最终确定 YOLOv8n 模型。2. 构建了基于 108 条记录 ChromaDB 知识库的双语检索增强生成导览系统，在七种候选语言模型中选择了 Gemma 4 E2B，并通过十项针对性优化降低延迟。3. 将两个子系统集成到生产级 Flutter 应用中，支持双语界面、博物馆位置门控和文本转语音功能。

主要发现: 1. 最终确定的 YOLOv8n 模型解决了所有之前失败的类别，模型大小为 5.97 MB，可在中端手机上实时运行，mAP@0.5 为 0.995，mAP@0.5:0.95 为 0.924。2. 通过十项针对性优化，将端到端延迟从超过 30 秒降低至约 10 秒。

结论: TimeLens 应用成功集成了文物检测和双语导览功能，解决了馆内部署中的关键问题，并在实际应用中实现了实时性和低延迟。

翻译: TimeLens is an AI-powered bilingual mobile guide for the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Pointing a phone at an exhibit, a visitor sees the artifact recognized in real time and can ask follow-up questions answered in English or Arabic. The work addresses three problems specific to in-gallery deployment: fine-grained visual similarity among 51 catalogued artifacts (many near-identical Ramesside statues), the gap between curated training data and handheld camera conditions, and the risk of an AI guide stating unsupported historical facts. Two engineering contributions are reported. First, an on-device artifact detector was developed through a data-quality-driven iteration study -- from foundation-model auto-annotation (YOLO-World), through spatial label-cleaning rules, to a fully hand-annotated dataset -- isolating label quality as the decisive factor: the final YOLOv8n model resolves every previously failing class while remaining a 5.97 MB TensorFlow Lite asset that runs in real time on a mid-range phone (mAP@0.5 = 0.995, mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.924). Second, a bilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) guide, grounded in a 108-record ChromaDB knowledge base, was benchmarked across seven candidate language models, with Gemma 4 E2B (Q4 K M) selected; ten targeted optimizations reduce end-to-end latency from over 30 s to approximately 10 s. Both subsystems are integrated in a production Flutter application with bilingual interface, museum location gating, and text-to-speech support.

Abstract

TimeLens is an AI-powered bilingual mobile guide for the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Pointing a phone at an exhibit, a visitor sees the artifact recognized in real time and can ask follow-up questions answered in English or Arabic. The work addresses three problems specific to in-gallery deployment: fine-grained visual similarity among 51 catalogued artifacts (many near-identical Ramesside statues), the gap between curated training data and handheld camera conditions, and the risk of an AI guide stating unsupported historical facts. Two engineering contributions are reported. First, an on-device artifact detector was developed through a data-quality-driven iteration study -- from foundation-model auto-annotation (YOLO-World), through spatial label-cleaning rules, to a fully hand-annotated dataset -- isolating label quality as the decisive factor: the final YOLOv8n model resolves every previously failing class while remaining a 5.97 MB TensorFlow Lite asset that runs in real time on a mid-range phone (mAP@0.5 = 0.995, mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.924). Second, a bilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) guide, grounded in a 108-record ChromaDB knowledge base, was benchmarked across seven candidate language models, with Gemma 4 E2B (Q4 K M) selected; ten targeted optimizations reduce end-to-end latency from over 30 s to approximately 10 s. Both subsystems are integrated in a production Flutter application with bilingual interface, museum location gating, and text-to-speech support.

item.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models with Holistic Visual Tokenizers
item.author: Guozhen Zhang, Xuerui Qiu, Yutao Cui, Tianhui Song, Changlin Li, Junzhe Li, Tao Huang, Xiao Zhang, Yang Li, Jianbing Wu, Miles Yang, Zhao Zhong, Liefeng Bo, Limin Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了HYDRA-X，这是首个在单个视觉变换器中统一图像和视频标记化的统一多模态模型。该模型通过解决时空重建能力注入和语义意识嵌入两大挑战，提出了分层时间压缩和轻量级解压缩器，并改进了编辑流水线，在图像和视频理解与生成任务中取得了强大性能。

背景: 整体视觉标记化器是统一多模态模型的基础，负责将多样化的视觉输入映射到统一的表示空间。

目的: 提出HYDRA-X，首个在单个视觉变换器中统一图像和视频标记化的统一多模态模型，以解决时空重建能力注入和语义意识嵌入的挑战。

方法: 采用帧级因果时间注意力进行视觉重建，使用分层时间压缩替代单步替代方案，提出轻量级解压缩器在联合图像视频教师监督下对时间压缩特征进行上采样，并改进编辑流水线使源目标交互发生在标记化器内部的潜在层面。

主要发现: 帧级因果时间注意力足以进行视觉重建，而完整时空注意力会降低重建效果；分层时间压缩显著优于单步替代方案；在潜在层面进行源目标交互可显著提高编辑一致性和加速收敛。

结论: HYDRA-X在图像和视频理解与生成任务中实现了强大性能，为未来统一标记化器的统一多模态模型铺平了道路。

翻译: 整体视觉标记化器是统一多模态模型的基础，负责将多样化的视觉输入映射到统一的表示空间。在本文中，我们提出了HYDRA-X，这是首个在单个视觉变换器中统一图像和视频标记化的统一多模态模型。我们的设计由两大核心挑战驱动：将时空重建能力高效注入原生视觉变换器，以及在潜在空间中嵌入图像和视频级别的语义意识。为了解决第一个挑战，全面的消融研究揭示了两个关键发现：帧级因果时间注意力足以进行视觉重建，而完整的时空注意力会降低重建效果；分层时间压缩显著优于单步替代方案。为了解决第二个挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级解压缩器，在联合图像视频教师监督下对时间压缩特征进行上采样，从而在紧凑的潜在空间中强制执行互补的语义结构。在此基础上，我们进一步提出了一种原则性的编辑流水线改进：源目标交互应发生在标记化器内部的潜在层面，而不是语言大模型内部的语义层面，这显著提高了编辑一致性和加速了收敛。在7B密集模型上实例化的HYDRA-X在图像和视频理解与生成任务中实现了强大性能，为未来统一标记化器的统一多模态模型铺平了道路。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要致力于构建一个能同时处理图像和视频的统一视觉分词器，将其压缩到共享的潜在空间中，以解决现有模型在图像与视频编码上相互割裂或缺乏时空语义对齐的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为统一的视觉表示能够消除不同编码器之间的匹配差异，促进视觉理解与生成任务的相互增强，并显著提升图像编辑等任务的连贯性与训练效率，为多模态大模型提供高效通用的底层视觉接口。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者主要围绕如何将时空重建能力高效融入原生视觉网络，以及如何将图像与视频的语义感知能力嵌入共享潜在空间这两个核心挑战展开设计。通过实验发现，仅关注相邻帧的因果注意力比全局注意力更能保留结构信息，且分层时序压缩优于单步压缩，同时引入轻量级解压模块结合图像与视频教师网络进行联合监督以强化语义结构。该方法借鉴了前期单模态统一多模态框架的压缩与恢复蒸馏思想，并在此基础上扩展至视频任务，同时参考了相关预训练视觉模型进行初始化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个统一的视觉词元器，将图像和视频映射到同一个表示空间中，使大语言模型能够原生地联合处理视觉理解与生成任务。整体流程首先通过视觉模型采用帧级因果时间注意力与分层压缩技术高效提取时空特征；接着利用轻量级解压模块结合图像与视频教师网络进行语义蒸馏，确保压缩后的潜在表示既保留像素细节又具备丰富的语义结构；最后将特征输入大语言模型，并在图像编辑任务中于词元器内部直接进行源图与目标图的潜在层交互，从而实现多模态任务的高效统一。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次在一个视觉模型中统一了图像与视频的编码，并针对时空重建与语义感知提出了两项反直觉设计。与以往逐帧独立处理或缺乏语义约束的级联架构不同，本文发现仅关注相邻帧的因果注意力比全局注意力更能保留图像先验，且分层压缩策略显著优于单步压缩。此外，论文引入轻量级解压模块结合图文双教师监督以强化语义结构，并将图像编辑的源目标交互提前至编码阶段的潜在层进行，从而在统一框架下同时提升了重建质量、编辑一致性与训练效率。
