Abstract

Holistic visual tokenizers are fundamental to unified multimodal models (UMMs) as they map diverse visual inputs into a unified representation space. In this paper, we present HYDRA-X, the first UMM that unifies image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer (ViT). Our design is driven by two core challenges: efficiently injecting spatiotemporal reconstruction capability into a native ViT, and embedding image- and video-level semantic awareness into the latent space. To address the first, comprehensive ablations reveal two key findings: (1) frame-level causal temporal attention suffices for visual reconstruction, whereas full spatiotemporal attention degrades it; and (2) hierarchical temporal compression substantially outperforms single-step alternatives. To tackle the second, we propose a lightweight decompressor that upsamples temporally compressed features under joint image-video teacher supervision, thereby enforcing complementary semantic structures within the compact latent space. Building on this holistic tokenizer, we further propose a principled improvement of the editing pipeline: source-target interaction should occur at the latent level inside the tokenizer rather than at the semantic level inside the LLM, substantially improving editing consistency and accelerating convergence. Instantiated at the 7B dense model, HYDRA-X achieves strong performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks, paving the way for future unified-tokenizer UMMs.

item.title: Physics-Guided Spatiotemporal Learning for Coastal Wave Peak Period Estimation from Video
item.author: Abubakar Hamisu Kamagata, Dharm Singh Jat, Attlee Munyaradzi Gamundani, Abhishek Srivastava, Paramasivam Saravanakumar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种物理引导的深度时空学习框架，用于从被动海岸视频流中直接估计近岸波峰周期。

背景: 近岸波浪参数对海岸工程、海岸线保护、海洋灾害评估和气候韧性海岸管理至关重要。传统的监测系统如浮标和雷达平台虽然监测准确，但安装和维护成本高，空间覆盖有限。基于视频的被动海洋监测利用深度学习实现，但许多方法缺乏物理可解释性、可行性和海洋学验证。

目的: 开发一种物理引导的深度时空学习框架，以直接从被动海岸视频流中估计近岸波峰周期，提高预测准确性和物理一致性。

方法: 结合基于自动时间方差感兴趣区域检测、多阶段模拟到现实迁移学习和物理信息正则化的框架。评估了多种时空架构，如基于变换器和循环卷积架构，以及合成预训练、银标签适应和专家微调。

主要发现: 基于变换器的架构在瞬时预测准确性方面表现更好，而轻量级循环卷积架构实现了更高的时间稳定性和操作海洋学技能。物理引导正则化在趋势跟随一致性和避免物理上不可预测方面显示出优势。可解释性审计有助于关注水动力活跃的近岸区域，并与物理推导的波浪传播行为显示出良好的一致性。

结论: 提出的框架展示了物理引导的视频深度学习系统在长期海岸波浪监测中的潜力，具有成本效益和操作可行性。

翻译: 近岸波浪参数对海岸工程、海岸线保护、海洋灾害评估和气候韧性海岸管理至关重要。传统的监测系统如浮标和雷达平台虽然监测准确，但安装和维护成本高，空间覆盖有限。基于视频的被动海洋监测利用深度学习实现，但许多方法缺乏物理可解释性、可行性和海洋学验证。本文提出了一种物理引导的深度时空学习框架，用于从被动海岸视频流中直接估计近岸波峰周期。该框架结合了基于自动时间方差感兴趣区域检测、多阶段模拟到现实迁移学习和物理信息正则化，以提高预测准确性和物理一致性。评估了多种时空架构，如基于变换器和循环卷积架构，以及合成预训练、银标签适应和专家微调。结果显示，基于变换器的架构在瞬时预测准确性方面表现更好，而轻量级循环卷积架构实现了更高的时间稳定性和操作海洋学技能。消融研究还表明，物理引导正则化在趋势跟随一致性和避免物理上不可预测方面显示出优势。可解释性审计有助于关注水动力活跃的近岸区域，并与物理推导的波浪传播行为显示出良好的一致性。总体而言，提出的框架展示了物理引导的视频深度学习系统在长期海岸波浪监测中的潜力，具有成本效益和操作可行性。

Abstract

Wave parameters in the nearshore are crucial for coastal engineering, shoreline protection, marine hazard assessment, and coastal management for climate resilience. Traditional monitoring systems like buoys and radar platforms offer accurate monitoring but can have high installation and maintenance expenses and limited spatial coverage. Passive ocean monitoring using video has been achieved by leveraging deep learning, however, many methods are not physically interpretable, feasible, and validated for oceanography. In thiswork, a Physics-Guided Deep Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for direct estimation of nearshore wave peak periods from passive coastal video stream is proposed. The framework combines automated temporal-variance based region-of-interest detection, multi-stage Sim-to-Real transfer learning, and physics-informed regularization to enhance the predictive accuracy and physical consistency. A variety of spatiotemporal architectures were assessed, such as transformer-based and recurrent-convolutional ones, alongside synthetic pretraining,silver-label adaptation, and expert fine-tuning. The results show that transformer-based architectures outperformed in terms of the accuracy of the instantaneous prediction, while lightweight recurrent-convolutional architectures achieved higher temporal stability and operational oceanographic skill. Ablation studies also demonstrated the benefits of physics-guided regularization in terms of trend-following consistency, and physically implausible predictions. Explainability auditing also helped to focus attention in hydrodynamically active surf-zone regions and showed good agreement with the physically derived wave propagation behavior. In general, the proposed framework shows the promise of physics-guided video-based deep learning systems for long-term coastal wave monitoring that are cost-efficient and operationally feasible.

item.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
item.author: Lai, Xunhao, Xu, Weiqi, Yang, Yufeng, Chen, Qiaorui, Xu, Yang, Zeng, Lunbin, Li, Xiaolong, Sun, Haohai, Zhu, Haichao, Zhang, Vito, Zhao, Pengyu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MiniMax稀疏注意力机制（MSA），这是一种基于分组查询注意力（GQA）的块级稀疏注意力方法，旨在解决超长上下文处理中的计算成本问题。

背景: 前沿大语言模型在智能体工作流、仓库级代码推理和持久记忆等应用中需要处理数十万至数百万个标记，但softmax注意力的二次方成本使得在部署规模下难以实现。

目的: 设计一种简单且可扩展的注意力机制，以在保持性能的同时显著降低超长上下文处理中的计算成本，并提高在GPU上的执行效率。

方法: 提出MSA，包含索引分支和主分支。索引分支对键值块进行评分并独立选择每个GQA组的Top-k子集，实现组特定的稀疏检索；主分支仅对选定的块执行精确的块稀疏注意力。同时，与GPU执行路径协同设计，使用无指数运算的Top-k选择和KV外积稀疏注意力，以提高块粒度访问下的张量核心利用率。

主要发现: 在109B参数的原生多模态模型上，MSA在1M上下文长度下与GQA性能相当，但每标记注意力计算量减少了28.4倍。结合协同设计的内核，在H800 GPU上实现了14.2倍的预填充加速和7.6倍的解码墙钟时间加速。

结论: MSA通过简化设计和与GPU执行路径的协同优化，成功实现了高效部署和显著的性能提升，其推理内核和基于MSA的生产级原生多模态模型已公开。

翻译: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and independently selects a Top-k subset for each GQA group, enabling group-specific sparse retrieval while maintaining efficient block-level execution; the Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention over only the selected blocks. Designed around a principle of simplicity and scalability, MSA is deliberately streamlined, making it straightforward to deploy efficiently across a broad range of GPUs. To translate sparsity into practical speedups, we co-design MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access. On a 109B-parameter model with native multimodal training, MSA performs on par with GQA while reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4x at 1M context. Paired with our co-designed kernel, MSA achieves 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding wall-clock speedups on H800. Our inference kernel is available at: this https URL . A production-grade natively multimodal model powered by MSA has been publicly released at: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在处理超长文本时，传统注意力机制带来的计算成本过高与内存瓶颈问题。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为智能体工作流、代码推理和持久记忆等前沿应用均要求模型同时关注数十万至数百万个词元，若无法突破这一计算限制，将严重阻碍大模型的实际部署与能力扩展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者遵循奥卡姆剃刀原则与简洁可扩展的设计理念，为突破超长上下文的计算瓶颈，将方法精简为仅保留核心组件的两分支结构。该设计直接借鉴了分组查询注意力机制，并沿用了稀疏注意力范式，旨在最大程度复用现有的软硬件基础设施。同时，作者将算法与底层图形处理器执行路径协同设计，以将理论上的计算节省转化为实际的运行加速。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是引入块级稀疏注意力机制，通过仅关注序列中最重要的少数关键数据块，打破传统注意力计算量随序列长度平方增长的瓶颈。整体流程分为索引与计算两阶段：索引阶段先用轻量级网络对历史数据块打分并筛选出得分最高的固定数量块，计算阶段则仅在这些被选中的块内执行精确的注意力运算。训练时通过分布对齐损失引导索引网络学习，并配合梯度隔离与强制保留最近数据块等策略保障稳定性，最终结合专用显卡计算内核实现高效的端到端加速。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于分组查询注意力机制的块级稀疏架构。它通过轻量级索引分支独立筛选每个注意力组的关键数据块，主分支仅在这些块上进行精确计算，并强制保留当前局部块以保障训练稳定。与以往依赖细粒度词元选择或复杂路由的工作不同，该方法采用块级共享策略大幅降低路由开销，并专门设计了免指数运算的筛选机制与数据排布方式，实现了算法与硬件内核的深度协同，从而在保持模型性能的同时显著提升了长上下文场景下的实际运行速度。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为MiniMax稀疏注意力的高效块级注意力机制，通过算法与图形处理器内核的协同设计，在百万级上下文长度下实现了大幅推理加速，同时保持了与原始注意力机制相当的性能，并支持从头训练与预训练模型转换。

Abstract

Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and independently selects a Top-k subset for each GQA group, enabling group-specific sparse retrieval while maintaining efficient block-level execution; the Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention over only the selected blocks. Designed around a principle of simplicity and scalability, MSA is deliberately streamlined, making it straightforward to deploy efficiently across a broad range of GPUs. To translate sparsity into practical speedups, we co-design MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access. On a 109B-parameter model with native multimodal training, MSA performs on par with GQA while reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4x at 1M context. Paired with our co-designed kernel, MSA achieves 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding wall-clock speedups on H800. Our inference kernel is available at: this https URL . A production-grade natively multimodal model powered by MSA has been publicly released at: this https URL .

item.title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
item.author: Chen, Jiacheng, Zhang, Xinyu, Zhang, Shunkai, Wang, Yanmohan, Li, Lin, Qin, Tiancheng, Wang, Qin, Zhu, Zhengmao, Li, Tianle, Li, Jingyang, Li, Zehan, Jiang, Binyang, Zhu, Jin, Ding, Han, Yu, Fei, Du, Chenyu, Song, Zijian, Song, Jiayuan, Zhang, Zhi, Huang, Yunan, Cheng, Weiyu, Zhao, Pengyu, Cheng, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MaxProof，这是一种用于MiniMax-M3系列模型在竞赛级数学证明中的群体级测试时扩展框架。

背景: MiniMax-M3系列模型在数学证明领域的应用。

目的: 提升模型在竞赛级数学证明任务中的表现，达到人类金牌水平。

方法: 首先训练三种面向证明的能力：证明生成、证明验证和基于批评的证明修复，使用针对低误报率设计的纵深防御生成验证器。然后将这些能力合并到单个发布的M3模型中。在测试时，将模型作为生成器、验证器、优化器和排名器，在候选证明群体中进行搜索，并通过锦标赛选择返回最终证明。

主要发现: 通过MaxProof测试时扩展，M3模型在2025年国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）中取得42题中的35分，在2026年美国数学奥林匹克竞赛（USAMO）中取得42题中的36分。

结论: M3模型在IMO和USAMO中的成绩均超过了人类金牌门槛。

翻译: We present MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities -- proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair -- using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker, searches over a population of candidate proofs, and returns one final proof through tournament selection. With MaxProof test-time scaling, the M3 model reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何利用大语言模型可靠地生成竞赛级数学证明的问题，重点突破训练时奖励信号不可靠、模型容易钻空子以及推理阶段难以扩展计算资源等瓶颈。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为数学证明要求严密的逻辑链条且容错率极低，是检验人工智能可靠推理能力的核心压力测试。成功解决这一问题不仅能推动自动定理证明和数学教育的发展，还能显著提升大模型在复杂科学计算与学术探索中的实际应用能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者将竞赛级数学证明任务拆解为生成、验证与修正三个核心能力，并通过分阶段专项训练将其整合至单一模型中。在测试阶段，他们借鉴了自一致性、树状推理与验证修正流水线等现有研究思路，设计了基于群体搜索与锦标赛选拔的扩展框架，以分摊验证器噪声并提升结果稳定性。整体方法的设计充分吸收了强化学习、过程监督与推理时间扩展等领域的成熟技术，并针对训练中出现的奖励作弊问题引入了多层防御机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将数学证明的生成、验证与修正能力整合到单一模型中，并通过测试时的群体搜索与对抗筛选机制，将多次尝试的最佳结果转化为稳定的一次性正确输出。整体流程首先通过强化学习训练证明生成、错误定位与修正三个专项能力，并将它们融合为统一模型；在测试阶段，模型会批量生成候选证明，利用验证器进行保守评分与过滤，结合局部修改与重写策略进行迭代优化，最后通过两两对决的锦标赛机制选出最终证明。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于提出了一套针对数学证明的生成式验证器强化学习框架与群体级测试时扩展方法。它通过包含过滤、标准化、多裁判评分与保守聚合的四层验证器大幅降低训练误报率，并将证明生成、验证与修正能力整合至单一模型中。相比以往依赖单一评分器或结果反馈的工作，该方法通过群体搜索与锦标赛选择机制，将概率性生成转化为更稳定的最终答案输出，有效避免了奖励作弊并提升了复杂证明的求解成功率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种融合证明生成、验证与修复能力的统一模型，并设计了基于群体搜索的测试时扩展框架，成功使模型在多项顶级数学竞赛中达到人类金牌水平。

Abstract

We present MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities -- proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair -- using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker, searches over a population of candidate proofs, and returns one final proof through tournament selection. With MaxProof test-time scaling, the M3 model reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

item.title: CloudCons: A Comprehensive End-to-End Benchmark for Cloud Resource Consolidation
item.author: Xiaobin Zhang, Lefei Shen, Mouxiang Chen, Zhuo Li, Hongkai Li, Han Fu, Jianling Sun, Xiaoxue Ren, Chenghao Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对云计算数据中心资源利用率低的问题，提出CloudCons基准测试，评估预测模型在资源整合中的实际决策效用，发现基础模型虽预测精度高但未必提升决策效用，并提供了预测分位数选择的指导。

背景: 保守过度配置导致云数据中心资源利用率低，预测优化范式通过预测未来需求来优化整合。时间序列基础模型有望通过零样本泛化增强该范式，但现有基准仅关注预测误差指标，未验证其实际决策效用。

目的: 提出CloudCons基准测试，以在云资源整合的具体背景下评估预测模型的实际决策效用，弥补现有研究仅关注预测误差的不足。

方法: 构建涵盖华为云、微软Azure和Google Borg等不同工作负载的高质量数据集，对统计模型、深度学习和基础模型进行广泛评估，分析预测分位数选择对资源效率和可靠性权衡的影响。

主要发现: 基础模型在零样本预测精度上表现优越，但这种优势并不必然转化为更好的决策效用。预测分位数选择是关键杠杆，影响资源效率和可靠性之间的权衡。

结论: 通过系统分析预测分位数选择，提供了校准这些选择的可行指南，以平衡资源效率和可靠性，为实际部署决策提供重要见解。

翻译: Driven by conservative over-provisioning to guarantee service reliability, resource utilization in cloud data centers remains at low levels. To mitigate this, the forecast-then-optimize paradigm has emerged to optimize consolidation by anticipating future demands. While emerging time series foundation models promise to enhance this paradigm through zero-shot generalization, existing benchmarks focus solely on prediction error metrics. The actual decision utility of these advanced models remains unverified, rendering their practical value for downstream tasks uncertain. To bridge this gap, we propose CloudCons, a comprehensive end-to-end benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models within the specific context of cloud resource consolidation. We build high-quality datasets that cover diverse workloads from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg, capturing distinct service characteristics ranging from synchronized diurnal rhythms to stochastic, pulse-like bursts and high-frequency noise. We conduct an extensive evaluation of statistical, deep learning, and foundation models. Our experiments reveal a pivotal finding: while foundation models demonstrate superior zero-shot forecasting accuracy, this advantage does not inherently translate into better decision utility. Of practical significance, we systematically analyze how the selection of predictive quantiles acts as a critical lever. We provide actionable guidelines for calibrating these selections to balance the trade-off between resource efficiency and service reliability, offering vital insights for real-world deployment decisions.

Abstract

Driven by conservative over-provisioning to guarantee service reliability, resource utilization in cloud data centers remains at low levels. To mitigate this, the forecast-then-optimize paradigm has emerged to optimize consolidation by anticipating future demands. While emerging time series foundation models promise to enhance this paradigm through zero-shot generalization, existing benchmarks focus solely on prediction error metrics. The actual decision utility of these advanced models remains unverified, rendering their practical value for downstream tasks uncertain. To bridge this gap, we propose CloudCons, a comprehensive end-to-end benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models within the specific context of cloud resource consolidation. We build high-quality datasets that cover diverse workloads from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg, capturing distinct service characteristics ranging from synchronized diurnal rhythms to stochastic, pulse-like bursts and high-frequency noise. We conduct an extensive evaluation of statistical, deep learning, and foundation models. Our experiments reveal a pivotal finding: while foundation models demonstrate superior zero-shot forecasting accuracy, this advantage does not inherently translate into better decision utility. Of practical significance, we systematically analyze how the selection of predictive quantiles acts as a critical lever. We provide actionable guidelines for calibrating these selections to balance the trade-off between resource efficiency and service reliability, offering vital insights for real-world deployment decisions.

item.title: NetCause: Counterfactual Learning for Root Cause Analysis in Large-Scale Networks
item.author: Fabien Chraim, Jian Zhang, Dominik Janzing, Xiang Song, Christos Faloutsos, John Evans
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: NetCause是一个基于自监督学习的框架，用于网络故障根因分析。

背景: 现有根因分析技术依赖静态规则、相关性启发式方法或拓扑局部推理，在动态环境中难以泛化。

目的: 捕捉故障在大型网络中的传播方式，并将客户影响因果归因于根本原因。

方法: 将网络事件建模为图时序过程，使用反事实仿真对候选根因进行排序。

主要发现: 在1500多个事件上训练，在31个专家标注事件上评估，根因排序质量提升16.1%，推理速度快。

结论: NetCause能有效提升根因分析准确性，且推理轻量，适合实际运维决策。

翻译: Can a learned model capture how faults propagate through a large-scale network and use this knowledge to causally attribute customer impact to its underlying root cause? Existing root cause analysis techniques often rely on static rules, correlation heuristics, or topology-local reasoning, which struggle to generalize in dynamic environments where faults propagate across complex physical and logical dependencies. We present NetCause, a self-supervised learning-based framework that models network incidents as graph-temporal processes and uses counterfactual simulation to rank candidate root causes. This approach produces an interpretable ranking of root cause hypotheses and integrates naturally with operator-defined mitigation and remediation actions. We train the model on over 1,500 incidents collected over six months from a leading cloud provider's production network and evaluate it on 31 expert-labeled incidents. NetCause consistently improves root cause ranking quality in the regime most relevant to operational decision-making, achieving a 16.1% accuracy improvement over a rule-based heuristic baseline. While training is computationally intensive, inference is lightweight, requiring only seconds of GPU runtime per incident (well below typical telemetry collection latencies).

Abstract

Can a learned model capture how faults propagate through a large-scale network and use this knowledge to causally attribute customer impact to its underlying root cause? Existing root cause analysis techniques often rely on static rules, correlation heuristics, or topology-local reasoning, which struggle to generalize in dynamic environments where faults propagate across complex physical and logical dependencies. We present NetCause, a self-supervised learning-based framework that models network incidents as graph-temporal processes and uses counterfactual simulation to rank candidate root causes. This approach produces an interpretable ranking of root cause hypotheses and integrates naturally with operator-defined mitigation and remediation actions. We train the model on over 1,500 incidents collected over six months from a leading cloud provider's production network and evaluate it on 31 expert-labeled incidents. NetCause consistently improves root cause ranking quality in the regime most relevant to operational decision-making, achieving a 16.1% accuracy improvement over a rule-based heuristic baseline. While training is computationally intensive, inference is lightweight, requiring only seconds of GPU runtime per incident (well below typical telemetry collection latencies).

item.title: ArogyaSutra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Medical Reasoning in Indic Languages
item.author: Halder, Tanmoy Kanti, Ghosh, Akash, Baidya, Subhadip, Roy, Arijit, Saha, Sriparna
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在医疗领域特别是多语言和低资源场景下表现有限的问题，提出了一个名为ArogyaBodha的多语言多模态医疗问答数据集和一个名为ArogyaSutra的多智能体框架，旨在提升多语言医疗推理能力。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在通用领域展现出有前景的推理能力，但在医疗等专门领域，尤其是在多语言和低资源场景下，其性能仍然有限。在印度农村地区，患者通常用本土印度语言提出复杂的医疗查询并依赖多模态输入，而现有的以英语为中心的多模态大语言模型难以支持此类用例，限制了公平获取人工智能驱动的医疗援助。

目的: 解决现有模型在多语言医疗场景下的不足，提升多语言医疗推理的准确性，促进公平获取人工智能驱动的医疗援助。

方法: 构建了ArogyaBodha数据集，该数据集来自八个异构来源，涵盖三十一个人体系统、六种成像模态和二十一个临床领域，涉及英语和七种主要印度语言。提出了ArogyaSutra框架，这是一个基于演员-评论家的多智能体框架，集成了工具定位和双记忆机制，用于逐步推理感知的决策，并利用存储的演员-评论家模拟轨迹进行蒸馏。

主要发现: 实验表明，所提出的数据集和框架在所有印度语言上提高了多语言医疗推理的准确性，消融实验验证了每个组件的贡献。

结论: ArogyaBodha数据集和ArogyaSutra框架有效提升了多语言医疗推理能力，为多语言医疗人工智能应用提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet their performance remains limited in specialized settings such as healthcare, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios. This gap is critical in regions like rural India, where patients often express complex medical queries in native Indic languages and rely on multimodal inputs such as medical images. Existing English-centric MLLMs struggle to support such use cases, limiting equitable access to AI-driven healthcare assistance. To address this challenge, we introduce ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset constructed from eight heterogeneous sources, covering 31 body systems, six imaging modalities, and 21 clinical domains across English and seven major Indian languages. We further propose ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation. Experiments show that our dataset and framework improve multilingual medical reasoning accuracy across all Indic languages, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. The source code and dataset are available at: this https URL ArogyaSutra/

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有医疗多模态模型在印度语系等低资源语言中推理能力不足、语言一致性差以及缺乏逐步推理机制的问题。这一问题在现实中至关重要，因为印度等地区的患者常使用母语结合医学影像提出复杂健康咨询，现有以英语为主的模型无法满足需求，严重限制了人工智能医疗辅助的公平性与可及性。在研究中，填补这一空白有助于推动多语言医疗人工智能的可靠性、公平性及实际临床应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有医疗模型在低资源印度语言中缺乏逐步推理与语言一致性的问题，设计了结合视觉工具定位与双记忆机制的演员与评论家协作框架。该方法明确借鉴了现有的强化学习、多智能体协作及思维链推理等研究基础，并在此基础上引入短期与长期记忆模块记录历史错误，通过评论家反馈与语言切换机制实现迭代修正，从而构建出专为印度语言医疗场景优化的推理系统。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是采用演员与评论家协作的多智能体架构，结合工具辅助的视觉定位与双记忆机制，实现分步推理与动态纠错，从而提升低资源印度语言医疗场景下的多模态推理准确性与语言一致性。整体流程为：演员模型首先调用视觉工具提取图像关键信息并生成中间推理步骤，随后由评论家模型评估其医学正确性与语言一致性。若评估未通过，系统会识别错误类型，语言错误则切换至英语处理，推理错误则结合长短时记忆中的历史错误进行修正，最后将优化后的输入反馈给演员模型进行迭代优化，直至输出最终答案。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于构建了覆盖七种印度语言及英语的大规模多模态医疗问答数据集，并提出了由执行者与评估者协作的多智能体推理框架。相比以往主要依赖英语且偏向直接输出最终答案的医疗模型，该工作专门针对低资源印度语言场景，引入了视觉工具辅助分析与双记忆机制。它能够分步进行推理，并针对语言错误与逻辑错误分别采用切换语言和回顾历史错误的方式进行修正，从而显著提升了多语言医疗推理的准确性与稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文的核心贡献是构建了一个涵盖七种印度语言的多模态医学问答基准数据集，并提出了一种结合视觉工具定位与双记忆机制的双智能体框架，有效提升了低资源印度语言环境下的多模态医学推理准确性与语言一致性。

Abstract

Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet their performance remains limited in specialized settings such as healthcare, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios. This gap is critical in regions like rural India, where patients often express complex medical queries in native Indic languages and rely on multimodal inputs such as medical images. Existing English-centric MLLMs struggle to support such use cases, limiting equitable access to AI-driven healthcare assistance. To address this challenge, we introduce ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset constructed from eight heterogeneous sources, covering 31 body systems, six imaging modalities, and 21 clinical domains across English and seven major Indian languages. We further propose ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation. Experiments show that our dataset and framework improve multilingual medical reasoning accuracy across all Indic languages, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. The source code and dataset are available at: this https URL ArogyaSutra/

item.title: LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories
item.author: Ren, Baochang, Liu, Xinjie, Chen, Xi, Liu, Yanshuo, Li, Chenxi, Gao, Daqi, Su, Zeqin, Xing, Jintao, Xue, Zirui, Li, Rui, Zhao, Xiangyu, Qiao, Shuofei, Pan, Minting, Zuo, Wangmeng, Bai, Lei, Zhou, Dongzhan, Zhang, Ningyu, Chen, Huajun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对科学实验室中AI系统难以执行物理实验操作的问题，提出了一种结合仿真数据引擎和策略模型的解决方案，通过构建RoboGenesis和LabVLA，实现了在实验室环境下的机器人实验协议执行，并在LabUtopia基准测试中取得了最佳性能。

背景: 科学实验室日益依赖AI系统进行实验推理，但物理实验操作仍主要依赖人工。现有的视觉语言动作模型主要基于家庭或桌面演示训练，缺乏对科学实验室中仪器、透明液体及固定协议工作流的适应。

目的: 缩小AI系统与科学实验室物理操作之间的差距，解决数据获取和机器人形态差异带来的瓶颈，实现从书面协议到机器人执行的有效对接。

方法: 构建RoboGenesis仿真数据引擎，从原子技能组合实验室工作流并导出结构化演示数据；提出LabVLA策略模型，采用两阶段训练方法，包括FAST动作令牌预训练和流匹配后训练，结合Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct主干和DiT动作专家。

主要发现: 在LabUtopia基准测试中，LabVLA在分布内和分布外设置下均取得了所有评估基线中最高的平均成功率。

结论: 通过解决数据和形态瓶颈，结合仿真数据引擎和两阶段策略训练，AI系统能够有效执行科学实验室中的实验协议，为自动化科学实验提供了可行路径。

翻译: Scientific laboratories increasingly rely on AI systems to reason about experiments, but the physical act of doing science remains largely outside their reach. AI can help read literature, generate hypotheses, and plan protocols, yet the execution of those protocols at the bench still requires a human operator. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide one possible interface between written protocols and robot execution, but existing policies are trained mostly on household and tabletop demonstrations and rarely encounter the instruments, transparent liquids, or fixed protocol workflows found in scientific laboratories. Closing this gap requires both laboratory-specific supervision and a unified learning framework that can accommodate the diverse robot embodiments used to execute experimental protocols. We therefore identify data and embodiment as central bottlenecks alongside model design. To address the data side, we build RoboGenesis, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles. On the policy side, we present LabVLA, trained with a two-stage recipe: FAST action token pretraining first makes the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone action aware before any continuous control is learned, and flow matching posttraining then attaches a DiT action expert under knowledge insulation. On the LabUtopia benchmark, LabVLA achieves the highest average success rate among all evaluated baselines under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是将科学实验室中的书面实验协议转化为机器人物理执行的问题，即让人工智能模型能够准确识别并操作实验室仪器以完成复杂实验流程。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为当前实验台的物理操作仍高度依赖人工，且现有模型缺乏对精密仪器、液体转移和固定实验流程的认知。实现自动化实验操作不仅能大幅降低人力与设备成本，还能提高操作精度与安全性，从而加速科学研究的进程。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出现有模型多基于家庭场景训练，缺乏实验室特有的仪器操作知识且真实数据采集成本过高，因此将数据质量与机器人形态适配视为核心瓶颈。基于此，他们设计了仿真数据生成引擎以低成本构建实验室演示集，并采用两阶段训练策略配合知识隔离机制，使模型能精准理解实验指令并控制不同机器人执行固定流程。该方法在通用视觉与操作先验上借鉴了公开的大型机器人数据集，同时直接融合了动作令牌预训练、流匹配预测及扩散网络动作专家等成熟算法进行组合优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将科学实验室自动化视为视觉语言动作模型的学习问题，通过解决专业数据稀缺与机器人形态多样性的瓶颈，实现书面实验协议到机器人物理执行的无缝对接。整体流程分为数据合成与策略训练两部分：首先利用仿真引擎自动构建实验室场景，将自然语言指令分解为基础操作技能，在多种机器人平台上进行环境随机化与成功过滤以生成高质量训练数据；随后采用两阶段训练策略，先通过动作标记预训练使视觉语言模型理解动作语义，再通过流匹配后训练结合知识隔离机制，精准输出连续的控制指令。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于构建了面向科学实验室的机器人操作框架及配套的数据生成引擎。数据引擎能够基于基础操作技能自动组合长程实验流程，支持多类机器人平台部署、场景随机化与执行结果过滤，并生成包含专业仪器和标准操作流程的结构化数据，弥补了现有数据集缺乏实验室专属内容的不足。模型方面采用分阶段训练策略，先通过动作令牌预训练让视觉语言模型具备动作感知能力，再通过流匹配技术生成连续控制指令，并引入知识隔离机制防止语言理解与动作预测相互干扰。整体方案实现了将书面实验协议直接转化为机器人物理执行动作的高效闭环。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出LabVLA模型与RoboGenesis仿真数据引擎，通过构建实验室专属数据集与两阶段训练策略，有效解决了科学实验自动化中数据稀缺与机器人形态适配的瓶颈，显著提升了机器人在实验室环境中的实验协议执行成功率。

Abstract

Scientific laboratories increasingly rely on AI systems to reason about experiments, but the physical act of doing science remains largely outside their reach. AI can help read literature, generate hypotheses, and plan protocols, yet the execution of those protocols at the bench still requires a human operator. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide one possible interface between written protocols and robot execution, but existing policies are trained mostly on household and tabletop demonstrations and rarely encounter the instruments, transparent liquids, or fixed protocol workflows found in scientific laboratories. Closing this gap requires both laboratory-specific supervision and a unified learning framework that can accommodate the diverse robot embodiments used to execute experimental protocols. We therefore identify data and embodiment as central bottlenecks alongside model design. To address the data side, we build RoboGenesis, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles. On the policy side, we present LabVLA, trained with a two-stage recipe: FAST action token pretraining first makes the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone action aware before any continuous control is learned, and flow matching posttraining then attaches a DiT action expert under knowledge insulation. On the LabUtopia benchmark, LabVLA achieves the highest average success rate among all evaluated baselines under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

item.title: Beyond Uniform Tokens: Adaptive Compression for Time Series Language Models
item.author: Jialin Gan, Xin Qiu, Guangzhe Chen, Xue Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于非对称令牌视角的时间序列语言建模令牌效率优化框架，通过压缩时间序列令牌和逐层减少提示令牌，实现了推理加速和性能提升。

背景: 大型语言模型通过共享令牌接口联合建模数值观测和文本上下文，使时间序列分析成为可能。然而，时间序列令牌和提示令牌具有根本不同的信息结构，导致统一的令牌处理效率低下。

目的: 研究时间序列语言建模中的令牌效率问题，特别是从非对称令牌视角出发，优化时间序列令牌和提示令牌的处理方式。

方法: 开发了一种自适应令牌预算框架，通过频域结构压缩时间序列令牌，并在各层中逐步减少提示令牌。

主要发现: 时间序列令牌具有高度不均匀的频谱贡献，许多令牌共享冗余的频率模式，而少数令牌保留关键的时间证据。提示令牌的影响随模型深度衰减，表明无需在所有层中完全保留提示令牌。

结论: 非对称令牌压缩方法在预测、分类、插补和异常检测任务中实现了最高七点六八倍的推理加速，并在百分之七十八的评估设置中提升了性能，证明了其在可扩展时间序列基础模型中的有效性。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled time series (TS) analysis by jointly modeling numerical observations and textual context through a shared token interface. However, TS tokens and prompt tokens exhibit fundamentally different information structures, making uniform token processing inefficient. In this paper, we study token efficiency in TS language modeling from an asymmetric-token perspective. We show that TS tokens have highly uneven spectral contributions, where many tokens share redundant frequency patterns while a small subset preserves critical temporal evidence. We also observe that prompt-token influence attenuates with model depth, suggesting that full prompt retention across all layers is unnecessary. Based on these findings, we develop an adaptive token budgeting framework that compresses TS tokens via frequency-domain structure and progressively reduces prompt tokens across layers. Experiments across forecasting, classification, imputation, and anomaly detection demonstrate up to 7.68x inference acceleration and performance gains in 78% of evaluated settings, showing the effectiveness of asymmetric token compression for scalable TS foundation models.

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) have enabled time series (TS) analysis by jointly modeling numerical observations and textual context through a shared token interface. However, TS tokens and prompt tokens exhibit fundamentally different information structures, making uniform token processing inefficient. In this paper, we study token efficiency in TS language modeling from an asymmetric-token perspective. We show that TS tokens have highly uneven spectral contributions, where many tokens share redundant frequency patterns while a small subset preserves critical temporal evidence. We also observe that prompt-token influence attenuates with model depth, suggesting that full prompt retention across all layers is unnecessary. Based on these findings, we develop an adaptive token budgeting framework that compresses TS tokens via frequency-domain structure and progressively reduces prompt tokens across layers. Experiments across forecasting, classification, imputation, and anomaly detection demonstrate up to \textit{\textbf{7.68$\times$}} inference acceleration and performance gains in \textit{\textbf{78\%}} of evaluated settings, showing the effectiveness of asymmetric token compression for scalable TS foundation models.

item.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
item.author: Xin, Amy, Siow, Jiening, Wang, Junjie, Yao, Zijun, Zhang, Fanjin, Song, Jian, Hou, Lei, Li, Juanzi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为EurekAgent的环境工程化智能体系统，用于基于指标的自主科学发现。随着模型能力提升，自主科学发现的瓶颈正从设计智能体工作流转向设计智能体环境。EurekAgent通过权限、工件、预算和人机协作四个维度构建环境，以放大有益行为并抑制有害行为。该系统在多项数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上取得了新的最先进成果，包括以极低API成本发现新的二十六圆堆积最优解。作者开源了代码和结果，并呼吁将环境工程作为开发可靠自主研究智能体的核心研究方向。

背景: 基于大语言模型的智能体在自动化科学发现方面展现出巨大潜力，能够提出、验证和迭代科学解决方案，且结果已超越人类设计的方法。随着模型能力的不断提升，自主科学发现的瓶颈正从规定智能体工作流转向设计智能体环境，即塑造智能体行为的资源、约束和接口。

目的: 提出一种环境工程化的智能体系统，通过构建能够放大有益行为（如开放式探索、系统性工件管理、智能体间协作）并抑制有害行为（如奖励黑客攻击、高摩擦人类监督）的环境，来实现基于指标的自主科学发现。

方法: 提出EurekAgent系统，从四个维度进行环境工程化设计：权限工程化以实现受限的智能体执行和隔离评估；工件工程化以实现基于文件系统和Git的协作；预算工程化以实现预算感知的探索；人机协作工程化以实现简便的人类监督与干预。

主要发现: EurekAgent在多项数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上设定了新的最先进结果。特别地，该系统以低于十一美元的总API成本发现了新的二十六圆堆积最优解。

结论: 作者开源了EurekAgent的代码和结果，并呼吁将环境工程作为开发可靠自主研究智能体的核心研究方向。

翻译: LLM-based agents have shown increasing potential in automating scientific discovery. Given an optimizable metric and an execution environment, they can propose, validate, and iterate scientific solutions, and have produced results that outperform human-designed approaches. As model capabilities continue to improve, we argue that the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery is shifting from prescribing agent workflows to designing agent environments: the resources, constraints, and interfaces that shape agent behavior. We frame this as environment engineering: building environments that amplify productive behaviors, such as open-ended exploration, systematic artifact management, and inter-agent collaboration, while suppressing harmful behaviors, such as reward hacking and high-friction human oversight. We present EurekAgent, an environment-engineered agent system for metric-driven autonomous scientific discovery. EurekAgent engineers the environment along four dimensions: permissions engineering for bounded agent execution and isolated evaluation; artifact engineering for filesystem and Git-based collaboration; budget engineering for budget-aware exploration; and human-in-the-loop engineering for easy human supervision and intervention. EurekAgent sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks, including new state-of-the-art 26-circle packing results discovered with less than $11 in total API cost. We open-source our code and results, and call for environment engineering as a core research direction for developing reliable autonomous research agents.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是人工智能代理在自主科学发现中缺乏可靠性与可重复性的问题。随着模型能力增强，研究瓶颈已从设计固定工作流程转向如何构建安全可控的运行环境。该问题之所以重要，是因为科学探索必须严谨且可追溯，若缺乏环境约束，代理容易作弊或篡改结果，导致产出不可信。通过工程化设计运行环境，既能保障研究过程的透明与合规，又能让代理自由探索，从而推动自主科研向高效可靠的方向发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为随着通用智能体能力增强，自主科学发现的瓶颈已从设计固定工作流程转向构建智能体运行的环境。因此，他们借鉴生态心理学中的可供性理论，将系统核心设计为通过权限、文件、预算和人工监督四个维度来塑造环境，以放大探索行为并抑制作弊等有害行为。在现有工作方面，作者参考了多种自主研究系统，但指出它们多依赖预设流程或任务特定防护，而本方法主张将环境工程作为核心，让智能体在安全边界内自主决定研究策略。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将自主科学发现的瓶颈从预设智能体工作流转向环境工程，即通过精心设计运行环境来引导智能体行为，放大探索与协作等有益行为，抑制作弊与高摩擦监督等有害行为。整体实现流程采用简单的三阶段循环。系统首先进行准备阶段以搭建可靠的运行环境，随后进入迭代循环。在迭代循环中，系统先在提议阶段生成多样化的研究假设，再在并行实施阶段让多个智能体独立测试与优化这些假设。整个过程中环境负责协调进度、记录成果、控制预算与权限，而智能体在既定边界内自主决定具体研究策略。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新在于提出环境工程理念，将自主科学发现的瓶颈从设计固定工作流转向构建规范智能体行为的外部运行环境。与以往依赖预设流程或特定角色分工的研究系统不同，该工作直接调用通用编程智能体，并通过权限隔离、文件系统共享记忆、预算控制及人工监督四大机制来保障探索的可靠性。这种设计让智能体在安全边界内自主决定研究策略，从而以更低的成本实现了多项任务的最优结果。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了EUREKAGENT系统，通过将自主科学发现的核心从设计固定工作流转向构建安全的运行环境，成功利用通用智能体在数学、内核工程与机器学习等领域实现了多项最新最优成果。

Abstract

LLM-based agents have shown increasing potential in automating scientific discovery. Given an optimizable metric and an execution environment, they can propose, validate, and iterate scientific solutions, and have produced results that outperform human-designed approaches. As model capabilities continue to improve, we argue that the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery is shifting from prescribing agent workflows to designing agent environments: the resources, constraints, and interfaces that shape agent behavior. We frame this as environment engineering: building environments that amplify productive behaviors, such as open-ended exploration, systematic artifact management, and inter-agent collaboration, while suppressing harmful behaviors, such as reward hacking and high-friction human oversight. We present EurekAgent, an environment-engineered agent system for metric-driven autonomous scientific discovery. EurekAgent engineers the environment along four dimensions: permissions engineering for bounded agent execution and isolated evaluation; artifact engineering for filesystem and Git-based collaboration; budget engineering for budget-aware exploration; and human-in-the-loop engineering for easy human supervision and intervention. EurekAgent sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks, including new state-of-the-art 26-circle packing results discovered with less than $11 in total API cost. We open-source our code and results, and call for environment engineering as a core research direction for developing reliable autonomous research agents.

item.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
item.author: Zheng, Dian, Lee, Harry, Zhang, Manyuan, Feng, Kaituo, Guo, Zoey, Zhang, Ray, Li, Hongsheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出InterleaveThinker，首个多智能体流水线，赋予现有图像生成器交错生成能力，通过规划与批评智能体优化指令，结合冷启动与强化学习提升性能，在基准测试中表现媲美先进模型并增强推理能力。

背景: 现有图像生成器在单图生成与编辑中表现优异，但受架构限制无法实现文本图像序列的交错生成，该能力对视觉叙事、引导和具身操作至关重要；最新开源统一多模态模型在此方面性能有限。

目的: 设计并实现InterleaveThinker多智能体流水线，使任何现有图像生成器具备交错生成能力。

方法: 采用规划智能体组织输入序列并指导图像生成器执行步骤；引入批评智能体评估输出、识别偏离指令的样本并优化指令以重新生成；构建Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k和Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k进行格式冷启动；开发Interleave-Critic-RL-13k使用GRPO强化轨迹内逐步指令纠正能力；提出准确性奖励与逐步奖励，通过单步强化学习有效引导整个生成轨迹。

主要发现: InterleaveThinker在多个图像生成器上提升性能；在交错生成基准测试中性能与Nano Banana和GPT-5相当；显著增强基础模型在基于推理的基准测试中的表现，例如在4步FLUX.2-klein上于WISE和RISE基准取得显著提升。

结论: InterleaveThinker成功赋予现有图像生成器交错生成能力，通过多智能体协作与强化学习优化，实现高性能生成并增强推理能力，为视觉叙事等应用提供有效解决方案。

翻译: Recent image generators have demonstrated impressive photorealism and instruction-following capabilities in single-image generation and editing. However, constrained by their architectures, they cannot achieve interleaved generation (text-image sequence), which has crucial applications in visual narratives, guidance, and embodied manipulation. Even the latest open-source Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) exhibit limited performance in this regard. In this paper, we introduce InterleaveThinker, the first multi-agent pipeline designed to endow any existing image generator with interleaved generation capabilities. Specifically, we employ a planner agent to organize the image-text input sequence, instructing the image generator on the required execution at each step. Subsequently, we introduce a critic agent to evaluate the generator's outputs, identify samples that deviate from the planned instructions, and refine the instructions for regeneration. To implement this pipeline, we construct the Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k and Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k to perform a format cold-start. Then we develop Interleave-Critic-RL-13k to reinforce the step-wise instruction correction capability within a generation trajectory using GRPO. Since a single interleaved generation trajectory may involve over 25 generator calls, optimizing the entire trajectory is computationally impractical. Therefore, we propose accuracy reward and step-wise reward, allowing single-step RL to effectively guide the entire generation trajectory. The results show that InterleaveThinker improves performance across various image generators. On interleaved generation benchmarks, it achieves performance comparable to Nano Banana and GPT-5. Surprisingly, it also significantly enhances the base model on reasoning-based benchmarks; for example, on 4-step FLUX.2-klein, we observe substantial gains on WISE and RISE.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有图像生成模型在生成交错文本与图像序列时，容易过度依赖中间画面以及误差逐步骤累积的问题。该能力在现实和研究中至关重要，因为它是实现视觉叙事、分步操作指导以及机器人控制等复杂多步任务的基础，能够有效弥补单张图像生成与长序列推理之间的技术鸿沟。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有图像生成模型无法进行图文交错生成、统一多模态模型存在视觉过度依赖和逐步误差累积的痛点，设计了包含规划器、生成器和评估器的多智能体流水线。该方法通过规划器预先制定完整指令序列以切断中间视觉反馈，再由评估器实时检查输出并优化提示词，从而解耦规划与生成过程。在借鉴现有工作方面，作者参考了统一多模态模型与智能体强化学习的相关研究，并针对前人方法在视觉依赖和通用性上的不足进行了针对性改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过解耦规划与生成评估环节，利用多智能体协作解决现有模型在长序列生成中容易过度依赖中间画面和误差累积的问题。整体流程包含规划、生成与批评三个模块：首先由规划智能体预先制定完整的图文交替执行步骤与初始提示词；随后生成模型按步骤输出图像；最后由批评智能体评估生成结果是否偏离计划，若偏离则优化提示词并重新生成，循环直至达标后再进入下一步。整个流程通过构建专用数据集并进行监督微调与强化学习训练，使任意固定图像生成模型都能具备稳定的长序列图文生成能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种多智能体框架，通过解耦规划与生成过程，赋予任意现有图像生成器实现图文交错生成的能力。与以往依赖单一模型逐步生成的统一多模态模型不同，该方法利用规划模块预先制定完整步骤以消除视觉依赖，并引入评估模块进行逐步纠错与提示词优化，有效避免了误差累积。此外，论文设计了专用的数据构建流程与双奖励强化学习策略，以较低的计算成本实现了轨迹级对齐，显著提升了生成质量与推理能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了InterleaveThinker框架，通过规划与评估协同的多智能体机制，成功赋予任意现有图像生成器进行图文交错生成的能力，并有效解决了视觉过度依赖与逐步误差累积问题。

Abstract

Recent image generators have demonstrated impressive photorealism and instruction-following capabilities in single-image generation and editing. However, constrained by their architectures, they cannot achieve interleaved generation (text-image sequence), which has crucial applications in visual narratives, guidance, and embodied manipulation. Even the latest open-source Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) exhibit limited performance in this regard. In this paper, we introduce InterleaveThinker, the first multi-agent pipeline designed to endow any existing image generator with interleaved generation capabilities. Specifically, we employ a planner agent to organize the image-text input sequence, instructing the image generator on the required execution at each step. Subsequently, we introduce a critic agent to evaluate the generator's outputs, identify samples that deviate from the planned instructions, and refine the instructions for regeneration. To implement this pipeline, we construct the Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k and Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k to perform a format cold-start. Then we develop Interleave-Critic-RL-13k to reinforce the step-wise instruction correction capability within a generation trajectory using GRPO. Since a single interleaved generation trajectory may involve over 25 generator calls, optimizing the entire trajectory is computationally impractical. Therefore, we propose accuracy reward and step-wise reward, allowing single-step RL to effectively guide the entire generation trajectory. The results show that InterleaveThinker improves performance across various image generators. On interleaved generation benchmarks, it achieves performance comparable to Nano Banana and GPT-5. Surprisingly, it also significantly enhances the base model on reasoning-based benchmarks; for example, on 4-step FLUX.2-klein, we observe substantial gains on WISE and RISE.

item.title: EvoArena: Tracking Memory Evolution for Robust LLM Agents in Dynamic Environments
item.author: Xu, Jundong, Li, Qingchuan, Wu, Jiaying, Lan, Yihuai, Li, Shuyue Stella, Zhou, Huichi, Jiang, Bowen, Wang, Lei, Wang, Jun, Luu, Anh Tuan, Xiong, Caiming, Park, Hae Won, Hooi, Bryan, Hu, Zhiyuan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 大型语言模型智能体在静态环境中表现良好，但在动态环境中面临挑战。本文提出EvoArena基准测试和EvoMem记忆机制，以评估和改进智能体在动态环境中的适应能力。

背景: 大型语言模型智能体在广泛基准测试中表现优异，但大多数评估假设环境是静态的。实际部署中环境是动态的，要求智能体持续调整知识、技能和行为以适应变化的环境和任务条件。

目的: 解决静态环境评估与动态现实部署之间的差距，提出一个能模拟环境变化的基准测试套件和一个基于补丁的记忆范式，以评估和改进智能体在动态环境中的表现。

方法: 提出EvoArena基准测试套件，将环境变化建模为终端、软件和社会领域的渐进更新序列。提出EvoMem，一种基于补丁的记忆范式，将记忆演化记录为结构化更新历史，使智能体能够通过记忆变化推理环境演化。

主要发现: 当前智能体在EvoArena上平均准确率为百分之三十九点六，表现不佳。EvoMem consistently 提升性能，在EvoArena上平均提升百分之一点五，在GAIA和LoCoMo标准基准测试中分别提升百分之六点一和百分之四点八。EvoMem还将链级准确率提升百分之三点七。机制分析表明EvoMem改善了记忆中的证据捕获，更好地保留了完整的环境状态。

结论: 在评估和记忆中对演化进行建模对于可靠部署智能体至关重要。

翻译: Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, yet most evaluations assume static environments. In contrast, real-world deployment is inherently dynamic, requiring agents to continually align their knowledge, skills, and behavior with changing environments and updated task conditions. To address this gap, we introduce EvoArena, a benchmark suite that models environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains. We further propose EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records memory evolution as structured update histories, enabling agents to reason about environmental evolution through changes in their memory. Experiments show that current agents struggle on EvoArena, achieving an average accuracy of 39.6% across evolving terminal, software, and social-preference domains. EvoMem consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of 1.5% on EvoArena and also improving standard benchmarks such as GAIA and LoCoMo by 6.1% and 4.8%. Beyond individual tasks, EvoMem further improves chain-level accuracy by 3.7% on EvoArena, where success requires completing a consecutive sequence of related evolutionary subtasks. Mechanistic analysis shows that EvoMem improves evidence capture in the memory, indicating better preservation of complete evolving environment states. Our results highlight the importance of modeling evolution in both evaluation and memory for reliable agent deployment.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在持续变化的动态环境中难以追踪环境演变与记忆更新的问题。现有研究多基于静态环境进行评估，但现实部署中接口、规则和偏好会不断更迭，传统记忆机制容易用新信息覆盖旧信息，导致智能体丢失关键上下文而失效。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为只有在持续变化的环境中具备版本感知与记忆追溯能力，智能体才能真正可靠地适应新变化并保留仍有效的旧知识，从而实现长期稳定的实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有智能体在动态环境中常因记忆仅保留最新状态而导致关键旧信息被覆盖。为此，他们借鉴了版本控制系统的思路，设计了基于补丁的记忆机制。该机制将每次记忆更新记录为包含更新前后状态、原因及证据的结构化历史，使智能体能够追溯环境变化并灵活检索有效信息。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将记忆更新转化为可追溯的证据链，通过记录状态变化的前后内容、原因及上下文依据，帮助智能体理解环境演变并做出正确决策。整体实现流程是在标准记忆系统外增加一个只追加的补丁历史记录，每次记忆变更时自动保存更新前后的状态、变更理由及相关证据；在实际使用时默认读取最新记忆，当遇到信息覆盖或冲突时再按需检索相关历史补丁进行补充推理。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了EvoArena基准测试套件与EvoMem记忆机制。EvoArena将环境变化建模为跨终端、软件和社交领域的渐进式版本更新，旨在测试智能体在适应新变化的同时保留有效旧知识的能力。EvoMem则采用基于补丁的记忆范式，将记忆更新记录为包含前后状态、更新理由和证据的结构化历史。相比以往工作主要评估静态环境或仅刷新任务的基准，以及将记忆压缩为单一最新状态的做法，本文首次系统性地考察了智能体在持续演化的环境中追踪版本变化、追溯更新依据并维持行为兼容性的能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一个用于评估智能体在持续演变环境中表现的新基准测试，并设计了一种基于补丁历史记录的记忆机制来追踪环境变化，实验证明该机制能有效提升智能体在动态场景下的适应能力和推理鲁棒性。

Abstract

Large language model (LLM) agents have achieved strong performance on a wide range of benchmarks, yet most evaluations assume static environments. In contrast, real-world deployment is inherently dynamic, requiring agents to continually align their knowledge, skills, and behavior with changing environments and updated task conditions. To address this gap, we introduce EvoArena, a benchmark suite that models environment changes as sequences of progressive updates across terminal, software, and social domains. We further propose EvoMem, a patch-based memory paradigm that records memory evolution as structured update histories, enabling agents to reason about environmental evolution through changes in their memory. Experiments show that current agents struggle on EvoArena, achieving an average accuracy of 39.6% across evolving terminal, software, and social-preference domains. EvoMem consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of 1.5% on EvoArena and also improving standard benchmarks such as GAIA and LoCoMo by 6.1% and 4.8%. Beyond individual tasks, EvoMem further improves chain-level accuracy by 3.7% on EvoArena, where success requires completing a consecutive sequence of related evolutionary subtasks. Mechanistic analysis shows that EvoMem improves evidence capture in the memory, indicating better preservation of complete evolving environment states. Our results highlight the importance of modeling evolution in both evaluation and memory for reliable agent deployment.

item.title: Distilling LLM Feedback for Lean Theorem Proving
item.author: Narozniak, Gaetan, Biau, Gérard, Munos, Rémi, Rammal, Ahmad, Marion, Pierre
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为反馈蒸馏的训练方法，用于改进复杂推理模型的后训练过程。该方法通过在标记级别匹配模型自身分布与由语言模型产生的特权反馈条件分布，提供标记级监督并注入外部知识。在Lean4定理证明任务上的评估表明，该方法相比GRPO能保持更高的轨迹多样性、策略熵和更好的pass@k扩展性。与GRPO结合使用时效果更佳，为改进复杂推理模型的后训练提供了有前景的方向。

背景: 推理模型的后训练通常结合监督微调与基于可验证奖励的强化学习，最常见的是GRPO算法。然而，GRPO存在奖励稀疏、探索有限和模式崩溃等问题。

目的: 提出一种新的训练方法以改进复杂推理模型的后训练，解决现有方法如GRPO的局限性。

方法: 提出反馈蒸馏方法，让模型在标记级别上匹配其自身在由语言模型产生的特权反馈条件下的分布。该方法提供标记级监督并能够注入外部知识。

主要发现: 在Lean4定理证明任务上，反馈蒸馏生成的轨迹多样性高于GRPO，具有更高的策略熵和更好的pass@k扩展性。反馈蒸馏与GRPO具有互补性，使用反馈蒸馏的检查点初始化GRPO的效果优于单独使用任一方法。

结论: 反馈蒸馏为改进复杂推理模型的后训练提供了一条有前景的途径。

翻译: Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback Distillation offers token-level supervision and can inject external knowledge. Evaluating our method for Lean4 theorem-proving, we find that Feedback Distillation maintains greater diversity in generated trajectories than GRPO, yielding higher policy entropy and better pass@k scaling. The two methods are complementary: initializing GRPO from a Feedback Distillation checkpoint outperforms either method alone. All in all, our results suggest a promising avenue to improve post-training for complex reasoning.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有大语言模型后训练方法在复杂推理任务中面临的奖励稀疏、探索不足和输出模式单一等问题。作者提出通过引入外部反馈进行蒸馏训练，使模型在生成过程中获得更细粒度的指导并注入新知识。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为形式化数学证明等任务需要模型在庞大的知识库中有效探索，而传统方法往往导致策略多样性下降。提升这一训练机制有助于推动人工智能在严谨逻辑推理领域的实际应用与能力突破。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统训练方法奖励稀疏、探索不足和容易陷入固定模式等局限，希望寻找一种能提供细粒度监督并促进探索的新机制。他们借鉴了近期提出的自我蒸馏思路，但并未直接使用环境原始信号或标准答案，而是创新性地引入外部语言模型生成的文本反馈作为特权信息。在此基础上，他们设计了教师模型根据反馈调整输出概率分布，并让学生模型在逐词层面模仿该分布，从而将反馈策略直接内化到模型参数中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过自蒸馏机制，让模型学习在特定反馈条件下的最优输出分布，从而在词元级别提供细粒度监督并注入外部知识。整体流程为：学生模型首先生成初步解答，随后由反馈模型分析解答与验证结果并生成改进建议，接着教师模型基于问题与反馈生成目标概率分布，最后学生模型通过最小化与教师分布的差异进行训练，且教师参数会定期通过学生参数的指数移动平均进行更新。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是提出了反馈蒸馏方法，利用语言模型对模型自身证明尝试的文本反馈作为特权信息，在生成步骤的每个词级别进行自我蒸馏训练。与以往直接使用环境原始信号或标准答案作为特权信号的工作不同，该方法通过外部反馈注入知识，并提供了细粒度的监督信号。相比传统的强化训练范式，它能有效缓解奖励稀疏和探索不足的问题，在训练过程中保持更高的输出多样性，并与强化学习方法结合后能进一步提升复杂推理任务的性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为反馈蒸馏的训练方法，通过让模型学习匹配由语言模型生成的反馈条件分布，在保持生成轨迹多样性的同时显著提升了形式化定理证明的性能，且该方法与强化学习算法结合后效果更佳。

Abstract

Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback Distillation offers token-level supervision and can inject external knowledge. Evaluating our method for Lean4 theorem-proving, we find that Feedback Distillation maintains greater diversity in generated trajectories than GRPO, yielding higher policy entropy and better pass@k scaling. The two methods are complementary: initializing GRPO from a Feedback Distillation checkpoint outperforms either method alone. All in all, our results suggest a promising avenue to improve post-training for complex reasoning.

item.title: EvoTrainer: Co-Evolving LLM Policies and Training Harnesses for Autonomous Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Chen, Guhong, Shi, Yingcheng, Li, Yongbin, Li, Binhua, Xu, Xander, Wei, Hu, Ni, Shiwen, Yang, Min, Ye, Jieping
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为EvoTrainer的自主训练框架，该框架通过实证反馈共同进化大语言模型策略和训练侧工具。

背景: 自主大语言模型训练通常被框定为配方搜索，导致训练工具保持静态。在代理强化学习中，这种局限性更加明显，因为瓶颈和标量奖励掩盖了多样化的失败模式。

目的: 开发一种能够共同进化大语言模型策略和训练侧工具的自主训练框架，以解决现有方法的局限性。

方法: EvoTrainer框架通过实证反馈共同进化大语言模型策略和训练侧工具，包括诊断 rollout 级别的证据、修订诊断、回溯测试干预措施以及积累可重用的技能。

主要发现: 在数学推理、竞争性编程代码生成和仓库级软件工程任务上，EvoTrainer在相同数据、代码库和评估协议下匹配或超过了人工设计的强化学习参考。在长周期代理软件工程任务上取得了最大增益。轨迹分析显示，保留的策略在不同领域分化，进化的诊断防止了无效的高分分支被提升，可重用的技能塑造了后续的搜索。

结论: 自主大语言模型强化学习应超越配方搜索，走向策略和解释它们的训练工具的联合进化。

翻译: Autonomous LLM training is often framed as recipe search, which leaves the training harness largely static. This limitation sharpens in agentic RL, where shifting bottlenecks and scalar rewards mask diverse failure modes. We introduce EvoTrainer, an autonomous training framework that co-evolves LLM policies and training-side harnesses through empirical feedback: it diagnoses rollout-level evidence, revises diagnostics, backtests interventions, and accumulates reusable skills. Evaluated on mathematical reasoning, competitive-programming code generation, and repository-level software engineering, EvoTrainer matches or exceeds the human-engineered RL references under the same data, codebase, and evaluation protocol, with the largest gain on long-horizon agentic SWE. Trajectory analyses show that retained strategies diverge across domains, evolving diagnostics prevent invalid high-scoring branches from being promoted, and reusable skills shape later search. Autonomous LLM RL should move beyond recipe search toward joint evolution of policies and the training harnesses that interpret them.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决自主训练大语言模型时，诊断与决策基础设施长期固定而无法适应动态变化任务的问题。在现实研究中，智能体强化学习的瓶颈会不断转移，固定工具链难以准确识别模型失败原因或区分有效与虚假的高分结果。因此，让训练工具链与模型策略共同进化，能够提升训练过程的自主性、可解释性与最终性能，突破人类设计固定流程的局限。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有自主训练系统通常只优化训练配方而固定诊断工具，导致难以应对复杂强化学习中不断变化的瓶颈与失败模式。基于此，他们设计出协同进化框架，让模型策略与训练侧的诊断基础设施通过实证反馈共同迭代，并利用持久记忆库积累和复用跨版本的经验。该方法明确借鉴了自主实验系统、推理侧工具优化及自适应强化学习等领域的现有工作，但创新地将训练侧的诊断框架本身作为可进化对象进行联合优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让大语言模型的训练策略与用于分析训练结果的诊断工具同步进化，通过实证反馈动态调整模型参数和训练诊断框架，而非仅依赖固定模板搜索训练配方。整体流程首先生成并训练候选模型版本，随后收集运行证据进行诊断；若现有诊断工具不足以解释结果则自动升级分析指标与流程，并将验证有效的干预策略和诊断技能存入持久化记忆库供后续迭代复用，最终由表现最优的版本作为新基线开启下一轮循环，关键执行步骤保留人工审核。

item.title: Large Language Models Are Overconfident in Their Own Responses
item.author: Sanz-Guerrero, Mario, Mager, Manuel, von der Wense, Katharina
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了聊天模板对对话式大语言模型校准性的影响，发现模型存在“所有权偏见”，即对自身答案的置信度显著高于用户提供的相同答案。通过提出一种推理时策略，将模型答案作为用户输入进行置信度评估，可显著降低过度自信并提高校准性，无需重新训练。

背景: 先前研究表明，经过指令调优的大语言模型比其基础预训练模型校准性更差。然而，关于常用的聊天模板对对话式大语言模型校准性的影响知之甚少。

目的: 通过解耦后训练算法和聊天格式的影响，调查导致这种校准性变差的机制。

方法: 在六个近期开源大语言模型、三个基准测试和三种置信度提取方法上进行广泛实验，并提出了在推理时将模型答案作为用户输入进行置信度评估的策略。

主要发现: 指令调优从根本上损害了校准性，而聊天模板通过“所有权偏见”加剧了这一问题。模型对自身答案的置信度比相同用户答案高出高达百分之二十六。

结论: 提出的推理时策略显著降低了过度自信，将校准性提高了高达百分之二十六，无需重新训练即可缩小基础模型与指令调优模型之间的差距。

翻译: Prior work has shown that instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) are less well calibrated than their base pre-trained counterparts. However, little is known about the frequently used chat template's effect on the calibration of conversational LLMs. In this work, we investigate the mechanisms driving this miscalibration by decoupling the effects of the post-training algorithm and the chat format. 深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决指令微调后的大语言模型对自身回答过度自信、导致置信度评估严重失准的问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为准确的置信度评估是保障人工智能安全与可信的基础，尤其在高风险场景中，模型若对错误答案盲目自信可能引发严重后果。通过揭示这一机制并提出无需重新训练的缓解方法，研究能有效提升大模型在实际应用中的可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于实验发现的“所有权偏差”假设设计了该方法。他们通过简单的提示词调整，在要求模型评估置信度时，将模型自己生成的答案伪装成用户输入，从而有效降低过度自信。文中并未明确说明该具体策略直接借鉴了现有工作，而是作者根据自身实验洞察独立提出的无需重新训练的推理期优化方案。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用大模型对自身生成答案存在“所有权偏见”的特性，通过改变答案的呈现身份来降低其过度自信。整体实现流程为：在需要评估答案置信度时，将模型生成的答案重新包装成用户输入的内容，再交由模型进行置信度打分。这一推理阶段的简单操作无需重新训练，即可有效缓解过度自信并提升模型校准效果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于揭示了大语言模型在对话模式下存在所有权偏见，即模型对自身生成的答案比相同内容但由用户提供的答案表现出显著更高的自信度。基于此机制，作者提出了一种无需重新训练的简单推理时策略，即将模型生成的答案伪装成用户输入再进行置信度评估，从而有效降低过度自信并提升校准效果。与以往依赖复杂训练干预或仅关注底层概率的工作不同，本研究从机制层面厘清了对话格式的影响，并提供了轻量级且易于部署的解决方案。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文揭示了大语言模型在评估自身回答时存在所有权偏见从而导致过度自信的问题，并提出了一种无需重新训练、仅需在推理时将模型回答伪装为用户输入的简单策略，有效降低了过度自信并显著提升了模型校准度。

Abstract

Prior work has shown that instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) are less well calibrated than their base pre-trained counterparts. However, little is known about the frequently used chat template's effect on the calibration of conversational LLMs. In this work, we investigate the mechanisms driving this miscalibration by decoupling the effects of the post-training algorithm and the chat format. We find that, while instruction tuning fundamentally harms calibration, the chat template aggravates the issue through an "ownership bias" -- models are significantly more confident in their own answers than in identical answers provided by a user. Extensive experiments across six recent open-weight LLMs, three benchmarks, and three confidence elicitation methods show that models assign up to 26% higher confidence to their own responses. Leveraging this insight, we propose a simple inference-time strategy: framing the model's answer as user input during confidence elicitation. This approach significantly reduces overconfidence and improves calibration by up to 26% without the need for retraining, narrowing the gap between base and instruction-tuned models.

item.title: DuDi: Dual-Signal Distillation with Cross-Lingual Verbalizer
item.author: Patomporn Payoungkhamdee, Tinnakit Udsa, Jian Gang Ngui, Sarana Nutanong, Alham Fikri Aji, Peerat Limkonchotiwat
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DuDi的双信号多语言蒸馏框架，旨在解决小语言模型在多语言场景下能力下降的问题，特别是在东南亚语言方面。该框架结合了在线序列级信号和离线策略与在线策略的标记级信号，并使用跨语言词表器来优化教师反馈，提升多语言环境下的知识迁移能力。实验表明，DuDi在多个模型家族、规模及师生设置下均优于基线方法。

背景: 小语言模型具有高效和可扩展的特点，但在子十亿参数规模下，其多语言能力，尤其是东南亚语言的能力，会严重退化。

目的: 提出一种新的多语言蒸馏框架，以改善小语言模型在多语言环境下的性能，特别是针对东南亚语言。

方法: 提出DuDi框架，该框架结合了在线序列级信号与离线策略和在线策略的标记级信号。此外，还引入了跨语言词表器来细化教师反馈，并提高多语言设置下师生模型之间的可迁移性。

主要发现: 在SEA-HELM基准上的实验显示，DuDi在多种模型家族、规模及师生设置下均稳定优于竞争性蒸馏基线。消融实验和分析证实，序列级优化、标记级监督和跨语言词表化为多语言小语言模型提供了互补且可迁移的学习信号。

结论: DuDi框架通过结合多种信号和优化策略，有效提升了多语言小语言模型的性能，特别是在东南亚语言任务上。

翻译: Small language models are efficient and scalable, but their multilingual capabilities degrade severely at sub-billion scales, especially for Southeast Asian languages. We introduce DuDi, a dual-signal multilingual distillation framework that combines an online sequence-level signal with off-policy and on-policy token-level signals. DuDi further uses a cross-lingual verbalizer to refine teacher feedback and improve teacher-student transferability in multilingual settings. Experiments on SEA-HELM across multiple model families, scales, and teacher-student settings show that DuDi consistently outperforms competitive distillation baselines. Ablations and analyses confirm that sequence-level optimization, token-level supervision, and cross-lingual verbalization provide complementary and transferable learning signals for multilingual SLMs.

Abstract

Small language models (SLMs) are efficient and scalable, but their multilingual capabilities degrade severely at sub-billion scales, especially for Southeast Asian (SEA) languages. We introduce DuDi, a dual-signal multilingual distillation framework that combines an online sequence-level signal with off-policy and on-policy token-level signals. DuDi further uses a cross-lingual verbalizer to refine teacher feedback and improve teacher-student transferability in multilingual settings. Experiments on SEA-HELM across multiple model families, scales, and teacher-student settings show that DuDi consistently outperforms competitive distillation baselines. Ablations and analyses confirm that sequence-level optimization, token-level supervision, and cross-lingual verbalization provide complementary and transferable learning signals for multilingual SLMs.

item.title: Breaking the Bubble: Asynchronous Pipeline Parallel Training with Bounded Weight Inconsistency
item.author: Elam, Itay, Rahimi, Eliron, Mendelson, Avi, Baskin, Chaim
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PACI是一种无气泡的异步流水线训练方法，通过局部梯度累积控制版本漂移，无需权重存储或全局同步，在保持内存和吞吐量的同时提升训练效率。

背景: 流水线并行对训练大型神经网络至关重要，但现有调度方法在吞吐量、内存和优化一致性之间需要权衡。同步流水线保持权重一致性但存在气泡；异步流水线消除气泡但引入版本不匹配，通常需要权重存储、预测或校正机制。

目的: 提出一种无需权重存储、预测、额外参数副本或全局同步的无气泡异步流水线方法，以平衡效率与一致性。

方法: 使用局部梯度累积作为版本控制机制，通过减缓参数版本相对于流水线延迟的演进速度，限制任何微批次跨越的优化器更新次数，同时保持稳态利用率。

主要发现: 在GPT风格语言模型预训练中，PACI与同步1F1B-flush方法在稳定性和最终困惑度上相当，保持相同的峰值内存占用，实现完全利用的流水线吞吐量，并将训练时间-准确率提升最高1.69倍。

结论: 前向和后向不一致性无需完全消除，当被显式限制时，可以安全地转化为显著的效率提升。

翻译: Pipeline parallelism is essential for training large neural networks, but existing schedules trade off throughput, memory, and optimization consistency. Synchronous pipelines preserve forward/backward weight consistency but suffer from bubbles; asynchronous pipelines remove bubbles but introduce weight-version mismatch, typically requiring weight stashing, prediction, or correction mechanisms. We introduce PACI (Pipeline Asynchronous training with Controlled Inconsistency), a bubble-free asynchronous pipeline method that bounds forward/backward version drift without weight stashing, prediction, additional parameter copies, or global synchronization. The key idea is to use local gradient accumulation as a version-control mechanism: by slowing parameter-version evolution relative to pipeline delay, PACI limits the number of optimizer updates crossed by any micro-batch while preserving steady-state utilization. In GPT-style language-model pretraining, PACI matches the stability and final perplexity of synchronous 1F1B-flush, retains the same peak memory footprint, achieves fully utilized pipeline throughput, and improves training time-to-accuracy by up to 1.69 times over the fastest flush baseline. These results show that forward/backward inconsistency need not be eliminated: when explicitly bounded, it can be safely traded for substantial efficiency gains.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型训练中流水线并行效率与参数一致性难以兼顾的问题。同步方法虽能保证一致性但会产生大量计算空闲，而异步方法虽能消除空闲却会导致前后向计算使用不同版本的参数，影响训练稳定性。该问题之所以重要，是因为随着模型规模不断扩大，如何在保证训练质量的前提下高效利用计算资源，已成为降低训练成本与加速模型迭代的关键瓶颈。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者的核心思路是转变传统完全消除权重不一致的观念，转而将其控制在可容忍的范围内。他们观察到异步流水线中的不一致性主要取决于前向与反向传播之间发生的优化器更新次数，因此将传统的梯度累加机制重新设计为版本控制工具，通过降低参数更新频率来减缓版本漂移。该方法并未直接沿用现有工作的权重缓存或预测技术，而是针对同步方法存在流水线空闲、异步方法依赖额外内存的缺陷，提出了一种无需额外内存和全局同步的新型异步调度策略。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用本地梯度累积作为版本控制机制，通过减缓参数版本的更新速度来限制微批次在正向和反向传播之间跨越的优化器更新次数，从而将权重版本不一致性控制在安全范围内，同时消除流水线气泡且不增加额外内存。整体实现流程为：采用无气泡的异步流水线调度，各计算节点在收到输入后立即执行正向和反向计算；反向

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种利用本地梯度累积来控制参数版本演进的异步流水线训练方法。它通过减缓参数更新频率，将前后向计算中的权重版本差异限制在可控范围内，从而在不增加额外显存、不进行权重存储或预测、也不依赖全局同步的情况下实现了零流水线气泡。与以往工作相比，同步方法虽能保证一致性但会引入计算空闲，而传统异步方法通常需通过存储旧权重、预测未来参数或引入修正机制来消除不一致性；该方法则直接从源头控制不一致性，在保持相同显存占用的同时显著提升了训练效率并维持了模型质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种利用本地梯度累积控制参数版本差异的异步流水线并行训练方法，在无需额外内存或全局同步的情况下消除了流水线气泡，从而在保持模型质量的同时显著提升了训练收敛速度。

Abstract

Pipeline parallelism is essential for training large neural networks, but existing schedules trade off throughput, memory, and optimization consistency. Synchronous pipelines preserve forward/backward weight consistency but suffer from bubbles; asynchronous pipelines remove bubbles but introduce weight-version mismatch, typically requiring weight stashing, prediction, or correction mechanisms. We introduce PACI (Pipeline Asynchronous training with Controlled Inconsistency), a bubble-free asynchronous pipeline method that bounds forward/backward version drift without weight stashing, prediction, additional parameter copies, or global synchronization. The key idea is to use local gradient accumulation as a version-control mechanism: by slowing parameter-version evolution relative to pipeline delay, PACI limits the number of optimizer updates crossed by any micro-batch while preserving steady-state utilization. In GPT-style language-model pretraining, PACI matches the stability and final perplexity of synchronous 1F1B-flush, retains the same peak memory footprint, achieves fully utilized pipeline throughput, and improves training time-to-accuracy by up to $1.69\times$ over the fastest flush baseline. These results show that forward/backward inconsistency need not be eliminated: when explicitly bounded, it can be safely traded for substantial efficiency gains.

item.title: POISE: Position-Aware Undetectable Skill Injection on LLM Agents
item.author: Hao, Haochang, Min, Dehai, Zhang, Zhifang, Zhang, Yunbei, Xu, Miao, Ge, Yingqiang, Cheng, Lu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为POISE的位置感知攻击方法，用于对抗通用智能体技能中的技能投毒攻击。该方法通过将触发器压缩为单个看似无害的正文指令，并将其放置在可行位置，利用上下文感知生成器将其与附近的设置或前置步骤融合，从而在保持隐蔽性的同时提高了攻击成功率。

背景: 智能体技能提供了一种轻量级的扩展通用智能体的机制，但其开放格式使其容易受到技能投毒攻击。有效的攻击必须保持隐蔽，如果执行负载导致用户任务失败，会引发对技能的检查。

目的: 评估在要求注入的负载执行且用户任务仍通过验证器的条件下，技能投毒攻击的成功率，并解决现有攻击在可靠性与隐蔽性之间的权衡问题。

方法: 提出POISE攻击方法，这是一种位置感知的攻击，通过将触发器压缩为单个看似无害的正文指令，放置在可行位置，并使用上下文感知生成器将其与附近的设置或前置步骤融合。

主要发现: 在Skill-Inject数据集上，使用codex和gpt-5.2模型，POISE达到了百分之八十九点三的攻击成功率，比随机放置的正文基线高出二十八点分，比仅使用YAML的基线高出两点六分，同时保留了正文放置的隐蔽优势。由于合法技能正文自然需要特权工具操作，大型语言模型扫描器对合法技能过度敏感，平均误报率为百分之七十四点六。POISE通过融入这些误报，使得只有百分之五点六的中毒变体获得新的风险警报，从而使当前的静态防御措施失效。

结论: POISE攻击方法在保持隐蔽性的同时显著提高了攻击成功率，揭示了当前静态防御措施在面对此类融合攻击时的有效性不足。

翻译: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for extending general-purpose agents, but their open format exposes them to skill-poisoning attacks. A practically dangerous injection must stay invisible: if executing the payload derails the user's legitimate task, the resulting failure signal invites inspection of the skill. We therefore evaluate attacks by Attack Success Rate, which requires the injected payload to execute and the user's task to still pass its verifier in the same trial. Prior skill-poisoning attacks face a reliability-stealth trade-off under this lens: YAML-header injections are reliably loaded but easily inspected, whereas stealthier body injections that place explicit malicious commands in the skill prose are less reliable because out-of-context commands invite the agent's own suspicion. We introduce POISE, a position-aware attack that compresses the trigger into a single, benign-looking body instruction, placing it at a feasible position and using a context-aware generator to blend it with nearby setup or prerequisite steps. On Skill-Inject with codex+gpt-5.2, POISE achieves an 89.3% ASR, 28.0 points above a random-placement body baseline and 2.6 points above a YAML-only baseline, while retaining the stealth advantage of body placement. That stealth is the decisive margin: because legitimate skill bodies naturally require privileged tool operations, LLM scanners are hyper-sensitive, falsely flagging 74.6% of clean skills on average across four judges and both benchmarks. Blending into these false alarms, POISE causes only 5.6% of poisoned variants to gain a new high-risk alert over their clean baselines, rendering current static defenses ineffective.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在加载开源技能文件时面临的技能投毒攻击问题，重点突破现有攻击方法在隐蔽性与执行可靠性之间难以兼顾的瓶颈。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为技能文件具有开放共享的特性，极易成为供应链攻击的入口。一旦恶意内容被植入，攻击者可以在后台悄悄执行有害操作，同时确保智能体正常完成用户任务，从而绕过用户检测和现有安全防御，造成难以察觉的系统安全风险。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有技能投毒攻击在可靠性与隐蔽性之间的权衡困境展开思考，发现直接修改文件头元数据容易被审查，而分散插入正文指令又容易引发智能体的上下文怀疑。为此，他们设计了一种单行正文注入策略，将恶意行为全部封装在外部辅助脚本中，仅保留一行触发指令，并严格限制在智能体必然执行的编号步骤或安装区域进行位置适配。同时，利用上下文感知生成器将触发指令伪装成常规的前置检查步骤，使其与周围文本自然融合。该方法借鉴了前期技能注入与提示词注入研究中对攻击面特征和检测机制的分析，并在其评估基准与对抗框架的基础上进行了针对性优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将恶意行为压缩至一个外部辅助脚本中，仅在技能正文中植入单行看似正常的触发指令，并通过位置感知与上下文融合技术使其伪装成常规前置步骤，从而兼顾执行可靠性与隐蔽性。整体实现流程分为三步：首先根据技能文件结构筛选可行的植入位置；其次利用大语言模型结合局部上下文生成一句符合语境的触发文本；最后将该文本插入选定位置并调整编号，其余内容保持原样，实际恶意操作由该指令调用的脚本在后台执行。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种单行技能注入方法。它通过将恶意逻辑打包为外部脚本，仅在技能正文中保留一行看似正常的触发指令，并结合位置感知与上下文融合技术，使该指令自然融入现有步骤或安装环节中。相比以往工作，传统方法在可靠性与隐蔽性之间难以兼顾：基于头部元数据的注入容易被检测，而分散在正文中的注入又易被智能体怀疑。该方法则通过单行触发与上下文融合，在保持高隐蔽性的同时显著提升了攻击成功率，并能有效规避现有静态扫描工具的误报。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种新型技能投毒攻击方法，通过位置感知与上下文融合技术，将恶意指令压缩为单行并精准嵌入技能文件的合理位置，从而在保持高隐蔽性的同时显著提升了攻击成功率并有效绕过了现有检测机制。

Abstract

Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for extending general-purpose agents, but their open format exposes them to skill-poisoning attacks. A practically dangerous injection must stay invisible: if executing the payload derails the user's legitimate task, the resulting failure signal invites inspection of the skill. We therefore evaluate attacks by Attack Success Rate, which requires the injected payload to execute and the user's task to still pass its verifier in the same trial. Prior skill-poisoning attacks face a reliability-stealth trade-off under this lens: YAML-header injections are reliably loaded but easily inspected, whereas stealthier body injections that place explicit malicious commands in the skill prose are less reliable because out-of-context commands invite the agent's own suspicion. We introduce POISE, a position-aware attack that compresses the trigger into a single, benign-looking body instruction, placing it at a feasible position and using a context-aware generator to blend it with nearby setup or prerequisite steps. On Skill-Inject with codex+gpt-5.2, POISE achieves an 89.3% ASR, 28.0 points above a random-placement body baseline and 2.6 points above a YAML-only baseline, while retaining the stealth advantage of body placement. That stealth is the decisive margin: because legitimate skill bodies naturally require privileged tool operations, LLM scanners are hyper-sensitive, falsely flagging 74.6% of clean skills on average across four judges and both benchmarks. Blending into these false alarms, POISE causes only 5.6% of poisoned variants to gain a new high-risk alert over their clean baselines, rendering current static defenses ineffective.

item.title: Beyond Scalar Rewards by Internalizing Reasoning into Score Distributions
item.author: Jin, Xin, Cai, Huanqia, Li, Zhen, Zhan, Zechao, Jiang, Dengyang, Hao, Aiming, Jiang, Yuming, Guo, Chunle, Gao, Peng, Cheng, Ming-Ming, Hoi, Steven C. H.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出Z-Reward框架，通过教师-学生模型解耦推理与部署，提升文本到图像后训练中的奖励模型性能。

背景: 视觉偏好具有主观性，应表示为评分分布而非确定性标量。现有奖励模型过度压缩不确定性，而基于推理的生成奖励成本高且难以直接用于优化。

目的: 解决现有奖励模型压缩不确定性及推理奖励部署困难的问题，实现高效且准确的文本到图像优化。

方法: 采用教师-学生框架。教师使用大型视觉语言模型结合组级直接分数优化，推理评分分布；学生通过推理内化分数蒸馏，将教师分布迁移至紧凑模型，无需推理链。

主要发现: 27B教师模型在人类偏好准确率上达百分之八十九点六，优于SFT等基线；9B学生模型达百分之八十八点六，接近教师性能。Z-Reward作为可微奖励信号，使人类偏好提升百分之四十一。

结论: Z-Reward有效平衡了推理准确性与部署效率，为文本到图像优化提供了高性能的可微奖励信号。

翻译: Reward models are central to text-to-image post-training, but visual preference is subjective and better represented as a distribution over rubric scores than as a deterministic scalar. Existing scalar, score-token, and pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards provide stronger judgments but are costly to deploy and difficult to use as direct optimization signals. We propose Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward modeling framework that decouples reasoning-heavy judgment from efficient reward deployment. The teacher is a large VLM that uses reasoning to infer rubric-aligned score distributions, and is trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO), which combines policy-gradient rewards from distribution expectations with direct pointwise and pairwise supervision on score distributions and score gaps. The student is trained with Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD), which transfers the teacher's reasoning-conditioned score distribution into a compact VLM without requiring explicit reasoning chains at inference time. On our internally annotated evaluation set, the 27B GDSO teacher reaches 89.6% human preference accuracy, outperforming SFT, RewardDance, and GRPO, while the 9B RISD student reaches 88.6%, outperforming the OPD baseline and closely matching the larger teacher. We further show that Z-Reward can serve as a differentiable reward signal for text-to-image optimization, yielding a 41.3% net human-preference improvement over the SFT baseline.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决图像生成奖励模型难以同时兼顾主观偏好表达的准确性与部署推理效率的问题。现有方法要么将复杂偏好压缩为单一分数而丢失细节，要么依赖耗时的推理过程导致无法直接用于模型训练。该问题之所以重要，是因为高质量的奖励信号是图像生成模型后期优化、数据筛选和策略调整的核心基础，只有高效且能直接提供梯度反馈的奖励模型，才能在实际应用中稳定提升生成图像的质量。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对视觉偏好主观性强且现有模型难以兼顾评分质量与推理效率的矛盾，提出将判断质量与部署效率解耦。他们借鉴了知识蒸馏、序列推理蒸馏及在线策略蒸馏等现有范式，并基于群体相对策略优化算法进行改进。设计思路上采用教师与学生框架：教师利用推理能力生成校准的分数分布，学生则通过蒸馏直接内化该分布，从而在推理时无需生成推理链即可实现高效且可微的直接打分。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将高质量评分所需的推理能力与高效部署所需的直接打分能力解耦，由大型教师模型利用推理过程生成校准后的分数分布，再由紧凑的学生模型直接内化该分布以实现快速打分。整体流程分为两个阶段：首先利用标注数据训练教师模型，通过结合策略梯度与分数分布的直接监督来学习推理条件下的分数分布；随后通过蒸馏技术将教师模型的推理增强型分布迁移至学生模型中，使其在推理时无需生成推理链即可直接输出分数。最终，该学生模型可作为高效的可微奖励信号用于文生图模型的优化训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种教师与学生协同的奖励建模框架，将基于推理的高质量判断与高效部署解耦。教师模型利用推理过程推断符合规范的分数分布，学生模型则通过蒸馏技术将这种推理增强的分布直接内化为紧凑模型的快速打分能力。相比以往工作，该方法既克服了传统标量奖励模型压缩偏好不确定性的缺陷，又避免了推理生成式奖励模型推理成本高且难以直接用于梯度优化的问题，实现了高质量判断与高效可微奖励信号的统一。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种教师-学生奖励建模框架，通过让大型模型利用推理生成评分分布，并将该分布知识蒸馏给小型模型，从而在实现高效直接打分的同时显著提升了文本生成图像的质量评估与优化效果。

Abstract

Reward models are central to text-to-image post-training, but visual preference is subjective and better represented as a distribution over rubric scores than as a deterministic scalar. Existing scalar, score-token, and pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards provide stronger judgments but are costly to deploy and difficult to use as direct optimization signals. We propose Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward modeling framework that decouples reasoning-heavy judgment from efficient reward deployment. The teacher is a large VLM that uses reasoning to infer rubric-aligned score distributions, and is trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO), which combines policy-gradient rewards from distribution expectations with direct pointwise and pairwise supervision on score distributions and score gaps. The student is trained with Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD), which transfers the teacher's reasoning-conditioned score distribution into a compact VLM without requiring explicit reasoning chains at inference time. On our internally annotated evaluation set, the 27B GDSO teacher reaches 89.6% human preference accuracy, outperforming SFT, RewardDance, and GRPO, while the 9B RISD student reaches 88.6%, outperforming the OPD baseline and closely matching the larger teacher. We further show that Z-Reward can serve as a differentiable reward signal for text-to-image optimization, yielding a 41.3% net human-preference improvement over the SFT baseline.

item.title: Intention Driven Identification of In-Possession Match Phases in Association Football through Temporal Graph Learning
item.author: Yuesen Li, Daniel Link
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种基于数据驱动的框架，用于从时空追踪数据中识别足球比赛中的控球阶段。该框架通过分层阶段模型定义了三种战术意图和六个阶段，并开发了时序图注意力网络来结合帧级球员交互图、上下文特征和基于变换器的时序建模。评估结果显示该模型在帧级和序列级均取得了良好性能，时序建模对分割质量起主要作用，而基于图的关联建模对反击识别特别有益。该框架可将连续的追踪数据转化为战术上可解释的控球阶段表示，具有自动比赛注释、战术分析和比赛风格画像等潜在应用。

背景: 理解足球的战术组织需要识别不同的比赛阶段。然而，控球阶段很少直接可见，且由不断演变的战术意图塑造，而不仅仅是空间模式。

目的: 提出一种基于数据驱动的框架，用于从时空追踪数据中识别足球比赛中的控球阶段。

方法: 分析了七场以赫兹频率记录的德国足球甲级联赛比赛的追踪数据。定义了包含三种战术意图和六个阶段的分层阶段模型。开发了时序图注意力网络，结合帧级球员交互图、上下文特征和基于变换器的时序建模。使用帧级分数和序列感知的交集度量进行评估。

主要发现: 时序图注意力网络在战术意图级别的帧级分数达到零点八七，在入侵相关阶段得分为零点七六，在得分阶段得分为零点七九。后处理后，意图和阶段的序列级分数分别提高。时序建模是分割质量的主要驱动因素，而基于图的关联建模对反击识别特别有益。探索性球员注意力分析表明，边路和中场位置组对阶段区分贡献较大。

结论: 该框架将连续的追踪数据转化为战术上可解释的控球阶段表示，在自动比赛注释、战术分析和比赛风格画像方面具有潜在应用。

翻译: Understanding tactical organisation of association football, hereafter referred to as football, requires identifying distinct match phases. Yet in-possession phases are rarely directly observable and are shaped by evolving tactical intentions, rather than spatial patterns alone. This study proposes a data-driven framework for identifying in-possession match phases from spatiotemporal tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical phase model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) was developed to combine frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and a sequence-aware Intersection over Truth-Dominance (IoT-D) metric. T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. At the sequence level, mean diagonal IoT-D F1 increased from 0.68 to 0.79 for intentions and from 0.61 to 0.71 for phases after post-processing, indicating improved temporal coherence. Model comparisons showed that sequence modelling was the main driver of segmentation quality, while graph-based relational modelling was particularly beneficial for Counter Attack recognition. Exploratory player attention analysis further suggested that wide and midfield positional groups contributed strongly to phase discrimination. Overall, the framework translates continuous tracking data into tactically interpretable in-possession phase representations, with potential applications in automated match annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.

Abstract

Understanding tactical organisation of association football, hereafter referred to as football, requires identifying distinct match phases. Yet in-possession phases are rarely directly observable and are shaped by evolving tactical intentions, rather than spatial patterns alone. This study proposes a data-driven framework for identifying in-possession match phases from spatiotemporal tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical phase model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) was developed to combine frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and a sequence-aware Intersection over Truth-Dominance (IoT-D) metric. T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. At the sequence level, mean diagonal IoT-D F1 increased from 0.68 to 0.79 for intentions and from 0.61 to 0.71 for phases after post-processing, indicating improved temporal coherence. Model comparisons showed that sequence modelling was the main driver of segmentation quality, while graph-based relational modelling was particularly beneficial for Counter Attack recognition. Exploratory player attention analysis further suggested that wide and midfield positional groups contributed strongly to phase discrimination.
