Overall, the framework translates continuous tracking data into tactically interpretable in-possession phase representations, with potential applications in automated match annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.

item.title: $\tau$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
item.author: Narasimhan, Bharath Sivaram, Narasimhan, Karthik R
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了τ-Rec基准测试，用于评估代理式推荐系统。该基准测试通过可验证奖励和揭示标记的提示机制取代主观评估，并揭示了当前对话代理在可靠性方面存在显著差距。

背景: 随着推荐系统向代理式多轮对话界面转变，评估范式未能跟上发展步伐。现有的基准测试通常依赖“大语言模型作为裁判”的评估方法，这种方法引入了主观性、高成本和结果不一致的问题。

目的: 提出τ-Rec基准测试，为代理式推荐系统提供评估，以取代主观评估，提供可验证的奖励和对话过程中任务约束的揭示机制。

方法: 使用揭示标记的提示机制控制任务约束在对话中的呈现方式。通过测试代理对结构化目录谓词的表现，并采用pass^k可靠性指标，对五个模型家族的九种配置进行了系统性测试。

主要发现: 在五个模型家族的九种配置评估中，发现存在陡峭的可靠性悬崖。即使表现最好的模型，在pass^1指标下也仅达到约百分之五十七，在pass^4指标下仅达到约百分之三十八。

结论: 当前对话代理在部署方面存在关键性差距，需要改进以应对代理式推荐系统的评估需求。

翻译: As recommender systems transition toward agentic, multi-turn conversational interfaces, evaluation paradigms have struggled to keep pace. Current benchmarks often rely on

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前智能推荐系统评估方法主观性强、缺乏客观验证标准且无法准确衡量多轮对话与工具调用能力的问题。该问题在研究与现实中至关重要，因为随着推荐系统向对话式智能体演进，传统评估会掩盖模型在重复交互中的可靠性缺陷，导致实际部署时表现不稳定甚至违反安全策略。建立可验证的评估基准有助于系统性地测试和优化智能体的推理与合规能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有评测主观性强且缺乏一致性衡量标准的问题，将多轮对话推荐建模为约束优化过程，并设计了包含可验证奖励、信息逐步揭示机制、可靠性评估指标及政策合规检查的核心框架。该方法主要借鉴了先前 tau-bench 基准的确定性验证思路、用户模拟器设定及可靠性评估指标，同时参考了 MATCHA 的安全策略设计。在此基础上，作者针对推荐场景的特殊挑战，独立开发了适配的工具接口、策略类型与成功判定标准。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将推荐任务转化为多轮对话中的约束优化问题，用客观可验证的指标替代主观评分，强制智能体通过提问逐步挖掘用户偏好，并严格考核其政策合规性与多次运行的稳定性。整体流程首先构建基于最新电影数据的目录库，并设计包含主动提供、需询问或隐藏等不同信息揭示难度的任务。随后让智能体在用户模拟器引导下，通过调用搜索和过滤工具进行多轮交互以收集需求，最后提交单一推荐结果。系统会直接比对目录数据验证推荐是否满足所有条件与政策要求，并统计其在多次独立尝试中全部成功的概率来评估可靠性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套可验证的评测框架，核心包括四项机制：采用基于目录属性的确定性评分替代主观裁判，引入揭示标签机制强制智能体通过多轮对话逐步挖掘用户偏好，使用跨多次试验全对的指标检验模型一致性，并将政策合规性作为核心评估目标。相比以往工作，现有基准多依赖表面相似度指标或主观评分，且多为静态对话或单次推荐，容易受模型记忆干扰且缺乏可靠性与合规性评估。本框架首次将可验证评分、多轮对话、工具调用、政策检查与训练后新数据目录相结合，全面弥补了现有评测在一致性检验、防作弊和负责任人工智能行为评估上的不足。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套用于智能对话推荐系统的客观评测基准，通过引入确定性约束验证、对话式偏好提取机制、多轮可靠性评估指标及合规性检查，有效替代了主观评分并防止数据污染，同时揭示了当前大模型在复杂推荐任务中存在的显著一致性缺陷。

Abstract

As recommender systems transition toward agentic, multi-turn conversational interfaces, evaluation paradigms have struggled to keep pace. Current benchmarks often rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluations, which introduce subjectivity, high costs and inconsistency. We present $\tau$-Rec, a benchmark for agentic recommender systems that replaces subjective evaluation with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation (RTE) mechanism that controls how task constraints surface during dialogue. By testing agents against structured catalog predicates and employing a pass^k reliability metric, $\tau$-Rec provides a systematic test for consistent reasoning. Our evaluation of nine configurations across five model families -- GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3-32B and GPT-5 mini -- reveals a steep reliability cliff, where even the best model achieves only ~57% at pass^1 and ~38% at pass^4, highlighting a critical gap in current conversational agent deployment. All code and data are publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: ComBench: A Benchmark for Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization in Olympiad-Level Combinatorics
item.author: Zhang, Shunkai, Zhang, Haoran, Luo, Yun, Cheng, Qianjia, Lei, Haodi, Li, Yizhuo, Zhan, Runzhe, Wang, Zhilin, Xu, Bangjie, Su, Yucheng, Han, Xinmiao, Qu, Xiaoye, Liu, Dongrui, Lin, Zhouchen, Qiao, Yu, Ding, Ning, Li, Yafu, Cheng, Yu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了ComBench，一个用于评估和诊断大型语言模型组合推理能力的奥林匹克级别组合学基准。该基准包含一百个人工标注的竞赛级问题，分为以分析为中心和以构造为中心两类。实验表明，当前最强模型在该基准上远未饱和，且严谨证明推理与构造实现是两种不同的能力。

背景: 组合学在奥林匹克级别的数学问题解决中处于核心地位，需要深度的离散推理、创造性构造和严谨的结构洞察。最新证据表明，即使是当前最强的前沿模型在奥林匹克组合学方面表现不均，揭示了创造性数学推理方面的差距。

目的: 引入ComBench基准，用于评估和诊断大型语言模型的组合推理能力。

方法: ComBench包含一百个人工标注的竞赛级问题，分为以分析为中心的问题（主要需要严谨的数学论证）和以构造为中心的问题（需要明确的构造及正确性证明）。评估协议结合了基于量化的证明评分和确定性的构造验证。

主要发现: 在前沿开源和闭源模型上的实验显示，ComBench远未饱和，最强模型整体平均准确率达到百分之六十五点四，整体Best@4准确率达到百分之七十五点三。研究发现严谨证明推理和构造实现是两种不同的能力，例如Kimi-K2.6在以分析为中心的证明评分上落后于GPT-5.5，但在以构造为中心的Best@4上超越它。存在性问题与构造性问题在所有代表性前沿模型中始终最难。

结论: 当前最强模型在奥林匹克组合学问题上仍有较大提升空间，且模型在分析性证明和构造性实现方面表现出不同的能力特征。

翻译: Combinatorics is central to Olympiad-level mathematical problem solving, requiring deep discrete reasoning, creative constructions, and rigorous structural insight. Recent evidence suggests that even today's strongest frontier models remain uneven on Olympiad combinatorics, revealing a gap in creative mathematical reasoning. We introduce ComBench, an Olympiad-level combinatorics benchmark for evaluating and diagnosing the combinatorial reasoning capabilities of large language models. ComBench contains 100 human-annotated competition-level problems organized around two complementary settings: analysis-centric problems, which primarily require rigorous mathematical arguments, and construction-centric problems, which require explicit constructions in addition to correctness justifications. The evaluation protocol combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic construction verification, exposing cases where proof quality and construction validity diverge. Experiments on frontier open- and closed-source models show that ComBench is far from saturated: the strongest model reaches 65.4% overall Avg. and 75.3% overall Best@4. We further find that Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization are distinct capabilities: Kimi-K2.6 trails GPT-5.5 on analysis-centric proof grading but surpasses it on construction-centric Best@4, while Existence and Construction problems remain consistently hardest across representative frontier models.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决现有数学评测基准无法有效区分和评估人工智能模型在组合数学中严谨证明推理与构造实现两项核心能力的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为当前顶尖模型在奥林匹克级组合数学难题上表现不均，暴露出其在创造性数学推理和离散结构构造方面的明显短板。准确评估这两项能力有助于深入诊断人工智能的数学推理极限，并为推动模型向更复杂的数学问题解决能力迈进提供关键方向。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出当前评测要么仅核对答案无法检验论证过程，要么仅对自然语言证明打分却忽略构造的实际有效性。基于此，他们设计了包含分析型与构造型两类问题的基准，前者沿用专家制定的评分标准进行证明质量评估，后者要求模型输出具体构造对象并通过确定性代码进行机器验证。该方法借鉴了现有竞赛基准的评分规则与形式化验证思路，但创新性地保留了自然语言解答形式，并引入可执行验证器将证明与构造能力分开评估与结合。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个专门评估大语言模型在奥林匹克组合数学中两项关键能力的基准测试，即严谨的证明推理能力与将存在性论证转化为明确可检构造物的构造实现能力，并通过结合人工评分标准与机器可执行的构造验证来揭示模型在理论证明与实际构造之间的差距。整体实现流程首先从各类数学竞赛中筛选并标注一百道题目，分为侧重证明和侧重构造两类；接着为构造类题目设计具体的构造指令与参考构造物，编写确定性验证代码，并经过语义审计与可执行检查确保验证逻辑准确无误；最后采用验证门控评分机制，要求模型同时输出证明与构造对象，若构造验证失败则对高分证明进行降级处理，从而综合评估模型的实际解题水平。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了ComBench基准，专门用于评估大语言模型在奥林匹克级组合数学中的严谨证明推理与构造实现能力。相比以往仅核对最终答案或仅对自然语言证明文本进行评分的评测集，ComBench引入了可执行的确定性验证器，要求模型输出具体的离散构造对象并进行机器自动校验。这种设计将证明质量与构造有效性分开评估，能够精准诊断模型在逻辑论证与具体构造实现之间的能力差异。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套包含一百道竞赛级组合数学题的评估基准，设计了结合严格证明评分与确定性构造验证的评估协议，并通过实验揭示了当前大模型在数学证明推理与显式构造实现能力上的显著差异及薄弱环节。

Abstract

Combinatorics is central to Olympiad-level mathematical problem solving, requiring deep discrete reasoning, creative constructions, and rigorous structural insight. Recent evidence suggests that even today's strongest frontier models remain uneven on Olympiad combinatorics, revealing a gap in creative mathematical reasoning. We introduce ComBench, an Olympiad-level combinatorics benchmark for evaluating and diagnosing the combinatorial reasoning capabilities of large language models. ComBench contains 100 human-annotated competition-level problems organized around two complementary settings: analysis-centric problems, which primarily require rigorous mathematical arguments, and construction-centric problems, which require explicit constructions in addition to correctness justifications. The evaluation protocol combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic construction verification, exposing cases where proof quality and construction validity diverge. Experiments on frontier open- and closed-source models show that ComBench is far from saturated: the strongest model reaches 65.4% overall Avg. and 75.3% overall Best@4. We further find that Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization are distinct capabilities: Kimi-K2.6 trails GPT-5.5 on analysis-centric proof grading but surpasses it on construction-centric Best@4, while Existence and Construction problems remain consistently hardest across representative frontier models.

item.title: DeNovoSWE: Scaling Long-Horizon Environments for Generating Entire Repositories from Scratch
item.author: Zhao, Jiale, Chen, Guoxin, Meng, Fanzhe, Zhao, Wayne Xin, Song, Ruihua, Wen, Ji-Rong, Jia, Kai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了DeNovoSWE，一个用于完整代码仓库生成的大规模数据集，包含4818个高质量实例，通过自动化的沙盒智能体工作流构建，采用分治和批评修复策略，并引入难度感知的轨迹过滤策略以平衡数据质量与多样性。

背景: 基于大语言模型的代码代理能力不断提升，其角色正从修复现有代码库中的局部错误扩展到根据高层规范架构和实现完整的软件仓库。然而，由于缺乏大规模、可验证的完整仓库生成数据，训练代理执行此类长周期软件工程任务仍然困难。

目的: 引入DeNovoSWE数据集，以解决长周期软件工程任务训练数据稀缺的问题，提升代码代理在完整仓库生成任务上的性能。

方法: 通过精心设计的沙盒智能体工作流自动构建数据集，采用分治和批评修复哲学，并引入难度感知的轨迹过滤策略来平衡数据质量与多样性。

主要发现: 在DeNovoSWE上微调Qwen3-30B-A3B模型显著提升了长周期软件工程性能，在具有挑战性的BeyondSWE-Doc2Repo基准测试中，得分从百分之五点八提升至百分之四十七点二。

结论: DeNovoSWE数据集能够有效支持代码代理的训练，显著提升其在完整仓库生成任务上的表现。

翻译: As the capabilities of LLM-based code agents continue to advance, their expected role is expanding beyond localized bug fixing in existing codebases toward architecting and implementing complete software repositories from high-level specifications. However, training agents for such long-horizon software engineering tasks remains difficult due to the scarcity of large-scale, verifiable whole-repository generation data. In this paper, we introduce DeNovoSWE, a large-scale dataset for whole-repository generation. DeNovoSWE comprises 4,818 high-quality instances, where each instance requires generating a complete repository from documentation. Our dataset is automatically constructed through a carefully designed sandboxed agentic workflow, enabling scalable curation without human annotation. DeNovoSWE is constructed with divide and conquer and critic-repair philosophy. To balance data quality and diversity, we further introduce a difficulty-aware trajectory filtering strategy. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B on DeNovoSWE substantially improves long-horizon SWE performance, raising its score on the challenging BeyondSWE-Doc2Repo benchmark from 5.8% to 47.2%.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前训练代码智能体时缺乏大规模、可验证的完整代码仓库生成数据的问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为真实的软件开发流程要求从高层需求出发从零构建整个项目，而现有数据集多局限于修复单一代码缺陷，无法有效锻炼模型进行长期规划和复杂架构设计的能力。填补这一数据空白是推动智能体从局部代码维护者向全局软件架构师演进的关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有软件工程训练数据多集中于单点修复、缺乏完整仓库级生成数据的痛点，设计了自动化沙盒代理工作流。其核心思路采用分而治之与批评修复机制，将复杂仓库拆解为独立模块并迭代优化文档，同时引入难度感知的轨迹过滤策略以平衡数据质量与多样性。该方法并未直接照搬现有算法，而是基于对现有基准测试与数据集局限性的分析，独立构建了面向长周期仓库生成的全新数据合成框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是采用分治策略与批评修复机制相结合，通过自动化沙盒工作流自动生成高质量、可验证的文档到完整代码仓库的训练数据。整体流程首先将目标仓库按功能拆解为独立模块并梳理相关代码组件，接着由智能体迭代生成并修正各模块的说明文档，最后在严格隔离的环境中清理源码并运行测试以验证生成结果，最终通过难度感知筛选策略保留优质数据用于模型训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一套自动化构建完整软件仓库生成数据集的流程。它采用分治策略与迭代批评修复机制，结合难度感知的轨迹过滤方法，自动生成并筛选出大量高质量任务。与以往主要聚焦于单点缺陷修复的现有数据集相比，该工作将训练目标扩展为从零开始生成完整软件仓库，显著提升了任务难度与数据规模，有效解决了长周期软件工程任务中数据稀缺和代码泄露的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了DeNovoSWE数据集及自动化构建流水线，通过分治策略与批评修复机制生成高质量的全仓库生成任务，并开发了微调模型，显著提升了大语言模型从文档生成完整代码仓库的长期软件工程能力。

Abstract

As the capabilities of LLM-based code agents continue to advance, their expected role is expanding beyond localized bug fixing in existing codebases toward architecting and implementing complete software repositories from high-level specifications. However, training agents for such long-horizon software engineering tasks remains difficult due to the scarcity of large-scale, verifiable whole-repository generation data. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DeNovoSWE}, a large-scale dataset for whole-repository generation. DeNovoSWE comprises 4,818 high-quality instances, where each instance requires generating a complete repository from documentation. Our dataset is automatically constructed through a carefully designed sandboxed agentic workflow, enabling scalable curation without human annotation. DeNovoSWE is constructed with "divide and conquer" and critic-repair philosophy. To balance data quality and diversity, we further introduce a difficulty-aware trajectory filtering strategy. Fine-tuning Qwen3-30B-A3B on DeNovoSWE substantially improves long-horizon SWE performance, raising its score on the challenging BeyondSWE-Doc2Repo benchmark from 5.8% to 47.2%.

item.title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.author: Zou, Heming, Wang, Qi, Qu, Yun, Jiang, Yuhang, Cai, Lizhou, Mao, Yixiu, Peng, Ru, Xu, Xin, Liu, Weijie, Yang, Kai, Yang, Saiyong, Ji, Xiangyang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TRACE的树状展开分配框架，用于增强大语言模型在多轮智能体强化学习中的奖励对比度和策略更新信号，通过在提示词根和中间前缀层面分配展开预算，实现了在固定采样成本下性能与效率的提升。

背景: 强化学习结合可验证奖励是提升大语言模型推理和智能体行为的有效方法，但现有的策略优化受限于奖励对比度不足。这通常由过于简单或复杂的提示词导致低方差反馈，以及仅基于结果的奖励在多轮展开中对所有决策给予相同终端评估所引起。现有研究多聚焦于将资源分配给有潜力的提示词，但忽略了同一展开内不同轮次前缀层面的信息量差异。

目的: 针对多轮智能体强化学习，通过建模每个思维-动作-观察轮次为语义不同的节点，将预算分配从提示词根扩展到具有进一步延续的轮次级前缀，从而自然形成树状展开结构，以增强奖励对比度。

方法: 提出树状展开分配对比探索框架TRACE。该框架将展开预算分配给最可能产生混合终端奖励的提示词根和中间前缀。使用一个共享的可泛化预测器，根据前缀历史估计这些锚点的条件成功概率，以指导预算分配。这种自适应树状结构丰富了仅基于结果的反馈并放大了策略更新信号。

主要发现: TRACE在典型的智能体基准测试中实现了具有竞争力的性能和效率提升。例如，在相同的采样成本下，Qwen3-14B模型在Multi-Hop QA任务上的平均准确率相比竞争性基线提升了2.8个百分点。

结论: TRACE框架通过树状展开分配有效增强了奖励对比度，提升了大语言模型在多轮智能体任务中的推理能力和效率，为资源受限下的强化学习优化提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is a promising approach for enhancing reasoning and agentic behavior in large language models. However, rollout-intensive policy optimization is often limited by insufficient reward contrast, arising when overly simple or complex prompts generate low-variance feedback and when outcome-only rewards assign the same terminal assessment to every decision in a multi-turn rollout. Past efforts have focused on allocating available rollout resources to promising prompts, yet they only leverage sample informativeness at the prompt level and neglect variation in prefix-level informativeness across turns within the same rollout. This work targets multi-turn agentic RL by modeling each ReAct-style thought-action-observation turn as a semantically distinct node, allowing budget allocation to extend from prompt roots to turn-level prefixes with further continuations, which naturally forms tree-structured rollouts. We introduce Tree Rollout Allocation for Contrastive Exploration, a unified rollout allocation framework that enhances reward contrast within a fixed sampling budget. Technically, TRACE allocates rollout budget to both prompt roots and intermediate prefixes that are most likely to yield mixed terminal rewards. A shared generalizable predictor estimates conditional success probability at these anchors from prefix histories to guide this allocation. The resulting adaptive tree structure enriches outcome-only feedback and amplifies the policy-update signal. Empirically, TRACE achieves competitive performance and efficiency gains on typical agentic benchmarks, e.g., improving Qwen3-14B Multi-Hop QA average accuracy by 2.8 points over competitive baselines at equal sampling cost.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在强化学习训练中采样资源分配效率低和奖励信号对比度不足的问题。现有方法通常只在初始提示词层面分配计算资源，忽略了多轮交互过程中中间步骤的信息价值，导致模型难以获得有效的学习反馈。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为强化学习训练成本高昂，高效分配有限的采样预算能够显著提升模型在复杂推理和智能体任务中的准确率与训练效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法仅在初始提示词层面分配计算资源，忽略了多轮交互过程中中间步骤的信息价值。为此，他们将多轮对话的中间状态视为树状结构的分支节点，提出利用共享预测器评估各节点的成功概率，从而将预算集中分配给最可能产生结果对立的节点，以增强学习信号。该设计借鉴了前期在提示词筛选、采样数量分配以及树结构偏好学习等工作中关于对比探索的思路，将其统一扩展为覆盖提示词根节点与中间前缀节点的资源分配框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将有限的采样预算集中分配给最可能同时产生成功与失败结果的提示词起点和中间步骤节点，通过构建混合奖励对比来增强模型的学习信号。整体实现流程分为两个阶段：首先在全局范围内利用预测器评估并筛选出有潜力的提示词起点进行初始采样；随后在已生成的轨迹中识别出具有探索价值的中间步骤节点，为其分配额外的分支采样，从而形成树状结构并丰富反馈信号。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种统一预算分配框架，将资源分配从传统的提示词根节点扩展到了多轮交互中的中间前缀节点，从而构建出树状采样轨迹结构。相比以往仅关注提示词级别筛选或分配数量的工作，该方法通过共享预测器评估各节点产生混合结果的可能性，将预算精准分配给最可能同时产生成功与失败分支的节点。这一设计有效增强了单一结果奖励的对比信号，提升了多轮智能体强化学习的样本效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出TRACE框架，通过共享预测器将有限的采样预算智能分配给最可能产生成功与失败混合结果的初始提示和中间决策节点，从而在固定计算成本下显著提升大语言模型智能体强化学习的训练效率与性能。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a promising approach for enhancing reasoning and agentic behavior in large language models. However, rollout-intensive policy optimization is often limited by insufficient reward contrast, arising when overly simple or complex prompts generate low-variance feedback and when outcome-only rewards assign the same terminal assessment to every decision in a multi-turn rollout. Past efforts have focused on allocating available rollout resources to promising prompts, yet they only leverage sample informativeness at the prompt level and neglect variation in prefix-level informativeness across turns within the same rollout. This work targets multi-turn agentic RL by modeling each ReAct-style thought-action-observation turn as a semantically distinct node, allowing budget allocation to extend from prompt roots to turn-level prefixes with further continuations, which naturally forms tree-structured rollouts. We introduce Tree Rollout Allocation for Contrastive Exploration (TRACE), a unified rollout allocation framework that enhances reward contrast within a fixed sampling budget. Technically, TRACE allocates rollout budget to both prompt roots and intermediate prefixes that are most likely to yield mixed terminal rewards. A shared generalizable predictor estimates conditional success probability at these anchors from prefix histories to guide this allocation. The resulting adaptive tree structure enriches outcome-only feedback and amplifies the policy-update signal. Empirically, TRACE achieves competitive performance and efficiency gains on typical agentic benchmarks, e.g., improving Qwen3-14B Multi-Hop QA average accuracy by 2.8 points over competitive baselines at equal sampling cost.

item.title: i1: A Simple and Fully Open Recipe for Strong Text-to-Image Models
item.author: Zeng, Boya, Luo, Tianze, Pu, Shu, Shen, Jucheng, Lu, Taiming, Sarch, Gabriel, Liu, Zhuang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文系统研究了文本到图像扩散模型的建模和数据设计选择，通过大量受控实验得出多项实证发现，并基于这些发现训练了一个名为i1的30亿参数模型。该模型仅使用公开数据集训练，在多个基准测试中表现领先，显著优于现有完全开源模型，并公开了模型权重、代码和数据处理流程，为未来开放研究奠定了基础。

背景: 扩散模型持续推动文本到图像生成的进步，但难以将近期进展归因于特定的建模和数据选择。最先进的开源模型提供的消融实验有限，且不披露训练数据和完整训练细节。研究社区需要完全开源的模型作为进一步研究的基础，但现有的完全开源模型在性能上仍远落后于领先模型。

目的: 系统调查文本到图像扩散训练和推理中的建模和数据设计选择，以提供完全开源的模型和详细训练细节，促进研究社区的进一步研究。

方法: 进行了300多项受控实验，总计消耗70万多个TPU v6e小时。基于实验得出的实证发现和设计决策，训练了一个名为i1的30亿参数文本到图像扩散模型，仅使用公开可用的数据集。

主要发现: 混合策展数据集时，等权重是一个强有力的默认选择；使用较大的文本编码器适配器可以在增加极少参数的情况下提升性能。

结论: i1模型在五个代表性基准测试中与领先模型具有竞争力，并在平均表现上比现有最佳完全开源模型高出29.5个百分点。提供的模型检查点、训练和推理代码以及数据处理流程，为未来文本到图像扩散模型的开放研究建立了实用基础。

翻译: Diffusion models have consistently driven progress in text-to-image generation. However, it is challenging to attribute recent progress to specific modeling and data choices: state-of-the-art open-weight models provide limited ablations, and do not disclose their training data and full training details. The research community needs fully open (weights, data, and code) models as a foundation for further research; yet existing fully open models still fall significantly short of leading models in performance. In this project, we conduct a systematic investigation of the modeling and data design choices in text-to-image diffusion training and inference with 300+ controlled experiments totaling 700K+ TPU v6e hours. Our experiments highlight several empirical findings (e.g., equal weighting is a strong default for mixing curated datasets) and simple design decisions (e.g., larger text encoder adapters improve performance with minimal added parameters) for training strong models. Guided by these insights, we train i1, a 3B-parameter text-to-image diffusion model using only publicly available datasets. i1 is competitive with leading models on five representative benchmarks (GenEval, DPG, PRISM, CVTG-2K, and LongText), and outperforms the best existing fully open model by 29.5 absolute percentage points on average. We provide the i1 checkpoints, training and inference code, and the data processing pipeline. Together, our findings and the i1 recipe establish a practical foundation for future open research in text-to-image diffusion models. Our code is available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前顶尖文本生成图像模型缺乏透明度与可复现性的问题，即领先模型通常不公开训练数据和完整训练细节，而现有完全开源的模型性能又明显落后。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为缺乏透明机制使得学术界难以准确归因性能提升的具体因素，严重阻碍了可复现性研究与后续创新。提供一套完全开源且性能强劲的基础模型与实验指南，能够为未来的开放研究提供可靠基石，推动该领域的健康发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过数百次受控实验系统探索了模型架构与数据设计的组合空间，并从中提炼出关键经验。该方法并未引入全新的网络模块，而是主要借鉴并重新组合了现有工作中被低估或未被充分利用的设计，例如长跳跃连接和更大的文本编码器适配器。最终，作者将这些经过验证的简单设计决策与公开数据集相结合，训练出了该模型。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过大量受控实验系统探索文生图模型的设计空间，验证并组合有效的架构与数据处理策略，从而仅用公开数据训练出高性能的完全开源模型。整体实现流程首先构建一个基础模型作为对照起点，随后在低分辨率阶段进行数百项独立变量实验，筛选出最优的文本编码方式、网络骨干结构和数据混合方案。最后将这些经过验证的设计整合，先在低分辨率下完成预训练，再在高分辨率下进一步训练，最终得到目标模型并公开全部权重、代码与数据处理流程。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于通过大量受控实验系统梳理了文本到图像生成模型的建模与数据设计选择，并提炼出多项实用经验。例如，发现使用单个强文本编码器配合较大适配器比多编码器更有效，长跳跃连接能显著提升性能，且数据集等权重混合是强默认策略。相比以往工作，本文不依赖隐藏数据或复杂的新网络模块，而是以完全开源的方式提供可复现的训练配方，在仅使用公开数据的情况下实现了全开源模型中的最强性能，并大幅领先其他开源模型。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文通过大量受控实验系统探索了文本到图像生成模型的建模与数据设计选择，提炼出多项有效经验，并据此训练了参数量仅为三十亿且完全开源的i1模型，其在多项测试中达到完全开源模型的最优水平，同时公开了完整的模型权重、代码、数据与训练流程，为未来的开放研究奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract

Diffusion models have consistently driven progress in text-to-image generation. However, it is challenging to attribute recent progress to specific modeling and data choices: state-of-the-art open-weight models provide limited ablations, and do not disclose their training data and full training details. The research community needs fully open (weights, data, and code) models as a foundation for further research; yet existing fully open models still fall significantly short of leading models in performance. In this project, we conduct a systematic investigation of the modeling and data design choices in text-to-image diffusion training and inference with 300+ controlled experiments totaling 700K+ TPU v6e hours. Our experiments highlight several empirical findings (e.g., equal weighting is a strong default for mixing curated datasets) and simple design decisions (e.g., larger text encoder adapters improve performance with minimal added parameters) for training strong models. Guided by these insights, we train i1, a 3B-parameter text-to-image diffusion model using only publicly available datasets. i1 is competitive with leading models on five representative benchmarks (GenEval, DPG, PRISM, CVTG-2K, and LongText), and outperforms the best existing fully open model by 29.5 absolute percentage points on average. We provide the i1 checkpoints, training and inference code, and the data processing pipeline. Together, our findings and the i1 recipe establish a practical foundation for future open research in text-to-image diffusion models. Our code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Interpretable Neural Marked Statistics for Cosmological Inference
item.author: Federico Semenzato, Benjamin D. Wandelt, Michele Liguori, Alvise Raccanelli
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种神经标记方案，通过可解释的物理变换将宇宙学信息从形态学层面整合到两点统计中，利用对比学习目标对齐可学习的标记摘要与宇宙学参数。

背景: 仅通过两点统计无法获取晚期非高斯信号中的宇宙学信息，而标记统计通过非线性函数重新加权场，将部分信息整合回两点水平。

目的: 开发一种可解释且物理动机明确的神经标记方案，以直接解释形态学层面宇宙学信息的增益。

方法: 采用对比学习目标，将可学习的标记摘要与底层宇宙学参数对齐，通过一组可解释的物理变换实现标记过程。

主要发现: 在最大波数0.2 h/Mpc处，神经标记相比经典标记将σ8的边际约束收紧2.9倍，Ωm收紧1.8倍，打破Fisher信息层面的Ωm-σ8简并；参数均方误差较最佳经典标记降低1.45倍；学习到的潜在几何结构与参数空间中的Ωm和σ8方向对齐。

结论: 该方法为宇宙学推断开辟了更强大且可解释的摘要统计途径。

翻译: Recovering cosmological information beyond the power spectrum is a central goal for upcoming cosmological surveys, since late-time non-Gaussian signal in the matter density cannot be accessed through two-point statistics alone. Marked statistics fold part of this information back into the two-point level by reweighting the field with non-linear functions. We propose a neural marking scheme to generalize this process through a set of interpretable, physically motivated transformations that directly allow to interpret the gain in cosmological information at the morphological level. We employ a contrastive learning objective to align learnable marked summaries with the underlying cosmological parameters. At k_max=0.2 h/Mpc, our neural mark tightens the marginalized constraint on σ8 by 2.9x and on Ωm by 1.8x compared to classical marks, breaking the Ωm-σ8 degeneracy at the Fisher information level. It further reduces the parameter MSE across our cosmological parameter prior by 1.45x over the best classical mark. The learned latent geometry aligns with the Ωm and σ8 directions in parameter space, indicating that the contrastive objective recovers the dominant axes of cosmological information. Our approach opens the door to more powerful, interpretable summary statistics for cosmological inference.

Abstract

Recovering cosmological information beyond the power spectrum is a central goal for upcoming cosmological surveys, since late-time non-Gaussian signal in the matter density cannot be accessed through two-point statistics alone. Marked statistics fold part of this information back into the two-point level by reweighting the field with non-linear functions. We propose a neural marking scheme to generalize this process through a set of interpretable, physically motivated transformations that directly allow to interpret the gain in cosmological information at the morphological level. We employ a contrastive learning objective to align learnable marked summaries with the underlying cosmological parameters. At $k_{\max}=0.2\,h\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$, our neural mark tightens the marginalized constraint on $σ_8$ by $2.9\times$ and on $Ω_m$ by $1.8\times$ compared to classical marks, breaking the $Ω_m-σ_8$ degeneracy at the Fisher information level. It further reduces the parameter MSE across our cosmological parameter prior by $1.45\times$ over the best classical mark. The learned latent geometry aligns with the $Ω_m$ and $σ_8$ directions in parameter space, indicating that the contrastive objective recovers the dominant axes of cosmological information. Our approach opens the door to more powerful, interpretable summary statistics for cosmological inference.

item.title: Comparison and verification methods to trace interaction-driven disturbances in galaxies
item.author: Haotian Lyu, Sarah Brough, Aman Khalid, Alice Desmons, Elizaveta Sazonova
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文评估了两种自动化方法在追踪星系相互作用驱动的结构和合并特征方面的性能，以视觉分类为基准。

背景: 星系周围的低表面亮度潮汐碎片和其他相互作用驱动的结构是过去或正在进行的星系合并的重要指标。随着巡天数据量的增加，自动化检测方法变得至关重要。

目的: 评估自监督学习模型和浓度不对称平滑度参数方法在追踪相互作用驱动的结构和合并特征方面的性能。

方法: 使用视觉分类作为基准，评估自监督学习模型和浓度不对称平滑度参数方法的完整性和精确性。

主要发现: 视觉分类在样本中产生百分之二十五点一加减一点五的高置信度结构分数。自监督学习模型通过仅重新训练其线性分类器，实现了高召回率和低污染，适合识别广泛的受干扰系统。浓度不对称平滑度参数方法使用传统阈值，显示出较高的精确性但较低的召回率，表明其方法较为保守。视觉分类和自监督学习模型显示恒星质量与结构分数之间存在显著正相关，而浓度不对称平滑度参数方法表现出较弱的趋势。

结论: 自监督学习模型适合识别广泛的受干扰系统，包括低表面亮度潮汐碎片，从而提供更完整的合并相关特征目录。

翻译: Low surface brightness tidal debris around galaxies, such as tails, streams, and shells, together with other interaction-driven morphological disturbances, serve as valuable indicators of past or ongoing galaxy mergers. With the growing data volume from surveys like the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), automated detection methods are essential. This paper evaluates the performance of two automated methods, a Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) model and the Concentration-Asymmetry-Smoothness (CAS) parameter method, in tracing interaction-driven disturbances and merger signatures, with visual classification used as the benchmark. Visual classification yields a high-confidence disturbance fraction of 25.1 +/- 1.5% in our sample and serves as the reference standard for assessing the completeness and precision of the automated approaches. Visual classification is affected by galaxy distance and image resolution, which limit the detectability of faint low surface brightness structures. The SSL model achieves high recall (0.86 +/- 0.04) and low contamination (0.2) by retraining only its linear classifier on a small labelled dataset, making it suitable for identifying a broad set of disturbed systems, including faint tidal debris and other interaction-driven morphological disturbances, thereby providing a more complete census of merger-related features. The CAS method, using the traditional threshold A > 0.35, shows higher precision (0.77) but lower recall (0.20), indicating a conservative approach that captures cleaner but less complete samples. Visual classification and the SSL model show a significant positive correlation between stellar mass and disturbance fraction, while the CAS method exhibits a much weaker trend.

Abstract

Low surface brightness tidal debris around galaxies, such as tails, streams, and shells, together with other interaction-driven morphological disturbances, serve as valuable indicators of past or ongoing galaxy mergers. With the growing data volume from surveys like the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), automated detection methods are essential. This paper evaluates the performance of two automated methods, a Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) model and the Concentration-Asymmetry-Smoothness (CAS) parameter method, in tracing interaction-driven disturbances and merger signatures, with visual classification used as the benchmark. Visual classification yields a high-confidence disturbance fraction of 25.1 +/- 1.5% in our sample and serves as the reference standard for assessing the completeness and precision of the automated approaches. Visual classification is affected by galaxy distance and image resolution, which limit the detectability of faint low surface brightness structures. The SSL model achieves high recall (0.86 +/- 0.04) and low contamination (0.2) by retraining only its linear classifier on a small labelled dataset, making it suitable for identifying a broad set of disturbed systems, including faint tidal debris and other interaction-driven morphological disturbances, thereby providing a more complete census of merger-related features. The CAS method, using the traditional threshold A > 0.35, shows higher precision (0.77) but lower recall (0.20), indicating a conservative approach that captures cleaner but less complete samples. Visual classification and the SSL model show a significant positive correlation between stellar mass and disturbance fraction, while the CAS method exhibits a much weaker trend.

item.title: GLACIER: A Multimodal Student-Teacher Foundation Model for Molecular Property Prediction
item.author: Emily Nguyen, Yongchan Hong, Harsh Toshniwal, Yan Liu, Andreas Luttens
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为GLACIER的模型，该模型通过整合分子图、SMILES字符串和理化描述符，利用学生-教师框架学习丰富的分子嵌入，以解决深度学习模型在分子发现中计算负担重且多模态数据利用不足的问题。

背景: 深度学习模型有助于在数十亿候选化合物中发现具有特定性质的分子，但开发部署最先进模型的计算负担不断增加，限制了其可扩展性。大多数大规模模型本质上是单模态的，忽视了利用互补分子数据模态的潜力。

目的: 解决现有模型计算负担重和多模态数据利用不足的问题，通过整合多种分子数据模态来学习更丰富的分子嵌入，提高分子性质预测的性能和效率。

方法: 提出GLACIER模型，采用学生-教师框架。首先，在十万个类药分子上预训练三个学生编码器：用于分子图的消息传递神经网络、用于SMILES字符串的基于Transformer的编码器以及用于理化描述符的多层感知机。其次，使用一种新的Finsler几何感知模块融合这些学生模态。最后，通过对比学习将大型教师模型（如MiniMol和MolFormer）的互补知识蒸馏到单个轻量级模型中。

主要发现: GLACIER是一个鲁棒的框架，在复杂的分子性质预测任务中提供了高预测性能和计算效率。

结论: GLACIER模型能够有效整合多模态分子数据，通过蒸馏学习实现高效且高性能的分子性质预测，其代码已公开。

翻译: Deep learning models facilitate the discovery of molecules with tailored properties among billions of candidate compounds. However, the computational burden to develop and deploy state-of-the-art models continuously increases, limiting their scalability. Most large-scale models are unimodal in nature and overlook the potential to leverage complementary molecular data modalities. To address these shortcomings, this paper introduces the Graph-Language Alignment for Chemical Inference and Exploration using Representations (GLACIER) model, a student-teacher framework that integrates molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and physicochemical descriptors to learn rich molecular embeddings. Our framework consists of three stages: (1) we pretrain three student encoders on 100,000 drug-like molecules: a message-passing neural network for molecular graphs, a transformer-based encoder for SMILES strings, and a multilayer perceptron for physicochemical descriptors, (2) we fuse these student modalities using a novel Finsler geometry-aware module, and (3) distill complementary knowledge from large teacher models, including MiniMol and MolFormer, into a single lightweight model via contrastive learning. We demonstrate that GLACIER is a robust framework that delivers high predictive performance and computational efficiency in complex molecular property prediction tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/eemokey/glacier.

Abstract

Deep learning models facilitate the discovery of molecules with tailored properties among billions of candidate compounds. However, the computational burden to develop and deploy state-of-the-art models continuously increases, limiting their scalability. Most large-scale models are unimodal in nature and overlook the potential to leverage complementary molecular data modalities. To address these shortcomings, this paper introduces the Graph-Language Alignment for Chemical Inference and Exploration using Representations (GLACIER) model, a student-teacher framework that integrates molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and physicochemical descriptors to learn rich molecular embeddings. Our framework consists of three stages: (1) we pretrain three student encoders on 100,000 drug-like molecules: a message-passing neural network for molecular graphs, a transformer-based encoder for SMILES strings, and a multilayer perceptron for physicochemical descriptors, (2) we fuse these student modalities using a novel Finsler geometry-aware module, and (3) distill complementary knowledge from large teacher models, including MiniMol and MolFormer, into a single lightweight model via contrastive learning. We demonstrate that GLACIER is a robust framework that delivers high predictive performance and computational efficiency in complex molecular property prediction tasks. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/eemokey/glacier.

item.title: Gumbel-BEARD: Automatic Layer Selection for Self-Supervised Adaptation of Whisper in Low-Resource Domains
item.author: Zilai Wang, Natarajan Balaji Shankar, Mohan Shi, Kaiyuan Zhang, Abeer Alwan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出Gumbel-BEARD框架，通过自动选择Whisper编码器层实现低资源领域的语音识别自适应，在多个数据集上达到最优性能。

背景: 语音基础模型在低资源领域常因领域不匹配和数据稀缺而表现不佳。

目的: 解决低资源领域因领域不匹配和数据稀缺导致的语音识别性能下降问题。

方法: 提出Gumbel-BEARD框架，使用端到端可训练的硬Gumbel-Softmax选择器自动选择Whisper编码器层，结合BEST-RQ目标实现自监督自适应，无需手动调参。

主要发现: 在MyST儿童语音语料库上，仅用10小时标注数据微调即可匹配使用完整133小时标注数据的完全监督基线；在MyST和OGI Spontaneous数据集上分别达到8.21%和11.06%的最低词错误率；在CORAAL数据集上验证了对成人方言领域偏移的鲁棒性，词错误率最高降低6%。

结论: 该方法在多种低资源条件下具有高效性、可扩展性和泛化能力。

翻译: Speech foundation models often struggle in low-resource domains due to domain mismatch and data scarcity. We propose Gumbel-BEARD, a domain adaptation framework that automates Whisper encoder layer selection via an end-to-end trainable hard Gumbel-Softmax selector. It enables self-supervised adaptation with a BEST-RQ objective that dynamically adapts to target acoustic characteristics without manual tuning. Experiments on the MyST child speech corpus demonstrate efficiency and scalability: with 10 h of labeled data for fine-tuning, our method matches a fully supervised baseline trained on the complete 133 h labeled set. We establish new state-of-the-art word error rates (WERs) of 8.21% using Whisper-medium on MyST and 11.06% using Whisper-small on the OGI Spontaneous dataset. Evaluation on CORAAL further confirms robustness to adult dialectal domain shifts, with up to 6% relative WER reduction, highlighting the generalizability of our approach to diverse low-resource conditions.

Abstract

Speech foundation models often struggle in low-resource domains due to domain mismatch and data scarcity. We propose Gumbel-BEARD, a domain adaptation framework that automates Whisper encoder layer selection via an end-to-end trainable hard Gumbel-Softmax selector. It enables self-supervised adaptation with a BEST-RQ objective that dynamically adapts to target acoustic characteristics without manual tuning. Experiments on the MyST child speech corpus demonstrate efficiency and scalability: with 10 h of labeled data for fine-tuning, our method matches a fully supervised baseline trained on the complete 133 h labeled set. We establish new state-of-the-art word error rates (WERs) of 8.21% using Whisper-medium on MyST and 11.06% using Whisper-small on the OGI Spontaneous dataset. Evaluation on CORAAL further confirms robustness to adult dialectal domain shifts, with up to 6% relative WER reduction, highlighting the generalizability of our approach to diverse low-resource conditions.

item.title: The Periodic Table of LLM Reasoning: A Structured Survey of Reasoning Paradigms, Methods, and Failure Modes
item.author: Avinash Anand, Mahisha Ramesh, Avni Mittal, Ashutosh Kumar, Erik Cambria, Zhengkui Wang, Timothy Liu, Aik Beng Ng, Simon See, Rajiv Ratn Shah
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对大语言模型推理能力进行了系统性综述，分析了超过三百篇近期文献，涵盖了推理能力的涌现机制、失败模式及未来方向。

背景: 大语言模型在自然语言处理任务中表现强劲，但可靠推理仍是未解难题。尽管现代模型在结构化推理、多步问题解决和上下文理解方面取得进展，但其推理行为往往不一致，且对提示策略、任务设计和模型规模敏感。

目的: 旨在为大语言模型推理能力的当前能力和局限性提供统一视角，并为未来开发更稳健、可解释且具泛化能力的推理系统提供参考。

方法: 系统分析了来自arXiv、Semantic Scholar、Google Scholar、Papers with Code和ACL Anthology等来源的三百多篇近期论文。

主要发现: 首先，构建了涵盖思维链推理、多跳推理、数学推理、常识推理、视觉与时间推理、代码与算法推理、检索增强推理、工具增强与智能体推理以及基于强化学习的推理的结构化分类体系。其次，分析了各范式的方法论趋势，包括提示方法、模型架构、训练目标、奖励建模和评估基准。最后，综合了重复出现的局限性和失败模式，如推理幻觉、脆弱多步推理、弱因果抽象和跨领域泛化能力差。

结论: 该综述通过整理快速扩展的文献，提供了大语言模型推理能力的统一视图，并确定了元推理、自进化推理框架、多模态推理和社会化 grounded 推理等新兴研究方向。

翻译: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across natural language processing tasks, yet reliable reasoning remains an open challenge. Although modern LLMs show progress in structured inference, multi-step problem solving, and contextual understanding, their reasoning behavior is often inconsistent and sensitive to prompting strategies, task design, and model scale. This survey provides a systematic analysis of more than 300 recent papers from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, Papers with Code, and the ACL Anthology to examine how reasoning capabilities emerge in LLMs and where they fail. We make three main contributions. First, we introduce a structured taxonomy of LLM reasoning research, covering Chain-of-Thought reasoning, multi-hop reasoning, mathematical reasoning, common sense reasoning, visual and temporal reasoning, code and algorithmic reasoning, retrieval-augmented reasoning, tool-augmented and agentic reasoning, and reinforcement learning-based reasoning. Second, we analyze methodological trends across these paradigms, including prompting methods, model architectures, training objectives, reward modeling, and evaluation benchmarks. Third, we synthesize recurring limitations and failure modes, such as reasoning hallucinations, brittle multi-step inference, weak causal abstraction, and poor cross-domain generalization. By organizing a rapidly expanding literature, this survey offers a unified view of the current capabilities and limitations of reasoning in LLMs. We also identify emerging research directions, including meta-reasoning, self-evolving reasoning frameworks, multimodal reasoning, and socially grounded reasoning. Overall, this work aims to serve as a reference for developing more robust, interpretable, and generalizable reasoning systems in future language models.

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across natural language processing tasks, yet reliable reasoning remains an open challenge. Although modern LLMs show progress in structured inference, multi-step problem solving, and contextual understanding, their reasoning behavior is often inconsistent and sensitive to prompting strategies, task design, and model scale. This survey provides a systematic analysis of more than 300 recent papers from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, Papers with Code, and the ACL Anthology to examine how reasoning capabilities emerge in LLMs and where they fail. We make three main contributions. First, we introduce a structured taxonomy of LLM reasoning research, covering Chain-of-Thought reasoning, multi-hop reasoning, mathematical reasoning, common sense reasoning, visual and temporal reasoning, code and algorithmic reasoning, retrieval-augmented reasoning, tool-augmented and agentic reasoning, and reinforcement learning-based reasoning. Second, we analyze methodological trends across these paradigms, including prompting methods, model architectures, training objectives, reward modeling, and evaluation benchmarks. Third, we synthesize recurring limitations and failure modes, such as reasoning hallucinations, brittle multi-step inference, weak causal abstraction, and poor cross-domain generalization. By organizing a rapidly expanding literature, this survey offers a unified view of the current capabilities and limitations of reasoning in LLMs. We also identify emerging research directions, including meta-reasoning, self-evolving reasoning frameworks, multimodal reasoning, and socially grounded reasoning. Overall, this work aims to serve as a reference for developing more robust, interpretable, and generalizable reasoning systems in future language models.

item.title: CRUMB: Efficient Prior Fitted Network Inference via Distributionally Matched Context Batching
item.author: Jamie Heredge, Mattia J. Villani, Pranav Deshpande, Akshay Seshadri, Niraj Kumar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: CRUMB 是一种针对表格基础模型的前置拟合网络推理包装器，通过聚类测试查询和基于最小化最大均值差异选择训练子集，有效解决了大规模训练数据集下推理成本过高的问题，并在基准测试中表现优于现有方法。

背景: 前置拟合网络是一种具有上下文学习能力的表格基础模型，通过将完整的标记训练集作为上下文，在一次前向传播中生成测试查询的预测。然而，许多前置拟合网络架构中二次扩展的自注意力机制使得在非常大的训练数据集上进行推理变得不可行。

目的: 提出一种名为 CRUMB 的推理包装器，以解决前置拟合网络在处理大规模训练数据集时推理成本过高的问题，同时保持架构无关性和无需重新训练的特性。

方法: CRUMB 是一个三阶段的推理包装器：首先对测试查询进行聚类；其次，通过贪婪地最小化最大均值差异，为每个聚类选择一个分布匹配的小规模训练子集；最后，在每个缩减上下文的批次上运行精确的前置拟合网络推理。

主要发现: 在包含 51 个数据集的 TabArena 基准测试中，评估了三种前置拟合网络架构（TabPFNv2、TabICLv1、TabICLv2），结果显示 CRUMB 优于类似的最新上下文选择策略。此外，CRUMB 对协变量漂移具有弹性，因为最小化最大均值差异的步骤自然地帮助将训练上下文分布与当前测试批次分布对齐。

结论: CRUMB 提供了一种高效且鲁棒的前置拟合网络推理解决方案，能够在不重新训练模型的情况下，通过优化上下文选择显著提升大规模数据场景下的推理性能和适应性。

翻译: Prior-fitted networks (PFNs) are a promising class of tabular foundation models that perform in-context learning, whereby the entire labelled training set is supplied as context, and predictions for test queries are produced in a single forward pass. However, the quadratically scaling self-attention mechanism in many PFN architectures makes inference prohibitive for very large training datasets. We propose CRUMB (Clustered Retrieval Using Minimised-MMD Batching), a three-stage inference wrapper that (i) clusters the test queries, (ii) selects a small, distributionally matched training subset for each cluster by greedily minimising the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and (iii) runs exact PFN inference on each reduced-context batch. CRUMB is architecture-agnostic and requires no retraining. On the 51-dataset TabArena benchmark, evaluated across three PFN architectures (TabPFNv2, TabICLv1, TabICLv2), we show that CRUMB outperforms similar state-of-the-art context selection strategies. We also show that CRUMB is resilient to covariate drift, as the MMD-minimisation step naturally helps align the training context distribution to match the current test batch distributions.

Abstract

Prior-fitted networks (PFNs) are a promising class of tabular foundation models that perform in-context learning, whereby the entire labelled training set is supplied as context, and predictions for test queries are produced in a single forward pass. However, the quadratically scaling self-attention mechanism in many PFN architectures makes inference prohibitive for very large training datasets. We propose CRUMB (Clustered Retrieval Using Minimised-MMD Batching), a three-stage inference wrapper that (i) clusters the test queries, (ii) selects a small, distributionally matched training subset for each cluster by greedily minimising the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and (iii) runs exact PFN inference on each reduced-context batch. CRUMB is architecture-agnostic and requires no retraining. On the 51-dataset TabArena benchmark, evaluated across three PFN architectures (TabPFNv2, TabICLv1, TabICLv2), we show that CRUMB outperforms similar state-of-the-art context selection strategies. We also show that CRUMB is resilient to covariate drift, as the MMD-minimisation step naturally helps align the training context distribution to match the current test batch distributions.

item.title: Towards Fully Automated Exam Grading: Fairness-Aware Recognition of Handwritten Answers with Foundation Models
item.author: Hartwig Grabowski
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究利用通用视觉语言基础模型改进了手写考试自动评分的准确性与公平性，解决了传统方法在识别非标准书写和位置偏差答案时的不足，实现了高准确率和低误判率的自动化评分。

背景: 传统手写考试批改耗时且易出错，而全数字化考试往往限制题型为封闭式问题。现有自动识别方法准确率较低，且难以处理答案超出单元格、被划掉或连笔书写等情况。

目的: 验证通过记录单字母答案的混合考试形式是否能够实现准确且公平的无人监督评分，并解决现有自动识别方法在关键案例上的失败问题。

方法: 采用通用视觉语言基础模型而非像素模板匹配来解读页面。在包含六十一份匿名考试和三千一百四十一处答案位置的基准测试中，使用提供参考答案作为上下文的轻量级提示，区分并降低漏判率。

主要发现: 最佳模型准确率达到百分之九十八点四，显著高于之前的基准。通过引入参考答案上下文，漏判率降至百分之零点五八。在示例评分方案下，仅三份考试会被降级，且可通过学生自查步骤发现。

结论: 大规模公平性感知的完全自动化考试评分是可行的。研究发布了匿名基准测试以支持可重复性。

翻译: Correcting handwritten exams by hand is time-consuming and error-prone, particularly for large cohorts, while fully digital exams tend to force a didactic narrowing towards closed question formats. A practical middle ground keeps paper-based, problem-oriented tasks but records the assessment-relevant answers as single capital letters in a table that a machine can read. The open question is whether this reading can be made accurate and, above all, fair enough for unsupervised grading. Earlier automated approaches reached only about 88%--91% recognition -- too low -- and failed on the cases that matter most: answers placed outside the cell, crossed out, or written in cursive. We show that general-purpose vision-language foundation models (VLMs), which interpret the page rather than match pixel templates, close this gap. On a benchmark of 61 anonymised exams (3141 answer positions) the best model reaches 98.4% accuracy, well above the previous baseline. Crucially, we centre the evaluation on fairness: we distinguish false negatives (a correct answer marked wrong, which disadvantages the student) from false positives, and a lightweight prompt that supplies the reference solution as context lowers the false-negative rate to 0.58%. Under an exemplary grading scheme only three of the 61 exams would be graded worse, all caught by a student self-review step. Fully automated, fairness-aware exam grading at scale is therefore defensible; we release the anonymised benchmark to support reproducibility.

Abstract

Correcting handwritten exams by hand is time-consuming and error-prone, particularly for large cohorts, while fully digital exams tend to force a didactic narrowing towards closed question formats. A practical middle ground keeps paper-based, problem-oriented tasks but records the assessment-relevant answers as single capital letters in a table that a machine can read. The open question is whether this reading can be made accurate and, above all, fair enough for unsupervised grading. Earlier automated approaches reached only about 88%--91% recognition -- too low -- and failed on the cases that matter most: answers placed outside the cell, crossed out, or written in cursive. We show that general-purpose vision-language foundation models (VLMs), which interpret the page rather than match pixel templates, close this gap. On a benchmark of 61 anonymised exams (3141 answer positions) the best model reaches 98.4% accuracy, well above the previous baseline. Crucially, we centre the evaluation on fairness: we distinguish false negatives (a correct answer marked wrong, which disadvantages the student) from false positives, and a lightweight prompt that supplies the reference solution as context lowers the false-negative rate to 0.58%. Under an exemplary grading scheme only three of the 61 exams would be graded worse, all caught by a student self-review step. Fully automated, fairness-aware exam grading at scale is therefore defensible; we release the anonymised benchmark to support reproducibility.

item.title: Building Social World Models with Large Language Models
item.author: Haofei Yu, Yining Zhao, Guanyu Lin, Jiaxuan You
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为社会世界模型的新框架，用于捕捉社会信念如何响应重大事件而演变。该模型通过挖掘社会数据中的时间模式并优化证据下界来学习社会信念的状态转移函数，无需显式的人类标注或昂贵的普查数据。在基于真实世界预测市场构建的基准测试中，该模型在政治、金融和加密货币等领域的社会信念预测任务中显著优于时间序列基础模型，取得了最先进结果，并提供了对社会信念动态背后机制的可解释见解。

背景: 理解和预测社会信念如何响应事件（从政策变化到科学突破）而演变仍然是社会科学中的一个基本挑战。

目的: 探讨大型语言模型是否能够模拟社会事件后社会信念的动态变化。

方法: 引入社会世界模型框架，通过挖掘社会数据中的时间模式并优化证据下界来学习社会信念的状态转移函数，无需显式的人类标注或昂贵的普查数据。

主要发现: 在基于真实世界预测市场构建的基准测试中，该模型在政治、金融和加密货币等领域的社会信念预测任务中显著优于时间序列基础模型，取得了最先进结果，并提供了对社会信念动态背后机制的可解释见解。

结论: 大型语言模型具备模拟社会事件后社会信念动态变化的能力，所提出的框架在预测社会信念演变方面表现优异。

翻译: Understanding and predicting how social beliefs evolve in response to events -- from policy changes to scientific breakthroughs -- remains a fundamental challenge in social science. Given LLMs' commonsense knowledge and social intelligence, we ask: Can LLMs model the dynamics of social beliefs following social events? In this work, we introduce the concept of the Social World Model (SWM), a general framework designed to capture how social beliefs evolve in response to major events. SWM learns state-transition functions for social beliefs by mining temporal patterns in social data and optimizing the evidence lower bound, without the need for explicit human annotations linking events to belief shifts, or for expensive census data. To evaluate SWM, we introduce a benchmark, SWM-bench, derived from real-world prediction markets, specifically Kalshi and Polymarket. SWM-bench includes over 12k data points for social belief prediction tasks spanning diverse domains such as politics, finance, and cryptocurrency. Our experimental results show that SWM significantly outperforms time-series foundation models, achieving state-of-the-art results on Kalshi data and demonstrating competitive performance on Polymarket data, while offering interpretable insights into the underlying mechanisms of social belief dynamics.

Abstract

Understanding and predicting how social beliefs evolve in response to events -- from policy changes to scientific breakthroughs -- remains a fundamental challenge in social science. Given LLMs' commonsense knowledge and social intelligence, we ask: Can LLMs model the dynamics of social beliefs following social events? In this work, we introduce the concept of the Social World Model (SWM), a general framework designed to capture how social beliefs evolve in response to major events. SWM learns state-transition functions for social beliefs by mining temporal patterns in social data and optimizing the evidence lower bound, without the need for explicit human annotations linking events to belief shifts, or for expensive census data. To evaluate SWM, we introduce a benchmark, SWM-bench, derived from real-world prediction markets, specifically Kalshi and Polymarket. SWM-bench includes over 12k data points for social belief prediction tasks spanning diverse domains such as politics, finance, and cryptocurrency. Our experimental results show that SWM significantly outperforms time-series foundation models, achieving state-of-the-art results on Kalshi data and demonstrating competitive performance on Polymarket data, while offering interpretable insights into the underlying mechanisms of social belief dynamics.

item.title: OmniLoc: A Geometry-Aware Foundation Model for Anchor-Free UE Localization Across Diverse Indoor Environments
item.author: Lei Chu, Yuning Zhang, Omer Gokalp Serbetci, Anushka Katiyar, Bassel Abou Ali Modad, Andreas F. Molisch
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为OmniLoc的环境交互基础模型，用于在多样化的室内环境中进行无锚点用户设备定位。该模型直接基于无线测量数据构建，通过统一的输入标记化模块、几何感知的Transformer以及几何感知的位置估计模块，实现了异构无线测量数据的统一表示、主导接入点的特征提取以及几何一致的位置预测。在大规模内部数据集和公共基准数据集上的评估表明，OmniLoc显著优于现有方法，具有良好的泛化能力和性能提升效果。

背景: 由于建筑几何结构、可检测接入点集合以及接收信号异质性的显著变化，基于无线测量的室内定位在大规模部署中仍然具有挑战性。现有的基于学习的方法通常仅在有限设置下表现良好，并在环境变化时性能下降，使得在多样化室内环境中实现鲁棒的无锚点定位变得非常困难。

目的: 提出一种环境交互的基础模型OmniLoc，用于在多样化的室内环境中进行无锚点用户设备定位。

方法: OmniLoc基于三个关键设计：首先，统一的输入标记化模块将异构无线测量数据转换为更易于学习的共同表示；其次，几何感知的Transformer通过强调主导接入点并聚合支持接入点的互补证据，执行接入点感知的特征提取；最后，几何感知的位置估计模块对几何嵌入进行条件回归，以产生几何一致的位置预测。

主要发现: 在大规模内部数据集和公共基准数据集上的评估结果显示，OmniLoc显著优于现有方法。当将其设计组件集成到现有骨干网络时，能够持续提升性能。在跨环境评估中，OmniLoc展现出强大的泛化能力。

结论: OmniLoc是首个直接基于无线测量数据构建的基础模型方法，用于无锚点用户设备定位任务。该模型通过其独特的设计，在多样化室内环境中实现了鲁棒且高精度的定位，为室内定位领域提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Indoor localization from wireless measurements remains challenging in large-scale deployments due to substantial variation in building geometry, the set of detectable access points (APs), and the heterogeneity of received signals. Existing learning-based methods often perform well only in limited settings and degrade under environmental shifts, making robust anchor-free localization across diverse indoor environments notoriously difficult. In this paper, we present OmniLoc, an environment-interactive foundation model for anchor-free user equipment localization across diverse indoor environments. To the best of our knowledge, OmniLoc is the first foundation-model-based approach built directly on wireless measurements for this task. OmniLoc is built on three key designs. First, a unified input tokenization module converts heterogeneous wireless measurements into a common representation that is more amenable to learning. Second, a geometry-aware Transformer performs AP-aware feature extraction by emphasizing dominant APs while aggregating complementary evidence from supporting APs. Third, a geometry-aware location estimation module conditions regression on geometric embeddings to produce geometrically consistent location predictions. We evaluate OmniLoc on both a large-scale in-house dataset and a public benchmark dataset. Results show that OmniLoc significantly outperforms existing methods, consistently improves existing backbones when its design components are integrated, and demonstrates strong generalization in cross-environment evaluations.

Abstract

Indoor localization from wireless measurements remains challenging in large-scale deployments due to substantial variation in building geometry, the set of detectable access points (APs), and the heterogeneity of received signals. Existing learning-based methods often perform well only in limited settings and degrade under environmental shifts, making robust anchor-free localization across diverse indoor environments notoriously difficult. In this paper, we present OmniLoc, an environment-interactive foundation model for anchor-free user equipment localization across diverse indoor environments. To the best of our knowledge, OmniLoc is the first foundation-model-based approach built directly on wireless measurements for this task. OmniLoc is built on three key designs. First, a unified input tokenization module converts heterogeneous wireless measurements into a common representation that is more amenable to learning. Second, a geometry-aware Transformer performs AP-aware feature extraction by emphasizing dominant APs while aggregating complementary evidence from supporting APs. Third, a geometry-aware location estimation module conditions regression on geometric embeddings to produce geometrically consistent location predictions. We evaluate OmniLoc on both a large-scale in-house dataset and a public benchmark dataset. Results show that OmniLoc significantly outperforms existing methods, consistently improves existing backbones when its design components are integrated, and demonstrates strong generalization in cross-environment evaluations.

item.title: Probabilistic Contrastive Pretraining for Multi-task ADME Property Prediction
item.author: Yifan Xue, Srimukh Prasad Veccham, Saee Paliwal, Tyler Shimko, Micha Livne
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种结合化学特定自监督与对比互信息机器学习的分子图变换器预训练框架，用于准确预测ADME属性。

背景: 准确预测吸收、分布、代谢和排泄属性对药物发现至关重要，但由于这些终点噪声大、相互依赖且数据有限，仍具有挑战性。

目的: 开发一种新的预训练框架，以改进ADME属性的预测性能。

方法: 提出分子图变换器预训练框架，将分子图编码为潜在变量，从图派生的潜在代码重建SMILES字符串，并通过领域特定的自监督化学任务增强对比目标。将重建、对比判别和化学特定监督公式化为单个概率潜在变量目标中的单位加权对数概率因子。微调时采用多任务图神经网络读出架构，具有特定任务的多层感知器头。

主要发现: 在Biogen、ExpansionRX和ChEMBL-MT数据集上，对比KERMT预训练分别比KERMT基线提高了百分之七点六、百分之九点九和百分之九点五。将ADME邻近分子添加到预训练语料库中进一步提高了迁移能力，对比组件使化学上有意义的潜在邻域更加清晰。

结论: 该框架有效提高了ADME属性预测的准确性，并改善了模型对异构、非线性任务关系的建模能力。

翻译: 准确预测吸收、分布、代谢和排泄属性对药物发现至关重要，但由于这些终点噪声大、相互依赖且数据有限，仍具有挑战性。我们提出了一种结合化学特定自监督与对比互信息机器学习的分子图变换器预训练框架。我们的方法将分子图编码为潜在变量，从图派生的潜在代码重建SMILES字符串，并通过领域特定的自监督化学任务增强对比目标。而不是将这些任务作为单独调整损失权重的辅助正则化器，我们将重建、对比判别和化学特定监督公式化为单个概率潜在变量目标中的单位加权对数概率因子。对于微调，我们提出了一种具有特定任务多层感知器头的多任务图神经网络读出架构，在保留共享表示学习的同时减轻负迁移并改善对异构、非线性任务关系的建模。在Biogen、ExpansionRX和ChEMBL-MT上，结果对比KERMT预训练分别比KERMT基线提高了百分之七点六、百分之九点九和百分之九点五。将ADME邻近分子添加到预训练语料库中进一步提高了迁移能力，对比组件使化学上有意义的潜在邻域更加清晰。

Abstract

Accurate prediction of absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) properties is critical to drug discovery, but remains challenging because ADME endpoints are noisy, interdependent, and often data-limited. We propose a molecular graph-transformer pretraining framework that combines chemistry-specific self-supervision with contrastive mutual information machine learning (cMIM). Our method encodes molecular graphs into latent variables, reconstructs SMILES strings from the graph-derived latent codes, and augments the contrastive objective with domain-specific self-supervised chemistry tasks. Rather than treating these tasks as auxiliary regularizers with separately tuned loss weights, we formulate reconstruction, contrastive discrimination, and chemistry-specific supervision as unit-weighted log-probability factors in a single probabilistic latent-variable objective. For fine-tuning, we propose a multi-task GNN readout architecture with task-specific multilayer perceptron heads, preserving shared representation learning while mitigating negative transfer and improving the modeling of heterogeneous, nonlinear task relationships. Across Biogen, ExpansionRX, and ChEMBL-MT, the resulting Contrastive KERMT pretraining improves over the KERMT baseline by 7.6%, 9.9%, and 9.5% respectively (averaged over significantly-improved endpoints). Adding ADME-adjacent molecules to the pretraining corpus further improves transfer, and the contrastive component sharpens chemically meaningful latent neighborhoods.

item.title: Continuous biome representations from Earth observation embeddings
item.author: Maxwell B. Joseph, Flávia De Souza Mendes, Dieu My T. Nguyen, Camile Sothe, Christopher B. Anderson
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究利用地球观测基础模型生成的卫星图像嵌入，将离散的生物群落地图转化为连续的概率表示，以更好地捕捉生态变异。

背景: 生物群落在空间上连续变化，但生物群落地图施加了类别边界，压缩了这种变化，特别是在生态过渡带。

目的: 探讨地球观测基础模型能否将离散的生物群落地图转化为连续表示，以更好地捕捉生态变异。

方法: 在Clay v1.5卫星图像嵌入上拟合线性分类器以预测生物群落标签，利用softmax输出生成对应于命名生物群落类别的连续概率向量。使用六个巴西生物群落、一百三十万嵌入和一万零一百十五个 withheld 森林清查样地进行评估。

主要发现: 连续的生物群落表示在预测物种出现方面优于离散的生物群落标签。这种改进主要源于概率输出的连续性而非标签重新分配。原始的一千零二十四维嵌入是最强的预测因子，但连续表示恢复了大部分嵌入相对于离散标签的优势。

结论: 这种方法提供了一种概率性的离散地图标签替代方案，在保留其含义的同时编码了离散地图所抑制的分级变异。

翻译: Biotic communities vary continuously across space, yet biome maps impose categorical boundaries that compress this variation, particularly at ecotones where transitional communities are ecologically distinct. Could Earth observation (EO) foundation models, which encode spectral, spatial, and temporal information with dense embeddings, convert discrete biome maps into continuous representations that better capture ecological variation? Here, we fit a linear classifier on Clay v1.5 satellite image embeddings to predict biome labels from a categorical map. The softmax output yields a continuous probability vector whose dimensions correspond to named biome classes. We evaluate this approach using six Brazilian biomes, 1.3 million embeddings, and 10,015 withheld forest inventory plots spanning 4,672 plant species. The continuous biome representation outperforms discrete biome labels for predicting species occurrence (mean per-species AUC 0.618 vs. 0.570 across 10 spatial cross-validation folds). Decomposing this gain shows that continuity in the graded probability output, rather than label reassignment, accounts for the improvement; the pattern holds across all distances from biome boundaries. The raw 1024-dimensional embedding remains the strongest predictor we tested (mean AUC 0.646 vs. 0.618), but the continuous representation recovers most of the embedding's gain over discrete labels. This simple approach provides a probabilistic replacement for categorical map labels, preserving their meaning while encoding graded variation that discrete maps suppress.

Abstract

Biotic communities vary continuously across space, yet biome maps impose categorical boundaries that compress this variation, particularly at ecotones where transitional communities are ecologically distinct. Could Earth observation (EO) foundation models, which encode spectral, spatial, and temporal information with dense embeddings, convert discrete biome maps into continuous representations that better capture ecological variation? Here, we fit a linear classifier on Clay v1.5 satellite image embeddings to predict biome labels from a categorical map. The softmax output yields a continuous probability vector whose dimensions correspond to named biome classes. We evaluate this approach using six Brazilian biomes, 1.3 million embeddings, and 10,015 withheld forest inventory plots spanning 4,672 plant species. The continuous biome representation outperforms discrete biome labels for predicting species occurrence (mean per-species AUC 0.618 vs. 0.570 across 10 spatial cross-validation folds). Decomposing this gain shows that continuity in the graded probability output, rather than label reassignment, accounts for the improvement; the pattern holds across all distances from biome boundaries. The raw 1024-dimensional embedding remains the strongest predictor we tested (mean AUC 0.646 vs. 0.618), but the continuous representation recovers most of the embedding's gain over discrete labels. This simple approach provides a probabilistic replacement for categorical map labels, preserving their meaning while encoding graded variation that discrete maps suppress.

item.title: APEX: A Network-Native Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting and Anomaly Detection for Wireless Edge Operations
item.author: Swadhin Pradhan, Niloo Bahadori, Peiman Amini
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出 APEX，一种专为无线网络遥测数据设计的解码器仅 Transformer 模型，用于预测企业接入点遥测数据，特别是在 DHCP 降级任务中表现优异。

背景: 通用时间序列基础模型在无线网络的突发性、零膨胀且跨协议层耦合的遥测信号上迁移效果不佳。

目的: 评估 APEX 在 DHCP 降级这一代表性网络任务上的性能。

方法: 使用约 4500 个生产无线网络中约 10 万个接入点的时间序列数据（每个接入点 34 个指标，共 10 个通道）对 APEX 进行预训练，提供 APEX-Large（2.69 亿参数，云端）和 APEX-Edge（1050 万参数，边缘端）两个版本。

主要发现: 在 192 步（4 天）的 DHCP 降级基准测试中，APEX-Large 的均方绝对误差比最强的基础模型基线 Toto 降低 18%，比 SARIMA 降低 38%，异常检测 F1 分数为 0.93；APEX-Edge 能在接入点级别的边缘硬件上实现亚秒级、隐私保护的推理。

结论: 网络原生预训练是主动式无线网络运维的实用基础。

翻译: Generic time-series foundation models transfer poorly to wireless network telemetry whose signals are bursty, zero-inflated, and coupled across protocol layers. We present APEX, a network-native, decoder-only transformer for forecasting enterprise AP telemetry, and evaluate it on DHCP degradation as a representative network task. APEX is pre-trained on 10-channel multivariate telemetry from ~4,500 production wireless networks (~100K AP time series, 34 metrics per AP), and is available as APEX-Large (269M, cloud) and APEX-Edge (10.5M, edge). On a 192-step (4-day) DHCP degradation benchmark, APEX-Large reduces MAE by 18% over the strongest foundation-model baseline (Toto) and 38% over SARIMA, with anomaly-detection F1 = 0.93, while APEX-Edge enables sub-second, privacy-preserving inference on AP-class edge hardware. These results suggest network-native pre-training is a practical foundation for proactive wireless operations.

Abstract

Generic time-series foundation models transfer poorly to wireless network telemetry whose signals are bursty, zero-inflated, and coupled across protocol layers. We present APEX, a network-native, decoder-only transformer for forecasting enterprise AP telemetry, and evaluate it on DHCP degradation as a representative network task. APEX is pre-trained on 10-channel multivariate telemetry from ~4,500 production wireless networks (~100K AP time series, 34 metrics per AP), and is available as APEX-Large (269M, cloud) and APEX-Edge (10.5M, edge). On a 192-step (4-day) DHCP degradation benchmark, APEX-Large reduces MAE by 18% over the strongest foundation-model baseline (Toto) and 38% over SARIMA, with anomaly-detection F1 = 0.93, while APEX-Edge enables sub-second, privacy-preserving inference on AP-class edge hardware. These results suggest network-native pre-training is a practical foundation for proactive wireless operations.

item.title: Enhancing Spectral Embedding through Robust and Flexible Knowledge Transfer in Electronic Health Records
item.author: Feiqing Huang, Zongqi Xia, Rong Ma, Tianxi Cai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于谱的无监督表示学习框架，用于从电子健康记录中为罕见病队列的临床概念和患者生成低维嵌入。

背景: 罕见病队列数据具有高维但样本量有限的挑战。

目的: 克服数据高维且样本量有限的挑战，通过引入从更广泛人群提取的知识矩阵，该矩阵与罕见病队列共享部分重叠的子空间。

方法: 放松了潜在数据矩阵与知识矩阵之间严格的单一对齐假设，允许更灵活的结构化共享。引入了一种新颖的两步谱嵌入过程：首先识别并移除知识矩阵中的不相关成分；然后应用基于投影的方法分别恢复共享和异质成分。

主要发现: 模拟研究和真实世界多发性硬化症队列分析表明，所提方法优于现有方法，特别是在共享信号较弱且仅部分对齐的罕见病数据常见挑战性场景中。

结论: 该方法在罕见病数据中能有效处理高维低样本量问题，特别是在共享信号弱且部分对齐的情况下表现优异。

翻译: We propose a spectral-based, unsupervised representation learning framework to derive low-dimensional embeddings for clinical concepts and patients in rare disease cohorts from electronic health records, where data are high-dimensional but sample sizes are limited. To overcome this challenge, we incorporate a knowledge matrix extracted from a broader population that shares a partially overlapping subspace with the rare-disease cohort. Our method departs from existing approaches by relaxing restrictive one-to-one signal-alignment assumptions between the latent data matrix and knowledge matrix, allowing more flexible and realistic forms of structured sharing. We introduce a novel two-step spectral embedding procedure: first, we identify and remove irrelevant components from the knowledge matrix; then, we apply a projection-based method to separately recover shared and heterogeneous components. Simulations and an analysis of a real-world multiple sclerosis cohort show that the proposed method outperforms competing approaches, particularly in challenging scenarios where shared signals are weak and only partially aligned, as is common in rare-disease data.

Abstract

We propose a spectral-based, unsupervised representation learning framework to derive low-dimensional embeddings for clinical concepts and patients in rare disease cohorts from electronic health records, where data are high-dimensional but sample sizes are limited. To overcome this challenge, we incorporate a knowledge matrix extracted from a broader population that shares a partially overlapping subspace with the rare-disease cohort. Our method departs from existing approaches by relaxing restrictive one-to-one signal-alignment assumptions between the latent data matrix and knowledge matrix, allowing more flexible and realistic forms of structured sharing. We introduce a novel two-step spectral embedding procedure: first, we identify and remove irrelevant components from the knowledge matrix; then, we apply a projection-based method to separately recover shared and heterogeneous components. Simulations and an analysis of a real-world multiple sclerosis cohort show that the proposed method outperforms competing approaches, particularly in challenging scenarios where shared signals are weak and only partially aligned, as is common in rare-disease data.

item.title: FreqKD: Frequency-Decoupled Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Infrared Object Detection
item.author: Keval Thaker, Venkatraman Narayanan, Abdalmalek Aburaddaha, Samir A. Rawashdeh
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种频率解耦的知识蒸馏框架FreqKD，用于将大规模RGB基础模型迁移到红外图像。通过观察RGB与红外模态差异的光谱结构，发现低频成分（形状、布局）的跨模态对齐程度高于高频成分（纹理、细边缘）。该方法对低频采用严格的均方误差以保持共享结构信息，对高频采用松弛的对数均方误差以提供边缘引导并容忍纹理差异。在KAIST多光谱行人检测任务上，该方法取得了64.1 mAP50的成绩，相比DINOv2基线提升了2.4个点。

背景: 通过知识蒸馏将大规模RGB基础模型迁移到红外图像面临挑战，主要由于图像形成物理机制的根本差异。

目的: 解决RGB与红外图像模态差异带来的迁移学习挑战，提升红外图像任务的性能。

方法: 提出FreqKD框架，基于频率解耦策略。对低频成分应用严格的均方误差监督以保留共享结构信息；对高频成分应用松弛的对数均方误差（权重为0.1）以提供边缘引导并容忍纹理差异。

主要发现: 1. RGB与红外模态差异的光谱结构显示，特征发散在空间频率上不均匀，低频成分（形状、布局）的跨模态对齐程度高于高频成分（纹理、细边缘）。2. 在500对样本的光谱发散分析中，高频发散平均比低频发散高出2.4倍。3. 在KAIST多光谱行人检测上达到64.1 mAP50，相比DINOv2基线提升2.4个点。4. 学习到的表示具有跨数据集（FLIR ADAS，+2.1 mAP50）、跨任务（MFNet分割，+1.85 mIoU）和跨架构（ResNet-50，+1.0 mAP50）的迁移能力。

结论: FreqKD框架通过频率解耦的知识蒸馏有效提升了RGB到红外图像的迁移学习效果，在多个数据集、任务和架构上均表现出良好的性能提升。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

Transfer learning from large-scale RGB foundation models to infrared (IR) imagery through knowledge distillation (KD) remains challenging due to fundamental differences in image formation physics. We investigate the spectral structure of the RGB--IR modality gap and observe that feature divergence is not uniform across spatial frequencies: low-frequency components (shape, layout) show greater cross-modal alignment than high-frequency components (texture, fine edges), which reflect modality-specific characteristics. Based on this analysis, we propose FreqKD, a frequency-decoupled distillation framework that applies asymmetric supervision adapted to each band's cross-modal consistency. The method employs strict mean squared error (MSE) on the low-frequency band to preserve shared structural information and a relaxed log-MSE loss (weighted at 0.1) on the high-frequency band to provide edge guidance while tolerating texture differences. Spectral divergence analysis on 500 paired samples shows that high-frequency divergence exceeds low-frequency divergence by a factor of 2.4x on average across all analysed transformer layers. On KAIST multispectral pedestrian detection, FreqKD achieves 64.1 mAP50, improving 2.4 points over the DINOv2 baseline. The learned representation transfers across datasets (FLIR ADAS, +2.1 mAP50), tasks (MFNet segmentation, +1.85 mean intersection-over-union), and architectures (ResNet-50, +1.0 mAP50). Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/freq_decoupled_kd-5E5A

item.title: Frozen Foundation-Model Embeddings Discard Small-Lesion Signal in Chest Radiography: Implications for Pre-Deployment Evaluation
item.author: Raajitha Muthyala, Zhenan Yin, Alekhya Jilla, Frank Li, Theo Dapamede, Bardia Khosravi, Mohammadreza Chavoshi, Judy Gichoya, Saptarshi Purkayastha
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究系统量化了冻结的视觉变换器基础模型嵌入在下游胸部X光管线中保留或丢失小尺度低对比度信号的情况。

背景: 冻结的视觉变换器基础模型嵌入越来越多地作为下游胸部X光管线的基底，但其在冻结前向传递过程中小尺度低对比度信号的保留或丢失情况尚未在不同架构、预训练领域和目标之间进行系统量化。

目的: 探究不同冻结视觉变换器模型在胸部X光数据集中小尺度信号的处理情况。

方法: 研究了对五个冻结视觉变换器模型和一个冻结DINO预训练的ResNet-50架构控制组在三个大型胸部X光队列和一个胸部X光检测数据集上的表现。每个模型通过小尺度扰动面板和区域感知边界框分层探针在真实病变上进行评估，比较了三种来自同一前向传递的池化模式：分类令牌、补丁均值和边界框限制的补丁局部。

主要发现: 在扰动面板上，分类令牌嵌入处于机会水平，补丁均值在等模糊和网状细细胞上与分类令牌无异，但在较大方向模糊足迹上有所提升。补丁局部探针从同一前向传递中恢复了接近完美的曲线下面积。在胸部X光检测数据集上，图像级分类显示了类内小与大类之间的差距，而边界框级补丁局部池化恢复了极高的曲线下面积。

结论: 冻结的视觉变换器嵌入在全球聚合步骤中无声地抑制了小尺度信号，但该信号在条件于感兴趣区域时可以从补丁令牌中恢复。

翻译: 本研究系统量化了冻结的视觉变换器基础模型嵌入在下游胸部X光管线中保留或丢失小尺度低对比度信号的情况。冻结的视觉变换器基础模型嵌入越来越多地作为下游胸部X光管线的基底，但其在冻结前向传递过程中小尺度低对比度信号的保留或丢失情况尚未在不同架构、预训练领域和目标之间进行系统量化。研究了对五个冻结视觉变换器模型和一个冻结DINO预训练的ResNet-50架构控制组在三个大型胸部X光队列和一个胸部X光检测数据集上的表现。每个模型通过小尺度扰动面板和区域感知边界框分层探针在真实病变上进行评估，比较了三种来自同一前向传递的池化模式：分类令牌、补丁均值和边界框限制的补丁局部。在扰动面板上，分类令牌嵌入处于机会水平，补丁均值在等模糊和网状细细胞上与分类令牌无异，但在较大方向模糊足迹上有所提升。补丁局部探针从同一前向传递中恢复了接近完美的曲线下面积。在胸部X光检测数据集上，图像级分类显示了类内小与大类之间的差距，而边界框级补丁局部池化恢复了极高的曲线下面积。冻结的视觉变换器嵌入在全球聚合步骤中无声地抑制了小尺度信号，但该信号在条件于感兴趣区域时可以从补丁令牌中恢复。

Abstract

Frozen vision-transformer (ViT) foundation-model embeddings increasingly serve as the substrate for downstream chest-radiography (CXR) pipelines, yet where small-scale, low-contrast signal is retained or lost in the frozen forward pass has not been systematically quantified across architectures, pretraining domains, and objectives. We probed five frozen ViTs (RAD-DINO, DINOv2-B/14, DINOv3 ViT-7B, BiomedCLIP, MedSigLIP) and a frozen DINO-pretrained ResNet-50 architectural control across three large CXR cohorts (NIH-CXR14, MIMIC-CXR, Emory-CXR; aggregate pool n=492,724) and ChestX-Det10 (n=3,543; 1,462 small-lesion bounding boxes across Calcification, Nodule, Mass). Each model was evaluated with a small-scale-perturbation panel and a region-aware bounding-box-stratified probe on real lesions, comparing three pooling modes from the same forward pass: classification token (CLS), patch-mean (mean over all final-layer patch tokens), and bounding-box-restricted patch-local. On the perturbation panel, CLS embeddings sat at the chance floor (area under the ROC curve [AUC] 0.500-0.524); patch-mean was indistinguishable from CLS on iso-blur and reticular-fine cells but rose with CLS on larger directional-blur footprints, while disease AUC on globally decided tasks ranged 0.642-0.913. Patch-local probes recovered AUC ~1.0 from the same forward pass (per-model mean improvement +0.412 to +0.488); the ResNet-50 control reproduced the chance floor. On ChestX-Det10, image-level CLS classification showed within-class small-versus-large stratum gaps up to +0.243 AUC; bounding-box-level patch-local pooling on the same forward pass recovered AUC >= 0.899 on every (model x class) cell. Frozen ViT embeddings silently suppress small-scale signal at the global-aggregation step; the signal is recoverable from patch tokens conditional on a region of interest.

item.title: SARA: A Dual-Stream VAE for High-Fidelity Speech Generation via Integrating Semantic and Acoustic Representations
item.author: Peijie Chen, Wenhao Guan, Weijie Wu, Kaidi Wang, Daiyu Huang, Zhuanling Zha, Junbo Li, Jun Fang, Qingyang Hong, Lin Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SARA的双流变分自编码器，旨在解决零样本文本到语音合成中语音表示的鲁棒性问题。

背景: 当前的语音分词器面临一个根本性的权衡：声学编解码器虽然能保留高保真音频，但缺乏语言约束，导致生成时出现内容错误；而来自自监督学习模型的语义令牌虽然能确保精确的文本对齐，但会丢弃部分声学信息。

目的: 为了弥合上述差距，提出一种能够直接融合冻结的自监督学习语义锚点和专用残差声学编码器的方法，以创建一个高效且紧凑的潜在空间，无需依赖复杂的正则化器。

方法: 提出了SARA，这是一种双流变分自编码器，它直接融合了一个冻结的自监督学习语义锚点和一个专用的残差声学编码器。

主要发现: SARA在重建质量上优于强大的基线模型。在下游零样本文本到语音合成任务中，它产生了高度自然且富有表现力的合成质量，即使在加速推理下也能保持稳健的生成性能，在合成速度和计算成本之间提供了有利的权衡。

结论: SARA有效地缓解了声学保真度与语言约束之间的困境，提供了一种在零样本文本到语音合成中平衡合成质量、速度和计算成本的有效解决方案。

翻译: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) relies on robust speech representations. However, current speech tokenizers face a fundamental trade-off: acoustic codecs preserve high-fidelity audio but lack linguistic constraints, causing content errors during generation, whereas semantic tokens from self-supervised learning (SSL) models ensure precise text alignment but discard some acoustic information. To bridge this gap, we propose SARA, a dual-stream VAE that directly fuses a frozen SSL semantic anchor with a dedicated residual acoustic encoder. This effectively mitigates the dilemma, creating an efficient and compact latent space without relying on complex regularizers. SARA achieves superior reconstruction quality over strong baselines. Furthermore, in downstream zero-shot TTS tasks, it yields highly natural and expressive synthesis quality, and maintains robust generation performance even under accelerated inference, offering a favorable trade-off between synthesis speed and computational cost.

Abstract

Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) relies on robust speech representations. However, current speech tokenizers face a fundamental trade-off: acoustic codecs preserve high-fidelity audio but lack linguistic constraints, causing content errors during generation, whereas semantic tokens from self-supervised learning (SSL) models ensure precise text alignment but discard some acoustic information. To bridge this gap, we propose SARA, a dual-stream VAE that directly fuses a frozen SSL semantic anchor with a dedicated residual acoustic encoder. This effectively mitigates the dilemma, creating an efficient and compact latent space without relying on complex regularizers. SARA achieves superior reconstruction quality over strong baselines. Furthermore, in downstream zero-shot TTS tasks, it yields highly natural and expressive synthesis quality, and maintains robust generation performance even under accelerated inference, offering a favorable trade-off between synthesis speed and computational cost.

item.title: TimeRouter: Efficient and Adaptive Routing of Time-Series Foundation Models
item.author: Kanghui Ning, Yushan Jiang, Kashif Rasul, Anderson Schneider, Yuriy Nevmyvaka, Dongjin Song
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TimeRouter的高效路由框架，用于在基于预训练时间序列基础模型的智能体系统中进行专家选择。该框架通过轻量级的判别式路由、选择性门控和集成回退机制，实现了自适应的专家选择，无需在推理时调用大型语言模型。

背景: 时间序列基础模型正逐渐成为新兴智能体时间序列系统中的预测专家。然而，这些模型具有异构的归纳偏置，且没有单一模型能在所有预测场景中始终占据主导地位，使得专家选择成为一个关键挑战。现有系统通常将这一决策委托给基于大型语言模型的控制器，这导致了巨大的推理开销。

目的: 旨在解决现有系统中因依赖大型语言模型进行专家选择而产生的高推理开销问题，提供一种高效、轻量级的路由框架，以优化预训练时间序列基础模型池中的专家选择过程。

方法: 提出了TimeRouter框架，该框架结合了学习到的路由头、选择性门控和集成回退机制。通过轻量级的判别式路由、选择性门控和集成回退，实现了对预训练时间序列基础模型池的自适应专家选择，避免了在推理阶段调用大型语言模型。

主要发现: TimeRouter在GIFT-EVAL排行榜上取得了最先进的性能，其LB MASE为0.6765。消融研究提供了关于时间序列基础模型路由设计的实证见解，强调了模型池组成和选择性门控的重要性。

结论: TimeRouter作为一个模块化和轻量级的路由层，为未来基于基础模型池构建的智能体时间序列系统提供了有力的支持。

翻译: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly explored as predictive experts within emerging agentic time-series systems. However, TSFMs exhibit heterogeneous inductive biases, and no single model consistently dominates across forecasting regimes, making expert selection a critical challenge. Existing systems often delegate this decision to LLM-based controllers, incurring substantial inference overhead. We present TimeRouter, an efficient routing framework that leverages empirical complementarity across a pool of pretrained TSFMs through lightweight discriminative routing, selective gating, and ensemble fallback. Concretely, TimeRouter combines a learned routing head, a selective gate, and an ensemble fallback, enabling adaptive expert selection without invoking an LLM at inference time. TimeRouter achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GIFT-EVAL leaderboard, with an LB MASE of 0.6765. Beyond benchmark performance, our ablation studies provide empirical insights into TSFM routing design, highlighting the importance of pool composition and selective gating. Taken together, these results position TimeRouter as a modular and lightweight routing layer for future agentic time-series systems built upon foundation-model pools. Our code is available at https://github.com/UConn-DSIS/TimeRouter.

Abstract

Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly explored as predictive experts within emerging agentic time-series systems. However, TSFMs exhibit heterogeneous inductive biases, and no single model consistently dominates across forecasting regimes, making expert selection a critical challenge. Existing systems often delegate this decision to LLM-based controllers, incurring substantial inference overhead. We present TimeRouter, an efficient routing framework that leverages empirical complementarity across a pool of pretrained TSFMs through lightweight discriminative routing, selective gating, and ensemble fallback. Concretely, TimeRouter combines a learned routing head, a selective gate, and an ensemble fallback, enabling adaptive expert selection without invoking an LLM at inference time. TimeRouter achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GIFT-EVAL leaderboard, with an LB MASE of 0.6765. Beyond benchmark performance, our ablation studies provide empirical insights into TSFM routing design, highlighting the importance of pool composition and selective gating. Taken together, these results position TimeRouter as a modular and lightweight routing layer for future agentic time-series systems built upon foundation-model pools.
