这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是结合指令语言学理念与持续指令微调技术，利用双语词典和单语数据提取词汇、语义、语音及上下文等显式语言特征，构建多样化的训练指令，从而在缺乏大规模平行语料的情况下提升低资源语言翻译模型的理解能力。整体实现流程首先通过语言模型提取源句的关键语义词，随后基于这些词生成上下文、语义映射、语音相似及列表分组标签四类指令提示，最后采用持续指令微调范式，让模型按顺序依次学习同一翻译任务的不同指令提示，通过迭代训练优化最终的翻译效果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了基于双语词典特征的指令语言学方法和持续指令微调训练范式。指令语言学通过提取词汇、语义和语音等显式语言特征来设计提示词，引导模型理解低资源语言的复杂关系。持续指令微调则改变了传统单次输入输出的微调模式，让模型对同一翻译目标依次接受多种指令进行迭代学习。相比以往依赖大规模平行语料或单一指令微调的工作，该方法有效降低了对平行数据的依赖，并在低资源语言翻译中实现了性能提升。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种融合语言学特征指令设计与持续迭代微调的新方法，显著提升了低资源语言的翻译质量并降低了对大规模平行语料的依赖。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new potential for translation tasks but often experience performance degradation when handling low-resource languages. To address this limitation, we propose an approach for fine-tuning LLMs on a low-resource language, Kupang Malay. Our approach involves designing a set of instructions by leveraging explicit lexical and semantic features from a bilingual dictionary, and introducing Continual Instruction Tuning (CIT), a training paradigm that enables iterative instruction-based training. Experimental results demonstrate that our model, named Lius, yields notable improvements over standard instruction-tuned models by outperforming 4-6 points, and surpassing both Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and Multilingual LLM models by 10-13 points on several evaluation metrics. These findings highlight the potential of our approach to mitigate the reliance on large-scale parallel data in low-resource language translation.

item.title: MultiToP: Learning to Patch Visual Tokens to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
item.author: Yuansheng Gao, Wenbin Xing, Jiahao Yuan, Kaiwen Zhou, Han Bao, Zonghui Wang, Wenzhi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MultiToP的多模态上下文感知视觉令牌修补框架，旨在通过语言生成前修正不可靠的视觉令牌来减轻视频大语言模型中的幻觉问题。

背景: 视频大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但仍容易产生幻觉，即生成的回答缺乏输入视频的有效支持。

目的: 减轻视频大语言模型中的幻觉问题，提高生成回答与输入视频的一致性。

方法: 提出MultiToP框架，包含一个轻量级的视觉令牌修补器，用于预测令牌级替换分布并动态替换不可靠视觉令牌；引入信息引导的秩校准技术，利用骨干网络导出的答案条件帧级信息线索指导令牌替换；结合真实答案监督与稀疏性正则化，在不修改原始模型的情况下实现局部视觉证据修正。

主要发现: 在Vript-HAL数据集上，MultiToP有效减少了幻觉，在几乎不增加推理开销的情况下，使Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的F1分数提升了百分之五十点六零；同时保留了通用视频理解能力，在ActivityNet-QA数据集上使Video-LLaVA-7B的相对准确率提升了百分之十八点五八。

结论: MultiToP能够有效减轻视频大语言模型的幻觉问题，同时保持其通用视频理解能力，且推理开销极小。

翻译: Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.

Abstract

Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet they remain prone to hallucinations, where generated responses are not faithfully supported by the input video. In this paper, we propose MultiToP, a multimodal-context-aware visual token patching framework that mitigates hallucinations by refining unreliable visual tokens before language generation. MultiToP introduces a lightweight Visual Token Patcher to predict token-level replacement distributions and selectively substitute unreliable visual tokens with a dynamic global patch token. To train the patcher effectively, we further propose information-guided rank calibration, which uses answer-conditioned frame-level information cues derived from the backbone to guide token replacement. Combined with ground-truth answer supervision and sparsity regularization, MultiToP enables localized visual evidence refinement without modifying the original model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MultiToP effectively reduces hallucinations on Vript-HAL with negligible inference overhead, improving the F1 scores of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct by 50.60% over the vanilla model. Meanwhile, MultiToP preserves general video understanding ability, yielding an 18.58% relative accuracy gain on ActivityNet-QA for Video-LLaVA-7B.

item.title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding Can Jailbreak LLMs into Generating Malicious Code
item.author: Zhang, Yitong, Lu, Shiteng, Li, Jia
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文揭示了语法约束解码在提升大语言模型代码生成可靠性时可能带来的安全风险，提出了一种名为CodeSpear的新型越狱攻击方法，并设计了CodeShield安全对齐方案以抵御该攻击。

背景: 大语言模型被广泛用于代码生成，但存在被滥用生成恶意代码的风险。语法约束解码被广泛采用以提高生成代码的语法正确性和可靠性。

目的: 揭示语法约束解码可能成为攻击面这一反直觉风险，并提出一种安全对齐方法以在保持模型安全行为的同时维持其良性效用。

方法: 提出CodeSpear攻击，通过应用良性代码语法约束诱导大语言模型生成恶意代码；提出CodeShield方法，通过在代码模态对齐模型，教导其在语法约束下生成语义无害且结构多样的蜜罐代码，同时保留自然语言拒绝能力。

主要发现: 仅应用良性代码语法约束即可有效越狱大语言模型；CodeSpear在四个基准测试的十个流行大语言模型上表现优于代表性越狱基线，平均攻击成功率提高超过三十个百分点；CodeShield能在CodeSpear攻击下恢复安全性并保留良性效用。

结论: 语法约束解码存在根本性安全风险，其潜在的安全影响需要引起更多关注。

翻译: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLMs into generating malicious code. Our experiments show that simply applying a benign code grammar constraint can effectively jailbreak LLMs. To address this vulnerability, we propose CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that robustly preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints. CodeShield aligns the model in the code modality by teaching it to generate honeypot code under GCD. Such code is semantically harmless, so it does not implement the malicious request, and structurally diverse, so it is difficult to suppress through grammar tightening. At the same time, CodeShield still preserves natural-language refusals when natural language is available. Experiments on 10 popular LLMs across 4 benchmarks show that CodeSpear outperforms representative jailbreak baselines and increases the attack success rate by more than 30 percentage points on average. CodeShield also restores safety under CodeSpear while preserving benign utility. Our findings reveal a fundamental risk of GCD and call for greater attention to its potential security implications.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在启用语法约束解码技术时，大型语言模型的安全防护机制失效并被迫生成恶意代码的问题。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为语法约束解码已被广泛集成于主流代码生成框架中，若其本身成为攻击面，将直接威胁到依赖人工智能进行软件开发的安全性与可靠性。同时，现有安全对齐方法主要依赖自然语言拒绝，无法覆盖纯代码输出场景，填补这一研究空白对保障大模型在实际应用中的安全落地具有关键意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有大模型的安全对齐主要依赖自然语言拒绝，而语法约束解码会强制模型输出代码，导致模型在代码生成时缺乏安全行为指导。基于这一发现，作者设计了通过引入标准代码语法来迫使模型生成恶意代码的攻击方法。在防御设计上，作者借鉴了直接偏好优化技术，但改变了训练偏好对的构建方式，转而让模型学习生成语义无害且结构多样的代码，从而在无法使用自然语言拒绝时仍能保持安全。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该攻击方法的核心思想是利用现有安全机制过度依赖自然语言拒绝回复的缺陷，通过强制使用标准代码语法限制输出，直接屏蔽掉模型的自然语言拒绝能力，从而迫使模型在代码模态下继续生成。整体实现流程为：攻击者向模型输入恶意请求并附带一个普通的代码语法约束，模型在逐词生成时会严格遵循该语法，由于自然语言拒绝语句不符合语法要求被系统过滤，模型只能持续输出符合语法的恶意代码。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种利用语法约束解码机制的新型越狱攻击方法，以及一种针对代码模态的安全对齐防御方法。攻击方法通过引入标准的代码语法规则，直接阻断大语言模型使用自然语言拒绝恶意请求的能力，迫使模型在缺乏安全对齐的代码生成空间中输出恶意代码。防御方法则训练模型在无法使用自然语言拒绝时，生成语义无害且结构多样的替代代码，从而抵御语法规则收紧带来的攻击。与以往需要精心构造对抗性语法规则、提示词工程或模型微调的攻击不同，该工作仅需调用标准的代码语法接口即可生效，首次揭示了现有安全对齐机制在代码生成场景下因过度依赖自然语言拒绝而存在的根本性漏洞。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文揭示了语法约束解码技术可能成为大语言模型的安全漏洞，提出了一种名为CodeSpear的新型越狱攻击方法，并设计了CodeShield防御机制，通过训练模型在代码模态下生成无害的蜜罐代码来有效恢复模型安全性。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLMs into generating malicious code. Our experiments show that simply applying a benign code grammar constraint can effectively jailbreak LLMs. To address this vulnerability, we propose CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that robustly preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints. CodeShield aligns the model in the code modality by teaching it to generate honeypot code under GCD. Such code is semantically harmless, so it does not implement the malicious request, and structurally diverse, so it is difficult to suppress through grammar tightening. At the same time, CodeShield still preserves natural-language refusals when natural language is available. Experiments on 10 popular LLMs across 4 benchmarks show that CodeSpear outperforms representative jailbreak baselines and increases the attack success rate by more than 30 percentage points on average. CodeShield also restores safety under CodeSpear while preserving benign utility. Our findings reveal a fundamental risk of GCD and call for greater attention to its potential security implications.

item.title: Towards Data-free and Training-free Compression for Speech Foundation Models Using Parameter Clustering
item.author: Haoning Xu, Zhaoqing Li, Huimeng Wang, Youjun Chen, Chengxi Deng, Mengzhe Geng, Xunying Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无需数据和训练的语音基础模型压缩方法，通过基于通道的聚类实现模型压缩，并探索了更细粒度的混合稀疏剪枝。

背景: 语音基础模型在应用中面临计算资源消耗大、模型体积庞大等问题，需要高效的压缩方法。

目的: 开发一种无需数据和训练的压缩方法，以提高语音基础模型的效率和实用性。

方法: 使用基于通道的聚类方法，结合k-means算法进行模型压缩，并探索了层级别参数聚类数量的混合稀疏剪枝。

主要发现: 在LibriSpeech数据集上的实验表明，在HuBERT-large模型上，50%剪枝稀疏度下，未经微调的测试集上WER绝对降低27.73%/18.61%，相对降低34.37%/21.91%；微调后WER绝对降低0.19%/0.79%。在Whisper-large-v3模型上，10%剪枝稀疏度下WER绝对降低2.86%/5.02%，相对降低59.21%/55.29%。

结论: 该方法在无需数据和训练的情况下，显著降低了语音基础模型的错误率，同时保持了与未压缩基线相当的模型性能。

翻译: This paper presents a novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means. More fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is also explored. Experiments conducted on the LibriSpeech dataset suggest that when operating with pruning sparsity of 50% on HuBERT-large, consistent WER reductions of 27.73%/18.61% absolute (34.37%/21.91% relative) over the magnitude-based pruning were obtained on the test-clean and test-other subsets before fine-tuning and 0.19%/0.79% absolute (3.36%/4.62% relative) after fine-tuning with only 3 epochs. Similar WER reductions of 2.86%/5.02% absolute (59.21%/55.29% relative) were observed against magnitudebased pruning on Whisper-large-v3 at 10% sparsity, all with no significant WER increase relative to the uncompressed baseline.

Abstract

This paper presents a novel data-free and training-free compression approach for speech foundation models using channelwise clustering via k-means. More fine-grained, mixed sparsity pruning by layer-level varying number of parameter clusters is also explored. Experiments conducted on the LibriSpeech dataset suggest that when operating with pruning sparsity of 50% on HuBERT-large, consistent WER reductions of 27.73%/18.61% absolute (34.37%/21.91% relative) over the magnitude-based pruning were obtained on the test-clean and test-other subsets before fine-tuning and 0.19%/0.79% absolute (3.36%/4.62% relative) after fine-tuning with only 3 epochs. Similar WER reductions of 2.86%/5.02% absolute (59.21%/55.29% relative) were observed against magnitudebased pruning on Whisper-large-v3 at 10% sparsity, all with no significant WER increase relative to the uncompressed baseline.

item.title: SheafStain: Sheaf-Theoretic Schrödinger Bridge for Spatially and Biologically Coherent Virtual Staining
item.author: Hyeongyeol Lim, Hongjun Yoon, Eunjin Jang, Daeky Jeong, Won June Cho, Hwamin Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SheafStain的新方法，用于解决虚拟染色中因分块推理导致的空间不连续性和伪影问题。该方法将病理视觉基础模型的特征重新解释为类似层流的截面，通过结合类标记和块标记，在薛定谔桥框架下实现空间与生物学一致性。实验表明，该方法在多个生物标志物评估中优于现有方法，有效减少了拼接伪影。

背景: 当前虚拟染色方法在癌症诊断和预后中提供了时间和成本效益，但针对吉字节级全切片图像的分块推理无法保持空间连续性，导致与真实图像出现严重不匹配。尽管病理视觉基础模型提供了丰富的表示，但其自注意力机制导致相同物理区域在不同全局上下文下产生不一致的嵌入。

目的: 解决虚拟染色中因分块推理导致的空间不连续性和伪影问题，实现空间与生物学一致的虚拟染色。

方法: 提出SheafStain方法，将病理视觉基础模型的特征重新解释为类似层流的截面。将类标记和块标记整合到薛定谔桥框架中，类标记锚定生物学一致性，块标记形成逐位置空间映射。使用在苏木精和伊红染色与免疫组织化学染色上联合预训练的骨干网络，生成非退化的跨染色茎，使单个视觉基础模型特征空间同时监督输入条件和输出染色对齐。

主要发现: 在HER2、ER、PR和Ki-67标志物上，以256乘256像素进行翻译，并在拼接后的1024乘1024像素输出上进行评估。SheafStain在六个现有方法的对比中展现出有前景的结果，有效缓解了块边界拼接伪影。

结论: SheafStain通过重新解释视觉基础模型特征为类似层流的截面，成功解决了虚拟染色中的空间不连续性问题，为癌症诊断和预后提供了更准确的虚拟染色方法。

翻译: 当前虚拟染色方法在癌症诊断和预后中提供了时间和成本效益，但针对吉字节级全切片图像的分块推理无法保持空间连续性，导致与真实图像出现严重不匹配。尽管病理视觉基础模型提供了丰富的表示，但其自注意力机制导致相同物理区域在不同全局上下文下产生不一致的嵌入。我们将此“上下文污染”形式化并验证为层论问题，其中这些嵌入形成违反粘合公理的预层。为解决此问题，我们提出SheafStain，一种新方法，将视觉基础模型特征重新解释为类似层流的截面，以实现空间和生物学一致的虚拟染色。具体而言，SheafStain将类标记和块标记整合到薛定谔桥框架中作为类似层流的截面。类标记锚定生物学一致性，块标记形成逐位置空间映射。在苏木精和伊红染色与免疫组织化学染色上联合预训练的骨干网络生成非退化的跨染色茎，使单个视觉基础模型特征空间同时监督输入条件和输出染色对齐。与先前仅在孤立256乘256像素块上评估并随机裁剪或调整1024乘1024像素真实图像大小的工作不同，我们以256乘256像素进行翻译，并在拼接后的1024乘1024像素输出上对HER2、ER、PR和Ki-67进行评估。SheafStain在六个现有方法的对比中展现出有前景的结果，同时缓解了块边界拼接伪影。代码即将发布。

Abstract

Current virtual staining approaches offer the potential for time- and cost-efficient biomarker quantification in cancer diagnostics and prognostics. However, patch-wise inference for gigapixel whole slide images (WSIs) fails to maintain spatial continuity, yielding artifacts that cause catastrophic mismatches with ground-truth images. Although pathology Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) offer rich representations, their self-attention causes varying global contexts to produce inconsistent embeddings for the same physical region. We formalize and validate this ``context contamination'' as a sheaf-theoretic problem where these embeddings form a presheaf that violates the gluing axiom. To address this, we propose SheafStain, a new approach that reinterprets VFM features as sheaf-like sections for spatially and biologically coherent virtual staining. Specifically, SheafStain integrates class and patch tokens into a Schrödinger Bridge framework as sheaf-like sections. While the class token anchors biological consistency, patch tokens form a per-position spatial map. A backbone co-pretrained on Hematoxylin \& Eosin (H\&E) and Immunohistochemistry (IHC) yields non-degenerate cross-stain stalks, so a single VFM feature space supervises both input conditioning and output stain alignment. Departing from prior work that evaluates on isolated $256 \times 256$ patches and either random-crops or resizes the $1024 \times 1024$ ground truth, we translate at $256 \times 256$ and evaluate on the stitched $1024 \times 1024$ outputs across HER2, ER, PR, and Ki-67. SheafStain demonstrates promising results against six prior methods while mitigating patch-boundary stitching artifacts. Code will soon be released.

item.title: Fine-tuning Multi-modal LLMs with ART: Art-based Reinforcement Training
item.author: Chudoba, Michal, Alyaev, Sergey, Galuscakova, Petra, Wiktorski, Tomasz
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ART（基于艺术的强化训练）的新方法，用于对大型语言模型进行参数高效微调。该方法通过优化原始视觉输入而非修改模型权重或计算图，实现了在预编译模型上的软提示微调，并在多个基准测试中达到了与LoRA相媲美的准确率。

背景: 大型语言模型主要有两种参数高效微调技术：低秩自适应（LoRA）和软提示（Soft Prompting）。LoRA在模型层之间引入额外权重，而软提示在输入端添加额外的微调专用原始标记。然而，这两种方法都需要修改预编译、预优化大型语言模型的计算图，因此无法在vLLM等高吞吐量引擎中完全支持。

目的: 提出一种能够在不修改预编译计算图的情况下，对大型语言模型进行参数高效微调的方法，以支持高吞吐量引擎并实现软提示技术。

方法: 提出ART（基于艺术的强化训练）方法。该方法通过优化原始视觉输入（即纯像素数组）来向冻结的多模态大型语言模型注入信息，从而在预编译的计算图上实现软标记方法。该方法依赖于将梯度反向传播到纯像素数组中，支持任何微调目标。此外，优化后的视觉输入可以被风格化为与任务相关的计算艺术作品。

主要发现: ART方法在多个文本基准测试中进行了验证，包括数学和结构化工具使用基准。实验结果表明，ART在不同规模的开源Qwen架构上均有效，并在数学和结构化工具使用基准测试中达到了与LoRA相媲美的准确率。

结论: ART方法成功实现了在预编译计算图上的软提示微调，无需修改模型结构或计算图，同时保持了与主流微调方法LoRA相当的准确率，为高吞吐量引擎中的模型微调提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: There are two main Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) introduces additional weights between the LLM layers, Soft Prompting introduces additional fine-tuning-specific raw tokens to an LLM input. However, both require modification to the computational graphs of precompiled, preoptimized LLMs. As a result, neither is fully supported in high-throughput engines like vLLM. We propose fine-tuning with ART (Art-based Reinforcement Training). The method injects information into a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) by optimizing only its raw visual input, thus enabling the soft-token approach on pre-compiled computational graphs. It relies on backpropagation of gradients back into a plain pixel array and thus supports any fine-tuning objective. Moreover, the optimized visual input can be stylized as task-relevant computational artworks. The approach's effectiveness is confirmed for different sizes of a popular open Qwen architecture and for several textual benchmarks. Specifically, ART reaches accuracy competitive with LoRA across mathematics and structured-tool-use benchmarks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有高效微调技术在部署到高性能推理服务引擎时，因需要动态加载权重或注入自定义嵌入向量，导致预编译计算图失效、内存碎片化及推理吞吐量严重下降的工程兼容性问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为实际应用场景通常需要同时服务大量并发用户并切换不同任务，传统方法会大幅增加启动时间与内存开销。本文提出的方法通过仅优化输入图像来冻结模型并适配现有推理管线，从而在保持生产环境高吞吐服务效率的同时实现任务定制。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有高效微调方法在高性能推理引擎中部署困难且需修改底层计算图的问题，提出直接优化输入图像像素的设计思路。该方法借鉴了视觉提示工程、对抗重编程、软提示技术以及基于强化学习的推理优化等现有工作，将视觉通道作为非侵入式接口，通过反向传播将梯度直接回传至原始像素空间，从而在保持模型权重完全冻结的同时实现任务适配。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是冻结多模态大语言模型的参数，仅通过优化输入图像的像素值来引导模型输出特定任务所需的内容，从而避免修改模型权重或破坏现有推理引擎。整体实现采用双阶段迭代流程：首先将连续像素数据转换为标准图片输入模型生成文本，并根据任务结果计算奖励分数；随后将奖励分数转化为损失函数，通过反向传播直接更新像素数据。经过多次迭代训练后，最终将优化好的图片保存为普通图像文件，在实际使用时与文本提示词配合即可。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新在于提出了一种仅通过优化输入图像像素值来适配冻结模型的方法，无需修改模型权重或底层计算图。与传统的权重微调及软提示技术相比，该方法完全避开了对高性能推理引擎的架构修改与动态加载需求，使微调后的模型能像普通多模态请求一样直接部署，同时生成的图像还能作为隐藏任务信息的计算艺术作品。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种通过仅优化输入图像来微调冻结多模态大模型的新方法，该方法无需修改模型权重或计算图即可兼容高性能推理引擎，并在数学与工具使用等任务上达到与传统权重微调方法相当的性能。

Abstract

There are two main Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs). While Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) introduces additional weights between the LLM layers, Soft Prompting introduces additional fine-tuning-specific raw tokens to an LLM input. However, both require modification to the computational graphs of precompiled, preoptimized LLMs. As a result, neither is fully supported in high-throughput engines like vLLM. We propose fine-tuning with ART (Art-based Reinforcement Training). The method injects information into a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) by optimizing only its raw visual input, thus enabling the soft-token approach on pre-compiled computational graphs. It relies on backpropagation of gradients back into a plain pixel array and thus supports any fine-tuning objective. Moreover, the optimized visual input can be stylized as task-relevant computational artworks. The approach's effectiveness is confirmed for different sizes of a popular open Qwen architecture and for several textual benchmarks. Specifically, ART reaches accuracy competitive with LoRA across mathematics and structured-tool-use benchmarks.

item.title: RePAIR: Predictive Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Chess
item.author: Christoph Koller, Johannes Fürnkranz, Timo Bertram
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为RePAIR的新型自监督表示学习架构，该架构融合了掩码自编码器、联合嵌入预测架构和双向编码器表示Transformer的核心思想。

背景: 现有的表示学习方法如掩码自编码器和双向编码器表示Transformer通常通过掩码序列中的部分状态来学习，而联合嵌入预测架构则在低维嵌入空间中修复序列间隙。

目的: 将RePAIR架构应用于如连续国际象棋棋局等顺序数据，以编码对象为紧凑且具有意义的表示。

方法: 该架构的基本原理是掩码掉潜在状态序列中的大部分内容，然后应用一个轻量级预测器在低维嵌入空间中修复序列中的间隙。

主要发现: 在国际象棋领域的实验表明，编码器能够优化棋盘表示，使有意义的国际象棋概念在潜在空间中聚类；模型能够在不依赖昂贵强化学习方法的情况下推理棋子移动；表示空间允许通过观察游戏路径轨迹对国际象棋游戏进行快速直观的剖析。

结论: RePAIR架构能够有效学习顺序数据中的紧凑且语义丰富的表示，为理解和分析复杂顺序数据提供了新的方法。

翻译: In this paper, we introduce Representation Prediction via Autoencoding using Iterative Refinement (RePAIR) - a novel self-supervised representation learning architecture that synthesizes Masked Autoencoders (MAE), Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). We demonstrate how it can be used to encode objects in sequential data like consecutive chess positions into compact yet meaningful representations. The basic principle of the architecture is to mask large portions of a sequence of latent states, similar to BERT and MAE. Then, we apply a lightweight Predictor to the latent representations that repairs gaps in the sequence in a lower-dimensional embedding space akin to JEPA. Our experiments in the domain of chess show that the Encoder refines the board representations such that meaningful chess concepts emerge clustered in the latent space. Furthermore, reconstructions of the masked board states show that the model is able to reason about the piece movements without relying on costly reinforcement learning methods. Lastly, we find that the resulting representation space allows for quick and intuitive dissections of chess games by observing the game path trajectories in this semantically rich space.

Abstract

In this paper, we introduce Representation Prediction via Autoencoding using Iterative Refinement (RePAIR) - a novel self-supervised representation learning architecture that synthesizes Masked Autoencoders (MAE), Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). We demonstrate how it can be used to encode objects in sequential data like consecutive chess positions into compact yet meaningful representations. The basic principle of the architecture is to mask large portions of a sequence of latent states, similar to BERT and MAE. Then, we apply a lightweight Predictor to the latent representations that repairs gaps in the sequence in a lower-dimensional embedding space akin to JEPA. Our experiments in the domain of chess show that the Encoder refines the board representations such that meaningful chess concepts emerge clustered in the latent space. Furthermore, reconstructions of the masked board states show that the model is able to reason about the piece movements without relying on costly reinforcement learning methods. Lastly, we find that the resulting representation space allows for quick and intuitive dissections of chess games by observing the game path trajectories in this semantically rich space.

item.title: Task-Aligned Stability Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving Hazard Detection
item.author: Everett Richards
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶场景理解中应用广泛，但鲁棒性分析常仅依赖任务无关的嵌入稳定性。本文研究由扰动引起的嵌入漂移是否能预测基于CLIP图像文本相似度得出的任务对齐风险分数的变化。通过控制扰动对BDD100K道路场景进行测试，比较嵌入漂移与风险漂移。发现不同扰动类型对嵌入漂移和决策漂移的耦合程度不同，且多数扰动导致漏检，而遮挡引发误报。建议鲁棒性基准测试应包含任务对齐的稳定性指标。

背景: 视觉语言模型在自动驾驶场景理解中应用广泛，但鲁棒性分析常仅依赖任务无关的嵌入稳定性。

目的: 研究由扰动引起的嵌入漂移是否能预测基于CLIP图像文本相似度得出的任务对齐风险分数的变化。

方法: 通过控制扰动对BDD100K道路场景进行测试，比较嵌入漂移与风险漂移。

主要发现: 不同扰动类型对嵌入漂移和决策漂移的耦合程度不同，且多数扰动导致漏检，而遮挡引发误报。

结论: 建议鲁棒性基准测试应包含任务对齐的稳定性指标。

翻译: Vision-language models are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. Furthermore, corruption families differ in failure direction: most suppress hazard detections via false negatives, while occlusion instead triggers false alarms, suggesting that benchmark design should account for asymmetric failure modes, not just overall instability rates. These results suggest that robustness benchmarks should include task-aligned stability measures in addition to embedding-level perturbation statistics.

Abstract

Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for scene understanding in autonomous driving, but robustness analysis often relies on task-agnostic embedding stability alone. We study whether corruption-induced embedding drift predicts changes in a task-aligned hazard score derived from CLIP image-text similarities. Using controlled corruptions on BDD100K road scenes, we compare embedding drift against margin drift, defined as the change in hazard score under perturbation. The relationship is highly corruption-dependent: some families exhibit strong coupling between representation drift and decision drift, while others induce hazardous decision instability despite relatively modest embedding change. Furthermore, corruption families differ in failure direction: most suppress hazard detections via false negatives, while occlusion instead triggers false alarms, suggesting that benchmark design should account for asymmetric failure modes, not just overall instability rates. These results suggest that robustness benchmarks should include task-aligned stability measures in addition to embedding-level perturbation statistics.

item.title: GraspLLM: Towards Zero-Shot Generalization on Text-Attributed Graphs with LLMs
item.author: Hengyi Feng, Zeang Sheng, Meiyi Qiang, Meiyi Qiang, Wentao Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: GraspLLM 是一个结合图结构理解与大语言模型语义理解能力的框架，旨在提升跨数据集和跨任务的泛化能力。

背景: 文本属性图在引用网络、电商平台、社交媒体和网页等现实场景中应用广泛。大语言模型在语义理解方面表现出色，已有研究尝试将其与文本属性图结合。

目的: 解决现有方法在跨不同图和任务时泛化能力不足，以及捕捉可迁移图结构模式能力有限的问题。

方法: 使用冻结的通用嵌入模型将不同图的节点文本映射到统一语义空间；通过 motif 感知的对比学习在多个 motif 诱导的邻接矩阵上提取数据集无关的结构信息；提出最优上下文子图，为每个目标节点提取最相关的子图，并通过对齐投影器将这些子图与大语言模型的词元空间对齐。

主要发现: 在涵盖不同领域的文本属性图基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，GraspLLM 在零样本场景下尤其表现出色，一致优于以往的基于大语言模型的文本属性图方法。

结论: GraspLLM 在不同数据集和任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。

翻译: Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.

Abstract

Research on Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) has gained significant attention recently due to its broad applications across various real-world data scenarios, such as citation networks, e-commerce platforms, social media, and web pages. Inspired by the remarkable semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), there have been numerous attempts to integrate LLMs into TAGs. However, existing methods still struggle to generalize across diverse graphs and tasks, and their ability to capture transferable graph structural patterns remains limited. To address this, we introduce the GraspLLM, a framework that combines Graph structural comprehension with semantic understanding prowess of LLMs to enhance the cross-dataset and cross-task generalizability. Specifically, we represent node texts from different graphs in a unified semantic space with a frozen general embedding model, on top of which we perform motif-aware contrastive learning across multiple motif-induced adjacency matrices to extract dataset-agnostic structural information. Then, with our proposed optimal contextual subgraph, we extract the most contextually relevant subgraph for each target node and align these subgraphs to the token space of LLM via an alignment projector. Extensive experiments on TAG benchmark datasets spanning diverse domains reveal that GraspLLM consistently outperforms previous LLM-based methods for TAGs, especially in zero-shot scenarios, highlighting its strong generalizability across different datasets and tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/Heinz217/GraspLLM.

item.title: From Content to Knowledge: Lightning Fast Long-Video Understanding with Neural Knowledge Representations
item.author: Yuchen Guan, Xiao Li, Zongyu Guo, Xiaoyi Zhang, Xiulian Peng, Chun Yuan, Yan Lu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种将长视频视为神经知识表示的新范式，通过代理知识蒸馏过程将视频语义内容编码为网络权重，实现高效的多轮视频理解。

背景: 长视频理解通常面临处理成本高和效率低的问题，传统方法将视频表示为令牌流或预组织数据库。

目的: 实现长视频的高效理解，解耦视频长度与推理成本，提供高摊销效率的多轮视频理解能力。

方法: 将长视频视为神经知识表示，通过代理知识蒸馏过程自动合成密集描述和问题对，将视频知识蒸馏到网络权重中，推理时将轻量级表示挂载到冻结的视觉语言模型上。

主要发现: 在LVBench基准测试中，该方法性能与最先进方法相当，同时将端到端延迟降低两个数量级以上。

结论: 该方法为交互式长视频理解开辟了新可能性。

翻译: We propose a new paradigm for long video understanding by treating a long video as a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR). NKR represents video contents neither as a stream of tokens nor pre-organized databases, but as an individual small portion of network weights attached to the VLM backbone. The NKR weights are optimized to encapsulate the video's semantic content via a novel Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) process, where an agent automatically synthesizes dense descriptions and question-answer pairs to distill the video's knowledge into the NKR. While AKD serves as a comprehensive, one-time encoding phase, the resulting NKR transforms the video into a portable, reusable asset. At inference, the lightweight NKR is mounted onto a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling direct, query-based understanding without reloading or re-encoding the original video. This approach decouples video length from inference cost, offering high amortized efficiency for multi-turn video understanding. Experiments on the LVBench benchmark show our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches while reducing end-to-end latency by over two orders of magnitude, opening new possibilities for interactive long-video understanding.

Abstract

We propose a new paradigm for long video understanding by treating a long video as a Neural Knowledge Representation (NKR). NKR represents video contents neither as a stream of tokens nor pre-organized databases, but as an individual small portion of network weights attached to the VLM backbone. The NKR weights are optimized to encapsulate the video's semantic content via a novel Agentic Knowledge Distillation (AKD) process, where an agent automatically synthesizes dense descriptions and question-answer pairs to distill the video's knowledge into the NKR. While AKD serves as a comprehensive, one-time encoding phase, the resulting NKR transforms the video into a portable, reusable asset. At inference, the lightweight NKR is mounted onto a frozen Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling direct, query-based understanding without reloading or re-encoding the original video. This approach decouples video length from inference cost, offering high amortized efficiency for multi-turn video understanding. Experiments on the LVBench benchmark show our method achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art approaches while reducing end-to-end latency by over two orders of magnitude, opening new possibilities for interactive long-video understanding.

item.title: Lung-SRAD: Spectral-Aware Regularized Audio DASS with Dual-Axis Patch-Mix Contrastive Learning for Respiratory Sound Classification
item.author: Hemansh Shridhar, Miika Toikkanen, June-Woo Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了状态空间模型作为呼吸音分类任务替代主干网络的有效性，通过引入频谱感知层正则化和双轴补丁混合对比学习，在ICBHI基准测试中取得了优于传统音频频谱变换器基线模型的性能。

背景: 现有的呼吸音分类研究主要依赖基于CLS令牌驱动的自注意力架构如音频频谱变换器，虽然能有效建模全局上下文，但可能因低通滤波行为而降低对局部异常模式的敏感性。

目的: investigate State Space Models as an alternative backbone for RSC.（探讨状态空间模型作为呼吸音分类任务的替代主干网络）

方法: 使用蒸馏音频状态空间模型，通过频谱响应曲线分析中间表示；引入应用于选定层的基于高斯卷积的频谱感知层正则化；提出针对基于状态空间模型的音频模型的双轴补丁混合对比学习。

主要发现: 状态空间模型在中间表示中表现出更强的中高频空间分量保留能力；在ICBHI基准测试中，该方法取得了百分之六十四点四八的得分，比音频频谱变换器基线模型高出百分之五。

结论: 状态空间模型及其相关正则化和对比学习方法在呼吸音分类任务中表现出优越性，能够有效保留高频信息并提升分类性能。

翻译: Recent respiratory sound classification studies largely rely on CLS-token driven self-attention architectures such as the Audio Spectrogram Transformer. While effective at modeling global context, recent analyses suggest a low-pass filtering behavior that may reduce sensitivity to localized abnormal patterns. In this work, we investigate State Space Models as an alternative backbone for RSC. Using the Distilled Audio State Space model, we analyze intermediate representations through spectral response curves and observe stronger preservation of mid-to-high spatial-frequency components. Based on these observations, we introduce spectral-aware layer regularization using Gaussian convolution applied to selected layers. We further propose Dual-Axis Patch-Mix contrastive learning tailored to SSM-based audio models for robust representation learning. Experiments on the ICBHI benchmark show that our approach achieves 64.48% score, outperforming the AST baseline by 5%. Code is available at https://github.com/RSC-Toolkit/Lung-SRAD.

Abstract

Recent respiratory sound classification (RSC) studies largely rely on CLS-token driven self-attention architectures such as the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST). While effective at modeling global context, recent analyses suggest a low-pass filtering behavior that may reduce sensitivity to localized abnormal patterns. In this work, we investigate State Space Models (SSMs) as an alternative backbone for RSC. Using the Distilled Audio State Space model, we analyze intermediate representations through spectral response curves and observe stronger preservation of mid-to-high spatial-frequency components. Based on these observations, we introduce spectral-aware layer regularization using Gaussian convolution applied to selected layers. We further propose Dual-Axis Patch-Mix contrastive learning tailored to SSM-based audio models for robust representation learning. Experiments on the ICBHI benchmark show that our approach achieves 64.48% score, outperforming the AST baseline by 5%. Code is available at https://github.com/RSC-Toolkit/Lung-SRAD.

item.title: Toward Generalist Autonomous Research via Hypothesis-Tree Refinement
item.author: Jin, Jiajie, Hu, Yuyang, Qiu, Kai, Dai, Qi, Luo, Chong, Dong, Guanting, Li, Xiaoxi, Zhao, Tong, Ma, Xiaolong, Zhang, Gongrui, Wu, Zhirong, Liu, Bei, Yang, Zhengyuan, Li, Linjie, Wang, Lijuan, Qian, Hongjin, Zhu, Yutao, Dou, Zhicheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Arbor是一个用于自主研究的通用框架，通过长期协调者、短期执行者和假设树精炼机制，实现研究过程的累积性推进。

背景: 科学进步依赖于探索、实验和抽象的重复循环，研究人员测试候选方向、解释证据并将经验教训带入后续尝试。

目的: 研究AI代理如何在长周期内自主运行这一研究循环。

方法: 引入Arbor框架，结合长期协调者管理全局研究策略，短期执行者在隔离工作区实现和测试假设，以及假设树精炼机制链接跨时间的假设、产物、证据和提炼见解。

主要发现: 在六个真实研究任务中，Arbor在所有任务上均取得最佳保留外结果，其平均相对保留外增益是Codex和Claude Code的两倍多；在MLE-Bench Lite上，使用GPT-5.5达到86.36%的Any Medal率，为对比中最强结果。

结论: Arbor将自主研究从局部尝试序列转变为策略、执行和证据跨时间累积的过程。

翻译: Scientific progress depends on a repeated loop of exploration, experimentation, and abstraction. Researchers test candidate directions, interpret the evidence, and carry the resulting lessons into later attempts. We study how an AI agent can run this loop autonomously over long horizons. We introduce Arbor, a general framework for autonomous research that combines a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR), a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time. The coordinator manages global research strategy over the tree, while executors implement and test individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees. As results return, Arbor updates the tree, propagates reusable lessons, refines the search frontier, and admits verified improvements. This design turns autonomous research from a sequence of local attempts into a cumulative process in which strategy, execution, and evidence are carried across time. We evaluate Arbor under Autonomous Optimization (AO), an operational setting where an agent improves an initial research artifact through iterative experimentation without step-level human supervision. Across six real research tasks in model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis, Arbor achieves the best held-out result on all six tasks, attaining more than 2.5x the average relative held-out gain of Codex and Claude Code under the same task interface and resource budget. On MLE-Bench Lite, Arbor reaches 86.36% Any Medal with GPT-5.5, the strongest result in our comparison.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何让人工智能代理在长时间跨度内自主开展科学研究的问题，核心是构建一种能持续记录假设、实验、证据与经验的机制，将零散的局部尝试转化为累积性的研究进展。该问题之所以重要，是因为科学进步本质上依赖于反复的探索、实验与经验总结，而现有AI系统往往只能执行短期任务或孤立尝试，难以在漫长且充满不确定性的研究过程中有效整合历史反馈并指导后续探索，严重制约了自动化科学发现与优化的实际效能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于科学研究中探索、实验与抽象的循环过程，针对现有智能体缺乏长期累积研究状态的问题，设计了该框架。该方法将系统分为长期运行的全局协调器和短期执行的独立实验器，并通过假设树将研究设想、代码版本、实验证据与提炼的经验持久化关联，实现策略与证据的跨时间累积。在设计过程中，作者广泛借鉴了自动科研系统、长周期智能体及外部状态管理技术，并针对现有方法在证据保留、开发测试分离和盲目优化指标等方面的不足进行了针对性改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过构建持久的假设树，将离散的局部实验转化为累积式研究过程，使假设、代码版本、实验证据与提炼的经验在时间轴上持续关联。整体流程采用双层架构：长期协调者负责维护全局研究状态并制定探索策略，短期执行者在隔离环境中独立验证具体假设并返回结构化结果。随着实验反馈不断返回，系统会动态更新假设树、向上传递可复用经验、修剪或扩展探索方向，并在独立验证集上确认性能提升后更新最优成果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了自主研究框架与假设树精炼机制，将分散的实验尝试转化为长期累积的研究过程。相比以往系统多依赖固定流程或孤立执行，该框架通过持久化的树状结构将研究假设、代码版本、实验证据与提炼洞察紧密绑定。同时采用长期全局协调器与短期隔离执行器分离的架构，使系统能够显式管理竞争方向、传播可复用经验，并在严格区分探索反馈与最终验证的基础上实现可审计的迭代优化。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文定义了自主优化任务，提出了名为Arbor的通用研究框架，通过假设树精炼机制将长期策略规划与短期实验执行相结合，实现了累积式自主研究，并在多项真实科研任务中取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。

Abstract

Scientific progress depends on a repeated loop of exploration, experimentation, and abstraction. Researchers test candidate directions, interpret the evidence, and carry the resulting lessons into later attempts. We study how an AI agent can run this loop autonomously over long horizons. We introduce Arbor, a general framework for autonomous research that combines a long-lived coordinator, short-lived executors, and Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR), a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time. The coordinator manages global research strategy over the tree, while executors implement and test individual hypotheses in isolated worktrees. As results return, Arbor updates the tree, propagates reusable lessons, refines the search frontier, and admits verified improvements. This design turns autonomous research from a sequence of local attempts into a cumulative process in which strategy, execution, and evidence are carried across time. We evaluate Arbor under Autonomous Optimization (AO), an operational setting where an agent improves an initial research artifact through iterative experimentation without step-level human supervision. Across six real research tasks in model training, harness engineering, and data synthesis, Arbor achieves the best held-out result on all six tasks, attaining more than 2.5x the average relative held-out gain of Codex and Claude Code under the same task interface and resource budget. On MLE-Bench Lite, Arbor reaches 86.36% Any Medal with GPT-5.5, the strongest result in our comparison.

item.title: Frozen Multimodal Embeddings for Personality and Cognitive Ability Assessment in Asynchronous Video Interviews
item.author: Kuo-En Hung, Hung-Yue Suen, Shih-Ching Yeh, Hsiang-Wen Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对异步视频面试中预测心理特质的多模态学习难题，提出了一种基于小样本表示学习的解决方案，通过冻结多模态编码器并结合下游模型，在ACM多媒体AVI挑战赛中取得了优于基线的性能。

背景: 从异步视频面试中预测心理特质是一个具有挑战性的多模态学习任务，因为标注数据集有限，而每个回答包含高维度的视觉、声音和语言信号。

目的: 解决ACM多媒体AVI挑战赛的预测心理特质问题，具体包括两个任务：从与人格相关的面试回答中预测自我报告的HEXACO人格特质，以及从结构化的异步视频面试回答中分类认知能力水平。

方法: 将问题视为小样本表示学习任务，不使用大型预训练模型的微调，而是采用冻结的多模态编码器（包括用于视觉特征的CLIP、用于声音特征和转录的Whisper，以及用于文本表示的RoBERTa、E5和DeBERTaV3），随后连接低容量的下游模型。对于人格特质预测，采用特定于特质的回归和晚期融合系统；对于认知能力分类，采用多模态集成方法。

主要发现: 在人格特质预测任务中，特定于特质的晚期融合系统实现了平均验证均方误差为0.2696，相比官方基线0.3334有显著提升，相对均方误差减少了19.1%。在认知能力分类任务中，多模态集成方法的准确率为0.5313，高于官方基线0.4062，但低于简单的主体-属性基线0.5781。

结论: 基于异步视频面试的心理评估受益于特定于特质的多模态建模，但认知能力预测需要仔细控制数据集中的捷径问题。

翻译: Predicting psychological traits from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) is a challenging multimodal learning problem because labeled datasets are limited while each response contains high-dimensional visual, acoustic, and verbal signals. This paper presents our solution for the ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026, which evaluates two tasks: Track~1 predicts self-reported HEXACO personality traits from personality-related interview responses, and Track~2 classifies cognitive ability levels from structured AVI responses. We treat the problem as a small-sample representation learning task. Instead of fine-tuning large pretrained models, we use frozen multimodal encoders, including CLIP for visual features, Whisper for acoustic features and transcripts, and RoBERTa, E5, and DeBERTaV3 for textual representations, followed by low-capacity downstream models. For Track~1, our trait-specific regression and late-fusion system achieves an average validation MSE of 0.2696, improving over the official baseline of 0.3334. Ablation results show a three-step improvement from a global model (0.3189), to per-trait modeling (0.2871), to per-trait late fusion (0.2696), corresponding to a 19.1% relative MSE reduction over the official baseline. For Track~2, a compact subject-attribute baseline reaches 0.5781 accuracy, while our multimodal ensemble reaches 0.5313, both above the official baseline of 0.4062. We interpret this result as evidence of possible subject-attribute shortcuts in the validation split rather than robust cognitive inference from AVI content. Overall, our findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.

Abstract

Predicting psychological traits from asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) is a challenging multimodal learning problem because labeled datasets are limited while each response contains high-dimensional visual, acoustic, and verbal signals. This paper presents our solution for the ACM Multimedia AVI Challenge 2026, which evaluates two tasks: Track~1 predicts self-reported HEXACO personality traits from personality-related interview responses, and Track~2 classifies cognitive ability levels from structured AVI responses. We treat the problem as a small-sample representation learning task. Instead of fine-tuning large pretrained models, we use frozen multimodal encoders, including CLIP for visual features, Whisper for acoustic features and transcripts, and RoBERTa, E5, and DeBERTaV3 for textual representations, followed by low-capacity downstream models. For Track~1, our trait-specific regression and late-fusion system achieves an average validation MSE of 0.2696, improving over the official baseline of 0.3334. Ablation results show a three-step improvement from a global model (0.3189), to per-trait modeling (0.2871), to per-trait late fusion (0.2696), corresponding to a 19.1\% relative MSE reduction over the official baseline. For Track~2, a compact subject-attribute baseline reaches 0.5781 accuracy, while our multimodal ensemble reaches 0.5313, both above the official baseline of 0.4062. We interpret this result as evidence of possible subject-attribute shortcuts in the validation split rather than robust cognitive inference from AVI content. Overall, our findings suggest that AVI-based psychological assessment benefits from trait-specific multimodal modeling, but cognitive ability prediction requires careful control of dataset shortcuts.

item.title: Feature extraction for plant growth estimation
item.author: Simbarashe Aldrin Ngorima, Albert Helberg, Marelie H. Davel
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出两种用于植物生长阶段估计的特征提取方法，即基于Gabor滤波器与形态学操作的手工特征提取方法，以及基于预训练卷积神经网络和迁移学习的方法。在室内条件下采集的油菜和萝卜数据集上进行了测试，并与支持向量机和提升树分类器结合。结果表明，两种方法均适用于实时应用，且卷积神经网络特征在速度和准确性上均优于手工特征。最佳系统（VGG-19特征配合径向基函数支持向量机）对两个物种的准确率达到百分之九十八点四，处理单张图像耗时零点零八秒。

背景: 精准农业需要实时估计植物生长阶段，以便按需供应资源，减少浪费。然而，处于不同生长阶段的植物具有相似的形态特征，这使得自主生长阶段估计变得困难。

目的: 提出并评估两种用于植物生长阶段估计的特征提取方法，以解决因形态相似性导致的估计难题，并实现实时、高效的资源管理。

方法: 提出两种特征提取方法：一是使用Gabor滤波器组结合形态学操作的手工特征提取方法；二是使用预训练卷积神经网络结合迁移学习的方法。在公开的室内条件下采集的油菜和萝卜植物生长阶段数据集上进行测试，并使用支持向量机和提升树作为分类器进行比较。

主要发现: 两种提出的特征提取方法都适合实时应用。卷积神经网络提取的特征在速度和准确性方面均优于手工设计的特征。最佳系统（使用VGG-19特征和径向基函数支持向量机分类器）对两个物种的准确率达到百分之九十八点四，处理一张图像仅需零点零八秒。

结论: 基于预训练卷积神经网络和迁移学习的方法在植物生长阶段估计任务中表现最佳，兼具高精度和快速处理能力，适用于精准农业中的实时应用。

翻译: Precision agriculture requires the estimation of plant growth stages in real-time. When the plant growth stage is known, the wastage of resources in cultivation, such as nutrients and water, is reduced as only the required resources need to be supplied. Plants at different growth stages, however, have similar morphological features, which can make autonomous growth stage estimation difficult. This paper presents two feature extraction methods for growth stage estimation: one that uses a bank of Gabor filters and morphological operations, and the other that uses pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning. We test these methods on a publicly available plant growth stage dataset (``bccr-segset``) for two species, canola and radish, grown and captured under indoor conditions. The two proposed feature extraction methods are compared, using support vector machines and boosted trees as classifiers. We find that both methods are suitable for real-time applications, and that CNN features outperform the hand-crafted features, both with regard to speed and accuracy. The best system (VGG-19 features, classified with a radial basis function support vector machine) obtained an accuracy of 98.4% for both species, processing an image in 0.08 seconds.

Abstract

Precision agriculture requires the estimation of plant growth stages in real-time. When the plant growth stage is known, the wastage of resources in cultivation, such as nutrients and water, is reduced as only the required resources need to be supplied. Plants at different growth stages, however, have similar morphological features, which can make autonomous growth stage estimation difficult. This paper presents two feature extraction methods for growth stage estimation: one that uses a bank of Gabor filters and morphological operations, and the other that uses pre-trained convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning. We test these methods on a publicly available plant growth stage dataset (``bccr-segset``) for two species, canola and radish, grown and captured under indoor conditions. The two proposed feature extraction methods are compared, using support vector machines and boosted trees as classifiers. We find that both methods are suitable for real-time applications, and that CNN features outperform the hand-crafted features, both with regard to speed and accuracy. The best system (VGG-19 features, classified with a radial basis function support vector machine) obtained an accuracy of 98.4% for both species, processing an image in 0.08 seconds.

item.title: From Nominal Intensity to Equivalent Rainfall: A Path-Based Credibility Evaluation Framework for Simulated Rainfall in Autonomous-Driving Perception Tests
item.author: Tian Xia, Xin Zhao, Shaolingfeng Ye, Junyi Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于路径的模拟降雨可信度评估方法，用于自动驾驶感知测试。该方法通过结合真实降雨的液滴尺寸和速度联合分布作为参考，利用路径等效降雨强度、不确定度带和路径平均雨滴分布真实性评分来表征候选路径，并进一步利用激光雷达目标点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正，以量化模拟降雨路径对真实降雨感知效应的代理能力。实验验证了该方法在识别优选路径和支持自动驾驶降雨感知测试条件描述与解释方面的有效性。

背景: 可信的模拟降雨条件对于识别感知系统边界和支持面向安全预期功能的自动驾驶风险评估至关重要。然而，封闭场地测试通常仅由名义降雨强度或单点测量描述，使得模拟降雨场与真实降雨难以对齐，测试结果也难以映射到现实场景。

目的: 提出一种基于路径的模拟降雨可信度评估方法，以解决模拟降雨场与真实降雨对齐困难及测试结果映射现实场景的问题，支持自动驾驶感知测试的路径选择、条件描述和可信解释。

方法: 使用真实降雨的液滴尺寸和速度联合分布作为参考，将每个候选路径表示为路径等效降雨强度、不确定度带和路径平均雨滴分布真实性评分。利用激光雷达目标点云计数和平均反射率进行感知一致性校正，量化模拟降雨路径对真实降雨感知效应的代理能力。实验使用了约一万份真实降雨雨滴谱样本、七百二十八份RainSense感知样本以及四点二米乘七点二米模拟降雨区域内的四十五个空间采样点。

主要发现: 在相同名义条件下，空间非均匀性仍然存在，证实了基于路径评估的必要性。该方法识别出路径四和路径六为优选候选路径，其路径等效降雨强度分别为十一点五四加减零点三一毫米每小时和八点二八加减零点三四毫米每小时，雨滴分布真实性评分分别为零点四三和零点四六。这些路径在降雨强度稳定性、雨滴谱真实性和感知一致性方面表现出更平衡的性能。

结论: 所提出的方法支持自动驾驶降雨感知测试的路径选择、条件描述和可信解释。

翻译: Credible simulated-rainfall conditions are essential for identifying perception-system boundaries and supporting SOTIF-oriented risk assessment in automated driving. However, closed-field tests are often described only by nominal rainfall intensity or single-point measurements, making it difficult to align simulated rain fields with real rainfall and map test results to real-world scenarios. This paper proposes a path-based credibility evaluation method for simulated rainfall in autonomous-driving perception tests. Using the drop size and velocity joint distribution of real rainfall as the reference, each candidate path is represented by path-equivalent rainfall intensity, an uncertainty band, and a path-averaged Realism of Raindrop Distribution (RRD) score. Lidar target point-cloud count and mean reflectivity are further used for perception-consistency correction, quantifying the proxy capability of each simulated-rainfall path for real-rainfall perception effects. Experiments are conducted using about 10,000 real-rainfall raindrop-spectrum samples, 728 RainSense perception samples, and 45 spatial sampling points in a 2.4 m x 7.2 m simulated-rainfall area. Results show that spatial non-uniformity remains under the same nominal condition, confirming the need for path-based evaluation. The method identifies Path IV and Path VI as preferable candidates, with results of 11.54 +/- 0.31 mm/h, RRD = 0.43, and 8.28 +/- 0.34 mm/h, RRD = 0.46, respectively. These paths show more balanced performance in rainfall-intensity stability, raindrop-spectrum realism, and perception consistency. The proposed method supports path selection, condition description, and credible interpretation of autonomous-driving perception tests under rainfall.

Abstract

However, closed-field tests are often described only by nominal rainfall intensity or single-point measurements, making it difficult to align simulated rain fields with real rainfall and map test results to real-world scenarios. This paper proposes a path-based credibility evaluation method for simulated rainfall in autonomous-driving perception tests. Using the drop size and velocity joint distribution of real rainfall as the reference, each candidate path is represented by path-equivalent rainfall intensity, an uncertainty band, and a path-averaged Realism of Raindrop Distribution (RRD) score. Lidar target point-cloud count and mean reflectivity are further used for perception-consistency correction, quantifying the proxy capability of each simulated-rainfall path for real-rainfall perception effects. Experiments are conducted using about 10,000 real-rainfall raindrop-spectrum samples, 728 RainSense perception samples, and 45 spatial sampling points in a 2.4 m x 7.2 m simulated-rainfall area. Results show that spatial non-uniformity remains under the same nominal condition, confirming the need for path-based evaluation. The method identifies Path IV and Path VI as preferable candidates, with results of 11.54 +/- 0.31 mm/h, RRD = 0.43, and 8.28 +/- 0.34 mm/h, RRD = 0.46, respectively. These paths show more balanced performance in rainfall-intensity stability, raindrop-spectrum realism, and perception consistency. The proposed method supports path selection, condition description, and credible interpretation of autonomous-driving perception tests under rainfall.

item.title: Time-Series Foundation Model Embeddings for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
item.author: Amir El-Ghoussani, Michele De Vita, Ronald Naumann, Valiseios Belagiannis
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于冻结预训练时间序列基础模型和小型回归头的轻量级学习方法，用于从多变量传感器流中预测剩余使用寿命。

背景: 剩余使用寿命预测对工业预测性维护至关重要，但许多基于学习的方法依赖大量的特征工程或大型标注数据集来训练特定任务的序列模型。

目的: 开发一种轻量级的学习方法，利用冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型结合小型回归头，以从多变量传感器流中估计剩余使用寿命。

方法: 使用Chronos-2作为冻结骨干网络提取上下文窗口特征，并训练一个轻量级回归神经网络进行剩余使用寿命预测。

主要发现: 在两个设备类型的真实工业传感器数据上的实验表明，Chronos-2特征在相同的预处理和评估协议下， consistently 优于循环神经网络、卷积神经网络、基于Transformer的模型和梯度提升基线。上下文长度分析显示，随着历史数据的增加，性能显著提升。

结论: 时间序列基础模型表示为工业环境中的剩余使用寿命估计提供了一种实用且数据高效的替代方案。

翻译: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction is essential for industrial predictive maintenance, yet many learning-based approaches rely on extensive feature engineering or large labeled datasets to train task-specific sequence models. In this work, we introduce a lightweight learning approach, in which we leverage a frozen pretrained time-series foundation model (TSFM) and combine it with a small regression head for RUL estimation from multivariate sensor streams. More specifically, we use Chronos-2 as a frozen backbone to extract context window features and train a lightweight regression neural network for RUL prediction. Experiments on real-world industrial sensor data from two device types show that Chronos-2 features consistently improve over recurrent, convolutional, Transformer-based, and gradient-boosting baselines under the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol. We further analyze the impact of context length and find that performance improves significantly with longer histories, indicating that TSFM representation offer a practical and data-efficient alternative for RUL estimation in industrial settings.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何利用工业设备的多变量传感器数据准确预测其剩余使用寿命的问题。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为准确预测设备故障时间能够提前规划维护干预，从而大幅减少意外停机时间和相关成本。传统方法通常依赖繁琐的特征工程或大量标注数据，而本文提出的方法通过冻结预训练的时间序列基础模型提取特征，提供了一种高效且数据友好的替代方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统预测性维护方法依赖大量标注数据和繁琐特征工程的问题，提出利用预训练时间序列基础模型提取丰富的时序上下文特征。在设计上，作者将剩余使用寿命预测转化为监督回归任务，直接冻结并借用现成的预训练模型作为特征提取骨干，仅在其上方训练一个轻量级的多层神经网络回归头。该方法明确借鉴了预训练时间序列基础模型的能力，同时参考了传统循环神经网络和注意力机制模型在训练成本与泛化性上的局限性，通过固定主干网络实现高效适配。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型作为固定特征提取器，直接从多变量传感器历史数据中提取丰富的时序上下文特征，并在此基础上连接一个轻量级的可训练回归网络来预测设备剩余使用寿命，从而避免繁琐的特征工程和大规模从头训练。整体流程首先对原始传感器数据进行时间对齐、异常值裁剪和标准化处理并生成标签，接着将历史数据窗口输入冻结的基础模型获取高维特征表示，最后仅训练顶部的轻量级多层感知机回归头，将特征映射为最终的剩余寿命预测值。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将预训练的时间序列基础模型作为固定特征提取器，并仅在其上方训练一个轻量级的多层感知机回归头来预测设备剩余使用寿命。与以往依赖大量标注数据或复杂手工特征的传统方法不同，该方法无需对庞大的基础模型进行微调，仅通过冻结骨干网络即可提取丰富的时序上下文特征。实验表明，该策略在工业传感器数据上显著优于各类传统序列模型，且能充分利用长历史数据，提供了一种数据高效且易于部署的预测性维护新方案。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种利用冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型提取上下文特征，并结合轻量级回归头进行剩余使用寿命预测的轻量级方法，在工业传感器数据上显著优于传统基线模型。

Abstract

Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction is essential for industrial predictive maintenance, yet many learning-based approaches rely on extensive feature engineering or large labeled datasets to train task-specific sequence models. In this work, we introduce a lightweight learning approach, in which we leverage a frozen pretrained time-series foundation model (TSFM) and combine it with a small regression head for RUL estimation from multivariate sensor streams. More specifically, we use Chronos-2 as a frozen backbone to extract context window features and train a lightweight regression neural network for RUL prediction. Experiments on real-world industrial sensor data from two device types show that Chronos-2 features consistently improve over recurrent, convolutional, Transformer-based, and gradient-boosting baselines under the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol. We further analyze the impact of context length and find that performance improves significantly with longer histories, indicating that TSFM representation offer a practical and data-efficient alternative for RUL estimation in industrial settings.

item.title: Tabular Foundation Models for Clinical Survival Analysis via Survival-Aware Adaptation
item.author: Minh-Khoi Pham, Luca Cotugno, Alina Sirbu, Tai Tan Mai, Martin Crane, Marija Bezbradica
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种轻量级适配方法，将表格基础模型应用于临床生存分析，通过在预训练表示之上直接训练生存感知头来建模右删失时间事件结果。

背景: 预测生存时间结果（如死亡率）是临床决策中的基本任务，通常通过生存分析解决。虽然经典统计和深度学习方法已被广泛研究，但它们通常需要特定任务的训练和足够的标记数据。最近的表格基础模型进展为结构化数据提供了通用表示学习的新范式，但其在临床环境中对删失时间事件预测的适用性仍未得到充分探索，因为典型应用仅限于离散分类而非生存分析任务。

目的: 提出一种轻量级适配方法，将表格基础模型应用于临床生存分析，以解决现有方法对特定任务训练和大量标记数据的依赖，并探索表格基础模型在生存分析中的适用性。

方法: 在预训练的表格基础模型表示之上直接训练一个生存感知的多任务逻辑回归头。研究了包括TabPFN、TabDPT和TabICL在内的代表性架构，并使用多任务逻辑回归头对它们进行适配，以建模右删失的时间事件结果。在多个公共生存基准数据集以及两个大型重症监护病房队列（MIMIC-IV和eICU）上评估了该方法。

主要发现: 该迁移学习方法在性能上具有竞争力或优于强大的基线模型。在MIMIC-IV数据集上，TabDPT-FT-MTLR达到了0.856的C指数，相比最佳非基础模型基线（DeepSurv，0.844）相对提高了百分之一点四，相比最佳零样本模型（0.802）提高了百分之六点七。在eICU数据集上，TabICL-FT-MTLR达到了0.797，分别比DeepSurv（0.784）和零样本模型（0.749）提高了百分之一点七和百分之六点四。

结论: 将预训练表格表示与生存感知目标相结合非常重要，表格基础模型为临床生存预测提供了一种实用且有效的替代方案。

翻译: Predicting time-to-event outcomes such as mortality is a fundamental task in clinical decision-making, commonly addressed through survival analysis. While classical statistical and deep learning approaches have been widely studied, they typically require task-specific training and sufficient labeled data. Recent advances in tabular foundation models offer a new paradigm by learning general-purpose representations for structured data. However, their applicability to censored time-to-event prediction in clinical settings remains underexplored, as typical applications are restricted to discrete classification rather than survival analysis tasks. In this work, we propose a lightweight adaptation approach for applying tabular foundation models to clinical survival analysis by directly training a survival-aware head on top of the pretrained representations. We study representative architectures, including TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICL, and adapt them using a multi-task logistic regression (MTLR) head to model right-censored time-to-event outcomes. We evaluate this approach on a diverse set of public survival benchmarks and two large-scale ICU cohorts, MIMIC-IV and eICU. Our results show that this transfer learning approach achieves competitive or superior performance compared to strong baselines. On MIMIC-IV, TabDPT-FT-MTLR reaches a C-index of 0.856, corresponding to a relative improvement of +1.4% over the best non-FM baseline (DeepSurv, 0.844) and +6.7% over the best zero-shot model (0.802). On eICU, TabICL-FT-MTLR achieves 0.797, yielding gains of +1.7% (DeepSurv, 0.784) and +6.4% (0.749), respectively. These findings highlight the importance of combining pretrained tabular representations with survival-aware objectives and suggest that tabular foundation models provide a practical and effective alternative for clinical survival prediction.

Abstract

Predicting time-to-event outcomes such as mortality is a fundamental task in clinical decision-making, commonly addressed through survival analysis. While classical statistical and deep learning approaches have been widely studied, they typically require task-specific training and sufficient labeled data. Recent advances in tabular foundation models offer a new paradigm by learning general-purpose representations for structured data. However, their applicability to censored time-to-event prediction in clinical settings remains underexplored, as typical applications are restricted to discrete classification rather than survival analysis tasks. In this work, we propose a lightweight adaptation approach for applying tabular foundation models to clinical survival analysis by directly training a survival-aware head on top of the pretrained representations. We study representative architectures, including TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICL, and adapt them using a multi-task logistic regression (MTLR) head to model right-censored time-to-event outcomes. We evaluate this approach on a diverse set of public survival benchmarks and two large-scale ICU cohorts, MIMIC-IV and eICU. Our results show that this transfer learning approach achieves competitive or superior performance compared to strong baselines. On MIMIC-IV, TabDPT-FT-MTLR reaches a C-index of 0.856, corresponding to a relative improvement of +1.4% over the best non-FM baseline (DeepSurv, 0.844) and +6.7% over the best zero-shot model (0.802). On eICU, TabICL-FT-MTLR achieves 0.797, yielding gains of +1.7% (DeepSurv, 0.784) and +6.4% (0.749), respectively. These findings highlight the importance of combining pretrained tabular representations with survival-aware objectives and suggest that tabular foundation models provide a practical and effective alternative for clinical survival prediction.

item.title: MODF-SIR: A Multi-agent Omni-modal Distilled Framework for Social Intelligence Reasoning
item.author: Shang Ma, Jisheng Dang, Wencan Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Bimei Wang, Hong Peng, Bin Hu, Qi Tian, Tat-Seng Chua
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种基于轻量级多模态大语言模型的多智能体协作框架，用于社会智能推理。

背景: 社会智能推理需要处理多模态数据，特别是长尾事件，这些事件在标记化过程中容易被头部事件和环境噪声掩盖。

目的: 提高社会智能推理的准确性和效率，特别是在处理长尾事件时。

方法: 通过知识蒸馏增强训练和推理阶段，精确本地化与社会智能相关的多模态数据，识别、提取并格式化长尾事件，防止关键信息被掩盖。集成测试时适应机制，涵盖长尾事件的提取和表示、思维链提示和自我反思。使用低秩适应微调基础模型，仅针对实例级推理。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，使用约百分之三十的IntentTrain训练数据，该框架取得了最先进的结果。

结论: 该框架在社会智能推理任务中表现出色，具有实际应用价值。

翻译: We propose a multi-agent collaborative framework built upon a lightweight Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), specifically designed for social intelligence reasoning. A key feature of our approach is that both the training and inference phases are augmented via knowledge distillation. Within this architecture, multi-modal data pertinent to social intelligence is precisely localized. Furthermore, relevant long-tail events are identified, extracted, and rendered as formatted, explicit text. This formatting strategy prevents critical long-tail information from being overshadowed by head events and environmental noise during the tokenization process. Specifically, we integrate Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) across the entire reasoning pipeline, encompassing the extraction and representation of long-tail events, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, and self-reflection. This TTA mechanism is also distillation-enhanced, utilizing Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the foundation model exclusively for instance-level reasoning. Extensive evaluations against various open-source and proprietary AI models across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. With around 30% of training data from IntentTrain, we achieve state-of-the-art results. Codes are available at https://github.com/eeee-sys/MODF-SIR, demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR, LoRA is available at https://huggingface.co/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR and the dataset for training router is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Harry-1234/IntentRouterTrain.

Abstract

We propose a multi-agent collaborative framework built upon a lightweight Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), specifically designed for social intelligence reasoning. A key feature of our approach is that both the training and inference phases are augmented via knowledge distillation. Within this architecture, multi-modal data pertinent to social intelligence is precisely localized. Furthermore, relevant long-tail events are identified, extracted, and rendered as formatted, explicit text. This formatting strategy prevents critical long-tail information from being overshadowed by head events and environmental noise during the tokenization process. Specifically, we integrate Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) across the entire reasoning pipeline, encompassing the extraction and representation of long-tail events, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, and self-reflection. This TTA mechanism is also distillation-enhanced, utilizing Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the foundation model exclusively for instance-level reasoning. Extensive evaluations against various open-source and proprietary AI models across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. With around 30% of training data from IntentTrain, we achieve state-of-the-art results. Codes are available at https://github.com/eeee-sys/MODF-SIR, demo is available at https://huggingface.co/spaces/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR, LoRA is available at https://huggingface.co/Harry-1234/MODF-SIR and the dataset for training router is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Harry-1234/IntentRouterTrain.

item.title: SpikeTAD: Spiking Neural Networks for End-to-End Temporal Action Detection
item.author: Min Yang, Mi Zhou, Limin Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于脉冲神经网络的端到端时序动作检测架构 SpikeTAD，旨在解决现有视频理解模型在移动设备上部署困难的问题。

背景: 视频理解是计算机视觉的重要组成部分，具有广泛的应用场景。随着移动设备的普及，越来越多的研究致力于将视频理解模型部署到移动设备上。然而，现有模型由于体积庞大且功耗过高，难以部署。脉冲神经网络相较于人工神经网络具有生物合理性和低功耗优势，尤其适用于被视为未来移动设备核心组件的神经形态芯片。但脉冲神经网络存在转换时间步过长和性能严重下降的问题，限制了其应用。

目的: 解决脉冲神经网络在转换时间步和性能方面的问题，探索其在时序动作检测这一重要视频理解任务中的应用。

方法: 提出首个基于脉冲神经网络的端到端时序动作检测架构 SpikeTAD。

主要发现: SpikeTAD 在保持极低功耗的同时，在 THUMOS14 数据集上取得了 67.2% 的平均 mAP，在 ActivityNet-1.3 数据集上取得了 37.42% 的平均 mAP。

结论: SpikeTAD 证明了低功耗时序动作检测模型的可行性。

翻译: Video understanding is a crucial part of computer vision, with numerous application scenarios. With the increasing popularity of mobile devices, an increasing number of efforts are trying to deploy video understanding models on them. However, existing video understanding models are difficult to deploy due to their large size and prohibitive power consumption. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown bioplausibility and low power advantages over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), especially on neuromorphic chips which are regarded as essential components of future mobile devices. However, excessively long conversion time-steps and severe performance degradation problems limit their application. To solve the problems above, we explore the application of SNNs on temporal action detection (TAD), which is an important task in video understanding, and propose the first SNN-based end-to-end TAD architecture coined as SpikeTAD. While maintaining extremely low power consumption, SpikeTAD achieves an average mAP of 67.2% in THUMOS14 and 37.42% in ActivityNet-1.3, demonstrating the feasibility of a low-power TAD model. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SpikeTAD.

Abstract

Video understanding is a crucial part of computer vision, with numerous application scenarios. With the increasing popularity of mobile devices, an increasing number of efforts are trying to deploy video understanding models on them. However, existing video understanding models are difficult to deploy due to their large size and prohibitive power consumption. Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have shown bioplausibility and low power advantages over Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), especially on neuromorphic chips which are regarded as essential components of future mobile devices. However, excessively long conversion time-steps and severe performance degradation problems limit their application. To solve the problems above, we explore the application of SNNs on temporal action detection (TAD), which is an important task in video understanding, and propose the first SNN-based end-to-end TAD architecture coined as SpikeTAD. While maintaining extremely low power consumption, SpikeTAD achieves an average mAP of 67.2% in THUMOS14 and 37.42% in ActivityNet-1.3, demonstrating the feasibility of a low-power TAD model. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SpikeTAD.

item.title: Metadata-Aware Multi-Prompt Reasoning for Zero-Shot Accident Understanding
item.author: Tarandeep Singh, Soumyanetra Pal, Soham Biswas, Nishanth Chandran
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于从监控视频中零样本理解事故的三阶段管道，通过自然语言识别撞击事件的发生时间、类型和位置。

背景: 监控视频中的事故理解是一个挑战，特别是在零样本设置下。

目的: 通过自然语言识别撞击事件的发生时间、类型和位置，以提高零样本视频理解的可靠性。

方法: 提出一个三阶段管道：第一阶段使用视觉语言相似度提取撞击周围的短时间窗口；第二阶段通过五种互补视角进行元数据驱动的多提示推理，并通过熵门控成对裁决器解决分歧；第三阶段使用开放词汇检测器定位撞击位置，并通过分数加权质心聚合关键帧的检测。

主要发现: 该管道在零样本ACCIDENT @ CVPR基准测试上显著提高了谐波平均分数。

结论: 将零样本视频理解分解为时间定位、语义分类和空间接地，比直接提示更能实现可靠的推理。

翻译: In this paper, we address the problem of zero-shot understanding of accidents from surveillance videos by identifying when an impact event occurs, what type of impact it is, and where in the frame it occurs using natural language. We propose a three-stage pipeline that decomposes the accident understanding into when, what, and where. The first stage extracts a short temporal window around the impact using vision-language similarity. In the second stage, we perform metadata-driven multi-prompt reasoning with five complementary views (baseline, motion, geometry, contrast, and tiebreaker) and resolve disagreement via an entropy-gated pairwise adjudicator. Finally, we localize the impact of an open-vocabulary detector queried on the predicted accident type and scene layout, and aggregate detections across keyframes using a score-weighted centroid. Our pipeline achieves a substantial improvement in the harmonic-mean score over a centre-of-frame baseline on the zero-shot ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark. We show that decomposing zero-shot video understanding into temporal localization, semantic classification, and spatial grounding enable more reliable reasoning with vision-language models than direct prompting alone.

Abstract

In this paper, we address the problem of zero-shot understanding of accidents from surveillance videos by identifying when an impact event occurs, what type of impact it is, and where in the frame it occurs using natural language. We propose a three-stage pipeline that decomposes the accident understanding into when, what, and where. The first stage extracts a short temporal window around the impact using vision-language similarity. In the second stage, we perform metadata-driven multi-prompt reasoning with five complementary views (baseline, motion, geometry, contrast, and tiebreaker) and resolve disagreement via an entropy-gated pairwise adjudicator. Finally, we localize the impact of an open-vocabulary detector queried on the predicted accident type and scene layout, and aggregate detections across keyframes using a score-weighted centroid. Our pipeline achieves a substantial improvement in the harmonic-mean score over a centre-of-frame baseline on the zero-shot ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark. We show that decomposing zero-shot video understanding into temporal localization, semantic classification, and spatial grounding enable more reliable reasoning with vision-language models than direct prompting alone.

item.title: MFEN:Multi-Frequency Expert Network for Visible-Infrared Person Re-ID
item.author: Xulin Li, Yan Lu, Bin Liu, Qinhong Yang, Qi Chu, Tao Gong, Nenghai Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种多频专家网络用于可见光与红外行人重识别，通过多频调制和混合专家设计自适应结合不同频带，并引入随机频域增强和频域辅助优化进行训练，有效解决了光照条件差异带来的模态差异问题。

背景: 可见光与红外行人重识别面临巨大的模态差异挑战，这种差异主要与光照条件不同有关，包括光波长和光源类型的差异。现有的基于频域的方法虽然能更好地提取身份相关轮廓和细节，但通常不区分不同频带或仅关注单一频带，在多样光照条件下表现不足。

目的: 为了进行全面的频域学习，解决现有方法在频带处理上的不足，提出一种能够自适应结合不同频带的网络结构，以在多样光照条件下实现更鲁棒的表示学习。

方法: 提出了多频专家网络，通过混合专家设计实现多频调制并自适应结合不同频带。同时引入了随机频域增强和频域辅助优化来更好地训练该网络。这三个模块互补，共同捕获关键的频域细节。

主要发现: 在三个可见光与红外行人重识别数据集上的广泛实验表明，所提出的方法有效。

结论: 该方法通过全面的频域学习，能够有效应对可见光与红外图像间的模态差异，提升了行人重识别的性能。

翻译: Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) is challenging due to the large modality discrepancy between visible and infrared images. We contend that this discrepancy is largely related to differing lighting conditions, including differences in light wavelength and light source type. Recently, frequency-based VI-ReID approaches have achieved notable success because frequency information can better extract identity-relevant contours and details while excluding irrelevant lighting and color. However, existing methods either do not distinguish different frequency bands or focus on only one band, which is insufficient under diverse lighting conditions. To perform comprehensive frequency domain learning, we propose a Multi-Frequency Expert Network (MFEN) that enables multi-frequency modulation and adaptively combines different bands through a mixture-of-experts design. We further introduce Random Frequency Augmentation (RFA) and Frequency Auxiliary Optimization (FAO) to better train MFEN. The three modules are complementary and jointly capture critical frequency-domain details for robust representation learning. Extensive experiments on three VI-ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

Abstract

Visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) is challenging due to the large modality discrepancy between visible and infrared images. We contend that this discrepancy is largely related to differing lighting conditions, including differences in light wavelength and light source type. Recently, frequency-based VI-ReID approaches have achieved notable success because frequency information can better extract identity-relevant contours and details while excluding irrelevant lighting and color. However, existing methods either do not distinguish different frequency bands or focus on only one band, which is insufficient under diverse lighting conditions. To perform comprehensive frequency domain learning, we propose a Multi-Frequency Expert Network (MFEN) that enables multi-frequency modulation and adaptively combines different bands through a mixture-of-experts design. We further introduce Random Frequency Augmentation (RFA) and Frequency Auxiliary Optimization (FAO) to better train MFEN. The three modules are complementary and jointly capture critical frequency-domain details for robust representation learning. Extensive experiments on three VI-ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

item.title: World Model Self-Distillation: Training World Models to Solve General Tasks
item.author: Stapf, Sebastian, Huertos, Pablo Acuaviva, Davtyan, Aram, Favaro, Paolo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种结合自蒸馏与强化学习的可扩展框架，使预训练视频生成器具备任务求解能力。

背景: 预训练视频生成器展现出涌现的任务求解能力，但依赖详细文本描述限制了其在规划与决策中的直接应用。现有方法或将推理外包给语言或视觉语言模型，或依赖成本高昂且难以扩展的配对任务执行视频进行监督微调。

目的: 开发一种无需人工标注任务视频监督的可扩展框架，以激发预训练视频生成器的任务求解能力。

方法: 给定无标签场景图像，视觉语言模型生成候选任务及详细分步解决方案。该解决方案用于条件化预训练视频扩散模型（演示者），并将其行为蒸馏至仅依赖图像和简短任务提示的条件化执行器。随后，利用视觉语言模型反馈进行强化学习，以优化执行器。

主要发现: 在世界任务基准和DreamGen机器人基准上的实验表明，执行器在基于视觉语言模型的评估协议中优于演示者，并能有效迁移至机器人任务。

结论: 该方法成功将基于字幕引导的生成知识转移至基于指令的条件化任务求解，无需人工标注的任务视频监督，且具备可扩展性。

翻译: Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability in such models by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning. Given an unlabeled scene image, a vision-language model generates a candidate task and a detailed step-by-step solution. The solution conditions a pretrained video diffusion model, the Demonstrator; we distill its behavior into an Executor conditioned only on the image and a short task prompt. This transfers execution knowledge from caption-guided generation to instruction-conditioned task solving without curated task-video supervision. We further improve the Executor with reinforcement learning from VLM feedback, exploiting the asymmetry between judging whether a sampled video satisfies a task and generating the solution. Experiments on our proposed WorldTasks-Benchmark and the DreamGen robotics benchmark show that the Executor surpasses the Demonstrator under our VLM-based evaluation protocol and transfers competitively to robotic tasks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决预训练视频生成模型难以仅凭简短任务指令自主规划并执行复杂动作的问题。现有方法通常依赖外部模型提供详细步骤，或需要耗费巨大成本收集配对的任务演示视频。该研究的重要性在于，它通过自蒸馏与反馈强化学习相结合，使模型能够直接根据初始画面和简短指令生成合理动作序列，大幅降低了数据标注成本，为机器人控制和通用环境中的自主决策提供了高效可扩展的解决方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有视频生成模型依赖详细文本描述且难以直接用于任务规划的问题，设计了结合自蒸馏与强化学习的训练框架。该方法借鉴了知识蒸馏与分布匹配技术，将依赖详细步骤描述的预训练模型作为教师，将仅接收简短指令的模型作为学生进行知识迁移。同时，参考了基于偏好的强化学习及视觉语言模型作为零样本验证器的现有工作，利用生成方案与验证方案之间的难度差异，通过视觉语言模型反馈持续优化执行模型，从而在无需人工标注配对数据的情况下实现通用任务求解。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过自蒸馏与强化学习相结合，将依赖详细文本描述的预训练视频生成模型转化为仅需简短任务指令即可自主执行任务的智能体。整体流程首先由视觉语言模型根据初始场景图像自动生成任务目标与详细操作步骤，并以此指导教师模型生成示范视频。随后，学生模型仅凭初始图像和简短指令生成视频，并通过自蒸馏过程模仿教师模型的行为轨迹。最后，利用视觉语言模型对生成视频进行反馈评估，结合强化学习进一步微调学生模型，使其能够独立高效地完成各类通用任务。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种结合自蒸馏与强化学习的框架，将依赖详细文本描述的预训练视频生成模型转化为仅需简短任务指令即可执行任务的模型。相比以往依赖昂贵配对数据监督微调或完全外包推理给外部语言模型的方法，该方法利用无标注图像自动生成任务与详细步骤，通过教师模型指导学生模型学习，并引入视觉语言模型反馈进行强化学习优化。这使得模型无需人工标注数据即可掌握通用任务解决能力，且在评估中能够超越教师模型。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种结合自蒸馏与视觉语言模型反馈强化学习的框架，成功将依赖详细描述的预训练视频生成模型转化为仅需简短指令即可自主解决通用任务的智能体，且无需依赖昂贵的人工标注配对数据。

Abstract

Pretrained video generators are promising visual world models that exhibit emergent task-solving abilities; however, their reliance on detailed textual descriptions limits their direct use for planning and decision-making. Existing approaches either outsource this reasoning to language or vision-language models, or rely on supervised fine-tuning with paired task-execution videos, which are costly to collect and difficult to scale. We propose a scalable framework that elicits task-solving ability in such models by combining self-distillation with reinforcement learning. Given an unlabeled scene image, a vision-language model generates a candidate task and a detailed step-by-step solution. The solution conditions a pretrained video diffusion model, the Demonstrator; we distill its behavior into an Executor conditioned only on the image and a short task prompt. This transfers execution knowledge from caption-guided generation to instruction-conditioned task solving without curated task-video supervision. We further improve the Executor with reinforcement learning from VLM feedback, exploiting the asymmetry between judging whether a sampled video satisfies a task and generating the solution. Experiments on our proposed WorldTasks-Benchmark and the DreamGen robotics benchmark show that the Executor surpasses the Demonstrator under our VLM-based evaluation protocol and transfers competitively to robotic tasks.

item.title: Q-Fold: Query-Aware Focus-Context Spatio-Temporal Folding for Long Video Understanding
item.author: Biao Tang, Xu Chen, Shuxiang Gou, Jingyi Yuan, Yuhan Zhang, Chenqiang Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Q-Fold的训练自由输入构建框架，用于解决多模态大语言模型在长视频理解中的挑战。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在处理长视频时面临挑战，因为长视频通常包含数千帧，处理成本高昂。现有方法通常在有限的视觉预算下从长视频中构建紧凑的视觉输入，但大多遵循以帧为中心的范式，对保留的内容应用相似的表示，无论其重要性如何，难以同时保持高保真视觉证据和广泛的时间覆盖。

目的: 解决现有方法难以同时保持高保真视觉证据和广泛时间覆盖的问题。

方法: 提出Q-Fold框架，该框架不以孤立帧为基本建模单元，而是基于连续的时间段进行操作，并在查询指导下构建异质的焦点-上下文表示。与查询相关的片段被保留为高保真的焦点帧，而不太相关的片段被折叠成保留时间顺序的上下文布局。

主要发现: 在四个长视频基准测试上，使用多个视频多模态大语言模型进行实验，Q-Fold在不增加输入预算的情况下 consistently 提高了性能。在超长视频基准测试上，性能提升高达9.1个百分点。
