It supports structural modifications, mathematical transformations, and tensor reshaping through expressive regex and structural targeting, while built-in assertions validate tensor shapes, data types, and values to prevent silent errors. We envision that BrainSurgery will provide a strong foundation for future research through its reproducible and validated operations.

item.title: SearchSwarm: Towards Delegation Intelligence in Agentic LLMs for Long-Horizon Deep Research
item.author: Ning, Pu, Chen, Quan, Tao, Kun, Tang, Xinyu, Wang, Tianshu, Cao, Qianggang, Kong, Xinyu, Wen, Zujie, Zhang, Zhiqiang, Zhou, Jun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于训练大型语言模型进行任务分解与委派能力的方法，通过构建引导框架生成训练数据，并微调模型以提升其在长周期复杂任务中的表现。

背景: 大型语言模型在处理需要无限增长上下文的复杂长周期现实任务时面临上下文窗口有限的限制。现有研究探索了主智能体分解任务并委派给子智能体的范式，但需要模型具备委派智能，而此类训练数据在自然文本中稀缺，且合成数据及训练方法在开源社区中尚未充分探索。

目的: 填补在合成委派智能训练数据及训练模型获取该能力方面的研究空白，特别针对深度研究这一代表性长周期智能体任务进行初步探索。

方法: 设计一个引导框架，指导模型进行高质量的任務分解与委派，同时约束子智能体返回适当结果以支持主智能体工作流。利用该框架生成的轨迹作为监督微调数据，将委派智能内化到模型权重中。

主要发现: 所提出的模型SearchSwarm-30B-A3B在BrowseComp基准测试中得分68.1，在BrowseComp-ZH基准测试中得分73.3，在同等规模模型中取得最佳结果。

结论: 该方法有效提升了模型在长周期任务中的委派能力，研究团队将公开引导框架、模型权重和训练数据以促进未来研究。

翻译: Large language models are increasingly expected to handle complex, long-horizon real-world tasks whose context demands can grow without bound, yet model context windows remain inherently finite. Recent work explores a paradigm where a main agent decomposes tasks and dispatches subtasks to subagents, which execute and return only summarized results, conserving the main agent's context budget. However, performing this well requires delegation intelligence: the ability to decompose complex tasks, determine when and what to delegate, and integrate returned results into the ongoing workflow. Training data for this capability is scarce in naturally occurring text, and to our knowledge, how to synthesize such data and train models to acquire this capability remains largely unexplored in the open-source community. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary exploration targeting deep research, a representative long-horizon agent task. Specifically, we design a harness that guides the model toward high-quality task decomposition and delegation, while constraining subagents to return results properly to support the main agent's workflow. The harness-guided trajectories naturally encode correct delegation decisions, which we use as supervised fine-tuning data to internalize delegation intelligence into model weights. Our resulting model, SearchSwarm-30B-A3B, achieves 68.1 on BrowseComp and 73.3 on BrowseComp-ZH, the best results among all models of comparable scale. We will release our harness, model weights, and training data to facilitate future research.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在处理超长周期复杂任务时，因上下文长度有限而难以有效管理海量信息的问题。它旨在训练模型的委派智能，使其能够主动拆解任务、分配子任务给独立运行的子代理，并高效整合返回结果。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为传统的被动信息压缩方式容易丢失关键线索，而主动委派机制能大幅节省上下文资源，显著提升模型在深度研究与复杂决策中的准确性与可靠性，同时填补了开源社区在训练此类协作能力上的空白。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对大模型上下文容量有限而长任务需求无限的核心矛盾，提出由主智能体主动规划并委派子任务给独立子智能体执行的设计思路，以此实现更智能的上下文管理。在具体实现上，他们设计了一套引导框架，通过鼓励委派、提供详细研究背景、保留主智能体核心判断权以及要求子智能体附带来源引用等原则，引导模型生成高质量轨迹，并据此进行监督微调以固化该能力。该方法借鉴了近期类似的主分发与子执行架构研究，但进一步系统性地补充了完整的引导机制、数据构建流程与训练方案。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让模型具备委派智能，由主智能体主动将复杂任务拆解并委派给独立上下文的子智能体执行，最后整合精简报告，以此实现主动且高效的上下文管理。整体流程首先设计一套引导框架，通过特定工具与提示词规范任务拆解、详细委派、核心判断保留及引用报告行为。随后利用该框架生成执行轨迹，筛选出决策正确的数据后，通过监督微调将委派模式内化为模型权重。最终训练好的模型即可自主完成长程任务的拆解、委派与结果整合。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于设计了一套系统引导机制与数据合成方法，使主智能体能够主动将复杂任务拆解并委派给独立上下文中的子智能体执行，同时要求子智能体提供带来源引用的精简报告以保障结果可靠性。相比以往被动压缩上下文或仅关注高层架构的做法，该方法将委派决策内化为模型参数，实现了基于内容感知的智能上下文管理。此外，论文首次提供了从引导机制设计、高质量训练数据构建到监督微调的完整流程，并在多项基准测试中取得了同规模模型的最佳成绩。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文通过设计引导框架使大语言模型掌握任务分解与委派能力，利用生成的执行轨迹进行监督微调，训练出在同等规模下性能最优的SearchSwarm模型，并开源了全部框架、权重与训练数据。

Abstract

Large language models are increasingly expected to handle complex, long-horizon real-world tasks whose context demands can grow without bound, yet model context windows remain inherently finite. Recent work explores a paradigm where a main agent decomposes tasks and dispatches subtasks to subagents, which execute and return only summarized results, conserving the main agent's context budget. However, performing this well requires delegation intelligence: the ability to decompose complex tasks, determine when and what to delegate, and integrate returned results into the ongoing workflow. Training data for this capability is scarce in naturally occurring text, and to our knowledge, how to synthesize such data and train models to acquire this capability remains largely unexplored in the open-source community. To bridge this gap, we present a preliminary exploration targeting deep research, a representative long-horizon agent task. Specifically, we design a harness that guides the model toward high-quality task decomposition and delegation, while constraining subagents to return results properly to support the main agent's workflow. The harness-guided trajectories naturally encode correct delegation decisions, which we use as supervised fine-tuning data to internalize delegation intelligence into model weights. Our resulting model, SearchSwarm-30B-A3B, achieves 68.1 on BrowseComp and 73.3 on BrowseComp-ZH, the best results among all models of comparable scale. We will release our harness, model weights, and training data to facilitate future research.

item.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL
item.author: Yao, Jiarui, Zhou, Xiangxin, Qi, Penghui, Lee, Wee Sun, Bo, Liefeng, Pang, Tianyu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DRPO的新方法，用于改进大语言模型强化学习训练的稳定性和效率。

背景: 强化学习是大语言模型后训练的关键组成部分。由于训练与推理不匹配及策略陈旧，大语言模型的强化学习通常是非策略的，因此需要信任区域控制以确保优化稳定。主流方法如PPO和GRPO使用比率裁剪机制近似控制，但在长尾词汇表中，重要性比率可能是分布偏移的较差代理。

目的: 解决现有方法如DPPO在信任区域边界处理上的不足，即DPPO依赖硬掩码，一旦令牌偏离信任区域边界，其梯度会被丢弃而非修正。

方法: 提出DRPO（Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization），用平滑的优势加权二次正则化器替换硬掩码，对策略偏移进行正则化。该方法保留了与DPPO相同的信任区域几何结构，但诱导有界且连续的梯度权重，以衰减发散更新并提供边界外的修正信号。

主要发现: 在模型规模、架构和精度设置上的实验表明，DRPO提高了大语言模型强化学习训练的稳定性和效率。

结论: DRPO通过平滑的正则化器改进了信任区域控制，有效提升了大语言模型强化学习训练的效果。

翻译: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component of post-training large language models (LLMs). In practice, LLM RL is often off-policy because of training-inference mismatch and policy staleness, making trust-region control essential for stable optimization. Mainstream methods such as PPO and GRPO approximate this control with a ratio-clipping mechanism, but the importance ratio can be a poor proxy for distributional shift in long-tailed vocabularies. Recent work such as DPPO addresses this mismatch by replacing ratio-based clipping with a divergence-based mask, yielding a trust region defined by the sampled token's absolute probability shift. However, DPPO still relies on a hard mask: once a token crosses the trust-region boundary in a harmful direction, its gradient is discarded rather than corrected. To address this, we propose Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO), which replaces the hard mask with a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer on policy shift. DRPO preserves the same trust-region geometry as DPPO while inducing bounded, continuous gradient weights that attenuate diverging updates and provide corrective signals beyond the boundary. Experiments across model scales, architectures, and precision settings show that DRPO improves the stability and efficiency of LLM RL training.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型强化学习训练中信任区域控制不稳定，以及现有方法在长尾词表下对策略更新进行硬性截断导致梯度突变的问题。传统方法依赖概率比值来限制更新幅度，但在词表分布不均时容易失效；而改进方法虽改用绝对概率偏移量，却因硬性丢弃越界梯度而缺乏修正信号。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为大语言模型训练普遍存在策略不匹配现象，缺乏平滑且自适应的约束机制会直接导致训练过程震荡、效率低下甚至性能倒退。本文提出的平滑正则化方法能有效提供连续修正信号，从而显著提升训练的稳定性和效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法虽然用概率绝对偏移替代了传统比率裁剪以更好适应长尾词表，但其硬性梯度屏蔽机制会导致边界处梯度突变且缺乏修正信号。为此，作者借鉴了SPO方法中用平滑二次正则项替代硬性裁剪的设计思路，将其与DPPO的散度约束相结合。最终设计出DRPO方法，通过优势加权的光滑正则项替代硬屏蔽，使梯度权重连续变化，既保持了稳定的信任域边界，又能在超出边界时提供平滑的修正信号。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是用平滑的二次正则项替代原有算法中生硬的梯度截断机制，通过约束当前策略与行为策略在采样词上的绝对概率变化幅度，来稳定大语言模型的强化学习训练。整体实现流程为：模型生成回复后计算每个词的优势值，接着根据当前策略与旧策略的概率差计算平滑的梯度权重，该权重会在概率变化接近安全边界时自动衰减，超出边界时提供反向修正信号，最后利用这些连续调整的梯度直接更新模型参数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新是提出了一种基于散度正则的策略优化方法，将原有算法中用于限制策略更新的硬截断机制替换为平滑的优势加权二次正则项。与依赖重要性比率的传统方法相比，该方法直接约束词元的绝对概率变化，更适配大语言模型长尾词表的分布特性。与仅使用硬掩码丢弃越界梯度的方法相比，新方法在超出信任边界时仍能通过连续变化的权重提供平滑的修正信号，从而显著提升了训练的稳定性和效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种新的策略优化方法，通过将硬截断的散度控制掩码替换为平滑的优势加权二次正则化项，有效缓解了长尾词表下的分布偏移问题，从而提升了大型语言模型强化学习训练的稳定性与效率。

Abstract

Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key component of post-training large language models (LLMs). In practice, LLM RL is often off-policy because of training-inference mismatch and policy staleness, making trust-region control essential for stable optimization. Mainstream methods such as PPO and GRPO approximate this control with a ratio-clipping mechanism, but the importance ratio can be a poor proxy for distributional shift in long-tailed vocabularies. Recent work such as DPPO addresses this mismatch by replacing ratio-based clipping with a divergence-based mask, yielding a trust region defined by the sampled token's absolute probability shift. However, DPPO still relies on a hard mask: once a token crosses the trust-region boundary in a harmful direction, its gradient is discarded rather than corrected. To address this, we propose Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (DRPO), which replaces the hard mask with a smooth advantage-weighted quadratic regularizer on policy shift. DRPO preserves the same trust-region geometry as DPPO while inducing bounded, continuous gradient weights that attenuate diverging updates and provide corrective signals beyond the boundary. Experiments across model scales, architectures, and precision settings show that DRPO improves the stability and efficiency of LLM RL training.

item.title: Co-GLANCE: Uncertainty-Aware Active Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Teaming
item.author: Michal P. Podolinsky, Neel P. Bhatt, Pranay Samineni, Rohan Siva, Christian Ellis, Ufuk Topcu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Co-GLANCE的实时机载感知与决策系统，用于异构机器人团队在非结构化户外环境中解决感知不确定性问题。

背景: 异构机器人在非结构化户外环境中面临感知不确定性挑战，单一视角无法提供可靠的场景理解。感知不确定性由遮挡等因素引起，在不同机器人视角下表现不同。视觉语言模型虽能提供语义先验，但计算成本高且缺乏校准的不确定性量化。

目的: 开发一种实时机载感知和决策系统，以解决异构机器人团队中的感知不确定性问题，无需依赖云端推理。

方法: Co-GLANCE系统将视觉语言模型的语义推理能力蒸馏为端到端模型，用于遮挡分割和机器人分配。结合共形预测和选择性拒绝机制，为分割、机器人分配和检测结果提供统计有效的覆盖保证。校准的不确定性估计直接触发主动感知，派遣最合适的机器人获取信息性视角以解决不确定性。

主要发现: 在真实世界场景中，Co-GLANCE在遮挡分割和机器人分配准确性上分别比基于云端的视觉语言模型基线高出百分之二十五和百分之三十六，同时将每帧推理延迟降低了三百五十倍。

结论: Co-GLANCE有效解决了异构机器人团队中的感知不确定性问题，提供了高效的实时机载解决方案，并发布了空-地数据集以供未来研究。

翻译: Perceptual uncertainty is a central challenge for heterogeneous robot teams operating in unstructured outdoor environments, where no single viewpoint affords reliable scene understanding. Perceptual uncertainty, arising from sources such as occlusions, manifests differently across robot viewpoints depending on scene structure. Detecting and resolving sources of perceptual uncertainty requires both scene-based contextual reasoning and capability-aware robot allocation. While vision-language models provide strong semantic priors for both, they are computationally prohibitive for onboard inference and lack calibrated uncertainty quantification. We introduce Co-GLANCE, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams. Co-GLANCE distills the semantic reasoning capabilities of a vision-language model into an end-to-end model for occlusion segmentation and robot allocation, eliminating the need for cloud-based inference. To quantify perceptual uncertainty, Co-GLANCE combines conformal prediction with selective abstention to provide statistically valid coverage guarantees for segmentation, robot allocation, and detection outputs. These calibrated uncertainty estimates directly trigger active perception, dispatching the most appropriate robot to acquire informative viewpoints and resolve uncertainty. Across real-world scenarios, Co-GLANCE outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy by 25% and 36%, respectively, while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x. We also release an air-ground dataset for future research. Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/ .

Abstract

Perceptual uncertainty is a central challenge for heterogeneous robot teams operating in unstructured outdoor environments, where no single viewpoint affords reliable scene understanding. Perceptual uncertainty, arising from sources such as occlusions, manifests differently across robot viewpoints depending on scene structure. Detecting and resolving sources of perceptual uncertainty requires both scene-based contextual reasoning and capability-aware robot allocation. While vision-language models provide strong semantic priors for both, they are computationally prohibitive for onboard inference and lack calibrated uncertainty quantification. We introduce Co-GLANCE, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams. Co-GLANCE distills the semantic reasoning capabilities of a vision-language model into an end-to-end model for occlusion segmentation and robot allocation, eliminating the need for cloud-based inference. To quantify perceptual uncertainty, Co-GLANCE combines conformal prediction with selective abstention to provide statistically valid coverage guarantees for segmentation, robot allocation, and detection outputs. These calibrated uncertainty estimates directly trigger active perception, dispatching the most appropriate robot to acquire informative viewpoints and resolve uncertainty. Across real-world scenarios, Co-GLANCE outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy by 25% and 36%, respectively, while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x. We also release an air-ground dataset for future research. Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/ .

item.title: Sigma-Branch: Hierarchical Single-Path Network Reconstruction for Dynamic Inference with Reduced Active Parameters
item.author: Kohga Tanaka, Hiroaki Nishi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Sigma-Branch的框架，通过将预训练密集网络重构为包含共享主干、分层路由器和专用叶节点的层次化二叉树结构，有效解决了在内存受限的边缘加速器上部署深度神经网络时面临的每推理次片外权重传输瓶颈问题。

背景: 在内存受限的边缘加速器上部署深度神经网络时，每推理次数的片外权重传输而非计算过程成为性能瓶颈。由于密集网络无法完全保留在片上内存中，每个参数在每次推理时都必须被加载。现有的模型压缩方法虽然能减少这种传输，但会导致永久性的容量损失。

目的: 提出一种新的模型压缩框架，旨在解耦每推理次数的内存流量与总参数数量，从而在不显著降低模型精度的前提下，减少每次推理所需的活跃参数数量。

方法: 提出Sigma-Branch框架，将预训练密集网络重构为层次化二叉树结构，包含共享主干、分层路由器和专用叶节点。通过基于激活值的球形k均值聚类算法将预训练权重分配到树中，该算法同时初始化路由器权重和每个分支的通道分配。随后进行软路由微调，使每个叶节点与其路由的输入子集对齐。在推理过程中，网络仅执行单条从根到叶的路径，从而减少活跃参数足迹，同时完整存储密集参数集。

主要发现: 在CIFAR-100/ResNet-50、ImageNet-1K/ResNet-50和ModelNet40/PointNet++等基准测试中，SigmaB-Net将每推理次数的活跃参数减少了百分之五十八至六十，同时精度仅比密集基线低一点七二个百分点以内。在ImageNet-1K精度相当的情况下，活跃参数减少幅度比静态结构化剪枝方法高出十四个至二十三个百分点。跨模态评估涵盖了二维视觉和三维点云骨干网络。

结论: 该框架成功解耦了每推理次数的内存流量与总参数数量，证明了在内存受限的边缘设备上高效部署深度神经网络的可行性。

翻译: Deploying deep neural networks on memory-constrained edge accelerators is bottlenecked by per-inference off-chip weight transfer rather than computation: the dense network cannot be retained on-chip, and every parameter must be loaded for every input. Existing model compression reduces this transfer only at the cost of permanent capacity loss. We propose Sigma-Branch (SigmaB), a framework that restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree composed of a shared backbone, hierarchical routers, and specialized leaves. Pretrained weights are distributed across the tree via activation-based spherical k-means clustering, which jointly initializes router weights and per-branch channel allocations; soft-routing fine-tuning then aligns each leaf with its routed input subset. At inference, the resulting network executes only a single root-to-leaf path, reducing the active-parameter footprint while storing the complete dense parameter set in memory. Across CIFAR-100 / ResNet-50, ImageNet-1K / ResNet-50, and ModelNet40 / PointNet++, SigmaB-Net reduces per-inference active parameters by 58-60% while remaining within 1.72 percentage points (pp) of the dense baseline Top-1. At comparable ImageNet-1K Top-1, the active-parameter reduction exceeds static structured pruning (FPGM, HRank) by 14-23 pp. The cross-modal evaluation, spanning 2D vision and 3D point-cloud backbones, substantiates a framework-level claim that decouples per-inference memory traffic from the total parameter count.

Abstract

Deploying deep neural networks on memory-constrained edge accelerators is bottlenecked by per-inference off-chip weight transfer rather than computation: the dense network cannot be retained on-chip, and every parameter must be loaded for every input. Existing model compression reduces this transfer only at the cost of permanent capacity loss. We propose Sigma-Branch (SigmaB), a framework that restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree composed of a shared backbone, hierarchical routers, and specialized leaves. Pretrained weights are distributed across the tree via activation-based spherical k-means clustering, which jointly initializes router weights and per-branch channel allocations; soft-routing fine-tuning then aligns each leaf with its routed input subset. At inference, the resulting network executes only a single root-to-leaf path, reducing the active-parameter footprint while storing the complete dense parameter set in memory. Across CIFAR-100 / ResNet-50, ImageNet-1K / ResNet-50, and ModelNet40 / PointNet++, SigmaB-Net reduces per-inference active parameters by 58-60% while remaining within 1.72 percentage points (pp) of the dense baseline Top-1. At comparable ImageNet-1K Top-1, the active-parameter reduction exceeds static structured pruning (FPGM, HRank) by 14-23 pp. The cross-modal evaluation, spanning 2D vision and 3D point-cloud backbones, substantiates a framework-level claim that decouples per-inference memory traffic from the total parameter count.

item.title: Toward Intelligent Prefetching: A Survey on Complex Memory Access Prediction Techniques
item.author: Sheel Sindhu Manohar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 数据预取是弥合处理器与内存性能差距的关键技术，通过预测未来内存访问并在需求到达前将数据检索到片上缓存中。传统预取器在处理规则访问模式时表现良好，但在处理现代工作负载（如图分析、稀疏矩阵计算和指针密集型应用）中常见的不规则、数据依赖模式时存在不足。本综述采用PRISMA指导的选择方法，系统回顾了相关论文，并提出了一个结构化分类法，从局部性类型、实现层和机器学习范式三个维度组织预取技术。通过对基于机器学习的预取器在存储开销、准确性、推理延迟、硬件可行性和泛化能力等方面的多维度比较分析，识别出三个关键发现：由模型类别定义的准确性与开销的帕累托前沿、模型复杂度与缓存层次结构级别之间的自然架构映射，以及运行时适应性与模型容量之间的根本张力，这推动了分层集成架构的发展。

背景: 数据预取是弥合处理器与内存性能差距的关键技术。传统预取器基于下一行、步长和相关性启发式方法，在处理规则访问模式时表现良好，但在处理现代工作负载（如图分析、稀疏矩阵计算和指针密集型应用）中常见的不规则、数据依赖模式时存在不足。

目的: 系统回顾基于机器学习的预取技术，提出结构化分类法，并通过多维度比较分析识别关键发现。

方法: 采用PRISMA指导的选择方法进行系统综述，提出结构化分类法，从局部性类型、实现层和机器学习范式三个维度组织预取技术。对基于机器学习的预取器在存储开销、准确性、推理延迟、硬件可行性和泛化能力等方面进行多维度比较分析。

主要发现: 识别出三个关键发现：由模型类别定义的准确性与开销的帕累托前沿、模型复杂度与缓存层次结构级别之间的自然架构映射，以及运行时适应性与模型容量之间的根本张力。

结论: 运行时适应性与模型容量之间的根本张力推动了分层集成架构的发展。

翻译: Data prefetching is a critical technique for bridging the processor-memory performance gap by predicting future memory accesses and retrieving data into on-chip caches before demand. While traditional prefetchers based on next-line, stride, and correlation heuristics perform well for regular access patterns, they are fundamentally inadequate for the irregular, data-dependent patterns prevalent in modern workloads such as graph analytics, sparse matrix computations, and pointer-intensive applications. This survey presents a systematic review of papers using a PRISMA-guided selection methodology. We propose a structured taxonomy that organizes prefetching techniques across three dimensions: locality type, including spatial and temporal locality; implementation layer, including hardware, software, and hybrid approaches; and, for the increasingly important class of ML-based prefetchers, learning paradigm, including supervised, reinforcement, and unsupervised learning, paired with training mode, including online and offline training. Through a multi-dimensional comparative analysis of ML-based prefetchers evaluated across storage overhead, accuracy, inference latency, hardware feasibility, and generalization ability, we identify three key findings: an accuracy-overhead Pareto frontier defined by model class, a natural architectural mapping between model complexity and cache hierarchy level, and a fundamental tension between runtime adaptability and model capacity that motivates hierarchical ensemble architectures.

Abstract

Data prefetching is a critical technique for bridging the processor-memory performance gap by predicting future memory accesses and retrieving data into on-chip caches before demand. While traditional prefetchers based on next-line, stride, and correlation heuristics perform well for regular access patterns, they are fundamentally inadequate for the irregular, data-dependent patterns prevalent in modern workloads such as graph analytics, sparse matrix computations, and pointer-intensive applications. This survey presents a systematic review of papers using a PRISMA-guided selection methodology. We propose a structured taxonomy that organizes prefetching techniques across three dimensions: locality type, including spatial and temporal locality; implementation layer, including hardware, software, and hybrid approaches; and, for the increasingly important class of ML-based prefetchers, learning paradigm, including supervised, reinforcement, and unsupervised learning, paired with training mode, including online and offline training. Through a multi-dimensional comparative analysis of ML-based prefetchers evaluated across storage overhead, accuracy, inference latency, hardware feasibility, and generalization ability, we identify three key findings: an accuracy-overhead Pareto frontier defined by model class, a natural architectural mapping between model complexity and cache hierarchy level, and a fundamental tension between runtime adaptability and model capacity that motivates hierarchical ensemble architectures.

item.title: Interpreting and Steering a Text-to-Speech Language Model with Sparse Autoencoders
item.author: Koriagin, Nikita, Aparin, Georgii, Balagansky, Nikita, Gavrilov, Daniil
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究通过训练稀疏自编码器并引入模态感知自动解释管道，揭示了语言模型在文本转语音系统中共享残差流时的内部表示，发现这些特征具有可解释性且能作为因果控制方向。

背景: 语言模型日益成为文本转语音系统的核心，但关于文本和生成的语音令牌共享单一残差流时模型构建的表示，目前了解甚少。

目的: 理解语言模型在文本转语音系统中共享残差流时的内部表示，并探索这些表示的可解释性和控制能力。

方法: 在 CosyVoice3 的语言模型骨干网上训练批次顶部 K 稀疏自编码器，并引入模态感知的自动解释管道，根据特征触发来源（文本前缀上下文、一秒语音片段或两者）对每个特征进行标记。

主要发现: 恢复的特征具有可解释性，涵盖音素、笑声、口音提示和说话人性别等；通过稀疏自编码器潜在空间进行引导表明这些特征是因果性的而非仅仅是描述性的，定向干预能显著提高笑声概率、翻转感知说话人性别并控制语速，同时保持说话内容不变。

结论: 稀疏自编码器特征既可作为可解释性对象，也可作为文本转语音合成的控制方向。

翻译: Language models increasingly serve as the backbone of text-to-speech (TTS) systems, yet we understand little about the representations they build when text and generated speech tokens share a single residual stream. We train BatchTopK sparse autoencoders on the LM backbone of CosyVoice3 and introduce a modality-aware auto-interp pipeline that labels each feature from where it fires-text-prefix context, 1-second speech clips, or both. The recovered features are interpretable, spanning phonemes, laughter, accent prompts and speaker gender. Steering through the SAE latent space shows these features are causal rather than merely descriptive: targeted interventions raise laughter probability from 0.02 to 0.79, flip perceived speaker gender, and control speech rate while preserving spoken content. SAE features thus serve both as interpretability objects and as control directions for TTS synthesis.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决文本到语音语言模型内部表示不透明的问题，即模型在混合处理文本与语音时如何编码信息，以及这些内部特征能否用于精准控制语音生成。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为传统语音合成模型如同黑盒，缺乏可解释性且难以进行细粒度的声学干预。明确并操控这些特征不仅能揭示模型工作机制，还能为语音合成提供安全可控的干预手段，对开发高质量、可定制的语音系统具有重要价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者意识到现有方法难以区分文本与语音混合序列中的特征，因此将稀疏自编码器引入语音合成模型，并设计了根据激活位置自动划分模态并标注的流程。该方法借鉴了大型语言模型可解释性领域的成熟技术，将原有的文本自动解释与检测式评估协议扩展至多模态证据上。通过直接调整这些特征的激活值，他们验证了模型内部表示对语音生成的因果控制能力。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用稀疏自编码器将语音合成语言模型的内部激活分解为稀疏且可解释的特征，从而同时实现模型内部机制的解读与生成过程的因果控制。整体流程首先对模型内部激活训练稀疏自编码器以提取特征，接着根据特征激活位置将其分为文本、音频或混合模态，并利用语言模型自动标注特征含义。随后通过检测式任务验证标注质量，最后通过在特征潜在空间进行定向干预，实现对笑声、性别或语速等语音属性的精准控制。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次将稀疏自编码器应用于生成式文本转语音语言模型的残差流，并设计了模态感知的自动解释流水线。与以往仅针对纯文本模型或判别式语音模型的研究不同，该方法能够根据激活位置自动区分特征来源于文本提示、语音片段还是两者混合。实验进一步证明这些特征具有因果控制能力，可直接用于调节语音合成的笑声、说话人性别和语速等属性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文首次将稀疏自编码器应用于文本转语音语言模型，成功提取出可解释的文本、语音及混合模态特征，并证明通过干预这些特征能够因果性地控制语音生成的笑声、性别和语速等属性。

Abstract

Language models increasingly serve as the backbone of text-to-speech (TTS) systems, yet we understand little about the representations they build when text and generated speech tokens share a single residual stream. We train BatchTopK sparse autoencoders on the LM backbone of CosyVoice3 and introduce a modality-aware auto-interp pipeline that labels each feature from where it fires-text-prefix context, 1-second speech clips, or both. The recovered features are interpretable, spanning phonemes, laughter, accent prompts and speaker gender. Steering through the SAE latent space shows these features are causal rather than merely descriptive: targeted interventions raise laughter probability from 0.02 to 0.79, flip perceived speaker gender, and control speech rate while preserving spoken content. SAE features thus serve both as interpretability objects and as control directions for TTS synthesis.

item.title: The Chronicles of Radio Frequency Fingerprinting
item.author: Abdul Aziz, Ingrid Huso, Savio Sciancalepore, Gabriele Oligeri
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对射频指纹识别技术从一九九三年至二零二六年的发展历程进行了批判性历史分析，梳理了该领域从雷达发射机识别到无线设备识别与频谱监控的演变过程。

背景: 射频指纹识别技术已从早期的雷达发射机识别概念发展为无线设备识别和频谱监控的重要研究领域。

目的: 本文旨在通过批判性历史分析，梳理射频指纹识别领域的重大概念范式转变，澄清其演变过程，识别持续存在的局限性，并概述推动该领域向现实可靠应用发展的关键研究方向。

方法: 文章按方法论阶段划分，依次分析了基于瞬态特征的早期方法、数字通信时代的稳态损伤与工程特征提取、机器学习时代的标准化工作流以及深度学习时代从原始样本进行表示学习的方法。

主要发现: 射频指纹识别技术经历了从瞬态特征到稳态特征，再到机器学习和深度学习的范式转变。当前领域仍面临信道依赖性、接收机灵敏度、数据集真实性不足、跨领域泛化能力差、开放集识别和对抗鲁棒性等核心挑战。

结论: 通过整合三十多年的研究成果，本文明确了射频指纹识别技术的演变路径和持续存在的局限性，为未来实现该技术在现实世界中的可靠应用指明了关键研究方向。

翻译: Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFF) has evolved from an early idea for radar emitter identification into a broad research field for wireless device identification and spectrum monitoring for security. Rather than presenting a conventional literature survey, this work provides a critical historical analysis of RFF organized around the field's major conceptual paradigm shifts from 1993 to 2026. We discuss the evolution of RFF across its fundamental methodological phases, beginning with early transient-based approaches, in which transmitter turn-on behavior, unintentional modulation, and hardware nonlinearities were treated as the primary fingerprint sources. We then examine the transition to digital communications, during which attention shifted to steady-state impairments and to engineered features extracted from signals. Next, we discuss the Machine Learning period, which standardized the RFF workflow around feature extraction, dimensionality reduction, and supervised classification, followed by the Deep Learning period, in which representation learning from raw IQ samples significantly improved performance and expanded the application space. Beyond a chronological list of methods and best practices, this paper critically examines the changing assumptions and persistent limitations that have driven these transitions. We highlight the central challenges that continue to shape the field, including channel dependence, receiver sensitivity, limited dataset realism, poor cross-domain generalization, open-set recognition, and adversarial robustness. By organizing more than three decades of work into a coherent narrative, this paper clarifies the evolution of RFF, identifies persistent limitations, and outlines the key research directions required to move the field toward dependable real-world adoption.

Abstract

Radio Frequency Fingerprinting (RFF) has evolved from an early idea for radar emitter identification into a broad research field for wireless device identification and spectrum monitoring for security. Rather than presenting a conventional literature survey, this work provides a critical historical analysis of RFF organized around the field's major conceptual paradigm shifts from 1993 to 2026. We discuss the evolution of RFF across its fundamental methodological phases, beginning with early transient-based approaches, in which transmitter turn-on behavior, unintentional modulation, and hardware nonlinearities were treated as the primary fingerprint sources. We then examine the transition to digital communications, during which attention shifted to steady-state impairments and to engineered features extracted from signals. Next, we discuss the Machine Learning period, which standardized the RFF workflow around feature extraction, dimensionality reduction, and supervised classification, followed by the Deep Learning period, in which representation learning from raw IQ samples significantly improved performance and expanded the application space. Beyond a chronological list of methods and best practices, this paper critically examines the changing assumptions and persistent limitations that have driven these transitions. We highlight the central challenges that continue to shape the field, including channel dependence, receiver sensitivity, limited dataset realism, poor cross-domain generalization, open-set recognition, and adversarial robustness. By organizing more than three decades of work into a coherent narrative, this paper clarifies the evolution of RFF, identifies persistent limitations, and outlines the key research directions required to move the field toward dependable real-world adoption.

item.title: Inside the Latent Flow: Causal Deciphering of Attention Dynamics in Audio Separation Foundation Models
item.author: Yuxuan Chen, Haoyuan Xu, Peize He
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Flow-matching transformers 在音频分离方面表现强劲，但其注意力动态不透明。本文通过因果干预原则，为 SAM Audio 设计了确定性推理探测协议。正交探测揭示了双路径文本条件机制：加法注入控制语义身份，交叉注意力细化声学结构。观察到异步层收敛：稳定层早期构建时间支架，快速层在采样期间持续解决伪影。模型还衰减时间分割线索以维持连续流稳定性。基于这些洞察，提出无训练加速方法 LSAC，缓存稳定层的注意力。LSAC 减少约百分之二十五的自注意力计算，质量损失可忽略，质量保留率比简单步长减少高至六点七倍。

背景: Flow-matching transformers 在音频分离方面表现强劲，但其注意力动态不透明。

目的: 为 SAM Audio 设计确定性推理探测协议，揭示其注意力动态机制，并提出加速方法。

方法: 将因果干预原则应用于 SAM Audio 的确定性推理探测协议。使用正交探测分析文本条件机制。观察层收敛行为。提出 Layer-Selective Attention Caching (LSAC) 方法，缓存稳定层的注意力。

主要发现: 揭示双路径文本条件机制：加法注入控制语义身份，交叉注意力细化声学结构。观察到异步层收敛：稳定层早期构建时间支架，快速层持续解决伪影。模型衰减时间分割线索以维持连续流稳定性。LSAC 减少约百分之二十五的自注意力计算，质量损失可忽略，质量保留率比简单步长减少高至六点七倍。

结论: LSAC 是一种有效的无训练加速方法，能在保持高质量的同时显著减少计算量。

翻译: Flow-matching transformers achieve strong audio separation, yet their attention dynamics are opaque. We adapt established causal-intervention principles into a deterministic, inference-time probing protocol for SAM Audio. Orthogonal probing uncovers a dual-pathway text-conditioning mechanism: additive injections control semantic identity, while cross-attention refines acoustic structure. We observe an asynchronous layerwise convergence: stable layers build temporal scaffolds early, whereas fast layers continue resolving artifacts during sampling. The model also attenuates temporal segmentation cues to maintain continuous-flow stability. Using these insights, we propose Layer-Selective Attention Caching (LSAC), a training-free acceleration method that caches attention in stable layers. Across acoustic complexities, LSAC cuts self-attention computation by about ~25% with negligible quality loss and yields up to 6.7x higher quality retention than naive step reduction.

Abstract

Flow-matching transformers achieve strong audio separation, yet their attention dynamics are opaque. We adapt established causal-intervention principles into a deterministic, inference-time probing protocol for SAM Audio. Orthogonal probing uncovers a dual-pathway text-conditioning mechanism: additive injections control semantic identity, while cross-attention refines acoustic structure. We observe an asynchronous layerwise convergence: stable layers build temporal scaffolds early, whereas fast layers continue resolving artifacts during sampling. The model also attenuates temporal segmentation cues to maintain continuous-flow stability. Using these insights, we propose Layer-Selective Attention Caching (LSAC), a training-free acceleration method that caches attention in stable layers. Across acoustic complexities, LSAC cuts self-attention computation by about ~25% with negligible quality loss and yields up to 6.7x higher quality retention than naive step reduction.

item.title: BenSyc: Benchmarking Conversational Sycophancy and Human Alignment in LLMs for Bengali Contexts
item.author: Noshin, Kazi, Dip, Sajib Acharjee, Prangon, Ranat Das, Tamim, Fardin Hassan, Ahmed, Syed Ishtiaque, Zhang, Liqing, Sultana, Sharifa
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 大型语言模型在情感敏感的社会对话中可能表现出过度认同或升级对齐的行为。现有研究多关注事实性同意和指令遵循，缺乏对文化背景对话认同现象的探讨。本文提出首个孟加拉语社会语境下的对话认同基准BenSyc，基于Reddit数据构建包含二元标签和五级细粒度分类的人类验证基准，评估了十五个以上模型的分类与生成能力。结果显示前沿模型在区分共情支持与强化认同方面仍面临挑战，生成任务中部分模型易产生过度认同或升级回应。研究强调文化背景多语言基准对评估社会对齐对话人工智能系统的重要性。

背景: 大型语言模型越来越多地参与情感敏感的社会对话，其回应可能从平衡支持转向过度认同或升级对齐。现有关于阿谀奉承（sycophancy）的研究主要集中在事实性同意和指令遵循场景，对具有文化背景的对话认同现象研究不足。

目的: 提出首个用于研究孟加拉语社会语境下对话认同现象的基准BenSyc，以填补文化背景对话认同研究的空白。

方法: 从孟加拉国和西孟加拉邦的社区收集一万一千八百四十条Reddit帖子和十七万条评论，构建包含二元标签和五级细粒度分类（无效化、中性、支持、认同、升级）的人类验证基准。评估了十五个以上开源和专有大型语言模型在对话对齐分类和回应生成任务上的表现。

主要发现: 区分共情支持与强化导向的认同对前沿指令微调模型而言仍然具有挑战性，最佳系统在二元检测中Macro-F1得分为百分之六十一点八，在五类分类中为百分之六十一点七。在生成设置中，多个模型在情绪化情境中频繁产生强烈认同或升级的回应。不同模型家族和对话行为之间存在显著差异。

结论: 研究结果凸显了文化背景多语言基准在评估社会对齐对话人工智能系统方面的重要性，指出当前模型在情感敏感对话中仍存在过度认同或升级对齐的风险。

翻译: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in emotionally sensitive social conversations, where responses may shift from balanced support toward excessive validation or escalatory alignment. Existing sycophancy research primarily focuses on factual agreement and instruction-following settings, leaving culturally grounded conversational sycophancy underexplored. We introduce BenSyc, the first benchmark for studying conversational sycophancy in Bengali social contexts. Starting from 11,840 Reddit posts and 170k comments collected from communities across Bangladesh and West Bengal, we construct a human-validated benchmark with binary labels and a fine-grained five-level taxonomy spanning Invalidation, Neutral, Support, Validation, and Escalation. We evaluate more than 15 open and proprietary LLMs on conversational alignment classification and response generation tasks. Results show that distinguishing empathetic support from reinforcement-oriented validation remains challenging even for frontier instruction-tuned models: the best system achieves only 61.8 Macro-F1 on binary detection and 61.7 Macro-F1 on five-class classification. In generation settings, several models frequently produce strongly validating or escalatory responses in emotionally charged situations. Our findings highlight substantial variation across model families and conversational behaviors, underscoring the importance of culturally grounded multilingual benchmarks for evaluating socially aligned conversational AI systems.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要致力于解决大语言模型在孟加拉语文化背景的社交对话中，难以区分真诚的情感支持与盲目附和或情绪升级的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为现有评估多集中于事实核对或指令遵循，忽略了模型在情感敏感场景下容易过度迎合用户观点的缺陷。建立此类文化特定的基准有助于开发更符合人类社交规范、能提供平衡建议且避免激化矛盾的人工智能系统。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有研究多聚焦事实性附和，忽视了文化语境下情感对话的复杂性，因此设计了该基准。他们借鉴了顺从行为、社会规范及多语言对齐等领域的先前工作，将对话对齐视为从否定到升级的连续谱系，并据此构建了五个层级的分类体系。在方法设计上，他们保留了孟加拉语网络社区的真实发帖与评论，采用大语言模型辅助结合人工校验的标注流程，最终形成用于分类与生成任务评估的基准数据集。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个针对孟加拉语社交语境的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在情感敏感对话中是否表现出过度附和行为，并将回应按从反对到情绪升级的谱系进行细粒度分类。整体流程首先从孟加拉国和西孟加拉邦的Reddit社区收集真实帖子与评论，筛选出具有道德立场且含有人类回复的样本。接着采用大语言模型辅助加人工校验的方式标注二元标签与五级分类，最后利用该基准测试多款模型在分类与生成任务上的表现，并通过基于规则的大语言模型裁判进行一致性评估。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是提出了首个面向孟加拉语社交语境的对话阿谀奉承评估基准。它收集了真实社交媒体帖子并构建了从否定、中立、支持到认同和升级的五级对话对齐分类体系。与以往主要关注事实一致性或指令遵循的西方中心基准不同，该工作聚焦于非西方文化背景下情感敏感对话中的社会强化行为，填补了跨文化社交对齐评估的空白。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了首个针对孟加拉语社交语境的大语言模型对话阿谀奉承行为基准数据集，构建了包含五级对话对齐分类的千余条人工验证数据，并系统评估了多款模型在该任务上的分类与生成能力。

Abstract

Large language models (LLMs) increasingly participate in emotionally sensitive social conversations, where responses may shift from balanced support toward excessive validation or escalatory alignment. Existing sycophancy research primarily focuses on factual agreement and instruction-following settings, leaving culturally grounded conversational sycophancy underexplored. We introduce BenSyc, the first benchmark for studying conversational sycophancy in Bengali social contexts. Starting from 11,840 Reddit posts and 170k comments collected from communities across Bangladesh and West Bengal, we construct a human-validated benchmark with binary labels and a fine-grained five-level taxonomy spanning Invalidation, Neutral, Support, Validation, and Escalation. We evaluate more than 15 open and proprietary LLMs on conversational alignment classification and response generation tasks. Results show that distinguishing empathetic support from reinforcement-oriented validation remains challenging even for frontier instruction-tuned models: the best system achieves only 61.8 Macro-F1 on binary detection and 61.7 Macro-F1 on five-class classification. In generation settings, several models frequently produce strongly validating or escalatory responses in emotionally charged situations. Our findings highlight substantial variation across model families and conversational behaviors, underscoring the importance of culturally grounded multilingual benchmarks for evaluating socially aligned conversational AI systems.

item.title: Deployment-Time Memorization in Foundation-Model Agents
item.author: Lei, Chen, Guilin Zhang, Kai Zhao, Dalmo Cirne, Andy Olsen, Xu Chu, Zeke Miller, Alet Blanken, Amine Anoun, Jerry Ting
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了基础模型智能体在部署时记忆机制的设计选择如何共同影响个性化效用、提取风险和删除保真度，提出了新的评估指标并进行了实验分析。

背景: 基础模型智能体是长期运行的系统，能够在多次交互中记住用户信息，使得记忆成为部署时的显式功能，而不仅仅是模型权重的属性。现有工作主要解决参数化记忆或审计固定记忆配置，但未充分表征记忆设计选择如何共同塑造个性化效用、提取风险和删除保真度。

目的: 研究部署时记忆这一现象，将智能体记忆形式化为由个性化召回率和对抗性提取率衡量的隐私效用前沿，并探索记忆设计选择对记忆机制的影响。

方法: 通过扫描三个记忆设计旋钮（摘要激进程度、检索广度k和删除模式）来研究记忆设计。引入遗忘残差分数来量化删除后信息是否仍可从派生记忆层级中恢复。在LongMemEval数据集上进行实验。

主要发现: 关键事实摘要可显著降低加拿大鹅提取率，同时几乎保留所有个性化召回率；一旦内容被压缩，增加检索广度无法恢复泄露。然而，压缩会导致删除保真度失败：仅删除原始内容会使派生摘要副本在约百分之二十的案例中可恢复，只有全管道清除或墓碑重定向才能使最底层残差为零。

结论: 持久的智能体记忆必须作为首要记忆机制进行评估，评估内容包括它帮助智能体回忆什么、使什么可被提取以及它能真正擦除什么。

翻译: Foundation-model agents are increasingly long-lived systems that remember users across interactions, making memorization an explicit deployment-time function rather than solely a property of model weights. Existing work addresses parametric memorization or audits fixed memory configurations, but does not characterize how memory-design choices jointly shape personalization utility, extraction risk, and deletion fidelity. We study this surface as deployment-time memorization, formulating agent memory as a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall (PR) and Adversarial Extraction Rate (AER), and sweeping three memory-design knobs: summarization aggressiveness, retrieval breadth (k), and deletion mode. We further introduce the Forgetting Residue Score (FRS) to quantify whether deleted information remains recoverable from derived memory tiers. On LongMemEval, key-fact summarization reduces canary extraction by 76% on Gemma 3 12B and 64% on GPT-4o-mini while preserving nearly all personalization recall; critically, once content is compressed away, increasing k no longer restores leakage. The same compression, however, induces a deletion-fidelity failure: raw-only deletion leaves derived summary copies recoverable in approximately 20% of instances, and only full-pipeline purge or tombstone redaction drives worst-tier residue to zero. Together, these results establish that persistent agent memory must be evaluated as a first-class memorization mechanism -- assessed by what it helps agents recall, what it makes extractable, and what it can truly erase.

Abstract

Foundation-model agents are increasingly long-lived systems that remember users across interactions, making memorization an explicit deployment-time function rather than solely a property of model weights. Existing work addresses parametric memorization or audits fixed memory configurations, but does not characterize how memory-design choices jointly shape personalization utility, extraction risk, and deletion fidelity. We study this surface as deployment-time memorization, formulating agent memory as a privacy-utility frontier measured by Personalization Recall (PR) and Adversarial Extraction Rate (AER), and sweeping three memory-design knobs: summarization aggressiveness, retrieval breadth (k), and deletion mode. We further introduce the Forgetting Residue Score (FRS) to quantify whether deleted information remains recoverable from derived memory tiers. On LongMemEval, key-fact summarization reduces canary extraction by 76% on Gemma 3 12B and 64% on GPT-4o-mini while preserving nearly all personalization recall; critically, once content is compressed away, increasing k no longer restores leakage. The same compression, however, induces a deletion-fidelity failure: raw-only deletion leaves derived summary copies recoverable in approximately 20% of instances, and only full-pipeline purge or tombstone redaction drives worst-tier residue to zero. Together, these results establish that persistent agent memory must be evaluated as a first-class memorization mechanism -- assessed by what it helps agents recall, what it makes extractable, and what it can truly erase.

item.title: A Theory on Flow Matching with Neural Networks
item.author: Yihan He, Qishuo Yin, Yuan Cao, Jianqing Fan, Han Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究为基于神经网络参数化条件速度场的流匹配方法奠定了理论基础。

背景: 流匹配是一种生成模型方法，但缺乏严格的理论保证。

目的: 建立流匹配方法的理论框架，提供收敛性和泛化性保证。

方法: 使用两层ReLU神经网络在过参数化 regime 下分析梯度下降的收敛性，推导条件速度场匹配目标的泛化界，并基于多任务表示学习的泛化界分析生成样本的Wasserstein距离保证。

主要发现: 在过参数化两层ReLU神经网络中，梯度下降具有收敛保证；条件速度场匹配目标存在泛化界；生成的样本在Wasserstein距离下具有保证。

结论: 理论结果在合成数据和真实图像基准上通过实验验证，表明该方法具有理论支持和实际有效性。

翻译: In this work, we develop theoretical foundation for flow matching with neural-network-parameterized conditional velocity fields. We establish convergence guarantees for gradient descent in the over-parameterized 2-layered ReLU neural network regime. We derive generalization bounds for the conditional velocity-field matching objective. Building on these results, we provide Wasserstein-distance guarantees for the samples generated by the induced flow. Our analysis is based on generalization bound for multi-task representation learning with unbounded losses, which may be of independent interest beyond flow-based generative modeling. These theoretical results are validated through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world image benchmarks.

Abstract

In this work, we develop theoretical foundation for flow matching with neural-network-parameterized conditional velocity fields. We establish convergence guarantees for gradient descent in the over-parameterized 2-layered ReLU neural network regime. We derive generalization bounds for the conditional velocity-field matching objective. Building on these results, we provide Wasserstein-distance guarantees for the samples generated by the induced flow. Our analysis is based on generalization bound for multi-task representation learning with unbounded losses, which may be of independent interest beyond flow-based generative modeling. These theoretical results are validated through extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world image benchmarks.

item.title: Unsupervised Style Representation Learning for AI-Text Detection via Paraphrase Inversion
item.author: Rafael Rivera Soto, Barry Chen, Nicholas Andrews
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种无需作者身份标签即可学习判别性风格特征的方法，通过训练风格编码器从机器生成的转述中重建人类 authored 文本，并在训练过程中冻结语义编码器以迫使风格编码器仅捕获非语义特征。该方法在少样本和零样本检测设置中均表现出色，且学到的表示能泛化到未见过的任务和大型语言模型。

背景: 大型语言模型的快速发展引发了对滥用行为（如抄袭、错误信息和自动化影响操作）的担忧，促使需要强大的检测器。近期的研究表明，写作风格的神经表示对于检测有效，并且对击败大多数现有检测器的对抗性攻击具有鲁棒性。然而，当前的基于风格的检测器依赖于作者身份标签进行训练，并且仅限于少样本推理，需要可能无法获得的分布内样本。

目的: 学习无需作者身份标签的判别性风格特征，以解决当前基于风格的检测器对作者身份标签的依赖以及少样本推理的限制。

方法: 训练一个风格编码器，使其能够从机器生成的转述中重建人类 authored 文本。在训练过程中冻结语义编码器，从而偏置风格编码器仅捕获重建所需的非语义特征。通过两种检测策略评估学到的表示：少样本检测器和基于零样本 DeepSVDD 的检测器。

主要发现: 在少样本设置中，该方法在基准测试中匹配或优于所有基线。在零样本设置中，该方法在分布内测试数据上与完全监督的分类器具有竞争力，并且对未见过的语言模型具有更好的泛化能力。此外，学到的表示泛化到未见过的任务，在作者身份验证和细粒度风格区分方面取得了具有竞争力的性能，尽管从未针对这些目标进行过训练。

结论: 提出的方法能够有效学习判别性风格特征，无需作者身份标签，并在检测和泛化任务中表现出色，为大型语言模型检测提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: 大型语言模型的快速发展引发了对滥用行为（如抄袭、错误信息和自动化影响操作）的担忧，促使需要强大的检测器。近期的研究表明，写作风格的神经表示对于检测有效，并且对击败大多数现有检测器的对抗性攻击具有鲁棒性。然而，当前的基于风格的检测器依赖于作者身份标签进行训练，并且仅限于少样本推理，需要可能无法获得的分布内样本。我们通过学习判别性风格特征来解决这一问题，方法是训练一个风格编码器从机器生成的转述中重建人类 authored 文本；在训练过程中冻结语义编码器，从而偏置风格编码器仅捕获重建所需的非语义特征。我们通过两种检测策略评估学到的表示：少样本检测器和基于零样本 DeepSVDD 的检测器。在基准测试中，该方法在少样本设置中匹配或优于所有基线，在零样本设置中，在分布内测试数据上与完全监督的分类器具有竞争力，并且对未见过的语言模型具有更好的泛化能力。除了检测之外，学到的表示泛化到未见过的任务，在作者身份验证和细粒度风格区分方面取得了具有竞争力的性能，尽管从未针对这些目标进行过训练。

Abstract

The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has raised concerns about misuse such as plagiarism, misinformation, and automated influence operations, motivating the need for robust detectors. Recent work has shown that neural representations of writing style are effective for detection and, crucially, robust to adversarial attacks that defeat most existing detectors. However, current style-based detectors rely on authorship labels for training, and are limited to few-shot inference for detection, requiring in-distribution samples that may not always be available. We learn discriminative style features without authorship labels by training a style encoder to reconstruct human-authored text from its machine-generated paraphrase; freezing a semantic encoder during training biases the style encoder to capture only the non-semantic features needed for reconstruction. We evaluate the learned representations via two detection strategies: a few-shot detector and a zero-shot DeepSVDD-based detector. Across benchmarks, our method matches or outperforms all baselines in the few-shot setting and, in the zero-shot regime, is competitive with fully supervised classifiers on in-distribution test data while generalizing better to unseen LLMs. Beyond detection, the learned representations generalize to unseen tasks, achieving competitive performance on authorship verification and fine-grained style discrimination despite never being trained on either objective.

item.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
item.author: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Abilio de Carvalho Junior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为iSAGE的迭代稀疏标注框架，通过专家点击针对模型的高置信度错误进行标注，无需辅助扩展机制即可实现与密集监督相媲美的性能。

背景: 遥感语义分割需要昂贵的像素级标注，且模型在不同传感器、平台或地理区域间难以迁移，导致每个问题都需要新数据集。现有的人机交互框架依赖伪标签、传播等辅助机制将稀疏点击扩展为密集监督，但无法区分模型的高置信度正确与错误像素。

目的: 验证专家针对模型高置信度错误的点击是否足以匹配密集监督效果，且无需任何扩展机制。

方法: 提出iSAGE框架，在开源平台上实现，通过误差加权损失放大每次点击的梯度，将标注记录本身作为可扩展、可纠正和可审计的数据集。实验采用最小努力策略，每帧每类最多一个标注像素。

主要发现: 在BsB Aerial数据集上，iSAGE使用0.040%的像素达到74.79%的mIoU，恢复密集监督的97.2%性能；在ISPRS Vaihingen数据集上，使用0.011%的像素达到76.78%的mIoU，匹配密集基线并超越所有已发表方法。四种输出读取机制性能均低于iSAGE。iSAGE是唯一无需辅助机制的迭代人机交互框架。

结论: 专家针对模型高置信度错误的稀疏点击足以实现与密集监督相当的性能，iSAGE框架在极低标注成本下达到最优性能，且无需辅助扩展机制。

翻译: Semantic segmentation in remote sensing requires costly pixel-level annotations, and nearly every problem demands a new dataset since models rarely transfer across sensors, platforms, or geographies. Existing human-in-the-loop frameworks expand sparse clicks into dense supervision via auxiliary machinery (pseudo-labels, propagation, CRFs, foundation-model prompts, auxiliary heads), all operating on the model's predictive distribution. A confidently wrong pixel is indistinguishable from a confidently correct one in that distribution by construction, so no rule reading it can separate the two; the distinguishing signal is external to the model. This paper hypothesizes that expert clicks targeting confident model errors, not arbitrary pixels, suffice to match dense supervision, with no expansion machinery. iSAGE (Iterative Sparse Annotation Guided by Expert) realizes this hypothesis on an integrated open-source platform, where an error-weighted loss amplifies the gradient at each click and the annotation record itself is the dataset, extensible, correctable, and auditable. Experiments use a minimum-effort regime: at most one labeled pixel per class per frame. On BsB Aerial, iSAGE recovers 97.2% of dense supervision (74.79% mIoU on 0.040% of pixels) with contrasting class dynamics: amorphous classes (permeable areas) saturate from the seed, while small classes (cars) require late-iteration effort. On ISPRS Vaihingen (external benchmark), iSAGE reaches 76.78% mIoU with 0.011% of pixels, matching the dense baseline (76.65%) and exceeding all published methods. Under the same pipeline, four output-reading mechanisms (oracle entropy across budgets 1--100x, pseudo-labels across thresholds 0.90--0.99, CRF-based propagation, uniform random) plateau 7.4 to 14.5 pp below iSAGE. Across 31 surveyed methods, iSAGE is the only iterative human-in-the-loop framework operating without auxiliary machinery.

Abstract

Semantic segmentation in remote sensing requires costly pixel-level annotations, and nearly every problem demands a new dataset since models rarely transfer across sensors, platforms, or geographies. Existing human-in-the-loop frameworks expand sparse clicks into dense supervision via auxiliary machinery (pseudo-labels, propagation, CRFs, foundation-model prompts, auxiliary heads), all operating on the model's predictive distribution. A confidently wrong pixel is indistinguishable from a confidently correct one in that distribution by construction, so no rule reading it can separate the two; the distinguishing signal is external to the model. This paper hypothesizes that expert clicks targeting confident model errors, not arbitrary pixels, suffice to match dense supervision, with no expansion machinery. iSAGE (Iterative Sparse Annotation Guided by Expert) realizes this hypothesis on an integrated open-source platform, where an error-weighted loss amplifies the gradient at each click and the annotation record itself is the dataset, extensible, correctable, and auditable. Experiments use a minimum-effort regime: at most one labeled pixel per class per frame. On BsB Aerial, iSAGE recovers 97.2% of dense supervision (74.79% mIoU on 0.040% of pixels) with contrasting class dynamics: amorphous classes (permeable areas) saturate from the seed, while small classes (cars) require late-iteration effort. On ISPRS Vaihingen (external benchmark), iSAGE reaches 76.78% mIoU with 0.011% of pixels, matching the dense baseline (76.65%) and exceeding all published methods. Under the same pipeline, four output-reading mechanisms (oracle entropy across budgets 1--100x, pseudo-labels across thresholds 0.90--0.99, CRF-based propagation, uniform random) plateau 7.4 to 14.5 pp below iSAGE. Across 31 surveyed methods, iSAGE is the only iterative human-in-the-loop framework operating without auxiliary machinery.

item.title: Local Is Not a Sufficient Privacy Boundary: Governing OS-Integrated On-Device AI
item.author: Jonghyun Chung, Sanket Badhe
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种以操作系统为中心的隐私框架，用于设备端人工智能系统。该框架将隐私视为制度问责问题而非部署属性，包含威胁模型、六部分隐私风险分类、隐私架构控制及四级审计标准。通过对比苹果智能、安卓AICore和微软Recall等系统，验证了该框架的有效性。

背景: 随着人工智能系统进入操作系统，隐私问题不再仅取决于模型是否本地运行。本地助手可能收集多种数据、保留衍生状态、调用工具或连接云端，本地推理仅解决计算位置问题，无法回答上下文组装权限、持久化状态、授权行为及系统更新影响等关键问题。

目的: 开发一种以操作系统为中心的隐私框架，用于设备端人工智能，将隐私视为制度问责问题而非部署属性。

方法: 构建包含威胁模型、六部分隐私风险分类、隐私架构控制及四级审计标准的框架，并通过文档对比苹果智能、安卓AICore和微软Recall等系统进行验证。

主要发现: 通过文档对比发现，苹果智能、安卓AICore和微软Recall等系统在隐私风险分类和审计标准下存在差异，验证了框架的适用性。

结论: 设备端人工智能的有意义隐私依赖于受限的信息流、有界的权限、可见的用户控制以及贯穿操作系统生命周期的可审计治理。

翻译: As AI systems move into operating systems, privacy no longer turns only on whether a model runs locally. A local assistant may assemble email, calendar entries, files, screenshots, notifications, and app intents; retain embeddings or summaries; invoke tools; emit telemetry; or route difficult requests to cloud infrastructure. Local inference reduces some exposure, but it answers only one question: where computation occurs. It does not answer who may assemble context, what derived state persists, which actions are authorized, or how updates change the system's authority. We develop an OS-centered privacy framework for on-device AI that treats privacy as an institutional accountability problem rather than a deployment attribute. The framework specifies a threat model, a six-part privacy risk taxonomy, privacy-by-architecture controls, and a four-level audit rubric. We demonstrate the rubric through a documentation-bounded comparison of Apple Intelligence/Foundation Models, Android AICore/Gemini Nano, and Microsoft Recall. Meaningful privacy in on-device AI depends on constrained information flow, bounded authority, visible user control, and auditable governance across the operating-system lifecycle.

Abstract

As AI systems move into operating systems, privacy no longer turns only on whether a model runs locally. A local assistant may assemble email, calendar entries, files, screenshots, notifications, and app intents; retain embeddings or summaries; invoke tools; emit telemetry; or route difficult requests to cloud infrastructure. Local inference reduces some exposure, but it answers only one question: where computation occurs. It does not answer who may assemble context, what derived state persists, which actions are authorized, or how updates change the system's authority. We develop an OS-centered privacy framework for on-device AI that treats privacy as an institutional accountability problem rather than a deployment attribute. The framework specifies a threat model, a six-part privacy risk taxonomy, privacy-by-architecture controls, and a four-level audit rubric. We demonstrate the rubric through a documentation-bounded comparison of Apple Intelligence/Foundation Models, Android AICore/Gemini Nano, and Microsoft Recall. Meaningful privacy in on-device AI depends on constrained information flow, bounded authority, visible user control, and auditable governance across the operating-system lifecycle.

item.title: Integral Field Unit Spectroscopy with One Fiber
item.author: Zehao Peng, Biprateep Dey, Chris J. Maddison, Joshua S. Speagle
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种多模态概率基础模型，能够从宽带图像直接预测星系任意空间位置的高分辨率光谱及其校准的不确定性，无需使用积分场单元光谱数据。

背景: 积分场单元光谱技术能够提供星系的空间分辨光谱，对理解星系演化至关重要，但其高昂的观测成本限制了当前数据集的规模，仅包含约一万颗星系。

目的: 旨在利用宽带图像预测高分辨率光谱，以克服积分场单元光谱数据稀缺的问题，实现类似积分场单元光谱的能力。

方法: 基于掩码自编码器框架，注入光纤位置编码和红移感知波长编码，构建空间条件预测架构。模型在暗能量光谱仪巡天项目的四百七十万张图像和单光纤光谱观测数据上进行训练，利用光纤放置的自然变异和星系的形态自相似性。

主要发现: 预测的发射线通量图与阿帕奇点天文台附近星系测绘巡天项目的独立积分场单元观测结果相匹配，其性能与直接在积分场单元数据上训练的监督基线相当。

结论: 该模型成功实现了无需积分场单元训练数据即可生成类似积分场单元光谱的能力，为大规模星系光谱研究提供了有效途径。

翻译: Integral field unit spectroscopy provides spatially resolved spectra across galaxies, offering crucial insights into their evolution. However, its high observational cost limits current IFU datasets to ~ 10^4 objects. We present a multi-modal, probabilistic foundation model that predicts high-resolution spectra with calibrated uncertainties at arbitrary spatial locations within a galaxy directly from broadband images. Built on a masked autoencoder framework, our architecture injects fiber positional encodings and redshift aware wavelength encodings, enabling spatially conditioned predictions. Trained on 4.7 million images and single fiber spectroscopic observations from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument survey, our model exploits the natural variance of fiber placements and the morphological self-similarity of galaxies to achieve IFU-like capabilities without any IFU training data. Predicted emission line flux maps match independent IFU observations from the Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO survey, with performance comparable to a supervised baseline trained directly on IFU data.

Abstract

Integral field unit (IFU) spectroscopy provides spatially resolved spectra across galaxies, offering crucial insights into their evolution. However, its high observational cost limits current IFU datasets to $\sim 10^4$ objects. We present a multi-modal, probabilistic foundation model that predicts high-resolution spectra with calibrated uncertainties at arbitrary spatial locations within a galaxy directly from broadband images. Built on a masked autoencoder framework, our architecture injects fiber positional encodings and redshift aware wavelength encodings, enabling spatially conditioned predictions. Trained on 4.7 million images and single fiber spectroscopic observations from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) survey, our model exploits the natural variance of fiber placements and the morphological self-similarity of galaxies to achieve IFU-like capabilities without any IFU training data. Predicted emission line flux maps match independent IFU observations from the Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO (MaNGA) survey, with performance comparable to a supervised baseline trained directly on IFU data.

item.title: Exploration of Foundation Model-Based Robots in Patient and Elderly Care
item.author: Zhiwen Qiu, Wei Liu, Yuexing Hao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 随着全球人口老龄化，对老年护理和患者护理的需求迅速增长。基础模型正被整合到机器人和交互代理中，以提供更灵活的沟通和个性化协助。然而，护理环境需要可靠且与工作流程兼容的系统，并需要负责任的人类监督。目前尚不清楚现有的具身系统能否将技术进展转化为临床影响。本文综合了基于基础模型的护理机器人在设计特征、用户体验和护理相关结果证据方面的研究。当前系统主要将基础模型用作以语音为中心的社交辅助具身中的对话和推理层，而多模态 grounding 和物理自主性仍然有限。实证评估报告了积极的可用性和参与度益处，但可靠性故障（如幻觉和对话中断）在交互管道中仍然存在。关于护理影响的证据仍集中在认知参与和参与度等近端结果上，缺乏对经过验证的临床或护理相关变化的证据。作者认为，未来的研究应转向护理特定的评估标准、负责任自主性以及整合到护理工作流程中，以支持更具响应性和责任性的护理技术。

背景: 全球人口老龄化导致对老年护理和患者护理的需求迅速增长。基础模型正被越来越多地整合到机器人和交互代理中，旨在提供更灵活的沟通和个性化协助。然而，护理环境要求系统可靠、与工作流程兼容，并具备负责任的人类监督。目前尚不清楚现有的具身系统能否将技术进展转化为实际的临床影响。

目的: 综合基于基础模型的护理机器人在设计特征、用户体验以及护理相关结果证据方面的研究，以评估其当前状态和未来发展方向。

方法: 通过视角性综述（Perspective）的方式，综合分析了基于基础模型的护理机器人在设计特征、用户体验和护理相关结果证据三个方面的现有研究。

主要发现: 当前系统主要将基础模型用作以语音为中心的社交辅助具身中的对话和推理层，多模态 grounding 和物理自主性有限。实证评估显示系统具有积极的可用性和参与度益处，但存在可靠性故障如幻觉和对话中断。关于护理影响的证据主要集中在认知参与和参与度等近端结果，缺乏对经过验证的临床或护理相关变化的证据。

结论: 未来的研究应转向护理特定的评估标准、负责任自主性以及整合到护理工作流程中，以支持更具响应性和责任性的护理技术。

翻译: 随着全球人口老龄化，对老年护理和患者护理的需求迅速增长。基础模型正被越来越多地整合到机器人和交互代理中，旨在提供更灵活的沟通和个性化协助。然而，护理环境要求系统可靠、与工作流程兼容，并具备负责任的人类监督。目前尚不清楚现有的具身系统能否将技术进展转化为实际的临床影响。本文综合了基于基础模型的护理机器人在设计特征、用户体验以及护理相关结果证据方面的研究。当前系统主要将基础模型用作以语音为中心的社交辅助具身中的对话和推理层，而多模态 grounding 和物理自主性仍然有限。实证评估报告了积极的可用性和参与度益处，但可靠性故障（如幻觉和对话中断）在交互管道中仍然存在。关于护理影响的证据仍集中在认知参与和参与度等近端结果上，缺乏对经过验证的临床或护理相关变化的证据。作者认为，未来的研究应转向护理特定的评估标准、负责任自主性以及整合到护理工作流程中，以支持更具响应性和责任性的护理技术。

Abstract

Demand for older-adult and patient care is growing rapidly as populations age worldwide. Foundation models are increasingly being integrated into robots and interactive agents, with the promise of more flexible communication and personalized assistance. However, care settings require reliable and workflow-compatible systems with accountable human oversight, and it remains unclear whether current embodied systems can translate technical advances into clinical impact. This Perspective synthesizes foundation model-based care robots across three areas: design features, user experience, and evidence for care-related outcomes. Current systems most commonly use foundation models as conversational and reasoning layers within voice-centered socially assistive embodiments, while multimodal grounding and physical autonomy remain limited. Empirical evaluations report positive usability and engagement benefits, but reliability failures persist across the interaction pipeline such as hallucinations and conversational breakdowns. Evidence for care impact remains concentrated in proximal outcomes such as cognitive engagement and participation, with limited evidence for validated clinical or care-related changes. We argue that future research should transition toward care-specific evaluation standards, accountable autonomy, and integration into care workflows to support more responsive and responsible care technologies.

item.title: TestMap: Evidence Infrastructure for Foundation-Model-Assisted Test Generation
item.author: Hunter Leary, Luke Hanuska, Chris Brown
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TestMap的开源基础设施原型，旨在自动化基于证据的、由基础模型辅助的C#和.NET代码库的测试生成过程。该工具支持从仓库分析到测试验证、修复及实验跟踪的完整生命周期管理，通过记录生成测试的中间结果来揭示模型局限性和工具链问题，使生成的测试具备可观察性、可重复性和可比性。

背景: 基础模型能够生成看似合理的单元测试，但确定这些测试是否正确、有用、可维护且值得集成仍然非常困难。生成的测试需要映射到目标代码、插入真实项目、构建、执行、与基线套件对比、必要时进行修复，并跨模型和生成策略进行比较。这一验证过程分散在构建系统、测试运行器、覆盖率工具、变异工具、静态分析器和实验脚本中。由于生成的测试既是代码工件又是验证工件，必须在信任它们作为被测系统证据之前对其进行验证。

目的: 解决生成测试验证过程碎片化的问题，为C#和.NET代码库提供一个自动化、基于证据的基础模型辅助测试生成基础设施，使生成的测试在跨仓库、模型、提示和生成策略的比较中具备可观察性、可重复性和可比性。

方法: 开发了TestMap原型系统，支持仓库分析、源测试映射、基线执行、代码指标收集、测试异味检测、覆盖率测量、变异测试、模型引导的测试生成、验证、修复以及特定仓库的实验跟踪。系统记录每个生成候选项的生命周期，包括失败、修复、低影响和证据积极的结果，而非仅报告最终通过的测试。

主要发现: TestMap记录了生成测试的完整生命周期，包括失败、修复、低影响和证据积极的结果。这些中间结果可以揭示模型局限性、缺失上下文、修复成本、工具链效率低下或被测系统中可能的故障。

结论: 通过TestMap的设计案例，描述了使生成测试可观察、可重复和可比的架构和证据模型。最后总结了经验教训和开放挑战，包括断言质量、指标归因、测试可维护性、不稳定性、执行成本和开发者接受度。

翻译: 基础模型可以生成合理的单元测试，但确定这些测试是否正确、有用、可维护且值得集成仍然很困难。生成的测试必须映射到它们针对的代码，插入到真实项目中，构建，执行，与基线套件进行比较，必要时进行修复，并跨模型和生成策略进行比较。这一验证过程分散在构建系统、测试运行器、覆盖率工具、变异工具、静态分析器和实验脚本中。这个问题尤为重要，因为生成的测试既是代码工件又是验证工件：在它们被信任为被测系统的证据之前，必须对它们本身进行验证。本文提出了TestMap，一个开源的基础设施原型，用于自动化基于证据的基础模型辅助的C#和.NET代码库的测试生成。TestMap支持仓库分析、源测试映射、基线执行、代码指标收集、测试异味检测、覆盖率测量、变异测试、模型引导的测试生成、验证、修复和特定仓库的实验跟踪。TestMap不仅报告最终通过的测试，还记录每个生成候选项的生命周期，包括失败、修复、低影响和证据积极的结果。这些中间结果可以揭示模型局限性、缺失上下文、修复成本、工具链效率低下或被测系统中可能的故障。以TestMap作为设计案例，我们描述了使生成测试在跨仓库、模型、提示和生成策略的比较中可观察、可重复和可比的架构和证据模型。最后总结了经验教训和开放挑战，包括断言质量、指标归因、测试可维护性、不稳定性、执行成本和开发者接受度。

Abstract

Foundation models (FMs) can generate plausible unit tests, but determining whether those tests are correct, useful, maintainable, and worth integrating remains difficult. Generated tests must be mapped to the code they target, inserted into real projects, built, executed, measured against the baseline suite, repaired when necessary, and compared across models and generation strategies. This validation process is fragmented across build systems, test runners, coverage tools, mutation tools, static analyzers, and experiment scripts. The problem is especially important because generated tests are both code artifacts and validation artifacts: they must themselves be validated before they can be trusted as evidence about the system under test. This paper presents TestMap, an open-source infrastructure prototype that automates evidence-backed foundation-model-assisted test generation for C#/.NET repositories. TestMap supports repository analysis, source-test mapping, baseline execution, code metric collection, test smell detection, coverage measurement, mutation testing, model-guided test generation, validation, repair, and repository-specific experiment tracking. Rather than reporting only final passing tests, TestMap records the lifecycle of each generated candidate, including failed, repaired, low-impact, and evidence positive outcomes. These intermediate outcomes can reveal model limitations, missing context, repair cost, toolchain inefficiencies, or possible faults in the system under test. Using TestMap as a design case, we describe the architecture and evidence model needed to make generated tests observable, repeatable, and comparable across repositories, models, prompts, and generation strategies. We conclude with lessons learned and open challenges, including oracle and assertion quality, metric attribution, test maintainability, flakiness, execution cost, and developer acceptance.

item.title: Automated Pronunciation Evaluation for Korean Toddler Speech using Speech Diarization and Self-Supervised Learning
item.author: Diane Myung-kyung Woodbridge, Jee Hyun Suh
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于韩国幼儿语音自动发音评估的端到端流程，结合神经说话人分离与自监督语音表示学习。

背景: 韩国儿童沟通障碍病例中约百分之四十四存在语音障碍，但针对韩国幼儿语音的自动评估工具仍不发达。

方法: 构建并引入一个包含五十三段录音的韩国儿童语音语料库，由三名独立评审员标注辅音和元音的单词级正确性标签。评估三种说话人分离模型，并比较三种自监督学习骨干网络在不同池化策略下的表现，采用跨模型集成路由策略。

主要发现: NeMo SortFormer模型在说话人分离方面达到百分之八十八点六九的说话人数量准确率和百分之三十三点零四的分离错误率。在发音评分中，跨模型集成路由将辅音预测分配给HuBERT-large，元音预测分配给WavLM-large，实现平衡准确率分别为零点七二零和零点八四五，平均为零点七八二。

结论: 该端到端流程有效提升了韩国幼儿语音自动评估的准确性，为相关领域提供了新的工具和方法。

翻译: Speech sound disorders affect approximately 44% of Korean pediatric communication disorder cases, yet automated assessment tools for Korean toddler speech remain underdeveloped. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for automated pronunciation evaluation of Korean toddler speech, combining neural speaker diarization with self-supervised speech representation learning. We introduce a novel IRB-approved corpus of 53 recordings from Korean-speaking children aged 2-5 years. A subset of 53 subjects was annotated by three independent reviewers, yielding 1,190 consonant and 748 vowel word-level binary correctness labels. We evaluate three diarization models, finding that NeMo SortFormer achieves 88.69% speaker count accuracy and 33.04% diarization error rate (DER) owing to its arrival-time-sorted transformer architecture, which handles the acoustic confound between young female caregivers exhibiting aegyo and toddler speech. For pronunciation scoring, we compare three self-supervised learning (SSL) backbones across multiple pooling strategies. A cross-model ensemble routing consonant prediction to HuBERT-large and vowel prediction to WavLM-large achieves balanced accuracies of 0.720 and 0.845, with a mean of 0.782.

目的: 开发一种结合神经说话人分离与自监督语音表示学习的端到端流程，以实现对韩国幼儿语音的自动发音评估。

Abstract

Speech sound disorders affect approximately 44% of Korean pediatric communication disorder cases, yet automated assessment tools for Korean toddler speech remain underdeveloped. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for automated pronunciation evaluation of Korean toddler speech, combining neural speaker diarization with self-supervised speech representation learning. We introduce a novel IRB-approved corpus of 53 recordings from Korean-speaking children aged 2-5 years. A subset of 53 subjects was annotated by three independent reviewers, yielding 1,190 consonant and 748 vowel word-level binary correctness labels. We evaluate three diarization models, finding that NeMo SortFormer achieves 88.69% speaker count accuracy and 33.04% diarization error rate (DER) owing to its arrival-time-sorted transformer architecture, which handles the acoustic confound between young female caregivers exhibiting aegyo and toddler speech. For pronunciation scoring, we compare three self-supervised learning (SSL) backbones across multiple pooling strategies. A cross-model ensemble routing consonant prediction to HuBERT-large and vowel prediction to WavLM-large achieves balanced accuracies of 0.720 and 0.845, with a mean of 0.782.

item.title: A Source Domain is All You Need: Source-Only Cross-OS Transfer Learning for APT Anomaly Detection via Semantic Alignment and Optimal Transport
item.author: Sidahmed Benabderrahmanea, Petko Valtchev, James Cheney, Talal Rahwan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究针对跨操作系统环境下的高级持续性威胁检测问题，提出了一种基于最优传输的框架，通过系统级溯源轨迹对目标进程进行异常排序，无需目标域标签即可实现零监督异常检测。

背景: 高级持续性威胁具有隐蔽性和多阶段特征，由于标注数据稀缺、类别严重不平衡以及生成真实恶意行为困难，其检测极具挑战性。在跨操作系统场景中，需在无目标域标签的情况下，将在源平台训练的检测器部署到目标平台，挑战进一步加剧。

目的: 研究仅依赖源数据的跨操作系统高级持续性威胁检测问题，提出一种基于传输的框架，用于在零目标监督条件下对目标进程进行异常排序。

方法: 将进程行为抽象为结构化的自然语言描述，使用预训练语言模型进行嵌入，并构建源正常参考用于目标评分。结合三种证据通道：与源正常原型的语义偏差、图自编码捕获的结构偏差，以及通过最优传输测量的几何偏差。提出基于最优传输的重心异常分数，将目标嵌入投影到源正常流形上并量化残余传输不匹配。引入熵加权、角度感知和密度感知的最优传输变体以捕捉不确定性、方向漂移和稀疏支持行为。

主要发现: 在涵盖Linux、Windows、BSD和Android的DARPA透明计算数据上，针对两个高级持续性威胁场景和十二个跨操作系统转移对的评估表明，所提出的框架在ROC-AUC和nDCG指标上优于仅依赖源数据的异常检测基线。

结论: 仅依赖源数据的溯源建模，结合语义抽象和基于最优传输的异常评分，能够在无需目标域监督的情况下支持实际的跨平台高级持续性威胁检测。

翻译: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are stealthy, multi-stage cyberattacks whose detection is difficult due to scarce labeled traces, severe class imbalance, and the challenge of generating realistic malicious behavior. These challenges are amplified in cross-operating-system (cross-OS) settings, where a detector trained on one source platform must be deployed on an unlabeled target platform without access to target-domain labels. We study this source-only cross-OS APT detection problem using system-level provenance traces and propose a transport-based framework for ranking anomalous target processes under zero target supervision. The framework abstracts process behavior into structured natural-language descriptions, embeds them using pretrained language models, and constructs a source-normal reference for target scoring. It combines three evidence channels: semantic deviation from source-normal prototypes, structural deviation captured by graph autoencoding, and geometric deviation measured through Optimal Transport (OT). The main contribution is an OT-based barycentric anomaly score that projects target embeddings onto the source-normal manifold and quantifies residual transport mismatch. We further introduce entropy-weighted, angle-aware, and density-aware OT variants to capture uncertainty, directional drift, and sparse-support behavior. Evaluation on DARPA Transparent Computing data spanning Linux, Windows, BSD, and Android, across two APT scenarios and twelve cross-OS transfer pairs, shows that the proposed framework improves ROC-AUC and nDCG over source-only anomaly-detection baselines. The results demonstrate that source-only provenance modeling, combined with semantic abstraction and OT-based anomaly scoring, can support practical cross-platform APT detection without target-domain supervision.

Abstract

Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) are stealthy, multi-stage cyberattacks whose detection is difficult due to scarce labeled traces, severe class imbalance, and the challenge of generating realistic malicious behavior. These challenges are amplified in cross-operating-system (cross-OS) settings, where a detector trained on one source platform must be deployed on an unlabeled target platform without access to target-domain labels. We study this source-only cross-OS APT detection problem using system-level provenance traces and propose a transport-based framework for ranking anomalous target processes under zero target supervision. The framework abstracts process behavior into structured natural-language descriptions, embeds them using pretrained language models, and constructs a source-normal reference for target scoring. It combines three evidence channels: semantic deviation from source-normal prototypes, structural deviation captured by graph autoencoding, and geometric deviation measured through Optimal Transport (OT). The main contribution is an OT-based barycentric anomaly score that projects target embeddings onto the source-normal manifold and quantifies residual transport mismatch. We further introduce entropy-weighted, angle-aware, and density-aware OT variants to capture uncertainty, directional drift, and sparse-support behavior. Evaluation on DARPA Transparent Computing data spanning Linux, Windows, BSD, and Android, across two APT scenarios and twelve cross-OS transfer pairs, shows that the proposed framework improves ROC-AUC and nDCG over source-only anomaly-detection baselines. The results demonstrate that source-only provenance modeling, combined with semantic abstraction and OT-based anomaly scoring, can support practical cross-platform APT detection without target-domain supervision.

item.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
item.author: Takehiko Ohkawa, Jumpei Arima, Yuki Noguchi, Masatoshi Tateno, Makoto Sugiura, Takuya Okubo, Kengo Ikeuchi, Yuma Shin, Hiroki Nishizawa, Naoaki Kanazawa, Yuki Wakayama, Daiki Fukunaga, Koshi Makihara, Tomohiro Motoda, Floris Erich, Yukiyasu Domae, Tatsuya Matsushima, Yohishiro Okumatsu, Kei Ota
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了屈服通用双数字接口（YUBI），这是一种手指对齐的夹持器，旨在为双手灵巧操作提供直观、人体工学且可扩展的数据收集。

背景: 现有的手持式数据收集系统（如通用操作接口 UMI）虽然成本较低，但其笨重的枪柄设计在精细灵巧操作任务中可能带来人体工学和可用性挑战。

目的: 解决现有手持式数据收集系统在精细灵巧操作任务中的人体工学和可用性挑战，实现更直观、高效的双手操作数据收集。

方法: 设计了一种具有屈服、手指驱动执行原理的 YUBI 夹持器，直接将人类手指运动映射到夹持器 jaws 运动；结合基于虚拟现实（VR）的六自由度夹持器跟踪，建立高保真轨迹数据采集系统；收集了包含 8434 小时、120 万集和 119 个任务的超大规模 UMI 数据集。

主要发现: YUBI 在复杂双手任务的通用性、灵巧性和操作效率方面优于 UMI 夹持器；在 YUBI 数据集上训练的单一策略只需将夹持器安装到不同平台（UR、Franka 和 ELEY）即可在多种双手机器人上迁移，证实收集的数据可直接作为策略监督执行。

结论: YUBI 提供了开源的夹持器硬件、数据采集软件和数据集作为集成堆栈，为社区提供了可复现的大规模数据采集路径，以推动机器人基础模型的发展。

翻译: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.

Abstract

We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.

item.title: A Unified Adaptive Feature Composition Framework for Multi-Task Generalization in Wireless Foundation Models
item.author: Yuxuan Shi, Tingting Yang, Kangning Ma, Liwen Jing, Yuwei Wang, Mengfan Zheng, Li Sun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于无线基础模型多任务泛化的统一自适应特征组合框架，核心组件为路由适配器用于特征组合。该框架通过路由机制将不同Transformer深度的隐藏状态作为可复用的多层特征池，利用轻量级任务驱动的特征组合网络生成逐层聚合权重，从而自适应地组合分层表示。实验表明，该方法在四个代表性无线任务中持续优于传统适应基线，且仅增加少于五万额外参数。此外，学习到的路由权重提供了任务特定层偏好的可解释证据，使该框架成为适应无线基础模型到多样化下游场景的低复杂度、可扩展且可解释的接口。

背景: 无线基础模型在学习通用信道表示方面展现出强大潜力，但其适应各种下游任务的能力仍受现有范式的限制。微调策略引入了巨大的计算和存储开销，而冻结特征提取则在多样化的下游任务中导致次优性能。

目的: 解决无线基础模型适应各种下游任务时面临的计算开销大和性能次优的问题，实现多任务泛化。

方法: 提出统一自适应特征组合框架，核心为路由适配器用于特征组合。该框架不提取最终层输出，而是将不同Transformer深度的隐藏状态作为可复用的多层特征池，使用轻量级任务驱动的特征组合网络生成逐层聚合权重，通过加权求和自适应组合分层表示，无需修改预训练骨干网络。

主要发现: 在四个代表性无线任务上的广泛实验表明，路由适配器用于特征组合持续优于传统适应基线，同时引入的额外参数少于五万。学习到的路由权重提供了任务特定层偏好的可解释证据。

结论: 该框架是一种低复杂度、可扩展且可解释的接口，能够有效地将无线基础模型适应到多样化的下游场景中。

翻译: 尽管无线基础模型在学习通用信道表示方面展现出强大潜力，但其适应各种下游任务的能力仍受现有范式的限制。微调策略引入了巨大的计算和存储开销，而冻结特征提取则在多样化的下游任务中导致次优性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于无线基础模型多任务泛化的统一自适应特征组合框架，其核心组件是用于特征组合的路由适配器。该路由器不提取最终层输出，而是将不同Transformer深度的隐藏状态视为可复用的多层隐藏特征池，并采用轻量级任务驱动的特征组合网络生成逐层聚合权重，然后通过加权求和自适应地组合分层表示。这种设计使得每个下游任务无需修改预训练骨干网络即可访问低、中、高层无线特征的合适混合。在四个代表性无线任务上的广泛实验表明，路由适配器用于特征组合持续优于传统适应基线，同时引入的额外参数少于五万。此外，学习到的路由权重提供了任务特定层偏好的可解释证据，使所提出的框架成为适应无线基础模型到多样化下游场景的低复杂度、可扩展且可解释的接口。

Abstract

Though wireless foundation models (WFMs) have shown strong potential in learning universal channel representations, their adaptation to various downstream tasks remains constrained by existing paradigms. Fine-tuning strategies introduces substantial computational and storage overhead, while frozen feature extraction leads to sub-optimal performance across diverse downstream tasks. To address this issue, we propose a unified adaptive feature composition framework for multitask generalization in WFMs, where the key component is the Routing Adapter for Feature Composition (RAFC). Instead of extracting only the final-layer output, this router treats the hidden states from different Transformer depths as a reusable pool of multi-level hidden features, and employs a lightweight task-driven feature composition network to generate layer-wise aggregation weights, then adaptively combine hierarchical representations through weighted summation. This design enables each downstream task to access suitable mixture of low-, mid-, and high-level wireless features without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on four representative wireless tasks demonstrate that RAFC consistently outperforms conventional adaptation baselines while introducing fewer than 50K additional parameters. Moreover, the learned routing weights provide interpretable evidence of task-specific layer preferences, making the proposed framework a low-complexity, scalable, and explainable interface for adapting WFMs to diverse downstream scenarios.

item.title: Revisiting Positive Samples in Graph Contrastive Learning: From the Perspective of Message Passing
item.author: Lianze Shan, Ningchong Wang, Jitao Zhao, Di Jin, Dongxiao He
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对图对比学习中正样本机制的局限性，提出了一种名为SPGCL的新方法，通过区分不同狄利克雷能量特征的作用，优化正样本的构建与学习过程，从而提升模型性能。

背景: 图对比学习通过将图编码器训练为最大化正样本相似度并最小化负样本相似度，已成为主流的图预训练范式。正样本通常被认为对图对比学习至关重要，理想情况下能帮助编码器捕捉图数据的内在语义和模式。

目的: 重新审视图对比学习中正样本的根本机制，解决因消息传递机制导致正样本最大化过程被平凡化、从而无法有效学习正样本的问题。

方法: 提出SPGCL方法，通过狄利克雷能量视角分析特征。该方法仅传播高狄利克雷能量特征以提供有效的学习信号，同时利用低狄利克雷能量特征构建概率矩阵，用于构建可靠的正样本。

主要发现: 图对比学习即使在没有正样本的情况下也能取得具有竞争力的性能。从狄利克雷能量角度看，消息传递机制会平凡化正样本的最大化过程。高狄利克雷能量特征有助于提供有效的学习信号，而低狄利克雷能量特征对学习信号贡献较小，但对构建正样本有用。

结论: SPGCL方法通过缓解消息传递导致的平凡化问题并恢复正样本的学习效能，在广泛实验中证明了其有效性。

翻译: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL), which trains graph encoders by maximizing similarity between positive samples and minimizing it between negative ones, has emerged as a mainstream graph pre-training paradigm. It is widely recognized that positive samples are essential in GCLs. Ideally, maximizing the similarity of positive samples enables graph encoders to capture intrinsic semantic and patterns of graph data. However, we discover an interesting phenomenon: GCLs can achieve competitive performance even without positive samples. This motivates us to revisit the fundamental mechanism of positive samples in GCLs. From the perspective of Dirichlet energy, we theoretically finds that message passing, a key mechanism in graph encoders, trivializes the maximization of positive samples, preventing GCLs from effectively learning from positive samples.
