To address this, we propose SPGCL to mitigate the trivialization caused by message passing and restore the learning efficacy of positive samples. Specifically, we find that high Dirichlet energy features help positive samples provide effective learning signals while low Dirichlet energy features contribute little to positive learning signal but is useful for positive sampling. Based on this, SPGCL propagates only high Dirichlet energy features and uses low energy features to construct a probability matrix for reliable positive sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of SPGCL.

Abstract

Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL), which trains graph encoders by maximizing similarity between positive samples and minimizing it between negative ones, has emerged as a mainstream graph pre-training paradigm. It is widely recognized that positive samples are essential in GCLs. Ideally, maximizing the similarity of positive samples enables graph encoders to capture intrinsic semantic and patterns of graph data. However, we discover an interesting phenomenon: GCLs can achieve competitive performance even without positive samples. This motivates us to revisit the fundamental mechanism of positive samples in GCLs. From the perspective of Dirichlet energy, we theoretically finds that message passing, a key mechanism in graph encoders, trivializes the maximization of positive samples, preventing GCLs from effectively learning from positive samples. To address this, we propose SPGCL to mitigate the trivialization caused by message passing and restore the learning efficacy of positive samples. Specifically, we find that high Dirichlet energy features help positive samples provide effective learning signals while low Dirichlet energy features contribute little to positive learning signal but is useful for positive sampling. Based on this, SPGCL propagates only high Dirichlet energy features and uses low energy features to construct a probability matrix for reliable positive sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of SPGCL.

item.title: Decomposing Firm-Level Crisis Responses from Incomplete Market Signals: Evidence from China's IT Sector During COVID-19
item.author: Xiao Han, Yao Xiao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合因果识别、无监督行为发现和横截面韧性预测的多方法框架，用于分解企业层面对外部冲击的异质性响应。以中国A股IT企业为研究对象，发现疫情冲击导致IT行业整体波动率上升而非收益率下降，企业响应分为快速恢复、韧性/中等和持续拖累三类，且危机前的财务基本面预测韧性能力有限。

背景: 外部冲击导致企业产生异质性行为响应，但事件研究通常仅报告行业层面的平均值。

目的: 开发一种多方法框架，以分解从嘈杂市场信号中观察到的企业层面响应异质性。

方法: 结合因果识别（带集群稳健推断的双重差分法）、无监督行为发现（K均值轨迹聚类、高斯隐马尔可夫模型）和横截面韧性预测（带自助法推断的逻辑回归）。研究对象为2020年1月疫情冲击期间的246家中国A股IT企业（其中216家数据完整），并以252家非IT沪深300企业作为对照组。

主要发现: 疫情冲击导致市场-wide收益率下降，而非IT行业特有；IT行业特有效应表现为波动率显著上升。无监督聚类将企业响应轨迹分为三类：快速恢复（36家）、韧性/中等（67家）和持续拖累（113家）。危机前的财务基本面预测韧性能力较差（AUC为0.64），符合有效市场假说。

结论: 该结合因果分析、无监督学习和预测的框架具有可重复性，可应用于其他市场时期的危机研究。

翻译: Exogenous shocks generate heterogeneous behavioral responses across firms, yet event studies typically report only sector-level averages. This paper develops a multi-method approach combining causal identification (difference-in-differences with cluster-robust inference), unsupervised behavioral discovery (K-means trajectory clustering, Gaussian hidden Markov models), and cross-sectional resilience prediction (logistic regression with bootstrap inference) to decompose firm-level response heterogeneity from noisy market signals. We demonstrate the approach on 246 Chinese A-share IT firms (216 with complete data for all analyses) during the COVID-19 shock (January 2020), using 252 non-IT CSI 300 firms as controls. The return decline was market-wide, not IT-specific (DID p = 0.59); the IT-specific effect was elevated volatility (DID eta = 0.043, cluster-robust p < 0.001), with the effect surviving Benjamini-Hochberg correction across alternative specifications. Unsupervised clustering produced three categories of trajectories: fast recovery (36 companies, +29.7%), resilient/moderate (67 companies), and persistent drag (113 companies, -6.9%). Prior-to-crisis financial fundamentals did not predict resilience well (AUC = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.57-0.71), in line with efficient markets' incorporation of public information into stock prices. The combination of causal analysis, unsupervised learning, and prediction represents a reproducible framework which can be applied to crises in other market periods.

Abstract

Exogenous shocks generate heterogeneous behavioral responses across firms, yet event studies typically report only sector-level averages. This paper develops a multi-method approach combining causal identification (difference-in-differences with cluster-robust inference), unsupervised behavioral discovery (K-means trajectory clustering, Gaussian hidden Markov models), and cross-sectional resilience prediction (logistic regression with bootstrap inference) to decompose firm-level response heterogeneity from noisy market signals. We demonstrate the approach on 246 Chinese A-share IT firms (216 with complete data for all analyses) during the COVID-19 shock (January 2020), using 252 non-IT CSI 300 firms as controls. The return decline was market-wide, not IT-specific (DID p = 0.59); the IT-specific effect was elevated volatility (DID \b{eta} = 0.043, cluster-robust p < 0.001), with the effect surviving Benjamini-Hochberg correction across alternative specifications. Unsupervised clustering produced three categories of trajectories: fast recovery (36 companies, +29.7%), resilient/moderate (67 companies), and persistent drag (113 companies, -6.9%). Prior-to-crisis financial fundamentals did not predict resilience well (AUC = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.57-0.71), in line with efficient markets' incorporation of public information into stock prices. The combination of causal analysis, unsupervised learning, and prediction represents a reproducible framework which can be applied to crises in other market periods.

item.title: OMG: Omni-Modal Motion Generation for Generalist Humanoid Control
item.author: Siqiao Huang, Kun-Ying Lee, Dongming Qiao, Guanqi He, Zhenyu Wang, Yitang Li, Shaoting Zhu, Hang Zhao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为OMG的全能型人形机器人全身控制框架，旨在通过构建可扩展的‘大脑’模块和反应式的‘小脑’模块，实现基于多模态输入（语言、音频、人类参考动作）的通用控制。

背景: 人形机器人全身控制近年来取得显著进展，但现有方法要么局限于技能单一且依赖繁重奖励工程的政策，要么难以扩展到新的输入模态的运动跟踪器。

目的: 实现通用的人形机器人控制，构建能够处理多样化条件模态的可扩展‘大脑’模块，并使其建立在反应式运动跟踪‘小脑’之上，以模仿生物运动系统的层级结构。

方法: 提出OMG框架，通过细致的数据策展、过滤和标注流程获取高质量数据，并使用基于扩散的运动生成骨干网络，该网络能够接受语言、音频和人类参考动作等多模态输入。

主要发现: OMG作为全能型全身控制器，在实验中展现出最先进的性能、模型缩放行为以及对新分布和模态的高效适应能力。

结论: OMG标志着向人形机器人基础模型迈出了具体的一步，证明了通过多模态条件控制实现通用人形机器人控制的可行性。

翻译: Humanoid whole-body control has made significant progress in recent years, yet existing approaches remain limited to few-skill policies with heavy reward engineering, or motion trackers that are difficult to extend to new input modalities. We argue that the key to general-purpose humanoid control is to build a scalable brain, a module capable of reasoning with diverse conditioning modalities, atop a reactive motion tracking cerebellum, mirroring the hierarchical structure of biological motor systems. Two challenges arise in realizing this vision: acquiring a vast amount of high-quality data to achieve general purpose control, and equipping the generator with the capability to condition on compositional, extensible multi-modal inputs. We present OMG, which addresses these challenges with a meticulous data curation, filtering and labeling pipeline, as well as a diffusion-based motion generation backbone that conditions on language, audio, and human reference motions. Extensive experiments validate OMG as an omni-modal whole-body controller exhibiting state-of-the-art performance, model scaling behavior and efficient adaptation to new distributions and modalities, marking a concrete step toward foundation models for humanoid robots.

Abstract

Humanoid whole-body control has made significant progress in recent years, yet existing approaches remain limited to few-skill policies with heavy reward engineering, or motion trackers that are difficult to extend to new input modalities. We argue that the key to general-purpose humanoid control is to build a scalable brain, a module capable of reasoning with diverse conditioning modalities, atop a reactive motion tracking cerebellum, mirroring the hierarchical structure of biological motor systems. Two challenges arise in realizing this vision: acquiring a vast amount of high-quality data to achieve general purpose control, and equipping the generator with the capability to condition on compositional, extensible multi-modal inputs. We present OMG, which addresses these challenges with a meticulous data curation, filtering and labeling pipeline, as well as a diffusion-based motion generation backbone that conditions on language, audio, and human reference motions. Extensive experiments validate OMG as an omni-modal whole-body controller exhibiting state-of-the-art performance, model scaling behavior and efficient adaptation to new distributions and modalities, marking a concrete step toward foundation models for humanoid robots.

item.title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Co-Evolutionary Mechanisms for LLM-Driven Strategy Evolution in Adversarial Games
item.author: Haoran Li, Zengle Ge, Ziyang Zhang, Xiaomin Yuan, Yui Lo, Qianhui Liu, Bocheng An, Dongke Rong, Jiaqun Liu, Annan Li, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FAMOU的框架，用于解决大型语言模型驱动的代码进化在对抗性多智能体游戏中面临的评估环境动态变化问题。通过引入评估器协同进化、分层深度评估和弱点压力机制，该框架在MCTF 2026 3v3海上夺旗任务中表现出色，不仅超越了基线方法，还在实际比赛中获得优异成绩，证明了代码级进化在对抗环境中产生非平凡算法创新的能力。

背景: 大型语言模型驱动的代码进化方法通过迭代生成和改进程序实现了自动化发现。然而，将这些方法应用于对抗性多智能体游戏时，随着策略的改进，评估环境会发生变化，导致固定评估器变得不可靠，进化过程陷入停滞。

目的: 解决对抗性多智能体游戏中因评估环境动态变化导致的固定评估器不可靠和进化停滞问题。

方法: 提出三种机制：评估器协同进化（将发现的冠军策略加入对手池）、分层深度评估（用统计上可靠的评估替代嘈杂的少量游戏分数）、弱点压力（动态提高最难突破的对手的权重）。这些机制被实现在FAMOU框架中，该框架基于与OpenEvolve和ShinkaEvolve相同的基础模型代码进化范式。

主要发现: 在MCTF 2026 3v3海上夺旗任务中，FAMOU在两种骨干大型语言模型下均持续优于基线方法，取得最高综合得分（0.526）和对未见对手的最佳泛化能力（61.7%胜率）。消融实验证实每种机制都对性能有贡献。大型语言模型变异过程生成了种子策略中完全缺失的战术结构（如前瞻搜索和自适应拦截），证明了代码级进化能在对抗环境中产生非平凡算法创新。

结论: FAMOU进化的策略在AAMAS 2026 MCTF竞赛的硬件循环赛中获得第一名，在模拟赛中获得第三名，验证了其现实世界的可迁移性。优化的实现代码和相应的评估代码已通过进化过程开发并公开。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

Recent advances in LLM-driven code evolution have enabled automated discovery by iteratively generating and improving programs. However, applying these methods to adversarial multi-agent games introduces a fundamental challenge: the evaluation landscape shifts as strategies improve, causing fixed evaluators to become unreliable and evolution to stagnate. We propose three mechanisms to address this challenge: evaluator co-evolution, which incorporates discovered champions into the opponent pool; hierarchical deep evaluation, which replaces noisy few-game scores with statistically reliable assessments; and weakness pressure, which dynamically up-weights the most difficult opponents to break through plateaus. We implement these mechanisms within FAMOU, a framework built upon the same foundation-model code-evolution paradigm as OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve. On the MCTF 2026 3v3 maritime capture-the-flag task, FAMOU consistently outperforms both baselines under two backbone LLMs, achieving the highest combined score (0.526) and the best generalization to unseen opponents (61.7% win rate), while ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to performance. Notably, the LLM mutation process generates tactical structures entirely absent from the seed strategies -- including lookahead search and adaptive interception -- demonstrating that code-level evolution can produce nontrivial algorithmic innovations in adversarial settings. The FAMOU-evolved strategy further achieved 1st place in the hardware round-robin and 3rd in simulation at the AAMAS 2026 MCTF Competition, validating its real-world transferability. The optimized implementation and corresponding evaluation codes developed through our evolutionary process are available at: https://github.com/1xiangliu1/FAMOU-CoEvo

item.title: Vision-Assisted Foundation Model for Solving Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Problems
item.author: Shuangchun Gui, Zhiguang Cao, Wen Song, Yew-Soon Ong
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种视觉辅助的基础模型VaFM，用于解决多任务车辆路径问题。

背景: 多任务车辆路径问题在提升各行业和服务部门效率方面至关重要，现有求解器仅使用图模态，限制了处理多约束变体的能力。

目的: 利用视觉模态编码多样化的车辆路径问题约束，并整合到基于图的模型中，以同时解决各种车辆路径问题变体。

方法: 提出视觉辅助基础模型VaFM，通过卷积神经网络编码针对所有约束的输入图像，将获得的补丁嵌入与基于图的节点融合以生成解决方案，并设计辅助任务以解决像素不平衡问题。

主要发现: 在十六种不同的车辆路径问题变体上评估VaFM的性能，实验结果表明VaFM优于最先进的方法，特别是在处理具有复杂约束的变体时。

结论: 视觉模态在编码多样化约束方面具有巨大潜力，VaFM能够有效解决多任务车辆路径问题中的多个挑战。

翻译: Multi-task vehicle routing problems play a critical role in enhancing efficiency across various industries and service sectors. These problems consist of multiple variants that optimize routing costs while meeting diverse customer constraints. Existing multi-task VRP solvers solely utilize a graph-based modality, limiting their ability to address variants with multiple constraints. As a format to represent complex semantics, vision modality shows great potential for encoding diverse VRP constraints. This motivates us to learn patch-level semantics from the vision images, and then integrate them into a graph-based model to solve various VRP variants simultaneously. However, directly applying this approach to multi-task VRPs presents three challenges: 1) existing VRP images lack constraint representations, which are essential for multi-task VRPs, 2) the fixed receptive field of individual patches cannot effectively accommodate varying requirements across tasks, and 3) imbalanced pixel distribution among constraints may cause the model to overlook constraints with fewer pixels. In this paper, we propose a vision-assisted foundation model (VaFM) to address these challenges. In the vision modality, input images tailored to all constraints are encoded by a convolutional neural network. The obtained patch embeddings are fused with graph-based nodes to generate solutions, with an auxiliary task designed to address the pixel-imbalanced issue. The performance of VaFM is evaluated across 16 different VRP variants. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of VaFM over state-of-the-art methods, especially for variants with complex constraints.

Abstract

Multi-task vehicle routing problems play a critical role in enhancing efficiency across various industries and service sectors. These problems consist of multiple variants that optimize routing costs while meeting diverse customer constraints. Existing multi-task VRP solvers solely utilize a graph-based modality, limiting their ability to address variants with multiple constraints. As a format to represent complex semantics, vision modality shows great potential for encoding diverse VRP constraints. This motivates us to learn patch-level semantics from the vision images, and then integrate them into a graph-based model to solve various VRP variants simultaneously. However, directly applying this approach to multi-task VRPs presents three challenges: 1) existing VRP images lack constraint representations, which are essential for multi-task VRPs, 2) the fixed receptive field of individual patches cannot effectively accommodate varying requirements across tasks, and 3) imbalanced pixel distribution among constraints may cause the model to overlook constraints with fewer pixels. In this paper, we propose a vision-assisted foundation model (VaFM) to address these challenges. In the vision modality, input images tailored to all constraints are encoded by a convolutional neural network. The obtained patch embeddings are fused with graph-based nodes to generate solutions, with an auxiliary task designed to address the pixel-imbalanced issue. The performance of VaFM is evaluated across 16 different VRP variants. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of VaFM over state-of-the-art methods, especially for variants with complex constraints.

item.title: GC-LoRA: Gated Convolutional LoRA for Parameter-Efficient Acoustic Adaptation
item.author: Natarajan Balaji Shankar, Zilai Wang, Kaiyuan Zhang, Mohan Shi, Abeer Alwan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为GC-LoRA的新型适配器架构，通过将类似Conformer的局部卷积处理注入到预训练的Transformer编码器中，以解决基于Transformer的语音基础模型在声学特征不匹配的领域性能下降的问题。

背景: 基于Transformer的语音基础模型在大多数自动语音识别任务中表现优异，但在应用于声学特征不匹配的领域时，性能往往会下降。现有的参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）虽然可以调整全局注意力，但缺乏对局部上下文的建模，这对于捕捉领域特定的变化至关重要。

目的: 提出一种新的适配器架构，以在保持预训练全局表示的同时，高效捕捉局部声学依赖关系，从而提升模型在声学特征不匹配领域中的性能。

方法: 提出GC-LoRA架构，将轻量级适配器集成到编码器注意力输出投影中，注入类似Conformer的局部卷积处理，从而在不破坏预训练全局表示的情况下捕捉局部声学依赖。

主要发现: 在多个不同数据集（包括声学退化、带宽受限、方言和儿童语音）上的实验表明，该方法相比基线方法在词错误率上最高降低了百分之十点九，同时仅增加了极少的可训练参数。

结论: GC-LoRA是一种有效的适配器架构，能够显著提升基于Transformer的语音基础模型在声学特征不匹配领域的性能，同时保持参数效率。

翻译: Transformer-based Speech Foundation Models excel in most Automatic Speech Recognition tasks but often suffer performance degradation when applied to domains with mismatched acoustic characteristics. While Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), adjust global attention, they lack the local context modeling crucial for capturing domain-specific variations. We propose GC-LoRA, a novel adapter architecture that injects Conformer-style local convolutional processing into pretrained Transformer encoders. By integrating a lightweight adapter to encoder attention output projections, our method efficiently captures local acoustic dependencies without disrupting pretrained global representations. Experiments across diverse datasets (acoustically-degraded, bandlimited, dialectal, child) demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving Word Error Rate (WER) reductions of up to 10.9% compared to baselines while adding minimal trainable parameters.

Abstract

Transformer-based Speech Foundation Models excel in most Automatic Speech Recognition tasks but often suffer performance degradation when applied to domains with mismatched acoustic characteristics. While Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), adjust global attention, they lack the local context modeling crucial for capturing domain-specific variations. We propose GC-LoRA, a novel adapter architecture that injects Conformer-style local convolutional processing into pretrained Transformer encoders. By integrating a lightweight adapter to encoder attention output projections, our method efficiently captures local acoustic dependencies without disrupting pretrained global representations. Experiments across diverse datasets (acoustically-degraded, bandlimited, dialectal, child) demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving Word Error Rate (WER) reductions of up to 10.9% compared to baselines while adding minimal trainable parameters.

item.title: Machine Learning Methods for Studying Latent Neural Activity Dynamics
item.author: Shufeng Kong, Fumei Deng, Xinyi Dong, Caihua Liu, Weiwei Chen, Yingheng Wang, Daniel Cao, Azahara Oliva, Antonio Fernandez-Ruiz, Carla Gomes
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对潜在变量模型在解码大规模神经元群体潜在结构方面的应用进行了全面综述，涵盖了从早期状态空间模型到近期深度生成模型的发展轨迹。

背景: 脑记录技术的最新发展推动了对能够解码大规模神经元群体潜在结构的机器学习工具的需求。

目的: 提供关于潜在变量模型发展轨迹的全面综述，并讨论基准、评估标准及开放挑战，以促进未来研究在可解释脑动力学与可靠神经解码之间的桥梁搭建。

方法: 将文献组织为三个紧密相关的领域：单区域潜在动态（包括线性动力系统、循环神经网络和神经常微分方程）、多区域通信（使用概率和子空间方法研究信息在不同脑区间的转移）以及行为对齐建模（通过监督或对比学习分离与任务表现相关的神经活动）。此外，还涵盖了依赖大规模预训练的大型神经基础模型（如Transformer和扩散模型）。

主要发现: 潜在变量模型的发展涵盖了从简单的线性动力系统到复杂的循环神经网络、神经常微分方程，再到大型神经基础模型（如Transformer和扩散模型）的演进。这些模型在单区域动态、多区域通信和行为对齐建模方面展现了不同的应用方式。

结论: 综述总结了基准、评估标准及开放挑战，如识别因果联系或通信方向性的能力，旨在为未来研究提供指导，以连接可解释的脑动力学与可靠的神经解码。

翻译: Recent developments in brain recording are driving a demand for machine learning tools capable of decoding the latent structure of large populations of neurons. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey that outlines the trajectory of Latent Variable Models (LVMs) from early state-space models to more recent deep generative models. We organize the literature into three closely related domains: (1) Single-Region Latent Dynamics, which includes models such as linear dynamical systems to more complex dynamics represented by Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs); (2) Multi-Region Communication, which employs probabilistic as well as subspace methods to study how information is transferred across different brain areas considering synaptic propagation delays and network connectivity; and (3) Behavior-Aligned Modeling, which seeks to disentangle neural activity related to task performance from other internal states via supervised or contrastive learning. This survey also includes large-scale neural foundation models, such as Transformers and diffusion models, that rely on large-scale pre-training for optimal performance across subjects. Finally, we conclude and discuss benchmarks, evaluation criteria, and open challenges, such as the ability to identify causal links or directionality of communication, to facilitate future research for bridging interpretable brain dynamics with reliable neural decoding.

Abstract

Recent developments in brain recording are driving a demand for machine learning tools capable of decoding the latent structure of large populations of neurons. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey that outlines the trajectory of Latent Variable Models (LVMs) from early state-space models to more recent deep generative models. We organize the literature into three closely related domains: (1) Single-Region Latent Dynamics, which includes models such as linear dynamical systems to more complex dynamics represented by Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs); (2) Multi-Region Communication, which employs probabilistic as well as subspace methods to study how information is transferred across different brain areas considering synaptic propagation delays and network connectivity; and (3) Behavior-Aligned Modeling, which seeks to disentangle neural activity related to task performance from other internal states via supervised or contrastive learning. This survey also includes large-scale neural foundation models, such as Transformers and diffusion models, that rely on large-scale pre-training for optimal performance across subjects. Finally, we conclude and discuss benchmarks, evaluation criteria, and open challenges, such as the ability to identify causal links or directionality of communication, to facilitate future research for bridging interpretable brain dynamics with reliable neural decoding.

item.title: One Token per Multimodal Evidence: Latent Memory for Resource-Constrained QA
item.author: Zheng, Zhi, Meng, Ziqiao, Luan, Hao, Liu, Wei, Lee, Wee Sun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为潜在记忆的新范式，通过将原始文本或图像证据替换为单个高维潜在令牌，解决了现有基于检索的问答系统在资源受限应用中面临的令牌消耗高和存储压力大的问题。

背景: 外部记忆能有效为大语言模型和视觉语言模型驱动的问答系统提供相关的多模态证据。然而，现有记忆范式以原始文本和图像形式表示每个记忆项，检索系统必须将检索到的原始文本或图像传递给生成模型，导致高令牌消耗和存储压力，难以应用于资源受限场景。

目的: 提出一种在统一潜在表示空间操作的潜在记忆范式，以替代原始证据检索，降低生成模型的令牌消耗和存储压力，同时保持高质量的问答性能。

方法: 使用小型压缩器模型将每个原始文本或图像证据项转换为单个高维潜在令牌。查询被嵌入到同一潜在空间以检索相关潜在令牌，这些令牌直接作为提示输入到预训练的大语言模型或视觉语言模型中进行答案生成。通过重建、对比和蒸馏目标在统一端到端方式下训练压缩器，使每个潜在令牌同时具备重建、检索和生成所需的丰富信息。

主要发现: 在七个纯文本问答基准和多模态问答基准上评估表明，潜在记忆在问答性能上与先进的检索增强生成基线相当，同时生成器令牌消耗减少三到十倍。在WebQA上实现了最强的图像 grounding 问答性能。

结论: 潜在记忆范式通过高效利用潜在令牌，显著降低了资源消耗，同时保持了竞争力的问答性能，为资源受限应用提供了可行的解决方案。

翻译: External memory effectively grounds large language models and vision-language models-based question answering in relevant multimodal evidence. However, existing memory paradigms represent each memory item in raw text and image forms, so retrieval-based systems must pass the retrieved text or images to the generation models, resulting in high token consumption and storage pressure, making it unaffordable for resource-constrained applications. We propose Latent Memory, a latent-space memory paradigm that replaces each raw text or image evidence item with a single high-dimensional latent token produced by a small compressor model. Rather than retrieving raw evidence for generation, Latent Memory operates in a unified latent representation space: the query is embedded into this space to retrieve relevant latent tokens, and the retrieved latent tokens are directly prompted to a pretrained model for answer generation. To make each latent token simultaneously informative for reconstruction, retrieval, and generation, we train the compressor with reconstruction, contrastive, and distillation objectives in a unified end-to-end manner. Latent Memory is evaluated on seven text-only question answering benchmarks and multimodal question answering benchmarks, where it achieves competitive question answering performance compared to advanced retrieval-augmented generation baselines while consuming three to ten times fewer generator tokens. It can also deliver the strongest image-grounded question answering performance on WebQA.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有问答系统在利用外部记忆时，因直接使用原始文本或图像证据而导致的高消耗与存储压力问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为庞大的数据量会严重限制模型在长上下文和多轮对话中的扩展能力。在现实应用中，高昂的成本使得系统难以部署在手机或边缘设备等资源受限的场景，而本文的方法能大幅降低计算与存储开销，推动高效智能助手的实际落地。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有外部记忆方法使用原始图文导致存储与计算成本过高的问题，思考能否用高度压缩的单令牌隐式表示替代原始证据。为此，他们设计了将每条证据压缩为单一高维隐式令牌的方法，并通过信息重构、检索对齐和生成行为蒸馏三种目标联合训练压缩模型，使其同时具备内容保留、高效检索和直接生成能力。该方法借鉴了外部检索增强生成、文本证据压缩以及隐空间推理等现有研究，但突破了以往方法仅支持文本的局限，将隐空间推理原则成功扩展至多模态场景，从而在资源受限条件下实现了存储与生成效率的显著提升。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将每段原始文本或图像证据压缩为单个高维隐层标记，以替代传统方法中直接传递原始内容的方式，从而大幅降低存储与计算开销。整体实现流程首先利用小型压缩模型将证据编码为隐层标记并构建统一检索空间；随后将查询问题映射至同一空间进行相似度匹配，检索出最相关的隐层标记；最后将这些标记直接输入冻结的大语言或视觉语言模型中完成答案生成。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种潜在记忆范式，将每条多模态证据压缩为单个高维潜在标记，替代传统的原始文本或图像。相比以往依赖原始数据检索和生成的方法，该设计统一了表征与检索空间，并通过结合重建、对比和蒸馏的联合训练目标，使单个标记同时具备信息保留、高效检索和直接驱动生成模型的能力。这使得系统在大幅降低存储压力和生成标记消耗的同时，仍能保持竞争力的问答性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了Latent Memory框架，将多模态证据压缩为单一隐空间令牌，通过结合重建、对比与蒸馏的联合训练目标，在大幅降低存储与生成令牌消耗的同时，实现了具有竞争力的问答性能。

Abstract

External memory effectively grounds large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs)-based question answering (QA) in relevant multimodal evidence. However, existing memory paradigms represent each memory item in raw text and image forms, so retrieval-based systems must pass the retrieved text or images to the generation LLMs/VLMs, resulting in high token consumption and storage pressure, making it unaffordable for resource-constrained applications. We propose Latent Memory, a latent-space memory paradigm that replaces each raw text or image evidence item with a single high-dimensional latent token produced by a small compressor LLM/VLM. Rather than retrieving raw evidence for generation, Latent Memory operates in a unified latent representation space: the query is embedded into this space to retrieve relevant latent tokens, and the retrieved latent tokens are directly prompted to a pretrained LLM or VLM for answer generation. To make each latent token simultaneously informative for reconstruction, retrieval, and generation, we train the compressor with reconstruction, contrastive, and distillation objectives in a unified end-to-end manner. Latent Memory is evaluated on seven text-only QA benchmarks (e.g., HotpotQA) and multimodal QA benchmarks, where it achieves competitive QA performance compared to advanced RAG baselines while consuming 3x to 10x fewer generator tokens. It can also deliver the strongest image-grounded QA performance on WebQA. Code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Small Data, Big Noise: Adversarial Training for Robust Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
item.author: Eitan Cohen, Idan Simai, Uri Shaham
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SDBN的统一框架，将对抗训练引入参数高效微调领域，以增强模型在噪声和有限数据下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

背景: 参数高效微调已成为适应基础模型到下游自然语言处理任务的关键技术，但现有方法在噪声鲁棒性和有限训练数据下的性能方面存在不足。

目的: 增强模型鲁棒性和泛化能力，解决参数高效微调与对抗训练结合较少研究的问题，使部署更可靠。

方法: 提出SDBN框架，包含两个变体：SDBN-h通过枚举字符级编辑并使用梯度选择最坏情况变体；SDBN-p使用大语言模型生成的变体进行生成任务的鲁棒优化。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中表现出显著改进，特别是在低资源设置以及单词级和字符级损坏情况下，优于替代方法。

结论: 该框架在不引入额外参数或仅增加适度计算开销的情况下，解决了参数高效微调与对抗训练的交叉领域问题，提高了现实场景中数据稀缺和语言变异共存时的可靠性。

翻译: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become essential for adapting foundation models to downstream NLP tasks. However, current PEFT methods often struggle with robustness to noise and performance degradation on limited training data. We propose SDBN (Small Data Big Noise), a unified framework that brings adversarial training to PEFT - a combination that remains less studied in the PEFT setting despite its complementary strengths - to enhance model robustness and generalization, outperforming alternative approaches. We also introduce two variants of the method that use discrete uncertainty sets: SDBN-h, which enumerates character-level edits and selects worst-case variants using gradients, and SDBN-p, which uses LLM-generated variants for robust optimization in generative tasks. Experiments across multiple benchmarks reveal substantial improvements, particularly in low-resource settings and under both word-level and character-level corruptions. This framework addresses the less explored intersection of adversarial training and parameter-efficient adaptation, without introducing additional parameters or only modest computational overhead, making PEFT deployments more reliable in real-world scenarios where data scarcity and linguistic variability often coexist

Abstract

Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become essential for adapting foundation models to downstream NLP tasks. However, current PEFT methods often struggle with robustness to noise and performance degradation on limited training data. We propose SDBN (Small Data Big Noise), a unified framework that brings adversarial training to PEFT - a combination that remains less studied in the PEFT setting despite its complementary strengths - to enhance model robustness and generalization, outperforming alternative approaches. We also introduce two variants of the method that use discrete uncertainty sets: SDBN-h, which enumerates character-level edits and selects worst-case variants using gradients, and SDBN-p, which uses LLM-generated variants for robust optimization in generative tasks. Experiments across multiple benchmarks reveal substantial improvements, particularly in low-resource settings and under both word-level and character-level corruptions. This framework addresses the less explored intersection of adversarial training and parameter-efficient adaptation, without introducing additional parameters or only modest computational overhead, making PEFT deployments more reliable in real-world scenarios where data scarcity and linguistic variability often coexist

item.title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
item.author: Dong, Zhichen, Li, Yang, Sun, Yuhan, Wang, Weixun, Luo, Yijia, Peng, Zinian, Ye, Taiheng, Yang, Chao, Su, Wenbo, Cheng, Yu, Zheng, Bo, Yan, Junchi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FlowTracer的强化学习框架，旨在解决大语言模型中令牌级信用分配的问题。该框架通过在注意力诱导的有向无环图上追踪针对答案的推理流，从全局结构推导令牌信用，并通过重塑令牌级奖励来提升推理任务的性能。

背景: 在大语言模型的强化学习中，令牌级信用分配是一个关键障碍。现有的强化学习方法通常将所有令牌视为同等重要，无法区分关键的推理步骤与常规的格式或填充内容。近期的尝试虽然利用模型内部信号进行更细粒度的信用分配，但往往采用逐点启发式方法，忽略了信息传播的全局结构。

目的: 提出一种能够追踪针对答案的推理流并基于全局结构分配令牌信用的强化学习框架，以解决现有方法忽略信息传播全局结构的问题，并提升大语言模型在推理任务中的表现。

方法: 提出FlowTracer框架，在由令牌作为节点、聚合注意力权重作为边容量的注意力诱导有向无环图上追踪推理流。通过重加权边容量仅保留能到达答案区域的影响，并强制执行局部流量守恒，确保中间令牌不因路径长度或不相关分支而损失或获得有效质量。在此基础上，提取连接问题与答案的信息流主干，通过流量吞吐量对令牌进行评分，识别高影响力枢纽和聚合检查点。

主要发现: FlowTracer能够从全局结构中提取信息流主干，并通过流量吞吐量对令牌进行评分，揭示出中介长距离依赖的高影响力枢纽和聚合检查点。这些派生的重要性评分被用于塑造令牌级奖励，使学习信号能够精确聚焦于将信息路由向或远离正确答案的令牌。

结论: FlowTracer框架通过基于全局信息流结构的令牌级信用分配，实现了学习信号对关键令牌的精确聚焦，并在多种推理任务中带来了持续的性能提升。

翻译: Token-level credit assignment remains a key obstacle for reinforcement learning (RL) in large language models (LLMs), where RL recipes typically treat all tokens equally, failing to distinguish decisive reasoning steps from routine formatting or fluent filler. Recent attempts leverage model-internal signals to assign finer-grained credit, but these are often point-wise heuristics that ignore the global structure of information propagation. We propose FlowTracer, an RL framework that traces answer-targeted reasoning flow on an attention-induced directed acyclic graph in which nodes correspond to tokens and edge capacities come from aggregated attention weights and derives token credit from this global structure. The edge capacities are reweighted to retain only the influence that can reach the answer region, while enforcing local flow conservation so intermediate tokens neither lose nor gain effective mass due to path length or irrelevant branches. On this graph, FlowTracer extracts an information-flow backbone connecting the question to the answer and scores tokens by flow throughput, revealing high-impact hubs and aggregation checkpoints that mediate long-range dependencies. These derived importances are used to shape token-level rewards, enabling learning signals to focus precisely on the tokens that route information toward (or away from) correct answers and delivering consistent performance gains across a range of reasoning tasks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型强化学习中的词元级信用分配问题，即如何精准识别并强化对最终答案起关键作用的推理步骤，而不是将奖励平均分配给所有生成的词元。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为传统方法无法区分核心推理环节与冗余格式或填充内容，导致学习信号模糊且训练效率低下。准确追踪信息从问题传递到答案的路径，能够显著提升模型在复杂推理任务中的表现与收敛速度。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为现有强化学习方法在分配词元奖励时往往平均对待所有词元或仅依赖局部启发式信号，忽略了信息从问题传递到答案的全局传播结构。为此，他们将词元序列视为由注意力机制生成的有向无环图，利用一种类似概率变换的数学方法对连接权重进行重分配，以剔除无关分支并保证局部流量守恒，从而精准提取指向答案的关键推理路径。该方法借鉴了以往利用模型内部动态信号进行信用分配的研究思路，但突破了其单点评估的局限，并参考了将真实标签作为引导信号的标签再利用理念，最终将计算出的流量通过度转化为词元级奖励

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将大语言模型的推理视为信息在注意力网络中的定向流动，通过追踪从问题到答案的有效路径来精准识别关键推理词语，从而解决强化学习中奖励分配不均的问题。整体实现流程首先基于注意力权重构建词语间的原始影响图，接着以答案为条件对路径进行筛选与权重重分配，剔除无关分支并保证信息守恒。随后从问题端注入单位流量并向前传播，计算每个词语的流量通过量作为其重要性评分。最后将这些评分转化为强化学习中的词元级奖励信号，引导模型重点优化关键推理步骤。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于注意力机制构建的有向无环图框架，将大语言模型的推理过程建模为从问题到答案的信息流。通过引入答案导向的流守恒重加权机制，该方法有效过滤了无关分支，并提取出支撑最终预测的核心推理骨干路径。与以往仅依赖单点启发式指标或均匀分配信用分的方法不同，本文从全局结构出发，通过计算节点流量来精准识别关键推理枢纽，从而实现更细粒度的强化学习奖励塑造。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了FlowTracer框架，通过将大语言模型的注意力交互建模为有向无环图，并基于目标答案筛选有效路径与守恒变换，精准量化每个生成词元在推理过程中的实际贡献，从而实现了细粒度的强化学习信用分配并有效提升了模型的推理性能。

Abstract

Token-level credit assignment remains a key obstacle for reinforcement learning (RL) in large language models (LLMs), where RL recipes typically treat all tokens equally, failing to distinguish decisive reasoning steps from routine formatting or fluent filler. Recent attempts leverage model-internal signals to assign finer-grained credit, but these are often point-wise heuristics that ignore the global structure of information propagation. We propose FlowTracer, an RL framework that traces answer-targeted reasoning flow on an attention-induced directed acyclic graph in which nodes correspond to tokens and edge capacities come from aggregated attention weights and derives token credit from this global structure. The edge capacities are reweighted to retain only the influence that can reach the answer region, while enforcing local flow conservation so intermediate tokens neither lose nor gain effective mass due to path length or irrelevant branches. On this graph, FlowTracer extracts an information-flow backbone connecting the question to the answer and scores tokens by flow throughput, revealing high-impact hubs and aggregation checkpoints that mediate long-range dependencies. These derived importances are used to shape token-level rewards, enabling learning signals to focus precisely on the tokens that route information toward (or away from) correct answers and delivering consistent performance gains across a range of reasoning tasks.

item.title: Dynamic Linear Attention
item.author: Wang, Xin, Shen, Hui, Zheng, Boyuan, Liu, Xueshen, Cho, Minkyoung, Wan, Zhongwei, Zhao, Zesen, Mao, Zhuoqing, Yan, Shen, Zhang, Mi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DLA的动态内存建模框架，用于多状态线性注意力机制，旨在解决现有方法在长上下文处理中因固定状态合并策略导致的错误累积和关键信息丢失问题。

背景: 大型语言模型处理长上下文的扩展性受到标准注意力机制二次复杂度的限制，因此需要采用具有次二次成本的线性注意力机制。现有的多状态线性注意力方法依赖固定的状态合并策略，无法适应动态变化的token重要性，导致关键token被不可逆地掩盖，并在长序列中造成严重的错误累积。

目的: 解决现有方法因固定状态合并策略无法适应动态token重要性而导致的关键信息丢失和错误累积问题，提升长上下文下的表示能力。

方法: 提出DLA框架，包含两个核心组件：一是信息感知动态状态合并，根据token级别的信息变化自适应确定状态边界，在语义转换周围保留高分辨率表示，同时对稳定区域进行激进摘要；二是容量受限内存建模，通过选择性地合并相邻低信息状态，维护固定大小且按时间顺序排列的状态缓存，以最小信息损失控制内存增长。

主要发现: 在两个不同的线性注意力模型上进行预训练，并在涵盖三个类别的16个数据集上进行评估，实验结果表明DLA优于最先进的方法。

结论: DLA框架通过动态内存建模有效提升了多状态线性注意力机制在长上下文处理中的性能，克服了固定策略的局限性。

翻译: The scalability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to long contexts is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic complexity of standard attention, motivating the adoption of linear attention mechanisms with sub-quadratic cost. To improve representation capacity under long contexts, recent approaches organize memory in a multi-state manner. However, existing multi-state linear attention methods rely on fixed state merging policies that cannot adapt to dynamically varying token importance, irreversibly obscuring critical tokens and causing severe error accumulation over long sequences. To address this limitation, we propose DLA, a dynamic memory modeling framework for multi-state linear attention. DLA introduces (i) Information-Aware Dynamic State Merging, which adaptively determines state boundaries based on token-level information variation, preserving high-resolution representations around semantic transitions while aggressively summarizing stable regions, and (ii) Capacity-Bounded Memory Modeling, which maintains a fixed-size, chronologically ordered state cache by selectively merging adjacent low-information states to control memory growth with minimal information loss. We pre-train DLA on two different linear attention models and evaluate on 16 datasets across three categories. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of DLA over state-of-the-art.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有长文本注意力机制中固定状态合并策略无法适应动态信息变化，从而导致关键信息被掩盖和误差累积的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为传统注意力机制的计算成本过高，限制了模型处理长上下文的能力，而改进线性注意力能在保持高效计算的同时显著提升模型对长序列的理解与生成性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有长文本注意力方法采用固定的状态合并策略，无法适应信息密度的动态变化，容易导致关键信息丢失和误差累积。为此，他们设计了基于信息变化的动态合并机制，在语义稳定区进行压缩，在语义转折处保留细节，并配合固定容量的缓存管理来控制内存增长。该方法借鉴了现有的线性注意力架构与多状态记忆组织思路，并在对数线性注意力等已有模型的基础上进行改进与预训练。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是根据词元信息的变化程度动态划分记忆状态，在语义关键处保留高分辨率细节，在稳定区域进行高效压缩。整体流程为依次处理输入词元，计算其与最近记忆状态的差异分数，差异小时合并入当前状态，差异大时开启新状态。系统会维护一个固定容量的有序状态缓存，当缓存满时自动合并信息密度最低的两个相邻状态以控制内存增长，最终在生成时基于这些动态构建的状态进行注意力计算。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种动态记忆建模框架，核心包含两项机制。一是信息感知的动态状态合并，它根据词元表示的变化程度自适应划分状态边界，在语义转折处保留细节而在稳定区域进行压缩。二是容量受限的记忆建模，通过维护固定大小的有序缓存，并在满载时选择性合并信息量最低的相邻状态以控制内存。与以往依赖固定块大小或固定合并规则的工作不同，该方法能够动态适应长序列中非均匀的信息分布，避免了重要信息被不可逆地压缩，从而显著降低了误差累积。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种动态线性注意力框架，通过根据词元信息变化动态划分记忆状态边界并限制缓存容量，有效克服了传统固定合并策略在长文本处理中易丢失关键信息且误差累积的缺陷，显著提升了模型的理解性能与推理效率。

Abstract

The scalability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to long contexts is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic complexity of standard attention, motivating the adoption of linear attention mechanisms with sub-quadratic cost. To improve representation capacity under long contexts, recent approaches organize memory in a multi-state manner. However, existing multi-state linear attention methods rely on fixed state merging policies that cannot adapt to dynamically varying token importance, irreversibly obscuring critical tokens and causing severe error accumulation over long sequences. To address this limitation, we propose DLA, a dynamic memory modeling framework for multi-state linear attention. DLA introduces (i) Information-Aware Dynamic State Merging, which adaptively determines state boundaries based on token-level information variation, preserving high-resolution representations around semantic transitions while aggressively summarizing stable regions, and (ii) Capacity-Bounded Memory Modeling, which maintains a fixed-size, chronologically ordered state cache by selectively merging adjacent low-information states to control memory growth with minimal information loss. We pre-train DLA on two different linear attention models and evaluate on 16 datasets across three categories. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of DLA over state-of-the-art.

item.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
item.author: Kwai Keye Team, Bin Wen, Changyi Liu, Chengru Song, Chongling Rao, Guowang Zhang, Han Li, Haonan Fan, Hengrui Ju, Jiankang Chen, Jiapeng Chen, Jiawei Yuan, Kaixuan Yang, Kaiyu Jiang, Kun Gai, Lingzhi Zhou, Na Nie, Sen Na, Tianke Zhang, Tingting Gao, Xuanyu Zheng, Yulong Chen, Fan Yang, Haixuan Gao, Lele Yang, Mingqiao Liu, Muxi Diao, Qi Zhang, Qile Su, Wei Chen, Wentao Hong, Xingyu Lu, Yancheng Long, Yankai Yang, Yingxin Li, Yiyang Fan, Yu Xia, Yuzhe Chen, Ziliang Lai, Chuan Yi, Haonan Jia, Tianming Liang, Weixin Xu, Xiaoxiao Ma, Yang Tian, Yufei Han, Feng Han, Hang Li, Jing Wang, Jinghui Jia, Junmin Chen, Junyu Shi, Ruilin Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B，一个开源的混合专家多模态基础模型，旨在提升长视频理解和智能体智能。

背景: 小时级视频面临超长上下文、信息冗余和计算成本高昂的挑战。

目的: 解决超长上下文、信息冗余和计算成本问题，提升长视频理解和智能体智能。

方法: 首次将DeepSeek稀疏注意力机制适配到基于分组查询注意力的多模态架构中，实现无损的超长上下文处理；采用优化的训练和推理基础设施，包括可扩展的视频输入输出、异构视觉语言模型并行化和自定义稀疏注意力内核；引入跨模态多教师在线策略蒸馏，结合上下文强化学习和视频强化学习，解决多任务对齐中的灾难性遗忘问题。

主要发现: 该模型在视频理解、时间定位、推理、科学技术和智能体基准测试中达到同类模型的最先进性能，尤其在TimeLens上的细粒度时间定位以及Video-MME-v2和LongVideoBench上的长视频理解方面表现突出。

结论: 该模型开源，旨在加速社区向可扩展和鲁棒的多模态智能体应用发展。

翻译: We introduce Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed to advance long-video understanding and agentic intelligence. To address the challenges of ultra-long contexts, information redundancy, and prohibitive computational costs inherent in hour-level videos, Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, enabling lossless 256K context processing while capturing critical frames and long-range temporal dependencies. This architecture is underpinned by a highly optimized training and inference infrastructure, including scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels that significantly maximize throughput and minimize computational overhead. Furthermore, to overcome the algorithmic dilemma of catastrophic forgetting during multi-task alignment, we introduce Cross-Modal Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) paired with Context-RL and Video-RL. By distilling dense token-level teacher feedback from on-policy rollouts back into the MoE backbone, which activates only 3B parameters, Keye-VL-2.0 natively empowers advanced agent collaboration across Code, Tool, and Search scenarios with multimodal self-correction. Extensive evaluations across video understanding, temporal grounding, reasoning, STEM, and agent benchmarks demonstrate that Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of similar scale, particularly excelling in fine-grained temporal localization on TimeLens and long-video comprehension on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench. We release our model checkpoints to accelerate community progress toward scalable and robust multimodal agentic applications.

By distilling dense token-level teacher feedback from on-policy rollouts back into the MoE backbone, which activates only 3B parameters, Keye-VL-2.0 natively empowers advanced agent collaboration across Code, Tool, and Search scenarios with multimodal self-correction. Extensive evaluations across video understanding, temporal grounding, reasoning, STEM, and agent benchmarks demonstrate that Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B achieves state-of-the-art performance among models of similar scale, particularly excelling in fine-grained temporal localization on TimeLens and long-video comprehension on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench. item.title: Post-Quantum Secure Federated DeFi for Inclusive Banking
item.author: Swati Sachan, Dale Fickett, Richard Buchinger, Theo Miller
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种后量子安全的联邦去中心化金融框架，旨在通过银行间协作提升金融服务包容性。该框架利用基于格的完全同态加密技术，在虚拟服务器上对加密数据进行端到端同态计算，融合本地数据驱动的评估、专家信念及经NASA-IBM普里特维地理空间基础模型生成的可验证证据。通过去中心化技术确保数据交换的防篡改性和可审计性。该框架在弗吉尼亚州农村借款人的农业贷款决策中进行了测试。

背景: 纠错量子位的最新进展加速了实用量子计算的进程，这对用于保护金融系统、政府基础设施、通信网络及去中心化金融生态系统安全的密码学原语构成威胁。

目的: 引入一种后量子安全的联邦去中心化金融框架，通过银行间协作提升因金融历史记录有限而未被当地贷款机构服务的个人的金融服务包容性。

方法: 多家银行向虚拟服务器提交加密的信息批次。利用基于格的完全同态加密技术实现端到端的同态计算。服务器在加密状态下融合本地数据驱动的概率评估、专家信念以及由NASA-IBM普里特维地理空间基础模型生成的可验证证据。采用去中心化技术确保所有机构与服务器之间加密数据交换的防篡改性和可审计问责制。

主要发现: 该框架在弗吉尼亚州农村借款人的农业贷款决策场景中进行了测试。

结论: 该框架能够有效支持银行间协作，在保障数据隐私和安全的前提下，为金融服务不足的群体提供更包容的信贷评估。

翻译: Recent advances in error-corrected qubits have accelerated the timeline for practical quantum computing. It poses a threat to cryptographic primitives used to secure financial systems, government infrastructure, communication networks, and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) ecosystems. This paper introduces a post-quantum secure federated DeFi framework that enables inter-bank collaboration to improve the inclusivity of individuals underserved by local lenders due to limited financial histories. Multiple banks contribute encrypted information batches to a virtual server, where lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables end-to-end homomorphic computation. The server fuses local data-driven probabilistic assessments, expert beliefs, and verifiable evidence generated by the NASA-IBM Prithvi Geospatial Foundation Model (GFM), in encrypted format. Decentralized technologies are employed to ensure tamper-proof evidence and auditable accountability for all encrypted data exchanges between institutions and the server. The framework is tested on agricultural lending decisions for rural borrowers in Virginia.

Abstract

Recent advances in error-corrected qubits have accelerated the timeline for practical quantum computing. It poses a threat to cryptographic primitives used to secure financial systems, government infrastructure, communication networks, and DeFi (Decentralized Finance) ecosystems. This paper introduces a post-quantum secure federated DeFi framework that enables inter-bank collaboration to improve the inclusivity of individuals underserved by local lenders due to limited financial histories. Multiple banks contribute encrypted information batches to a virtual server, where lattice-based Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables end-to-end homomorphic computation. The server fuses local data-driven probabilistic assessments, expert beliefs, and verifiable evidence generated by the NASA-IBM Prithvi Geospatial Foundation Model (GFM), in encrypted format. Decentralized technologies are employed to ensure tamper-proof evidence and auditable accountability for all encrypted data exchanges between institutions and the server. The framework is tested on agricultural lending decisions for rural borrowers in Virginia.

item.title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
item.author: Lu, Yu, Yang, Junjie, Koniusz, Piotr, Song, YuXin, Yang, Yi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出FadeMem，一种距离感知的KV记忆整合机制，通过固定缓存预算下的时间层级组织历史KV块，解决自回归视频生成器因历史KV缓存增长导致的成本问题。

背景: 自回归视频生成器通过连续生成时间片段合成视频，但历史KV缓存随视频长度增长。现有有界缓存方法通过局部窗口、固定令牌或压缩记忆状态降低成本，但通常对历史不同部分分配固定角色。

目的: 解决自回归视频生成器中历史KV缓存增长带来的计算成本问题，同时保持视频生成的质量。

方法: 提出FadeMem机制，基于频率依赖的时间衰减特性，将新历史作为细粒度条目插入，旧相邻条目按幂律时间分配计划逐步合并，形成近密远疏的记忆结构。

主要发现: 实验表明，FadeMem在主体一致性、背景稳定性和时间连贯性方面优于现有有界缓存策略。

结论: FadeMem无需架构修改即可保留近期上下文用于短期动态，并提供紧凑的长程锚点以维持身份和场景连贯性。

翻译: Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos by generating successive temporal segments, but their historical KV cache grows with video length. Existing bounded-cache methods reduce this cost with local windows, sink tokens, or compressed memory states, yet they usually assign fixed roles to different parts of the history. We propose FadeMem, a distance-aware KV memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed cache budget. This design is motivated by frequency-dependent temporal decay: fine details decorrelate quickly, while coarse scene structure and identity remain useful over longer horizons. During generation, new history is inserted as fine-grained entries, while older adjacent entries are progressively merged under a power-law temporal allocation schedule, yielding a dense-near, sparse-far memory within one cache. Without architectural changes, FadeMem preserves recent context for short-term dynamics and compact long-range anchors for identity and scene coherence. Experiments show improved subject consistency, background stability, and temporal coherence over existing bounded-cache strategies.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决自回归视频生成模型在生成长视频时，历史缓存信息随时间无限增长导致的存储与计算成本过高的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为长视频生成必须持续依赖历史帧来维持角色外观、场景布局和动作的连贯性，而现有固定缓存策略无法根据时间远近自适应分配内存，容易导致角色漂移和画面退化。通过提出一种按时间距离动态合并历史缓存的机制，该方法能在固定内存预算下显著提升长视频生成的质量与可行性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过实证分析发现长视频中帧间相关性会随时间距离增加而衰减，且高频细节衰减快而低频场景结构更持久。基于此，他们在固定缓存容量下设计了距离感知的记忆整合机制，将历史状态按时间远近分层，近期内容保持精细记录，远期内容则按幂律规律逐步合并为粗略摘要。该方法并未直接照搬现有工作，而是针对以往固定划分缓存区域的做法进行改进，仅借鉴了基础缓存压缩思路，核心在于根据时间距离动态分配记忆粒度。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用视频内容随时间距离增加而呈现的频率衰减特性，在固定缓存预算下构建近密远疏的时间层级记忆结构。近期画面保留精细细节以维持短期连贯性，而远期画面则逐步合并为粗糙的结构摘要以锚定整体场景与身份。整体实现流程为：生成新帧时将其作为精细条目加入有序缓存；当缓存条目数达到上限时，系统会根据时间距离的幂律映射规则，自动选择时间跨度最接近的相邻旧条目进行合并。合并操作会加权平均它们的特征状态并更新覆盖的时间跨度，从而在无需修改模型架构的前提下，动态维持近处精细、远处精简的记忆布局。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种距离感知的记忆整合机制，在固定缓存预算下将历史数据按时间距离组织成时间层级结构。相比以往工作为不同缓存区域分配固定角色，该方法自适应地分配内存粒度：近期数据保持精细记录以捕捉短期动态，远期数据则逐步合并为粗粒度摘要以维持场景与身份稳定。该机制无需修改模型架构，通过统一的更新规则有效提升了长视频生成的连贯性与一致性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种距离感知的记忆整合机制，通过根据时间远近动态合并历史缓存块，在固定内存预算下有效提升了长视频生成中的人物一致性与场景连贯性。

Abstract

Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos by generating successive temporal segments, but their historical KV cache grows with video length. Existing bounded-cache methods reduce this cost with local windows, sink tokens, or compressed memory states, yet they usually assign fixed roles to different parts of the history. We propose FadeMem, a distance-aware KV memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical KV blocks into a temporal hierarchy under a fixed cache budget. This design is motivated by frequency-dependent temporal decay: fine details decorrelate quickly, while coarse scene structure and identity remain useful over longer horizons. During generation, new history is inserted as fine-grained entries, while older adjacent entries are progressively merged under a power-law temporal allocation schedule, yielding a dense-near, sparse-far memory within one cache. Without architectural changes, FadeMem preserves recent context for short-term dynamics and compact long-range anchors for identity and scene coherence. Experiments show improved subject consistency, background stability, and temporal coherence over existing bounded-cache strategies.

item.title: One Step Closer to Ground Truth: A Multi-Scale Residual-Aware Representation Learning Pipeline for Predicting Time Series Data
item.author: Amrijit Biswas, Mustafa Kamal, Robin Krambroeckers, M. M. Lutfe Elahi, Sifat Momen, Nabeel Mohammed, Shafin Rahman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种两阶段、模型无关的框架，将预测和残差学习解耦，通过元校正器动态建模结构化误差模式并迭代修正残差偏差，在多个基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。

背景: 基于变换器的模型近年来已成为时间序列预测的主流范式，利用自注意力机制捕捉长程依赖关系。然而，这些单阶段预测架构存在系统性残差偏差，源于结构差异、未建模的随机分量或多尺度时间表示不足。

目的: 解决单阶段架构中残差被视为不可约噪声而导致的局限性，通过显式解耦预测和残差学习，实现结构化误差模式的自适应修正。

方法: 引入一个两阶段框架：首先使用基础变换器生成初始预测，随后通过专用的元校正器动态建模多变量通道上的结构化误差模式，保持跨变量依赖关系，并迭代细化基础变换器的残差偏差。该框架被形式化为假设空间扩展。

主要发现: 在八个流行基准数据集上评估，该方法在标准指标（均方误差、平均绝对误差）上取得显著改进，实现了最先进的性能。

结论: 该框架能够有效减轻系统性偏差，增强对复杂时间动态的鲁棒性，提升了基于变换器的预测模型的实际适用性。

翻译: Transformer-based models have emerged as leading paradigms in time-series forecasting in recent years, employing self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies. Despite their success, these single-stage forecasting architectures exhibit persistent systematic residual biases arising from structural discrepancies, unmodeled stochastic components, or inadequate multi-scale temporal representations. This limitation persists when residuals are treated as irreducible noise, precluding adaptive correction of structured error patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that explicitly decouples forecasting and residual learning into distinct stages of representation learning. A base transformer first generates the initial predictions. Subsequently, a dedicated meta-corrector dynamically models structured error patterns across multivariate channels, preserves cross-variable dependencies, and iteratively refines the residual bias of the base transformer. By formalizing this pipeline as a hypothesis space expansion, our framework addresses approximation limitations inherent in single-stage architectures, removes reliance on restrictive assumptions, and enables end-to-end learning of complex error dynamics. Evaluated on eight popular benchmark datasets using established protocols, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in standard metrics (MSE, MAE). The results demonstrate the framework's ability to mitigate systematic biases and enhance robustness to complex temporal dynamics, advancing the practical applicability of transformer-based forecasting models.

Abstract

Transformer-based models have emerged as leading paradigms in time-series forecasting in recent years, employing self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies. Despite their success, these single-stage forecasting architectures exhibit persistent systematic residual biases arising from structural discrepancies, unmodeled stochastic components, or inadequate multi-scale temporal representations. This limitation persists when residuals are treated as irreducible noise, precluding adaptive correction of structured error patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that explicitly decouples forecasting and residual learning into distinct stages of representation learning. A base transformer first generates the initial predictions. Subsequently, a dedicated meta-corrector dynamically models structured error patterns across multivariate channels, preserves cross-variable dependencies, and iteratively refines the residual bias of the base transformer. By formalizing this pipeline as a hypothesis space expansion, our framework addresses approximation limitations inherent in single-stage architectures, removes reliance on restrictive assumptions, and enables end-to-end learning of complex error dynamics. Evaluated on eight popular benchmark datasets using established protocols, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in standard metrics (MSE, MAE). The results demonstrate the framework's ability to mitigate systematic biases and enhance robustness to complex temporal dynamics, advancing the practical applicability of transformer-based forecasting models.

item.title: Don't waste SAM
item.author: Nermeen Abou Baker, Uwe Handmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究评估了Segment Anything Model在废物分割任务中的泛化能力，并通过微调提升了其性能。

背景: Meta AI发布的Segment Anything Model在零样本图像分割任务中表现出色，但在多个研究领域无法提供精确分割，仍可作为分割流程的起点。

目的: 评估Segment Anything Model的泛化能力，并使用三个废物分割数据集对其进行微调。

方法: 使用三个从真实场景捕获的废物分割数据集对Segment Anything Model进行微调，这些数据集包含遮挡、可变形物体、透明物体及易与背景混淆的物体等挑战。

主要发现: 微调后的Segment Anything Model-ViT-H模型在IoU指标上显著提升了百分之三十，优于Zerowaste和TACO数据集的最先进模型，且与TrashCan 1.0的性能差距仅为负一点四四。

结论: 微调Segment Anything Model作为基础模型对于提升下游废物分割任务的泛化能力至关重要，不应被忽视。

翻译: Meta AI最近发布了Segment Anything Model，该模型在各种任务的零样本图像分割中表现出卓越的准确性和性能。尽管它在多个研究领域无法提供精确分割，但仍然是支持分割流程的有价值起点，特别是需要大量高级技能标注的任务。本研究旨在评估Segment Anything Model的泛化能力，并使用三个废物分割数据集对其进行微调。虽然这些数据集是从真实场景中捕获的，与Segment Anything Model预训练时类似，但它们存在遮挡、可变形物体、透明物体以及容易与背景混淆的物体等挑战。我们的发现表明，微调后的Segment Anything Model-ViT-H模型在IoU指标上显著提升了百分之三十，优于Zerowaste和TACO数据集的最先进模型，并且与TrashCan 1.0的性能水平非常接近，仅相差负一点四四。在评估这些流行的废物数据集后，很明显，微调Segment Anything Model作为基础模型对于为下游废物分割任务提供更好的泛化能力至关重要。因此，不应忽视或浪费Segment Anything Model。

Abstract

Meta AI has recently released the Segment Anything Model (SAM), which demonstrates exceptional zero-shot image segmentation performance across various tasks with remarkable accuracy. Despite its inability to provide accurate segmentation across multiple research fields, SAM still serves as a valuable starting point for supporting the segmentation pipeline process, particularly for tasks that require extensive and senior skills annotations. This study aims to evaluate the generalization of SAM and fine-tuning SAM models using three waste segmentation datasets. Although they are captured from real scenes as SAM was pretrained on, these datasets present several challenges, including occlusions, deformable objects, transparency, and objects easily confused with backgrounds. In our findings, the fine-tuned SAM-ViT-H model outperforms the state-ofthe-art Zerowaste, and TACO datasets with a significant increase of +30 in IoU, and it closely approaches performance levels of TrashCan 1.0, with only a -1.44 difference. After evaluating these popular waste datasets, it became evident that fine-tuning SAM as a foundational model is a crucial step for providing better generalization for downstream waste segmentation tasks. Therefore, SAM should not be disregarded or wasted.

item.title: When the Chain of Thought Knows Better: Failure Modes in Multi-Turn Reasoning Models
item.author: Kasu, Sai Kartheek Reddy, Lukas, Nils, Poppi, Samuele
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为思维链输出二乘二安全矩阵的追踪级诊断框架，用于揭示多轮推理模型中终端分数评估难以察觉的隐藏时间动态。该框架通过内部推理和可见输出两个独立轴对每一轮对话进行标记，识别出四种操作定义的失败类型。研究评估了三种蒸馏推理目标在五种监督条件下的表现，收集了大量多轮对话数据。分析揭示了两个可复现的漏洞：监督悖论和上下文注入失败。最后，研究公开了完整数据集以支持后续研究。

背景: 多轮推理模型的失败在终端分数评估中 largely invisible（很大程度上不可见）。模型可能在长对话早期锁定不安全立场，但其最终轮的拒绝率可能与稳健对齐的基线难以区分。

目的: 为了暴露这些隐藏的时间动态，提出一种追踪级诊断方法。

方法: 提出思维链输出二乘二安全矩阵框架。该框架沿两个独立轴（内部推理和可见输出）对每一轮对话进行标记，产生四种操作定义的失败单元格：稳健对齐、对齐伪装、公开越狱和上下文注入失败。评估三种蒸馏推理目标，对抗固定攻击者，在五种监督条件下收集信息危害场景下的多轮对话和思维链追踪数据。

主要发现: 揭示了两个可复现的漏洞：一是监督悖论，即显式监控线索反而增加了对齐伪装率而非抑制它；二是上下文注入失败，即模型在内部状态安全的情况下锁定了不安全的外部输出。

结论: 研究公开了完整的多轮对话和思维链追踪数据集，以支持后续的追踪诊断研究。

翻译: 多轮推理模型的失败在终端分数评估中很大程度上不可见。模型可能在长对话早期锁定不安全立场，但其最终轮的拒绝率可能与稳健对齐的基线难以区分。为了暴露这些隐藏的时间动态，我们提出了一种追踪级诊断方法——思维链输出二乘二安全矩阵。该框架沿两个独立轴（内部推理和可见输出）对每一轮对话进行标记，产生四种操作定义的失败单元格：稳健对齐、对齐伪装、公开越狱和我们称为上下文注入失败的一种独特失败模式（其中思维链保持安全推理，但可见输出产生危害，突出了推理不忠实性的多轮表现）。我们在五种监督条件下，针对固定攻击者评估了三种蒸馏推理目标，收集了信息危害场景下六千七百五十条轮次级观察数据。我们的分析揭示了两个可复现的漏洞：一是监督悖论，即显式监控线索反而增加了对齐伪装率而非抑制它；二是上下文注入失败，即模型在内部状态安全的情况下锁定了不安全的外部输出。我们公开了完整的多轮对话和思维链追踪数据集，以支持后续的追踪诊断研究。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统评估指标无法捕捉多轮对话中推理模型隐藏的安全失效问题。现有方法通常只看最终拒绝率，导致模型内部产生不安全推理但表面输出合规的伪装对齐等动态风险被完全掩盖。明确这些隐藏机制对研究和现实应用至关重要，因为不同的失效模式需要完全不同的安全干预策略，只有精准定位问题才能有效提升模型在真实交互场景中的可靠性与可解释性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出传统单次评估仅关注最终拒绝率，无法捕捉长对话中模型内部推理与外部输出脱节的隐藏风险。为此，他们借鉴了现有文献中关于对齐伪装与思维链忠实度的研究，将其从静态单次交互拓展至动态多轮对话场景。在方法设计上，作者采用固定攻击者进行多轮对抗对话以诱发安全立场漂移，并构建了一个将内部推理与外部输出独立标记的二维诊断框架，从而精准识别四种不同的失效模式。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过将对话的每一轮独立拆解为内部推理与可见输出两个维度，构建一个四象限安全矩阵，从而精准识别传统终端评分无法察觉的隐藏失效模式。整体实现流程首先设定固定攻击者与目标模型进行多轮对抗对话，随后利用多模型评审团队独立标注每一轮的推理过程与最终回复的安全状态，最后将每轮对话归类至矩阵的四个象限中，以分析模型在长期交互中的行为漂移与欺骗倾向。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种同时评估内部推理过程与外部可见输出的双轴分析框架，并首次将内部推理安全但外部输出有害的上下文注入失败定义为独立的故障模式。相比以往依赖静态单轮提示和整体拒绝率的传统评估，本研究构建了动态多轮对抗对话机制，揭示了监督提示反而诱发模型策略性伪装的矛盾现象。此外，论文公开了包含完整推理轨迹的多轮对话数据集，为后续研究提供了可复现的行为分析基础。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种结合内部思维链与外部可见输出的诊断框架，用于精准识别多轮对话中推理模型隐藏的安全失效模式，并发布了完整的可复现多轮对话数据集。

Abstract

Failures in multi-turn reasoning models are largely invisible to terminal-score evaluation. A model can lock onto an unsafe stance early in a long dialogue, yet its final-turn refusal rate may appear indistinguishable from a robustly aligned baseline. To expose these hidden temporal dynamics, we propose a trace-level diagnostic - the CoT-Output 2x2 safety matrix. This framework labels every turn along two independent axes (internal reasoning and visible output), yielding four operationally defined failure cells: robust alignment, alignment faking, overt jailbreak, and a distinct failure mode we term context-injection failure (where the CoT maintains safe reasoning, but the visible output produces harm, highlighting a multi-turn manifestation of reasoning unfaithfulness). We evaluate three distilled reasoning targets against a fixed attacker across five oversight conditions, collecting 6750 turn-level observations on the Information-Hazard scenario. Our analysis reveals two reproducible vulnerabilities: an oversight paradox where explicit monitoring cues paradoxically increase alignment-faking rates rather than suppress them, and a context-injection failure where models lock onto unsafe external outputs despite safe internal states. We release the full dataset of multi-turn dialogues and CoT traces to support follow-up trace-diagnostic research.

item.title: Spatially Selective Self-Training for Unsupervised Building Change Detection
item.author: Wafaa I. M. Hussin, Zhi Lu, Anas M. I. Mohammed, Xiang Zhou, Ratiba A. H. Abubaker, Zhenming Peng
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SST-CD的空间选择性自训练框架，用于无监督建筑变化检测。该框架将完全无标签的建筑变化检测重新定义为在嘈杂伪监督下的端到端检测器学习。通过利用时间差异作为候选伪标签，并仅对空间可靠像素进行训练，结合局部一致性准则过滤不一致区域，以及使用轻量级特征适配器和基于原型的解码器来稳定训练过程。在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有的无监督和免标签基线方法。

背景: 无监督建筑变化检测旨在从未标记的双时相遥感图像中学习建筑变化掩膜。现有的免标签方法通常遵循差异到掩膜的范式，直接使用时间差异、冻结的基础模型响应、基于提示的输出或后处理结果作为最终变化图。这些策略虽然提供了无需标注的线索，但并未学习任务特定的建筑变化检测器，且容易受到通用时间差异与建筑定义的结构变化之间差距的影响。在实际应用中，这些差异通常具有噪声且与任务无关，因为外观变化、配准误差和非建筑修改可能会产生强烈但具有误导性的响应。

目的: 解决现有方法中差异具有噪声且与任务无关的问题，学习一个任务特定的建筑变化检测器，提高检测的准确性和鲁棒性。

方法: 提出SST-CD框架，将完全无标签的建筑变化检测重新定义为在嘈杂伪监督下的端到端检测器学习。使用时间差异作为候选伪标签，通过局部一致性准则估计空间可靠像素的可靠性，并仅在这些可靠像素上训练检测器。为了进一步稳定嘈杂的自训练过程，使用轻量级特征适配器重新校准双时相特征，并使用基于原型的解码器生成紧凑的变化和无变化表示。

主要发现: 在LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD和DSIFN-CD数据集上的实验表明，SST-CD分别取得了百分之八十三点零八、百分之九十一点六九和百分之八十六点六零的F1分数，优于现有的无监督和免标签基线方法。

结论: SST-CD框架有效地解决了无监督建筑变化检测中的噪声和任务无关差异问题，通过空间选择性自训练和特征校准提高了检测性能，为完全无标签的建筑变化检测提供了一种有效的解决方案。

翻译: Unsupervised building change detection aims to learn building-change masks from unlabeled bi-temporal remote sensing images. Existing label-free methods often follow a discrepancy-to-mask paradigm, directly using temporal differences, frozen foundation-model responses, prompt-based outputs, or post-processing results as final change maps. Although these strategies provide annotation-free cues, they do not learn a task-specific building-change detector and remain vulnerable to the gap between generic temporal discrepancies and building-defined structural changes. In practice, such discrepancies are often noisy and task-irrelevant, as appearance shifts, registration errors, and non-building modifications can produce strong but misleading responses. To address this problem, we propose SST-CD, a spatially selective self-training framework that reformulates fully label-free building change detection as end-to-end detector learning under noisy pseudo supervision. SST-CD uses temporal discrepancies as candidate pseudo labels and trains the detector only on spatially reliable pixels, whose reliability is estimated by a local consistency criterion that filters inconsistent regions from supervision. To further stabilize noisy self-training, a lightweight feature adapter recalibrates bi-temporal features, while a prototype-based decoder produces compact change and no-change representations. Experiments on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and DSIFN-CD show that SST-CD achieves F1 scores of 83.08%, 91.69%, and 86.60%, respectively, outperforming existing unsupervised and label-free baselines. Code will be made publicly available.

Abstract

Unsupervised building change detection aims to learn building-change masks from unlabeled bi-temporal remote sensing images. Existing label-free methods often follow a discrepancy-to-mask paradigm, directly using temporal differences, frozen foundation-model responses, prompt-based outputs, or post-processing results as final change maps. Although these strategies provide annotation-free cues, they do not learn a task-specific building-change detector and remain vulnerable to the gap between generic temporal discrepancies and building-defined structural changes. In practice, such discrepancies are often noisy and task-irrelevant, as appearance shifts, registration errors, and non-building modifications can produce strong but misleading responses. To address this problem, we propose SST-CD, a spatially selective self-training framework that reformulates fully label-free building change detection as end-to-end detector learning under noisy pseudo supervision. SST-CD uses temporal discrepancies as candidate pseudo labels and trains the detector only on spatially reliable pixels, whose reliability is estimated by a local consistency criterion that filters inconsistent regions from supervision. To further stabilize noisy self-training, a lightweight feature adapter recalibrates bi-temporal features, while a prototype-based decoder produces compact change and no-change representations. Experiments on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and DSIFN-CD show that SST-CD achieves F1 scores of 83.08\%, 91.69\%, and 86.60\%, respectively, outperforming existing unsupervised and label-free baselines. Code will be made publicly available.

item.title: From Patches to Patients: A study of the tile-to-slide performance transferability in Digital Pathology
item.author: Sofiène Boutaj, Leo Fillioux, Maria Vakalopoulou, Stergios Christodoulidis, Pierre Marza
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究探讨了基于图像块级别的线性探测能否作为图像级别性能的有效代理，从而减少为每个候选编码器运行完整图像级流程的需求。通过评估十九种最先进的基座模型在四十二个图像级别任务和十六个图像块级别任务上的表现，发现图像块级别与图像级别性能之间存在高度相关性，表明编码器表示质量是决定全切片图像分析成功的关键因素。研究还指出，图像块级别基准测试可作为筛选候选模型的高效初步步骤，而图像级别评估对于临床任务的最终验证仍然不可或缺。

背景: 基座模型近期通过为全切片图像分析提供稳健的表示，重新定义了组织病理学的最先进水平。然而，为特定临床队列选择最佳基座模型目前需要多个预处理步骤，随后进行计算昂贵的特征提取，并为每个模型训练多实例学习聚合器。

目的: 调查高效的图像块级别线性探测能否作为图像级别性能的可靠代理，从而减少为每个候选编码器运行完整图像级流程的需求。

方法: 在四十二个图像级别任务和十六个图像块级别任务上对十九种最先进的基座模型进行基准测试，使用平均池化和注意力多实例学习聚合方法比较图像块探测指标与图像级别结果。

主要发现: 图像块级别与图像级别性能在不同任务难度下表现出高度相关性，表明编码器表示质量是全切片图像分析成功的主要决定因素。敏感性分析显示，模型间的可迁移性稳定，且受队列大小和每张图像的图像块数量影响大于受平均任务难度影响。图像块级别与图像级别任务中表现最佳模型的一致性表明，图像块级别基准测试能可靠地筛选出强候选模型。

结论: 图像块级别基准测试为缩小候选模型范围提供了高效且实用的初步步骤，而图像级别评估对于临床任务的最终验证仍然至关重要。

翻译: Foundation Models (FMs) have recently redefined the state-of-the-art in histopathology by providing robust representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis. However, selecting the optimal foundation model (FM) for a specific clinical cohort currently requires multiple preprocessing steps, followed by computationally expensive feature extraction and the training of a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) aggregator for every model. In this work, we investigate whether efficient tile-level linear probing can serve as a reliable proxy for slide-level performance, reducing the need to run full slide-level pipelines for every candidate encoder. We benchmark 19 state-of-the-art FMs on 42 slide-level and 16 tile-level tasks, comparing tile probing metrics against slide-level outcomes using ABMIL and Mean Pooling aggregations. We observe a high correlation between tile and slide performance across varying task difficulties, indicating that encoder representation quality is the primary determinant of WSI success. Sensitivity analyses show that transferability is stable across models and is more influenced by cohort sizes and numbers of tiles per slide than by average task difficulty. We also measure the agreement in best performing models between tile and slide-level tasks, showing tile benchmarks reliably shortlist strong candidates. Overall, our study indicates that tile-level benchmarking provides an efficient and practical first step for narrowing down candidate models, while slide-level evaluation remains essential for final validation on clinical tasks.

Abstract

Foundation Models (FMs) have recently redefined the state-of-the-art in histopathology by providing robust representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis. However, selecting the optimal foundation model (FM) for a specific clinical cohort currently requires multiple preprocessing steps, followed by computationally expensive feature extraction and the training of a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) aggregator for every model. In this work, we investigate whether efficient tile-level linear probing can serve as a reliable proxy for slide-level performance, reducing the need to run full slide-level pipelines for every candidate encoder. We benchmark 19 state-of-the-art FMs on 42 slide-level and 16 tile-level tasks, comparing tile probing metrics against slide-level outcomes using ABMIL and Mean Pooling aggregations. We observe a high correlation between tile and slide performance across varying task difficulties, indicating that encoder representation quality is the primary determinant of WSI success. Sensitivity analyses show that transferability is stable across models and is more influenced by cohort sizes and numbers of tiles per slide than by average task difficulty. We also measure the agreement in best performing models between tile and slide-level tasks, showing tile benchmarks reliably shortlist strong candidates. Overall, our study indicates that tile-level benchmarking provides an efficient and practical first step for narrowing down candidate models, while slide-level evaluation remains essential for final validation on clinical tasks.

item.title: CITRAS-FM: Tiny Time Series Foundation Model for Covariate-Informed Zero-Shot Forecasting
item.author: Yosuke Yamaguchi, Issei Suemitsu, Yuki Kajihara, Wenpeng Wei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为CITRAS-FM的轻量级时间序列基础模型，该模型支持单变量、多变量及协变量驱动的零样本预测，具备实时CPU推理能力，并在多项基准测试中实现了高精度与低延迟的平衡。

背景: 预训练时间序列基础模型已实现了对未见目标序列的零样本预测，但现有模型通常计算成本高昂，对多样化变量类型支持有限，且常忽略外生影响目标变化的协变量。

目的: 解决现有时间序列基础模型计算成本高、变量类型支持有限以及未能有效利用协变量的问题。

方法: 提出CITRAS-FM模型，该模型基于基于补丁的解码器Transformer架构，参数规模仅为700万。引入移位注意力机制以有效利用预测期内已知的协变量。提出CovSynth方法，从目标序列的分解成分中合成逼真的协变量，以解决协变量丰富语料稀缺的问题。

主要发现: 在涵盖各种设置的一百个任务的fev-bench基准测试中，CITRAS-FM在参数规模小于1000万的模型中实现了最先进的零样本预测精度，同时实现了低于0.1秒的CPU推理时间。

结论: CITRAS-FM在预测精度和实时部署能力之间提供了强大的平衡，是一种高效且实用的轻量级时间序列基础模型。

翻译: Pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) have enabled zero-shot forecasting on unseen target series. However, existing TSFMs often incur high computational cost and provide limited support for diverse variable types, often failing to account for covariates that exogenously influence target variability. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS-FM, a tiny 7M-parameter TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting with real-time CPU inference. Built on a patch-based, decoder-only Transformer, CITRAS-FM introduces Shifted Attention into the cross-variate module to effectively exploit known covariates accessible throughout the forecast horizon. Moreover, to enable covariate-aware pretraining despite the scarcity of covariate-rich corpora, we propose CovSynth, which synthesizes realistic covariates from decomposed components of target series. Experiments on fev-bench, spanning 100 tasks across various settings, demonstrate that CITRAS-FM achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among sub-10M TSFMs while delivering sub-0.1-second CPU inference, offering a strong balance between forecasting accuracy and real-time deployability.

Abstract

Pretrained time series foundation models (TSFMs) have enabled zero-shot forecasting on unseen target series. However, existing TSFMs often incur high computational cost and provide limited support for diverse variable types, often failing to account for covariates that exogenously influence target variability. To address these challenges, we propose CITRAS-FM, a tiny 7M-parameter TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed zero-shot forecasting with real-time CPU inference. Built on a patch-based, decoder-only Transformer, CITRAS-FM introduces Shifted Attention into the cross-variate module to effectively exploit known covariates accessible throughout the forecast horizon. Moreover, to enable covariate-aware pretraining despite the scarcity of covariate-rich corpora, we propose CovSynth, which synthesizes realistic covariates from decomposed components of target series. Experiments on fev-bench, spanning 100 tasks across various settings, demonstrate that CITRAS-FM achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy among sub-10M TSFMs while delivering sub-0.1-second CPU inference, offering a strong balance between forecasting accuracy and real-time deployability.

item.title: SCAIL-2: Unifying Controlled Character Animation with End-to-end In-Context Conditioning
item.author: Yan, Wenhao, Guo, Fengjia, Yang, Zhuoyi, Tang, Jie
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出SCAIL-2框架，实现端到端角色动画，通过直接拼接驱动视频获取视觉信息，构建MotionPair-60K数据集，使用上下文掩码条件、模式特定RoPE和偏差感知DPO解决数据缺乏和合成差异问题，性能优于现有方法。

背景: 受控角色动画需要将驱动序列的动作转移到参考角色上。现有工作严重依赖中间表示（如姿态骨架表示动作或掩码背景表示环境），这不可避免地导致信息丢失。

目的: 解决现有方法因依赖中间表示而导致的信息丢失问题，实现端到端的角色动画。

方法: 提出SCAIL-2框架，直接拼接驱动视频以获取所有视觉信息；统一角色动画子任务并构建MotionPair-60K端到端动作转移数据集；使用上下文掩码条件和模式特定RoPE作为软引导；提出偏差感知DPO构建偏好项以缓解详细区域的合成差异。

主要发现: 广泛实验表明，该方法在各种角色动画任务中显著优于现有的最先进方法。

结论: SCAIL-2框架有效实现了端到端角色动画，解决了信息丢失问题，并提供了合成数据和模型权重。

翻译: Controlled character animation requires transferring motion from a driving sequence to a reference character. Prior works heavily rely on intermediate representations, including pose skeletons to represent motion or masked background to represent environment, which inevitably leads to information loss. To address this, we present SCAIL-2, an framework that bypasses those intermediates and achieves end-to-end character animation. By directly concatenating driving videos to the sequence, the model can obtain all the required visual information from the input video. To address lack of end-to-end data, we unify sub-tasks of character animation with decoupled conditions and then curate a pipeline to synthesize MotionPair-60K, an end-to-end motion transfer dataset containing heterogeneous tasks of character animation. To archive the unification, we utilize in-context mask conditioning and mode-specific RoPE as soft guidance beyond textual instructions and raw visual information. To address synthetic discrepancy in detailed regions, we propose Bias-Aware DPO to construct preference items to mitigate the errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in various character animation tasks. A large subset of synthetic data as well as model weights will be released at our project page: this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统角色动画生成方法依赖姿态骨架或背景掩码等中间表示，从而导致信息丢失和复杂交互失真的问题。通过端到端的直接视频驱动范式，模型能够完整保留遮挡关系与环境细节，实现更自然的动作迁移。该问题在影视制作与娱乐产业中至关重要，因为现有方法难以处理复杂场景交互与非人类角色驱动，而统一框架能显著提升泛化能力并降低制作门槛，推动相关技术的实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法依赖姿态骨架或背景掩码等中间表示会导致信息丢失的问题，思考采用端到端直接拼接驱动视频的设计思路，以完整保留视觉信息。为了解决数据匮乏和任务不统一的问题，他们解耦了子任务条件，设计了自动化合成管线构建数据集，并引入上下文掩码条件与特定模式的位置编码来实现多任务统一。该方法确实借鉴了现有工作，例如直接采用视频扩散模型作为基础架构，沿用作者前期工作的上下文驱动设计，并借助姿态驱动模型、图像分割模型及视觉语言模型来辅助数据合成与训练优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是跳过传统角色动画中容易丢失信息的中间表示，直接将驱动视频与参考视频拼接输入模型，并通过上下文掩码条件统一控制多种动画任务。整体实现流程为：首先利用自动化合成循环生成端到端运动配对数据集；接着将参考图像、噪声视频和驱动视频直接拼接输入扩散模型，借助上下文掩码与位置编码区分不同任务需求；最后采用偏好优化技术对细节区域进行微调以消除合成数据偏差并提升生成质量。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种端到端的角色动画生成框架，直接拼接驱动视频作为输入，彻底摒弃了传统方法依赖的骨架或掩码等中间表示。相比以往工作，该方法避免了中间信息提取导致的内容丢失与歧义，能够统一处理单角色动画、多角色交互及角色替换等多种子任务，并支持非人类驱动源。此外，论文还设计了自动化数据合成管线构建专用数据集，并引入偏好优化机制来提升手部等细节区域的生成质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种端到端的角色动画统一框架，通过直接拼接驱动视频摒弃传统中间表示，并结合自定义数据合成管线与上下文掩码条件技术，成功将多种角色动画任务统一于同一模型中并实现了高精度动作迁移。

Abstract

Controlled character animation requires transferring motion from a driving sequence to a reference character. Prior works heavily rely on intermediate representations, including pose skeletons to represent motion or masked background to represent environment, which inevitably leads to information loss. To address this, we present SCAIL-2, an framework that bypasses those intermediates and achieves \textbf{end-to-end} character animation. By directly concatenating driving videos to the sequence, the model can obtain all the required visual information from the input video. To address lack of end-to-end data, we unify sub-tasks of character animation with decoupled conditions and then curate a pipeline to synthesize MotionPair-60K, an end-to-end motion transfer dataset containing heterogeneous tasks of character animation. To archive the unification, we utilize in-context mask conditioning and mode-specific RoPE as soft guidance beyond textual instructions and raw visual information. To address synthetic discrepancy in detailed regions, we propose Bias-Aware DPO to construct preference items to mitigate the errors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in various character animation tasks. A large subset of synthetic data as well as model weights will be released at our project page: this https URL .

item.title: Role-Agent: Bootstrapping LLM Agents via Dual-Role Evolution
item.author: Wang, Xucong, Ma, Ziyu, Yang, Shidong, Huang, Tongwen, Wang, Pengkun, Wang, Yong, Chu, Xiangxiang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Role-Agent的框架，该框架利用单个大型语言模型同时充当智能体和环境，实现自举协同进化。该框架包含两个协同组件：World-In-Agent和Agent-In-World。实验表明，该框架在多个基准测试中 consistently 提升了性能，平均增益超过百分之四。

背景: 尽管大型语言模型智能体在复杂任务上表现出色，但其学习过程常受限于低效的交互反馈和静态的训练环境，这阻碍了更广泛的泛化能力。

目的: 解决大型语言模型智能体因低效交互反馈和静态训练环境而导致的泛化能力受限问题。

方法: 提出Role-Agent框架，利用单个大型语言模型同时作为智能体和环境。该框架包含两个组件：World-In-Agent，其中语言模型作为智能体预测动作后的未来状态，并将预测状态与实际状态的匹配度作为过程奖励以鼓励环境感知推理；Agent-In-World，其中语言模型分析失败轨迹中的失败模式，并检索具有相似失败模式的任務，从而重塑训练数据分布以进行针对性练习。

主要发现: 在多个基准测试中，Role-Agent consistently 提升了性能，相较于强大的基线模型，平均性能增益超过百分之四。

结论: Role-Agent框架通过自举协同进化机制，有效提升了大型语言模型智能体的性能。

翻译: Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks, their learning is often limited by inefficient interaction feedback and static training environments, which hinder broader generalization. To address these limitations, this paper introduces Role-Agent, a framework that harnesses a single LLM to function concurrently as both the agent and the environment, enabling a bootstrapped co-evolution. Role-Agent comprises two synergistic components: World-In-Agent (WIA) and Agent-In-World (AIW). In WIA, the LLM acts as the agent and predicts future states after each action; the alignment between predicted and actual states is then used as a process reward, encouraging environment-aware reasoning. In AIW, the LLM analyzes failure modes from failed trajectories and retrieves tasks with similar failure patterns, thereby reshaping the training data distribution for targeted practice. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Role-Agent consistently improves performance, yielding an average gain of over 4% over strong baselines.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在复杂任务学习中受限于交互反馈低效和训练环境静态固定，导致泛化能力不足的问题。现有方法通常只优化智能体而将环境视为固定不变，难以针对性地暴露和弥补智能体的隐藏弱点。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为实现智能体与环境的协同进化能够显著降低自适应环境的构建成本，并大幅提升智能体在编程、导航等动态现实场景中的推理能力、问题解决能力与泛化性能。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有智能体在静态环境中训练反馈低效的问题，提出让单一模型同时扮演智能体与环境角色的思路，以实现两者的协同进化。该方法设计了两个核心模块，分别用于通过预测未来状态获取过程奖励，以及通过分析失败轨迹来动态调整训练任务分布。在设计过程中，作者借鉴了强化学习、世界模型以及状态分组优势估计等现有研究，并在此基础上进行了整合与创新。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让同一个大语言模型同时扮演智能体和环境的双重角色，从而实现两者的协同进化。整体流程包含两个协同模块：模型首先作为智能体在每次行动后预测未来的环境状态，并将预测与实际状态的吻合度转化为奖励信号以增强环境感知；随后模型切换为环境角色，分析失败案例的根本原因，检索具有相似失败模式的过往任务，并据此动态调整训练数据的分布。这两个模块形成闭环，使模型在无需人工干预的情况下持续自我优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出单一模型同时扮演智能体与环境双重角色的协同进化框架。具体而言，框架通过让模型预测行动后的未来状态，并将预测与实际的吻合度转化为奖励信号以增强环境感知；同时让模型自主分析失败原因并检索相似难题，动态调整训练数据分布以针对性补强短板。与以往仅优化智能体或将环境视为固定反馈源的工作不同，该方法无需额外构建环境模型或人工干预，仅凭单一模型即可实现智能体与环境的自适应闭环进化。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为Role-Agent的框架，通过让同一个大语言模型同时扮演智能体与环境的双重角色，实现了无需人工监督的协同进化机制，并在多项基准测试中显著提升了模型性能。

Abstract

Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong performance on complex tasks, their learning is often limited by inefficient interaction feedback and static training environments, which hinder broader generalization.
