item.author: Canyu Lei, Fenglin Zhang, Derek Bivona, Cristiane Singulane, Jonathan Pan, Kenneth Bilchick, Amit R. Patel, Jianxin Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种多尺度注意力增强卷积网络（MSAIC-Net），用于基于心电图检测心肌基质异常。

背景: 心肌基质异常（如心肌瘢痕和心肌梗死）与不良心血管结局相关。心电图是检测这些异常的廉价且广泛可用的工具，但由于导联依赖性表现异质性、高维多导联信号、类别不平衡以及深度学习模型可解释性有限，基于心电图的检测仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 开发一种基于心电图的心肌基质异常检测方法。

方法: 提出了多尺度注意力增强卷积网络（MSAIC-Net）。该网络采用并行空洞卷积分支，在多个时间感受野中提取心电图特征。使用通道注意力自适应重新加权信息性导联和特征通道表示。引入了一种新颖的不平衡感知监督对比学习策略，以解决类别不平衡问题并提高特征可分性。结合导联置换重要性，量化每个心电图导联的贡献并提高模型可解释性。在两个互补数据集上评估了所提出的方法：弗吉尼亚大学健康系统的低数据机构队列（用于心肌瘢痕分类）和PhysioNet的大规模公开PTB-XL数据集（用于心肌梗死识别）。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，MSAIC-Net优于基线模型，在低数据的弗吉尼亚大学队列中改进尤为显著。

结论: 所提出的框架为基于心电图检测心肌基质异常提供了一种有效且可解释的方法。

翻译: 心肌基质异常（如心肌瘢痕和心肌梗死）与不良心血管结局相关。心电图是检测这些异常的廉价且广泛可用的工具，但由于导联依赖性表现异质性、高维多导联信号、类别不平衡以及深度学习模型可解释性有限，基于心电图的检测仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种用于基于心电图检测心肌基质异常的多尺度注意力增强卷积网络（MSAIC-Net）。MSAIC-Net采用并行空洞卷积分支，在多个时间感受野中提取心电图特征。然后使用通道注意力自适应重新加权信息性导联和特征通道表示。为了解决类别不平衡并提高特征可分性，我们引入了一种新颖的不平衡感知监督对比学习策略，该策略鼓励同一类的样本形成紧凑表示，同时增加异常样本和正常样本之间的分离。进一步结合导联置换重要性，以量化每个心电图导联的贡献并提高模型可解释性。所提出的方法在两个互补数据集上进行了评估：弗吉尼亚大学健康系统的低数据机构队列（用于心肌瘢痕分类）和PhysioNet的大规模公开PTB-XL数据集（用于心肌梗死识别）。实验结果表明，MSAIC-Net优于基线模型，在低数据的弗吉尼亚大学队列中改进尤为显著。总体而言，所提出的框架为基于心电图检测心肌基质异常提供了一种有效且可解释的方法。

Abstract

Myocardial substrate abnormalities, such as myocardial scar and myocardial infarction (MI), are associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides a low-cost and widely available tool for detecting these abnormalities, but ECG-based detection remains challenging due to heterogeneous lead-dependent manifestations, high-dimensional multi-lead signals, class imbalance, and the limited interpretability of deep learning models. We propose a multi-scale attention-enhanced convolutional network (MSAIC-Net) for ECG-based myocardial substrate abnormality detection. MSAIC-Net employs parallel atrous convolutional branches to extract ECG features across multiple temporal receptive fields. %, enabling the model to capture both local and longer-range temporal patterns. Channel attention is then used to adaptively reweight informative lead-wise and feature-channel representations. To address class imbalance and improve feature separability, we introduce a novel imbalance-aware supervised contrastive learning strategy that encourages samples from the same class to form compact representations while increasing separation between abnormal and normal samples. Lead-wise permutation importance is further incorporated to quantify the contribution of each ECG lead and improve model interpretability. The proposed method was evaluated on two complementary datasets: a low-data institutional cohort from the University of Virginia (UVA) Health System for myocardial scar classification and the large-scale public PTB-XL dataset from PhysioNet for MI identification. Experimental results show that MSAIC-Net outperforms baseline models, with particularly pronounced improvements in the low-data UVA cohort. Overall, the proposed framework provides an effective and interpretable approach for ECG-based detection of myocardial substrate abnormalities.

item.title: SCOUT: Semantic scene COverage via Uncertainty-guided Traversal
item.author: Junyu Mao, Sara Ayoubi, Vishnu D. Sharma, Ilija Hadžić, Matthew Andrews
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SCOUT的在线语义探索框架，该框架通过耦合主动遍历与概率性场景图构建，使机器人能够在长时间运行中逐步理解环境。

背景: 大多数三维场景图管线将感知视为固定数据集上的后处理阶段，将场景表示与决定观察内容的决策解耦。

目的: 使机器人不仅访问空间，还能逐步理解空间，将语义场景完整性作为操作目标而非语义映射的被动副产品。

方法: 给定先验二维占据地图和带姿态的RGB-D观测数据，SCOUT增量构建不确定性感知的三维场景图，节点融合几何与开放词汇对象标签的后验信念，边编码结构关系，并将这些信念反馈给不确定性引导的遍历规划器以选择视点。

主要发现: 机器人会在需要额外证据时重新访问模糊对象，并在场景不完整时扩展到未见过的自由空间，实现了语义确定性增益、几何覆盖增益与旅行成本之间的平衡。

结论: 该系统推动了自主代理的发展，使其能够在最少人工干预的情况下巡逻、更新和推理不断变化的室内环境。

翻译: Robots that operate over extended periods should not merely visit space; they should progressively understand it. Yet most 3D scene graph pipelines treat perception as a post-processing stage over a fixed dataset, decoupling scene representation from the decisions that determine what is observed in the first place. We present SCOUT, an online semantic exploration framework that closes this loop by coupling active traversal with probabilistic scene graph construction. Given a prior 2D occupancy map and posed RGB-D observations, SCOUT incrementally builds an uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph whose nodes maintain fused geometry and posterior beliefs over open-vocabulary object labels, while edges encode structural relations such as on, inside, belong, and next to. These beliefs are fed back to an uncertainty-guided traversal planner, which selects viewpoints by balancing expected semantic certainty gain, geometric coverage gain, and travel cost. In this way, the robot revisits ambiguous objects when additional evidence matters and expands into unseen free space when the scene remains incomplete. The resulting system treats semantic scene completeness as an operational objective rather than a passive by-product of semantic mapping, moving toward autonomous agents that can patrol, update, and reason about evolving indoor environments with minimal human intervention.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决机器人环境感知与数据收集相互脱节的问题，旨在通过主动探索与场景图构建的闭环，实现语义场景理解的持续自主更新。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为传统静态数据处理方式会导致数据收集效率低下、存在视觉盲区且无法适应动态变化的环境。通过让机器人根据认知不确定性自主规划观测视角，可以显著提升长期自主巡检和复杂交互任务中的环境理解能力与效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出传统方法将场景理解与数据采集割裂，导致效率低下且无法动态更新。为此，他们设计了将主动探索与概率场景图构建相耦合的闭环框架，通过综合评估语义确定性增益、几何覆盖增益与移动成本来动态规划观测路径。该方法借鉴了主动学习思想，并直接整合了现有的开放词汇检测、图像分割与特征提取工具来实现增量式场景理解。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将机器人的主动探索与场景图构建紧密结合，通过持续更新带有不确定性评估的三维场景图来动态指导机器人的移动路径。整体实现流程为：系统首先基于先验地图生成候选观测点，并根据语义确定性提升、几何覆盖范围及移动成本进行综合评分以选择最优视点；机器人到达该视点采集图像后，处理模块会实时融合几何信息、更新物体语义概率并降低不确定性；更新后的场景图数据再次反馈给路径规划器，形成闭环迭代，直至达到预设的几何与语义覆盖目标。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将数据采集与场景图构建深度融合，形成闭环的主动感知系统。与以往将感知视为静态数据后处理步骤的工作不同，本文通过不确定性引导的遍历规划器，动态平衡语义确定性提升、几何覆盖范围与移动成本来自主决策观测视角。系统采用概率化场景图维护对象语义的不确定性，并根据实时观测结果持续迭代更新，从而实现无需人工干预的语义场景完整性探索。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种在线语义探索框架，通过将主动路径规划与概率场景图构建相耦合，使机器人能够根据语义不确定性和几何覆盖需求自主规划观测视角，从而高效渐进地构建完整的三维语义场景图。

Abstract

Robots that operate over extended periods should not merely visit space; they should progressively understand it. Yet most 3D scene graph pipelines treat perception as a post-processing stage over a fixed dataset, decoupling scene representation from the decisions that determine what is observed in the first place. We present SCOUT, an online semantic exploration framework that closes this loop by coupling active traversal with probabilistic scene graph construction. Given a prior 2D occupancy map and posed RGB-D observations, SCOUT incrementally builds an uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph whose nodes maintain fused geometry and posterior beliefs over open-vocabulary object labels, while edges encode structural relations such as on, inside, belong, and next to. These beliefs are fed back to an uncertainty-guided traversal planner, which selects viewpoints by balancing expected semantic certainty gain, geometric coverage gain, and travel cost. In this way, the robot revisits ambiguous objects when additional evidence matters and expands into unseen free space when the scene remains incomplete. The resulting system treats semantic scene completeness as an operational objective rather than a passive by-product of semantic mapping, moving toward autonomous agents that can patrol, update, and reason about evolving indoor environments with minimal human intervention.

item.title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
item.author: Jiyun Jang, Yujin Sung, Woosung Joung, Daewon Chae, Sangwon Lee, Sohwi Kim, Jinkyu Kim, Jungbeom Lee
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为AxisGuide的轻量级引导方法，旨在弥合语义场景理解与动作坐标解释之间的差距，通过显式可视化机器人基座坐标系在图像空间中的含义，提升视觉运动策略在分布偏移下的可靠性和泛化能力。

背景: 通过大规模行为克隆训练的视觉运动策略在语义场景理解方面表现强劲，但在分布偏移下难以可靠执行正确的底层动作，例如在相同场景布局、相机视角和光照条件下，当物体放置在未见位置时性能显著下降。

目的: 解决因动作理解不足导致的问题，即无法在图像空间中解释机器人基座动作坐标系，从而提升视觉运动策略的可靠性和泛化能力。

方法: 使用相机参数和末端执行器位姿，AxisGuide在每个相机视图中渲染机器人基座坐标系轴，并通过少量提示通道增强RGB观测，显式可视化正x、正y和正z运动在图像空间中的含义。

主要发现: 在LIBERO仿真和真实世界环境中的广泛评估表明，AxisGuide带来了显著的性能提升和泛化能力改进，证明了显式动作坐标提示在学习可靠且可迁移的通用视觉运动策略方面的有效性。

结论: 显式动作坐标提示对于学习可靠且可迁移的通用视觉运动策略非常有效，AxisGuide方法能够有效弥合语义场景理解与动作坐标解释之间的差距。

翻译: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决视觉运动策略在机器人执行动作时，无法将图像中的像素空间与机器人自身的动作坐标系准确对应的问题。该问题之所以重要，是因为当前模型往往只能理解任务的高层语义，却难以在物体位置或视角发生变化时做出正确的底层动作，导致泛化能力差。明确这一对应关系能够填补语义理解与可靠执行之间的鸿沟，使机器人能够在真实复杂环境中稳定完成各种操作任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有策略虽能理解场景语义，却因无法在图像中明确对应机器人动作坐标系而导致泛化能力差。为此，他们利用相机参数和机械臂末端位姿，将机器人基座坐标轴投影到二维图像平面上，生成表示各方向运动的提示通道，并与原始彩色图像拼接输入模型。该方法参考了以往通过添加轨迹、关键点或空间线索来增强视觉输入的现有工作，但指出这些工作未显式解决动作坐标系在图像中的对应问题，因此针对性地设计了本方案。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将机器人动作坐标系的含义显式地映射到摄像头拍摄的二维图像中，以弥补视觉理解与底层动作执行之间的鸿沟。整体流程是：首先利用相机参数和机械臂末端位置，将机器人基座坐标系的三个轴向投影到图像平面上；接着将这三个方向的移动轨迹分别用红、绿、蓝通道绘制成箭头，生成动作坐标提示图；最后将该提示图与原始彩色图像按通道拼接，作为增强输入送入视觉运动策略模型进行训练与推理。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点是提出了一种轻量级引导方法，利用相机参数和机械臂末端位置，将机器人基座坐标系的三个空间方向投影并渲染为额外的图像通道，直接拼接在原始画面上。与以往仅补充运动轨迹、关键点或时空上下文等辅助信息的工作不同，该方法首次显式地将动作空间的物理含义与画面像素建立直观对应，使策略网络能够直接读取每个动作维度在镜头中的实际指向。这一设计有效弥补了高层语义理解与底层动作执行之间的鸿沟，显著提升了模型在未见场景下的泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为AxisGuide的轻量级方法，通过将机器人基座坐标系的三维运动方向显式渲染为额外的图像通道并叠加到原始彩色图像中，帮助视觉运动策略模型准确理解动作指令在画面中的实际含义，从而显著提升机器人在未见场景下的操作成功率与泛化能力。

Abstract

Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.

item.title: Leveraging Soft Distributions of SSL-Derived Discrete Speech Tokens for Downstream Inference
item.author: Kentaro Onda, Satoru Fukayama, Daisuke Saito, Nobuaki Minematsu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种仅在下游推理阶段应用软令牌分配的方法，以解决离散语音令牌因离散化导致的信息损失问题。该方法在训练时保持硬离散化的效率，同时在推理时增强令牌的表达能力。

背景: 从自监督学习模型中获得的离散语音令牌在保持强大性能的同时提供了高效的数据压缩，并广泛用作各种任务的中间表示。然而，离散化不可避免地导致信息损失，导致其性能低于连续自监督学习特征。

目的: 提出一种方法，仅在下游推理阶段应用软令牌分配，以解决离散化导致的信息损失问题，提升令牌在推理阶段的表达能力。

方法: 在训练阶段保持硬离散化的效率，仅在下游推理阶段应用软令牌分配。

主要发现: 该方法在自动语音识别和语音合成任务上均优于传统的硬分配方法，并且对域外数据表现出特别强的泛化能力。在非母语语音的自动语音识别任务中，其性能甚至超过了使用连续自监督学习特征的模型。分析显示，生成的表示与传统硬分配相比更准确地与音素对齐。

结论: 提出的方法在保持训练效率的同时，通过推理阶段的软令牌分配增强了表达能力和泛化性能，在多项任务中表现优异。

翻译: Discrete speech tokens obtained from self-supervised learning (SSL) models provide efficient data compression while maintaining strong performance, and have been widely used as intermediate representations in various tasks. However, discretization inevitably causes information loss, leading to degraded performance compared with continuous SSL features. In this work, we propose to apply soft token assignment only during downstream inference. This approach preserves the efficiency of hard discretization during training while enhancing the expressiveness of the tokens at inference. The proposed method outperforms conventional hard assignment on both ASR and speech synthesis tasks, and exhibits particularly strong generalizability to out-of-domain data. For ASR of non-native speech, it even surpasses models using continuous SSL features. Moreover, analysis of the resulting representations shows they align more accurately with phonemes compared with conventional hard assignment.

Abstract

Discrete speech tokens obtained from self-supervised learning (SSL) models provide efficient data compression while maintaining strong performance, and have been widely used as intermediate representations in various tasks. However, discretization inevitably causes information loss, leading to degraded performance compared with continuous SSL features. In this work, we propose to apply soft token assignment only during downstream inference. This approach preserves the efficiency of hard discretization during training while enhancing the expressiveness of the tokens at inference. The proposed method outperforms conventional hard assignment on both ASR and speech synthesis tasks, and exhibits particularly strong generalizability to out-of-domain data. For ASR of non-native speech, it even surpasses models using continuous SSL features. Moreover, analysis of the resulting representations shows they align more accurately with phonemes compared with conventional hard assignment.

item.title: Distilling first-principles accuracy into compact machine learning potentials for condensed-phase chemistry
item.author: Sijia Chen, Niamh O'Neill, Benjamin X. Shi, Venkat Kapil
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究结合迁移学习和知识蒸馏技术，构建了紧凑的机器学习原子间势学生模型，这些模型保留了由基础模型迁移学习获得的大型教师模型的准确性，并将生产模拟成本降低了约一个数量级，使得高精度采样在挑战性凝聚相问题中变得可行。

背景: 准确的机器学习原子间势使得第一性原理质量的势能面在凝聚相化学中日益可用，但其推理成本仍可能限制计算实验相关观测值所需的采样。

目的: 构建紧凑的学生模型，以保留大型教师模型的准确性，同时降低生产模拟成本，使高精度采样在挑战性凝聚相问题中变得实用。

方法: 结合迁移学习和知识蒸馏技术，从通过迁移学习应用于基础模型获得的大型教师模型中构建紧凑的学生模型。

主要发现: 在冰 Ih 的有限温度 NPT 模拟、液态水在 240 至 370 K 的经典和路径积分模拟，以及锐钛矿二氧化钛界面水解离的路径积分伞形采样模拟中，蒸馏学生模型比直接基于有限参考数据训练的同规模模型更可靠地复现了目标观测值。液态水学生模型复现了全温度范围内的热力学、结构、输运和核量子性质。在二氧化钛界面，蒸馏使路径积分分子动力学伞形采样变得可行，并显示核量子效应将解离势垒降低了约 2 千卡每摩尔，并将分子解离自由能差异的定量结果与最近的固态氧十七核磁共振测量结果一致。

结论: 知识蒸馏可以使准确的机器学习原子间势在连接凝聚相反应热力学与实验所需的采样方法中变得实用，特别是在界面化学和催化领域。

翻译: Accurate machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have made first-principles-quality potential energy surfaces increasingly accessible for condensed-phase chemistry, but their inference cost can still limit the sampling needed to compute experimentally relevant observables. In this work, we combine transfer learning and knowledge distillation to construct compact student models that retain the accuracy of much larger teacher models obtained by applying transfer learning to foundation models. The resulting students reduce production simulation cost by roughly an order of magnitude, making high-accuracy sampling practical for challenging condensed-phase problems. We demonstrate this across three problems of increasing sampling complexity: finite-temperature NPT simulations of ice Ih, classical and path-integral simulations of liquid water over 240-370 K, and path-integral umbrella-sampling simulations of water dissociation at the anatase TiO2(101)/water interface. In all cases, the distilled students reproduce the target observables of their teachers more reliably than models of the same size trained directly on the limited reference data. The liquid-water student, distilled from a Δ-learned CCSD(T)-quality teacher, reproduces thermodynamic, structural, transport, and nuclear quantum properties over the full temperature range studied. At the TiO2/water interface, distillation makes PIMD umbrella sampling practical and shows that nuclear quantum effects lower the dissociation barrier by roughly 2 kcal/mol and shift the molecular-dissociated free energy difference into quantitative agreement with recent solid-state 17O NMR measurements. Our work demonstrates how knowledge distillation can make accurate MLIPs practical for the sampling methods needed to connect condensed-phase reaction thermodynamics with experiment, notably for interfacial chemistry and catalysis.

Abstract

Accurate machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have made first-principles-quality potential energy surfaces increasingly accessible for condensed-phase chemistry, but their inference cost can still limit the sampling needed to compute experimentally relevant observables. In this work, we combine transfer learning and knowledge distillation to construct compact "student" models that retain the accuracy of much larger "teacher" models obtained by applying transfer learning to foundation models. The resulting students reduce production simulation cost by roughly an order of magnitude, making high-accuracy sampling practical for challenging condensed-phase problems. We demonstrate this across three problems of increasing sampling complexity: finite-temperature NPT simulations of ice Ih, classical and path-integral simulations of liquid water over 240-370 K, and path-integral umbrella-sampling simulations of water dissociation at the anatase TiO2(101)/water interface. In all cases, the distilled students reproduce the target observables of their teachers more reliably than models of the same size trained directly on the limited reference data. The liquid-water student, distilled from a Δ-learned CCSD(T)-quality teacher, reproduces thermodynamic, structural, transport, and nuclear quantum properties over the full temperature range studied. At the TiO2/water interface, distillation makes PIMD umbrella sampling practical and shows that nuclear quantum effects lower the dissociation barrier by roughly 2 kcal/mol and shift the molecular-dissociated free energy difference into quantitative agreement with recent solid-state 17O NMR measurements. Our work demonstrates how knowledge distillation can make accurate MLIPs practical for the sampling methods needed to connect condensed-phase reaction thermodynamics with experiment, notably for interfacial chemistry and catalysis.

item.title: MotionEnhancer: Leveraging Video Diffusion for Motion-Enhanced Vision-Language Models
item.author: Yifan Xu, Chao Zhang, Ruifei Ma, Fei Gao, Zhifei Yang, Jiaxing Qi, Zhipeng Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MotionEnhancer的新方法，通过从视频扩散模型中提取运动先验作为辅助监督，利用注意力对齐增强视觉语言模型的运动理解能力。

背景: 当前视觉语言模型在事件或故事层面的理解上表现出色，但在捕捉细粒度运动细节方面能力有限，主要受限于其对高层静态语义结构和宏观事件逻辑的关注。相比之下，视频扩散模型擅长建模动态运动模式。

目的: 增强视觉语言模型的运动理解能力，提供一种可扩展的解决方案，无需额外的训练参数、架构修改或工具调用。

方法: 提出MotionEnhancer方法，包含两个简单的无参数模块：运动敏感头选择（MHS）和运动显著文本令牌识别（MTTI），通过纯计算方式直接从视频扩散模型中提取和优化与运动相关的注意力。

主要发现: 在两个运动级视频理解基准测试中，MotionEnhancer在运动相关指标上实现了持续改进，优于最先进视觉语言模型。

结论: MotionEnhancer提供了一种无需额外训练参数和架构修改的扩展解决方案，有效提升了视觉语言模型的运动理解能力。

翻译: The new era has witnessed a remarkable capability to extend Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for tackling tasks of video understanding. While current VLMs excel at event- or story-level understanding, their ability to capture fine-grained motion details remains limited, primarily due to their focus on high-level static semantic structures and macro-event logic. In contrast, Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) are adept at modeling dynamic motion patterns, benefiting from large-scale video data and the intrinsic requirement of temporal generation. In this paper, we introduce MotionEnhancer, a novel approach that leverages motion priors distilled from a powerful video diffusion model as auxiliary supervision to enhance the motion understanding capability of a VLM via attention alignment. MotionEnhancer comprises two simple parameter-free modules, Motion-sensitive Head Selection (MHS) and Motion-salient Text Token Identification (MTTI), to directly extract and optimize motion-related attentions from the VDM in a computation-only manner. MotionEnhancer provides a scalable solution for motion understanding without additional training parameters, modifications to existing architectures, or tool calling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionEnhancer can achieve consistent improvements over state-of-the-art VLMs on two motion-level video understanding benchmarks, especially on motion-related metrics.

Abstract

The new era has witnessed a remarkable capability to extend Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for tackling tasks of video understanding. While current VLMs excel at event- or story-level understanding, their ability to capture fine-grained motion details remains limited, primarily due to their focus on high-level static semantic structures and macro-event logic. In contrast, Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) are adept at modeling dynamic motion patterns, benefiting from large-scale video data and the intrinsic requirement of temporal generation. In this paper, we introduce MotionEnhancer, a novel approach that leverages motion priors distilled from a powerful video diffusion model as auxiliary supervision to enhance the motion understanding capability of a VLM via attention alignment. MotionEnhancer comprises two simple parameter-free modules, Motion-sensitive Head Selection (MHS) and Motion-salient Text Token Identification (MTTI), to directly extract and optimize motion-related attentions from the VDM in a computation-only manner. MotionEnhancer provides a scalable solution for motion understanding without additional training parameters, modifications to existing architectures, or tool calling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionEnhancer can achieve consistent improvements over state-of-the-art VLMs on two motion-level video understanding benchmarks, especially on motion-related metrics.

item.title: Multi-FRuGaL: Multimodal Flexible Redundancy-aware Decomposed Gated Learning for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis
item.author: Sanket Kachole, Siddhesh Thakur, Shubham Innani, Sanyukta Adap, Suhang You, Carla Pitarch-Abaigar, Spyridon Bakas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为多模态灵活冗余感知分解门控学习（Multi-FRuGaL）的框架，旨在解决真实世界患者数据中模态缺失或不完整的问题。该框架通过分解层、门控网络和融合目标，分离冗余信号与互补信号，选择性加权信息性模态并抑制冗余或噪声输入。在头颈癌数据集上的实验表明，Multi-FRuGaL在生存分析、复发预测和人乳头瘤病毒状态分类等任务中，性能显著优于基线方法，即使在严重缺失模态条件下也能学习到判别性强且鲁棒的多模态表示。

背景: 现代医学依赖于跨越放射学、病理学、文本报告和结构化临床信息等多种异构数据源。然而，真实世界的患者数据经常不完整，存在模态缺失或稀疏获取的情况，这限制了标准多模态融合方法的有效性。

目的: 提出一种能够处理缺失数据的多模态框架，以在模态级别进行表示学习，解决因数据不完整导致的多模态融合效果受限问题。

方法: 提出了多模态灵活冗余感知分解门控学习（Multi-FRuGaL）框架。该框架是一个分解感知、自适应门控的中间融合框架。它集成了每个模态的编码器、信号分解层、输入条件门控网络和信息感知融合目标。其核心机制是分离冗余信号与模态特定的互补信号，选择性提高信息性模态的权重，并抑制冗余或噪声输入。该框架在多个模态缺失的情况下仍能保持定义明确且有效。

主要发现: 在两个多模态头颈癌队列（HANCOCK挑战数据集和HECKTOR挑战数据集）上评估了Multi-FRuGaL。结果显示，该框架在多个任务中 consistently 实现了高于评估基线的平均性能。具体而言，在生存预测中AUC从0.601提升至0.8496，在复发预测中AUC从0.672提升至0.8102，在HECKTOR数据集上的人乳头瘤病毒状态预测中达到了0.975的AUC。在生存分析中，它在HANCOCK数据集上实现了0.6814的总体生存一致性指数、0.7421的无复发生存一致性指数和0.7143的无进展生存一致性指数，在HECKTOR数据集上实现了0.7203的无复发生存一致性指数。定性分析显示，即使在严重缺失模态的条件下，Multi-FRuGaL也能学习到判别性强且鲁棒的多模态表示。

结论: Multi-FRuGaL框架能够有效处理多模态数据中的缺失问题，通过分离冗余和互补信号，显著提升了在头颈癌相关预后预测任务中的性能，证明了其在处理不完整多模态医学数据时的鲁棒性和有效性。

翻译: Modern medicine relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning radiology, pathology, text reports, and structured clinical information. However, real-world patient data are frequently incomplete, with missing or sparsely acquired modalities, limiting the effectiveness of standard multimodal fusion approaches. To this end, we propose the Multimodal Flexible Redundancy-aware decomposed GAted Learning (Multi-FRuGaL) framework, a decomposition-aware, adaptive gated intermediate-fusion framework that performs modality-level representation learning under missing data. Multi-FRuGaL integrates per-modality encoders with a signal decomposition layer, an input-conditioned gating network, and an information-aware fusion objective to separate redundant from modality-specific complementary signals, selectively upweighting informative modalities and suppressing redundant or noisy inputs, and remaining well-defined even when multiple modalities are absent. We evaluate Multi-FRuGaL on two multimodal head and neck cancer cohorts: the HANCOCK challenge dataset (N = 763) comprising five modalities and two prognostic endpoints (5-year survival and 2-year recurrence), and the HECKTOR challenge dataset (N = 588) comprising three modalities for human papillomavirus (HPV) status classification. Multi-FRuGaL consistently achieves higher mean performance than the evaluated baselines across multiple tasks, improving AUC from 0.601 to 0.8496 for survival, from 0.672 to 0.8102 for recurrence, and achieving 0.975 AUC for HPV prediction on HECKTOR. For survival analysis, it further achieves a concordance index of 0.6814 for overall survival, 0.7421 for recurrence-free survival, and 0.7143 for progression-free survival on HANCOCK, and 0.7203 for recurrence-free survival on HECKTOR. Qualitative analyses further show that Multi-FRuGaL learns discriminative and robust multimodal representations, even under severe missing-modality conditions.

Abstract

Modern medicine relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning radiology, pathology, text reports, and structured clinical information. However, real-world patient data are frequently incomplete, with missing or sparsely acquired modalities, limiting the effectiveness of standard multimodal fusion approaches. To this end, we propose the Multimodal Flexible Redundancy-aware decomposed GAted Learning (Multi-FRuGaL) framework, a decomposition-aware, adaptive gated intermediate-fusion framework that performs modality-level representation learning under missing data. Multi-FRuGaL integrates per-modality encoders with a signal decomposition layer, an input-conditioned gating network, and an information-aware fusion objective to separate redundant from modality-specific complementary signals, selectively upweighting informative modalities and suppressing redundant or noisy inputs, and remaining well-defined even when multiple modalities are absent. We evaluate Multi-FRuGaL on two multimodal head and neck cancer cohorts: the HANCOCK challenge dataset (N = 763) comprising five modalities and two prognostic endpoints (5-year survival and 2-year recurrence), and the HECKTOR challenge dataset (N = 588) comprising three modalities for human papillomavirus (HPV) status classification. Multi-FRuGaL consistently achieves higher mean performance than the evaluated baselines across multiple tasks, improving AUC from 0.601 to 0.8496 for survival, from 0.672 to 0.8102 for recurrence, and achieving 0.975 AUC for HPV prediction on HECKTOR. For survival analysis, it further achieves a concordance index of 0.6814 for overall survival, 0.7421 for recurrence-free survival, and 0.7143 for progression-free survival on HANCOCK, and 0.7203 for recurrence-free survival on HECKTOR. Qualitative analyses further show that Multi-FRuGaL learns discriminative and robust multimodal representations, even under severe missing-modality conditions.

item.title: A Cross-view Fusion Framework for Robust 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation
item.author: Kangjian Zhu, Haobo Jiang, Jianjun Qian, Jin Xie
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种跨视图融合框架，用于增强角视图下六自由度抓取姿态估计的鲁棒性。

背景: 在角视图下，六自由度抓取姿态估计面临遮挡问题，且传统多视图重建方法耗时且与任务无关。

目的: 通过引入辅助视图缓解遮挡，并避免耗时的多视图重建，以提高抓取姿态估计的鲁棒性和准确性。

方法: 采用后融合策略避免多视图重建；提出自监督对比学习策略，利用跨视图关联正则化点云特征，将对应同一三维位置的点视为匹配对，不同抓取方向的点视为非匹配对；设计跨视图对齐圆柱集成模块，通过点对齐、坐标转换和注意力机制融合抓取相关几何信息。

主要发现: 自监督对比学习显著提升了点特征的空间一致性和方向区分度；跨视图对齐圆柱集成模块有效增强了抗噪能力并突出了旋转对称几何结构；该框架在GraspNet-1Billion基准测试和实际应用中表现优异。

结论: 所提出的跨视图融合框架能有效提升角视图下抓取姿态估计的鲁棒性，代码已公开。

翻译: In this paper, we propose a cross-view fusion framework that enhances the robustness of 6-DoF grasp pose estimation in corner views. Our framework alleviates occlusion by incorporating an auxiliary view and avoids the time-consuming, task-agnostic multi-view reconstruction through a post-fusion strategy. To enhance cross-view fusion, we propose a self-supervised contrastive learning strategy that leverages cross-view associations to regularize point cloud features. In brief, a cross-view point pair is considered a match if the two points correspond to the same 3D location, and a non-match if they represent distinct grasp directions. The learning strategy significantly enhances the spatial consistency and direction distinctiveness of point features, thereby facilitating cross-view fusion and improving estimation robustness. Furthermore, we propose a cross-view-aligned cylinder integration module to fuse grasp-relevant geometry into a comprehensive representation. Specifically, the module first aligns the cross-view points and features according to their similarity to enhance the robustness against noise. Subsequently, these points are registered into the cylindrical coordinate frame, emphasizing the rotation-symmetric geometry which is important for grasping. Finally, local self-attention and seed cross-attention layers are alternately employed, respectively enabling interactions within single views and across views, which supports fine-grained representation of grasp-relevant geometry. Our framework achieves strong performance on the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark and in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/KJZhuAutomatic/Cross-view-Grasp.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决单视角机器人抓取姿态估计中因物体遮挡导致的几何信息缺失和鲁棒性不足的问题。传统多视角方法通常需要耗时且计算密集的全场景重建，而本文通过引入辅助视角的后融合策略，在避免复杂重建的同时有效补充了遮挡区域的几何特征。该问题在机器人抓取、物体重排和具身智能等实际应用中至关重要，因为提升复杂遮挡环境下的抓取成功率能直接增强机器人在真实场景中的操作可靠性与执行效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对单视角抓取易受遮挡且传统多视角场景重建耗时的问题，设计了仅融合抓取相关区域的策略，并引入辅助视角提升鲁棒性。在核心模块设计上，他们借鉴了先进的点云配准原理进行跨视角特征对齐，同时参考多帧注意力机制的设计思想来构建交替交互层，以降低计算开销。整体方法在主流抓取检测框架的基础上进行了针对性优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过引入辅助视角缓解主视角遮挡，并采用后融合策略仅对抓取相关区域进行特征融合，从而避免传统多视角重建的计算耗时与几何细节丢失。整体流程首先分别提取参考视角与辅助视角的点云特征，随后在参考视角上筛选抓取种子点并预测接近方向。接着，系统在圆柱区域内对双视角的邻近点进行相似度对齐与坐标转换，利用交替的注意力机制融合跨视角上下文以增强种子特征。最后，基于融合后的特征直接预测抓取质量与宽度，完成抓取姿态估计。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种基于辅助视角的交叉视图融合框架，采用后融合策略仅针对抓取相关区域进行特征整合，避免了传统方法中耗时的全景三维重建。同时，论文引入了自监督对比学习策略，利用跨视角关联来规范点云特征，增强了空间一致性与方向区分度，并设计了跨视图对齐的圆柱体集成模块，通过圆柱坐标系突出物体的旋转对称性以优化抓取几何表达。相比以往依赖复杂全景重建或多相机校准的前融合工作，该框架仅需单一辅助视角即可有效缓解角落视角的遮挡问题，在显著提升抓取鲁棒性的同时大幅降低了计算时间。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种跨视角融合框架，通过引入辅助视角与后融合策略有效缓解角落视角的遮挡问题，并结合自监督对比学习及圆柱坐标对齐模块，实现了高效且鲁棒的六自由度抓取姿态估计。

Abstract

In this paper, we propose a cross-view fusion framework that enhances the robustness of 6-DoF grasp pose estimation in corner views. Our framework alleviates occlusion by incorporating an auxiliary view and avoids the time-consuming, task-agnostic multi-view reconstruction through a post-fusion strategy. To enhance cross-view fusion, we propose a self-supervised contrastive learning strategy that leverages cross-view associations to regularize point cloud features. In brief, a cross-view point pair is considered a match if the two points correspond to the same 3D location, and a non-match if they represent distinct grasp directions. The learning strategy significantly enhances the spatial consistency and direction distinctiveness of point features, thereby facilitating cross-view fusion and improving estimation robustness. Furthermore, we propose a cross-view-aligned cylinder integration module to fuse grasp-relevant geometry into a comprehensive representation. Specifically, the module first aligns the cross-view points and features according to their similarity to enhance the robustness against noise. Subsequently, these points are registered into the cylindrical coordinate frame, emphasizing the rotation-symmetric geometry which is important for grasping. Finally, local self-attention and seed cross-attention layers are alternately employed, respectively enabling interactions within single views and across views, which supports fine-grained representation of grasp-relevant geometry. Our framework achieves strong performance on the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark and in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/KJZhuAutomatic/Cross-view-Grasp.

item.title: ARAPDiffusion: ARAP Regularization for Diffusion-Based Deformable Shape Space Learning
item.author: Haibo Liu, Jinghan Ke, Haitao Yang, Xiangru Huang, Georgios Pavlakos, Qixing Huang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了ARAPDiffusion，这是一种潜在扩散模型，用于学习变形形状集合的底层连续形状空间。

背景: 标准潜在扩散模型通常需要大量三维训练数据来学习生成模型。

目的: 减少对大量三维训练数据的依赖，并改进形状编码器、解码器及潜在扩散模型。

方法: 将尽可能刚性的变形模型作为正则化损失注入潜在扩散中，通过交替训练过程优化编码器、解码器和潜在扩散模型，并结合无表示的潜在扩散过程与适用于无序点云的隐式形状解码器。

主要发现: 实验结果展示了无条件形状生成和条件形状生成中ARAPDiffusion相对于基线方法的优势。

结论: ARAPDiffusion通过引入正则化损失有效提升了生成模型的性能，减少了对大量训练数据的需求。

翻译: This paper introduces ARAPDiffusion, a latent diffusion model to learn the underlying continuous shape space of a deformation shape collection. The key innovation is in injecting the as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) deformation model as regularization losses into latent diffusion (LD), releasing the requirement of having abundant 3D training data for learning generative models. In contrast to the standard LD, we show how the ARAP model can be used to improve both the encoder/decoder and the LD model. The training procedure alternates between using the synthetic distribution defined by the LD model to develop a regularization loss that enhances the shape encoder/decoder and using the shape decoder to develop a regularization loss to improve the LD model. We also show the benefit of the LD paradigm in combining a representation-free LD process and an implicit shape decoder that is applicable to unorganized point clouds. The experimental results of unconditional and conditional shape generation demonstrate the advantages of ARAPDiffusion over baseline approaches.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是如何利用少量样本学习可变形三维形状连续空间生成模型的问题。传统方法依赖海量训练数据且生成的形状空间多为离散形式，难以直接用于形状插值与探索。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为它能突破医疗等数据稀缺领域的三维生成瓶颈，并提供平滑连续的形状表示，从而有效支持形状插值、空间探索及逆向求解等实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于可变形形状具有丰富形变先验的特点，思考如何在训练数据有限的情况下学习生成模型。他们借鉴了隐空间扩散模型的基础框架以及早期基于生成对抗网络的正则化方法，将尽可能刚性的形变模型作为正则化损失引入训练过程。在方法设计上，他们摒弃了强制隐空间服从高斯分布的做法，转而采用交替优化策略，利用扩散模型生成的分布来优化编解码器，同时利用编解码器生成的形状分布来优化扩散模型，从而实现两者的协同提升。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将尽可能刚性的形变几何先验作为正则化约束引入潜在扩散模型的训练中，从而在训练数据有限的情况下也能学习到连续的形状空间，并实现形状解码器与扩散模型的联合优化。整体流程分为三个阶段：首先利用现有数据预训练基础的潜在扩散模型；随后交替执行两个微调步骤，即利用当前扩散模型生成的分布来优化形状解码器，再利用当前形状解码器生成的分布来优化扩散模型；这两个微调阶段循环迭代直至模型收敛。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新是将近似刚性变形模型作为正则化损失引入潜在扩散框架，并设计了交替优化流程。与以往仅固定编解码器训练扩散模型或依赖海量数据的方法不同，该方法通过交替迭代同时优化形状编解码器和扩散模型。它利用当前扩散模型生成的分布来约束编解码器，并利用编解码器生成的分布来优化扩散模型，从而在少量数据下也能生成几何合理的连续变形形状。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种新的潜在扩散生成模型，通过将尽可能刚性的形变模型作为正则化约束引入训练过程，并采用交替优化策略同步改进形状解码器与扩散模型，从而在仅需少量三维训练数据的情况下实现高质量的可形变形状生成。

Abstract

This paper introduces ARAPDiffusion, a latent diffusion model to learn the underlying continuous shape space of a deformation shape collection. The key innovation is in injecting the as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) deformation model as regularization losses into latent diffusion (LD), releasing the requirement of having abundant 3D training data for learning generative models. In contrast to the standard LD, we show how the ARAP model can be used to improve both the encoder/decoder and the LD model. The training procedure alternates between using the synthetic distribution defined by the LD model to develop a regularization loss that enhances the shape encoder/decoder and using the shape decoder to develop a regularization loss to improve the LD model. We also show the benefit of the LD paradigm in combining a representation-free LD process and an implicit shape decoder that is applicable to unorganized point clouds. The experimental results of unconditional and conditional shape generation demonstrate the advantages of ARAPDiffusion over baseline approaches.

item.title: Stream3D-VLM: Online 3D Spatial Understanding with Incremental Geometry Priors
item.author: Hanxun Yu, Xuan Qu, Lei Ke, Boqiang Zhang, Yuxin Wang, Jianke Zhu, Dong Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种在线3D视觉语言模型，实现了从流式视频中实时进行空间理解。

背景: 尽管3D场景理解取得了进展，但现有的3D大型多模态模型通常在离线环境中运行，需要完整的场景观测或预定义的短视频片段。

目的: 开发一种能够实时从流式视频中进行空间理解的在线3D视觉语言模型。

方法: 采用基于大语言模型下一个词元预测目标的自回归流式控制建模来学习响应时机；使用轻量级视觉空间特征集成模块将时间对齐的几何先验增量注入视觉流；提出即插即用的几何自适应体素压缩模块以缓解长上下文解码开销；开发可扩展的数据生成管道，构建包含超过100万在线时空3D问答对的数据集及涵盖29项任务的综合基准。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在在线和离线3D空间理解、推理和定位任务上均显著优于专有模型和开源模型。

结论: 该在线3D视觉语言模型有效解决了流式视频实时空间理解的问题，并在多项任务中展现出优越性能。

翻译: 尽管3D场景理解取得了进展，但现有的3D大型多模态模型通常在离线环境中运行，需要完整的场景观测或预定义的短视频片段。在本文中，我们提出了一种在线3D视觉语言模型，能够从流式视频中实现实时空间理解。我们的方法采用基于大语言模型下一个词元预测目标的自回归流式控制建模来学习响应时机，并使用轻量级视觉空间特征集成模块将时间对齐的几何先验增量注入视觉流。为了缓解长上下文解码开销，我们提出了一种即插即用的几何自适应体素压缩模块，用于高效的视觉词元压缩。为了解决流式3D语言数据的稀缺问题，我们进一步开发了一种可扩展的数据生成管道，整理了超过100万在线时空3D问答对，并建立了涵盖29项任务的综合基准。大量实验表明，我们的方法在在线和离线3D空间理解、推理和定位任务上均显著优于专有模型和开源模型。项目页面位于https://stream3d-vlm.github.io/

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有三维视觉语言模型仅支持离线处理、无法对实时流式视频进行动态交互的问题。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为自动驾驶、增强现实和具身智能等实际应用需要在视频流播放过程中随时进行实时感知与响应，而现有在线二维模型缺乏三维空间推理能力，难以满足真实场景中对连续三维空间理解的需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有在线二维视频理解模型缺乏三维空间推理能力，而传统三维大模型仅支持离线处理，无法满足实时交互需求。为此，他们借鉴了在线二维视频大语言模型的研究思路，将流式响应控制转化为大语言模型原生的下一个词元预测任务，使模型能自主判断回答时机。在此基础上，通过轻量级视觉空间特征融合模块增量注入几何先验以维持连续场景理解，并设计自适应体素压缩模块降低长上下文推理延迟，最终结合自研的大规模流式三维问答数据生成管线完成了整体方法设计。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让模型仅通过连续视频流实现实时的三维空间理解与交互，通过逐步注入几何结构信息来弥补纯二维视频的几何缺失，并自主判断最佳响应时机。整体流程首先利用大语言模型的原生预测机制学习何时继续接收画面或开始生成回答，接着通过专用模块将三维重建模型提取的时序对齐几何先验逐步融入视觉特征流。为降低长序列处理的延迟，系统会依据空间坐标动态压缩视觉特征以保留关键结构并去除冗余，最终在自生成的大规模流式三维问答数据上进行

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次构建了仅依赖流式视频的在线三维空间理解框架。其核心包括利用大语言模型的原生预测机制自主决定响应时机，通过轻量级模块增量注入时序对齐的几何信息以持续理解场景，并引入自适应压缩模块有效降低长视频推理延迟。与以往必须依赖完整视频片段或离线处理的工作不同，该方法实现了实时流式交互，无需预先获取完整场景数据，从而在动态环境中具备更强的实时响应能力与计算效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了首个仅基于流式视频的在线三维视觉语言模型，通过增量注入几何先验与动态压缩视觉令牌实现了实时三维空间理解与交互，并配套开发了大规模数据生成管线与包含二十九项任务的综合评测基准。

Abstract

Despite advances in 3D scene understanding, existing 3D Large Multimodal Models operate in offline settings, requiring complete scene observations or predefined video clips. In this paper, we present an online 3D vision-language model that enables real-time spatial understanding from streaming video. Our approach adopts an autoregressive streaming control modeling based on the LLM's next-token prediction objective to learn when to respond, and employs a lightweight Visual-Spatial Feature Integration (VSFI) module to incrementally inject temporally aligned geometry priors into the visual stream. To alleviate long-context decoding overhead, we propose a plug-and-play Geometry-Adaptive Voxel Compression (GAVC) module for efficient visual token compression. To address the scarcity of streaming 3D-language data, we further develop a scalable data generation pipeline that curates over 1M online spatio-temporal 3D QA pairs and establishes a comprehensive benchmark spanning 29 tasks. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly outperforms both proprietary and open-source models across online and offline 3D spatial understanding, reasoning, and grounding tasks. The project page is available at https://stream3d-vlm.github.io/

item.title: FDM: A Framework for Decision-making to build ML-based Malware detection systems
item.author: Tadiwa Vhito, Jakapan Suaboot, Warodom Werapun, Norrathep Rattanavipanon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于构建基于机器学习的恶意软件检测系统的决策框架，通过多标准评分函数将操作参数映射为配置推荐，并在多个数据集上验证了该框架的有效性。

背景: 为恶意软件检测选择适当的机器学习配置是一个复杂的多标准问题，模型选择、特征工程和更新机制必须共同满足随部署环境变化的操作约束。

目的: 提出一种决策框架以形式化机器学习配置的选择过程，帮助实践者根据具体上下文选择最优配置。

方法: 提出决策框架，使用加权配置兼容性评分函数，将平台约束、资源预算、响应延迟、更新频率和检测灵敏度五个操作参数映射到九个配置维度的排名推荐，并在三个数据集上进行了四项实验。

主要发现: 在二分类任务中，XGBoost在准确率与资源消耗比上表现最佳；在多分类任务中，经典模型优于循环深度学习模型；类增量学习在保持高准确率的同时实现了逐步学习；迁移学习显著减少了图像类恶意软件数据的训练时间；自编码器预处理大幅提升了训练速度且准确率损失极小。

结论: 最优的机器学习配置取决于具体上下文，验证了决策框架的核心前提并展示了其在网络安全实践中的实用价值。

翻译: Selecting appropriate machine learning (ML) configurations for malware detection is a complex, multi-criteria problem. Model choice, feature engineering, and update mechanisms must jointly satisfy operational constraints that vary across deployment contexts. This paper proposes the Framework for Decision-making (FDM) to build ML-based malware detection systems. The FDM formalises this selection process using the Weighted Configuration Compatibility Score (WCCS), a multi-criteria scoring function mapping five operational parameters (platform constraint, resource budget, response latency, update frequency, and detection sensitivity) to ranked recommendations across nine configuration dimensions. To validate the framework, four experiments were conducted on three datasets (a private Windows API dataset, the public Malimg image benchmark, and an Android static API dataset). Key results include: (i) XGBoost achieved the best accuracy-to-resource ratio in binary classification (97.46 % test accuracy, <70 MB RAM), outperforming LSTM/BiLSTM which consumed up to 2.8 GB; (ii) in multi-class classification, classical models (XGBoost 79.03 %) outperformed recurrent deep models (BiLSTM 72.27 %), reversing the binary ranking; (iii) class-incremental learning with EfficientNetB0 maintained 99.13 % accuracy with only 0.65 pp degradation across 11 incremental steps; (iv) transfer learning reduced training time by 2.14 times on average for image-based malware data without significant accuracy cost; and (v) autoencoder pre-processing yielded a 14 times training speedup at a cost of only 0.86 pp accuracy. These findings confirm that the optimal ML configuration is context-dependent, validating the FDM's core premise and demonstrating its practical utility for cybersecurity practitioners.

Abstract

Selecting appropriate machine learning (ML) configurations for malware detection is a complex, multi-criteria problem. Model choice, feature engineering, and update mechanisms must jointly satisfy operational constraints that vary across deployment contexts. This paper proposes the Framework for Decision-making (FDM) to build ML-based malware detection systems. The FDM formalises this selection process using the Weighted Configuration Compatibility Score (WCCS), a multi-criteria scoring function mapping five operational parameters (platform constraint, resource budget, response latency, update frequency, and detection sensitivity) to ranked recommendations across nine configuration dimensions. To validate the framework, four experiments were conducted on three datasets (a private Windows API dataset, the public Malimg image benchmark, and an Android static API dataset). Key results include: (i) XGBoost achieved the best accuracy-to-resource ratio in binary classification (97.46 % test accuracy, <70 MB RAM), outperforming LSTM/BiLSTM which consumed up to 2.8 GB; (ii) in multi-class classification, classical models (XGBoost 79.03 %) outperformed recurrent deep models (BiLSTM 72.27 %), reversing the binary ranking; (iii) class-incremental learning with EfficientNetB0 maintained 99.13 % accuracy with only 0.65 pp degradation across 11 incremental steps; (iv) transfer learning reduced training time by 2.14 times on average for image-based malware data without significant accuracy cost; and (v) autoencoder pre-processing yielded a 14 times training speedup at a cost of only 0.86 pp accuracy. These findings confirm that the optimal ML configuration is context-dependent, validating the FDM's core premise and demonstrating its practical utility for cybersecurity practitioners.

item.title: Lighting-Aware Representation Learning under Controllable Lighting Variation
item.author: Lizhen Zhu, Charantej Reddy Pochimireddy, James Z Wang, Brad Wyble
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种光照感知的表示学习框架，将光照变化作为显式训练信号而非干扰因素，通过扩展对比学习引入辅助目标来捕捉渲染场景中的光照依赖变化，从而在保持语义一致性的同时学习对光照依赖视觉结构敏感的特征表示。

背景: 光照变化是视觉表示学习面临的主要挑战，因为它会在不同环境和同一环境内引起显著的外观变化。现有方法通常通过数据增强来鼓励模型对光照变化不变，但这些策略在训练过程中没有显式建模光照信息。

目的: 受人类视觉理论的启发，旨在提出一种光照感知的表示学习框架，将光照变化作为显式训练信号，使模型能够联合学习既保持语义一致性又对光照依赖视觉结构敏感的特征表示。

方法: 扩展对比学习，引入一个辅助目标来捕捉渲染场景中的光照依赖变化。该框架将光照变化作为显式训练信号，而不是需要抑制的干扰因素。

主要发现: 在ImageNet、ExDark和PASCAL VOC基准上的图像分类和目标检测任务中，所提出的光照感知训练方法在保持相同架构和训练预算的情况下，持续优于标准对比学习基线，提升了下游性能。此外，该方法在监督学习框架和涉及较简单光照变化的设置下也表现出有前景的性能。

结论: 该方法具有广泛的适用性，不仅适用于复杂光照场景，也适用于更传统的图像处理任务。它有望增强模型在复杂视觉环境中的鲁棒性和适应性。

翻译: Variations in illumination remain a major challenge for visual representation learning, as they induce substantial appearance changes both across and within environments. While existing approaches typically address this issue through data augmentations that encourage models to become invariant to lighting changes, such strategies do not explicitly model lighting information during learning. Inspired by theories of human vision, we propose a lighting-aware representation learning framework that incorporates illumination variation as an explicit training signal rather than a nuisance factor to be suppressed. Our method extends contrastive learning by introducing an auxiliary objective that captures illumination-dependent variation in rendered scenes, enabling the model to jointly learn representations that preserve semantic consistency while remaining sensitive to lighting-dependent visual structure. We evaluate the proposed model on image classification and object detection tasks across the ImageNet, ExDark, and PASCAL VOC benchmarks. Results demonstrate that the proposed lighting-aware training consistently improves downstream performance over standard contrastive learning baselines, while maintaining the same architecture and training budget. Furthermore, our approach shows promising performance in supervised learning frameworks and under settings involving simpler lighting variation, suggesting broad applicability beyond complex illumination scenarios. These results indicate its potential to enhance model robustness and adaptability in complex visual environments as well as in more conventional image processing tasks.

Abstract

Variations in illumination remain a major challenge for visual representation learning, as they induce substantial appearance changes both across and within environments. While existing approaches typically address this issue through data augmentations that encourage models to become invariant to lighting changes, such strategies do not explicitly model lighting information during learning. Inspired by theories of human vision, we propose a lighting-aware representation learning framework that incorporates illumination variation as an explicit training signal rather than a nuisance factor to be suppressed. Our method extends contrastive learning by introducing an auxiliary objective that captures illumination-dependent variation in rendered scenes, enabling the model to jointly learn representations that preserve semantic consistency while remaining sensitive to lighting-dependent visual structure. We evaluate the proposed model on image classification and object detection tasks across the ImageNet, ExDark, and PASCAL VOC benchmarks. Results demonstrate that the proposed lighting-aware training consistently improves downstream performance over standard contrastive learning baselines, while maintaining the same architecture and training budget. Furthermore, our approach shows promising performance in supervised learning frameworks and under settings involving simpler lighting variation, suggesting broad applicability beyond complex illumination scenarios. These results indicate its potential to enhance model robustness and adaptability in complex visual environments as well as in more conventional image processing tasks.

item.title: DREAM: Dynamic Refinement of Early Assignment Mappings
item.author: Liwei Guan, Huanjie Wang, Hongwei Zhang, Linxun Chen, Zhaojie Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 生成式推荐通过将项目检索重构为语义ID的自回归生成来推进项目检索。当前方法在观察到足够用户反馈前通过离线分词为每个项目分配单一静态标识符，导致冷启动项目产生区分度差的代码和未对齐的路径。本文提出DREAM框架，通过渐进式细化解决冷启动瓶颈。

背景: 生成式推荐通过自回归生成语义ID推进项目检索，但现有方法在冷启动场景下因早期静态分配导致项目代码区分度低、路径未对齐。

目的: 克服冷启动瓶颈，弥合分词与生成目标的脱节。

方法: 提出DREAM框架，包含三个阶段：意图感知分词器通过反事实对比学习重建语义ID空间，生成行为对齐的候选集；冻结的推荐骨干网络作为评估器选择最可靠候选；动态束机制在训练和推理中维持多个加权假设，防止过早坍缩。

主要发现: DREAM在三个亚马逊基准测试的冷启动指标上显著优于最先进的生成式和序列基线。

结论: DREAM通过渐进式细化有效解决冷启动瓶颈，提升生成式推荐性能。

翻译: Generative recommendation advances item retrieval by reformulating it as autoregressive generation of Semantic IDs (SIDs), compact token sequences that encode item semantics. While SIDs offer a strong semantic prior, current SID-based methods assign each item a single static identifier through offline tokenization before sufficient user feedback is observed. For cold-start items, this one-shot commitment produces poorly discriminative codes, generating misaligned paths that remain unrefined because the associated tokens are rarely sampled during training. We identify this early static commitment, not model capacity, as the fundamental cold-start bottleneck in SID-based generative recommendation. To overcome this bottleneck and bridge the disjoint objectives of tokenization and generation, we propose DREAM (Dynamic Refinement of Early Assignment Mappings), a three-stage framework that resolves this flaw through progressive refinement. First, an intent-aware tokenizer rebuilds the SID space through counterfactual contrastive learning, generating a diverse pool of behavior-aligned candidates per cold-start item. Second, the frozen recommendation backbone serves as an evaluator, selecting the most reliable candidate based on multi-context user support without retraining. Third, a dynamic beam mechanism maintains multiple weighted SID hypotheses throughout training and inference, preventing premature collapse to a single assignment. Extensive experiments on three Amazon benchmarks show that DREAM substantially outperforms state-of-the-art generative and sequential baselines on cold-start metrics.

Abstract

Generative recommendation advances item retrieval by reformulating it as autoregressive generation of Semantic IDs (SIDs), compact token sequences that encode item semantics. While SIDs offer a strong semantic prior, current SID-based methods assign each item a single static identifier through offline tokenization before sufficient user feedback is observed. For cold-start items, this one-shot commitment produces poorly discriminative codes, generating misaligned paths that remain unrefined because the associated tokens are rarely sampled during training. We identify this early static commitment, not model capacity, as the fundamental cold-start bottleneck in SID-based generative recommendation. To overcome this bottleneck and bridge the disjoint objectives of tokenization and generation, we propose DREAM (Dynamic Refinement of Early Assignment Mappings), a three-stage framework that resolves this flaw through progressive refinement. First, an intent-aware tokenizer rebuilds the SID space through counterfactual contrastive learning, generating a diverse pool of behavior-aligned candidates per cold-start item. Second, the frozen recommendation backbone serves as an evaluator, selecting the most reliable candidate based on multi-context user support without retraining. Third, a dynamic beam mechanism maintains multiple weighted SID hypotheses throughout training and inference, preventing premature collapse to a single assignment. Extensive experiments on three Amazon benchmarks show that DREAM substantially outperforms state-of-the-art generative and sequential baselines on cold-start metrics.

item.title: DaX: Learning General Pathology Representations Across Scales
item.author: Bokai Zhao, Yiyang Zhang, Long Bai, Tai Ma, Hanqing Chao, Minfeng Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DaX的病理学视觉基础模型，该模型基于DINOv3风格的自监督学习，并针对全切片组织病理学进行了适配。DaX通过多种训练策略实现了跨临床终点和不同输入变化的鲁棒性，并在包含161个临床任务的基准测试中取得了最佳性能。

背景: 计算病理学需要能够在不同临床终点之间迁移的视觉表示，并且对放大倍数、染色、扫描仪类型、切片制备和输入分辨率的变化保持鲁棒性。

目的: 提出一种能够连接局部细胞形态与全局组织结构，并在不同输入尺度下稳定密集令牌级表示的病理学视觉基础模型。

方法: DaX模型从自然图像DINOv3权重初始化，并引入了连续放大倍数训练、跨尺度组织视图、方向无关和采集鲁棒的增强、多输入尺寸训练以及Gram锚定密集一致性等技术。此外，还构建了一个包含44个公共数据集、28182名患者和34394张切片的WSI级基准测试，涵盖四个临床领域和九个任务类别，并采用固定的患者级交叉验证协议进行评估。

主要发现: 在构建的基准测试中，DaX在所有任务中实现了最高的平均性能，并在诊断病理学、生物标志物和分子分析、组织/样本上下文以及风险、反应和预后等领域展现出持续强劲的任务级排名得分。

结论: DaX作为一种可转移的视觉编码器，为计算病理学提供了有效支持，并为未来的病理学基础模型提供了一个标准化的评估框架。

翻译: Computational pathology requires visual representations that transfer across diverse clinical endpoints and remain robust to variation in magnification, staining, scanner type, slide preparation, and input resolution. We present DaX, a pathology vision foundation model that adapts DINOv3-style self-supervised learning to whole-slide histopathology. DaX is initialized from natural-image DINOv3 weights and incorporates continuous magnification training, cross-scale tissue views, orientation-agnostic and acquisition-robust augmentation, multi-input-size training, and Gram-anchored dense consistency. These designs aim to connect local cellular morphology with global tissue architecture while stabilizing dense token-level representations across input scales. We further construct a WSI-level benchmark comprising 161 clinically meaningful tasks from 44 public datasets, covering 28,182 patients and 34,394 slides across four clinical domains and nine task categories. All models are evaluated under a fixed patient-level cross-validation protocol with fold-level statistical ranking, enabling reproducible comparisons that are less sensitive to split-dependent variation. Across this benchmark, DaX achieves the highest mean performance across tasks and consistently strong task-level ranking scores, with gains spanning diagnostic pathology, biomarker and molecular profiling, tissue/specimen context, and risk, response, and prognosis. These results support DaX as a transferable visual encoder for computational pathology and provide a standardized evaluation framework for future pathology foundation models. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/DaX/benchboard/.

Abstract

Computational pathology requires visual representations that transfer across diverse clinical endpoints and remain robust to variation in magnification, staining, scanner type, slide preparation, and input resolution. We present DaX, a pathology vision foundation model that adapts DINOv3-style self-supervised learning to whole-slide histopathology. DaX is initialized from natural-image DINOv3 weights and incorporates continuous magnification training, cross-scale tissue views, orientation-agnostic and acquisition-robust augmentation, multi-input-size training, and Gram-anchored dense consistency. These designs aim to connect local cellular morphology with global tissue architecture while stabilizing dense token-level representations across input scales. We further construct a WSI-level benchmark comprising 161 clinically meaningful tasks from 44 public datasets, covering 28,182 patients and 34,394 slides across four clinical domains and nine task categories. All models are evaluated under a fixed patient-level cross-validation protocol with fold-level statistical ranking, enabling reproducible comparisons that are less sensitive to split-dependent variation. Across this benchmark, DaX achieves the highest mean performance across tasks and consistently strong task-level ranking scores, with gains spanning diagnostic pathology, biomarker and molecular profiling, tissue/specimen context, and risk, response, and prognosis. These results support DaX as a transferable visual encoder for computational pathology and provide a standardized evaluation framework for future pathology foundation models. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/DaX/benchboard/.

item.title: Don't Pause: Streaming Video-Language Synchrony for Online Video Understanding
item.author: Zhenyu Yang, Kairui Zhang, Shengsheng Qian, Weiming Dong, Changsheng Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LyraV的在线视频理解新范式Streaming Video-Language Synchrony，旨在解决流媒体场景中视频感知与语言生成不同步的问题。

背景: 在线视频大语言模型通过逐帧处理和主动响应实现了人机交互的进步，但在流媒体场景中，现有模型在生成响应时通常会暂停视频感知，导致实时视频语言不同步和卡顿。

目的: 解决流媒体场景中视频感知与语言生成不同步的问题，实现细粒度的视频语言同步。

方法: 提出了一个分层控制框架，包含两个核心创新：帧驱动转换控制器和流式令牌 pacing 器。帧驱动转换控制器是一个无训练的基于验证的有限状态机，用于决定何时继续说话、开始新响应或保持沉默。流式令牌 pacing 器是一个即插即用的轻量级预测模块，动态调整语言生成速率以匹配视觉内容节奏。LyraV 在每个帧间隔内仅输出适应实时预算的小块令牌，实现逐帧增量解码。

主要发现: LyraV 在五个在线和三个离线基准测试中表现出色，保持了骨干模型的通用理解能力，同时显著提高了流媒体同步性和叙事流畅性，实现了百分之九十八点二九的视频播放同步率和每秒三点八九帧的实时处理速度。此外，观察到 LyraV 具有在流式令牌上进行动态推理的能力，能够与视觉输入并行进行连续解释和“思考”。

结论: LyraV 通过其创新的分层控制框架，成功实现了在线视频理解中的细粒度视频语言同步，提升了流媒体场景下的交互体验。

翻译: 本文提出了一种名为LyraV的在线视频理解新范式Streaming Video-Language Synchrony，旨在解决流媒体场景中视频感知与语言生成不同步的问题。在线视频大语言模型通过逐帧处理和主动响应实现了人机交互的进步，但在流媒体场景中，现有模型在生成响应时通常会暂停视频感知，导致实时视频语言不同步和卡顿。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一个分层控制框架，包含两个核心创新：帧驱动转换控制器和流式令牌 pacing 器。帧驱动转换控制器是一个无训练的基于验证的有限状态机，用于决定何时继续说话、开始新响应或保持沉默。流式令牌 pacing 器是一个即插即用的轻量级预测模块，动态调整语言生成速率以匹配视觉内容节奏。LyraV 在每个帧间隔内仅输出适应实时预算的小块令牌，实现逐帧增量解码。实验表明，LyraV 在五个在线和三个离线基准测试中表现出色，保持了骨干模型的通用理解能力，同时显著提高了流媒体同步性和叙事流畅性，实现了百分之九十八点二九的视频播放同步率和每秒三点八九帧的实时处理速度。此外，观察到 LyraV 具有在流式令牌上进行动态推理的能力，能够与视觉输入并行进行连续解释和“思考”。

Abstract

Online Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have advanced toward seamless human-AI interaction through frame-by-frame processing and proactive responding. However, a critical challenge remains in streaming scenarios: existing models typically pause video perception while generating responses, breaking real-time video-language synchrony and causing stutters. To address this, we introduce a novel paradigm for online video understanding: Streaming Video-Language Synchrony (SVLS), and present LyraV, a live streaming assistant built upon a hierarchical control framework with two core innovations. First, the Frame-Driven Transition Controller (FDTC), a training-free verification-based finite-state machine, makes high-level semantic decisions on when to continue speaking, start a new response, or stay silent. Second, the Streaming Token Pacer (SToP), a plug-and-play lightweight predictive module, dynamically adapts the language generation rate to match the pace of the visual content. Concretely, LyraV performs \emph{per-frame incremental, sub-budget decoding}: within each frame interval it emits only a small chunk of tokens that fits the real-time budget, so perception is never blocked for a full sentence. Together, these components enable LyraV to seamlessly interleave incoming video frames with generated word tokens, achieving a fine-grained synchrony. Extensive experiments conducted on five online and three offline benchmarks demonstrate that LyraV preserves the backbone's general understanding ability while substantially improving streaming synchrony and narrative fluency, delivering a 98.29\% synchrony with video playback and a real-time processing speed of 3.89 FPS. Interestingly, we observe an empirical capability in LyraV: dynamic reasoning over streaming tokens, enabling continuous interpretation and "thinking" alongside visual input.

item.title: Task Editing for Generalizable 3D Visuomotor Policy Learning
item.author: Jian-Jian Jiang, YiHan Yang, Lan Wei, Yuming Luo, Xiao-Ming Wu, Xuhang Chen, Bin Fan, Dandan Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 3D视觉运动策略在复杂机器人操作中具有潜力，但依赖大规模真实世界演示数据。现有方法通过对象中心变换提高数据效率，但场景结构变化有限。本文提出Task-Edit框架，从任务中心视角分解并重组场景、技能和对象组件，生成多样化轨迹，提升3D视觉运动策略的有效性和泛化能力。

背景: 3D视觉运动策略为复杂机器人操作提供方向，深度图和点云提供丰富几何信息。但成功依赖大规模真实世界演示，收集成本高。现有方法通过对象中心变换（如改变对象姿态或尺度）提高数据效率，但保留原始场景结构和技能序列，限制合成多样化场景-技能-对象组合的能力。

目的: 提出Task-Edit框架，从任务中心视角分解并重组场景、技能和对象组件，生成多样化轨迹，提升3D视觉运动策略的有效性和泛化能力。

方法: Task-Edit框架将任务分解为场景、技能和对象组件，并灵活重组。通过任务中心编辑视角生成多样化轨迹，实现可扩展的演示生成。

主要发现: Task-Edit在真实世界实验中显著提升3D视觉运动策略的有效性、泛化能力和适用性。具体包括：提升跨任务和机器人形态的有效性；改善不同场景设置的泛化能力；处理难以收集的场景（如抗干扰、避障和未见杂乱场景）。

结论: Task-Edit通过任务中心编辑视角生成多样化轨迹，显著提升3D视觉运动策略在复杂操作任务中的性能。

翻译: 3D visuomotor policies offer a promising direction for complex robotic manipulation, as depth maps and point clouds provide rich geometric information for spatial reasoning. However, their success often depends on large-scale real-world demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect. To this end, existing methods commonly use demonstration generation strategies to improve data efficiency by applying object-centric transformations to human-collected demonstrations, such as varying object poses or scales. While effective for local variation, these transformations largely preserve the original scene structure and skill sequence, limiting their ability to synthesize diverse scene-skill-object combinations for complex tasks. In this paper, we propose Task-Edit, a novel demonstration generation framework that generates diverse trajectories from a task-centric editing perspective. The key insight of Task-Edit is to decompose a task into scene, skill and object components, and flexibly recombine them. In this way, Task-Edit enables scalable demonstration generation and significantly improves generalization for long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate Task-Edit through extensive real-world experiments and demonstrate three advantages: (1) Effectiveness: Task-Edit significantly improves 3D visuomotor policies across various real-world tasks and robot embodiments. (2) Generalizability: Task-Edit improves model generalization across different scenario setups. (3) Applicability: Task-Edit enables models to handle scenarios that are difficult to collect in the real world, including disturbance resistance, obstacle avoidance and unseen cluttered scenes.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决三维视觉运动策略学习严重依赖大规模真实世界演示数据的问题。现有方法仅能改变物体位置或大小，难以生成多样化的场景与操作序列，导致机器人泛化能力不足。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为高效的数据生成能大幅降低采集成本，并显著提升机器人在复杂长程任务和未知环境中的实际应用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法主要局限于对物体位置或大小的局部变换，难以生成多样化的场景与技能组合，因此提出从任务整体视角出发，将任务解耦为场景、操作技能和物体三个独立组件进行编辑。该方法借鉴了仿真到现实再返回的通用范式以及前人将轨迹分解为运动与技能片段的思路，结合三维生成模型、关键点匹配和图结构规划技术，在仿真环境中灵活重组各组件以生成丰富数据，最后通过深度修复模块缩小仿真与现实的差距。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将复杂任务解耦为场景、操作技能和物体三个独立组件，通过分别编辑这些组件的属性，仅用单次人类演示即可合成大量多样化的训练轨迹，从而提升机器人的泛化能力。整体流程首先将真实演示重建至仿真环境中，接着利用三维生成模型和关键点匹配技术独立修改物体的位姿与纹理、通过有向无环图调整技能执行顺序，并添加干扰物改变场景布局。最后，在仿真中生成新轨迹后，使用深度修复和点云分割模型消除仿真到真实的差距，输出高质量数据用于策略训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种任务编辑框架，将操作任务解耦为场景、操作技能和物体三个核心部分，通过独立编辑各部分属性从单次演示中生成多样化的训练轨迹。与以往主要依赖物体中心变换（如仅调整物体位置或大小）的方法不同，该方法采用任务中心视角，能够灵活重组场景布局、技能执行顺序和物体属性，从而突破原有固定行为模式的限制。此外，框架结合了仿真到现实的修复模块，有效缩小了环境差异，显著提升了模型在长程操作任务中的泛化能力和适用性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种任务编辑框架，通过将任务解耦为场景、技能和物体三个核心组件并独立编辑重组，仅需单次人类演示即可生成多样化的训练数据，从而显著提升三维视觉运动策略在复杂机器人操作任务中的泛化能力与性能。

Abstract

3D visuomotor policies offer a promising direction for complex robotic manipulation, as depth maps and point clouds provide rich geometric information for spatial reasoning. However, their success often depends on large-scale real-world demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect. To this end, existing methods commonly use demonstration generation strategies to improve data efficiency by applying object-centric transformations to human-collected demonstrations, such as varying object poses or scales. While effective for local variation, these transformations largely preserve the original scene structure and skill sequence, limiting their ability to synthesize diverse scene-skill-object combinations for complex tasks. In this paper, we propose Task-Edit, a novel demonstration generation framework that generates diverse trajectories from a task-centric editing perspective. The key insight of Task-Edit is to decompose a task into scene, skill and object components, and flexibly recombine them. In this way, Task-Edit enables scalable demonstration generation and significantly improves generalization for long-horizon manipulation tasks. We evaluate Task-Edit through extensive real-world experiments and demonstrate three advantages: (1) Effectiveness: Task-Edit significantly improves 3D visuomotor policies across various real-world tasks and robot embodiments. (2) Generalizability: Task-Edit improves model generalization across different scenario setups. (3) Applicability: Task-Edit enables models to handle scenarios that are difficult to collect in the real world, including disturbance resistance, obstacle avoidance and unseen cluttered scenes.

item.title: Networked Spatial Effects in European Electricity Price Forecasting
item.author: Sultan Mahmud Chomon, Florian Ziel
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种网络时空模型，用于预测欧洲电力市场的日前电价，该模型通过映射空间信息覆盖范围，系统性地整合了相邻节点的网络化信息，并在高解析度的流式预测设置中进行了验证。

背景: 欧洲的竞价区通过物理输电线路高度互联，空间影响通过网络在相邻节点间传播，这反映在日前电价中，因为拍卖算法不仅使用每个竞价区地理边界内的信息，还使用了边界外的信息。

目的: 捕捉这种互联性如何影响相邻竞价区的电价，并展示网络结构在互联市场间传播信息的关键作用及其对日前电价预测的广泛影响。

方法: 使用度量图映射信息覆盖范围，定义邻域度量；提出网络时空模型，将不规则空间节点映射为有序网络，系统性地整合邻域信息；在覆盖欧洲大部分电力市场的三十九个竞价区中实施该模型，采用高解析度流式预测设置，结合自回归、跨小时效应、季节性效应、燃料和排放价格以及基本面的日前预测作为互联信息进行预测。

主要发现: 在欧洲范围内的研究中，网络时空模型一致优于传统的基于孤岛纯局部模型。

结论: 该论文提供了一个框架，证明了网络结构在互联市场间传播信息的关键作用，并展示了其对日前电价预测的广泛影响。

翻译: As European bidding zones are highly interconnected by physical transmission lines, spatial influences propagate across neighboring nodes through a network. It is reflected in the day-ahead electricity prices across European bidding zones, as the auction algorithm also uses information beyond each bidding zone's geographic boundary. To capture how this interconnection affects the electricity prices in neighboring bidding zones, we have used a metric graph to map the spatial coverage of information using a well-defined neighborhood measure. We propose the Networked Spatio-Temporal Model, which maps irregular spatial nodes into an ordered network, enabling the systematic incorporation of neighborhood information. We implement the NSTM across 39 bidding zones covering the majority of European electricity markets in a high-resolution, streaming-forecasting setup. The model uses autoregressive, cross-hour, and seasonal effects, along with fuel and emission prices and day-ahead forecasts of fundamentals, as interconnected information to predict the day-ahead prices for each bidding zone. A Europe-wide study presented in this paper shows that the NSTM consistently outperforms traditional island-based pure local models. This paper provides a framework that demonstrates the critical role the networked structure plays in propagating information across interconnected markets and its vast implications for day-ahead electricity price forecasting.

Abstract

As European bidding zones are highly interconnected by physical transmission lines, spatial influences propagate across neighboring nodes through a network. It is reflected in the day-ahead electricity prices across European bidding zones, as the auction algorithm also uses information beyond each bidding zone's geographic boundary. To capture how this interconnection affects the electricity prices in neighboring bidding zones, we have used a metric graph to map the spatial coverage of information using a well-defined neighborhood measure. We propose the Networked Spatio-Temporal Model (NSTM), which maps irregular spatial nodes into an ordered network, enabling the systematic incorporation of neighborhood information. We implement the NSTM across 39 bidding zones covering the majority of European electricity markets in a high-resolution, streaming-forecasting setup. The model uses autoregressive, cross-hour, and seasonal effects, along with fuel and emission prices and day-ahead forecasts of fundamentals, as interconnected information to predict the day-ahead prices for each bidding zone. A Europe-wide study presented in this paper shows that the NSTM consistently outperforms traditional island-based pure local models. This paper provides a framework that demonstrates the critical role the networked structure plays in propagating information across interconnected markets and its vast implications for day-ahead electricity price forecasting.

item.title: Phonetic Error Analysis of Raw Waveform Acoustic Models
item.author: Erfan Loweimi, Zhengjun Yue, Andrea Carmantini, Zoran Cvetkovic, Steve Renals, Peter Bell
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究分析了原始波形声学模型在TIMIT电话识别任务中的错误模式，超越了整体电话错误率。通过将电话错误率分解为三个广泛的语音类别，并从替换错误中构建混淆矩阵，揭示了模型在不同语音类别上的表现差异。研究结合参数化或非参数化卷积神经网络与双向长短期记忆网络，取得了原始波形模型在TIMIT上的最佳结果。通过从WSJ进行迁移学习，进一步降低了错误率，超越了滤波器基线。分析显示，双向长短期记忆网络层对依赖转换的类别最有益，而WSJ迁移学习对辅音的改善程度约为元音的三倍。混淆模式在原始波形和滤波器系统中保持一致，表明主要混淆反映了固有的语音相似性。

背景: TIMIT电话识别任务中，原始波形声学模型的整体电话错误率已得到广泛研究，但对其错误模式的深入分析，特别是超越整体错误率的分类分析，尚不充分。

目的: 分析原始波形声学模型在TIMIT电话识别任务中的错误模式，超越整体电话错误率，通过分解错误率和构建混淆矩阵，揭示模型在不同语音类别上的表现差异及其原因。

方法: 将电话错误率分解为三个广泛的语音类别，并从替换错误中构建混淆矩阵。结合参数化（SincNet, Sinc2Net）或非参数化卷积神经网络与双向长短期记忆网络。使用TIMIT数据集进行训练和测试，并从WSJ进行迁移学习。

主要发现: 模型在TIMIT的Dev/Test集上分别取得了百分之十三点九和百分之十五点三的电话错误率，为原始波形模型的最佳结果。从WSJ迁移学习后，错误率进一步降低至百分之十一点三和百分之十二点三，超越了滤波器基线。双向长短期记忆网络层对依赖转换的类别最有益。WSJ迁移学习对辅音的改善程度约为元音的三倍。混淆模式在原始波形和滤波器系统中保持一致。

结论: 主要混淆反映了固有的语音相似性，表明不同系统间的错误模式具有共性。通过结合特定网络结构和迁移学习，可以显著提升原始波形声学模型在电话识别任务中的性能。

翻译: We analyse error patterns of raw waveform acoustic models on TIMIT phone recognition beyond the overall phone error rate (PER). PER is decomposed across three broad phonetic class (BPC) categorisations, and confusion matrices are constructed from substitution errors. Our models combine parametric (SincNet, Sinc2Net) or non-parametric CNNs with Bidirectional LSTMs, achieving 13.9%/15.3% PER on Dev/Test, the best reported results for raw waveform models on TIMIT. Transfer learning from WSJ reduces PER to 11.3%/12.3%, surpassing the Filterbank baseline. Per-BPC analysis reveals that BLSTM layers benefit transition-dependent classes most, while WSJ transfer learning improves consonants roughly three times more than vowels. Confusion patterns are consistent across raw waveform and Filterbank systems, indicating that the dominant confusions reflect inherent phonetic similarities.

Abstract

We analyse error patterns of raw waveform acoustic models on TIMIT phone recognition beyond the overall phone error rate (PER). PER is decomposed across three broad phonetic class (BPC) categorisations, and confusion matrices are constructed from substitution errors. Our models combine parametric (SincNet, Sinc2Net) or non-parametric CNNs with Bidirectional LSTMs, achieving 13.9%/15.3% PER on Dev/Test, the best reported results for raw waveform models on TIMIT. Transfer learning from WSJ reduces PER to 11.3%/12.3%, surpassing the Filterbank baseline. Per-BPC analysis reveals that BLSTM layers benefit transition-dependent classes most, while WSJ transfer learning improves consonants roughly three times more than vowels. Confusion patterns are consistent across raw waveform and Filterbank systems, indicating that the dominant confusions reflect inherent phonetic similarities.

item.title: CF-JEPA: Mask-free forward prediction with asymmetric encoder utilization for time-series representation learning
item.author: Jaehoon Lee, Sunghyun Sim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为基于裁剪的前向JEPA的无掩码框架，用于时间序列表示学习。该框架通过多视界前向预测替代传统的掩码方法，利用时间序列固有的时间顺序作为学习信号。研究发现在线编码器与指数移动平均目标编码器之间存在强不对称性，并据此优化了不同任务的路由分配。实验表明该方法在分类、预测和异常检测任务中取得了优异的性能。

背景: 时间序列表示学习的自监督学习主要受两种范式主导：对比方法在构建正负样本对时面临挑战，而基于掩码的方法会破坏时间序列信号的时间连续性。现有的基于JEPA的时间序列变体仍然依赖掩码，因此继承了连续性破坏的问题。

目的: 提出一种创新的无掩码框架，以解决现有方法中掩码导致的时间连续性破坏问题，并探索更有效的自监督学习范式。

方法: 提出基于裁剪的前向JEPA框架，使用随机裁剪作为上下文视图，并在前向时间方向上预测短、中、长视界未来的表示。该方法直接利用时间序列固有的时间顺序作为学习信号，无需掩码。同时，识别并利用在线编码器与指数移动平均目标编码器之间的强不对称性，将分类任务路由至在线编码器，将预测或异常检测任务路由至指数移动平均目标编码器。

主要发现: 在线编码器与指数移动平均目标编码器之间存在强不对称性：在线编码器发展出更高秩的判别性特征，而指数移动平均目标编码器发展出更平滑、低秩的时间特征。利用这种不对称性，在无需额外训练成本的情况下，将多变量预测的均方误差降低了百分之二十七。在多个数据集和基准测试中，该方法在分类任务中取得了最高的平均准确率和排名，在单变量预测和基于k近邻得分的异常检测中排名第二。

结论: 基于裁剪的前向JEPA作为一种无掩码框架，通过多视界前向预测有效利用了时间序列的时间顺序，解决了传统掩码方法的问题，并在多种时间序列任务中展现了优越的性能。

翻译: Self-supervised learning (SSL) for time-series representation learning is dominated by two paradigms: contrastive methods, which face challenges in constructing positive or negative pairs, and masking-based methods, which disrupt the temporal continuity of time-series signals. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) offers a promising alternative by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing raw inputs. However, existing time-series JEPA variants still rely on masking and therefore inherit its continuity problem. Crop-based Forward JEPA (CF-JEPA) is proposed as an innovative mask-free framework that replaces masking with multi-horizon forward prediction: random crops serve as context views, and short-, mid-, and long-horizon future representations are predicted in the forward temporal direction, directly leveraging the inherent temporal ordering of time-series data as a learning signal. A strong asymmetry is also identified between the online encoder and the exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder, both produced from a single training run: the online encoder develops higher-rank discriminative features, while the EMA target encoder develops smoother, lower-rank temporal features. Exploiting this asymmetry, classification is routed to the online encoder and forecasting or anomaly detection to the EMA target encoder, achieving a 27% reduction in multivariate forecasting mean squared error (MSE) at no additional training cost. Across 126 University of California, Riverside (UCR) and 26 University of East Anglia (UEA) classification datasets, eight electricity transformer temperature forecasting benchmarks, and Key Performance Indicator /Yahoo anomaly detection, CF-JEPA achieves the highest average accuracy and rank on UCR and UEA among self-supervised baselines and ranks second on univariate forecasting and k-nearest neighbors-scored anomaly detection.

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) for time-series representation learning is dominated by two paradigms: contrastive methods, which face challenges in constructing positive or negative pairs, and masking-based methods, which disrupt the temporal continuity of time-series signals. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) offers a promising alternative by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing raw inputs. However, existing time-series JEPA variants still rely on masking and therefore inherit its continuity problem. Crop-based Forward JEPA (CF-JEPA) is proposed as an innovative mask-free framework that replaces masking with multi-horizon forward prediction: random crops serve as context views, and short-, mid-, and long-horizon future representations are predicted in the forward temporal direction, directly leveraging the inherent temporal ordering of time-series data as a learning signal. A strong asymmetry is also identified between the online encoder and the exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder, both produced from a single training run: the online encoder develops higher-rank discriminative features, while the EMA target encoder develops smoother, lower-rank temporal features. Exploiting this asymmetry, classification is routed to the online encoder and forecasting or anomaly detection to the EMA target encoder, achieving a 27% reduction in multivariate forecasting mean squared error (MSE) at no additional training cost. Across 126 University of California, Riverside (UCR) and 26 University of East Anglia (UEA) classification datasets, eight electricity transformer temperature forecasting benchmarks, and Key Performance Indicator /Yahoo anomaly detection, CF-JEPA achieves the highest average accuracy and rank on UCR and UEA among self-supervised baselines and ranks second on univariate forecasting and k-nearest neighbors-scored anomaly detection.

item.title: HRsR: Hierarchical Rotation System Reconstruction
item.author: Ruiqi Cui, Cem Akarsubaşı, Emil Toftegaard Gæde, Eva Rotenberg, Leif Kobbelt, J. Andreas Bærentzen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种分层旋转系统重建方法，通过分层边折叠和顶点分裂加速重建过程，在保持几何保真度和拓扑控制的同时显著提升了计算效率和内存使用。

背景: 从点云进行表面重建在需要几何保真度和拓扑控制时具有挑战性。现有的旋转系统重建方法通过欧拉特征显式控制拓扑，但顺序边插入限制了其可扩展性。

目的: 加速旋转系统重建过程，解决其顺序边插入导致的可扩展性限制问题。

方法: 提出分层旋转系统重建方法，首先使用k近邻图简化输入，在简化结构上执行重建，然后恢复几何细节并保留拓扑。通过处理相交和基于质量的顶点分裂选择来保持几何一致性。

主要发现: 与现有方法相比，该方法实现了最高六倍的速度提升和超过八倍的内存使用减少，同时保持了相当的重建结果。

结论: 分层旋转系统重建方法有效解决了旋转系统重建的可扩展性问题，在保持高质量重建结果的同时显著提升了性能。

翻译: Surface reconstruction from point clouds remains challenging when both geometric fidelity and topology control are required. Rotation System Reconstruction (RsR) reconstructs triangle meshes from point clouds while explicitly controlling topology through the Euler characteristic, but its sequential edge insertion limits scalability. We present Hierarchical Rotation System Reconstruction (HRsR), which accelerates RsR through a hierarchical pipeline of edge collapses and vertex splits. HRsR first simplifies the input using a k-nearest neighbor graph, performs reconstruction on the reduced structure, and then restores geometric detail while preserving topology. To maintain geometric consistency, we incorporate intersection handling and quality-driven vertex split selection. Experiments demonstrate up to a 6x speedup and more than 8x reduction in memory usage over RsR, while achieving comparable reconstruction results.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决基于点云进行三维表面重建时，现有算法在兼顾几何精度与拓扑控制的同时计算效率低、内存占用高的问题。针对原有方法在处理大规模点云时速度缓慢的缺陷，本文提出了一种分层加速策略。该问题在研究和工程中非常重要，因为点云重建技术广泛应用于计算机渲染、物理仿真、逆向工程和形状分析等领域，提升其效率与可扩展性能够显著降低计算成本并推动相关下游应用的落地。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现原有方法在处理大规模点云时，初始阶段因从包含所有顶点的单一面开始而计算成本过高。为此，他们设计了分层处理思路，先通过边折叠大幅简化输入点云，在简化结构上完成拓扑重建后，再按逆序通过顶点分裂恢复几何细节，从而显著提升效率并过滤冗余点。该方法的设计直接借鉴了渐进网格技术的思想，但将其应用场景从三角形网格的层次表示调整为图结构的简化与细节恢复，以适配新的重建流程。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是采用分层策略，通过先简化数据再重建、最后恢复细节的流程来加速点云表面重建。整体实现流程首先基于输入点云构建邻域图并执行边折叠以大幅减少顶点数量；接着在简化后的稀疏结构上运行拓扑可控的重建算法；最后按折叠的逆序进行顶点分裂，结合几何质量评估与相交处理，逐步恢复原始点云密度与几何细节。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种分层重建框架，通过先对输入点云进行边折叠简化，再在简化结构上执行拓扑可控的重建，最后按逆序进行顶点分裂以恢复几何细节。与之前的旋转系统重建方法相比，该方法将边折叠与顶点分裂分离应用于图与网格，有效解决了原始方法在大规模点云上计算成本高和内存占用大的问题。同时，论文引入了基于几何质量的顶点分裂选择策略以及交叉边检测与处理机制，进一步提升了重建网格的几何一致性与输出质量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种分层旋转系统重建方法，通过先简化输入点云、再在简化结构上重建、最后按逆序恢复细节的流程，在保持拓扑一致性的同时显著提升了重建速度并降低了内存消耗。

Abstract

Surface reconstruction from point clouds remains challenging when both geometric fidelity and topology control are required. Rotation System Reconstruction (RsR) reconstructs triangle meshes from point clouds while explicitly controlling topology through the Euler characteristic, but its sequential edge insertion limits scalability. We present Hierarchical Rotation System Reconstruction (HRsR), which accelerates RsR through a hierarchical pipeline of edge collapses and vertex splits. HRsR first simplifies the input using a $k$-nearest neighbor graph, performs reconstruction on the reduced structure, and then restores geometric detail while preserving topology. To maintain geometric consistency, we incorporate intersection handling and quality-driven vertex split selection. Experiments demonstrate up to a $6\times$ speedup and more than $8\times$ reduction in memory usage over RsR, while achieving comparable reconstruction results.

item.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
item.author: Shen, Zhennan, Li, Yanshu, Yin, Qingyu, Leong, Chak Tou, Wang, Zhilin, Chen, Yanxu, Han, Rongduo, Lee, Sunbowen, Fung, Yi R.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在线策略蒸馏在提升大语言模型推理能力中的训练动态，通过参数空间诊断分析其更新轨迹，并与监督微调及可验证奖励强化学习进行对比。

背景: 在线策略蒸馏被广泛用于提升大语言模型的推理能力，但其训练动态机制尚不明确。

目的: 刻画在线策略蒸馏在参数空间中的更新轨迹，并与监督微调和可验证奖励强化学习进行对比分析。
