方法: 使用参数空间诊断工具分析更新轨迹，进行控制实验以检验稀疏化更新令牌、偏离策略生成及混合目标对更新几何的影响。

主要发现: 在线策略蒸馏处于松弛的非主成分区域，更新影响的权重更少且更避开主成分方向；其累积更新迅速进入低维通道形成子空间锁定；该锁定子空间对在线策略蒸馏性能足够但对监督微调有害；稀疏化更新和偏离策略生成保持更新几何，而混合强化学习目标会改变它。

结论: 在线策略蒸馏并非监督微调与强化学习之间的中间点，而是在参数空间中诱导了独特的更新几何结构。

翻译: On-policy distillation is increasingly used to improve large language model reasoning, but its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We characterize the trajectory of OPD updates in parameter space and compare it with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. A suite of parameter-space diagnostics consistently places OPD in a relaxed off-principal regime: compared with SFT, its updates affect fewer weights and avoid principal directions more strongly, while compared with RLVR, they remain less tightly constrained. Beyond this static localization, OPD exhibits subspace locking: its cumulative updates rapidly enter a narrow low-dimensional channel. Constraining training to the update subspace formed early in training preserves OPD performance but substantially degrades SFT, indicating that the locked subspace is functionally sufficient for OPD. Control experiments further show that sparsifying the update tokens and shifting rollout generation off-policy preserve the rank dynamics, whereas mixing the OPD objective with RLVR changes them. Overall, these results suggest that OPD is not merely an intermediate point between SFT and RLVR, but induces its own update geometry in parameter space.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决对在线策略蒸馏训练动态和参数空间更新轨迹缺乏理解的问题。它通过系统对比监督微调与强化学习，揭示了该方法独特的更新几何特性。明确这一机制在研究中至关重要，因为在线策略蒸馏是提升大语言模型推理能力的关键技术，厘清其内在规律能直接指导更高效的算法设计，避免盲目训练带来的计算资源浪费。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 本文并非提出新方法，而是对已有的在线策略蒸馏技术进行几何特性分析。作者发现该技术虽能有效提升模型推理能力，但其训练过程中的参数变化规律尚不明确，因此设计了系统的参数空间诊断实验。研究明确借鉴了先前关于监督微调与强化学习权重几何特征的工作，将其作为对比基准与分析工具，从而揭示该技术的更新轨迹与子空间锁定现象。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让模型基于自身生成的采样轨迹进行训练，同时利用更强教师模型提供的密集逐词级指导信号来更新参数。整体实现流程在文中未明确说明，标记为unknown。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次系统刻画了在线策略蒸馏在参数空间中的更新轨迹，发现其处于一种介于监督微调与强化学习之间的宽松非主成分区域。相比以往仅关注监督微调或强化学习的几何特征，该研究揭示了在线策略蒸馏具有独特的子空间锁定现象，即训练初期便会迅速收敛并稳定在一个低维更新通道中。此外，论文证明该轨迹主要由目标函数构成方式决定，表明该方法并非前两者的简单过渡，而是形成了独立的参数更新几何结构。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文从参数空间几何视角系统揭示了在线策略蒸馏的训练动态，指出其更新轨迹介于监督微调与强化学习之间，具有避开主成分方向且快速锁定在低维功能子空间中的独特几何特性，从而阐明了该方法独立于其他范式的内在优化机制。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used to improve large language model reasoning, but its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We characterize the trajectory of OPD updates in parameter space and compare it with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). A suite of parameter-space diagnostics consistently places OPD in a relaxed off-principal regime: compared with SFT, its updates affect fewer weights and avoid principal directions more strongly, while compared with RLVR, they remain less tightly constrained. Beyond this static localization, OPD exhibits subspace locking: its cumulative updates rapidly enter a narrow low-dimensional channel. Constraining training to the update subspace formed early in training preserves OPD performance but substantially degrades SFT, indicating that the locked subspace is functionally sufficient for OPD. Control experiments further show that sparsifying the update tokens and shifting rollout generation off-policy preserve the rank dynamics, whereas mixing the OPD objective with RLVR changes them. Overall, these results suggest that OPD is not merely an intermediate point between SFT and RLVR, but induces its own update geometry in parameter space.

item.title: Native3D: End-to-End 3D Scene Generation via Unified Mesh-Texture Modeling and Semantic Alignment
item.author: Yibo Liu, Ziwei Zhang, Haozhou Pang, Menghao Li, Lanshan He, Gan Qi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了Native3D，这是首个完全绕过二维中间表示的端到端三维场景生成框架。

背景: 传统方法通常需要调整三维表示以适应二维领域，以利用预训练的扩散模型，这不可避免地引入了领域适应问题，包括几何结构扭曲和纹理细节退化。

目的: 解决传统方法中存在的领域适应问题，如几何结构扭曲和纹理细节退化。

方法: 设计了一种统一的网格纹理联合表示，通过基于Transformer的场景编码器同时建模几何结构和纹理特征，以有效维持场景内对象之间的空间关系和视觉一致性。提出了三维表示对齐损失，采用改进的对比学习机制在潜在空间中对齐多级语义表示，显著增强几何和纹理保真度。

主要发现: 实验结果表明，Native3D在生成质量和编辑灵活性方面优于现有方法。

结论: Native3D为三维场景编辑提供了一种新的解决方案。

翻译: This paper presents Native3D, the first end-to-end 3D scene generation framework that completely bypasses 2D intermediate representations. Traditional approaches typically require adapting 3D representations to the 2D domain to leverage pre-trained diffusion models, which inevitably introduces domain adaptation issues including geometric structural distortion and texture detail degradation. To address these limitations, we design a unified mesh-texture joint representation that simultaneously models both geometric structures and texture features through a Transformer-based scene encoder, effectively maintaining spatial relationships and visual consistency among objects within scenes. We further propose the 3D Representation Alignment Loss, which employs an improved contrastive learning mechanism to align multi-level semantic representations in the latent space, significantly enhancing geometric and textural fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that Native3D outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and editing flexibility, providing a novel solution for 3D scene editing.

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是彻底摒弃传统的二维中间表示，直接在三维特征空间中进行端到端的场景生成。通过联合建模网格几何与纹理特征，并引入三维语义对齐损失，有效保持场景的空间关系、视觉一致性及细节保真度。整体流程首先将输入的三维模型信息通过联合编码器提取特征，随后在三维潜在空间中结合文本提示进行扩散生成，最后解码还原为标准三维网格与纹理。训练时借助预训练编码器计算对齐损失，以指导模型同步优化全局布局与局部细节。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了首个完全绕过二维中间表示的端到端三维场景生成框架。它设计了统一的网格与纹理联合表示方法，通过基于注意力机制的编码器同时建模几何结构与纹理特征，并引入了三维表示对齐损失来对齐多层语义特征以提升细节保真度。相比以往依赖二维扩散模型或混合二维处理三维重建的工作，该方法从根本上避免了跨域转换导致的几何结构扭曲和纹理细节丢失，实现了更准确的三维空间一致性与全局协调性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了首个完全绕过二维中间表示的端到端三维场景生成框架Native3D，通过联合建模网格几何与纹理特征并引入三维表示对齐损失，有效消除了跨域信息丢失问题，显著提升了生成场景的几何结构、纹理细节保真度与多视角一致性。

Abstract

This paper presents Native3D, the first end-to-end 3D scene generation framework that completely bypasses 2D intermediate representations. Traditional approaches typically require adapting 3D representations to the 2D domain to leverage pre-trained diffusion models, which inevitably introduces domain adaptation issues including geometric structural distortion and texture detail degradation. To address these limitations, we design a unified mesh-texture joint representation that simultaneously models both geometric structures and texture features through a Transformer-based scene encoder, effectively maintaining spatial relationships and visual consistency among objects within scenes. We further propose the 3D Representation Alignment Loss (3D REPA Loss), which employs an improved contrastive learning mechanism to align multi-level semantic representations in the latent space, significantly enhancing geometric and textural fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that Native3D outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and editing flexibility, providing a novel solution for 3D scene editing.

item.title: AdaTok: Self-Budgeting Image Tokenization with Quality-Preserving Dynamic Tokens
item.author: Xiaocheng Lu, Yuxi Chen, Jie Zhang, Jian Liu, Jingcai Guo, Fangqi Zhu, Tao Han, Song Guo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为AdaTok的自预算离散一维图像标记器，通过表示与分配协同设计实现动态预算分配，在ImageNet-1K数据集上优于现有基线方法，并在自回归图像生成中显著提升吞吐量。

背景: 现有图像标记器通常使用固定数量的标记编码图像，但视觉复杂性高度异质，导致简单输入预算过剩而复杂输入预算不足。现有弹性标记器虽能输出可变长度重建，但标记长度通常作为部署时操作点、搜索目标或外部预测，而非标记器本身的输出。

目的: 探讨离散视觉标记器是否能在单次传递中自主分配预算，实现内容条件化的标记数量输出而非固定超参数。

方法: 提出AdaTok，结合优先表示学习（通过嵌套尾部掩码排序标记，并使用多头LoRA解码头解决预算依赖的语义偏移）和自适应标记分配（在候选预算上训练轻量级确定性组GRPO策略）。使用动态帕累托权重在策略训练期间平衡保真度和效率，无需手动权衡扫描。

主要发现: 可行的弹性需要表示与分配协同设计：前缀必须在不同预算下保持可解码，且标记器必须学习每个图像所需的前缀。AdaTok-Full在256个标记时达到rFID 1.31，AdaTok-Adaptive平均仅用约118个标记达到rFID 1.50，优于可比预算下的离散一维基线。

结论: 视觉标记数量可以作为内容条件化的输出进行学习，而非设置为固定超参数。自适应表示在自回归图像生成中比固定256标记解码提供约2.1倍的吞吐量提升。

翻译: Image tokenizers, from 2D grids to recent 1D sequences, typically encode every image with the same fixed number of tokens. Yet visual complexity is highly heterogeneous, so a uniform budget overspends on simple inputs and underserves complex ones. Existing elastic tokenizers expose variable-length reconstructions, but often leave token length as a deployment-time operating point, a search target, or an external prediction rather than an output of the tokenizer itself. In this work, we ask whether a discrete visual tokenizer can budget itself in one pass. Our central finding is that actionable elasticity requires a representation--allocation co-design: prefixes must remain decodable across budgets, and the tokenizer must learn which prefix each image needs. We propose AdaTok, a self-budgeting discrete 1D tokenizer. AdaTok combines Prioritized Representation Learning, which orders tokens with nested tail masking and resolves budget-dependent semantic shift through Multi-Head LoRA decoder heads, with Adaptive Token Allocation, which trains a lightweight deterministic-group GRPO policy over candidate budgets. Dynamic Pareto Weighting balances fidelity and efficiency during policy training without manual trade-off sweeps. On ImageNet-1K, AdaTok-Full reaches rFID 1.31 at 256 tokens, while AdaTok-Adaptive attains rFID 1.50 using only ~118 tokens on average, outperforming discrete 1D baselines at comparable budgets. In autoregressive image generation, the shorter adaptive representation yields ~2.1x throughput over a fixed 256-token decode, suggesting that visual token count can be learned as a content-conditioned output rather than set as a fixed hyperparameter.

Abstract

Image tokenizers, from 2D grids to recent 1D sequences, typically encode every image with the same fixed number of tokens. Yet visual complexity is highly heterogeneous, so a uniform budget overspends on simple inputs and underserves complex ones. Existing elastic tokenizers expose variable-length reconstructions, but often leave token length as a deployment-time operating point, a search target, or an external prediction rather than an output of the tokenizer itself. In this work, we ask whether a discrete visual tokenizer can budget itself in one pass. Our central finding is that actionable elasticity requires a representation--allocation co-design: prefixes must remain decodable across budgets, and the tokenizer must learn which prefix each image needs. We propose AdaTok, a self-budgeting discrete 1D tokenizer. AdaTok combines Prioritized Representation Learning, which orders tokens with nested tail masking and resolves budget-dependent semantic shift through Multi-Head LoRA decoder heads, with Adaptive Token Allocation, which trains a lightweight deterministic-group GRPO policy over candidate budgets. Dynamic Pareto Weighting balances fidelity and efficiency during policy training without manual trade-off sweeps. On ImageNet-1K, AdaTok-Full reaches rFID 1.31 at 256 tokens, while AdaTok-Adaptive attains rFID 1.50 using only ~118 tokens on average, outperforming discrete 1D baselines at comparable budgets. In autoregressive image generation, the shorter adaptive representation yields ~2.1x throughput over a fixed 256-token decode, suggesting that visual token count can be learned as a content-conditioned output rather than set as a fixed hyperparameter.

item.title: Reconstructing Multi-Decadal Forest Disturbances: A Spatio-Temporal Transformer Approach
item.author: Linus Scheibenreif, Anton Raichuk, Maxim Neumann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于深度学习的框架，用于监测美国本土连续地区长达三十八年的森林干扰情况。该方法通过同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域，利用视觉变换器架构过滤噪声并生成空间一致的干扰地图。在多个卫星数据和时间窗口上进行了全面评估，结果显示该方法在精度和减少空间伪影方面表现优异，但在不同干扰类型下与基线方法相比存在性能权衡。

背景: 准确监测森林干扰对于理解碳动态和土地管理至关重要。然而，传统方法通常依赖于卫星时间序列的逐像素分析，忽略了空间上下文信息。

目的: 开发一种能够同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域的深度学习框架，以准确监测美国本土连续地区长达三十八年的森林干扰。

方法: 使用视觉变换器架构，对三十八年（一九八四年至二零二二年）的森林干扰进行建模。该方法同时考虑时间轨迹和空间邻域，利用弱监督信号过滤噪声，生成空间一致的干扰地图。在多个卫星数据（Landsat、Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2）和时间窗口（三十八年和最近六年）上进行评估，并与手动标注的验证数据集（样本量为三百）和独立的火灾边界数据集（样本量为七百零六）进行性能验证。

主要发现: 该时空模型在检测精度方面表现优异，在一九八四年至二零二二年数据集中，对火灾边界的检测精度高达百分之九十八点二（正负一年误差范围内），在美国本土验证数据集上的精度为百分之七十一点三。F1分数分别达到百分之七十五点八和百分之四十七点三。该方法有效减少了空间伪影，但在不同干扰类型下与逐像素基线方法相比存在性能权衡。

结论: 该方法为一致的森林监测提供了一个有前景的基础。

翻译: 准确监测森林干扰对于理解碳动态和土地管理至关重要，然而传统方法通常依赖于卫星时间序列的逐像素分析，忽略了空间上下文。我们提出了一种深度学习框架，通过同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域，对美国本土连续地区长达三十八年（一九八四年至二零二二年）的森林干扰进行映射。利用视觉变换器架构，我们的方法有效地从弱监督信号中过滤噪声，以生成空间一致的干扰地图。我们在多个卫星（Landsat、Sentinel-1、Sentinel-2）和时间窗口（三十八年和最近六年）上进行了全面评估，并与一个新颖的手动标注验证数据集（样本量为三百）和独立的火灾边界数据集（样本量为七百零六）验证了性能。结果突出了任务的复杂性：虽然我们的时空模型展示了高精度（在MTBS上正负一年检测的精度高达百分之九十八点二，在美国本土验证数据集上为百分之七十一点三，F1分数分别高达百分之七十五点八和百分之四十七点三），并有效减少了空间伪影，但与逐像素基线相比，它在不同干扰类型下表现出性能权衡。我们的方法为一致的森林监测提供了一个有前景的基础。

Abstract

Accurate monitoring of forest disturbances is essential for understanding carbon dynamics and land management, yet traditional approaches typically rely on pixel-wise analysis of satellite time-series, ignoring spatial context. We present a deep learning framework that maps 38 years (1984-2022) of forest disturbance across the contiguous United States by modeling temporal trajectories and spatial neighborhoods simultaneously. By leveraging a vision transformer architecture, our approach effectively filters noise from weak supervision signals to produce spatially coherent disturbance maps. We perform exhaustive evaluations across multiple satellites (Landsat, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2) and temporal windows (38 years and the more recent 6 years), validating performance against a novel, manually annotated validation dataset (n=300) and independent fire perimeter dataset (n=706). The results highlight the complexity of the task: while our spatio-temporal model demonstrates high precision (up to 98.2% for +-1 year detection on MTBS and up to 71.3% on the CONUS validation datasets, with F1-scores up to 75.8% and 47.3%, respectively) and effectively reduces spatial artifacts, it exhibits performance trade-offs across different disturbance regimes compared to pixel-wise baselines. Our method offers a promising foundation for consistent forest monitoring.

item.title: Geometric-Aware Hypergraph Reasoning for Novel Class Discovery in Point Cloud Segmentation
item.author: Zihao Zhang, Aming Wu, Yang Li, Yahong Han, Jialie Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于超图的点云分割框架，用于新颖类别发现。

背景: 现有方法主要依赖成对关联进行类别分配和新颖类别推理，限制了捕捉已知与新颖类别间复杂关系的能力，可能导致语义分割不准确。

目的: 解决现有方法在捕捉复杂关系和利用几何信息方面的不足，提高新颖类别发现的准确性。

方法: 引入基于超图的框架以建模类别间的高阶关联，实现从已知类别到新颖类别的协同推理；提出几何感知原型以增强类别级几何线索的表示，并通过超边传播几何信息以改善对空间分布的理解。

主要发现: 在SemanticKITTI和SemanticPOSS数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效且优越。

结论: 基于超图的框架结合几何感知原型能有效提升点云分割中新颖类别发现的性能。

翻译: Novel class discovery in point cloud segmentation aims to transfer knowledge from known classes to automatically identify and segment unlabeled novel classes in point clouds. Existing methods mainly rely on pairwise associations for class assignment and novel class reasoning, which limits their ability to capture complex relationships among known and novel classes and may lead to inaccurate semantic segmentation. To address this issue, we introduce a hypergraph-based framework that models high-order associations among classes and enables collaborative reasoning from known classes to novel classes beyond traditional pairwise relations. Moreover, existing methods tend to focus on semantic feature extraction while paying insufficient attention to geometric information in point clouds. To better exploit spatial structure, we propose Geometric-Aware Prototypes to enhance the representation of class-level geometric cues. By propagating geometric information through hyperedges, the proposed method improves the understanding of spatial distributions across classes and leads to more accurate segmentation. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI and SemanticPOSS datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决在点云分割任务中如何仅依靠已知类别的知识自动发现并准确分割未知新类别的问题。现有方法通常只依赖类别间的两两关联且过度关注语义信息而忽略三维几何特征，导致分割精度受限。该问题在自动驾驶和智能机器人等开放世界场景中至关重要，因为现实环境中的目标类别不断涌现，模型必须具备自动识别和理解未见类别的能力，才能突破传统方法的局限并提升实际应用价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法仅依赖类间二元关联且过度关注语义信息而忽视几何特征的不足，提出引入超图结构来建模类间的高阶关联，并设计了几何感知原型以增强空间信息捕捉能力。该方法借鉴了早期点云新颖类发现工作的聚类与区域一致性思路，但通过超边连接多个原型实现协同推理，并加入动态超边调整机制以优化训练过程。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用超图结构建模多个类别之间的高阶关联，并结合几何感知原型捕捉点云的空间与语义特征，从而实现从已知类别到未知类别的协同推理。整体流程首先通过特征提取与聚类生成融合几何与语义信息的原型节点，随后依据几何与语义相似度将多个相似原型连接成超边构建超图，最后通过动态调整超边结构持续优化类别关联，完成新类别的发现与分割。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于引入超图结构来建模多个类别之间的高阶关联，并提出了几何感知原型以强化对三维空间几何特征的提取。与以往依赖成对关系或仅侧重语义信息的方法不同，该方法通过超边连接多个相似类别，实现了从已知类别到未知类别的协同推理。此外，论文还设计了动态超边调整机制，能够根据训练过程中的特征变化实时更新连接结构，从而有效缓解类别不平衡问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种结合几何感知原型与超图结构的点云分割新方法，通过建模已知类别与未知类别之间的高阶关联并深度融合几何与语义特征，有效克服了传统方法仅依赖二元关系和忽视三维几何信息的局限，显著提升了新类别发现与分割的精度。

Abstract

Novel class discovery in point cloud segmentation aims to transfer knowledge from known classes to automatically identify and segment unlabeled novel classes in point clouds. Existing methods mainly rely on pairwise associations for class assignment and novel class reasoning, which limits their ability to capture complex relationships among known and novel classes and may lead to inaccurate semantic segmentation. To address this issue, we introduce a hypergraph-based framework that models high-order associations among classes and enables collaborative reasoning from known classes to novel classes beyond traditional pairwise relations. Moreover, existing methods tend to focus on semantic feature extraction while paying insufficient attention to geometric information in point clouds. To better exploit spatial structure, we propose Geometric-Aware Prototypes to enhance the representation of class-level geometric cues. By propagating geometric information through hyperedges, the proposed method improves the understanding of spatial distributions across classes and leads to more accurate segmentation. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI and SemanticPOSS datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method.

item.title: TargetSEC: Plug-and-Play In-the-Wild Speech Emotion Conversion via Arousal-Conditioned Latent Style Diffusion
item.author: Constantin Alexander Auga
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Speech Emotion Conversion (SEC) 旨在转换源语音的情感，同时保留内容和说话人身份。

背景: 在野外数据上进行 SEC 具有挑战性，因为训练数据是非平行的，且现实世界的声学环境复杂。现有的固定时长方法要么难以有效转换情感（高质量，低转换率），要么会降低语音的自然度（低质量，高转换率）。

目的: 提出 TargetSEC，一种基于嵌入的潜在扩散框架，以生成专注于情感的风格嵌入，并基于说话人身份和连续情感进行条件控制。

方法: TargetSEC 在紧凑的潜在空间中运行，而不是在频谱图上扩散。

主要发现: 在 MSP-Podcast 数据集上的实验表明，TargetSEC 在转换准确率方面优于当前的非时长基线方法，同时保持了高质量的语音，并且实现了与无需显式时间建模的时长预测系统相当的性能。

结论: TargetSEC 在情感转换和语音质量方面表现出色，为 SEC 提供了一种有效的解决方案。

翻译: Speech Emotion Conversion (SEC) aims to transform the emotion of a source utterance into a target emotion while preserving content and speaker identity. SEC on in-the-wild data is challenging due to the non-parallel nature of training data and complex real-world acoustics. Existing fixed-duration approaches either struggle to shift the emotion effectively (high quality, low conversion) or degrade speech naturalness (low quality, high conversion). We propose TargetSEC, an embedding-driven latent diffusion framework that generates emotion-focused style embeddings conditioned on speaker identity and continuous emotion. Unlike methods that diffuse over spectrograms, TargetSEC operates in a compact latent space. Experiments on the MSP-Podcast dataset show that TargetSEC outperforms current non-duration baselines in conversion accuracy while maintaining high speech quality, and achieves performance comparable to duration-prediction systems without explicit temporal modeling.

Abstract

Speech Emotion Conversion (SEC) aims to transform the emotion of a source utterance into a target emotion while preserving content and speaker identity. SEC on in-the-wild data is challenging due to the non-parallel nature of training data and complex real-world acoustics. Existing fixed-duration approaches either struggle to shift the emotion effectively (high quality, low conversion) or degrade speech naturalness (low quality, high conversion). We propose TargetSEC, an embedding-driven latent diffusion framework that generates emotion-focused style embeddings conditioned on speaker identity and continuous emotion. Unlike methods that diffuse over spectrograms, TargetSEC operates in a compact latent space. Experiments on the MSP-Podcast dataset show that TargetSEC outperforms current non-duration baselines in conversion accuracy while maintaining high speech quality, and achieves performance comparable to duration-prediction systems without explicit temporal modeling.

item.title: SWE-Explore: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Explore Repositories
item.author: Zhang, Shaoqiu, Wang, Yuhang, Liang, Jialiang, Shi, Yuling, Zeng, Wenhao, Wang, Maoquan, He, Shilin, Xu, Ningyuan, Ye, Siyu, Cai, Kai, Gu, Xiaodong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了SWE-Explore基准测试，旨在隔离评估代码代理在仓库探索方面的关键能力。该基准测试要求代理在固定行数预算下，针对给定仓库和问题返回相关代码区域的排名列表。评估结果显示，这些指标与下游修复行为高度相关。研究发现，代理探索器在性能上明显优于传统检索方法，而文件级定位已较为成熟，行级覆盖率和高效排名仍是区分最先进探索器的关键维度。

背景: 以SWE-bench为代表的仓库级编码基准测试推动了代码代理能力的快速提升，但这些基准测试通常将编码任务视为整体性的二元预测问题（如解决或未解决），忽视了代码代理在仓库理解、上下文检索、代码定位和错误诊断等方面的细粒度能力。

目的: 引入SWE-Explore基准测试，以隔离并评估代码代理在仓库探索这一关键能力上的表现。

方法: SWE-Explore涵盖跨10种编程语言和203个开源仓库的848个问题。对于每个实例，通过独立代理轨迹成功解决同一问题的情况，提取其解决方案路径实际 consulted 的具体代码区域，从而生成行级真实标签。评估维度包括覆盖率、排名和上下文效率。

主要发现: 评估指标与下游修复行为高度相关。在广泛的检索方法、通用代码代理和专用定位器中，代理探索器形成明显优于传统检索的层级。现代方法在文件级定位方面已经表现强劲，而行级覆盖率和高效排名仍是区分最先进探索器的关键维度。

结论: SWE-Explore为评估代码代理的仓库探索能力提供了有效基准，揭示了当前最先进探索器在行级覆盖和排名效率方面的优势，同时指出了文件级定位已相对成熟。

翻译: Repository-level coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench have driven a rapid surge in the capabilities of coding agents. Yet they usually treat coding tasks as a holistic, binary prediction problem (e.g., resolved or unresolved), neglecting fine-grained agent capabilities such as repository understanding, context retrieval, code localization, and bug diagnosis. In this paper, we introduce SWE-Explore, a benchmark that isolates the evaluation of repository exploration, a critical capability of coding agents. Given a repository and an issue, SWE-Explore asks an explorer to return a ranked list of relevant code regions under a fixed line budget. SWE-Explore covers 848 issues across 10 programming languages and 203 open-source repositories. For each instance, we derive line-level ground truth from independent agent trajectories that successfully solved the same issue, distilling the specific code regions their solution paths actually consulted. We evaluate exploration along coverage, ranking, and context-efficiency dimensions, showing that these metrics strongly track downstream repair behavior. Across a broad set of retrieval methods, general coding agents, and specialized localizers, we find that agentic explorers form a clear tier above classical retrieval. While file-level localization is already strong for modern methods, line-level coverage and efficient ranking remain the key axes differentiating state-of-the-art explorers.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决现有代码智能体评估仅关注最终修复结果，而忽略了智能体在仓库探索、上下文检索和代码定位等细粒度能力的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为大型代码仓库包含海量文件，智能体能否准确找到并阅读关键代码行直接决定了修复成功率。现有的单一通过或不通过评分掩盖了失败的具体环节，导致难以针对性地优化智能体的探索机制。通过独立评估探索能力，可以更精准地衡量和推动代码智能体核心能力的发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者指出传统代码智能体基准测试仅关注最终修复结果，无法区分失败是源于代码探索不足还是代码生成错误。因此他们设计了一种独立评估仓库探索能力的方法，要求模型在限定行数内返回相关代码区域的排名列表，并利用多个成功解决同一问题的智能体运行轨迹交叉提取行级标准答案。该设计借鉴了现有代码基准的验证框架以及传统检索和智能体定位技术，但通过引入轨迹驱动的细粒度监督与下游上下文验证协议，弥补了现有工作缺乏统一行级探索评估标准的不足。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将代码仓库探索能力从完整的修复流程中独立出来，将其定义为在固定行数预算下对相关问题代码区域进行排序和检索的评估任务。整体流程首先筛选出拥有至少两条成功修复记录的实例，接着通过提取并交叉比对不同成功模型的实际读取记录来自动生成并人工校验核心代码区域作为标准答案。随后，让待测模型根据问题返回排序后的代码区域列表，并基于覆盖率、排序位置和预算效率等指标进行打分。最后，将打分结果作为唯一上下文输入固定修复模型，验证探索质量是否确实能提升最终的问题修复成功率。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次将代码仓库探索能力从完整的修复流程中独立出来，定义为按行级别的上下文选择任务。它提出了一种基于成功编程代理运行轨迹自动生成行级标准答案的方法，大幅降低了人工标注成本。与以往仅关注最终修复是否成功的基准不同，该工作通过覆盖度、排序效率和预算效率等指标，精准评估编程代理在编写代码前定位关键代码行的能力，并验证了这些探索指标与下游修复成功率的高度相关性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了SWE-Explore基准测试，将代码仓库探索能力从端到端修复任务中独立出来，定义为基于成功智能体轨迹标注的逐行上下文选择任务，并系统验证了相关评估指标对下游代码修复成功的预测能力。

Abstract

Repository-level coding benchmarks such as SWE-bench have driven a rapid surge in the capabilities of coding agents. Yet they usually treat coding tasks as a holistic, binary prediction problem (e.g., resolved or unresolved), neglecting fine-grained agent capabilities such as repository understanding, context retrieval, code localization, and bug diagnosis. In this paper, we introduce SWE-Explore, a benchmark that isolates the evaluation of repository exploration, a critical capability of coding agents. Given a repository and an issue, SWE-Explore asks an explorer to return a ranked list of relevant code regions under a fixed line budget. SWE-Explore covers 848 issues across 10 programming languages and 203 open-source repositories. For each instance, we derive line-level ground truth from independent agent trajectories that successfully solved the same issue, distilling the specific code regions their solution paths actually consulted. We evaluate exploration along coverage, ranking, and context-efficiency dimensions, showing that these metrics strongly track downstream repair behavior. Across a broad set of retrieval methods, general coding agents, and specialized localizers, we find that agentic explorers form a clear tier above classical retrieval. While file-level localization is already strong for modern methods, line-level coverage and efficient ranking remain the key axes differentiating state-of-the-art explorers.

item.title: DuMate-DeepResearch: An Auditable Multi-Agent System with Recursive Search and Rubric-Grounded Reasoning
item.author: Yan, Lingyong, Xu, Can, Zhao, Yukun, Li, Wenxuan, Chen, Qingyang, Wu, Jiulong, Song, Wenli, Li, Xiangnan, Shi, Weixian, Chen, Yiqun, Ma, Xuchen, Li, Yuchen, Zhao, Jiashu, Wang, Shuaiqiang, Wu, Jianmin, Yin, Dawei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: DuMate-DeepResearch是一个基于千帆智能体工厂的多智能体深度研究框架，通过解耦核心智能体与工具生态、引入动态规划策略、递归两级执行设计和基于量规的测试时优化机制，解决了当前深度研究系统在长程规划、任务分解、幻觉风险和过程可审计性方面的局限，并在两个基准测试中取得最优结果。

背景: 深度研究作为一种新的智能体范式，旨在解决复杂、开放式的研究任务，要求系统能够迭代地构建问题、获取证据、验证来源并综合长篇报告。然而，当前系统面临长程规划范围不明确、单智能体任务分解与调度的瓶颈、长篇综合中的幻觉风险以及过程可审计性有限等相互关联的局限。

目的: 提出DuMate-DeepResearch框架，以解决当前深度研究系统在规划、任务分解、幻觉风险和过程可审计性方面的局限，提升复杂研究任务的处理能力。

方法: 构建基于千帆智能体工厂的多智能体框架，解耦处理任务理解、规划和调度的核心智能体与负责检索、证据获取和报告渲染的工具生态，实现中间决策和工具调用的显式可追溯。引入三种机制：基于图的动态规划策略，通过反思、重新规划、回溯和并行分支不断细化研究路线图；递归两级执行设计，将复杂搜索子任务委托给内部搜索智能体，隔离噪声检索并稳定长程执行；基于量规的测试时优化机制，动态生成任务特定质量标准，作为证据支撑综合和自适应停止的推理支架。

主要发现: 在两个深度研究基准测试中，DuMate-DeepResearch取得了新的最先进结果：在DeepResearch Bench上获得最高总分58.03%，在DeepResearch Bench II上获得最高总分61.95%，并在信息召回和分析方面排名第一。

结论: DuMate-DeepResearch通过多智能体架构和三种创新机制，有效提升了深度研究系统在复杂任务处理中的性能、可审计性和结果质量，为未来深度研究系统的设计提供了新范式。

翻译: Deep Research (DR) has emerged as a new agentic paradigm to tackle complex, open-ended research tasks, demanding systems that can iteratively frame problems, acquire evidence, verify sources, and synthesize long-form reports. In practice, however, current DR systems are constrained by four interrelated limitations: long-horizon planning over an underspecified scope, the bottleneck of decomposing and scheduling such tasks within a single agent, hallucination risk in long-form synthesis, and limited process auditability. This technical report presents DuMate-DeepResearch, a multi-agent DR framework built on the Qianfan Agent Foundry. The framework decouples the Agent Core, which handles task understanding, planning, and scheduling, from an extensible Tool Ecosystem for retrieval, evidence acquisition, and report rendering, making every intermediate decision and tool invocation explicitly traceable. Building on this infrastructure, DuMate-DeepResearch further introduces three mechanisms: (i) a graph-based dynamic planning strategy expands the research roadmap coarse-to-fine and continuously revises it through reflection, re-planning, backtracking, and parallel branching; (ii) a recursive two-level execution design delegates each complex search sub-task to an inner Search Agent that runs its own planning loop, isolating noisy retrieval and stabilizing long-horizon execution; (iii) a rubric-based test-time optimization mechanism dynamically generates task-specific quality criteria and uses them as live reasoning scaffolds for evidence-grounded synthesis and adaptive stopping. Across two deep research benchmarks, DuMate-DeepResearch establishes new state-of-the-art results: the best overall score (58.03%) on DeepResearch Bench, and the best overall score (61.95%) on DeepResearch Bench II while ranking first in information recall and analysis.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有深度研究系统在长程规划、单智能体任务调度瓶颈、长文生成幻觉以及过程缺乏透明度方面的局限。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为深度研究旨在模拟人类严谨的学术调查流程，只有突破这些技术瓶颈，系统才能在复杂开放任务中稳定运行、确保事实准确，并提供透明可查的推理轨迹，从而真正满足高价值领域的实际应用与信任需求。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对当前深度研究系统在长程规划、单智能体调度、事实幻觉和过程不透明等方面的局限进行思考，设计了将核心推理与工具执行解耦的多智能体架构，并引入动态图规划、递归两级执行和量规引导推理三大机制以提升系统稳定性与过程可审计性。在设计过程中，作者借鉴并对比了单体架构、流水线工作流及现有智能体协作范式，同时明确区别于单步决策式推理与固定探索预算，最终基于千帆智能体工厂基础设施构建了该端到端研究框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将智能体的推理规划核心与工具执行层解耦，并借助动态规划图、递归双层执行机制以及动态生成的评价标准，实现可追溯、抗干扰且事实准确的深度研究。整体流程首先解析用户问题并生成研究大纲，随后进入循环迭代阶段，由规划模块动态调整研究路线，执行模块负责收集证据并反馈给系统，直至满足停止条件后，最终由写作模块综合所有证据生成完整报告。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点主要包括：将核心推理与工具执行解耦以实现全流程可审计；采用基于图的动态规划策略，支持全局长程规划与动态回溯调整，克服了传统单步推理的短视问题；设计递归双层执行架构，将复杂子任务交由内部智能体独立处理以隔离噪声；以及引入基于动态量表的推理支架机制，实现证据驱动的合成与自适应停止。相比以往工作，该系统打破了传统单体或线性流水线架构的局限，通过多智能体协作与全局动态规划，显著提升了复杂长程任务的全局视野、执行鲁棒性与事实准确性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种可审计的多智能体深度研究框架，通过解耦认知与工具架构、引入基于图的动态规划策略、递归双层执行设计以及基于评估标准的推理引导机制，有效解决了长程规划、任务分解与事实核查难题，并在多项基准测试中取得了最优性能。

Abstract

Deep Research (DR) has emerged as a new agentic paradigm to tackle complex, open-ended research tasks, demanding systems that can iteratively frame problems, acquire evidence, verify sources, and synthesize long-form reports. In practice, however, current DR systems are constrained by four interrelated limitations: long-horizon planning over an underspecified scope, the bottleneck of decomposing and scheduling such tasks within a single agent, hallucination risk in long-form synthesis, and limited process auditability. This technical report presents DuMate-DeepResearch, a multi-agent DR framework built on the Qianfan Agent Foundry. The framework decouples the Agent Core, which handles task understanding, planning, and scheduling, from an extensible Tool Ecosystem for retrieval, evidence acquisition, and report rendering, making every intermediate decision and tool invocation explicitly traceable. Building on this infrastructure, DuMate-DeepResearch further introduces three mechanisms: (i) a graph-based dynamic planning strategy expands the research roadmap coarse-to-fine and continuously revises it through reflection, re-planning, backtracking, and parallel branching; (ii) a recursive two-level execution design delegates each complex search sub-task to an inner Search Agent that runs its own planning loop, isolating noisy retrieval and stabilizing long-horizon execution; (iii) a rubric-based test-time optimization mechanism dynamically generates task-specific quality criteria and uses them as live reasoning scaffolds for evidence-grounded synthesis and adaptive stopping. Across two deep research benchmarks, DuMate-DeepResearch establishes new state-of-the-art results: the best overall score (58.03%) on DeepResearch Bench, and the best overall score (61.95%) on DeepResearch Bench II while ranking first in information recall and analysis.

item.title: Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence: Explanatory Insufficiency as a Driver of Representation Learning and World Models
item.author: Jacques Raynal, Pierre Slangen, Elsa Raynal, Jacques Margerit
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出表征涌现的自举理论，探讨在现有表征无法解释新现象时，新表征如何产生。

背景: 表征学习是现代机器学习的核心，但现有研究多关注表征优化，较少关注何时需要新的表征层级。

目的: 引入自举理论以描述当现有表征在解释力上不足时，新表征如何产生。

方法: 通过五个阶段形式化表征涌现过程：稳定观察、异常检测、解释不足识别、表征涌现和临时稳定。

主要发现: 解释不足是表征转换的积极信号，表征创新由持续的解释缺口驱动，而非仅由数据或算力驱动。

结论: 未来人工智能系统可能需要检测自身内部表征解释极限的机制。

翻译: Representation learning is central to modern machine learning, enabling transitions from handcrafted features to learned embeddings, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, and digital twins. Yet most research examines how representations are optimized after a representational framework has been selected, while less attention is given to when a new level of representation becomes necessary. We introduce the Bootstrap Theory of Representational Emergence (TBER), a framework describing how new representations arise when existing ones become explanatorily insufficient. In this view, representational innovation is not only driven by more data, larger models, or greater computational power, but also by persistent explanatory gaps: situations in which a representation can still describe observations but can no longer make their organization or transformations intelligible. TBER identifies explanatory insufficiency as a positive signal for representational transition. A representation becomes insufficient not because it is necessarily false, but because its explanatory domain has been exceeded. The bootstrap dynamic follows a recursive sequence: observations reveal anomalies; anomalies expose insufficiencies; insufficiencies motivate new representations; and these new representations generate further observations and possible new insufficiencies.We formalize this process through five stages: stabilized observation, anomaly detection, recognition of explanatory insufficiency, representational emergence, and provisional stabilization. We discuss applications to representation learning, latent spaces, foundation models, world models, digital twins, adaptive biological systems, and scientific discovery. TBER suggests that future AI systems may benefit from mechanisms for detecting the explanatory limits of their own internal representations.

TBER suggests that future AI systems may benefit from mechanisms for detecting the explanatory limits of their own internal representations.

item.title: Skeletal-Anchored Dual Harmonics for Structured 3D Modeling
item.author: Zhentao Huang, Changhao Li, Ruizhen Hu, Hui Huang, Minglun Gong
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为骨架锚定双谐波的新型三维形状表示方法，该方法将局部表面几何与内部介观骨骼组织紧密耦合。

背景: 现有的各向同性基元如中轴球或高斯核无法直接编码各向异性的局部表面几何及自适应空间支持，难以紧凑表示细节丰富且方向变化的表面区域。

目的: 实现复杂三维形状的高精度表面重建，同时保持紧凑且连贯的骨骼组织结构。

方法: 将形状表示为一系列锚定于内部优化锚点的紧凑表面块集合。每个表面块使用双通道球谐函数进行参数化，一个通道建模局部径向几何，另一个通道通过广义视锥定义自适应块支持。从无序点云开始，通过分阶段优化过程联合优化表面几何、锚点位置、块方向及结构连通性，并利用测地线锚点图保留相邻块之间的结构关系。

主要发现: 在复杂三维形状上的实验表明，该方法能够在广泛的几何形状范围内实现准确的表面重建，并生成紧凑且连贯的介观骨骼结构。

结论: 该方法通过紧密耦合局部表面几何与内部介观骨骼组织，有效解决了复杂形状表示中的细节保留与结构连贯性问题。

翻译: We present Skeletal-Anchored Dual Harmonics (SADH), a novel 3D shape representation that tightly couples local surface geometry with internal meso-skeletal organization. SADH represents a shape as a collection of compact surface patches rooted on internal anchors optimized directly inside the object volume. Each patch is parameterized using a dual-channel spherical harmonic (SH) formulation, where one channel models local radial geometry while the other defines adaptive patch support through a generalized viewing cone. Unlike isotropic primitives such as medial spheres or Gaussian kernels, SH patches directly encode anisotropic local surface geometry together with adaptive spatial support, enabling compact representation of detailed and directionally varying surface regions. Starting from unorganized point clouds, SADH jointly optimizes surface geometry, anchor locations, patch orientations, and structural connectivity through a staged optimization process that progressively forms a coherent meso-skeletal structure. A geodesic anchor graph further preserves structural relationships between neighboring patches. Experiments on complex 3D shapes demonstrate that SADH achieves accurate surface reconstruction together with compact and coherent skeletal organization across a wide range of geometries.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有三维形状表示方法通常只关注外部表面几何，而缺乏对物体内部结构组织显式建模的问题。该问题在研究和应用中非常重要，因为缺乏内部结构信息会导致生成的模型难以支持形变、动画制作和拓扑感知编辑等下游任务。通过同时建模局部表面几何与内部骨架结构，该方法能够提供更紧凑、连贯且易于处理的三维形状抽象，从而提升三维数据处理的整体效率与实用性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有三维表示方法侧重外部表面而缺乏内部结构、或结构提取与表面参数化脱节的问题，提出了将局部表面几何与内部骨架组织紧密结合的设计思路。该方法广泛借鉴了基于几何图元分解、隐式与图块建模以及中间骨架提取等领域的现有成果，继承了锚定球谐参数化的紧凑特性，并吸收了骨架提取中的全局覆盖优化思想。在此基础上，作者设计了双通道球谐参数化来同时刻画局部表面几何与自适应支撑范围，并通过分阶段优化策略联合调整表面几何、内部锚点位置、图块方向与结构连通性，从而自动生成连贯的三维骨架结构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将三维形状表示为一系列以内部锚点为根节点的紧凑局部表面片，利用双通道球谐函数同时刻画局部径向几何与自适应支撑范围，从而在统一框架下紧密耦合外部表面细节与内部骨架结构。整体实现流程从无序点云出发，先在表面下方初始化少量锚点并关联局部表面片；随后通过分阶段优化迭代调整表面几何、锚点位置、表面片朝向与支撑范围，并将生成的表面点与输入点云匹配以建立归属关系；在此过程中锚点逐渐沉入物体内部形成连贯骨架，高误差区域会自适应插入新锚点，最终构建出覆盖完整表面且结构连贯的紧凑表示。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种将局部表面几何与内部骨架结构紧密耦合的三维形状表示方法。它利用双通道球谐函数对内部锚点周围的表面区域进行参数化，分别建模局部径向几何与自适应的空间支持范围。与以往主要关注外部表面重建或仅提取孤立骨架的工作不同，该方法通过分阶段优化联合生成表面几何、锚点位置及结构连通性，能够紧凑且准确地表示各向异性的复杂表面区域，并自然支持形变与动画等下游任务。

item.title: Watch, Remember, Reason: Human-View Video Understanding with MLLMs
item.author: Jiahao Meng, Yue Tan, Qi Xu, Kuan Gao, Weisong Liu, Yanwei Li, Jason Li, Lingdong Kong, Haochen Wang, Qianyu Zhou, Jiangning Zhang, Guangliang Cheng, Yunhai Tong, Lu Qi, Minghsuan Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文从人类视角出发，对基于大语言模型的视觉理解进行了系统性综述，围绕观看、记忆和推理三项核心功能能力，构建了统一分析框架，并探讨了相关挑战、代表性方法、应用领域及未来方向。

背景: 多模态大语言模型正在迅速改变视频理解领域，研究重点正从短片转向长视频、多模态及知识密集型场景。这些场景要求模型在有限计算预算下处理稀疏证据、长距离依赖、多模态对齐及可靠推理。

目的: 提供基于大语言模型的视觉理解的人类视角，通过观看、记忆和推理三项功能能力构建统一结构，分析视觉多模态大语言模型如何获取证据、保留上下文并生成基于证据的输出。

方法: 引入一种形式化表述，通过感知表征、记忆状态、推理轨迹和最终预测来刻画视觉理解系统。将代表性方法按其在视觉多模态大语言模型系统中的角色进行分类，涵盖感知、记忆和推理三个层面。

主要发现: 识别出时空感知、高效长视频处理、记忆建模、流式理解和忠实推理等方面的挑战。将方法分为观看（细粒度、全面、视听及高效感知）、记忆（离线和流式记忆）和推理（纯文本推理及结合视频的推理）。还考察了自我中心、体育、教学、医疗和叙事视频等应用领域，以及相关的训练数据集和评估基准。

结论: 指出了可扩展、记忆感知及基于证据的视觉智能领域的开放问题和未来研究方向。

翻译: Video understanding is being rapidly transformed by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as research moves from short clips to long, multimodal, and knowledge-intensive video scenarios. These scenarios require models to handle sparse evidence, long-range dependencies, multimodal alignment, and reliable inference under limited computational budgets. This work presents a human-view perspective on LLM-based video understanding, organized around three functional abilities: watching, remembering, and reasoning. Rather than treating video tasks as isolated benchmarks, this view provides a unified structure for analyzing how video MLLMs acquire evidence, preserve context, and produce grounded outputs. We introduce a formulation that characterizes video understanding systems by their perceptual representations, memory states, reasoning traces, and final predictions. Based on this formulation, we identify challenges in spatio-temporal perception, efficient long-video processing, memory modeling, streaming understanding, and faithful reasoning. Representative methods are organized by their roles in video MLLM systems. Watching covers fine-grained, comprehensive, audio-visual, and efficient perception. Remembering includes offline and streaming memory, while reasoning covers text-only reasoning and thinking with videos. We further examine application domains such as egocentric, sports, instructional, medical, and narrative videos, and cover training datasets and evaluation benchmarks across task types, supervision formats, modalities, and capability dimensions. Finally, we outline open problems and future directions for scalable, memory-aware, and evidence-grounded video intelligence. Related works will be continuously traced at https://github.com/marinero4972/Awesome-HumanView-VideoUnderstanding.

Abstract

Video understanding is being rapidly transformed by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as research moves from short clips to long, multimodal, and knowledge-intensive video scenarios. These scenarios require models to handle sparse evidence, long-range dependencies, multimodal alignment, and reliable inference under limited computational budgets. Rather than treating video tasks as isolated benchmarks, this view provides a unified structure for analyzing how video MLLMs acquire evidence, preserve context, and produce grounded outputs. We introduce a formulation that characterizes video understanding systems by their perceptual representations, memory states, reasoning traces, and final predictions. Based on this formulation, we identify challenges in spatio-temporal perception, efficient long-video processing, memory modeling, streaming understanding, and faithful reasoning. Representative methods are organized by their roles in video MLLM systems. Watching covers fine-grained, comprehensive, audio-visual, and efficient perception. Remembering includes offline and streaming memory, while reasoning covers text-only reasoning and thinking with videos. We further examine application domains such as egocentric, sports, instructional, medical, and narrative videos, and cover training datasets and evaluation benchmarks across task types, supervision formats, modalities, and capability dimensions. Finally, we outline open problems and future directions for scalable, memory-aware, and evidence-grounded video intelligence. Related works will be continuously traced at https://github.com/marinero4972/Awesome-HumanView-VideoUnderstanding.

item.title: Skill-3D: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic 3D Spatial Reasoning
item.author: Haoyuan Li, Zhengdong Hu, Jun Wang, Hehe Fan, Yi Yang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了智能体3D空间理解，即多模态大语言模型智能体通过工具使用进行3D推理。现有方法在3D场景下常误用工具且存在偏好偏差，导致智能体范式相比非智能体策略仅带来微小提升。

背景: 现有方法在3D场景下经常误用工具，并表现出有偏见的工具偏好，使得智能体范式相比非智能体策略仅带来边际收益。

目的: 解决现有智能体在所有场景中应用统一工具使用策略而非根据特定场景和任务选择工具的问题，提升3D空间推理中的工具利用率。

方法: 提出Skill-3D框架，学习自演化的场景感知技能。该框架将任务场景和智能体的工具使用轨迹记录到场景记忆中，将相似场景的成功轨迹聚合并提炼为可重用的场景感知技能，并将失败轨迹作为教训附加。训练时，当遇到相似场景时注入相应技能引导智能体，新轨迹的成功与失败进一步精炼技能，形成记忆与技能库共同演化的循环。

主要发现: Skill-3D显著提高了3D空间推理中的工具利用率（在VSI-Bench上从39%提升至78%），推动智能体进行正确且充分的工具使用。例如，在MMSI-Bench上使Gemini-3-Flash提升了67%。此外，对技能引导轨迹进行智能体后训练，使Qwen3-VL-8B在VSI-Bench上提升了43%。

结论: Skill-3D框架通过自演化的场景感知技能显著提升了智能体在3D空间推理任务中的工具利用能力和整体性能。

翻译: This paper explores agentic 3D spatial understanding, i.e., MLLM agents performing 3D reasoning through tool use. Existing methods often misuse tools and exhibit biased tool preferences under 3D scenarios, leaving the agentic paradigm with only marginal gains over non-agentic strategies. We reveal that 3D spatial reasoning tasks are heterogeneous across scenes, while these agents apply a uniform tool-use strategy to all scenes rather than selecting tools according to the specific scene and task. To address this, we propose Skill-3D, a framework that learns self-evolving scene-aware skills. Specifically, Skill-3D identifies the task scene and records the agent's tool-use trajectory into a Scene Memory, where successful trajectories from similar scenes are aggregated and distilled into a reusable scene-aware skill, with failed ones attached to the skill as lessons. During training, once a similar scene recurs, the corresponding skill is injected to guide the agent, producing new trajectories whose successes and failures further refine the skill, forming a loop in which the memory and the skill library co-evolve. Experiments show that Skill-3D substantially improves tool utilization in 3D spatial reasoning (from 39% to 78% on VSI-Bench), driving the agent toward correct and sufficient tool use. For instance, it improves Gemini-3-Flash by 67% on MMSI-Bench. Furthermore, we conduct agentic post-training over skill-guided trajectories, which boosts Qwen3-VL-8B by 43% on VSI-Bench.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有三维空间推理智能体在调用外部工具时策略单一、容易误用工具的问题。由于不同场景所需的证据和工具流程差异很大，统一调用策略会导致推理效果提升有限。解决这一问题对于让智能体真正掌握三维空间理解能力至关重要，能够显著提升其在机器人导航、室内分析等实际场景中的工具使用效率和推理准确性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到现有方法在三维空间推理中常因忽视场景差异而错误调用工具，因此设计了能根据具体场景动态匹配工具策略的框架。该方法通过记录智能体的交互轨迹，将成功经验提炼为可复用的场景技能，并将失败案例作为教训，使技能库与场景记忆在循环中共同进化。在借鉴方面，作者参考了基于经验记忆的代理机制和通用技能提取技术，但针对三维空间推理中复杂的几何与多视角证据需求进行了专门改进，并结合监督微调与强化学习优化模型。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是让智能体根据具体场景动态选择工具，通过构建场景记忆与技能库，将成功经验提炼为可复用的场景感知技能，并将失败案例作为教训实现两者共同进化。整体流程包含四个阶段：首先记录智能体完成任务的轨迹并存储至场景记忆；其次将成功经验提炼为技能、失败经验作为教训，动态更新技能库；接着在新任务中识别场景特征并检索匹配的技能，以此指导智能体的工具调用与证据收集；最后利用这些技能引导的轨迹对模型进行监督微调与强化学习，使模型内化场景感知的工具使用行为。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种自进化场景感知技能框架，通过构建场景记忆库并协同更新技能库，使智能体能根据具体三维场景动态选择工具。与以往工作普遍采用固定工具策略或仅关注通用任务不同，该方法专门针对三维空间推理中场景差异大的问题，将成功路径提炼为可复用技能，并将失败经验作为教训进行修正，实现了记忆与技能的共同进化。此外，论文还引入了技能引导的强化学习训练机制，进一步将场景感知的工具使用行为内化到模型策略中。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为Skill-3D的框架，通过构建场景记忆并协同进化场景感知技能库，使智能体能够根据具体场景动态调用工具，从而显著提升三维空间推理任务中的工具使用效率与推理准确率。

Abstract

This paper explores agentic 3D spatial understanding, i.e., MLLM agents performing 3D reasoning through tool use. Existing methods often misuse tools and exhibit biased tool preferences under 3D scenarios, leaving the agentic paradigm with only marginal gains over non-agentic strategies. We reveal that 3D spatial reasoning tasks are heterogeneous across scenes, while these agents apply a uniform tool-use strategy to all scenes rather than selecting tools according to the specific scene and task. To address this, we propose Skill-3D, a framework that learns self-evolving scene-aware skills. Specifically, Skill-3D identifies the task scene and records the agent's tool-use trajectory into a Scene Memory, where successful trajectories from similar scenes are aggregated and distilled into a reusable scene-aware skill, with failed ones attached to the skill as lessons. During training, once a similar scene recurs, the corresponding skill is injected to guide the agent, producing new trajectories whose successes and failures further refine the skill, forming a loop in which the memory and the skill library co-evolve. Experiments show that Skill-3D substantially improves tool utilization in 3D spatial reasoning (from 39% to 78% on VSI-Bench), driving the agent toward correct and sufficient tool use. For instance, it improves Gemini-3-Flash by 67% on MMSI-Bench. Furthermore, we conduct agentic post-training over skill-guided trajectories, which boosts Qwen3-VL-8B by 43% on VSI-Bench.

item.title: Re-imagining ISO 26262 in the Age of Autonomous Vehicles: Enhancing Controllability through Transferability and Predictability
item.author: Chaitanya Shinde, Hadi Hajieghrary, Paul Schmitt, Adam Shoemaker, Bodo Seifert, Steve Kenner
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对自动驾驶汽车缺乏人类驾驶员的情况，重新审视了ISO 26262标准中的可控性原则，将其分解为可审计的两个维度：可转移性和可预测性。

背景: ISO 26262标准基于严重性、暴露性和可控性进行风险评估，其基础是人类驾驶车辆的范式。在自动驾驶汽车中，由于缺乏人类驾驶员，需要重新审视这些原则。

目的: 将ISO 26262中的可控性占位符分解为两个可审计的证据维度，以扩展该标准在无人驾驶自动化系统（SAE 4级和5级）中的适用性。

方法: 引入两个可测量的子概念：可转移性（捕捉自动驾驶系统向备用安全机制移交控制的能力）和可预测性（捕捉外部代理预测自动驾驶行为的能力）。从人机交互原则出发正式定义可预测性，并提供数学框架进行量化。引入设计-可实现差距以区分架构备用声明与场景条件可实现备用能力。

主要发现: 提出的指标与ISO 26262和ISO/PAS 21448（SOTIF）一致，使备用和交互声明在运行设计域切片中可证伪且可追溯。这些维度补充而非替代现有标准。

结论: 增强后的标准保留了ISO 26262的结构，同时扩展了其适用性至SAE 4级和5级的无人驾驶自动化系统。

翻译: The ISO 26262 standard defines functional safety for road vehicles through risk assessments based on Severity, Exposure, and Controllability, grounded in a human-driven vehicle paradigm. In the context of autonomous vehicles (AVs), the absence of a human driver necessitates revisiting these principles. This paper decomposes the Controllability placeholder into two auditable evidence dimensions of ISO 26262 by introducing two measurable sub-concepts: Transferability and Predictability. Transferability extends Controllability to capture AV systems' ability to hand off control to dedicated fallback safety mechanisms, while Predictability captures how easily external agents can anticipate AV behavior. Predictability is formally defined from human-robot interaction-inspired principles, and a mathematical framework is provided to quantify it. A designed-versus-achievable gap is introduced to distinguish architectural fallback claims from scene-conditioned achievable fallback capability. The proposed metrics align with ISO 26262 and ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF), rendering fallback and interaction claims falsifiable and traceable across ODD slices. These dimensions complement rather than replace existing standards, and the enhancements preserve the structure of ISO 26262 while extending its applicability to driverless automated systems operating at SAE Levels 4 and 5.

Abstract

The ISO 26262 standard defines functional safety for road vehicles through risk assessments based on Severity, Exposure, and Controllability, grounded in a human-driven vehicle paradigm. In the context of autonomous vehicles (AVs), the absence of a human driver necessitates revisiting these principles. This paper decomposes the Controllability placeholder into two auditable evidence dimensions of ISO 26262 by introducing two measurable sub-concepts: Transferability and Predictability. Transferability extends Controllability to capture AV systems' ability to hand off control to dedicated fallback safety mechanisms, while Predictability captures how easily external agents can anticipate AV behavior. Predictability is formally defined from human-robot interaction-inspired principles, and a mathematical framework is provided to quantify it. A designed-versus-achievable gap is introduced to distinguish architectural fallback claims from scene-conditioned achievable fallback capability. The proposed metrics align with ISO 26262 and ISO/PAS 21448 (SOTIF), rendering fallback and interaction claims falsifiable and traceable across ODD slices. These dimensions complement rather than replace existing standards, and the enhancements preserve the structure of ISO 26262 while extending its applicability to driverless automated systems operating at SAE Levels 4 and 5.

item.title: Implicit Data Synthesis for Contrastive Unsupervised Data Augmentation
item.author: Patrick Kage, Trevor Hedges, N. Siddharth, Pavlos Andreadis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种通过扰动网络权重而非原始数据来生成对比样本的方法，以更好地保留科学观测数据的结构，并在气象雷达观测数据上验证了该方法的有效性。

背景: 科学观测产生大量未标记数据，手动标注成本高昂，因此无监督学习技术具有重要价值。对比学习是一种从非标注数据中提取结构表示的有效方法。对于自然图像，通常使用数据空间增强方法生成合成样本，但科学观测数据的数据空间扰动可能会根本性地改变底层数据。

目的: 提出一种新的对比样本生成方法，通过扰动网络权重而不是底层数据，以更紧密地保留数据的结构。

方法: 提出一种基于网络权重扰动的对比样本生成方法，并将其应用于基于SimCLR的管道中，针对气象雷达观测数据进行处理。

主要发现: 在匹配的协议下，该方法在气象雷达观测数据上展示了性能提升。

结论: 通过扰动网络权重生成对比样本的方法能够有效保留科学观测数据的结构，并在特定任务中取得更好的性能。

翻译: Scientific observations generate large quantities of unlabeled data which is laborious to hand-label, making unsupervised learning techniques valuable for processing datasets. Among these approaches, contrastive learning provides a convenient mechanism for extracting structural representations from unannotated datasets. For natural imagery, the general approach is to use a variety of data-space augmentation methods in order to generate synthetic samples; however, for scientific observations data-space perturbations can fundamentally alter the underlying data. Our proposed method is to generate contrastive samples by perturbing the network weights rather than the underlying data, thus more closely preserving the structure of the data. We demonstrate this technique using a SimCLR-based pipeline applied over radar observations of meteors, and show performance gains under matched protocols.

Abstract

Scientific observations generate large quantities of unlabeled data which is laborious to hand-label, making unsupervised learning techniques valuable for processing datasets. Among these approaches, contrastive learning provides a convenient mechanism for extracting structural representations from unannotated datasets. For natural imagery, the general approach is to use a variety of data-space augmentation methods in order to generate synthetic samples; however, for scientific observations data-space perturbations can fundamentally alter the underlying data. Our proposed method is to generate contrastive samples by perturbing the network weights rather than the underlying data, thus more closely preserving the structure of the data. We demonstrate this technique using a SimCLR-based pipeline applied over radar observations of meteors, and show performance gains under matched protocols.

item.title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
item.author: Cong Chen, Guo Gan, Kaixiang Ji, ChaoYang Zhang, Zhen Yang, Guangming Yao, Hao Chen, Jingdong Chen, Yi Yuan, Chunhua Shen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MemDreamer 是一个用于长视频理解的即插即用框架，通过解耦感知与推理，将长视频理解转化为智能体探索过程。

背景: 当前的视觉语言模型在处理长达数小时的视频时，由于处理完整视觉序列会导致禁止性的令牌爆炸和注意力稀释，因此面临困难。

目的: 克服长视频处理中的令牌爆炸和注意力稀释问题，实现高效的长视频理解。

方法: 引入 MemDreamer 框架，构建分层图记忆，采用自顶向下的三层架构进行语义抽象，并在推理过程中使用智能体工具增强检索，通过观察-推理-行动循环导航层级、搜索节点和遍历逻辑边。

主要发现: MemDreamer 在四个主流基准测试中实现了最先进结果，将差距缩小至仅 3.7 分；推理上下文窗口限制为完整上下文输入的 2%，同时绝对准确率提升 12.5 分；视觉语言模型在逻辑推理和长视频理解基准测试上的性能存在强正线性相关。

结论: 智能体能力扩展为多模态理解建立了一种新范式。

翻译: 当前视觉语言模型在处理长达数小时的视频时面临困难，因为处理完整视觉序列会导致禁止性的令牌爆炸和注意力稀释。为克服这一问题，我们引入 MemDreamer 以解耦感知与推理，将长视频理解转化为智能体探索过程。作为一个即插即用框架，它逐步流式传输视频以构建分层图记忆，这是一种自顶向下的三层架构，用于语义抽象，并以捕捉时空和因果关系的基础图为基础。在推理过程中，推理模型采用智能体工具增强检索，通过观察-推理-行动循环导航层级、搜索节点和遍历逻辑边。实验表明，MemDreamer 在四个主流基准测试中实现了最先进结果，将差距缩小至仅 3.7 分。它将推理上下文窗口限制为完整上下文输入的 2%，同时绝对准确率提升 12.5 分。此外，统计分析揭示了视觉语言模型在逻辑推理和长视频理解基准测试上的性能之间存在强正线性相关，确立了智能体能力扩展作为多模态理解的新范式。

Abstract

Current Vision-Language Models struggle with hours-long videos because processing full-length visual sequences induces prohibitive token explosion and attention dilution. To overcome this, we introduce MemDreamer to decouple perception and reasoning, shifting long-video understanding into an agentic exploration process. As a plug-and-play framework, it incrementally streams videos to construct a Hierarchical Graph Memory, a top-down three-tier architecture for semantic abstraction, anchored by a foundational graph capturing spatiotemporal and causal relations. During inference, the reasoning model employs agentic tool-augmented retrieval, navigating hierarchies, searching nodes, and traversing logical edges via an Observation-Reason-Action loop. Experiments show MemDreamer achieves SOTA results across four mainstream benchmarks, narrowing the gap with human experts to only 3.7 points. It constrains the reasoning context window to merely 2% of full-context ingestion while delivering a 12.5 point absolute accuracy gain. Furthermore, statistical analysis uncovers a strong positive linear correlation between an VLM's performance on logic reasoning and long-video understanding benchmarks, establishing agentic capability scaling as a new paradigm for multimodal comprehension.

item.title: Eyes All Around: Design and Analysis of 360-Degree LiDAR Perception Using Equivariant Feature Learning in Unstructured Traffic
item.author: Pranav Darshan, Raghuveer Narayanan Rajesh, M Uttara Kumari
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了一种用于自动驾驶的三百六十度激光雷达感知流水线，重点关注全景感知、方位扇区空间处理和变换等变特征提取。

背景: 在密集且非结构化的城市交通中，由于道路使用者种类繁多、频繁遮挡、运动模式不规则以及缺乏标准化的道路布局，感知仍然是自动驾驶面临的主要挑战。尽管基于激光雷达的三维物体检测器在结构化驾驶场景中表现强劲，但大多数是为有限视场设置的，其在完整环绕三百六十度感知下的行为尚不清楚。

目的: 研究一种用于自动驾驶的三百六十度激光雷达感知流水线，特别是在复杂城市场景中的全景感知、方位扇区空间处理和变换等变特征提取。

方法: 提出了一种实用的三百六十度感知框架，将扇区全景处理与旋转等变稀疏卷积相结合，并在收集自多样化印度城市交通条件的自定义奥斯特OS零激光雷达数据集上评估其行为。

主要发现: 在多个物体类别中检测通常稳定，其中汽车检测性能最强，巴士和卡车次之，而行人、自行车手和摩托车手的得分较低，这反映了在密集城市场景中检测更小且变化更多的道路使用者的难度更大。

结论: 该框架在复杂城市场景中提供了稳定的检测能力，但检测较小且多变的道路使用者仍存在挑战。

翻译: Perception in dense, unstructured urban traffic remains a major challenge for autonomous driving because of the wide variety of road users, frequent occlusions, irregular motion patterns, and the lack of standardized road layouts. Although recent LiDAR based 3D object detectors have shown strong performance in structured driving scenarios, most are developed and evaluated for limited field of view settings, and their behavior under full surround 360-degree sensing is still not well understood. This paper studies a 360-degree LiDAR perception pipeline for autonomous driving, with particular attention to panoramic sensing, azimuthal sector wise spatial processing, and transformation equivariant feature extraction in complex urban scenes. The paper presents a practical 360-degree perception framework that combines sector wise panoramic processing with rotation equivariant sparse convolutions and evaluates its behavior on a custom Ouster OS0 LiDAR dataset collected across diverse Indian urban traffic conditions. The results show generally stable detection across several object classes, with the strongest performance for cars at 92.02/90.51, buses at 80.53/76.34, and trucks at 78.59/74.16, while lower scores for pedestrians at 67.45/61.02, cyclists at 73.21/69.54, and motorcyclists at 71.20/68.13 reflect the greater difficulty of detecting smaller and more variable road users in dense urban scenes.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决在密集且非结构化的城市交通中，如何利用全景激光雷达实现稳定可靠的环境感知与目标检测。现有算法多针对有限视角设计，难以应对全景扫描带来的视角变化、方位角边界断裂及物体分割等问题。该研究在现实中至关重要，因为全面的环境感知是自动驾驶执行碰撞避免、盲区监测等安全功能的基础，尤其在缺乏标准车道划线的复杂交通场景中更是不可或缺。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有检测模型多针对有限视场和结构化道路设计，难以应对全向激光雷达在复杂城市交通中面临的视角变化与边界物体碎片化问题，因此设计了将点云划分为重叠方位角扇区并融合旋转等变特征提取的感知框架。该方法并未从头构建全新检测器，而是借鉴了学术界关于变换等变学习与群等变卷积的已有成果，将其从受控环境成功扩展至全向激光雷达的复杂几何场景中，从而有效提升了模型在任意朝向下的检测一致性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将全景点云按方位角划分为重叠扇区，并结合变换等变特征提取技术，以解决全向感知中因视角变化、扇区边界断裂和遮挡带来的检测不一致问题。整体流程首先采集并预处理激光雷达点云数据，将其切分为带有重叠区域的方位角扇区；随后通过数据增强暴露模型于不同视角，利用等变稀疏卷积网络提取具有旋转一致性的特征；最后在重叠扇区上进行目标检测与融合，从而在复杂城市交通中实现稳定可靠的全景感知。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种面向密集非结构化城市交通的全景激光雷达感知框架。主要不同之处在于，它将方位角扇区划分策略与变换等变特征提取相结合，并引入重叠感知空间分解方法，专门解决全景感知中视角任意变化、方位角不连续及边界物体碎片化等挑战。相比以往主要面向有限视场和结构化道路的传统检测器，该工作系统适配了全景激光雷达的几何特性，并在反映真实复杂交通的自定义数据集上进行了验证。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种面向密集非结构化城市交通的三百六十度激光雷达全景感知框架，通过结合方位角扇区划分与变换等变特征提取技术，有效提升了复杂场景下的检测鲁棒性与边界一致性，并在真实印度城市交通数据集中验证了其有效性。

Abstract

Perception in dense, unstructured urban traffic remains a major challenge for autonomous driving because of the wide variety of road users, frequent occlusions, irregular motion patterns, and the lack of standardized road layouts. Although recent LiDAR based 3D object detectors have shown strong performance in structured driving scenarios, most are developed and evaluated for limited field of view settings, and their behavior under full surround 360-degree sensing is still not well understood. This paper studies a 360-degree LiDAR perception pipeline for autonomous driving, with particular attention to panoramic sensing, azimuthal sector wise spatial processing, and transformation equivariant feature extraction in complex urban scenes. The paper presents a practical 360-degree perception framework that combines sector wise panoramic processing with rotation equivariant sparse convolutions and evaluates its behavior on a custom Ouster OS0 LiDAR dataset collected across diverse Indian urban traffic conditions. The results show generally stable detection across several object classes, with the strongest performance for cars at 92.02/90.51, buses at 80.53/76.34, and trucks at 78.59/74.16, while lower scores for pedestrians at 67.45/61.02, cyclists at 73.21/69.54, and motorcyclists at 71.20/68.13 reflect the greater difficulty of detecting smaller and more variable road users in dense urban scenes.

item.title: BCG-FM: A Foundation Model for Ambient Cardiac Health Sensing
item.author: Magnus Ruud Kjaer, Haejun Han, Ashish Neupane, David Q. Sun
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: BCG-FM 是首个用于环境机械生物信号的基座模型，利用床面压电传感器记录无用户干预的夜间心动图数据，在生物年龄估计和健康状况分类等任务中表现优异，证明了环境纵向机械生物信号作为健康基座模型模态的可行性。

背景: 现有的可穿戴生物信号基座模型在多项临床任务中表现优异，但均依赖需要用户主动配合的模态，如佩戴设备或前往睡眠实验室。

目的: 引入 BCG-FM，即首个用于环境机械生物信号的基座模型，旨在利用无需用户努力的环境记录方式获取生物信号数据。

方法: 使用嵌入床面的压电传感器每晚记录心动图，使用来自 145985 名参与者的总计 275 万小时夜间录音数据，通过参与者级别的对比学习对 BCG-FM 进行预训练。

主要发现: 冻结的 BCG-FM 嵌入在生物年龄估计上达到 3.26 年的平均绝对误差，为任何环境无接触模态中最低；在 15 种自报健康状况和三个独立外部队列中产生临床相关的区分能力；仅使用 500 名标记参与者的预训练表示优于在 3372 名参与者上训练的完全监督基线；表示质量与对比学习批次大小呈对数线性缩放。

结论: 环境纵向机械生物信号是健康基座模型的一种可行模态。

翻译: Foundation models for wearable biosignals have matched or exceeded supervised specialists across a range of clinical tasks, yet all rely on modalities that require deliberate user action--wearing a device or visiting a sleep lab. We introduce BCG-FM, the first foundation model for ambient mechanical biosignals. A piezoelectric sensor embedded in the bed surface records ballistocardiography each night without user effort; we pretrain BCG-FM with participant-level contrastive learning and using a total of 2.75 million hours of nightly recordings from 145,985 individuals, the largest raw-waveform biosignal pretraining corpus to date. Frozen BCG-FM embeddings achieve 3.26-year MAE on biological-age estimation and yield clinically relevant discrimination across 15 self-reported health conditions and three independent external cohorts. Pretrained representations from only 500 labeled participants outperform a fully supervised baseline trained on 3,372, and representation quality scales log-linearly with contrastive batch size. These results establish ambient, longitudinal mechanical biosignals as a viable modality for health foundation models.

Abstract

Foundation models for wearable biosignals have matched or exceeded supervised specialists across a range of clinical tasks, yet all rely on modalities that require deliberate user action--wearing a device or visiting a sleep lab. We introduce BCG-FM, the first foundation model for ambient mechanical biosignals. A piezoelectric sensor embedded in the bed surface records ballistocardiography (BCG) each night without user effort; we pretrain BCG-FM with participant-level contrastive learning and using a total of 2.75 million hours of nightly recordings from 145,985 individuals, the largest raw-waveform biosignal pretraining corpus to date. Frozen BCG-FM embeddings achieve 3.26-year MAE on biological-age estimation (the lowest reported for any ambient, contactless modality) and yield clinically relevant discrimination across 15 self-reported health conditions and three independent external cohorts. Pretrained representations from only 500 labeled participants outperform a fully supervised baseline trained on 3,372, and representation quality scales log-linearly with contrastive batch size. These results establish ambient, longitudinal mechanical biosignals as a viable modality for health foundation models.

item.title: Transfer learning for causal forest
item.author: Bérénice-Alexia Jocteur, Véronique Maume-Deschamps, Pierre Ribereau
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了在模型偏移情况下，将迁移学习应用于因果森林（HTERF）以估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）的问题。

背景: 传统迁移学习主要关注将从源域（拥有大量观测数据）训练的模型适应到目标域（拥有少量观测数据），以提升目标域上的性能。

目的: 在模型偏移的情况下，研究将迁移学习应用于因果森林（HTERF）以估计条件平均处理效应（CATE）。

方法: 采用由Wang在2016年提出的偏移方法，并针对因果背景进行了调整。该方法利用中间模型来估计源域与目标域分布之间的偏移。

主要发现: 主要结果给出了HTERF在目标域上CATE误差的界限，该界限取决于中间模型的误差。模拟研究表明，该模拟设置和真实世界数据集的不同场景下均表现出良好的性能。

结论: 该迁移学习方法在估计条件平均处理效应方面有效，并在模拟和真实数据中展现了良好的性能。

翻译: Transfer learning addresses the challenge of transfering knowledge from one domain to another. Traditional transfer learning focuses on adapting models trained on a source domain (with a lot of observations) to improve performance on a target domain (with few observations). In this work we consider the case of a model shift and we focus on the transfer learning applied to a causal forest namely HTERF. This causal forest aims to estimate the Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE). The approach considered is the offset method presented by Wang (2016) adapted to a causal context. This method relies on the use of intermediate models in order to estimate the offset between source and target distributions. Our main result is a bound on the CATE error of HTERF on target depending on the error of the intermediate models. Simulation studies show the good performances of this approach in different settings on simulations and on a real-world dataset.

Abstract

Transfer learning addresses the challenge of transfering knowledge from one domain to another. Traditional transfer learning focuses on adapting models trained on a source domain (with a lot of observations) to improve performance on a target domain (with few observations). In this work we consider the case of a model shift and we focus on the transfer learning applied to a causal forest namely HTERF. This causal forest aims to estimate the Conditional Average Treatment Effect (CATE). The approach considered is the offset method presented by Wang (2016) adapted to a causal context. This method relies on the use of intermediate models in order to estimate the offset between source and target distributions. Our main result is a bound on the CATE error of HTERF on target depending on the error of the intermediate models. Simulation studies show the good performances of this approach in different settings on simulations and on a real-world dataset.

item.title: DSFNet: Learning Dual-Domain Spectral Operators for Multi-Modality Spatio-Temporal Forecasting in Urban Transportation Systems
item.author: Yongchao Li, Yang Li, Zhuoxuan Li, Jun Chen, Chu Zhang, Jinde Cao, Leszek Rutkowski
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种双域谱滤波网络，用于多模态时空预测，通过双域谱滤波捕捉异质空间模式并显式建模变量间关系，引入外部门控机制自适应调节外部影响下的时间动态，在五个真实交通数据集上显著优于现有最先进基线方法。

背景: 多模态时空预测通过整合多样化的交通模态扩展了传统时空预测。尽管近期在时空建模方面取得了显著进展，但现有方法通常未能显式建模不同模态变量之间的耦合关系。

目的: 解决多模态时空预测中面临的挑战，即需要建模（一）在外部影响下的时间动态异质性，以及（二）异质空间依赖关系与复杂的跨变量耦合关系。

方法: 提出双域谱滤波网络，采用双域谱滤波捕捉异质空间模式并显式建模变量间关系。该方法将空间模态交互分解为特征域和空间域的谱算子，以可扩展地建模非局部依赖和跨模态耦合。此外，引入外部门控机制自适应调节外部影响下的时间动态。

主要发现: 在五个代表性真实交通数据集上进行广泛实验，与次优基线相比，该方法在这些数据集上将平均绝对误差降低了百分之三点二一到百分之十点一六。

结论: 该方法在准确性方面显著优于现有的最先进基线，同时表现出效率和鲁棒性。

翻译: Multi-Modality Spatio-Temporal Forecasting (MoSTF) extends traditional spatio-temporal forecasting by incorporating diverse traffic modalities. Despite significant recent strides in spatio-temporal modeling, existing approaches often fail to explicitly model the coupling relationships between different modality variables. Accurate MoSTF is challenging, as it requires modeling (1) temporal dynamic heterogeneity under exogenous influences and (2) heterogeneous spatial dependencies alongside complex cross-variable couplings. To address these challenges, we propose the Dual-Domain Spectral Filtering Network (DSFNet). Our framework employs dual-domain spectral filtering to capture heterogeneous spatial patterns and explicitly model the relationships between variables. Unlike graph-based message passing or dense attention over node-modality pairs, DSFNet factorizes space-modality interactions into feature-domain and spatial-domain spectral operators, enabling scalable modeling of nonlocal dependencies and cross-modality couplings. Furthermore, we introduce an external gating mechanism to adaptively regulate temporal dynamics under external influences. We validate our method through extensive experiments on five representative real-world traffic datasets. Compared with the second-best baselines, DSFNet reduces MAE by 3.21%-10.16% across these datasets. The results demonstrate that DSFNet significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy while exhibiting efficiency and robustness.

Abstract

Multi-Modality Spatio-Temporal Forecasting (MoSTF) extends traditional spatio-temporal forecasting by incorporating diverse traffic modalities. Despite significant recent strides in spatio-temporal modeling, existing approaches often fail to explicitly model the coupling relationships between different modality variables. Accurate MoSTF is challenging, as it requires modeling (1) temporal dynamic heterogeneity under exogenous influences and (2) heterogeneous spatial dependencies alongside complex cross-variable couplings. To address these challenges, we propose the Dual-Domain Spectral Filtering Network (DSFNet). Our framework employs dual-domain spectral filtering to capture heterogeneous spatial patterns and explicitly model the relationships between variables. Unlike graph-based message passing or dense attention over node-modality pairs, DSFNet factorizes space-modality interactions into feature-domain and spatial-domain spectral operators, enabling scalable modeling of nonlocal dependencies and cross-modality couplings. Furthermore, we introduce an external gating mechanism to adaptively regulate temporal dynamics under external influences. We validate our method through extensive experiments on five representative real-world traffic datasets. Compared with the second-best baselines, DSFNet reduces MAE by 3.21%-10.16% across these datasets. The results demonstrate that DSFNet significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy while exhibiting efficiency and robustness.

item.title: Contrast encodes inductive bias: separating slow noise from dynamics in predictive representation learning
item.author: Paarth Gulati, Ilya Nemenman
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文指出自监督学习方法在潜在空间中预测动态时，会将缓慢变化的噪声误认为动态信号。通过研究JEPA和DySIB等方法，发现当负样本跨轨迹采样时，对比预测目标会优先编码轨迹特定的噪声。若改为在单条轨迹内采样负样本，可消除预测捷径，迫使编码器学习动态相关变量，从而提升表示质量。

背景: 自监督学习方法如JEPA在潜在空间中学习表示并预测动态。然而，当噪声特征在每条轨迹内近似恒定时，对比预测目标会优先编码这些噪声特征而非真实的潜在变量，导致下游性能随噪声强度增加而下降。

目的: 揭示对比预测目标在动态表示学习中的失败模式及其补救措施，特别是针对物理系统中存在噪声观测的情况。

方法: 在合成移动点数据集上研究标准SimCLR风格的JEPA，以及在刚体摆锤视频上研究DySIB方法。通过改变负样本采样策略，从跨轨迹采样改为单条轨迹内采样，分析其对表示学习的影响。

主要发现: 跨轨迹采样负样本时，对比预测目标会优先编码缓慢变化的噪声特征，导致表示被轨迹特定噪声主导。在单条轨迹内采样负样本可消除这一预测捷径，迫使编码器学习动态相关变量，且更长轨迹能产生更好的表示，即使存在强慢噪声。

结论: 对比预测目标的设计原则对于动态表示学习至关重要，特别是在物理系统中。通过调整负样本采样策略，可以有效避免噪声干扰，提升表示的准确性和可解释性。

翻译: Self-supervised methods that learn representations and predict dynamics fully in the latent space, such as JEPA, have been shown to confuse slowly varying noise with the dynamical signals they aim to capture. Specifically, when noise features remain approximately constant within each trajectory, contrastive predictive objectives preferentially encode these features instead of the true latent variables governing the system. The learned representation then becomes dominated by trajectory-specific noise, so downstream performance degrades with noise strength and does not improve even as the number and duration of training trajectories increase. We argue that this failure is a property of the objective itself, shared by a long line of contrastive predictive objectives that sample negatives across trajectories. To illustrate this generality, we study the failure mode and its remedy in two settings: a standard SimCLR-style JEPA on a synthetic moving-dot dataset, and DySIB, a recently introduced method designed for extracting physically interpretable representations of dynamics, on movies of a rigid-body pendulum. When negatives are instead sampled within a single trajectory, the slow noise can no longer distinguish frames within that trajectory, removing the predictive shortcut. Training one encoder simultaneously on many such trajectories then forces it to encode the variables relevant for the dynamics, with longer trajectories yielding better representations even for strong slow noise. Our results point toward principles for designing contrastive predictive objectives in dynamical representation learning, especially for physical systems with noisy experimental observations.

Abstract

Self-supervised methods that learn representations and predict dynamics fully in the latent space, such as JEPA, have been shown to confuse slowly varying noise with the dynamical signals they aim to capture. Specifically, when noise features remain approximately constant within each trajectory, contrastive predictive objectives preferentially encode these features instead of the true latent variables governing the system. The learned representation then becomes dominated by trajectory-specific noise, so downstream performance degrades with noise strength and does not improve even as the number and duration of training trajectories increase. We argue that this failure is a property of the objective itself, shared by a long line of contrastive predictive objectives that sample negatives across trajectories. To illustrate this generality, we study the failure mode and its remedy in two settings: a standard SimCLR-style JEPA on a synthetic moving-dot dataset, and DySIB, a recently introduced method designed for extracting physically interpretable representations of dynamics, on movies of a rigid-body pendulum. When negatives are instead sampled within a single trajectory, the slow noise can no longer distinguish frames within that trajectory, removing the predictive shortcut. Training one encoder simultaneously on many such trajectories then forces it to encode the variables relevant for the dynamics, with longer trajectories yielding better representations even for strong slow noise. Our results point toward principles for designing contrastive predictive objectives in dynamical representation learning, especially for physical systems with noisy experimental observations.

item.title: DALE-CT: Depth-Aware Foundation Models for Computed Tomography
item.author: Evan W. Damron, Mahmut S. Gokmen, Mitchell A. Klusty, Caroline N. Leach, Emily B. Collier, V. K. Cody Bumgardner
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为DALE-CT的二维模型系列，基于LeJEPA架构从头训练，用于处理计算机断层扫描数据。

背景: 自监督学习在计算机断层扫描领域的需求增加，特别是需要适应性强且高容量的视觉编码器。

目的: 探索二维切片架构作为处理体积计算机断层扫描数据的灵活替代方案，以替代原生三维模型。

方法: 使用CT-RATE数据集训练DALE-CT，采用基于LeJEPA的二维模型，并引入一种新颖的三维深度感知预训练策略，结合自动解剖掩码和人工标注异常的双重监督。

主要发现: 在多重异常检测的线性探针评估中，冻结骨干网络（DALE-CT-2S）实现了零点八三三的宏观AUROC，性能接近最先进的三维视觉语言模型，且使用更少的数据和无文本监督。

结论: DALE-CT在性能上接近最先进的三维视觉语言模型，同时显著减少了数据需求和无需文本监督，所有训练代码、评估脚本和模型权重已公开。

翻译: Recent breakthroughs in self-supervised learning (SSL), such as the Latent-Euclidean Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (LeJEPA), alongside successes in integrating visual encoders with language models, have driven the demand for adaptable, high-capacity vision encoders in Computed Tomography (CT). In this work, we explore 2D slice-based architectures as a flexible alternative to native 3D models for processing volumetric CT data. Using the CT-RATE dataset, we trained DALE-CT (Depth-Aware Latent-Euclidean Computed Tomography), a 2D model family built entirely from scratch using LeJEPA, and compared its performance against a continually pre-trained DINOv2 baseline. To enhance representation quality, we developed a novel 3D depth-aware pre-training strategy anchored by dense auxiliary supervision from both automated anatomical masks and human-annotated abnormalities. Under linear probe evaluation with Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) for multi-abnormality detection, the frozen backbone of this dual-supervised model (DALE-CT-2S) achieves a Macro AUROC of 0.833. This performance demonstrates near-parity with state-of-the-art 3D vision-language models, achieved entirely from scratch with significantly less data and no textual supervision. To ensure reproducibility, all training code, evaluation scripts, and model weights have been made publicly available.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统三维医学影像模型过度依赖医生文本报告所导致的视觉特征学习受限问题，同时缓解三维模型计算成本高和需强制调整图像尺寸的挑战。该问题在临床和研究中非常重要，因为计算机断层扫描应用广泛，但现有模型常因报告不完整而遗漏关键病变信息，且训练成本高昂。通过开发仅依赖视觉数据的二维切片基础模型，本研究能够更全面地捕捉解剖结构细节，为开发高效、准确的自动化辅助诊断系统提供可靠基础。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为传统三维CT模型过度依赖文本报告会限制视觉特征的全面性，且处理变长扫描时容易丢失信息。因此，他们设计了一种完全从零开始的二维切片基础模型，以规避文本瓶颈并提高计算灵活性。该方法主要借鉴了LeJEPA自监督学习框架来构建核心网络，并引入了自动生成的解剖与人工标注的异常标签作为辅助监督信号。同时，他们设计了深度感知的多裁剪策略，使模型在训练时能聚焦于临床相关的解剖区域和病变。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是摒弃传统三维网络与文本依赖，完全从零训练一种基于二维切片的自监督视觉基础模型。整体流程首先将计算机断层扫描数据切片并分组为连续块，优先围绕解剖与病变区域生成全局和局部图像块。接着，所有图像块输入统一的二维编码器，通过深度感知的一致性损失与正则化技术进行自监督训练。最后，引入自动化解剖掩码与病变标签作为辅助监督信号，进一步约束模型学习具有临床意义的空间特征。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种完全从零开始训练的二维切片基础模型，采用深度感知的多视角采样策略，并结合自动化解剖掩码与异常标注进行密集辅助监督。与以往依赖大量文本报告或庞大预训练数据的三维模型不同，该方法完全摒弃文本监督，仅通过纯视觉自监督学习即可实现相近性能，有效避免了文本报告不完整带来的视觉特征局限，同时大幅降低了数据与计算需求。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种全新的二维切片医学影像基础模型，通过引入深度感知预训练策略与密集辅助监督机制，在无需文本监督且训练数据更少的情况下，实现了与当前最先进的三维医学影像模型相当甚至更优的诊断性能。

Abstract

Recent breakthroughs in self-supervised learning (SSL), such as the Latent-Euclidean Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (LeJEPA), alongside successes in integrating visual encoders with language models, have driven the demand for adaptable, high-capacity vision encoders in Computed Tomography (CT). In this work, we explore 2D slice-based architectures as a flexible alternative to native 3D models for processing volumetric CT data. Using the CT-RATE dataset, we trained DALE-CT (Depth-Aware Latent-Euclidean Computed Tomography), a 2D model family built entirely from scratch using LeJEPA, and compared its performance against a continually pre-trained DINOv2 baseline. To enhance representation quality, we developed a novel 3D depth-aware pre-training strategy anchored by dense auxiliary supervision from both automated anatomical masks and human-annotated abnormalities. Under linear probe evaluation with Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) for multi-abnormality detection, the frozen backbone of this dual-supervised model (DALE-CT-2S) achieves a Macro AUROC of 0.833. This performance demonstrates near-parity with state-of-the-art 3D vision-language models, achieved entirely from scratch with significantly less data and no textual supervision. To ensure reproducibility, all training code, evaluation scripts, and model weights have been made publicly available.

item.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
item.author: Sung-Wook Lee, Xuhui Kang, Yen-Ling Kuo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TBD-VLA的离散视觉语言动作模型框架，该框架通过引入块扩散技术实现了基于时间块的动作生成，统一了时间自回归与并行动作解码，显著提升了推理速度并保持了时间连贯性。

背景: 离散视觉语言动作模型通常将动作生成建模为离散动作空间上的下一个词元预测，并基于先前上下文自回归地生成每个词元。虽然这种方法有效，但会导致较高的推理延迟，并且很大程度上忽略了动作轨迹中固有的时间结构。近期的研究引入了并行解码以提高效率，但缺乏显式的机制来建模词元之间的依赖关系。

目的: 旨在解决现有离散视觉语言动作模型推理延迟高且忽略时间结构的问题，同时克服并行解码缺乏显式词元依赖建模机制的不足，实现既具有强时间连贯性又具备更快推理速度的动作生成。

方法: 提出TBD-VLA框架，将动作序列划分为时间块，在每个时间块内执行掩码离散扩散，同时在块之间保持自回归生成。这种设计结合了时间自回归和并行动作解码。此外，通过显式的时间建模，利用时间修复技术实现了动作块的异步执行。

主要发现: TBD-VLA在模拟和真实世界的操作任务中均显著优于先前的视觉语言动作方法。

结论: TBD-VLA为快速、具有时间意识的离散视觉语言动作模型提供了一条可扩展的路径。

翻译: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introduce TBD-VLA, a discrete token-based VLA framework that incorporates block diffusion to enable temporal action generation. We partition action sequences into temporal blocks and perform masked discrete diffusion within each block, while maintaining autoregressive generation across blocks. This design unifies temporal autoregression and parallel action decoding, achieving both strong temporal coherence and improved inference speed. In addition, the explicit temporal modeling enables asynchronous execution of action chunks (e.g., Real-Time Chunking) via temporal in-painting. TBD-VLA significantly outperforms prior VLA approaches in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, offering a scalable path toward fast, temporally aware, discrete VLA models. Project webpage: https://tbd-vla.github.io/

Abstract

Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introduce TBD-VLA, a discrete token-based VLA framework that incorporates block diffusion to enable temporal action generation. We partition action sequences into temporal blocks and perform masked discrete diffusion within each block, while maintaining autoregressive generation across blocks.
