This design unifies temporal autoregression and parallel action decoding, achieving both strong temporal coherence and improved inference speed. In addition, the explicit temporal modeling enables asynchronous execution of action chunks (e.g., Real-Time Chunking) via temporal in-painting. TBD-VLA significantly outperforms prior VLA approaches in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, offering a scalable path toward fast, temporally aware, discrete VLA models. Project webpage: https://tbd-vla.github.io/

item.title: 3D Oral Modelling with Improved Vertex Distribution Using Matching-Based Learning
item.author: Jihun Cho, Soo-Yeon Jeong, Eun-Jeong Bae, Sun-Young Ihm
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对先前基于深度学习的三维口腔内重建模型中顶点分布不均的问题，提出了一种改进的损失函数，通过匈牙利匹配过滤和排斥损失函数实现了顶点在重建表面上的更均匀分布。

背景: 先前研究提出了一种基于深度学习的三维口腔内重建框架，该框架直接从十个固定角度的口腔内图像预测显式的三维点云坐标，采用MobileNetV2和多头注意力机制进行多视图特征融合，并结合L1损失和 Chamfer距离作为损失函数。

目的: 解决先前模型预测顶点倾向于集中在真实数据高密度区域，导致其他区域覆盖不足的问题。

方法: 引入带有过滤机制的匈牙利匹配和排斥损失函数，以强制重建模型上的顶点分布更加均匀。

主要发现: 改进后的模型精度为百分之六十八点零二，数值上低于先前模型的百分之七十七点四九，但顶点聚类问题得到显著缓解，预测顶点在整个重建表面上的分布更加均匀。

结论: 尽管精度数值有所下降，但新模型有效改善了顶点分布不均的问题，提升了重建质量。

翻译: In our previous work, a deep learning-based framework for 3D intraoral reconstruction was proposed. The model directly predicts explicit 3D point cloud coordinates from ten fixed-angle intraoral images, employing MobileNetV2 and Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion, with a combined L1 Loss and Chamfer Distance as the loss function. Although the model achieved an accuracy of 77.49%, predicted vertices tended to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, leaving other regions largely uncovered. In this paper, an improved loss function is proposed to address this limitation. Hungarian matching with filtering and Repulsion Loss are introduced to enforce more uniform vertex distribution across the reconstructed model. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 68.02%, which is numerically lower than the previous model. However, the vertex clustering issue observed in the prior work is substantially alleviated, with predicted vertices distributed more evenly across the entire reconstructed surface.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决三维口腔重建模型中预测顶点过度聚集在特定区域，导致整体表面覆盖不均的问题。该问题在研究中很重要，因为传统评估指标会因顶点聚集而虚高准确率，无法真实反映模型性能；在现实中，均匀分布的顶点能提供更完整准确的口腔三维结构，对牙科数字化诊疗具有关键意义。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现前作因使用传统距离损失导致预测顶点过度聚集在密集区域，因此设计了包含匈牙利匹配过滤与排斥损失的新损失函数。其中匈牙利匹配借鉴了目标检测领域的现有方法，用于强制建立预测点与真实点的一对一映射；过滤机制引导模型重点优化匹配较差的区域；排斥损失则直接惩罚距离过近的预测点。这三部分共同作用，促使顶点在重建表面上均匀分布。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过改进损失函数，解决传统方法中预测顶点过度聚集在密集区域的问题，从而在重建的口腔三维模型表面实现更均匀的顶点分布。整体实现流程首先利用深度学习网络从十张固定角度的口内图像中提取并融合特征，随后直接解码预测出三维顶点坐标。在训练阶段，模型综合使用一对一匹配损失配合动态过滤机制、基础位置误差损失以及顶点间距排斥损失，并随训练进度动态调整各项损失的权重，逐步引导模型将顶点均匀分布在整个口腔表面上。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种改进的损失函数，核心包含强制一一映射的匈牙利匹配过滤机制与惩罚点间距离过近的排斥损失。相比之前的工作使用传统最近邻距离导致预测顶点在密集区域聚集，新方法通过动态筛选匹配误差并施加空间排斥力，有效打破了顶点扎堆的现象。这使得模型虽然整体数值精度有所下降，但成功实现了预测顶点在整个口腔模型表面的均匀分布。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种结合匈牙利匹配过滤与排斥损失的改进损失函数，有效解决了三维口腔重建中预测顶点过度聚集的问题，显著提升了重建模型表面顶点分布的均匀性。

Abstract

In our previous work, a deep learning-based framework for 3D intraoral reconstruction was proposed. The model directly predicts explicit 3D point cloud coordinates from ten fixed-angle intraoral images, employing MobileNetV2 and Multi-head Attention for multi-view feature fusion, with a combined L1 Loss and Chamfer Distance as the loss function. Although the model achieved an accuracy of 77.49%, predicted vertices tended to concentrate in high-density regions of the ground truth, leaving other regions largely uncovered. In this paper, an improved loss function is proposed to address this limitation. Hungarian matching with filtering and Repulsion Loss are introduced to enforce more uniform vertex distribution across the reconstructed model. The proposed model achieves an accuracy of 68.02%, which is numerically lower than the previous model. However, the vertex clustering issue observed in the prior work is substantially alleviated, with predicted vertices distributed more evenly across the entire reconstructed surface.

item.title: DAL-PCQA: Enabling Distortion-Level and Language-Driven Reasoning for Point Cloud Quality Assessment
item.author: Swarna Chakraborty, Gabriel De Castro Araújo, Syeda Tasmi Faria, Marcelo M. Carvalho, Mylene C. Q. Farias
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为DAL-PCQA的失真感知语言标注点云质量评估数据集，旨在通过提供多级别失真严重性标签、离散质量类别和与自然语言描述对齐的结构化信息，弥补传统方法仅预测整体感知质量评分的不足。

背景: 传统的点云质量评估方法通常预测标量平均意见得分，只能量化整体感知退化，无法揭示退化的具体原因。而人类观察者通常会针对模糊、颜色偏移、点密度变化、缺失区域和几何变形等具体失真进行推理。

目的: 缩小传统点云质量评估方法与人类观察者推理方式之间的差距，提供一种能够揭示失真原因的可解释、失真级别的点云质量评估工具。

方法: 构建了DAL-PCQA数据集，对基准点云进行了增强，添加了多级别失真严重性标签、离散质量类别以及与人类感知对齐的结构化自然语言描述。定义了涵盖光度伪影和几何伪影的点云特定失真分类法，并进行了统计分析。通过比较零样本和微调的多模态模型生成感知质量描述，评估了这些标注的效用。

主要发现: 统计分析揭示了不同失真类型和质量级别下的特征退化模式。实验表明，失真感知监督显著提高了生成的描述与真实描述在词汇和语义上的一致性。

结论: DAL-PCQA通过启用可解释的失真级别推理，促进了语言驱动的、可解释的点云质量评估。该数据集已公开可用。

翻译: Point Cloud Quality Assessment (PCQA) methods typically predict scalar Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), which quantify overall perceptual degradation but do not reveal its causes. In contrast, human observers naturally reason in terms of specific distortions such as blur, color shifts, point density changes, missing regions, and geometric deformations. To close this gap, we introduce DAL-PCQA, a distortion-aware, language-annotated dataset for PCQA. DAL-PCQA augments benchmark point clouds with multi-level distortion severity labels, discrete quality categories, and structured natural language descriptions aligned with human perception. We define a point-cloud-specific distortion taxonomy that covers both photometric and geometric artifacts. Statistical analysis reveals characteristic degradation patterns across distortion types and quality levels. To assess the utility of these annotations, we compare zero-shot and fine-tuned multimodal models for generating perceptual quality descriptions. Experiments show that distortion-aware supervision substantially improves lexical and semantic alignment with ground-truth descriptions. By enabling interpretable, distortion-level reasoning, DAL-PCQA facilitates language-driven, explainable point cloud quality assessment. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/swarna96/DAL-PCQA.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统点云质量评估方法仅输出单一综合评分、无法揭示具体失真原因的问题。它通过构建包含多维度失真等级和自然语言描述的数据库，使算法能够像人类一样进行基于具体失真类型的推理。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为点云广泛应用于自动驾驶、虚拟现实等关键领域，准确的评估对优化数据压缩和保障用户体验至关重要。提供可解释的失真级分析不仅能提升模型与人类感知的一致性，还能为三维质量建模提供更具指导性的监督信号。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统方法仅输出单一分数，无法解释质量优劣的具体原因，而人类评估时会关注模糊或几何变形等具体失真类型。为此，他们设计了包含光度与几何失真分类的专用体系，通过多人独立标注、分数映射和文本模板自动生成结构化自然语言描述。该方法直接基于两个主流基准数据集构建，并参考了图像质量评估中语言驱动模型的设计思路，将其核心逻辑适配至三维点云场景。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是突破传统方法仅输出单一质量分数的局限，通过构建包含多维度失真等级与结构化语言描述的数据集，实现符合人类感知习惯的失真级别推理与可解释评估。整体流程首先基于现有基准数据定义涵盖光度与几何特征的三维失真分类体系，随后由标注人员为样本评定各项失真严重程度并映射为离散质量等级，最后利用预设文本模板自动生成与人工标注对齐的自然语言描述，形成支持多模态模型训练的标准数据集。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是构建了首个面向点云质量评估的结构化失真感知语言标注数据集。它专门设计了涵盖光度与几何特征的三维失真分类体系，并为样本提供多级失真严重程度标签及符合人类认知习惯的自然语言描述。与以往仅输出单一质量分数或缺乏三维几何失真标注的工作相比，该方法能够明确指出导致质量下降的具体失真类型，从而实现了可解释且语言驱动的三维质量评估。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次构建了一个面向点云质量评估的结构化数据集，通过引入多维度失真等级标签与对应的自然语言描述，成功实现了超越单一分数预测的、可解释的语言驱动质量评估。

Abstract

Point Cloud Quality Assessment (PCQA) methods typically predict scalar Mean Opinion Scores (MOS), which quantify overall perceptual degradation but do not reveal its causes. In contrast, human observers naturally reason in terms of specific distortions such as blur, color shifts, point density changes, missing regions, and geometric deformations. To close this gap, we introduce DAL-PCQA, a distortion-aware, language-annotated dataset for PCQA. DAL-PCQA augments benchmark point clouds with multi-level distortion severity labels, discrete quality categories, and structured natural language descriptions aligned with human perception. We define a point-cloud-specific distortion taxonomy that covers both photometric and geometric artifacts. Statistical analysis reveals characteristic degradation patterns across distortion types and quality levels. To assess the utility of these annotations, we compare zero-shot and fine-tuned multimodal models for generating perceptual quality descriptions. Experiments show that distortion-aware supervision substantially improves lexical and semantic alignment with ground-truth descriptions. By enabling interpretable, distortion-level reasoning, DAL-PCQA facilitates language-driven, explainable point cloud quality assessment. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/swarna96/DAL-PCQA.

item.title: FMRFusion: Frequency-Aware Multi-View Representation Learning for Heterogeneous Image Fusion
item.author: Tao Zhoua, Yunlong Liu, Qinghui Chen, Zekai Zhang, Minlong Sun, Changlin Biana, Dagang Li, Wenmin Wang, Jinglin Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 红外与可见光图像融合旨在生成保留显著目标信息并保留详细纹理的复合图像，整合两种异构模态。

背景: 先前的图像融合方法通常采用单模块堆叠方法从两种模态中提取特征，但可能导致对其独特特征的学习不完整，从而限制融合效果并在现实世界的异构数据场景中限制鲁棒性。

目的: 解决上述挑战，提出FMRFusion，一种用于异构图像融合的频域感知多视图表示学习网络。

方法: 引入多尺度结构感知模块以有效捕捉判别性结构，提取细粒度局部结构和基本上下文信息；采用双线性频率分解机制将特征分离为高频和低频分量，实现跨不同频域的局部细节和全局表示的联合建模；整合跨视图互补交互以显式建模和融合反射光信息与辐射强度响应之间的互补特征；通过流匹配改进融合结果的性能，通过从粗数据到高质量表示的学习逐步细化融合特征。

主要发现: 在多个基准数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，FMRFusion在一系列融合任务中实现了优越且一致的性能，尤其是在夜间场景中。

结论: FMRFusion在红外与可见光图像融合任务中表现出色，特别是在夜间场景中。

翻译: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to generate a composite image that retains significant target information and preserves detailed textures, integrating two heterogeneous modalities. Previous image fusion methods typically adopt a single-module stacking approach to extract features from the two modalities. However, these approaches may result in incomplete learning of their distinct characteristics, thereby limiting the fusion effectiveness and constraining robustness in real-world heterogeneous data scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose FMRFusion, a frequency-aware multi-view representation learning network for Heterogeneous Image Fusion. A Multi-Scale Structural Perception Module is introduced to effectively capture discriminative structures, extracting fine-grained local structures and essential contextual information. A bilinear frequency decomposition mechanism is employed to separate features into high-frequency and low-frequency components, enabling joint modeling of local details and global representations across different frequency domains. Moreover, a Cross-View Complementary Interaction is incorporated to explicitly model and fuse the complementary characteristics between reflected light information and radiative intensity responses, facilitating effective cross-view interaction. We further improve the Performance of the fused results by flow matching, which progressively refines the fused features by learning the transformation from coarse data to high-quality representations. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that FMRFusion achieves superior and consistent performance across a range of fusion tasks, especially in nighttime scenarios

Abstract

Infrared and visible image fusion aims to generate a composite image that retains significant target information and preserves detailed textures, integrating two heterogeneous modalities. Previous image fusion methods typically adopt a single-module stacking approach to extract features from the two modalities. However, these approaches may result in incomplete learning of their distinct characteristics, thereby limiting the fusion effectiveness and constrain ing robustness in real-world heterogeneous data scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose FMRFusion, a frequency-aware multi-view representation learning network for Heterogeneous Image Fusion. A Multi-Scale Struc tural Perception Module is introduced to effectively capture discriminative structures, extracting fine-grained local structures and essential contextual information. A bilinear frequency decomposition mechanism is employed to sepa rate features into high-frequency and low-frequency components, enabling joint modeling of local details and global representations across different frequency domains. Moreover, a Cross-View Complementary Interaction is incorpo rated to explicitly model and fuse the complementary characteristics between reflected light information and radiative intensity responses, facilitating effective cross-view interaction. We further improve the Performance of the fused results by flow matching, which progressively refines the fused features by learning the transformation from coarse data to high-quality representations. Extensive experiments conducted on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that FMRFusion achieves superior and consistent performance across a range of fusion tasks, especially in nighttime scenarios

item.title: GVC-Seg: Training-Free 3D Instance Segmentation via Geometric Visual Correspondence
item.author: Liang Xu, Fangjing Wang, Jinyu Yang, Feng Zheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为GVC-Seg的新型免训练3D实例分割方法，通过利用3D几何线索与2D视觉线索之间的对应关系来缓解不同分割模型间的置信度偏差，从而提升3D点云数据的实例分割性能。

背景: 在点云数据的机器视觉应用中，准确的3D实例分割至关重要。近期研究利用多个预训练基础模型生成3D提案，并结合提案聚合方法以提升性能。然而，由于不同分割模型在置信度水平上存在固有差异，现有方法往往因偏向高置信度模型而产生次优结果，这种偏差受数据预处理和训练策略等因素影响。

目的: 解决现有3D实例分割方法中因不同模型置信度差异导致的偏差问题，实现无偏的集成学习，提升提案质量评估和分割性能。

方法: 提出GVC-Seg方法，核心是利用3D几何线索与2D视觉线索之间的对应关系来缓解置信度偏差。具体包括：在实例掩码生成阶段引入3D提案生成模块，在实例语义推理阶段引入掩码感知的CLIP特征提取模块。该方法无需训练。

主要发现: 在多个具有挑战性的基准测试上，GVC-Seg方法达到了最先进的性能水平。

结论: GVC-Seg方法不仅提升了3D实例分割的准确性，还在开放词汇语义分割设置中展现出巨大潜力。

翻译: Accurate 3D instance segmentation in point cloud data is critical for machine vision applications. Recent advancements leverage multiple pre-trained foundation models to generate 3D proposals, followed by the application of proposal aggregation methods, which significantly enhance performance. However, they often produce sub-optimal results due to inherent variations in confidence levels across different segmentation models, resulting in a bias toward the model with higher confidence. This bias is inherently model-dependent and is influenced by factors such as data preprocessing techniques and training strategies. To address this bias, we propose a novel, training-free 3D instance segmentation approach via Geometric Visual Correspondence (GVC-Seg), which exploits the correspondence between 3D geometric cues and 2D visual cues to mitigate the confidence bias. Additionally, a 3D proposal generation module and a mask-aware CLIP feature extraction module are introduced during the instance mask generation and instance semantic reasoning, respectively. In this way, GVC-Seg enhances proposal quality assessment, ensuring unbiased ensemble learning across different models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on several challenging benchmarks, while also exhibiting strong potential in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation settings.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决的是在无训练三维实例分割任务中，融合多个预训练模型时产生的置信度偏差问题。由于不同模型输出的评分并不准确，传统方法容易盲目选择高分但质量差的分割结果，导致最终性能下降。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为高质量三维标注数据稀缺且获取成本极高，无训练方法能有效降低对数据的依赖。同时，准确分割三维物体是机器人导航、自动驾驶等机器视觉应用的核心基础，解决此偏差能显著提升这些现实场景中的感知可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有免训练方法在融合多模型提案时易受置信度偏差影响的问题，设计了通过几何与视觉线索对应来校正分数的框架。该方法首先利用预训练模型生成多样化的三维提案，随后将提案投影至二维平面并借助二维视觉先验计算无偏置信度，最后结合语义特征提取模块完成分割。在借鉴现有工作方面，作者直接启用了多种预训练的二维与三维基础模型作为提案生成器，并参考了相关开放词汇分割框架的架构思路，在此基础上创新性地加入了数据增强策略与掩码感知特征提取模块，以弥补传统方法在几何结构捕捉和语义推理上的不足。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用三维几何特征与二维视觉特征的对应关系，为不同模型生成的实例候选区域计算无偏置信度分数，从而消除多模型融合时的置信度偏差。整体流程首先将点云数据拆分并输入预训练三维模型生成多样化的候选掩码；接着将候选掩码投影到二维平面，结合二维视觉先验计算无偏置信度分数；最后基于该分数进行重叠抑制筛选，并提取掩码感知特征以实现开放词汇的语义分割。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点是提出了一种无需训练的三维实例分割框架，核心在于引入几何视觉对应模块。该模块通过结合三维几何特征与二维视觉先验，为不同模型生成的分割结果计算无偏置信度分数，从而有效缓解了传统方法中因模型置信度差异导致的融合偏差。与以往仅依赖三维几何信息或简单聚合提议的工作相比，本文方法无需额外训练即可实现跨模型的公平融合，并具备即插即用的扩展性，显著提升了分割质量与开放词汇场景下的性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种无需训练的三维实例分割框架，通过建立三维几何特征与二维视觉线索的对应关系来消除不同模型间的置信度偏差，从而提升实例筛选的可靠性与整体分割精度。

Abstract

Accurate 3D instance segmentation in point cloud data is critical for machine vision applications. Recent advancements leverage multiple pre-trained foundation models to generate 3D proposals, followed by the application of proposal aggregation methods, which significantly enhance performance. However, they often produce sub-optimal results due to inherent variations in confidence levels across different segmentation models, resulting in a bias toward the model with higher confidence. This bias is inherently model-dependent and is influenced by factors such as data preprocessing techniques and training strategies. To address this bias, we propose a novel, training-free 3D instance segmentation approach via Geometric Visual Correspondence (GVC-Seg), which exploits the correspondence between 3D geometric cues and 2D visual cues to mitigate the confidence bias. Additionally, a 3D proposal generation module and a mask-aware CLIP feature extraction module are introduced during the instance mask generation and instance semantic reasoning, respectively. In this way, GVC-Seg enhances proposal quality assessment, ensuring unbiased ensemble learning across different models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on several challenging benchmarks, while also exhibiting strong potential in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation settings.

item.title: CausShield: Sample Reconstruction-Resilient Vertical FL via Causal Representation Learning
item.author: Yongqi Jiang, Yansong Gao, Siguang Chen, Anmin Fu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CausShield的防御机制，用于解决垂直联邦学习中的主动样本重建攻击问题。该机制基于结构因果模型，将共享表示分解为任务相关和任务无关部分，在保护隐私的同时保持模型效用。

背景: 垂直联邦学习是一种分布式学习范式，利用跨隔离参与方的垂直划分特征而不共享原始样本。然而，它容易受到主动样本重建攻击。现有的防御方法在模型效用和隐私保护之间无法取得令人满意的平衡，要么抑制了与任务相关的信息，要么依赖于端到端监督训练，导致模型在训练早期阶段存在漏洞。

目的: 解决垂直联邦学习中隐私保护与模型效用之间的平衡问题，防止样本重建攻击，同时保持模型的性能和收敛性。

方法: 采用结构因果模型的理论基础，将共享表示分解为任务相关和任务无关组件。通过无监督表示学习解决优化问题，以在保留模型效用的同时减轻隐私泄露。

主要发现: CausShield在隐私保护、模型效用和计算效率方面 consistently 优于七种最先进的方法，包括InvL和URVFL。

结论: CausShield提供了一种有效的防御机制，能够在垂直联邦学习中实现全周期的隐私保护，同时保持模型的性能和收敛性。

翻译: Vertical federated learning (VFL) is a distributed learning paradigm that leverages vertically partitioned features across isolated parties without sharing raw samples; however, it remains vulnerable to active sample reconstruction attacks. Existing defenses fail to achieve a satisfactory trade-off between model utility and privacy protection, due to either suppressing task-relevant information alongside privacy-sensitive features or relying on end-to-end supervised training to converge the defense module, which exposes the model to early-epoch vulnerability. To address this challenge, we adopt a structural causal model (SCM) insight and construct CausShield. From a task-learning standpoint, causal features within a raw sample are those that are directly relevant and contributory to the learning objective, whereas non-causal features are task-irrelevant but often encode sample-specific private information, thereby facilitating reconstruction. Importantly, we lay a theoretical foundation to prove this insight. CausShield thus decomposes the shared representations between the client and the coordinating server in VFL into task-relevant and task-irrelevant components to ensure full-cycle privacy protection. Nonetheless, the decomposition is inherently challenging due to the dual objectives of preserving model utility while mitigating privacy leakage. We address this via a carefully formulated optimization problem, which is solved through unsupervised representation learning. We further theoretically prove that CausShield preserves the convergence behavior of standard VFL. Extensive experiments compare CausShield against seven SOTAs, including InvL (USENIX Security'25), and evaluate robustness against advanced reconstruction attacks such as URVFL (NDSS'25). Results demonstrate that CausShield consistently outperforms in privacy protection, model utility, and computational efficiency.

Abstract

Vertical federated learning (VFL) is a distributed learning paradigm that leverages vertically partitioned features across isolated parties without sharing raw samples; however, it remains vulnerable to active sample reconstruction attacks. Existing defenses fail to achieve a satisfactory trade-off between model utility and privacy protection, due to either suppressing task-relevant information alongside privacy-sensitive features or relying on end-to-end supervised training to converge the defense module, which exposes the model to early-epoch vulnerability. To address this challenge, we adopt a structural causal model (SCM) insight and construct CausShield. From a task-learning standpoint, causal features within a raw sample are those that are directly relevant and contributory to the learning objective, whereas non-causal features are task-irrelevant but often encode sample-specific private information, thereby facilitating reconstruction. Importantly, we lay a theoretical foundation to prove this insight. CausShield thus decomposes the shared representations between the client and the coordinating server in VFL into task-relevant and task-irrelevant components to ensure full-cycle privacy protection. Nonetheless, the decomposition is inherently challenging due to the dual objectives of preserving model utility while mitigating privacy leakage. We address this via a carefully formulated optimization problem, which is solved through unsupervised representation learning. We further theoretically prove that CausShield preserves the convergence behavior of standard VFL. Extensive experiments compare CausShield against seven SOTAs, including InvL (USENIX Security'25), and evaluate robustness against advanced reconstruction attacks such as URVFL (NDSS'25). Results demonstrate that CausShield consistently outperforms in privacy protection, model utility, and computational efficiency.

item.title: Have I Solved This Before? Retrieving Similar Segmentation Problems for Evolutionary Learning
item.author: Andreas Margraf, Henning Cui, Jörg Hähner
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种从算法设计转向深入分析检测问题的新型监测系统设计方法，通过逐步积累知识并存储于抽象系统模型中，实现解决方案的复用与增量优化，从而降低模型训练成本与后期修改风险。

背景: 在当代制造环境中，监测系统的可靠集成与稳固配置是实现高效率和高生产力的基本前提，但传感器类型与系统架构的设计需在早期高不确定性下做出。

目的: 旨在探索一种偏离传统监测系统的开发流程，通过复用和迁移已有解决方案，避免从头开始进行昂贵的模型训练，并提升设计过程的效率与可靠性。

方法: 提出逐步收集知识并存储于抽象系统模型中，以检索相似解决方案用于未来用例；分析过滤管道在不同但相似的分割问题中的跨域可迁移性；统计评估该“迁移学习”变体的优势；讨论简单模型在平衡复杂性、技术要求与可靠性之间的作用。

主要发现: 复用先前生成的处理管道可降低后期昂贵修改的风险；过滤管道在不同但相似的分割问题中具有跨域迁移潜力；该迁移学习变体在图像分割问题中展现出统计上的优势；简单模型有助于在设计过程中平衡复杂性、技术要求与可靠性。

结论: 通过抽象系统模型实现知识积累与解决方案复用，结合迁移学习策略与简单模型设计，可有效提升监测系统设计效率，降低开发成本，并在复杂性与可靠性之间取得平衡。

翻译: Reliable integration and solid configuration of monitoring systems constitute a fundamental prerequisites for achieving high efficiency and productivity in contemporary manufacturing environments. Design decisions on sensor type and system architecture have to be made at an early stage and under comparably high uncertainty. This work investigates a research direction that deviates from the traditional monitoring-system development process by shifting the attention from algorithm design to a deeper analysis of the inspection problem. In contrast to traditional design cycles, this paper proposes to gradually collect knowledge and store it in an abstract system model. This enables the retrieval of similar solutions for future use cases, preventing the need for expensive model training from scratch and allowing instead for the incremental refinement of existing base configurations. Reuse of previously generated pipelines reduces the risk of late and costly revisions. As there is little knowledge on cross-domain transferability of filter pipelines, this study analyzes the potential of retrieving filter pipelines to transfer them to different but similar segmentation problems. Finally, we statistically analyze the benefits of this `transfer learning' variant which is predominantly applied to image segmentation problems. In addition, we discuss how simple models help balancing the trade-off between complexity, technical requirements, and reliability in the design process.

Abstract

Reliable integration and solid configuration of monitoring systems constitute a fundamental prerequisites for achieving high efficiency and productivity in contemporary manufacturing environments. Design decisions on sensor type and system architecture have to be made at an early stage and under comparably high uncertainty. This work investigates a research direction that deviates from the traditional monitoring-system development process by shifting the attention from algorithm design to a deeper analysis of the inspection problem. In contrast to traditional design cycles, this paper proposes to gradually collect knowledge and store it in an abstract system model. This enables the retrieval of similar solutions for future use cases, preventing the need for expensive model training from scratch and allowing instead for the incremental refinement of existing base configurations. Reuse of previously generated pipelines reduces the risk of late and costly revisions. As there is little knowledge on cross-domain transferability of filter pipelines, this study analyzes the potential of retrieving filter pipelines to transfer them to different but similar segmentation problems. Finally, we statistically analyze the benefits of this `transfer learning' variant which is predominantly applied to image segmentation problems. In addition, we discuss how simple models help balancing the trade-off between complexity, technical requirements, and reliability in the design process.

item.title: Neural Field Tokenizations with Hierarchy and Spatial Locality Priors
item.author: Alonso Urbano, David W. Romero, Max Zimmer, Sebastian Pokutta
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LH-NeF的框架，用于学习连续信号的通用标记化表示。该框架通过保留局部性的层次编码器将原始坐标值场观测映射为结构化令牌，并在训练期间从这些令牌重建场。与基于元学习的方法相比，LH-NeF使用单次前向传播替代内循环优化，显著降低了内存使用并支持更大的批次大小。在图像、三维形状和气候场等跨模态任务中，该方法在重建和下游任务上的性能匹配或超过了现有基线。

背景: 神经场将数据参数化为从坐标到值的函数，为跨模态表示学习提供了统一框架。现有方法主要依赖逐样本元学习，由于内循环优化对内存要求高，扩展性较差。而替代的前馈编码方法通常引入特定模态的假设，牺牲了神经场学习的通用性。

目的: 利用局部性和层次性作为先验知识，在不牺牲模态无关性的前提下学习场表示，从而构建一种通用的连续信号表示学习方法。

方法: 提出LH-NeF框架，采用保留局部性的层次编码器将原始坐标值场观测映射为结构化令牌，并在训练过程中从令牌重建场。该方法用单次前向传播替代元学习的内循环优化。

主要发现: LH-NeF使用比最强模态无关基线少四十二倍的内存，并支持大一百三十三倍的批次大小。在图像、三维形状和气候场任务中，其学习到的表示在重建和下游任务上的性能匹配或优于模态无关、模态特定及专用生成神经场基线。

结论: LH-NeF通过结合局部性和层次性先验，成功实现了高效且通用的连续信号表示学习，在多种模态任务中展现出优越的性能和效率。

翻译: Neural fields parameterize data as functions from coordinates to values, providing a unified framework for representation learning across modalities. Existing approaches are dominated by per-sample meta-learning, which scales poorly due to memory-intensive inner-loop optimization. The natural alternative -- feed-forward encoding -- typically introduces modality-specific assumptions, sacrificing the generality that makes learning with neural fields attractive. We argue that locality and hierarchy are useful priors for learning field representations that can be injected without compromising modality-agnosticism. We propose LH-NeF, a framework to learn general-purpose tokenized representations of continuous signals. A locality-preserving hierarchical encoder maps raw coordinate-value field observations to structured tokens, from which the field is reconstructed during training. By replacing meta-learning's inner loop with a single forward pass, LH-NeF uses 42 times less memory and supports 133 times larger batches than the strongest modality-agnostic baseline. Across images, 3D shapes, and climate fields, our learned representations match or exceed performance of modality-agnostic, modality-specific, and specialized generative neural field baselines on both reconstruction and downstream tasks.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有神经场表示学习方法内存消耗过高、难以扩展以及缺乏空间结构信息的问题。当前主流方法依赖逐样本的迭代优化，导致训练时内存占用极大，严重限制了处理高分辨率数据或大规模数据集的能力。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为神经场是跨模态数据表示的统一框架，高效稳定的表示学习直接决定了图像生成、三维重建和科学计算等下游任务的实际应用效果与性能上限。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有方法在保持跨模态通用性时，往往面临结构缺失或依赖逐样本优化导致内存瓶颈的矛盾。为此，他们提出将层次结构与空间局部性作为核心先验，通过单前向传播替代复杂的内循环优化，以实现高效且通用的特征表示。在设计上，该方法主要借鉴了分层感知机的架构，但针对连续信号的空间特性进行了关键改进，利用空间填充曲线对输入坐标进行重排序，确保模型分组处理时能严格遵循空间局部性，从而避免了传统方法对特定模态结构的依赖。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是引入层次结构与空间局部性作为先验知识，在不依赖特定数据模态的前提下，将连续信号转化为结构化的标记表示，从而替代传统方法中耗时的逐样本优化过程。整体流程分为两步：首先通过局部性排序将原始观测数据分组，并经由多层分组注意力机制生成具有空间结构的标记；随后在渲染阶段，根据查询坐标定位到最近的标记组，通过交叉注意力聚合信息并解码出最终的场值。整个过程通过端到端的重建误差进行训练，大幅降低了内存消耗并提升了扩展性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该框架的核心创新在于利用保序的空间分组与分层注意力机制，将连续信号的坐标与数值直接转化为具有空间结构的令牌表示。与以往依赖逐样本元学习或自解码的方法不同，该方法仅通过单次前向传播完成编码，彻底消除了内存瓶颈并大幅提升了训练批次规模。同时，它在保持跨模态通用性的前提下显式引入了层次结构与空间局部性先验，避免了传统方法中结构设计与模态特异性之间的权衡。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种通用的神经场表示学习框架，通过引入局部性与层次性先验将数据观测转化为结构化令牌，以单次前向传播替代传统逐样本优化，在大幅降低内存消耗并提升训练批次的同时，在图像、三维形状和气候数据等多种模态上实现了领先的重建与下游任务性能。

Abstract

Neural fields parameterize data as functions from coordinates to values, providing a unified framework for representation learning across modalities. Existing approaches are dominated by per-sample meta-learning, which scales poorly due to memory-intensive inner-loop optimization. The natural alternative -- feed-forward encoding -- typically introduces modality-specific assumptions, sacrificing the generality that makes learning with neural fields attractive. We argue that locality and hierarchy are useful priors for learning field representations that can be injected without compromising modality-agnosticism. We propose LH-NeF, a framework to learn general-purpose tokenized representations of continuous signals. A locality-preserving hierarchical encoder maps raw coordinate-value field observations to structured tokens, from which the field is reconstructed during training. By replacing meta-learning's inner loop with a single forward pass, LH-NeF uses 42$\times$ less memory and supports 133$\times$ larger batches than the strongest modality-agnostic baseline. Across images, 3D shapes, and climate fields, our learned representations match or exceed performance of modality-agnostic, modality-specific, and specialized generative neural field baselines on both reconstruction and downstream tasks.

item.title: Empowering Feed-Forward Reconstruction Models with Metric Scale via Satellite Images
item.author: Xianghui Ze, Yongjian Luo, Mengjun Chao, Zhenbo Song, Jianfeng Lu, Yujiao Shi
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种卫星引导的框架，用于解决前馈三维重建模型中的尺度模糊问题。

背景: 前馈三维重建模型在多样场景中展现出强大的泛化能力，但通常只能恢复具有未知全局尺度的几何结构。这种尺度模糊限制了其在需要环境度量理解的应用中的使用。现有的度量重建方法通常依赖大规模度量标注或精确相机标定，这些在现实世界中往往成本高昂或不可靠。

目的: 解决前馈三维重建中的尺度模糊问题，实现绝对尺度的推断、场景几何的优化以及度量坐标系下的相机位姿估计。

方法: 利用现成的卫星图像作为全局度量参考。给定粗略相机位姿，检索局部卫星图块，并通过双向跨视图交互将其与前馈重建主干网络集成。通过强制重建场景与卫星参考之间的一致性，模型推断绝对尺度、优化场景几何并估计度量坐标系下的相机位姿。

主要发现: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Oxford RobotCar数据集上的实验表明，该方法在度量深度估计、多视图点云重建和跨视图相机定位方面均取得一致改进，同时保持了跨数据集和地理区域的强大泛化能力。

结论: 卫星引导框架有效解决了前馈三维重建中的尺度模糊问题，提升了度量重建性能，并保持了良好的泛化性。

翻译: 前馈三维重建模型最近在多样场景中展现出强大的泛化能力，但大多数模型只能恢复具有未知全局尺度的几何结构。这种尺度模糊限制了它们在需要环境度量理解的应用中的使用。现有的度量重建方法通常依赖大规模度量标注或精确相机标定，这些在现实世界中往往成本高昂或不可靠。我们提出了一种卫星引导的框架来解决前馈三维重建中的尺度模糊问题。核心思想是利用现成的卫星图像作为全局度量参考。给定粗略相机位姿，我们的方法检索局部卫星图块，并通过双向跨视图交互将其与前馈重建主干网络集成。通过强制重建场景与卫星参考之间的一致性，模型推断绝对尺度、优化场景几何并估计度量坐标系下的相机位姿。在KITTI、nuScenes和Oxford RobotCar数据集上的实验表明，该方法在度量深度估计、多视图点云重建和跨视图相机定位方面均取得一致改进，同时保持了跨数据集和地理区域的强大泛化能力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决前馈三维重建模型无法恢复场景绝对尺度的问题。通过引入卫星图像作为全局度量参考，模型能够结合粗略的相机位置信息推断出真实的物理尺度并重建精确的三维场景。这一问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为自动驾驶、增强现实和具身智能等实际应用都依赖对环境的精确度量理解，而解决尺度模糊能让这些高效模型直接落地，同时避免了对昂贵标注数据或高精度相机参数的依赖。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有前馈三维重建模型存在尺度模糊且依赖昂贵标注或精确相机参数的问题，提出利用广泛可用的卫星图像作为全局度量参考。设计思路上，他们仅依赖粗略的位置信息检索局部卫星图块，通过双向跨视图交互机制融合地面与卫星视角特征，并引入尺度因子、坐标偏移和几何修正预测头，结合对齐一致性损失实现绝对尺度恢复与相机定位。该方法借鉴了现有的前馈重建骨干网络，通过冻结原网络并克隆可训练分支来保留其泛化能力，同时吸收了基于卫星图像的相机定位技术思路，将其核心思想延伸至三维几何重建任务中。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用广泛可用的卫星图像作为全局度量参考，以解决前馈三维重建模型中固有的绝对尺度模糊问题。整体实现流程首先根据粗略的相机位置检索对应的局部卫星图像，随后通过冻结的基础重建网络处理地面视角图像，并克隆出一个可训练的卫星分支进行双向特征交互。模型基于交互后的特征预测全局尺度因子、坐标偏移量和几何修正项，最终将无尺度的重建结果转换为具有绝对尺度的三维场景与相机位姿。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次将卫星影像作为全局度量参考引入前馈三维重建模型，通过双向跨视图交互机制，仅凭粗略的相机位置即可推断绝对尺度并联合估计精确的相机姿态与三维几何。相比以往依赖海量标注数据或高精度相机参数的方法，本工作无需密集度量标注，直接利用广泛可用的卫星图像解决尺度模糊问题，显著降低了实际应用中的成本与对硬件精度的依赖。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种利用卫星图像作为全局度量参考的框架，通过地面与卫星视角的双向特征交互，有效解决了前馈三维重建模型的尺度模糊问题，实现了基于粗略定位的绝对尺度三维重建与相机位姿联合估计。

Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have recently shown strong generalization across diverse scenes, yet most of them recover geometry only up to an unknown global scale. This scale ambiguity limits their use in applications that require metric understanding of the environment. Existing metric reconstruction methods commonly rely on large-scale metric annotations or accurate camera calibration, both of which are costly or unreliable in many real-world settings. We propose a satellite-guided framework for resolving scale ambiguity in feed-forward 3D reconstruction. The key idea is to use readily available satellite imagery as a global metric reference. Given a coarse camera pose, our method retrieves a local satellite patch and integrates it with a feed-forward reconstruction backbone through bidirectional cross-view interaction. By enforcing consistency between the reconstructed scene and the satellite reference, the model infers absolute scale, refines scene geometry, and estimates camera pose in a metric coordinate frame. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Oxford RobotCar show consistent improvements in metric depth estimation, multi-view point-cloud reconstruction, and cross-view camera localization, while preserving strong generalization across datasets and geographic regions.

item.title: SegmentAnyTreeV2: Scaling Transformer-Based Tree Instance Segmentation Across Sensors, Platforms, and Forests
item.author: Maciej Wielgosz, Stefano Puliti, Rasmus Astrup
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为SegmentAnyTreeV2的传感器和平台无关的框架，用于森林点云的语义和实例分割。该模型结合了基于序列化的Point Transformer v3骨干网络、轻量级语义头和专注于树的交叉注意力掩码解码器。通过语义预测限制实例解码范围，并利用实例感知查询初始化、一对多种子监督和不对称掩码评分等技术，提高了在密集和结构复杂林分中的分离效果。同时引入了FOR-instance v3基准数据集，包含427个场景和26496棵标注树木。在FOR-instanceV2测试集上，该模型在精确率、召回率、F1分数、覆盖率和语义平均交并比等指标上均优于先前的学习方法，并在零样本评估中展现出强大的跨领域泛化能力。

背景: 森林点云的语义和实例分割在林业研究中具有重要意义，但现有方法在密集和结构复杂的林分中面临挑战。

目的: 开发一种能够高效、准确地进行森林点云语义和实例分割的框架，并评估其在不同环境和平台上的泛化能力。

方法: 提出SegmentAnyTreeV2框架，结合Point Transformer v3骨干网络、轻量级语义头和专注于树的交叉注意力掩码解码器。引入FOR-instance v3基准数据集，包含427个场景和26496棵标注树木，涵盖多种生物群落、森林结构和激光雷达平台。

主要发现: 在FOR-instanceV2测试集上，SegmentAnyTreeV2实现了90.5%的精确率、80.2%的召回率、85.0%的F1分数、90.7%的覆盖率和87.6%的语义平均交并比，优于先前的学习方法。零样本评估显示其在独立站点上具有强大的跨领域泛化能力。

结论: SegmentAnyTreeV2框架在森林点云的语义和实例分割任务中表现出色，具有高精度、高召回率和良好的跨领域泛化能力，为林业研究提供了有效的工具。

翻译: 我们提出了SegmentAnyTreeV2，这是一个传感器和平台无关的框架，用于森林点云的语义和实例分割。该模型结合了基于序列化的Point Transformer v3骨干网络、轻量级语义头和专注于树的交叉注意力掩码解码器。语义预测将实例解码限制在树木类体素中，而实例感知的查询初始化、一对多种子监督和不对称掩码评分提高了在密集和结构复杂林分中的分离效果。我们进一步引入了FOR-instance v3，这是一个扩展的基准测试，包含427个场景和26496棵标注树木，涵盖不同的生物群落、森林结构和激光雷达平台。在FOR-instanceV2测试集上，SegmentAnyTreeV2实现了90.5%的精确率、80.2%的召回率、85.0%的F1分数、90.7%的覆盖率和87.6%的语义平均交并比，在实例检测和掩码完整性方面均优于先前的学习方法。在独立站点的零样本评估进一步证明了其强大的跨领域泛化能力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有森林点云分割模型在应对复杂林分结构、多尺度树木分布、密集遮挡以及跨传感器和跨地域数据时泛化能力不足的问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为准确分割单株树木是森林资源调查与生态监测的基础，而现有方法难以直接应用于多样化的自然森林和不同采集平台，严重制约了林业自动化管理与大规模精准林业的实际部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法在复杂森林结构中分割精度不足的问题，通过解耦语义与实例分割路径来重新设计架构。他们借鉴了同类查询解码模型的设计思路，但将其与轻量级语义预测分离，并引入基于序列化排序的Transformer骨干网络以高效处理大规模点云。同时，该方法参考了实例感知采样与种子监督机制，通过仅聚焦树木体素和非对称掩码评分策略，提升了密集场景下的实例分离能力。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将语义分类与树木实例分割解耦为两条非对称路径，利用序列化注意力网络高效提取空间点云特征，并通过轻量级分类头直接输出语义结果，同时让专用解码器仅聚焦于树木实例的分组与轮廓生成。整体流程首先对点云进行圆柱形裁剪与网格化，骨干网络提取特征后分别输入语义分类模块和实例感知采样模块以生成初始查询种子。随后，实例解码器在交叉注意力机制下将查询种子迭代优化为单棵树木的二值掩码，且注意力计算范围被严格限制在树木类别的网格内。最后，系统通过重叠区域的并行处理与基于置信度的全局合并策略，输出完整林分的树木分割结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种将语义分类与实例分割解耦的森林点云处理架构。与以往方法普遍采用稀疏卷积网络或将两项任务耦合在同一个重型解码器中不同，本文引入了基于序列化注意力机制的骨干网络，并将语义预测移至独立的轻量级分支。实例解码器因此能完全专注于树木点云，通过预先过滤非树木区域、采用非对称掩码评分路径以及一对多种子监督策略，有效克服了传统方法在密集、多尺度及跨传感器复杂森林场景下容易出现的分割模糊与漏检问题，实现了更高的精度与跨域泛化能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种结合序列化Transformer骨干网络与树状交叉注意力解码器的统一分割框架，通过解耦语义与实例分割路径并引入针对性监督策略，实现了跨传感器、平台与森林类型的高精度点云树木实例分割，同时发布了扩展基准数据集以验证其泛化能力。

Abstract

We present SegmentAnyTreeV2, a sensor- and platform-agnostic framework for semantic and instance segmentation of forest point clouds. The model combines a serialization-based Point Transformer v3 backbone with a lightweight semantic head and a tree-focused cross-attention mask decoder. Semantic predictions restrict instance decoding to tree-class voxels, while instance-aware query initialization, one-to-many seed supervision, and asymmetric mask scoring improve separation in dense and structurally complex stands. We further introduce FOR-instance v3, an expanded benchmark comprising 427 scenes and 26,496 annotated trees across diverse biomes, forest structures, and LiDAR platforms. On the FOR-instanceV2 test split, SegmentAnyTreeV2 achieves 90.5% precision, 80.2% recall, 85.0% F1, 90.7% coverage, and 87.6% semantic mIoU, outperforming previous learning-based methods in both instance detection and mask completeness. Zero-shot evaluation on independent sites further demonstrates strong cross-domain generalization.

item.title: Public Machine Learning Solver Framework for Novices in the Machine Learning Domain
item.author: Lokman Saleh, Hafedh Mili, Mounir Boukadoum
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种新的半自动化机器学习平台，旨在为非专家用户提供智能解决方案推荐。该平台结合了专家算法选择指南和基于标准的决策支持系统，通过自动提取数据特征、集成迁移学习和一阶逻辑推理，为用户推荐量身定制的完整机器学习流水线。该平台具有用户友好的界面，并与众包平台连接以确保持续更新，是首个免费公开访问的在线框架，以结构化、透明的方式指导非专家解决机器学习问题。

背景: 解决机器学习问题通常复杂且仅限专家进行。过去二十年中，出现了支持非专家的系统，主要分为三类：完全自动化的自动机器学习系统、用于算法选择的专家速查表，以及使用选择标准（如准确性、透明度、数据要求）的决策支持系统。

目的: 提出一种新的平台，结合专家速查表和决策支持系统，为非专家用户提供半自动化的智能解决方案推荐。

方法: 该平台建议完整的流水线而非单一算法，集成专家定义的选择标准、迁移学习，并自动从用户提供的数据集中提取数据特征（如类别不平衡、缺失值）。使用一阶逻辑在知识库上进行推理，推荐按相关性排序的合适算法。平台具有用户友好的界面，并连接到机器学习专家众包平台以确保持续更新。平台采用增量构建方式，允许无缝集成新算法、标准和领域知识。

主要发现: 该平台是首个免费公开访问的在线框架，系统地捕获并操作化专家知识，以结构化、透明的方式指导非专家解决机器学习问题。

结论: 该平台通过结合专家知识和自动化技术，为非专家提供了有效的机器学习问题解决支持，具有可扩展性和持续更新的能力。

翻译: Solving machine learning problems is complex and typically reserved for experts. Over the past two decades, systems have emerged to support non-experts. Based on our review, we identify three categories: (1) fully automated AutoML systems, (2) expert cheat sheets for algorithm selection, and (3) decision-support systems using selection criteria (accuracy, transparency, data requirements). We propose a new platform combining categories 2 and 3 to deliver semi-automated, intelligent solution recommendations for non-experts. Unlike existing approaches that recommend a single algorithm, our platform suggests a complete pipeline tailored to the user's problem. It integrates expert-defined selection criteria with transfer learning and automatically extracts data characteristics (e.g., class imbalance, missing values) from user-provided datasets. The platform uses first-order logic to reason over its knowledge base and recommends suitable algorithms ranked by relevance. It features a user-friendly interface and connects to a crowdsourcing platform for ML experts, ensuring continuous updates. The platform is built incrementally, allowing seamless integration of new algorithms, criteria, and domain knowledge. To our knowledge, this is the first free, publicly accessible online framework that systematically captures and operationalizes expert knowledge to guide non-experts in solving ML problems in a structured, transparent manner.

Abstract

Solving machine learning problems is complex and typically reserved for experts. Over the past two decades, systems have emerged to support non-experts. Based on our review, we identify three categories: (1) fully automated AutoML systems, (2) expert cheat sheets for algorithm selection, and (3) decision-support systems using selection criteria (accuracy, transparency, data requirements). We propose a new platform combining categories 2 and 3 to deliver semi-automated, intelligent solution recommendations for non-experts. Unlike existing approaches that recommend a single algorithm, our platform suggests a complete pipeline tailored to the user's problem. It integrates expert-defined selection criteria with transfer learning and automatically extracts data characteristics (e.g., class imbalance, missing values) from user-provided datasets. The platform uses first-order logic to reason over its knowledge base and recommends suitable algorithms ranked by relevance. It features a user-friendly interface and connects to a crowdsourcing platform for ML experts, ensuring continuous updates. The platform is built incrementally, allowing seamless integration of new algorithms, criteria, and domain knowledge. To our knowledge, this is the first free, publicly accessible online framework that systematically captures and operationalizes expert knowledge to guide non-experts in solving ML problems in a structured, transparent manner.

item.title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
item.author: Yiheng Wang, Yueqian Lin, Lichen Zhu, Yudong Liu, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对多模态大语言模型在视频理解中检测缺失答案的能力进行了诊断性研究，发现模型普遍倾向于选择看似合理的干扰项而非识别出无有效选项的情况，且该问题在时序推理任务和密集帧采样下更为严重。尽管思维链提示能提升检测率，但效果仍不理想，表明仅靠提示策略不足以解决此系统性缺陷，需引入显式的检测机制。

背景: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但其回答的可靠性仍未得到充分探索。

目的: 诊断多模态大语言模型在视频理解中检测缺失答案的能力，即在正确答案被故意从候选集中排除时，模型能否可靠地识别出没有有效选项存在。

方法: 在三种设置下评估模型的缺失答案检测行为：一是带有“以上皆非”选项的多项选择题；二是带有检测指令的开放式生成；三是没有任何指导的标准评估。研究跨越了多样化的模型和基准测试，并探索了思维链提示作为缓解策略。

主要发现: 多模态大语言模型 overwhelmingly 选择看似合理的干扰项而不是检测缺失答案。这种失败在时序推理任务中更为明显，并且随着帧采样的密度增加而恶化。虽然思维链提示能显著提高检测率，但性能仍然令人不满意。

结论: 这些发现暴露了缺失答案检测中的系统性失败，并强调了在多模态系统中引入显式检测机制的必要性。

翻译: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice questions augmented with an ``None of the Above'' option, open-ended generation with a detection instruction, and standard evaluation without any guidance. Across a diverse set of models and benchmarks, we find that MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors rather than detecting the absent answer. This failure is more pronounced in temporal reasoning tasks and worsens with denser frame sampling. We further explore chain-of-thought prompting as a mitigation strategy and find that while it substantially improves detection rates, performance remains unsatisfactory, suggesting that prompting-based strategies alone are insufficient to fully address this limitation. These findings expose a systematic failure in absent answer detection and highlight the need for explicit detection mechanisms in multimodal systems.

Abstract

Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice questions augmented with an ``None of the Above'' option, open-ended generation with a detection instruction, and standard evaluation without any guidance. Across a diverse set of models and benchmarks, we find that MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors rather than detecting the absent answer. This failure is more pronounced in temporal reasoning tasks and worsens with denser frame sampling. We further explore chain-of-thought prompting as a mitigation strategy and find that while it substantially improves detection rates, performance remains unsatisfactory, suggesting that prompting-based strategies alone are insufficient to fully address this limitation. These findings expose a systematic failure in absent answer detection and highlight the need for explicit detection mechanisms in multimodal systems.

item.title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
item.author: Ziang Li, Dongzhou Cheng, Yibin Wang, Shiyue Wang, Xiaoyang Xu, Lingxuan Weng, Juan Wang, Jiaqi Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种轻量级世界动作模型Light-WAM，用于高效的机器人操作。该模型通过紧凑的视频主干和降采样潜在空间中的未来视频监督，降低了视频联合训练的成本，同时保留了其对表示学习的益处。在动作预测方面，Light-WAM引入了StateFusionActionExpert，通过融合多层主干的适应状态，直接预测动作块。实验表明，Light-WAM在LIBERO上保持了强大的性能，在RoboTwin 2.0上实现了可用的多任务性能，同时仅使用0.44B可训练参数，推理延迟为72.03ms，峰值GPU内存为4.1GiB，并提高了训练吞吐量。

背景: 世界动作模型通过引入未来预测作为额外的训练目标，扩展了机器人策略学习，鼓励策略在表示中编码任务相关的时序结构。然而，当前的世界动作模型通常依赖大规模生成架构，导致训练成本高和推理延迟大，难以部署为高效的闭环策略。

目的: 提出一种轻量级世界动作模型，以实现高效的机器人操作。

方法: Light-WAM采用紧凑的视频主干，并在降采样潜在空间中进行未来视频监督，以降低视频联合训练的成本。对于动作预测，引入StateFusionActionExpert，从多个主干层读取适应状态，通过查询池化融合，直接预测动作块。

主要发现: Light-WAM在LIBERO上保持了强大的性能，在RoboTwin 2.0上实现了可用的多任务性能，仅使用0.44B可训练参数，推理延迟为72.03ms，峰值GPU内存为4.1GiB，并提高了训练吞吐量。

结论: Light-WAM通过轻量级设计实现了高效的机器人操作，同时保持了强大的性能。

翻译: World Action Models (WAMs) extend robot policy learning by incorporating future prediction as an additional training objective, encouraging the policy to encode task-relevant temporal structure in its representations. Current WAMs often rely on large-scale generative architectures that incur high training costs and inference latency, making them difficult to deploy as efficient closed-loop policies. We propose Light-WAM, a lightweight World Action Model for efficient robot manipulation. Specifically, it is built with a compact video backbone and performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space, reducing the cost of video co-training while retaining its benefits for representation learning. For action prediction, Light-WAM introduces the StateFusionActionExpert, which reads adapted states from multiple backbone layers, fuses them through learned-query pooling, and directly predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. This design provides an efficient interface between video backbone representations and robot actions, avoiding the need for heavy generative action experts. Experiments demonstrate that Light-WAM maintains strong performance on LIBERO and achieves usable multi-task performance on RoboTwin 2.0, while using only 0.44B trainable parameters. It also achieves 72.03ms inference latency with 4.1GiB peak GPU memory and improved training throughput.

Abstract

World Action Models (WAMs) extend robot policy learning by incorporating future prediction as an additional training objective, encouraging the policy to encode task-relevant temporal structure in its representations. Current WAMs often rely on large-scale generative architectures that incur high training costs and inference latency, making them difficult to deploy as efficient closed-loop policies. We propose Light-WAM, a lightweight World Action Model for efficient robot manipulation. Specifically, it is built with a compact video backbone and performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space, reducing the cost of video co-training while retaining its benefits for representation learning. For action prediction, Light-WAM introduces the StateFusionActionExpert, which reads adapted states from multiple backbone layers, fuses them through learned-query pooling, and directly predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. This design provides an efficient interface between video backbone representations and robot actions, avoiding the need for heavy generative action experts. Experiments demonstrate that Light-WAM maintains strong performance on LIBERO and achieves usable multi-task performance on RoboTwin 2.0, while using only 0.44B trainable parameters. It also achieves 72.03ms inference latency with 4.1GiB peak GPU memory and improved training throughput.

item.title: Set-Based Transformer for Atmospheric Compensation in Standoff LWIR Hyperspectral Imaging
item.author: Perez, Fabian, Quintero, Nicolas, Acevedo, Jeferson, Rueda-Chacon, Hoover
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种轻量级的基于集合的深度学习框架，用于被动长波红外超光谱成像的大气补偿。

背景: 被动长波红外超光谱成像在 standoff 几何条件下依赖于大气吸收和发射以及反射辐射，因此大气补偿对于获取感兴趣目标的信息至关重要。然而，由于实际和建模的困难，这一补偿在很大程度上被忽视了。

目的: 提出一种轻量级的基于集合的深度学习框架，以联合估计透射率、大气路径辐射和共享的下行光谱。

方法: 使用在多个不同 standoff 距离下收集的多重辐射测量数据作为输入，并采用稀疏自编码器分析学习到的表示。

主要发现: 尽管缺乏位置监督，但学习到的表示中的几个潜在特征在测试数据的地理相干子集上激活。在 MODTRAN 生成的 standoff 长波红外数据集上的实验表明，所有估计产品都具有较低的光谱失真。

结论: 该框架能够有效进行大气补偿，且数据集和代码已公开。

翻译: Passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral imaging under a standoff geometry depends on atmospheric absorption and emission, as well as reflected radiance, thus making atmospheric compensation essential to get knowledge of a target of interest. Despite its importance, this compensation has been largely overlooked due to its practical and modeling difficulty. In this paper, we present a lightweight set-based deep learning framework that takes multiple radiance measurements, collected at different standoff ranges, as input and jointly estimates transmittance, atmospheric path radiance, and a shared downwelling spectrum. We analyze the learned representation with a sparse autoencoder and observe that several latent features do activate on geographically coherent subsets of the test data despite the absence of location supervision. Experiments on a MODTRAN generated standoff LWIR dataset demonstrate low spectral distortion across all estimated products. The dataset and code is publicly available at: this https URL

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决远距离红外高光谱成像中的大气干扰消除问题，旨在通过不同距离的测量数据联合反演大气透过率、大气自身辐射以及环境下行辐射。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为大气吸收与发射会严重扭曲原始测量数据，只有准确补偿这些干扰，才能还原目标的真实物理特性，从而保障安防监控、自动驾驶和灾害监测等下游应用的可靠性。由于该问题建模复杂且长期缺乏有效方法，本研究为此提供了轻量级且具备可解释性的深度学习解决方案。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对远距离观测中大气效应随距离变化的难题，将不同距离的多组辐射测量视为无序集合进行联合处理。他们借鉴了集合变换器架构，设计了满足输入顺序无关特性的编码器，并分别构建三个解码分支以输出透射率、上行辐射和共享下行光谱，同时引入稀疏自编码器解析模型内部特征。该方法明确借鉴了集合变换器与稀疏自编码器等现有深度学习模型，并针对传统星载或机载大气补偿方法在近距离多距离场景下的局限性进行了专门改进。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将不同距离获取的多组红外辐射数据视为无序集合，通过深度学习模型联合反演大气透射率、上行辐射以及全局共享的下行辐射光谱。整体实现流程首先利用集合编码器提取输入数据的潜在特征，随后将特征分流至三个专用分支，其中两个分支分别逐条预测对应距离的大气透射率和上行辐射，另一个分支通过注意力池化聚合生成统一的下行辐射光谱，最终通过最小化预测结果与真实数据的误差完成模型训练。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种轻量级的集合深度学习框架，能够直接处理不同距离获取的多组辐射测量数据，并联合估计大气透射率、上行辐射和共享的下行光谱。研究还引入了稀疏自编码器对模型内部特征进行可解释性分析，并首次公开了用于该任务的模拟数据集。与以往主要面向卫星或航空垂直观测、或依赖已知距离与查找表的方法不同，该工作专门针对近水平且距离多变的远距离观测场景，无需预设数据顺序即可自适应处理几何依赖性强的大气补偿问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种用于远距离被动长波红外成像大气补偿的轻量级集合深度学习框架，并首次公开了基于大气传输模型生成的相关模拟数据集。

Abstract

Passive long-wave infrared (LWIR) hyperspectral imaging under a standoff geometry depends on atmospheric absorption and emission, as well as reflected radiance, thus making atmospheric compensation essential to get knowledge of a target of interest. Despite its importance, this compensation has been largely overlooked due to its practical and modeling difficulty. In this paper, we present a lightweight set-based deep learning framework that takes multiple radiance measurements, collected at different standoff ranges, as input and jointly estimates transmittance, atmospheric path radiance, and a shared downwelling spectrum. We analyze the learned representation with a sparse autoencoder and observe that several latent features do activate on geographically coherent subsets of the test data despite the absence of location supervision. Experiments on a MODTRAN generated standoff LWIR dataset demonstrate low spectral distortion across all estimated products. The dataset and code is publicly available at: this https URL

item.title: SMI: Efficient Self-Supervised Learning via Mutual-Information-Inspired Dependency Optimization
item.author: Pritam Mishra, Coloma Ballester, Dimosthenis Karatzas
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为语义互信息的轻量级自监督学习目标，该目标基于高斯假设下的互信息依赖公式化，通过非线性变换成对相关性在样本级依赖矩阵上进行优化，从而在降低计算复杂度的同时实现了具有竞争力的表示学习性能。

背景: 自监督学习在表示学习方面取得了显著性能，但许多现有方法依赖大批次大小、内存库、动量编码器或全局同步机制，这显著增加了计算成本和训练复杂性。

目的: 提出一种轻量级的自监督学习目标，以减少计算复杂度和训练复杂性，同时保持或提升表示学习性能。

方法: 提出语义互信息，这是一种从互信息启发的依赖公式化中衍生出的轻量级自监督目标。它基于高斯假设，不同于在高维特征相关性矩阵上操作的常规相关性匹配目标，SMI通过对成对相关性进行非线性变换，在样本级依赖矩阵上进行优化。

主要发现: 在ImageNet上使用ResNet-50主干网络的实验表明，SMI实现了与最先进自监督学习方法相竞争的性能，同时显著降低了计算复杂性。在多个低资源基准测试中，SMI在细粒度数据集上持续提高了迁移性能。优化动态和表示几何分析表明，SMI改善了对齐冗余平衡，增加了特征多样性，并产生了更空间局部化的语义表示。

结论: 非线性依赖优化为常规基于相关性的自监督学习目标提供了一种有效且计算高效的替代方案。

翻译: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has achieved remarkable representation learning performance, but many existing methods rely on large batch sizes, memory banks, momentum encoders, or global synchronization mechanisms that substantially increase computational cost and training complexity. In this work, we propose Semantic Mutual Information (SMI), a lightweight self-supervised objective derived from a mutual-information-inspired dependency formulation under Gaussian assumptions. Unlike conventional correlation matching objectives that operate on high-dimensional feature correlation matrices, SMI performs optimization on a sample-level dependency matrix through a nonlinear transformation of pairwise correlations. This formulation induces distinct optimization dynamics that emphasize strongly dependent semantic pairs while maintaining representation diversity. Experimental results on ImageNet using a ResNet-50 backbone demonstrate that SMI achieves competitive linear evaluation performance relative to state-of-the-art SSL approaches while substantially reducing computational complexity. Across multiple low-resource benchmarks, SMI consistently improves transfer performance over Barlow Twins, particularly on fine-grained datasets. Furthermore, analyses of optimization dynamics and representation geometry suggest improved alignment--redundancy balance, greater feature diversity, and more spatially localized semantic representations. These results indicate that nonlinear dependency optimization provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to conventional correlation-based self-supervised learning objectives.

Abstract

Self-supervised learning (SSL) has achieved remarkable representation learning performance, but many existing methods rely on large batch sizes, memory banks, momentum encoders, or global synchronization mechanisms that substantially increase computational cost and training complexity. In this work, we propose Semantic Mutual Information (SMI), a lightweight self-supervised objective derived from a mutual-information-inspired dependency formulation under Gaussian assumptions. Unlike conventional correlation matching objectives that operate on high-dimensional feature correlation matrices, SMI performs optimization on a sample-level dependency matrix through a nonlinear transformation of pairwise correlations. This formulation induces distinct optimization dynamics that emphasize strongly dependent semantic pairs while maintaining representation diversity. Experimental results on ImageNet using a ResNet-50 backbone demonstrate that SMI achieves competitive linear evaluation performance relative to state-of-the-art SSL approaches while substantially reducing computational complexity. Across multiple low-resource benchmarks, SMI consistently improves transfer performance over Barlow Twins, particularly on fine-grained datasets. Furthermore, analyses of optimization dynamics and representation geometry suggest improved alignment--redundancy balance, greater feature diversity, and more spatially localized semantic representations. These results indicate that nonlinear dependency optimization provides an effective and computationally efficient alternative to conventional correlation-based self-supervised learning objectives.

item.title: Uncertainty-Aware Intention Prediction for Human-to-Robot Assembly Teleoperation
item.author: Fnu Heman, Yixuan Wang, Kolin Xu, Conner Wallace, John Dang, Akhil Joshi, Jun Sheng, Pinhas Ben-Tzvi, Mingyu Cai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种不确定性感知的人到机器人意图预测框架，结合分层迁移学习、共形预测模块和视觉语言模型引导的片段校正，用于辅助遥操作中的动作识别、时间分割、意图预测和错误检测。

背景: 在人类与机器人协作的辅助遥操作中，准确的意图预测对于实现及时可靠的机器人协助至关重要。然而，机器人遥操作演示成本高昂且受硬件限制，而人类演示更容易收集并提供丰富的时间结构。

目的: 解决机器人遥操作演示数据稀缺的问题，利用人类演示数据实现可扩展的预训练，以提高机器人动作分割的鲁棒性和不确定性感知能力。

方法: 采用分层迁移学习，先在人类手部演示上预训练MS-TCN++模型，再用有限的机器人遥操作数据进行微调；引入共形预测模块提供帧级预测集和统计覆盖保证；使用视觉语言模型引导的片段校正，对低置信度或时间不确定的片段进行选择性审查。

主要发现: 在包含22个动作类别的机器人组装演示实验中，仅使用16个机器人演示进行人机微调，将机器人测试集编辑分数从70.50提升至80.70；编辑安全的视觉语言模型校正进一步将帧准确率从45.21%提升至46.42%，并提高了F1@25和F1@50指标，同时保持编辑分数不变。

结论: 人类演示数据可作为可扩展的预训练数据，用于构建鲁棒且具备不确定性感知能力的机器人动作分割系统。

翻译: In assisted teleoperation for human-robot collaboration, accurate intention prediction is critical for enabling timely and reliable robotic assistance during long-horizon manipulation and assembly tasks. These systems require continuous understanding of user behavior to recognize actions, anticipate intentions, and detect mistakes in real time. However, robot teleoperation demonstrations are costly and hardware-limited, whereas human demonstrations are easier to collect and provide rich temporal structure. To address this challenge, we propose an uncertainty-aware human-to-robot intention prediction framework that combines: (1) hierarchical transfer learning, where MS-TCN++ is pretrained on human hand demonstrations and fine-tuned on limited robot teleoperation data to capture low-level actions and high-level task intentions; (2) a conformal prediction module that provides frame-level prediction sets with statistical coverage guarantees for reliable uncertainty quantification and early intention estimation; and (3) VLM-guided segment correction, which selectively reviews low-confidence or temporally uncertain segments using visual and temporal context. The framework supports action recognition, temporal segmentation, intention anticipation, and mistake detection for assisted teleoperation. Experiments on robot assembly demonstrations with 22 action classes show that human-to-robot fine-tuning improves the robot test-set Edit score from 70.50 to 80.70 using only 16 robot demonstrations. Edit-safe VLM correction further improves frame accuracy from 45.21% to 46.42% and increases F1@25 and F1@50 while preserving the Edit score. These results show that human demonstrations provide scalable pretraining data for robust, uncertainty-aware robot action segmentation. Code and data: project website.

Abstract

In assisted teleoperation for human-robot collaboration, accurate intention prediction is critical for enabling timely and reliable robotic assistance during long-horizon manipulation and assembly tasks. These systems require continuous understanding of user behavior to recognize actions, anticipate intentions, and detect mistakes in real time. However, robot teleoperation demonstrations are costly and hardware-limited, whereas human demonstrations are easier to collect and provide rich temporal structure. To address this challenge, we propose an uncertainty-aware human-to-robot intention prediction framework that combines: (1) hierarchical transfer learning, where MS-TCN++ is pretrained on human hand demonstrations and fine-tuned on limited robot teleoperation data to capture low-level actions and high-level task intentions; (2) a conformal prediction module that provides frame-level prediction sets with statistical coverage guarantees for reliable uncertainty quantification and early intention estimation; and (3) VLM-guided segment correction, which selectively reviews low-confidence or temporally uncertain segments using visual and temporal context. The framework supports action recognition, temporal segmentation, intention anticipation, and mistake detection for assisted teleoperation. Experiments on robot assembly demonstrations with 22 action classes show that human-to-robot fine-tuning improves the robot test-set Edit score from 70.50 to 80.70 using only 16 robot demonstrations. Edit-safe VLM correction further improves frame accuracy from 45.21% to 46.42% and increases F1@25 and F1@50 while preserving the Edit score. These results show that human demonstrations provide scalable pretraining data for robust, uncertainty-aware robot action segmentation. Code and data: project website.

item.title: Bayesian-Agent: Posterior-Guided Skill Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
item.author: Wu, Xiaojun, Yang, Cehao, Liu, Honghao, Lin, Xueyuan, Zhang, Wenjie, Shi, Zhichao, Jiang, Xuhui, Xu, Chengjin, Li, Jia, Guo, Jian
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Bayesian-Agent 的原生跨框架方法，将可复用技能和标准操作程序视为关于冻结模型在特定提示、上下文和框架环境下能否成功的假设。该方法通过记录验证过的轨迹证据，维护每个技能的特征条件分类后验，并将后验状态映射为可检查的操作（如修补、拆分、压缩、退役和探索）。在多个基准测试中，通过增量修复显著提升了性能。研究认为智能体技能的演进应被视为后验引导的框架优化，而非未校准的提示积累。

背景: 大型语言模型智能体日益依赖外部推理条件，如提示、工具、记忆、标准操作程序、技能和框架反馈。这些资产可以在不改变模型权重的情况下提高任务执行能力，但通常通过启发式反思或重复利用观察到的成功和失败来进行修订，且往往错误地将计数本身视为可靠的信念。

目的: 引入 Bayesian-Agent 框架，以处理可复用技能和标准操作程序，将其作为关于模型在特定条件下能否成功的假设，从而改进智能体技能的演进和优化过程。

方法: 提出 Bayesian-Agent 框架，记录验证过的轨迹证据，维护每个技能的特征条件分类后验，并将后验状态映射为可检查的操作（如修补、拆分、压缩、退役和探索）。为面向模型的提示提供可执行的安全护栏和失败模式修补，同时保留后验摘要以供审计。在 deepseek-v4-flash 模型上进行实验，并评估了原生后端及可选的 GenericAgent、mini-swe-agent 和 Claude Code 后端。

主要发现: 在 deepseek-v4-flash 模型上，增量修复使 SOP-Bench 从百分之八十提升至百分之九十五，Lifelong AgentBench 从百分之九十提升至百分之百，RealFin-Bench 从百分之四十五提升至百分之六十五。在多种设置（包括正面、负面、饱和和案例研究）下的评估结果支持了该框架的有效性。

结论: 智能体技能的演进最好被视为后验引导的框架优化，而不是未校准的提示积累。

翻译: LLM agents increasingly rely on external inference conditions: prompts, tools, memory, SOPs, skills, and harness feedback. These assets can improve task execution without changing model weights, but they are often revised by heuristic reflection or by reusing observed successes and failures as if counts alone were reliable belief. We introduce Bayesian-Agent, a native and cross-harness framework that treats reusable skills and SOPs as hypotheses about whether a frozen model will succeed under a particular prompt, context, and harness environment. Bayesian-Agent records verified trajectory evidence, maintains a feature-conditioned categorical posterior over each skill, and maps posterior state into inspectable actions such as patch, split, compress, retire, and explore. Model-facing prompts receive executable guardrails and failure-mode patches, while posterior summaries remain available for audit. With deepseek-v4-flash, incremental repair improves SOP-Bench from 80% to 95%, Lifelong AgentBench from 90% to 100%, and RealFin-Bench from 45% to 65%. We further evaluate Bayesian-Agent's native backend and optional GenericAgent, mini-swe-agent, and Claude Code backends. The results include positive, negative, saturated, and case-study settings, suggesting that agent skill evolution is best viewed as posterior-guided harness optimization rather than uncalibrated prompt accumulation. The source code is available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型智能体在依赖外部技能和工作流程时，仅凭简单经验统计或启发式反思进行更新所导致的可靠性差和噪声累积问题。该问题之所以重要，是因为外部经验的盲目积累不仅无法保证任务成功率，反而可能引入脆弱规则或干扰信息，阻碍智能体的长期稳定进化。通过引入基于证据的后验信念更新机制，该方法能够为智能体的技能维护提供可审计、可解释的优化路径，从而显著提升复杂任务环境下的执行效率与鲁棒性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到智能体能力高度依赖外部技能与环境配置，而传统仅靠统计成功失败次数的经验方法在数据稀疏且依赖上下文时并不可靠。为此，他们将可复用技能视为待验证的假设，借鉴贝叶斯优化与概率建模的思想，通过记录经过验证的执行轨迹来持续更新每个技能在特定条件下的成功概率后验分布。基于这一后验信念，系统自动触发修补、拆分、压缩或淘汰等具体优化动作。该方法明确借鉴了贝叶斯优化、概率机器学习以及现有自进化智能体框架的相关思路，但将核心创新聚焦于对外部技能库的后验引导式维护，而非直接修改模型参数或单次任务推理。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将智能体的可复用技能与标准流程视为待验证的假设，利用贝叶斯框架结合历史执行证据不断更新对技能成功率的信念，以此替代简单的经验统计或启发式反思，实现对外部推理环境的精准优化。整体流程首先记录并验证智能体的完整执行轨迹，提取关键特征后更新各技能的贝叶斯后验概率；随后系统根据后验状态自动触发探索、修补、拆分、压缩或淘汰等操作，并将生成的执行规则与防护策略注入提示词中，从而在后续任务中实现技能的持续迭代与性能提升。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于将大语言模型代理的可复用技能与标准操作流程视为贝叶斯证据对象，通过记录验证过的执行轨迹来维护技能成功率的概率后验分布，并据此自动触发修补、拆分、压缩或淘汰等具体优化动作。相比以往依赖大模型自我反思、启发式规则或简单成功失败计数的方法，本文的工作将技能进化从经验性的提示词积累转变为基于验证证据的贝叶斯不确定性优化，强调对外部执行环境的持续校准而非修改模型权重。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯智能体框架，将可复用的智能体技能视为概率假设，通过记录验证过的执行轨迹来维护技能成功率的信念状态，并据此自动指导技能的修补、拆分或淘汰，从而在不修改模型参数的前提下实现智能体能力的持续优化。

Abstract

LLM agents increasingly rely on external inference conditions: prompts, tools, memory, SOPs, skills, and harness feedback. These assets can improve task execution without changing model weights, but they are often revised by heuristic reflection or by reusing observed successes and failures as if counts alone were reliable belief. We introduce \textbf{Bayesian-Agent}, a native and cross-harness framework that treats reusable skills and SOPs as hypotheses about whether a frozen model will succeed under a particular prompt, context, and harness environment. Bayesian-Agent records verified trajectory evidence, maintains a feature-conditioned categorical posterior over each skill, and maps posterior state into inspectable actions such as patch, split, compress, retire, and explore. Model-facing prompts receive executable guardrails and failure-mode patches, while posterior summaries remain available for audit. With \texttt{deepseek-v4-flash}, incremental repair improves SOP-Bench from 80\% to 95\%, Lifelong AgentBench from 90\% to 100\%, and RealFin-Bench from 45\% to 65\%. We further evaluate Bayesian-Agent's native backend and optional GenericAgent, mini-swe-agent, and Claude Code backends. The results include positive, negative, saturated, and case-study settings, suggesting that agent skill evolution is best viewed as posterior-guided harness optimization rather than uncalibrated prompt accumulation. The source code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Beyond Prediction: Longitudinal Reasoning in EHR-Integrated Clinical AI
item.author: Irene Yi, Grace Brown, Sufian Aldogom, Nathan Roll, Eric J. Basile, Pamela M. Resnikoff, Isaac Gutterman, Oscar Schiff, Keira Salata, Benjamin Mujkic, Ammar Ahmed
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对当代临床人工智能系统如何整合电子健康记录数据及其对纵向临床推理的支持程度进行了结构化分析。

背景: 电子健康记录数据在临床人工智能系统中的应用日益广泛，但其在支持纵向临床推理方面的作用尚不明确。

目的: 分析临床人工智能系统整合电子健康记录数据的方式，并评估其对纵向临床推理的支持程度。

方法: 基于临床自然语言处理和电子健康记录集成系统的语料库，开发编码框架以捕捉技术整合策略和推理相关的表示特征；同时通过访谈三位医生，了解他们在电子健康记录使用中的经验和对当前系统的优缺点评价。

主要发现: 尽管许多系统整合了电子健康记录数据，但主要基于就诊级别或聚合表示运行，对跨患者病史的显式时间推理支持有限；推理相关结构表示不一致，评估范式主要关注预测性能而非纵向可解释性。

结论: 当前方法将电子健康记录数据视为静态输入而非持续临床推理的基础，未来系统需更好地与临床实践的时间和解释结构对齐。

翻译: We present a structured analysis of how contemporary clinical AI systems integrate electronic health record (EHR) data and the extent to which they support longitudinal clinical reasoning. Drawing on a curated corpus of clinical natural language processing (NLP) and EHR-integrated systems, we develop a coding framework that captures both technical integration strategies and reasoning-relevant representational features, such as trajectory modeling, cross-encounter synthesis, longitudinal analysis, and absence reasoning. We also elicited the experiences of three physicians in their EHR use, including what strengths and weaknesses they found with their institution's current EHR system(s). Our analysis shows that while many systems incorporate EHR data, they predominantly operate on encounter-level or aggregated representations, with limited support for explicit temporal reasoning across patient histories. Reasoning-relevant structures are inconsistently represented, and evaluation paradigms remain largely focused on predictive performance instead of longitudinal interpretability. We argue that current approaches treat EHR data as a static input rather than a substrate for ongoing clinical reasoning, and we outline a framework for understanding how future systems might more effectively align with the temporal and interpretive structure of clinical practice.

Abstract

We present a structured analysis of how contemporary clinical AI systems integrate electronic health record (EHR) data and the extent to which they support longitudinal clinical reasoning. Drawing on a curated corpus of clinical natural language processing (NLP) and EHR-integrated systems, we develop a coding framework that captures both technical integration strategies and reasoning-relevant representational features, such as trajectory modeling, cross-encounter synthesis, longitudinal analysis, and absence reasoning. We also elicited the experiences of three physicians in their EHR use, including what strengths and weaknesses they found with their institution's current EHR system(s). Our analysis shows that while many systems incorporate EHR data, they predominantly operate on encounter-level or aggregated representations, with limited support for explicit temporal reasoning across patient histories. Reasoning-relevant structures are inconsistently represented, and evaluation paradigms remain largely focused on predictive performance instead of longitudinal interpretability. We argue that current approaches treat EHR data as a static input rather than a substrate for ongoing clinical reasoning, and we outline a framework for understanding how future systems might more effectively align with the temporal and interpretive structure of clinical practice.

item.title: CoVEBench: Can Video Editing Models Handle Complex Instructions?
item.author: Wu, Jiangtao, Wang, Jiaming, He, Yiwen, Zhang, Yuanxing, Li, Shihao, Liu, Dunyuan, Zhao, Xuedong, Chen, Jialu, Wang, Zekun Moore, Liu, Jiaheng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了CoVEBench，一个用于组合式视频编辑的基准测试，旨在评估模型在复杂多指令编辑任务中的表现。

背景: 现有的文本引导视频编辑模型擅长基础任务，但现实用户需求具有高度组合性，需要同时修改多个元素并保留无关内容。现有基准测试受限于孤立编辑和粗糙的全局指标，无法诊断模型处理复杂工作流的能力。

目的: 填补现有基准测试在评估组合式视频编辑方面的空白，提供一个能够诊断模型在复杂多指令编辑任务中表现的测试平台。

方法: 构建CoVEBench基准测试，包含四百一十六个精选源视频、六百二十六个多点编辑指令和九千九百九十项细粒度检查清单。通过多模态大语言模型判断指令遵循度和视频保真度，并结合自动化视频质量指标进行评估。

主要发现: 组合式编辑仍然是一个巨大的挑战。当前模型在处理多个操作时，经常遗漏编辑、违反保留约束或引入伪影。

结论: CoVEBench提供了一个具有挑战性且具备诊断功能的测试平台，有助于推动视频编辑技术向符合现实用户工作流的方向发展。

翻译: While recent text-guided video editing models excel at elementary tasks (e.g., style transfer, object insertion), real-world user requests are highly compositional. A single prompt often demands multiple coupled edits, such as modifying subjects, actions, and camera views, while strictly preserving unrelated spatiotemporal content. Existing benchmarks, heavily constrained by isolated edits and coarse global metrics, fail to diagnose how models handle such complex workflows. To address this gap, we introduce CoVEBench, a compositional video editing benchmark comprising four hundred sixteen curated source videos, six hundred twenty-six multi-point editing instructions, and nine thousand nine hundred ninety fine-grained checklist items. Covering diverse editing dimensions, CoVEBench evaluates models via MLLM-judged instruction compliance and video fidelity, alongside automated metrics for video quality. Extensive experiments reveal that compositional editing remains a profound challenge: current models frequently omit edits, violate preservation constraints, or introduce artifacts when handling multiple operations simultaneously. CoVEBench provides a challenging, diagnostic testbed to advance video editing toward realistic user workflows.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有视频编辑评测基准过于简单、仅能评估孤立操作，无法准确衡量模型处理复杂多步指令能力的问题。该问题在现实和研究中非常重要，因为实际用户创作需求通常包含多个相互关联的编辑操作，且需严格保留无关内容。现有评测无法诊断模型在此类复杂工作流中的具体缺陷，阻碍了视频编辑技术向真实应用场景的演进。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于现实场景中用户常需同时执行多项关联编辑且严格保留无关内容的复杂需求，发现现有测试基准过于简单且评估指标粗糙，无法诊断模型处理多步指令的能力，因此设计了该评估框架。在设计上，他们采用三阶段流水线构建数据，包括视频筛选、基于多维分类体系生成复杂编辑指令，以及利用先进语言模型生成细粒度核查清单。该方法明确借鉴了现有视频编辑基准与多项成熟评估工具，并针对其提示词单一、覆盖范围窄和评估粗糙等不足进行了针对性优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个面向复杂组合指令的视频编辑评测基准，旨在评估模型在单次提示中同时执行多项编辑操作并严格保留无关内容的能力，以贴近真实创作需求。整体实现流程分为三个阶段：首先从多源平台收集并严格筛选高质量源视频；其次基于预设的编辑维度分类，利用大语言模型生成涵盖多操作点的复杂编辑指令并进行人工审核；最后将指令拆解为细粒度的可验证检查项，经人工过滤后形成评测清单，结合自动化指标对模型的指令遵循度、视频质量和内容保真度进行综合诊断。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了首个面向复杂组合指令的视频编辑评测基准，包含数百个源视频与多节点编辑指令，并构建了近万条细粒度检查清单。相比以往仅关注简单孤立编辑和粗糙全局指标的评测方法，该工作首次系统评估模型在同时执行多项编辑操作时保持无关内容不变的能力。其核心创新在于通过多维度细粒度诊断指标，精准检验指令遵循度、画面真实感与未修改区域的语义一致性，填补了复杂视频编辑评测的空白。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一个专注于复杂组合编辑的视频基准，包含四百余部源视频与六百多条多任务指令，并构建了细粒度检查清单与自动化指标相结合的评估体系，以全面诊断现有模型处理真实场景复杂编辑需求的能力。

Abstract

While recent text-guided video editing models excel at elementary tasks (e.g., style transfer, object insertion), real-world user requests are highly compositional. A single prompt often demands multiple coupled edits, such as modifying subjects, actions, and camera views, while strictly preserving unrelated spatiotemporal content. Existing benchmarks, heavily constrained by isolated edits and coarse global metrics, fail to diagnose how models handle such complex workflows. To address this gap, we introduce CoVEBench, a compositional video editing benchmark comprising 416 curated source videos, 626 multi-point editing instructions, and 9,990 fine-grained checklist items. Covering diverse editing dimensions, CoVEBench evaluates models via MLLM-judged instruction compliance and video fidelity, alongside automated metrics for video quality. Extensive experiments reveal that compositional editing remains a profound challenge: current models frequently omit edits, violate preservation constraints, or introduce artifacts when handling multiple operations simultaneously. CoVEBench provides a challenging, diagnostic testbed to advance video editing toward realistic user workflows.

item.title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
item.author: Jiang, Li, Xu, Haoran, Ding, Yichuan, Zhang, Amy
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种轨迹级修正方法TRD，用于解决大语言模型在轨策略蒸馏中因前缀失败导致的梯度碎片化问题，通过修正学生模型的生成轨迹并暴露于教师指导下的替代有效推导路径，显著提升了模型在多项基准测试中的单次尝试准确率和推理覆盖范围。

背景: 轨策略蒸馏已成为大语言模型训练中的核心后训练工具，通过提供密集的单令牌教师监督来指导学生学习。

目的: 识别并解决轨策略蒸馏中普遍存在的前缀失败问题，避免单令牌损失截断或重新加权无法解决的梯度碎片化现象。

方法: 提出轨迹级修正方法TRD，在轨策略支持范围内修正学生模型的生成轨迹，并在蒸馏前修正问题前缀，同时通过教师指导暴露学生模型于替代有效推导路径。

主要发现: TRD在多个规模和基准测试中持续优于现有基线方法，有效提升了单次尝试准确率和推理覆盖范围。

结论: TRD通过轨迹级修正有效缓解了前缀失败问题，为轨策略蒸馏提供了更优的解决方案。

翻译: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. This observation motivates us to move beyond token-level loss interventions toward trajectory-level output corrections. We thus propose Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support. By correcting problematic prefixes before distillation, TRD mitigates prefix failure at its source. Moreover, TRD improves the exploration by exposing the student to alternative valid derivations under teacher guidance, even when the original rolls are already correct. TRD can also be applied to on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a parameter-sharing variant that uses the student model conditioned on privileged informations as the teacher. Across a wide range of benchmarks and base models at multiple scales, TRD consistently outperforms prior baselines, improving single-attempt accuracy and broadening reasoning coverage. Code is available at this https URL

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在策略内蒸馏训练中常见的“前缀失败”问题。当模型在推理早期生成错误路径时，传统的逐词监督信号会变得混乱且无效，而现有的词元级损失调整方法无法从根本上修复这一结构缺陷。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为策略内蒸馏已成为现代大模型训练的核心环节，若无法有效纠正早期错误，不仅会导致训练不稳定和探索能力受限，还会严重制约模型在复杂推理任务中的最终准确率。通过轨迹级修正提供可靠监督，能显著提升模型的推理覆盖率和单次尝试成功率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有在线策略蒸馏方法在训练时，若学生模型早期推理路径出错，会导致教师提供的逐词监督信号变得混乱且梯度破碎。他们意识到仅从词级别调整损失无法解决根本问题，因此将改进尺度提升至轨迹级别。设计思路上，该方法先让学生生成原始回答，再由教师模型结合参考答案将其修正为更优的完整轨迹，最后用修正后的轨迹进行蒸馏。该方法直接借鉴并改进了现有的在线策略蒸馏与自蒸馏框架，同时针对前人仅做词级损失截断或重加权等局限性进行了针对性突破。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是突破传统逐词元损失调整的局限，通过轨迹层面的修正来解决学生模型推理路径出错导致的“前缀失败”问题。整体流程为：首先让学生模型生成初始推理轨迹，接着利用教师模型结合参考答案对该轨迹进行引导性修正，最后将修正后的高质量轨迹作为监督信号用于后续的蒸馏训练。该方法同样适用于参数共享的自蒸馏场景。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于揭示了在线策略蒸馏中普遍存在的“前缀失败”现象，并提出了轨迹级修正方法。与以往仅在词元损失层面进行截断或重权重的做法不同，该方法在蒸馏前直接依据教师指导修正学生生成的完整推理轨迹。这种从词元级干预转向轨迹级结构修正的策略，从根本上避免了错误推理路径对梯度计算的干扰，从而提升了模型的推理准确性与探索能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种轨迹级修正方法，通过在蒸馏前利用教师模型指导修正学生模型的生成轨迹，从根源上缓解了传统逐词监督中因早期推理路径错误导致后续无法修正的问题，从而显著提升了大语言模型的训练效果与推理能力。

Abstract

On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a central post-training tool for large language models (LLMs), providing dense per-token teacher supervision along the student's own rollouts. In this work, we identify a common structural cause underlying OPD, which we call prefix failure. Under prefix failure, dense per-token supervision induces a bimodal teacher mixture and fragmented gradients that token-level loss truncation or reweighting fail to address. This observation motivates us to move beyond token-level loss interventions toward trajectory-level output corrections. We thus propose Trajectory-Refined Distillation (TRD), a trajectory-level correction method that revises the student's rollout under the teacher guidance while within on-policy support. By correcting problematic prefixes before distillation, TRD mitigates prefix failure at its source. Moreover, TRD improves the exploration by exposing the student to alternative valid derivations under teacher guidance, even when the original rolls are already correct. TRD can also be applied to on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), a parameter-sharing variant that uses the student model conditioned on privileged informations as the teacher. Across a wide range of benchmarks and base models at multiple scales, TRD consistently outperforms prior baselines, improving single-attempt accuracy and broadening reasoning coverage. Code is available at this https URL

item.title: Personalized and Robust Proactive Robot Assistance with Uncertainty-Guided LLM Reasoning
item.author: Alvaro Gonzalez, M. H. Hasan Shovo, Ali Ayub
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 GLOBE 的轻量级框架，用于在家庭环境中进行主动机器人辅助。该框架结合 n 元马尔可夫模型捕捉时间行为模式与不确定性引导的大语言模型推理，仅在模型置信度低时调用大语言模型。在模拟噪声的 HOMER-Noise 数据集上验证，GLOBE 在保持竞争力的同时提升了鲁棒性和计算效率，并通过与 Stretch 3 移动操作臂的集成证明了其在真实人机交互场景中的应用潜力。

背景: 家庭环境中的主动机器人辅助需要准确预测人类活动和物体使用情况，但现有方法通常依赖复杂的时间空间模型，计算成本高且对环境变化敏感。

目的: 提出一种轻量级框架，以在动态和噪声条件下高效、准确地预测人类活动和物体使用情况，同时提高鲁棒性和计算效率。

方法: 提出 GLOBE 框架，结合 n 元马尔可夫模型捕捉时间行为模式与不确定性引导的大语言模型推理。该框架在模型置信度高时进行高效顺序预测，仅在置信度低时选择性调用大语言模型推理。使用模拟人类、宠物和幼儿引起物体移动的噪声扩展数据集 HOMER-Noise 进行评估。

主要发现: GLOBE 在干净和噪声设置下均实现了与最先进方法相竞争的性能，同时提高了鲁棒性和计算效率。

结论: GLOBE 框架在真实人机交互场景中具有应用潜力，通过与 Stretch 3 移动操作臂的集成验证了其实际可行性。

翻译: 家庭环境中的主动机器人辅助需要准确预测人类活动和物体使用情况，但现有方法通常依赖复杂的时间空间模型，计算成本高且对环境变化敏感。本文提出 GLOBE，一种轻量级框架，结合 n 元马尔可夫模型捕捉时间行为模式与不确定性引导的大语言模型推理。该框架在模型置信度高时进行高效顺序预测，仅在置信度低时选择性调用大语言模型推理。为评估现实条件下的性能，引入了模拟人类、宠物和幼儿引起物体移动的噪声扩展数据集 HOMER-Noise。实验结果表明，GLOBE 在干净和噪声设置下均实现了与最先进方法相竞争的性能，同时提高了鲁棒性和计算效率。该框架通过与 Stretch 3 移动操作臂的集成进一步验证，展示了其在真实人机交互场景中的应用潜力。

Abstract

Proactive robot assistance in household environments requires accurate prediction of human activities and object usage under dynamic and noisy conditions. Existing approaches often rely on complex spatio-temporal models, which can be computationally expensive and sensitive to environmental variability. In this paper, we propose GLOBE, a lightweight framework that combines n-gram Markov models for capturing temporal behavioral patterns with uncertainty-guided large language model (LLM) reasoning. The framework performs sequential prediction efficiently while selectively invoking LLM reasoning only when the model confidence is low. To evaluate performance under realistic conditions, we introduce HOMER-Noise, a noisy extension of the HOMER+ dataset that simulates structured disturbances such as object movements caused by humans, pets, and toddlers. Experimental results show that GLOBE achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods while improving robustness and computational efficiency across both clean and noisy settings.
