The framework is further validated through a proof-of-concept integration with a Stretch 3 mobile manipulator, demonstrating its potential application in real-world human-robot interaction scenarios.

item.title: PIPE-Cypher: Automatic Enterprise Benchmark Generation for Text-to-Cypher Systems
item.author: Ranganath, Suraj, Raghavendra, Anish
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PIPE-Cypher的本地基准测试生成流程，该流程能够将实时属性图和可选的种子查询转化为平衡的自然语言到Cypher查询的基准测试集，旨在解决企业属性图在结构、术语和治理约束上的多样性及动态变化问题。

背景: 企业属性图在模式结构、内部术语、领域假设、治理约束和用户交互模式上存在广泛差异。因此，与部署相关的文本到Cypher基准测试应反映用户和智能体实际向该图提出的问题。然而，由于模式和值具有唯一性且图结构随时间变化，创建此类基准测试非常困难。

目的: 创建一个能够反映实际用户和智能体查询的文本到Cypher基准测试，确保每个自然语言查询对都是可执行的、使用真实的图实体、保持多样性，并在查询类型和难度级别上保持平衡。

方法: 提出PIPE-Cypher流程，结合模式分析、反向查询接地、约束生成、确定性Cypher治理、执行验证、脱敏、多样性控制和校准的本地大型语言模型裁判。使用本地Qwen3.5-9B模型进行生成和评判，导出3000个被接受的FinBench/SNB示例，完成三次审计的消融实验，用人标签校准裁判行为，并评估11个本地下游模型。

主要发现: 生成的基准测试具有高度区分性：零样本迁移效果较弱，而少样本控制显示特定模式的示例库可以帮助兼容的模型家族。

结论: PIPE-Cypher使文本到Cypher基准测试成为一个可重复的过程，能够随着图结构、用户和目标工作负载的演变而更新。

翻译: Enterprise property graphs vary widely in schema structure, internal terminology, domain assumptions, governance constraints, and user interaction patterns. A deployment-relevant Text2Cypher benchmark therefore reflects the questions users and agents actually ask of that graph. Creating such a benchmark is difficult because schemas and values are unique, and graph structure changes over time. Each NL-query pair must also be executable, use real graph entities, preserve diversity, and remain balanced across query types and difficulty levels. We present PIPE-Cypher, a local benchmark-generation pipeline that turns a live property graph and optional seed queries from customer questions, analyst logs, or agent tool calls into balanced NL-to-Cypher benchmarks. PIPE-Cypher combines schema profiling, reverse-query grounding, constrained generation, deterministic Cypher governance, execution validation, redaction, diversity controls, and a calibrated local LLM judge. Using local Qwen3.5-9B generation and judging, PIPE-Cypher exports 3,000 accepted FinBench/SNB examples, completes three audited ablation suites, calibrates judge behavior with human labels, and evaluates 11 local downstream models. The resulting benchmark is deliberately discriminative: zero-shot transfer is weak, while a few-shot control shows that schema-specific example banks can help compatible model families. Together, PIPE-Cypher makes Text2Cypher benchmarking a repeatable process that evolves with the graph, its users, and its target workloads.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何自动从企业实际运行的属性图中生成平衡、可执行且保护隐私的自然语言转图查询基准测试集的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为企业内部的图结构、专业术语和隐私规则各不相同且会随业务变化，而现有的公开静态数据集无法反映这些真实场景。构建可重复、本地化的基准测试流程，不仅能准确评估大模型在特定企业环境中的查询生成能力，还能确保数据安全并适应不断演进的业务需求。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将本地大语言模型生成与确定性图规则检查相结合，确保生成的查询示例必须通过实际执行验证其可回答性与安全性，而非仅依赖提示词约束。整体实现流程包含六个阶段：首先对图结构进行画像并规划查询类别，接着通过反向查询定位真实数据值，然后由本地模型生成自然语言与查询语句对，随后通过严格的语法、安全与执行验证过滤无效结果，最后由本地模型裁判进行语义审查后导出基准集。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于提出了一套完全本地化、可重复执行的图基准自动生成流水线。相比以往依赖静态公开数据集或通用大模型提示词的工作，该方法通过反向查询定位、确定性语法与安全校验、本地大模型评审以及隐私脱敏机制，确保生成的自然语言与查询语句对真实图数据库可执行且安全。它不再提供固定数据集，而是为企业提供一个能随图结构、业务术语和治理规则持续演进的基准构建流程。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为PIPE-Cypher的本地化基准生成流水线，能够将企业私有属性图自动转化为平衡、可执行且隐私安全的自然语言到Cypher查询基准数据集。

Abstract

Enterprise property graphs vary widely in schema structure, internal terminology, domain assumptions, governance constraints, and user interaction patterns. A deployment-relevant Text2Cypher benchmark therefore reflects the questions users and agents actually ask of that graph. Creating such a benchmark is difficult because schemas and values are unique, and graph structure changes over time. Each NL-query pair must also be executable, use real graph entities, preserve diversity, and remain balanced across query types and difficulty levels. We present PIPE-Cypher, a local benchmark-generation pipeline that turns a live property graph and optional seed queries from customer questions, analyst logs, or agent tool calls into balanced NL-to-Cypher benchmarks. PIPE-Cypher combines schema profiling, reverse-query grounding, constrained generation, deterministic Cypher governance, execution validation, redaction, diversity controls, and a calibrated local LLM judge. Using local Qwen3.5-9B generation and judging, PIPE-Cypher exports 3,000 accepted FinBench/SNB examples, completes three audited ablation suites, calibrates judge behavior with human labels, and evaluates 11 local downstream models. The resulting benchmark is deliberately discriminative: zero-shot transfer is weak, while a few-shot control shows that schema-specific example banks can help compatible model families. Together, PIPE-Cypher makes Text2Cypher benchmarking a repeatable process that evolves with the graph, its users, and its target workloads.

item.title: STELLAR: Spatio-Temporal Environmental Learning with Latent Alignment and Refinement for Long-Tailed Species Distribution Modeling
item.author: Shufeng Kong, Tao Yu, Yuanyuan Wei, Caihua Liu, Junwen Bai, Yingheng Wang, Marc Grimson, Daniel Fink, Carla P. Gomes
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为STELLAR的新型框架，用于联合物种分布建模。该框架通过共享潜在空间联合优化动态栖息地背景和群落结构，整合了图时间编码器、上下文锚定潜在对齐机制和不平衡感知解耦解码模块，在大规模eBird数据集上显著优于现有基线方法，尤其在预测稀有物种和揭示可解释的物种相互作用方面表现突出。

背景: 联合物种分布建模是生物多样性监测和保护规划的关键技术。然而，准确的建模面临两个耦合挑战：环境驱动因素和物种分布具有内在的时空特性，而物种共存模式表现出复杂的非线性群落结构和由稀有物种驱动的严重长尾不平衡。现有方法通常孤立地处理这些因素，要么从静态协变量中学习，要么忽视动态群落结构的历史轨迹。

目的: 克服现有方法在联合物种分布建模中的局限性，特别是解决环境驱动因素与物种分布的时空特性以及物种共存模式的复杂性和不平衡问题，通过联合优化动态栖息地背景和群落结构来提高建模准确性。

方法: 提出STELLAR框架，包含三个互补组件：一是图时间编码器，利用图注意力和循环单元聚合空间邻域效应并捕捉环境背景和群落结构共同演化的历史动态；二是上下文锚定潜在对齐机制，使用标签激活的混合先验和监督对比学习构建潜在空间，基于共享的环境偏好主动聚类物种；三是不平衡感知解耦解码模块，利用非对称损失函数聚焦于困难且稀有的物种样本，防止长尾模式崩溃。

主要发现: 在由领域专家整理的大规模eBird数据集上的实验表明，STELLAR框架显著优于最先进的方法，特别是在预测稀有物种和揭示可解释的物种相互作用方面。

结论: STELLAR框架通过联合优化动态栖息地背景和群落结构，有效解决了联合物种分布建模中的时空特性和不平衡问题，为生物多样性监测和保护规划提供了更准确的工具。

翻译: Joint Species Distribution Modeling (JSDM) is a key enabler for biodiversity monitoring and conservation planning. However, accurate JSDM faces two coupled challenges: environmental drivers and species distributions are inherently spatio-temporal, while species co-occurrence patterns exhibit complex non-linear community structure and severe long-tail imbalance driven by rare species. Existing approaches often address these factors in isolation, learning from static covariates or neglecting the historical trajectories of dynamic community structure. To overcome these limitations, we propose STELLAR (Spatio-Temporal Environmental Learning with Latent Alignment and Refinement), a novel framework that learns a shared latent space where dynamic habitat context and community structure are optimized jointly. Our approach integrates three complementary components: (1) a Graph-Temporal Encoder that employs graph attention and recurrent units to aggregate spatial neighborhood effects and capture the co-evolving historical dynamics of environmental context and community structure; (2) a Context-Anchored Latent Alignment mechanism that structures the latent space using a label-activated mixture prior and supervised contrastive learning, actively clustering species based on shared environmental preferences; and (3) an Imbalance-Aware Decoupled Decoding module that utilizes Asymmetric Loss to focus learning on hard, rare species samples, preventing mode collapse in the long tail. Experiments on the large-scale eBird dataset, curated with domain experts, demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in predicting rare species and revealing interpretable species interactions.

Abstract

Joint Species Distribution Modeling (JSDM) is a key enabler for biodiversity monitoring and conservation planning. However, accurate JSDM faces two coupled challenges: environmental drivers and species distributions are inherently spatio-temporal, while species co-occurrence patterns exhibit complex non-linear community structure and severe long-tail imbalance driven by rare species. Existing approaches often address these factors in isolation, learning from static covariates or neglecting the historical trajectories of dynamic community structure. To overcome these limitations, we propose STELLAR (Spatio-Temporal Environmental Learning with Latent Alignment and Refinement), a novel framework that learns a shared latent space where dynamic habitat context and community structure are optimized jointly. Our approach integrates three complementary components: (1) a Graph-Temporal Encoder that employs graph attention and recurrent units to aggregate spatial neighborhood effects and capture the co-evolving historical dynamics of environmental context and community structure; (2) a Context-Anchored Latent Alignment mechanism that structures the latent space using a label-activated mixture prior and supervised contrastive learning, actively clustering species based on shared environmental preferences; and (3) an Imbalance-Aware Decoupled Decoding module that utilizes Asymmetric Loss to focus learning on hard, rare species samples, preventing mode collapse in the long tail. Experiments on the large-scale eBird dataset, curated with domain experts, demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly in predicting rare species and revealing interpretable species interactions.

item.title: OASIS: From Simulation Data Collection to Real-World Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
item.author: Yu, Zehao, Zheng, Jiakun, Xie, Weiji, Shi, Jiyuan, Zhang, Chenyun, Bai, Chenjia, Li, Xuelong
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为OASIS的仿真数据驱动框架，用于人形机器人的移动操作任务。该框架利用3D生成模型从真实图像中自动重建逼真的物体资产，并在仿真中通过遥操作收集轨迹，随后通过领域随机化进行数据增强。基于此仿真数据，设计了分层视觉运动策略。实验表明，在零样本部署下，该策略在大多数任务上的成功率高于使用真实机器人遥操作数据训练的策略，主要得益于仿真渲染覆盖了更广泛的光照和环境变化。

背景: 人形机器人移动操作任务的数据来源在轨迹质量和可扩展性之间存在不满意的权衡。真实世界的遥操作提供最高质量的轨迹，但需要专用物理空间且耗时重置场景；仿真则能大规模生成干净且与本体对齐的数据，无需物理硬件。

目的: 解决人形机器人移动操作任务中数据质量与可扩展性之间的权衡问题，提出一种利用仿真数据驱动的训练框架。

方法: 提出OASIS框架，首先使用3D生成模型从真实图像自动重建逼真物体资产；然后在仿真中通过遥操作收集轨迹；接着在后处理阶段通过多样化的领域随机化对轨迹进行增强；最后基于增强后的仿真数据设计分层视觉运动策略。

主要发现: 在真实人形机器人上的广泛实验表明，在零样本部署下，使用OASIS仿真数据训练的策略在大多数任务上取得了比使用真实机器人遥操作数据训练的策略更高的成功率。

结论: OASIS框架通过仿真数据及其广泛的光照和环境变化覆盖，有效提升了人形机器人移动操作任务的性能，证明了仿真数据在训练高质量策略方面的优势。

翻译: Recent progress in robot manipulation has been largely driven by learning from large-scale demonstrations. For humanoid robot loco-manipulation tasks, however, existing data sources force an unsatisfying tradeoff between trajectory quality and scalability. Real-world teleoperation provides the highest-quality trajectories but requires dedicated physical space and time-consuming scene resets. Simulation offers an alternative way out of this dilemma: it can produce clean, embodiment-aligned data at scale without any physical hardware. In this paper, we propose OASIS, a simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation. OASIS automatically reconstructs realistic object assets from real-world images using a 3D generative model. Based on these assets, trajectories are first collected through teleoperation in simulation, and then augmented under diverse domain randomizations in a post-processing stage. With the resulting simulation data, we further design a hierarchical visuomotor policy for humanoid loco-manipulation. Extensive experiments on the real humanoid robot show that, under zero-shot deployment, the policy trained on our simulation data achieves higher success rates on most tasks than that trained on real-robot teleoperation data, owing largely to the broad lighting and environmental variations covered by our simulation rendering, which real-robot data fails to capture. The project page is available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决人形机器人在移动与操作任务中难以大规模获取高质量演示数据的问题。传统实地遥控采集成本高昂且效率低下，而现有仿真方法又缺乏真实物理场景。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为机器人要适应复杂日常环境并执行精细任务，最终都依赖于海量且贴合自身结构的示范数据。突破这一瓶颈能够显著降低训练成本，加速人形机器人从实验室走向现实应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对真实机器人遥操作数据采集成本高、效率低且难以扩展的痛点，提出将数据采集完全移至仿真环境。设计上采用两阶段解耦流程，先利用生成模型和视觉语言模型自动构建逼真的仿真物体资产，再通过虚拟现实设备在仿真中遥操作采集运动状态，最后离线回放并随机化光照、纹理和视角以生成大量多样化训练数据。该方法借鉴了多项现有工作，包括三维资产生成技术、全身运动控制算法、流匹配策略以及轨迹数据增强范式，并在此基础上实现了从仿真到真实机器人的零样本迁移。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用高保真仿真环境替代昂贵的实体机器人数据采集，通过自动生成逼真的立体物体资产并扩大视觉变化范围，以极低的成本构建大规模训练数据，从而实现控制策略向真实机器人的零样本迁移。整体实现流程分为四个阶段：首先利用生成模型和视觉语言模型自动重建具备物理属性的仿真场景；接着通过虚拟现实设备在仿真中实时操控机器人并记录运动状态；然后将记录的数据离线回放，随机化光照、纹理和相机角度以生成大量多样化样本；最后基于这些样本训练分层视觉运动策略，并直接部署到真实人形机器人上执行任务。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种完全在仿真环境中收集数据并训练策略的框架。它通过三维生成模型自动从真实图片重建物理属性逼真的物体资产，并采用两阶段解耦设计，将虚拟环境中的遥操作轨迹在离线阶段通过光照、纹理等随机化扩展为大量视觉多样的训练样本。相比以往依赖昂贵低效的真实机器人遥操作或存在本体差异的人类视频数据，该方法不仅大幅降低了采集成本并提升了数据规模，还成功实现了策略在真实人形机器人上的零样本直接部署。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套完全在仿真环境中采集人形机器人全身操作数据的框架，通过虚拟现实遥操作与视觉增强技术生成海量训练样本，并据此训练的分层策略成功实现了在真实人形机器人上的零样本部署。

Abstract

Recent progress in robot manipulation has been largely driven by learning from large-scale demonstrations. For humanoid robot loco-manipulation tasks, however, existing data sources force an unsatisfying tradeoff between trajectory quality and scalability. Real-world teleoperation provides the highest-quality trajectories but requires dedicated physical space and time-consuming scene resets. Simulation offers an alternative way out of this dilemma: it can produce clean, embodiment-aligned data at scale without any physical hardware. In this paper, we propose OASIS, a simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation. OASIS automatically reconstructs realistic object assets from real-world images using a 3D generative model. Based on these assets, trajectories are first collected through teleoperation in simulation, and then augmented under diverse domain randomizations in a post-processing stage. With the resulting simulation data, we further design a hierarchical visuomotor policy for humanoid loco-manipulation. Extensive experiments on the real humanoid robot show that, under zero-shot deployment, the policy trained on our simulation data achieves higher success rates on most tasks than that trained on real-robot teleoperation data, owing largely to the broad lighting and environmental variations covered by our simulation rendering, which real-robot data fails to capture. The project page is available at this https URL .

item.title: FusionVul: A Multimodal Feature Fusion Framework for Source Code Vulnerability Detection
item.author: Hongyu Yang, Yaping Zhu, Jingchuan Luo, Hiroshi Nomaguchi, Chunhua Su, Willy Susilo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FusionVul的联合表示学习框架，用于源代码漏洞检测。该框架结合了预训练Transformer编码器提取的顺序句法表示和通过图神经网络传播的结构语义，并采用基于交叉注意力的特征融合网络及样本感知加权机制，在多个数据集上取得了优越的F1分数，能够有效捕捉复杂多样的漏洞模式。

背景: 源代码漏洞检测因现代代码库规模扩大、结构复杂及语义多样而长期面临挑战。传统的静态分析或基于规则的方法难以捕捉细微的执行依赖关系，而单模态学习模型往往忽略源代码词法表面之外的关键结构信息。

目的: 提高模型在不同异构代码模式下的鲁棒性，以更好地检测源代码漏洞。

方法: 提出FusionVul框架，整合由预训练Transformer编码器提取的顺序句法表示与通过图神经网络传播的结构语义。该框架还包含一个基于交叉注意力的特征融合网络以实现细粒度的跨模态交互，并采用样本感知加权机制来整合多个预测分支。

主要发现: 在四个数据集上的实验结果表明，FusionVul在函数大小分布高度分散且漏洞类型覆盖范围更广的数据集（如SVulD和DiverseVul）上实现了优越的F1分数，表明其具备捕捉复杂和多样化漏洞模式的能力。

结论: FusionVul框架通过结合顺序句法和结构语义信息，能够有效提升源代码漏洞检测的性能，特别是在处理复杂和多样化的代码模式时表现优异。

翻译: Source code vulnerability detection remains a long-standing challenge due to the increasing scale, structural complexity, and semantic diversity of modern codebases. Conventional static-analysis or rule-based approaches often fail to capture subtle execution dependencies, while single-modality learning models tend to overlook critical structural information embedded beyond the lexical surface of source code. To improve robustness across heterogeneous code patterns, we propose FusionVul, a joint representation learning framework that integrates sequential syntactic representations extracted by a pretrained Transformer encoder with structural semantics propagated through a graph neural network. The framework further incorporates a cross-attention-based feature fusion network to enable fine-grained cross-modal interaction and employs a sample-aware weighting mechanism to integrate multiple predictive branches. Experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that FusionVul achieves superior F1 scores on datasets with highly dispersed function size distributions and broader vulnerability-type coverage, such as SVulD and DiverseVul, reflecting its capability to capture complex and diverse vulnerability patterns.

Abstract

Source code vulnerability detection remains a long-standing challenge due to the increasing scale, structural complexity, and semantic diversity of modern codebases. Conventional static-analysis or rule-based approaches often fail to capture subtle execution dependencies, while single-modality learning models tend to overlook critical structural information embedded beyond the lexical surface of source code. To improve robustness across heterogeneous code patterns, we propose FusionVul, a joint representation learning framework that integrates sequential syntactic representations extracted by a pretrained Transformer encoder with structural semantics propagated through a graph neural network. The framework further incorporates a cross-attention-based feature fusion network to enable fine-grained cross-modal interaction and employs a sample-aware weighting mechanism to integrate multiple predictive branches. Experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that FusionVul achieves superior F1 scores on datasets with highly dispersed function size distributions and broader vulnerability-type coverage, such as SVulD and DiverseVul, reflecting its capability to capture complex and diverse vulnerability patterns.

item.title: EinSort: Sorting is All We Need for Tensorizing LLM
item.author: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu, Ye Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种自适应张量化方法，通过索引排序发现目标张量中的内在低秩结构，以解决大型基础模型中隐式低秩结构识别的挑战。

背景: 张量网络为压缩大型神经网络提供了高效的表示方法，通过精心设计形状和拓扑结构可以显著降低内存和计算成本。然而，由于大型基础模型的巨大规模和未结构化的权重分布，识别其中的隐式低秩结构仍然具有挑战性。

目的: 提出一种自适应张量化方法，以发现目标张量中的内在低秩结构。

方法: 通过索引排序来发现目标张量中的内在低秩结构。

主要发现: 在权重和KV缓存压缩的实验表明，该方法相比基线方法具有更高的重建质量。

结论: 自适应张量化方法能够有效发现大型张量中的低秩结构，并在压缩任务中提升重建质量。

翻译: Tensor networks provide efficient representations for compressing large neural networks. By carefully designing shapes and topologies, they can significantly reduce memory and computational costs. However, identifying implicit low-rank structures in large foundation models remains challenging due to their enormous scale and un-structured weight distributions. We propose an adaptive tensorization method that discovers inherent low-rank structure in a target tensor by index ordering. Experiments on weight and KV-cache compression demonstrate improved reconstruction quality compared to baselines.

Abstract

Tensor networks provide efficient representations for compressing large neural networks. By carefully designing shapes and topologies, they can significantly reduce memory and computational costs. However, identifying implicit low-rank structures in large foundation models remains challenging due to their enormous scale and un-structured weight distributions. We propose an adaptive tensorization method that discovers inherent low-rank structure in a target tensor by index ordering. Experiments on weight and KV-cache compression demonstrate improved reconstruction quality compared to baselines.

item.title: A spectral audit framework reveals task-dependent aperiodic reliance across EEG and ECG deep learning
item.author: Jasmeet Singh Bindra, Siddharth Panwar, Shubhajit Roy Chowdhury
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种频谱审计框架，用于评估深度学习在生理时间序列分析中对非周期性信号成分的依赖。研究发现，神经网络模型在脑电图和心电图任务中普遍存在对非周期性信号的依赖，这种依赖可能受到年龄、性别等人口统计学因素的影响。研究建议将非周期性控制作为可解释生理时间序列深度学习的标准流程。

背景: 深度学习在生理时间序列分析中通常通过领域特定特征进行解释，例如脑电图中的振荡节律和心电图中的形态学复合物。然而，这些信号叠加在一个与觉醒度、年龄和病理状态相关的宽带非周期性包络之上。

目的: 引入一种频谱审计框架，以评估深度学习模型对生理信号中非周期性成分的依赖程度，并验证这种依赖是否构成混淆因素。

方法: 构建了一个结合非周期性与周期性分解、相位保持傅里叶干预、假对照和模拟验证的频谱审计框架。在六种神经网络架构上进行了睡眠-觉醒分类、临床异常检测和运动想象任务测试。对七个脑电图基础模型进行了临床脑电图分析，并应用该框架到PTB-XL心电图数据集。

主要发现: 非周期性依赖具有任务依赖性和架构通用性。在睡眠-觉醒分类任务中，非周期性成分被移除后，六种神经网络架构的平衡准确率下降超过0.42分；在临床异常检测任务中下降0.07至0.13分；在运动想象任务中下降最小。七个脑电图基础模型中有六个显示出对临床脑电图非周期性成分的显著依赖，尽管控制了年龄、性别和记录时代，这种效应仍然存在。在PTB-XL心电图数据集中，人口统计学匹配后仍存在0.32至0.36的神经网络准确率下降，证实了这种混淆因素不仅限于脑电图。

结论: 非周期性控制应成为可解释生理时间序列深度学习的标准组成部分，以消除非周期性信号带来的混淆影响。

翻译: Deep learning on physiological time series is interpreted through domain-specific features -- oscillatory rhythms in EEG, morphological complexes in ECG -- yet these signals sit atop a broadband aperiodic 1/f-like envelope that covaries with arousal, age, and pathology. We introduce a spectral audit framework combining aperiodic/periodic decomposition, phase-preserving Fourier interventions, sham controls, and simulation validation. Aperiodic reliance was task-dependent and architecture-general: across six neural architectures, flattening drops exceeded 0.42 balanced-accuracy points for sleep-wake classification, reached 0.07-0.13 for clinical abnormality detection, and remained minimal for motor imagery. Six of seven EEG foundation models showed FDR-significant aperiodic reliance on clinical EEG; age/sex and recording-era controls reduced but did not eliminate the effect. Applying the audit to PTB-XL ECG revealed neural drops of 0.32--0.36 persisting after demographic matching, confirming this confound class extends beyond EEG. Aperiodic controls should become standard for interpretable physiological time-series deep learning.

Abstract

Deep learning on physiological time series is interpreted through domain-specific features -- oscillatory rhythms in EEG, morphological complexes in ECG -- yet these signals sit atop a broadband aperiodic 1/f-like envelope that covaries with arousal, age, and pathology. We introduce a spectral audit framework combining aperiodic/periodic decomposition, phase-preserving Fourier interventions, sham controls, and simulation validation. Aperiodic reliance was task-dependent and architecture-general: across six neural architectures, flattening drops exceeded 0.42 balanced-accuracy points for sleep-wake classification, reached 0.07-0.13 for clinical abnormality detection, and remained minimal for motor imagery. Six of seven EEG foundation models showed FDR-significant aperiodic reliance on clinical EEG; age/sex and recording-era controls reduced but did not eliminate the effect. Applying the audit to PTB-XL ECG revealed neural drops of 0.32--0.36 persisting after demographic matching, confirming this confound class extends beyond EEG. Aperiodic controls should become standard for interpretable physiological time-series deep learning.

item.title: Distilling LLM Reasoning into an Interpretable Policy Tree for Human-AI Collaboration
item.author: Beiwen Zhang, Yongheng Liang, Guowei Zou, Haitao Wang, Hejun Wu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为协作策略树（Co-pi-tree）的闭环方法，该方法通过蒸馏大语言模型的推理能力构建可执行策略树，并在人机协作环境中实现了显著的性能提升和效率优化。

背景: 在人机协作中构建高效可靠的策略至关重要。现有方法主要分为两类：一类依赖多智能体强化学习，存在可解释性差和安全隐患；另一类在每一步决策时查询大语言模型，导致响应速度慢和推理成本高。

目的: 解决现有方法在可解释性、安全性、响应速度和推理成本方面的问题，构建高效且可靠的人机协作策略。

方法: 提出协作策略树（Co-pi-tree），这是一种闭环方法，学习由伙伴行为预测树和智能体动作选择树组成的可执行策略树。该方法将大语言模型的推理蒸馏为策略树代码，通过与伙伴交互评估策略，获取反馈，并使用自然语言总结交互反馈以改进有问题的分支。

主要发现: 在Overcooked-AI环境中的实验表明，Co-pi-tree相比基线平均奖励提高了百分之三十五点四，同时减少了百分之七十七点七的大语言模型查询次数，并将测试时延迟降低了百分之九十七点一。

结论: Co-pi-tree通过结合大语言模型的推理能力和策略树的执行效率，有效提升了人机协作策略的性能和效率，为构建高效可靠的人机协作系统提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Constructing efficient and reliable policies to assist humans is indispensable for human-AI collaboration. Existing methods mainly follow two lines of work. Most prior work relies on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to learn black-box policies, which limits interpretability and raises safety concerns. Recent methods query large language models (LLMs) at each decision step, causing slow responses and high inference costs. We propose Collaboration Policy Tree (Co-pi-tree), a closed-loop method that learns an executable policy tree consisting of a partner-behavior prediction tree and an agent-action selection tree. Co-pi-tree constructs a policy by distilling LLM reasoning into policy tree code. It then evaluates the policy through partner interaction, obtains feedback, and uses natural language to summarize the interaction feedback to improve problematic branches. Experiments in Overcooked-AI show that Co-pi-tree improves average reward by 35.4% over the baseline average, while reducing the number of LLM queries by 77.7% and test-time latency by 97.1%. Project page: https://beiwenzhang.github.io/Co-pi-tree/

Abstract

Constructing efficient and reliable policies to assist humans is indispensable for human-AI collaboration. Existing methods mainly follow two lines of work. Most prior work relies on multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to learn black-box policies, which limits interpretability and raises safety concerns. Recent methods query large language models (LLMs) at each decision step, causing slow responses and high inference costs. We propose Collaboration Policy Tree (Co-pi-tree), a closed-loop method that learns an executable policy tree consisting of a partner-behavior prediction tree and an agent-action selection tree. Co-pi-tree constructs a policy by distilling LLM reasoning into policy tree code. It then evaluates the policy through partner interaction, obtains feedback, and uses natural language to summarize the interaction feedback to improve problematic branches. Experiments in Overcooked-AI show that Co-pi-tree improves average reward by 35.4% over the baseline average, while reducing the number of LLM queries by 77.7% and test-time latency by 97.1%. Project page: https://beiwenzhang.github.io/Co-pi-tree/

item.title: Facial Expression Recognition in the Deep Learning Era: A Systematic Multi-Criteria Review of Methods, Models, Datasets, Performance, Challenges, and Future Research Directions
item.author: Spyridon Georgiou, Aggelos Psiris, Spyridon Evangelatos, Thomas Lagkas, Vasileios Argyriou, Panagiotis Sarigiannidis, Iraklis Varlamis, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对基于深度学习的表情识别领域进行了全面综述，填补了现有综述在任务、架构或应用特定维度上缺乏系统性整合的空白。

背景: 过去十年中，表情识别技术从手工特征和浅层分类器发展到深度学习、注意力机制、视觉语言模型及基础模型架构，同时大规模野外基准数据集在分类、维度、复合、微表情、动作单元和强度估计等任务上迅速增长。

目的: 提供对基于深度学习的表情识别最新进展的系统性、整体性回顾，并将其与更广泛的表情识别领域联系起来。

方法: 将表情识别的发展划分为五个阶段，从手工特征和经典机器学习到注意力机制、视觉语言和基础模型方法；构建包含七个维度的多标准分类体系，涵盖识别任务、输入模态、面部预处理流程、网络架构、学习策略、采集设置和应用领域；进行逐标准比较分析，评估各方法在野外条件下的优缺点；整理公开数据集及其标注方案、模态和评估协议；汇总性能指标并对代表性最先进方法进行定量比较；讨论当前挑战和未来方向。

主要发现: 表情识别技术经历了五个发展阶段，现有方法在不同维度上各有优劣，在野外条件下存在特定局限性，公开数据集和评估协议多样，最先进方法在不同任务上表现各异。

结论: 该综述为表情识别领域的研究提供了系统性框架，指出了当前挑战和未来研究方向，有助于推动该领域的进一步发展。

翻译: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) has advanced rapidly over the last decade, driven by the shift from handcrafted descriptors and shallow classifiers to deep convolutional, attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model architectures, and by the parallel growth of large-scale in-the-wild benchmarks spanning categorical, dimensional, compound, micro-expression, Action Unit (AU), and intensity-estimation tasks. Yet the deep learning-based FER landscape has so far been reviewed only along narrow task-, architecture-, or application-specific axes, leaving a holistic, systematically organized account of its recent advances missing. This survey addresses that gap with a comprehensive review of recent deep learning-based FER, explicitly linked to the wider Facial Affect Recognition (FAR) domain. Its main contributions are: a) A description of FER's evolution into five distinct phases, from handcrafted features and classical machine learning to attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model approaches, with the key milestone works of each, b) A multi-criteria taxonomy analyzing the literature along seven complementary axes: recognition task, input modality, face pre-processing pipeline, network architecture, learning strategy, acquisition setting, and application domain, c) A per-criterion comparative analysis, with critical insights into the strengths and limitations of each category under in-the-wild conditions, d) A task-organized review of public FER datasets, with their annotation schemes, modalities, and evaluation protocols, e) A compilation of performance metrics and a per-task quantitative comparison of representative state-of-the-art methods on widely adopted benchmarks, and f) A discussion of current challenges and promising future directions.

Abstract

Facial Expression Recognition (FER) has advanced rapidly over the last decade, driven by the shift from handcrafted descriptors and shallow classifiers to deep convolutional, attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model architectures, and by the parallel growth of large-scale in-the-wild benchmarks spanning categorical, dimensional, compound, micro-expression, Action Unit (AU), and intensity-estimation tasks. Yet the deep learning-based FER landscape has so far been reviewed only along narrow task-, architecture-, or application-specific axes, leaving a holistic, systematically organized account of its recent advances missing. This survey addresses that gap with a comprehensive review of recent deep learning-based FER, explicitly linked to the wider Facial Affect Recognition (FAR) domain. Its main contributions are: a) A description of FER's evolution into five distinct phases, from handcrafted features and classical machine learning to attention-based, vision-language, and foundation-model approaches, with the key milestone works of each, b) A multi-criteria taxonomy analyzing the literature along seven complementary axes: recognition task, input modality, face pre-processing pipeline, network architecture, learning strategy, acquisition setting, and application domain, c) A per-criterion comparative analysis, with critical insights into the strengths and limitations of each category under in-the-wild conditions, d) A task-organized review of public FER datasets, with their annotation schemes, modalities, and evaluation protocols, e) A compilation of performance metrics and a per-task quantitative comparison of representative state-of-the-art methods on widely adopted benchmarks, and f) A discussion of current challenges and promising future directions.

item.title: Harnessing Streaming Video in the Wild
item.author: Dingyu Yao, Shuhuan Gu, Qingyi Si, Junhao Zhou, Chenxu Yang, Chuanyu Qin, Naibin Gu, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang, Nan Duan, Jiaqi Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对视觉语言模型在流式视频处理中的不足，提出了流式训练数据集、流式部署系统和流式评估基准，实现了主动交互、长期记忆和实时处理等核心能力。

背景: 视觉语言模型在视频通话助手、实时解说和具身机器人等应用中需要处理无界视频流。理想的流式系统应具备主动交互、长期记忆和实时处理能力，但现有模型擅长离线视频理解，在流式能力上存在不足，且缺乏专用的流式部署基础设施。

目的: 解决现有视觉语言模型在流式视频理解能力上的不足，推动从离线视频理解向可部署的流式智能的转变。

方法: 从三个方面解决问题：一是构建流式训练数据集和新的训练目标以适配流式交互和理解；二是引入即插即用的流式部署系统，赋予模型主动交互、长期记忆和实时处理三大核心能力；三是设计流式评估基准，反映模型在多样真实场景下的能力。

主要发现: 广泛的实验表明，该方法在所有流式视频理解所需的核心能力上均取得了一致的提升。

结论: 作者将开源数据、代码和基准，以推动社区在流式视频理解领域的进展。

翻译: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly required to process unbounded video streams in applications such as video-call assistants, live commentary, and embodied robots. An ideal streaming system should support proactive interaction, long-horizon memory, and real-time processing, while resting on a VLM backbone capable of handling diverse in-the-wild streaming tasks. However, existing VLMs excel at offline video understanding but fall short in streaming capabilities and lack dedicated infrastructure for streaming deployment. We address this gap on three fronts. (i) For backbone capability, we construct Streaming-Train-248K, a streaming dataset paired with a novel training objective for adapting VLMs to streaming interaction and understanding. (ii) For real-world deployment, we introduce Streaming Harness, a plug-and-play system that endows any VLM with three core abilities: proactive interaction (per-second response decisions), long-term memory (12-hour context retention), and real-time processing (sub-second latency). (iii) To drive continued community progress on streaming capabilities, we design Streaming-Eval, a benchmark that reflects models' capabilities across diverse in-the-wild scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains from our approach across all core capabilities required for streaming video understanding. We will open-source our data, code, and benchmark to advance the community's shift from offline video understanding to deployable streaming intelligence.

Abstract

Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly required to process unbounded video streams in applications such as video-call assistants, live commentary, and embodied robots. An ideal streaming system should support proactive interaction, long-horizon memory, and real-time processing, while resting on a VLM backbone capable of handling diverse in-the-wild streaming tasks. However, existing VLMs excel at offline video understanding but fall short in streaming capabilities and lack dedicated infrastructure for streaming deployment. We address this gap on three fronts. (i) For backbone capability, we construct \textbf{Streaming-Train-248K}, a streaming dataset paired with a novel training objective for adapting VLMs to streaming interaction and understanding. (ii) For real-world deployment, we introduce \textbf{Streaming Harness}, a plug-and-play system that endows any VLM with three core abilities: proactive interaction (per-second response decisions), long-term memory (12-hour context retention), and real-time processing (sub-second latency). (iii) To drive continued community progress on streaming capabilities, we design \textbf{Streaming-Eval}, a benchmark that reflects models' capabilities across diverse in-the-wild scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent gains from our approach across all core capabilities required for streaming video understanding. We will open-source our data, code, and benchmark to advance the community's shift from offline video understanding to deployable streaming intelligence.

item.title: Tyan-WP: A Wind Power Foundation Model for Ultra-Short-Term Probabilistic Forecasting
item.author: Jiahui Huang, Ao Luo, Lei Liu, Hongwei Zhao, Tengyuan Liu, Ruibo Guo, Bo Wang, Zhao Wang, Bin Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Tyan-WP的风电基础模型，用于超短期概率预测。该模型在覆盖超过一万两千个美国站点七年数据的大规模数据集上进行预训练，并通过静态站点嵌入和功率感知气象融合模块提升了零样本预测能力。在统一评估协议下，该模型在多个站点上超越了现有的特定站点时间序列模型和通用大型时间序列模型，显著降低了误差指标并提高了决定系数，同时展现了强大的跨地理区域泛化能力。

背景: 全球风电装机容量，尤其是中国的风电装机容量正在快速增长，新风电场遍布各种地形和气候。行业迫切需要准确的风电基础模型以缩短调试时间并加速并网。现有的特定站点时间序列模型在数据稀缺场景下表现不佳且泛化能力差，而通用大型时间序列模型主要局限于单变量输入，无法充分利用静态站点属性或功率与气象协变量之间的依赖关系，导致精度不足。

目的: 填补现有模型在数据稀缺场景和泛化能力方面的不足，提出一种能够进行超短期概率预测的风电基础模型，以实现无需目标站点训练的准确零样本预测，为快速风机上线和新风电场的概率风险管理提供实用途径。

方法: 提出Tyan-WP模型，该模型在覆盖超过一万两千个美国站点七年数据的大规模风电数据集上进行预训练。通过两个领域特定的模块设计提升零样本预测能力：一是使用坐标、地形和生态区元数据进行静态站点嵌入；二是设计功率感知气象融合模块，以建模历史功率与气象协变量之间的相互作用。

主要发现: 在统一评估协议下，Tyan-WP在十个域内站点上超越了八种特定站点监督时间序列模型，在一百二十七个域内站点上优于十一种通用大型时间序列模型。具体而言，平均绝对误差降低百分之十九点九，均方根误差降低百分之十六点六，连续概率评分降低百分之二十二点二，平均绝对量化损失降低百分之二十一点七，决定系数提高百分之十六点七。此外，该模型在六个真实英国站点上展现了强大的跨地理区域泛化能力。

结论: 风电基础模型可以在无需目标站点训练的情况下实现准确的零样本预测，为快速风机上线和新风电场的概率风险管理提供了一条实用途径。

翻译: Global wind power capacity, especially in China, is booming, with new farms spanning diverse terrains and climates. The industry urgently needs accurate wind power foundation models to shorten commissioning and accelerate grid connection. This is because site-specific time series models are not well suited to data-scarce scenarios and generalize poorly, while generic large time series models are mostly limited to univariate inputs and cannot fully exploit static site attributes or the dependencies between power and meteorological covariates, leading to insufficient accuracy. To fill this gap, we propose Tyan-WP, the first wind power foundation model for ultra-short-term probabilistic forecasting. Pretrained on a large-scale wind power dataset covering more than 126,000 U.S. sites over seven years, Tyan-WP further improves zero-shot forecasting through two domain-specific module designs: static site embedding using coordinate, terrain, and ecoregion metadata, and a power-aware meteorological fusion module that models interactions between historical power and meteorological covariates. Under a unified evaluation protocol, Tyan-WP surpasses eight site-specific supervised time series models on 10 in-domain sites and outperforms eleven generic large time series models on 127 in-domain sites, reducing MAE by 19.9%, RMSE by 16.6%, CRPS by 22.2%, and AQL by 21.7%, while raising R^2 by 16.7%. It further demonstrates strong cross-geography generalization on six real U.K. sites. These results show that the wind power foundation model can achieve accurate zero-shot forecasting without target-site training, providing a practical pathway for rapid turbine onboarding and probabilistic risk management at new wind farms.

Abstract

Global wind power capacity, especially in China, is booming, with new farms spanning diverse terrains and climates. The industry urgently needs accurate wind power foundation models to shorten commissioning and accelerate grid connection. This is because site-specific time series models (TSMs) are not well suited to data-scarce scenarios and generalize poorly, while generic large time series models (LTSMs) are mostly limited to univariate inputs and cannot fully exploit static site attributes or the dependencies between power and meteorological covariates, leading to insufficient accuracy. To fill this gap, we propose \textbf{Tyan-WP}, the first wind power foundation model for ultra-short-term probabilistic forecasting. Pretrained on a large-scale wind power dataset covering more than 126,000 U.S. sites over seven years, Tyan-WP further improves zero-shot forecasting through two domain-specific module designs: static site embedding using coordinate, terrain, and ecoregion metadata, and a power-aware meteorological fusion (PAMF) module that models interactions between historical power and meteorological covariates. Under a unified evaluation protocol, Tyan-WP surpasses eight site-specific supervised TSMs on 10 in-domain sites and outperforms eleven generic LTSMs on 127 in-domain sites, reducing MAE by 19.9%, RMSE by 16.6%, CRPS by 22.2%, and AQL by 21.7%, while raising R^2 by 16.7%. It further demonstrates strong cross-geography generalization on six real U.K. sites. These results show that the wind power foundation model can achieve accurate zero-shot forecasting without target-site training, providing a practical pathway for rapid turbine onboarding and probabilistic risk management at new wind farms.

item.title: Towards Long-Horizon Vessel Trajectory and Destination Forecasting with Reasoning Large Language Models
item.author: Hongwei Wang, Miao Zhou, Fengde Wang, Yuting Wang, Jiewen Yu, Jun-Yan He, Bohao Qu, Wanbing Zhang, Xiuju Fu, Qing Guo, Zipei Fan, Yingying Xing, Yi Yuan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对长周期海上轨迹预测问题，提出基于可验证奖励强化学习的海洋大语言模型后训练框架，通过语义化轨迹表示和分层匹配评估，显著提升了轨迹可行性和目的地预测准确性，为航运决策支持提供了新的语义对齐方法。

背景: 长周期海上轨迹预测对航运管理、物流规划和海事风险分析至关重要，但现有深度学习方法主要关注短中期坐标外推，难以在长周期内保持路线可行性和目的地正确性，且月份级预测研究不足。

目的: 研究结合推理能力的大语言模型进行联合长周期船舶轨迹和目的地预测，开发基于可验证奖励强化学习的海洋大语言模型后训练框架。

方法: 构建基于AIS数据的基准数据集，包含六十天历史轨迹和三十天预测周期，将轨迹转换为语义文本表示用于强化学习提示构建；通过物理有效性约束、早期加权轨迹监督和分层匹配课程学习，使大语言模型与海洋预测目标对齐。

主要发现: 强化学习训练的大语言模型在零样本大语言模型和代表性深度学习基线基础上显著提升，尤其在目的地相关指标上表现突出；四参数规模模型实现最佳整体性能，表明奖励兼容优化和任务特定容量匹配比单纯使用更大模型更重要；长短期记忆网络在有限微调数据下仍是强基线，而变压器风格时空模型通常需要更大数据集和更丰富的结构化输入。

结论: 该工作推进了语义验证器对齐的海洋预测技术，为运营决策支持提供了有效方法。

翻译: Long-horizon maritime trajectory prediction is important for shipping management, logistics planning, and maritime risk analysis, yet month-level forecasting remains insufficiently studied. Existing deep learning methods mainly focus on short- and mid-term coordinate extrapolation and often struggle to preserve route feasibility and destination correctness over extended horizons. This paper investigates joint long-horizon vessel trajectory and destination forecasting with reasoning-capable large language models, and develops a Maritime LLM post-training framework based on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR). An AIS-based benchmark is constructed with 60-day historical trajectories and 30-day forecasting horizons, where trajectories are converted into semantic textual representations for RL prompt construction. RLVR aligns LLMs with maritime forecasting objectives by enforcing physical validity, providing early-weighted trajectory supervision, and evaluating destination correctness through hierarchical matching and curriculum learning. Experimental results show that RLVR-trained LLMs substantially improve over zero-shot LLMs and representative deep learning baselines, especially on destination-related metrics. Among the evaluated RLVR-trained variants, 4B LLMs achieve the best overall performance, suggesting that reward-compatible optimization and task-specific capacity matching are more important than simply using larger 8B or 14B LLMs. The results also show that LSTM remains a strong deep learning baseline under limited fine-tuning data, while Transformer-style spatio-temporal models typically require larger datasets and richer structured inputs. Overall, this work advances semantic, verifier-aligned maritime forecasting for operational decision support.

Abstract

Long-horizon maritime trajectory prediction is important for shipping management, logistics planning, and maritime risk analysis, yet month-level forecasting remains insufficiently studied. Existing deep learning methods mainly focus on short- and mid-term coordinate extrapolation and often struggle to preserve route feasibility and destination correctness over extended horizons. This paper investigates joint long-horizon vessel trajectory and destination forecasting with reasoning-capable large language models, and develops a Maritime LLM post-training framework based on Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR). An AIS-based benchmark is constructed with 60-day historical trajectories and 30-day forecasting horizons, where trajectories are converted into semantic textual representations for RL prompt construction. RLVR aligns LLMs with maritime forecasting objectives by enforcing physical validity, providing early-weighted trajectory supervision, and evaluating destination correctness through hierarchical matching and curriculum learning. Experimental results show that RLVR-trained LLMs substantially improve over zero-shot LLMs and representative deep learning baselines, especially on destination-related metrics. Among the evaluated RLVR-trained variants, 4B LLMs achieve the best overall performance, suggesting that reward-compatible optimization and task-specific capacity matching are more important than simply using larger 8B or 14B LLMs. The results also show that LSTM remains a strong deep learning baseline under limited fine-tuning data, while Transformer-style spatio-temporal models typically require larger datasets and richer structured inputs. Overall, this work advances semantic, verifier-aligned maritime forecasting for operational decision support.

item.title: PhysGraph: A Physics-aware 3D Scene Graph for Perception and Reasoning
item.author: Haoyu Li, Aaron Thomas, Shuyan Zhou, Xianyi Cheng
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysGraph 是一个统一符号推理与结构化三维几何的框架，用于在杂乱场景中建模运动学和物理属性。

背景: 机器人需要构建语义丰富、物理基础且结构化的三维表示以支持任务规划。现有方法主要关注语义检索，忽视物理和运动学因素，且建模物理属性的方法通常依赖狭窄的训练集或单对象建模，限制了可扩展性和泛化能力。

目的: 解决现有方法在物理和运动学属性建模上的局限性，提供一个能够支持任务规划和功能预测的结构化三维表示。

方法: PhysGraph 框架通过 RGB-D 观测重建以对象为中心的三维几何并关联跨视图的对象实例，将对象分解为功能部件，并通过视觉推理推断材料和关节结构。

主要发现: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的评估显示，PhysGraph 在语义分割、多对象质量估计和关节预测方面取得了最先进结果。

结论: PhysGraph 设计简单有效，能生成物理一致且语义结构化的场景图，可作为下游任务（如约束感知的三维功能预测和真实到模拟迁移）的结构化三维表示。

翻译: 为了执行广泛的日常任务，机器人需要构建一个语义丰富、物理基础且结构足够支持任务规划和功能预测的三维表示。然而，现有方法主要关注语义检索，通常忽视物理和运动学因素。尝试建模物理属性的方法通常依赖狭窄的训练集或单对象建模，限制了在不同对象类型上的可扩展性和泛化能力。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 PhysGraph，这是一个统一符号推理与结构化三维几何的框架，用于在杂乱场景中建模运动学和物理属性。给定 RGB-D 观测，PhysGraph 重建以对象为中心的三维几何并关联跨视图的对象实例。然后它将对象分解为功能部件，并通过视觉推理推断材料和关节结构。在合成和真实世界数据集上的评估表明，PhysGraph 在语义分割、多对象质量估计和关节预测方面取得了最先进结果。凭借其简单而有效的设计，PhysGraph 生成了物理一致且语义结构化的场景图，作为下游任务（如约束感知的三维功能预测和真实到模拟迁移）的结构化三维表示，这些都在我们的实验中得到了展示。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有机器人场景表示过度依赖语义信息而忽视物理与运动学约束的问题，且现有方法难以在复杂多变的真实环境中泛化。这一问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为机器人要安全、精准地完成日常操作任务，必须准确理解物体的材质属性、连接关节类型及运动规律。缺乏这些物理知识将直接限制机器人的任务规划能力，并可能引发操作失误或安全隐患。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有三维场景表示缺乏物理与运动学信息且难以泛化到复杂场景的问题，设计了PhysGraph框架。该方法通过视觉基础模型与视觉语言模型，将彩色与深度图像重建、跨视角物体关联、部件分解与物理属性推理相结合，构建出包含空间关系与部件级物理约束的分层场景图。在借鉴现有三维场景图、神经场及功能理解等工作的基础上，作者改进了其封闭集训练、缺乏部件级推理或依赖大量人工标注的局限，利用大语言模型实现无需训练的零样本关节与材质推理，从而提升了方法的通用性与安全性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将符号推理与结构化三维几何相融合，构建物理感知的分层场景图，以同时捕捉物体的空间关系、运动学约束与材质属性，从而支持机器人的安全交互与任务规划。整体流程首先基于多视角图像重建物体三维几何并提取特征，跨视图关联识别出独立物体。接着利用大语言模型分析物体间的空间关系，并将每个物体分解为功能部件。随后通过视觉提示引导模型推理部件的材质参数与运动学约束类型，最终将所有信息整合为结构化场景图用于下游任务。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于提出了一种物理感知的三维场景图框架，能够自动将多视角视觉观测转化为包含物体空间关系、部件材质与运动约束的结构化三维表示。与以往仅关注语义检索或局限于单一物体建模的方法不同，该方法无需大量人工标注或离线训练，即可在杂乱场景中通过视觉提示与大语言模型进行零样本的物理推理。其独特之处在于实现了从整体到部件的细粒度属性推断，并直接为下游的约束感知功能推理及真实到仿真迁移提供统一的结构化基础。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了PhysGraph框架，通过结合视觉基础模型与大语言模型构建融合物理属性与运动约束的层次化三维场景图，实现了无需训练的零样本关节建模与约束感知的机器人任务规划。

Abstract

To perform a wide range of daily tasks, robots need to construct a 3D representation that is semantically rich, physically grounded, and structured enough to support task planning and affordance prediction. However, existing approaches primarily focus on semantic retrieval, often overlooking physical and kinematic factors. Methods that attempt to model physical properties typically rely on narrow training sets or single-object modeling, limiting scalability and generalization across diverse object types. To address these challenges, we present PhysGraph, a framework that unifies symbolic reasoning with structured 3D geometry to model kinematic and physical properties in cluttered scenes. Given RGB-D observations, PhysGraph reconstructs object-centric 3D geometry and associates object instances across views. It then decomposes objects into functional parts and infers materials and articulations through visual reasoning. Evaluated on both synthetic and real-world datasets, PhysGraph achieves state-of-the-art results in semantic segmentation, multi-object mass estimation, and articulation prediction. With its simple yet effective design, PhysGraph produces physically consistent and semantically structured scene graphs, serving as a structured 3D representation for downstream tasks such as constraint-aware 3D affordance prediction and real-to-sim transfer, both of which are demonstrated in our experiments.

item.title: Latent Diffusion Policy: Shaping Latent Spaces for Diffusion-Based Robotic Manipulation
item.author: Zhexuan Zhou, Yichen Lai, Jinhao Zhang, Huizhe Li, Youmin Gong, Jie Mei
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为潜在扩散策略的两阶段框架，通过在精心设计的潜在空间中进行流匹配来简化视觉运动策略的学习。

背景: 基于扩散的视觉运动策略直接在原始动作空间中运行，将场景理解与轨迹生成混合在单个去噪过程中，导致速度场需同时编码场景信息和生成精确轨迹，增加了学习复杂性，并限制了在多臂任务中需要精确时间协调的性能。

目的: 简化联合学习问题，提高在多臂任务中的性能。

方法: 引入潜在扩散策略，使用观察条件化的变分自编码器编码器吸收场景理解，集中每个观察的条件分布，使流模型在预集中的分布中生成，具有更平滑的速度场。训练时使用逐令牌扩散强制和阶梯推理采样以捕捉潜在令牌之间的时间依赖性。提出重建FID作为轻量级代理，仅从潜在空间统计预测下游任务成功。

主要发现: 在RoboTwin 2.0的协调密集型任务上，潜在扩散策略显著优于DP3，并有效转移到现实世界的双臂部署。

结论: 潜在扩散策略通过简化学习过程和提高性能，为多臂任务提供了有效的解决方案。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

Diffusion-based visuomotor policies operating directly in raw action spaces conflate scene comprehension with trajectory generation within a single denoising process. The resulting velocity field must simultaneously encode scene information and generate precise trajectories, increasing learning complexity and limiting performance on tasks demanding precise temporal coordination across multiple arms. To simplify this joint learning problem, we introduce Latent Diffusion Policy (LDP), a two-stage framework performing flow matching in a deliberately shaped latent space. By absorbing scene understanding into an observation-conditioned CVAE encoder, LDP concentrates the conditional distribution of each observation. Consequently, the flow model avoids implicitly resolving scene-dependent structures; instead, it generates within a pre-concentrated distribution featuring a smoother velocity field, simplifying learning from limited demonstrations. Furthermore, to capture temporal dependencies among latent tokens, LDP trains with per-token diffusion forcing and employs staircase inference sampling to resolve the resulting distributional mismatch. We also propose reconstruction FID (rFID) as a lightweight proxy predicting downstream task success solely from latent space statistics. On coordination-intensive tasks from RoboTwin 2.0, LDP outperforms DP3 by a substantial margin and transfers effectively to real-world bimanual deployments.

item.title: Language as a Sensor: Calibrated Spatial Belief Estimation in 3D Scenes from Natural Language
item.author: Aryan Naveen, Jason Xinyu Liu, Luca Carlone, Andreea Bobu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种语言传感器模型和视觉语言度量语义映射框架，将自然语言描述转化为校准的空间分布，并与机器人感知数据融合，以提高目标位置预测的准确性。

背景: 在以人为本的环境中，机器人常接收到超出其感知范围的物体位置自然语言描述。传统度量语义映射忽略此类信息，而现有多模态模型在三维空间推理和传感器融合方面存在局限。

目的: 将语言观察转化为校准的空间分布，并与机器人感知数据融合，以准确预测目标位置。

方法: 训练语言传感器模型，将语言描述和场景图上下文映射为多模态分布，其中混合权重编码指代歧义，协方差编码空间不确定性。引入视觉语言度量语义映射框架，将语言预测作为随机观测与机载感知融合到统一信念地图中。

主要发现: 在基准测试和真实移动机器人实验中，该语言预测器的协方差估计保持在校准范围内。融合后，目标位置预测的准确性显著提升，真实目标上的概率质量比最强基线模型高出约百分之七十。

结论: 所提出的方法能有效利用自然语言信息，提升机器人在复杂环境中的空间推理和目标定位能力。

翻译: Robots deployed in human-centric environments routinely receive natural-language descriptions of spatial information (I left my backpack on the table) that reference parts of the world beyond their perceptual field of view. Traditional metric-semantic mapping ignores this signal, while off-the-shelf multimodal models remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning and are not directly amenable to fusion with other sensor modalities. To convert language observations into a calibrated spatial distribution, we train a Language Sensor Model that maps each utterance and its scene-graph context to a multimodal distribution, with mixture weights encoding referential ambiguity (e.g., which table) and component covariances encoding spatial uncertainty (e.g., where on the table the target lies). We then introduce VL-Map, a probabilistic framework that treats these language predictions as stochastic observations and fuses them with onboard perception within a unified belief map. On the VLA-3D benchmark as well as on a real-world mobile robot, LSM is the only language predictor whose covariance estimates remain within the calibrated regime; fused into VL-Map, it leads to more accurate predictions of the target object location (about seventy percent more probability mass on the true target compared to the strongest foundation-model baseline).

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决如何将人类自然语言描述的空间信息转化为机器人可使用的、带有准确不确定性评估的三维空间概率分布，并将其与机器人自身的视觉传感器数据融合。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为机器人在与人类共处的环境中常需根据指令寻找视野外的目标，传统方法会忽略这些关键线索导致盲目搜索。通过把语言当作一种传感器并精确量化其模糊性，机器人能大幅缩小搜索范围，提升定位效率与人机协作的可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统建图系统会忽略人类语言提供的空间线索，而现有三维视觉语言模型只能输出确定性结果且缺乏可靠的不确定性评估，难以与传感器数据融合。为此，他们将语言视为一种空间传感器，设计了语言传感器模型，把自然语言语句与场景背景结合，输出包含指代歧义和空间不确定性的概率分布。该方法在借鉴传统建图系统、现有三维视觉语言模型及语言不确定性量化技术的基础上，通过贝叶斯推理框架将这些语言概率分布与实时视觉感知进行融合，从而实现对目标位置的精准定位。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将自然语言视为一种概率空间传感器，把人类口语描述转化为包含指代歧义和空间不确定性的校准概率分布，并与机器人实时视觉数据进行融合，从而在未见区域准确定位目标。整体流程首先利用语言模型结合场景先验图生成候选对象及置信度权重，接着通过深度学习网络为每个候选项预测三维位置的概率分布，最后将这些语言预测结果作为随机观测输入概率滤波框架，与机器人移动中获取的视觉数据递归融合，逐步收敛并精化目标位置的后验信念。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种语言传感器模型和一个融合框架，将自然语言描述转化为带有明确不确定性估计的三维空间概率分布，并以此作为传感器数据与机器人的视觉观测进行概率融合。与以往工作相比，传统建图系统完全忽略语言线索，而现有的多模态模型通常只输出确定性结果且缺乏校准的不确定性，无法直接与其他传感器融合。本文方法首次将语言视为可校准的随机空间观测，在部分可观测场景下实现了语言先验与实时视觉感知的无缝结合，显著提升了目标定位的准确性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种语言传感器模型，能将自然语言描述转化为校准的空间概率分布以量化不确定性，并设计了融合框架将该语言信号与机器人视觉感知数据结合，从而在三维场景中更精准地定位目标物体。

Abstract

Robots deployed in human-centric environments routinely receive natural-language descriptions of spatial information ("I left my backpack on the table") that reference parts of the world beyond their perceptual field of view. Traditional metric-semantic mapping ignores this signal, while off-the-shelf multimodal models remain limited in 3D spatial reasoning and are not directly amenable to fusion with other sensor modalities. To convert language observations into a calibrated spatial distribution, we train a Language Sensor Model (LSM) that maps each utterance and its scene-graph context to a multimodal distribution, with mixture weights encoding referential ambiguity (e.g., "which table") and component covariances encoding spatial uncertainty (e.g., where "on the table" the target lies). We then introduce VL-Map (Vision-Language Metric-Semantic Mapping), a probabilistic framework that treats these language predictions as stochastic observations and fuses them with onboard perception within a unified belief map. On the VLA-3D benchmark as well as on a real-world mobile robot, LSM is the only language predictor whose covariance estimates remain within the calibrated regime; fused into VL-Map, it leads to more accurate predictions of the target object location (~70% more probability mass on the true target compared to the strongest foundation-model baseline).

item.title: A Comparison of SSL-Based Feature Extractors and Back-End Classifiers for Spoofing Detection: A Multi-Corpus Training and Cross-Linguistic Analysis
item.author: Anh-Tuan Dao, Driss Matrouf, Mickael Rouvier, Nicholas Evans
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对语音生物识别系统面临的欺骗攻击威胁及检测模型评估不一致的问题，对四种自监督学习特征提取器与四种后端分类器进行了全面基准测试。通过跨语料库训练和多数据集评估，揭示了ASVspoof 5数据集的域偏差问题，并发现仅需八小时目标语言数据微调即可显著提升检测鲁棒性，强调了领域感知和语言特定适应在欺骗检测中的重要性。

背景: 语音生物识别系统正面临日益增长的欺骗攻击威胁，且不同数据集上的检测模型评估结果存在不一致性。

目的: 调查检测模型性能不可预测的波动原因，评估不同特征提取器和分类器的组合效果。

方法: 对四种自监督学习特征提取器与四种后端分类器进行基准测试，比较ResNet的层次局部特征提取与基于注意力和图的后端的全局序列及关系建模。在三种场景和六个评估数据集上进行跨语料库训练和实证分析。

主要发现: 第一，ASVspoof 5数据集存在域偏差，简单的数据缩放会主动降低性能。第二，跨语言分析显示，仅使用八小时目标语言数据进行微调即可增强检测的鲁棒性。

结论: 在欺骗检测中，领域感知和语言特定的适应至关重要。

翻译: Voice biometric systems face growing threats from spoofing attacks, yet the evaluation of detection models remains inconsistent across datasets. To investigate these unpredictable fluctuations, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark of four self-supervised learning feature extractors paired with four back-end classifiers. We compare the hierarchical local feature extraction of ResNet with the global sequence and relational modeling of attention and graph-based back-ends. Through multi-corpus training across three scenarios and six evaluation datasets, our empirical analysis yields two critical findings. First, we expose a domain bias within the ASVspoof 5 dataset, showing that naive data scaling actively degrades performance. Second, our cross-linguistic analysis reveals that fine-tuning with just 8 hours of target-language data enhances detection robustness. Together, these findings emphasize the critical need for domain-aware and language-specific adaptation in spoofing detection.

Abstract

Voice biometric systems face growing threats from spoofing attacks, yet the evaluation of detection models remains inconsistent across datasets. To investigate these unpredictable fluctuations, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark of four self-supervised learning feature extractors paired with four back-end classifiers. We compare the hierarchical local feature extraction of ResNet with the global sequence and relational modeling of attention and graph-based back-ends. Through multi-corpus training across three scenarios and six evaluation datasets, our empirical analysis yields two critical findings. First, we expose a domain bias within the ASVspoof 5 dataset, showing that naive data scaling actively degrades performance. Second, our cross-linguistic analysis reveals that fine-tuning with just 8 hours of target-language data enhances detection robustness. Together, these findings emphasize the critical need for domain-aware and language-specific adaptation in spoofing detection.

item.title: Speaker-Invariant Representation Learning for Spoofing Detection via Gradient Reversal and A Variational Information Bottleneck
item.author: Anh-Tuan Dao, Driss Matrouf, Mickael Rouvier, Nicholas Evans
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出一种教师-学生框架用于说话人不变的语音欺骗检测，通过解耦身份特征提升模型在域外设置下的泛化能力。

背景: 先进的生成式语音技术可能削弱语音生物识别的可靠性，现有欺骗检测系统在域内条件下表现良好，但在域外设置下泛化能力较差。

目的: 解决因说话人偏差导致的模型学习个体声音特征而非操纵或生成标记的问题，实现无需说话人标签的说话人不变欺骗检测。

方法: 采用预训练说话人识别教师模型通过梯度反转层指导学生模型，并集成变分信息瓶颈以平衡抑制身份相关线索与保留欺骗检测相关线索。

主要发现: 在九个数据集上的评估显示，该模型相比MHFA基线实现了25.7%的相对EER降低。

结论: 所提框架能有效解耦身份特征，提升语音欺骗检测在域外设置下的性能。

翻译: Sophisticated generative speech technology can undermined the reliability of voice biometrics. While spoofing detection systems excel when assessed under in-domain conditions, generalisation to out-of-domain settings is often poor. In this paper, we show that such issues could be caused by speaker bias, where models learn individual voice traits rather than markers of manipulation or generation. We propose a teacher-student framework for speaker-invariant spoofing detection that disentangles identity without requiring speaker labels. We leverage a pre-trained speaker recognition teacher to guide a student model via a gradient reversal layer. To control the balance between suppressing cues related to voice identity with the preservation of those related to spoofing detection, we integrate a Variational Information Bottleneck. Evaluations across nine datasets show our model achieves a 25.7% relative reduction to the EER compared to the MHFA baseline.

Abstract

Sophisticated generative speech technology can undermined the reliability of voice biometrics. While spoofing detection systems excel when assessed under in-domain conditions, generalisation to out-of-domain settings is often poor. In this paper, we show that such issues could be caused by speaker bias, where models learn individual voice traits rather than markers of manipulation or generation. We propose a teacher-student framework for speaker-invariant spoofing detection that disentangles identity without requiring speaker labels. We leverage a pre-trained speaker recognition teacher to guide a student model via a gradient reversal layer. To control the balance between suppressing cues related to voice identity with the preservation of those related to spoofing detection, we integrate a Variational Information Bottleneck. Evaluations across nine datasets show our model achieves a 25.7% relative reduction to the EER compared to the MHFA baseline.

item.title: Distortion-Aware PETR for BEV Object Detection with Mixed Pinhole-Fisheye Cameras
item.author: Xiangzhong Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为DAPETR的无投影检测器，专为混合针孔鱼眼相机设置设计，通过引入统一畸变感知位置嵌入和双向特征几何协同调制模块，解决了鱼眼相机在3D目标检测中因严重径向畸变导致的问题，并在KITTI-360基准测试中取得了优于基线和其他方法（如PolarPETR）的性能。

背景: 鱼眼相机因其低成本和全视场覆盖在自动驾驶感知套件中广泛应用，但在3D目标检测中潜力未被充分利用。严重的径向畸变破坏了均匀采样的基本假设，对大多数鸟瞰图检测器构成挑战。

目的: 弥合鱼眼相机在3D目标检测中的潜力与现有方法之间的差距，提出一种无需图像校正的畸变感知3D感知设计。

方法: 提出Distortion-Aware PETR（DAPETR），包含两个关键的学习自适应模块：统一畸变感知位置嵌入，用于协调图像表示与鱼眼几何的位置编码；双向特征几何协同调制模块，用于相互适应图像特征和3D位置嵌入。

主要发现: 在转换的KITTI-360基准测试中，DAPETR的性能优于基线方法和PolarPETR。同时发现将学习自适应策略与显式几何重新参数化策略结合时存在负面交互，表明这两种方法可能相互冲突。

结论: DAPETR显著推进了鱼眼鸟瞰图检测的研究和基准，为除图像校正外的有效畸变感知3D感知设计提供了关键见解。

翻译: Fisheye cameras are widely deployed in autonomous driving perception suites for their low cost and full-coverage field of view (FOV), yet their potential remains underleveraged in 3D object detection. Severe radial distortion challenges most BEV detectors by violating the fundamental assumption of uniform sampling. To bridge this gap, we propose Distortion-Aware PETR (DAPETR), a projection-free detector tailored for mixed pinhole-fisheye camera setups. DAPETR incorporates two key learned-adaptive modules: a unified distortion-aware positional embedding that harmonizes positional encodings for image representations with fisheye geometry, and a bidirectional feature-geometry co-modulation module that mutually adapts image features and 3D positional embeddings. In our experiments on a converted KITTI-360 benchmark, we systematically compare our learned adaptive approach against PETR in polar coordinates (PolarPETR). We find that while both methods improve over the baseline, our learned modules achieve superior performance. Crucially, we uncover a negative interaction when combining both strategies, revealing that learned adaptation and explicit geometric reparameterization can conflict. Our final DAPETR model significantly advances the research and benchmark for fisheye BEV detection, providing critical insights into effective distortion-aware 3D perception design other than image rectification.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决鱼眼相机在自动驾驶3D目标检测中因严重径向畸变导致传统鸟瞰图检测器失效的问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为鱼眼相机成本低且能提供全景视野，被广泛部署于自动驾驶感知系统中，但其畸变特性破坏了现有检测模型均匀采样的基本假设，严重限制了3D目标检测的性能与泛化能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对鱼眼相机严重径向畸变破坏传统检测器均匀采样假设的问题，思考将无投影架构的计算高效性与极坐标的空间对齐优势相结合。在方法设计上，他们以PETR检测器为基础，引入统一相机模型生成畸变感知的位置编码，并借鉴特征级线性调制技术构建了双向协同调制模块，使图像特征与三维位置信息相互优化。该工作明确借鉴并改进了PETR架构、极坐标表示方法以及特征调制机制等现有研究。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是放弃传统的图像畸变校正，转而通过可学习的自适应模块让网络直接适应混合相机带来的严重径向畸变。整体流程首先将多视角图像输入网络提取特征，接着利用统一相机模型生成兼顾鱼眼几何特性的三维位置编码，并引入极坐标信息增强二维特征的畸变感知能力。随后通过双向协同调制机制，使图像外观特征与三维空间位置编码相互优化。最后将融合后的特征送入解码器，直接预测出三维目标边界框。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种无需显式投影的鸟瞰图检测框架，通过统一的畸变感知位置编码将二维图像特征与鱼眼相机的几何特性对齐，并设计了双向特征与几何协同调制模块，使图像外观特征与三维空间位置编码相互优化。与以往工作相比，传统方法通常依赖计算开销大且易丢失视野的图像校正技术，或在严重镜头畸变下因缺乏几何对齐而导致检测性能下降。本文无需复杂的几何变换即可有效处理混合针孔与鱼眼相机的严重径向畸变，在保持免投影架构高效性的同时显著提升了检测精度，并首次揭示了显式几何对齐与学习自适应策略结合时可能产生的负面冲突。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种无需图像矫正的鸟瞰图目标检测框架，通过引入统一的畸变感知位置编码和双向特征几何协同调制模块，有效解决了混合针孔与鱼眼相机系统中的严重镜头畸变问题，并首次揭示了显式几何对齐与学习自适应策略之间的负面交互作用。

Abstract

Fisheye cameras are widely deployed in autonomous driving perception suites for their low cost and full-coverage field of view (FOV), yet their potential remains underleveraged in 3D object detection. Severe radial distortion challenges most BEV detectors by violating the fundamental assumption of uniform sampling. To bridge this gap, we propose Distortion-Aware PETR (DAPETR), a projection-free detector tailored for mixed pinhole-fisheye camera setups. DAPETR incorporates two key learned-adaptive modules: a unified distortion-aware positional embedding that harmonizes positional encodings for image representations with fisheye geometry, and a bidirectional feature-geometry co-modulation module that mutually adapts image features and 3D positional embeddings. In our experiments on a converted KITTI-360 benchmark, we systematically compare our learned adaptive approach against PETR in polar coordinates (PolarPETR). We find that while both methods improve over the baseline, our learned modules achieve superior performance. Crucially, we uncover a negative interaction when combining both strategies, revealing that learned adaptation and explicit geometric reparameterization can conflict. Our final DAPETR model significantly advances the research and benchmark for fisheye BEV detection, providing critical insights into effective distortion-aware 3D perception design other than image rectification.

item.title: Shift-Dependent Asymmetry: Orthogonal Inverse Low-Rank Adaptation for Federated Medical Segmentation
item.author: Xingyue Zhao, Wenke Huang, Linghao Zhuang, Haoran Wu, Anwen Jiang, Zhifeng Wang, Wenwen He, Ming Feng, Mang Ye, Bo Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为逆非对称微调的方法，用于解决医学图像分割中联邦低秩微调的泛化问题。

背景: 现有的联邦低秩微调方法通常采用统一的聚合规则，但在医学图像分割的编码器-解码器非对称结构下，编码器主要受外观变化影响，而解码器主要受监督变化影响，导致共享解剖结构与站点特定偏差纠缠，损害泛化能力。

目的: 解决联邦低秩微调中因编码器与解码器异质性来源不同而导致的泛化性能下降问题。

方法: 提出逆非对称微调方法，通过个性化编码器组件以吸收外观变化，个性化解码器组件以适应站点相关的监督变化，同时保留共享路径以获取可迁移的共识。此外，引入子空间正交正则化器，惩罚有效更新空间中共享与局部方向的共线性，防止站点特定更新泄漏到共享方向，且无需额外通信。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在多个基准测试中持续优于强大的联邦低秩微调及参数高效联邦学习方法。

结论: 逆非对称微调方法通过解耦异质性来源并防止更新泄漏，有效提升了医学图像分割模型的泛化性能。

翻译: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of segmentation foundation models for medical imaging. However, most federated LoRA methods adopt a uniform aggregation rule, which breaks under the encoder-decoder asymmetry in medical segmentation: the encoder is dominated by appearance shifts, while the decoder is dominated by supervision variations. This mismatch entangles shared anatomy with site-specific biases and harms generalization. To address this, we propose Inverse Asymmetric Tuning (IAT). IAT aligns adaptation with heterogeneity sources by personalizing module-specific components in the encoder to absorb appearance shifts and in the decoder to accommodate site-dependent supervision, while retaining a shared pathway for transferable consensus. However, structural separation alone is insufficient under LoRA's bilinear parameterization, where multiplicative coupling can still cause site-specific updates to leak into the shared direction. We therefore introduce a Subspace Orthogonality Regularizer that penalizes shared-local collinearity in the effective update space, mitigating leakage without extra communication. Experiments show consistent improvements over strong federated LoRA and parameter-efficient FL baselines.

Abstract

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of segmentation foundation models for medical imaging. However, most federated LoRA methods adopt a uniform aggregation rule, which breaks under the encoder-decoder asymmetry in medical segmentation: the encoder is dominated by appearance shifts, while the decoder is dominated by supervision variations. This mismatch entangles shared anatomy with site-specific biases and harms generalization. To address this, we propose Inverse Asymmetric Tuning (IAT). IAT aligns adaptation with heterogeneity sources by personalizing module-specific components in the encoder to absorb appearance shifts and in the decoder to accommodate site-dependent supervision, while retaining a shared pathway for transferable consensus. However, structural separation alone is insufficient under LoRA's bilinear parameterization, where multiplicative coupling can still cause site-specific updates to leak into the shared direction. We therefore introduce a Subspace Orthogonality Regularizer that penalizes shared-local collinearity in the effective update space, mitigating leakage without extra communication. Experiments show consistent improvements over strong federated LoRA and parameter-efficient FL baselines.

item.title: PhysAgent: Automating Physics-Based 4D Synthesis via Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback
item.author: Chunji Lv, Jiaxi Ye, Yuchen Jiang, Rexar Lin, Changsheng Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhysAgent 是一个基于模拟器的多智能体框架，通过解耦内在材质与外在动力学，利用语义智能体生成初始配置，并通过轨迹锚定的多智能体反馈机制，结合视觉基础模型与大语言模型常识推理，实现从任意多模态提示词到稳定、多样且物理准确的三维运动合成的自动化生成。

背景: 实现完全自动化且物理合理的三维运动合成是图形学与生成式人工智能的核心目标。然而，复杂环境力场的配置仍完全依赖人工专家干预，严重制约了大规模仿真数据的生成。现有自动化方法主要关注材质优化，在更复杂的力场优化空间中存在严重的模态差距和技术缺陷：朴素的大语言模型缺乏底层仿真反馈导致物理不准确，而传统的分数蒸馏采样方法存在梯度迟缓、陷入局部最优以及无法动态切换离散力场的数学局限。

目的: 解决复杂环境力场配置依赖人工干预的瓶颈问题，实现自动化、物理合理的三维运动合成。

方法: 提出 PhysAgent，这是一个模拟器在环的多智能体框架。首先，通过解耦内在材质与外在动力学，利用配备外部化力场技能模块的语义智能体掌握仿真规则并生成有效初始配置。其次，由轨迹锚定的多智能体反馈驱动的细化智能体，利用视觉基础模型从渲染帧中提取密集点轨迹。最后，将这些显式运动轨迹转换为结构化文本描述，利用大语言模型的常识推理执行零样本宏观跃迁，从而有效跳出局部最优并动态切换离散力场。

主要发现: PhysAgent 能够迅速从任意多模态提示词生成稳定且多样的物理场景，在生成多样性和物理准确性方面显著优于现有基线方法。

结论: PhysAgent 成功实现了基于多模态输入的自动化、物理基础的三维运动合成，解决了现有方法在力场优化中的技术缺陷，为大规模仿真数据生成提供了有效解决方案。

翻译: Achieving fully automated, physically plausible 3D motion synthesis is a core objective in graphics and generative AI. However, configuring complex environmental force fields still relies entirely on manual expert intervention, creating a severe bottleneck for large-scale simulation data generation. Existing automated methods primarily focus on material optimization and exhibit severe modality gaps and technical flaws when applied to the vastly more complex force field optimization space: naive Large Language Models (LLMs) lack underlying simulation feedback, causing severe physical inaccuracies, while traditional Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) suffers from sluggish gradients, local optima entrapment, and a mathematical inability to dynamically switch discrete force fields. To address this, we propose PhysAgent, the first simulator-in-the-loop multi-agent framework that leverages multimodal inputs for automated, physically grounded 4D synthesis. By decoupling intrinsic materials from extrinsic dynamics, PhysAgent utilizes a Semantic Agent equipped with an externalized Force Field Skill module to master simulation rules and generate valid initializations. Subsequently, the Refine Agents, driven by Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback, leverage vision foundation models to extract dense point trajectories from rendered frames. By converting these explicit motion trajectories into structured textual descriptors, the agent harnesses LLM commonsense reasoning to execute zero-shot macroscopic leaps, effectively escaping local optima and dynamically switching discrete force fields. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAgent rapidly generates stable, diverse physical scenes from arbitrary multimodal prompts, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both generation diversity and physical accuracy.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决物理仿真中环境力场参数完全依赖人工配置、导致大规模数据生成困难的问题。现有自动化方法要么缺乏物理反馈导致运动失真，要么优化过程缓慢且容易陷入局部最优。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为自动且符合物理规律的动态场景生成是赋能具身智能和降低仿真数据制作成本的核心瓶颈，实现力场参数的全自动配置将极大推动计算机图形学与生成式人工智能的发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有方法在环境力场配置上高度依赖人工、传统优化算法易陷入局部最优且无法动态切换离散力场，以及大语言模型缺乏物理反馈导致运动失真等问题，提出了“仿真器在环”的多智能体框架。该方法将物体固有材质与环境外力场解耦，通过语义智能体结合力场技能库生成初始配置，并利用视觉基础模型提取渲染视频中的运动轨迹，转化为文本后交由大语言模型进行全局推理与迭代优化。在技术路线上，作者充分借鉴了三维高斯溅射技术、质点法物理仿真器以及分数蒸馏采样算法，同时摒弃了传统梯度优化的缓慢更新机制，并融合了视觉大模型与大语言模型的能力以构建闭环反馈。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个仿真器在环的多智能体框架，通过将物体固有材质与环境外力场解耦，利用大语言模型的常识推理能力结合视觉反馈来自动化生成并迭代优化物理参数。整体流程首先从参考图像中提取初始材质与空间位置，再由语义智能体根据文本提示生成初始外力场配置；接着运行物理仿真渲染出动态视频；随后利用视觉基础模型提取视频中的物体运动轨迹并转化为文本描述；最后通过多智能体闭环反馈不断调整外力场参数，直至生成符合用户意图且物理真实的动态场景。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了首个基于物理仿真的闭环多智能体框架，通过语义智能体结合外部力场技能库自动生成初始参数，并利用轨迹反馈机制驱动视觉基础模型与大语言模型协同优化。相比以往工作，该方法彻底摒弃了传统基于梯度反传的优化方式以及缺乏物理反馈的简单大模型提示，转而采用渲染视频提取运动轨迹的视觉闭环反馈。这使得系统能够自动配置复杂的环境力场，有效避免陷入局部最优，并实现离散力场的动态切换，从而在生成多样性和物理准确性上显著超越现有基线。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了PhysAgent框架，首次通过仿真器在环的多智能体协作机制，结合语义解析与视觉轨迹反馈，实现了从图文提示到复杂环境力场配置的完全自动化物理驱动四维动态生成。

Abstract

Achieving fully automated, physically plausible 3D motion synthesis is a core objective in graphics and generative AI. However, configuring complex environmental force fields still relies entirely on manual expert intervention, creating a severe bottleneck for large-scale simulation data generation. Existing automated methods primarily focus on material optimization and exhibit severe modality gaps and technical flaws when applied to the vastly more complex force field optimization space: naive Large Language Models (LLMs) lack underlying simulation feedback, causing severe physical inaccuracies, while traditional Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) suffers from sluggish gradients, local optima entrapment, and a mathematical inability to dynamically switch discrete force fields. To address this, we propose PhysAgent, the first simulator-in-the-loop multi-agent framework that leverages multimodal inputs for automated, physically grounded 4D synthesis. By decoupling intrinsic materials from extrinsic dynamics, PhysAgent utilizes a Semantic Agent equipped with an externalized Force Field Skill module to master simulation rules and generate valid initializations. Subsequently, the Refine Agents, driven by Trajectory-Grounded Multi-Agent Feedback, leverage vision foundation models to extract dense point trajectories from rendered frames. By converting these explicit motion trajectories into structured textual descriptors, the agent harnesses LLM commonsense reasoning to execute zero-shot macroscopic leaps, effectively escaping local optima and dynamically switching discrete force fields. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysAgent rapidly generates stable, diverse physical scenes from arbitrary multimodal prompts, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both generation diversity and physical accuracy.

item.title: Hierarchical Projection for Adaptive Knowledge Transfer
item.author: Samhita Pal, Tian Gu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为投影迁移学习的统一框架，通过分层贝叶斯建模和自适应投影实现选择性知识迁移，解决了跨域学习中因数据异质性和虚假信号导致的性能下降问题，在模拟和真实生物医学应用中展示了更高的准确性、稳定性和可解释性。

背景: 现代数据驱动应用越来越多地涉及从多个异质源进行学习，目标数据集有限但跨域存在相关信息。简单结合这些源在相关性变化或存在虚假信号时会降低性能，对可信跨域学习构成根本挑战。

目的: 提出一种统一框架，通过选择性知识迁移整合跨域异质数据，以减轻负迁移并保留可解释性，实现稳健且可解释的迁移学习。

方法: 提出投影迁移学习框架，包含两个阶段：首先构建源引导的分层先验，使用数据驱动权重聚合源信息以捕获源与目标之间的全局对齐；其次通过后验投影步骤在特征层面进行细化，选择性地保留与目标信号局部一致的坐标，从而实现源选择和特征选择。

主要发现: 该两阶段设计能够同时执行源选择和特征选择，减轻负迁移并保留可解释性。在模拟和真实生物医学应用中，该方法相比现有方法提高了准确性、稳定性和可解释性。

结论: 该框架为高维设置下的可信跨域学习提供了一种可扩展且通用的策略，弥合了统计建模与现代机器学习范式之间的差距。

翻译: Modern data-driven applications increasingly involve learning from multiple heterogeneous sources, where a target dataset is limited but related information is available across domains. Naively combining these sources can degrade performance when relevance varies or spurious signals are present, posing a fundamental challenge for trustworthy cross-domain learning. We propose Projection Transfer Learning (ProjectionTL), a unified framework that integrates hierarchical Bayesian modeling with adaptive projection for selective knowledge transfer. The key idea is to decouple transfer at two levels: first, we construct a source-guided hierarchical prior that aggregates information across sources using data-driven weights, capturing global alignment between each source and the target; second, we refine this borrowing through a posterior-projection step that operates at the feature level, selectively retaining coordinates that exhibit local agreement with the target signal. This two-stage design enables the method to simultaneously perform source selection and feature selection, thereby mitigating negative transfer while preserving interpretability. ProjectionTL provides a principled approach to integrating heterogeneous data across domains, bridging statistical modeling and modern machine learning paradigms for robust and interpretable transfer. Through simulations and real-world biomedical applications, we demonstrate improved accuracy, stability, and interpretability compared to existing methods. Our framework offers a scalable and generalizable strategy for trustworthy cross-domain learning in high-dimensional settings.

Abstract

Modern data-driven applications increasingly involve learning from multiple heterogeneous sources, where a target dataset is limited but related information is available across domains. Naively combining these sources can degrade performance when relevance varies or spurious signals are present, posing a fundamental challenge for trustworthy cross-domain learning. We propose Projection Transfer Learning (ProjectionTL), a unified framework that integrates hierarchical Bayesian modeling with adaptive projection for selective knowledge transfer. The key idea is to decouple transfer at two levels: first, we construct a source-guided hierarchical prior that aggregates information across sources using data-driven weights, capturing global alignment between each source and the target; second, we refine this borrowing through a posterior-projection step that operates at the feature level, selectively retaining coordinates that exhibit local agreement with the target signal. This two-stage design enables the method to simultaneously perform source selection and feature selection, thereby mitigating negative transfer while preserving interpretability. ProjectionTL provides a principled approach to integrating heterogeneous data across domains, bridging statistical modeling and modern machine learning paradigms for robust and interpretable transfer. Through simulations and real-world biomedical applications, we demonstrate improved accuracy, stability, and interpretability compared to existing methods. Our framework offers a scalable and generalizable strategy for trustworthy cross-domain learning in high-dimensional settings.

item.title: MB-Loc: Multi-planar Bird's-eye-view Localization in outdoor LiDAR scenes
item.author: Ayaan Choudhury, Preet Savalia, Anirudh Pydah, Avinash Sharma
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MB-Loc的轻量级且对视角鲁棒的场景坐标回归框架，用于解决全局激光雷达定位中的计算效率低和视角变化导致性能下降的问题。

背景: 全局激光雷达定位是自主导航系统的基础任务。近期的场景坐标回归方法通过预测稠密三维世界坐标，在精度上优于绝对位姿回归方法。

目的: 解决现有场景坐标回归方法在处理原始三维几何结构时计算效率低下，以及在传感器视角变化时性能显著下降的瓶颈。

方法: 将输入的激光雷达扫描投影到二维半多平面鸟瞰图表示中，通过沿Z轴切片点云并将有符号深度映射到离散二维平面来保留三维几何结构并利用二维卷积神经网络的计算优势。引入KL正则化潜在瓶颈以显式建模空间不确定性而不注入随机噪声。在平面投影前应用三维空间增强以确保旋转鲁棒性。

主要发现: 在公开的NCLT数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进的方法。在实时推理速度下，MB-Loc在计算效率方面显著优于传统的三维场景坐标回归架构。

结论: MB-Loc是一种有效的轻量级且视角鲁棒的场景坐标回归框架，能够在保持高精度的同时提高计算效率。

翻译: Global LiDAR localization is a fundamental task for autonomous navigation systems. Recent methods perform Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) and achieve superior accuracy over Absolute Pose Regression (APR) solutions by predicting dense 3D world coordinates. However, SCR approaches introduce two major bottlenecks: severe computational inefficiency from processing raw 3D geometries and significant performance degradation under varying sensor viewpoints. To address these limitations, we present MB-Loc, a lightweight and viewpoint-robust SCR framework. Instead of relying on heavy 3D convolutions, we project the input LiDAR scan into a 2.5D Multi-planar Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation. By slicing the point-cloud along the Z-axis and mapping signed depths into discrete 2D planes, MB-Loc retains essential 3D geometric structures while exploiting the computational tractability of standard 2D CNNs. To handle the inherent sparsity of outdoor LiDAR, we introduce a KL-regularized latent bottleneck that explicitly models spatial uncertainty without injecting stochastic noise. Finally, to ensure rotation robustness, we apply 3D spatial augmentations prior to planar projection, forcing the network to implicitly learn viewpoint-invariant features. We perform extensive experiments on the publicly available NCLT dataset and demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms the current state-of-the-art. Operating at real-time inference speeds, MB-Loc significantly outperforms traditional 3D-SCR architectures in computational efficiency.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有激光雷达全局定位方法中计算效率低下以及视角变化导致定位性能显著下降的问题。该问题在现实与研究中至关重要，因为精确且高效的定位是自动驾驶、机器人等自主导航系统安全运行的核心基础，直接决定了系统能否在复杂户外环境中实现实时、可靠的导航与决策。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统三维点云定位计算繁重且标准二维投影易丢失垂直几何信息的问题，思考通过降维处理来兼顾计算效率与结构保留。为此，他们将三维点云沿垂直方向切片并映射到多个离散二维平面中，从而能够直接调用高效的二维卷积网络进行特征提取。该设计明确借鉴了相邻领域中利用分层二维深度切片进行几何重建的已有成果，同时结合了信息瓶颈原理与确定性正则化技术来建模空间不确定性，并通过训练前的三维空间数据增强来强制网络学习视角不变特征。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将三维激光点云沿垂直方向切分为多个水平切片，构建多平面二维半鸟瞰图表示，从而在保留三维几何结构的同时利用高效的二维卷积网络进行处理，并通过确定性隐空间建模空间不确定性以提升模型鲁棒性。整体流程首先对输入点云进行垂直切片与二维网格映射，接着使用带注意力机制的二维卷积网络提取特征并经过隐空间正则化，随后解码预测每个平面的三维坐标偏移量，最后将偏移量叠加至原始坐标重建全局三维点云，并通过随机采样一致性算法求解最终的全局位姿。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种二维半多平面鸟瞰图表示方法，通过将三维激光雷达点云沿垂直方向切片并映射到多个二维平面，既保留了三维几何结构又避免了传统单平面鸟瞰图的上视遮挡问题。同时，论文引入了基于信息瓶颈原理的确定性潜在瓶颈，在不使用随机采样的情况下显式建模空间不确定性，有效防止网络过拟合。与以往依赖高计算成本三维卷积或易丢失垂直信息的传统二维投影方法不同，该方法利用标准二维卷积神经网络实现了实时推理速度，并通过训练前的三维空间数据增强显著提升了模型在不同传感器视角下的鲁棒性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种轻量级且对视角变化鲁棒的激光雷达定位框架。该方法通过将三维点云切片转换为多平面俯视图表示，并结合确定性特征压缩机制，在保持高精度几何对齐的同时显著提升了计算效率与实时运行速度。

Abstract

Global LiDAR localization is a fundamental task for autonomous navigation systems. Recent methods perform Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) and achieve superior accuracy over Absolute Pose Regression (APR) solutions by predicting dense 3D world coordinates. However, SCR approaches introduce two major bottlenecks: severe computational inefficiency from processing raw 3D geometries and significant performance degradation under varying sensor viewpoints. To address these limitations, we present MB-Loc, a lightweight and viewpoint-robust SCR framework.
