To address these challenges, we propose CAMF-Det, a closure-aware multimodal fusion framework for LiDAR-camera 3D object detection on UAV platforms, which derives dual-modal occlusion intensity through physics-inspired modeling and embeds them as priors throughout the detection pipeline. First, a dual-modal closure modeling module explicitly constructs occlusion intensity ground truth for both modalities offline via a Beer-Lambert-inspired formulation and building-mask correction. Second, using these ground-truth maps as supervision, a dual-modal prediction network converts the offline modeling results into online occlusion intensity predictions under single-frame inference. Third, both ground-truth and predicted occlusion intensity are injected into data augmentation, feature encoding, multimodal fusion, and detection head, enabling adaptive detection under spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Experiments on two self-built UAV-based multimodal datasets, SI3D-DI and SI3D-DII, demonstrate that CAMF-Det achieves the best performance across all difficulty levels, with hard-level mAP_BEV improvements of 9.43% and 4.88% over the best competing methods, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of explicit occlusion prior modeling and exploitation for robust multimodal 3D detection in UAV scenes.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决无人机俯视场景中，树冠遮挡导致激光雷达与相机数据出现空间不均匀且模态依赖的信息退化问题。现有融合方法缺乏对遮挡程度的显式建模，难以在复杂遮挡环境下实现可靠的三维目标检测。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为无人机广泛应用于搜救、侦察和巡检任务，只有克服植被遮挡带来的感知退化，才能保障这些任务在真实复杂环境中的安全性与准确性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对无人机俯视场景中植被遮挡导致的光电信息空间非均匀退化问题，发现现有方法缺乏遮挡感知机制。为此，他们借鉴物理光学原理构建双模态遮挡强度先验，设计了离线建模与在线预测相结合的方案，并将该先验嵌入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合及检测头等全流程。该方法在现有地面车辆多模态检测与单无人机单模态检测工作的基础上进行改进，填补了单无人机平台多模态融合的空白。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是：针对无人机俯视场景中树冠遮挡导致的空间不均匀和模态依赖型信息退化问题，显式构建并引入激光雷达与相机双模态的遮挡强度先验，使检测系统能自适应地应对不同位置和传感器的感知质量差异。整体流程分为三步：首先离线利用物理模型生成双模态遮挡强度真实标签；其次训练网络在线实时预测单帧的遮挡强度图；最后将标签与预测结果注入数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合及检测头等环节，实现全链路的自适应目标检测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次提出了面向无人机平台的激光雷达与相机多模态三维目标检测框架。它通过物理启发模型离线构建双模态遮挡强度真实值，并设计预测网络将其转化为在线推理所需的遮挡先验，随后将先验信息贯穿数据增强、特征编码、多模态融合及检测头等全流程。相比以往主要面向地面车辆且假设模态可靠性均匀的工作，该方法首次显式建模了无人机俯视视角下由树冠引起的空间非均匀且模态依赖的信息退化问题，实现了自适应检测。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了首个面向无人机平台的激光雷达与相机多模态三维目标检测框架，通过物理启发方法构建双模态遮挡强度先验，并将其嵌入检测全流程以实现自适应融合。

Abstract

Multimodal 3D object detection based on LiDAR and cameras has demonstrated excellent performance in ground-vehicle scenarios, but has not been explored for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) platforms. In UAV top-down scenes, frequent groundobject occlusion dominated by tree canopies causes spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Existing multimodal fusion frameworks neither explicitly model such ground-object occlusion nor embed occlusion awareness into the detection pipeline, limiting their performance in occluded UAV scenes. To address these challenges, we propose CAMF-Det, a closure-aware multimodal fusion framework for LiDAR-camera 3D object detection on UAV platforms, which derives dual-modal occlusion intensity through physics-inspired modeling and embeds them as priors throughout the detection pipeline. First, a dual-modal closure modeling module explicitly constructs occlusion intensity ground truth for both modalities offline via a Beer-Lambert-inspired formulation and building-mask correction. Second, using these ground-truth maps as supervision, a dual-modal prediction network converts the offline modeling results into online occlusion intensity predictions under single-frame inference. Third, both ground-truth and predicted occlusion intensity are injected into data augmentation, feature encoding, multimodal fusion, and detection head, enabling adaptive detection under spatially varying and modality-dependent information degradation. Experiments on two self-built UAV-based multimodal datasets, SI3D-DI and SI3D-DII, demonstrate that CAMF-Det achieves the best performance across all difficulty levels, with hard-level mAP$_{\mathrm{BEV}}$ improvements of 9.43% and 4.88% over the best competing methods, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of explicit occlusion prior modeling and exploitation for robust multimodal 3D detection in UAV scenes.

item.title: Vision-Language Guided Hyperspectral Object Tracking via Semantics Fusion and Contextual Template Updating
item.author: Rui Yao, Yuhong Zhang, Kunyang Sun, Hancheng Zhu, Jiaqi Zhao, Zhiwen Shao, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为VLHTrack的新型高光谱视觉语言联合跟踪框架，旨在解决高光谱目标跟踪中光谱冗余和动态场景中目标形变的问题。

背景: 高光谱目标跟踪利用高光谱视频提供的丰富光谱信息，具有巨大潜力。然而，从冗余光谱波段中高效提取和利用光谱信息是一个根本性挑战，严重限制了模型的泛化能力和跟踪性能。此外，在动态场景中，由于遮挡和光照变化等因素，目标经常经历剧烈的外观变化，导致当前帧与模板之间出现大的形变，这对现有的时序建模方法构成了重大挑战。

目的: 提出VLHTrack框架，以解决高光谱目标跟踪中的光谱冗余问题以及动态场景中的目标形变问题。

方法: 1. 设计了语言引导波段选择模块（LBSM），利用大语言模型描述建立语义到光谱的映射，以减轻冗余并突出判别性光谱特征。2. 采用多模态视觉语言融合模块，无缝整合视觉和语言嵌入，学习连贯的跨模态表示。3. 提出了动态模板更新策略，通过基于Mamba的动态模板更新模块（DTUM）实现，利用选择性状态空间建模学习帧间依赖关系，以更新模板特征，确保在时序上下文指导下的高效模板特征演化。

主要发现: 在HOT2023和HOT2024数据集上的实验表明，VLHTrack优于最先进的方法。

结论: VLHTrack框架通过结合语言先验和多模态融合，有效解决了高光谱目标跟踪中的关键挑战，并在基准测试中取得了优越的性能。

翻译: Hyperspectral object tracking (HOT) leverages the rich spectral information provided by hyperspectral videos (HSVs), offering substantial potential for object tracking. However, efficiently extracting and exploiting spectral information from redundant spectral bands remains a fundamental challenge, which severely limits model generalization and tracking performance. Moreover, in dynamic scenes, targets often experience drastic appearance variations due to factors such as occlusion and illumination changes. These variations lead to large deformations between the current frame and the template. Such discrepancies pose major challenges for existing temporal modeling approaches. In this work, we propose VLHTrack, a novel hyperspectral vision-language (VL) joint tracking framework. Specifically, we incorporate language priors to address the fundamental challenge of spectral redundancy by designing a Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM). By leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) descriptions, LBSM establishes a semantic-to-spectral mapping that mitigates redundancy and accentuates discriminative spectral features. A Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module is then employed to seamlessly integrate visual and linguistic embeddings, harnessing their complementary advantages to learn coherent cross-modal representations. To address target deformation in long-term sequences, we propose a dynamic update template feature strategy implemented via the Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM) module. By leveraging selective state space modeling, DTUM learns inter-frame dependencies to update template feature, ensuring efficient template feature evolution guided by temporal context. Experiments on HOT2023 and HOT2024 demonstrate that VLHTrack outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

Abstract

Hyperspectral object tracking (HOT) leverages the rich spectral information provided by hyperspectral videos (HSVs), offering substantial potential for object tracking. However, efficiently extracting and exploiting spectral information from redundant spectral bands remains a fundamental challenge, which severely limits model generalization and tracking performance. Moreover, in dynamic scenes, targets often experience drastic appearance variations due to factors such as occlusion and illumination changes. These variations lead to large deformations between the current frame and the template. Such discrepancies pose major challenges for existing temporal modeling approaches. In this work, we propose VLHTrack, a novel hyperspectral vision-language (VL) joint tracking framework. Specifically, we incorporate language priors to address the fundamental challenge of spectral redundancy by designing a Language-Guided Band Selection Module (LBSM). By leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) descriptions, LBSM establishes a semantic-to-spectral mapping that mitigates redundancy and accentuates discriminative spectral features. A Multi-Modal Vision-Language Fusion Module is then employed to seamlessly integrate visual and linguistic embeddings, harnessing their complementary advantages to learn coherent cross-modal representations. To address target deformation in long-term sequences, we propose a dynamic update template feature strategy implemented via the Dynamic Template Update with Mamba (DTUM) module. By leveraging selective state space modeling, DTUM learns inter-frame dependencies to update template feature, ensuring efficient template feature evolution guided by temporal context. Experiments on HOT2023 and HOT2024 demonstrate that VLHTrack outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

item.author: Jianwei Tai

来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种联合审计框架，用于评估脑电图基础模型发布的安全性。通过跨编码器转移审计和属性解码器，揭示了单一端点审计无法检测到的频谱属性泄露问题，并引入了审计端点不一致分数作为部署可读的决策规则。

背景: 脑电图基础模型的发布通常仅针对单一端点进行审计，如原始重建、成员推断、身份链接或在下游头部使用差分隐私随机梯度下降。

目的: 对已发布的脑电图嵌入在多个端点上进行联合审计，以检测单一端点审计可能遗漏的安全风险，并提供一个可用于部署决策的审计框架。

方法: 在BIOT、LaBraM和EEGPT模型上，对原始重建、成员推断、身份链接和差分隐私随机梯度下降四个端点进行联合审计。采用跨编码器转移审计，使用从冻结编码器学习的岭属性解码器，通过拟合线性桥接器转移到其他编码器的测试集。引入审计端点不一致分数，并通过自助法校准。

主要发现: 单一端点审计通过的模型在联合审计中仍会泄露频谱属性。跨编码器转移审计显示，属性解码器可在不同编码器间转移，且存在显著的下界。证明了编码器共享非平凡属性坐标投影器重叠时，存在链式岭桥接攻击者。审计端点不一致分数在所有匹配置信区间单元格中均为正，而头部级别的成员推断审计效果不佳。标准防御措施在审计下失效。

结论: 提出的联合审计框架能将分散的单一端点防御转化为联合发布决策，支持发布阻止，但不涉及原始波形窃取或保留受试者身份恢复。

翻译: EEG foundation-model releases are usually audited one endpoint at a time: raw-reconstruction, membership inference, identity linkage, or DP-SGD on the downstream head. We audit the same released embeddings under all four endpoints jointly, on BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and show that each single-endpoint audit clears releases that still leak spectral attributes. The decisive evidence is a cross-encoder transfer audit: a single ridge attribute decoder learned from one frozen encoder transfers, via a fitted linear bridge, to held-out-subject test splits of every other encoder, with subject-disjoint matched-control 95% CI lower bound at least 0.081 across all six BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT directions. We prove a sufficient condition: two encoders sharing a nontrivial attribute-coordinate projector overlap beta admit a chained ridge bridge attacker with centered-gain lower bound sqrt(beta/(1+tau^2)) - eps_br - rho_0, and back-solve beta in [0.008, 0.198]. To turn the joint audit into a deployment-readable decision rule we introduce an audit-endpoint disagreement score (AEDS), prove sufficient conditions for its positivity, and bootstrap-calibrate it per cell; AEDS is positive in all eight matched-CI cells (BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT on EEGMMI; LaBraM on Sleep-EDF, 54-channel LIMO, CHB-MIT pediatric scalp EEG) with p<0.001, while a head-level Carlini LiRA membership audit reaches AUC only 0.50-0.70. Standard defenses fail under audit: a Wiener-style noise-aware adaptive attacker, the LiRA audit, and DP-SGD at every utility-preserving epsilon in {4,8} leave the attribute channel essentially unchanged. The contribution is an audit framework that turns scattered single-endpoint defenses into a joint release decision, supported by a cross-encoder bridge theorem and adaptive-attacker, LiRA, and DP-SGD baselines; the audit licenses release-blocking, not raw-waveform exfiltration or held-out-subject identity recovery.

Abstract

EEG foundation-model releases are usually audited one endpoint at a time: raw-reconstruction, membership inference, identity linkage, or DP-SGD on the downstream head. We audit the same released embeddings under all four endpoints jointly, on BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and show that each single-endpoint audit clears releases that still leak spectral attributes. The decisive evidence is a cross-encoder transfer audit: a single ridge attribute decoder learned from one frozen encoder transfers, via a fitted linear bridge, to held-out-subject test splits of every other encoder, with subject-disjoint matched-control 95% CI lower bound at least 0.081 across all six BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT directions. We prove a sufficient condition: two encoders sharing a nontrivial attribute-coordinate projector overlap beta admit a chained ridge bridge attacker with centered-gain lower bound sqrt(beta/(1+tau^2)) - eps_br - rho_0, and back-solve beta in [0.008, 0.198]. To turn the joint audit into a deployment-readable decision rule we introduce an audit-endpoint disagreement score (AEDS), prove sufficient conditions for its positivity, and bootstrap-calibrate it per cell; AEDS is positive in all eight matched-CI cells (BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT on EEGMMI; LaBraM on Sleep-EDF, 54-channel LIMO, CHB-MIT pediatric scalp EEG) with p<0.001, while a head-level Carlini LiRA membership audit reaches AUC only 0.50-0.70. Standard defenses fail under audit: a Wiener-style noise-aware adaptive attacker, the LiRA audit, and DP-SGD at every utility-preserving epsilon in {4,8} leave the attribute channel essentially unchanged. The contribution is an audit framework that turns scattered single-endpoint defenses into a joint release decision, supported by a cross-encoder bridge theorem and adaptive-attacker, LiRA, and DP-SGD baselines; the audit licenses release-blocking, not raw-waveform exfiltration or held-out-subject identity recovery.

item.title: Self-supervised Learning Matters: A Simple Ensemble Solution for Micro-Gesture Recognition
item.author: Tingyi Liu, Kun Li, Fei Wang, Junjie Chen, Zhiliang Wu, Jihao Gu, Haixu Liu, Dan Guo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了XInsight Lab在IJCAI 2026第四届MiGA挑战赛微手势分类赛道中取得第一名的解决方案，该方案实现了新的最先进结果。

背景: IJCAI 2026第四届MiGA挑战赛微手势分类赛道。

目的: 提出一种多模态集成框架，以解决微手势分类问题并提升识别精度。

方法: 提出一种多模态集成框架，整合了基于自监督学习的RGB模型与之前解决方案中的监督多流模型。自监督RGB模型通过在12万段未标记视频片段上进行掩码视频建模进行预训练，然后在iMiGUE数据集上进行微调。

主要发现: 简单的RGB基线在iMiGUE测试集上达到了百分之六十九点二二四的top-1准确率，证明了从域内未标记视频中学习可迁移表示的好处。结合该模型作为互补分支后，最终集成模型达到了百分之七十四点四一九的top-1准确率，比之前的最先进结果高出百分之一点二零六。消融实验验证了自监督RGB表示学习在微手势识别中的有效性。

结论: 自监督RGB表示学习对于微手势识别是有效的，该多模态集成框架在iMiGUE数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。

翻译: In this paper, we present XInsight Lab's solution to the micro-gesture classification track of the 4th MiGA Challenge at IJCAI 2026, in which our solution ranked first and achieved a new state-of-the-art result. We propose a multimodal ensemble framework that integrates a self-supervised RGB-based model with supervised multi-stream models from previous solutions. The self-supervised RGB model is pretrained on 120K unlabeled clips via masked video modeling and then fine-tuned on iMiGUE. This simple yet effective RGB baseline achieves 69.224% top-1 accuracy on the iMiGUE test set, demonstrating the benefit of learning transferable representations from unlabeled in-domain videos. By incorporating this model as a complementary branch, the final ensemble reaches 74.419% top-1 accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 1.206 percentage points. Experimental results on iMiGUE, including ablation studies on the ensemble strategy, validate the effectiveness of self-supervised RGB representation learning for micro-gesture recognition.

Abstract

In this paper, we present XInsight Lab's solution to the micro-gesture classification track of the 4th MiGA Challenge at IJCAI 2026, in which our solution ranked first and achieved a new state-of-the-art result. We propose a multimodal ensemble framework that integrates a self-supervised RGB-based model with supervised multi-stream models from previous solutions. The self-supervised RGB model is pretrained on 120K unlabeled clips via masked video modeling and then fine-tuned on iMiGUE. This simple yet effective RGB baseline achieves 69.224% top-1 accuracy on the iMiGUE test set, demonstrating the benefit of learning transferable representations from unlabeled in-domain videos. By incorporating this model as a complementary branch, the final ensemble reaches 74.419% top-1 accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 1.206 percentage points. Experimental results on iMiGUE, including ablation studies on the ensemble strategy, validate the effectiveness of self-supervised RGB representation learning for micro-gesture recognition.

item.title: Multi-View Speech Representation Learning for Parkinson's Disease Detection Using Context-guided Cross-modal Attention
item.author: George Theodosiou, Loukas Ilias, Dimitris Askounis
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 帕金森病是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，常导致与运动过少性构音障碍相关的言语障碍。言语分析已成为早期帕金森病检测的有前景的非侵入性和成本效益生物标志物。本文提出了一种多分支深度学习框架，用于从语音中自动检测帕金森病。该框架使用三种互补的模态表示语音：对数梅尔频谱图、梅尔频率倒谱系数和从原始波形中提取的HuBERT嵌入。通过预训练的ResNet-18编码器处理频谱图，通过双向长短期记忆网络对梅尔频率倒谱系数序列进行建模，并使用预训练的HuBERT模型对原始语音进行编码。引入了一种上下文引导的跨模态注意力机制，根据从频谱图和梅尔频率倒谱系数分支派生的全局声学上下文动态加权时间HuBERT嵌入。在公开的西班牙PC-GITA语料库上进行的实验证明了该方法的有效性。所提出的架构实现了百分之九十一点五一的准确率、百分之九十一点二四的F1分数和百分之九十五点九七的AUC。消融研究证实了所提出的上下文引导的跨模态注意力机制和互补语音表示整合的贡献。这些发现突出了异质语音建模在稳健和临床可靠的帕金森病检测中的潜力。

背景: 帕金森病是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，常导致与运动过少性构音障碍相关的言语障碍。言语分析已成为早期帕金森病检测的有前景的非侵入性和成本效益生物标志物。

目的: 提出一种多分支深度学习框架，用于从语音中自动检测帕金森病。

方法: 将每次录音分割为五秒的片段，并使用三种互补的模态表示：对数梅尔频谱图、梅尔频率倒谱系数和从原始波形中提取的HuBERT嵌入。通过预训练的ResNet-18编码器处理频谱图，通过双向长短期记忆网络对梅尔频率倒谱系数序列进行建模，并使用预训练的HuBERT模型对原始语音进行编码。引入了一种上下文引导的跨模态注意力机制，根据从频谱图和梅尔频率倒谱系数分支派生的全局声学上下文动态加权时间HuBERT嵌入。

主要发现: 在公开的西班牙PC-GITA语料库上进行的实验证明了该方法的有效性。所提出的架构实现了百分之九十一点五一的准确率、百分之九十一点二四的F1分数和百分之九十五点九七的AUC。消融研究证实了所提出的上下文引导的跨模态注意力机制和互补语音表示整合的贡献。

结论: 这些发现突出了异质语音建模在稳健和临床可靠的帕金森病检测中的潜力。

翻译: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that frequently causes speech impairments associated with hypokinetic dysarthria. As speech production relies on the precise coordination of complex neuromuscular mechanisms, speech analysis has emerged as a promising non-invasive and cost-effective biomarker for early PD detection. Recent deep learning approaches have shown encouraging results; however, most existing methods rely on a single speech representation, potentially overlooking complementary pathological information encoded across different feature spaces. In this work, we propose a multi-branch deep learning framework for automatic PD detection from speech. Each recording is segmented into 5-second chunks and represented using three complementary modalities: Log-Mel spectrograms, MFCCs, and HuBERT embeddings extracted from raw waveforms. The spectrograms are processed using a pre-trained ResNet-18 encoder, MFCC sequences are modeled through a BiLSTM network, and raw speech is encoded using a pre-trained HuBERT model. To effectively integrate these heterogeneous representations, we introduce a context-guided cross-modal attention mechanism that dynamically weights temporal HuBERT embeddings according to the global acoustic context derived from the spectrogram and MFCC branches. Experiments conducted on the publicly available Spanish PC-GITA corpus under strict speaker-independent 5-fold cross-validation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The proposed architecture achieves an accuracy of 91.51%, an F1-score of 91.24%, and an AUC of 95.97%. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm the contribution of both the proposed context-guided cross-modal attention mechanism and the integration of complementary speech representations. These findings highlight the potential of heterogeneous speech modeling for robust and clinically reliable PD detection.

Abstract

Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that frequently causes speech impairments associated with hypokinetic dysarthria. As speech production relies on the precise coordination of complex neuromuscular mechanisms, speech analysis has emerged as a promising non-invasive and cost-effective biomarker for early PD detection. Recent deep learning approaches have shown encouraging results; however, most existing methods rely on a single speech representation, potentially overlooking complementary pathological information encoded across different feature spaces. In this work, we propose a multi-branch deep learning framework for automatic PD detection from speech. Each recording is segmented into 5-second chunks and represented using three complementary modalities: Log-Mel spectrograms, MFCCs, and HuBERT embeddings extracted from raw waveforms. The spectrograms are processed using a pre-trained ResNet-18 encoder, MFCC sequences are modeled through a BiLSTM network, and raw speech is encoded using a pre-trained HuBERT model. To effectively integrate these heterogeneous representations, we introduce a context-guided cross-modal attention mechanism that dynamically weights temporal HuBERT embeddings according to the global acoustic context derived from the spectrogram and MFCC branches. Experiments conducted on the publicly available Spanish PC-GITA corpus under strict speaker-independent 5-fold cross-validation demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The proposed architecture achieves an accuracy of 91.51%, an F1-score of 91.24%, and an AUC of 95.97%. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm the contribution of both the proposed context-guided cross-modal attention mechanism and the integration of complementary speech representations. These findings highlight the potential of heterogeneous speech modeling for robust and clinically reliable PD detection.

item.title: Intention Driven Identification of In-Possession Match Phases in Association Football through Temporal Graph Learning
item.author: Yuesen Li, Daniel Link
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究提出了一种基于数据的框架，用于从时空追踪数据中识别足球比赛中的控球阶段。该框架结合了帧级球员互动图、上下文特征和基于变换器的时间建模，成功将连续的追踪数据转化为具有战术解释力的控球阶段表示。

背景: 理解足球的战术组织需要识别不同的比赛阶段。然而，控球阶段很少能直接观察到，并且是由不断演变的战术意图塑造的，而不仅仅是空间模式。

目的: 提出一种基于数据的框架，用于从时空追踪数据中识别比赛中的控球阶段。

方法: 分析了七场以每秒二十五赫兹频率记录的德国足球甲级联赛比赛数据。定义了一个包含三种战术意图（入侵对手空间、保持控球、得分）和六个阶段（组织进攻、推进、反击、维持、持续威胁、终结）的层次化阶段模型。开发了一种时间图注意力网络，用于结合帧级球员互动图、上下文特征和基于变换器的时间建模。使用帧级 F1 分数和序列感知的交集与真实主导度指标进行评估。

主要发现: 时间图注意力网络在意图层面的宏观平均帧级 F1 分数为 0.87，在入侵相关阶段为 0.76，在得分阶段为 0.79。在序列层面，后处理后的意图和阶段的平均对角线交集与真实主导度 F1 分数分别提高。序列建模是分割质量的主要驱动因素，而基于图的关联建模对反击识别特别有益。探索性球员注意力分析表明，边路和中场位置组对阶段区分贡献较大。

结论: 该框架将连续的追踪数据转化为具有战术解释力的控球阶段表示，在自动比赛注释、战术分析和比赛风格分析方面具有潜在应用价值。

翻译: Understanding tactical organisation of association football, hereafter referred to as football, requires identifying distinct match phases. Yet in-possession phases are rarely directly observable and are shaped by evolving tactical intentions, rather than spatial patterns alone. This study proposes a data-driven framework for identifying in-possession match phases from spatiotemporal tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical phase model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) was developed to combine frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and a sequence-aware Intersection over Truth-Dominance (IoT-D) metric. T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. At the sequence level, mean diagonal IoT-D F1 increased from 0.68 to 0.79 for intentions and from 0.61 to 0.71 for phases after post-processing, indicating improved temporal coherence. Model comparisons showed that sequence modelling was the main driver of segmentation quality, while graph-based relational modelling was particularly beneficial for Counter Attack recognition. Exploratory player attention analysis further suggested that wide and midfield positional groups contributed strongly to phase discrimination. Overall, the framework translates continuous tracking data into tactically interpretable in-possession phase representations, with potential applications in automated match annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.

Abstract

Understanding tactical organisation of association football, hereafter referred to as football, requires identifying distinct match phases. Yet in-possession phases are rarely directly observable and are shaped by evolving tactical intentions, rather than spatial patterns alone. This study proposes a data-driven framework for identifying in-possession match phases from spatiotemporal tracking data. Seven German Bundesliga matches recorded at 25 Hz with TRACAB were analysed. A hierarchical phase model was defined with three tactical intentions (Invade Opponent Space, Keep Possession, Scoring) and six phases (Build Up, Progression, Counter Attack, Maintenance, Sustained Threat, Finishing). A Temporal Graph Attention Network (T-GAN) was developed to combine frame-level player-interaction graphs, contextual features, and Transformer-based temporal modelling. Performance was evaluated using frame-level F1 and a sequence-aware Intersection over Truth-Dominance (IoT-D) metric. T-GAN achieved macro-average frame-level F1 scores of 0.87 at the intention level, 0.76 for invasion-related phases, and 0.79 for scoring phases. At the sequence level, mean diagonal IoT-D F1 increased from 0.68 to 0.79 for intentions and from 0.61 to 0.71 for phases after post-processing, indicating improved temporal coherence. Model comparisons showed that sequence modelling was the main driver of segmentation quality, while graph-based relational modelling was particularly beneficial for Counter Attack recognition. Exploratory player attention analysis further suggested that wide and midfield positional groups contributed strongly to phase discrimination. Overall, the framework translates continuous tracking data into tactically interpretable in-possession phase representations, with potential applications in automated match annotation, tactical analysis, and playing-style profiling.

item.title: Reason Twice: Segmentation via Candidate Discovery and Comparative Reasoning
item.author: Xinyan Gao, Haoran Hao, Xiangyu Yue
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为Rea2Seg的两阶段框架，用于掩码生成和选择，以更好地将多模态大语言模型的感知和推理能力转移到基于复杂推理的图像分割任务中。

背景: 预训练基础模型的快速发展推动了更通用的图像分割。多模态大语言模型已被广泛用于处理需要高级推理的复杂查询的图像分割。然而，现有方法通常受限于训练数据有限以及多模态大语言模型与掩码生成模块之间的差距。

目的: 将多模态大语言模型的感知和推理能力更好地转移到基于复杂推理的分割任务中。

方法: 提出Rea2Seg两阶段框架。第一阶段基于分割多模态大语言模型的注意力图识别潜在区域作为候选掩码。第二阶段利用多模态大语言模型对问题和候选掩码进行推理并分配分数，最终通过重新排序候选项并选择得分最高的掩码获得分割结果。此外，引入了新的基准测试ReasonSeg-SGDR，并收集训练数据以增强多模态大语言模型联合理解多模态查询和候选掩码并通过推理分配分数的能力。

主要发现: 现有基准测试中的问题大多集中在常识推理上，通常不需要联合视觉观察和推理。提出的ReasonSeg-SGDR基准测试在多个维度（包括判别性识别、空间推理、几何推理和多步推理）上全面评估模型的感知、定位和推理能力。

结论: 在提出的基准测试和ReasonSeg上的实验结果证明了统一的掩码生成和选择框架的有效性。

翻译: 预训练基础模型的快速发展使得更通用的图像分割成为可能。多模态大语言模型已被广泛用于处理需要高级推理的复杂查询的图像分割。尽管取得了有希望的进展，但现有方法通常受限于训练数据有限以及多模态大语言模型与掩码生成模块之间的差距。为了更好地将多模态大语言模型的感知和推理能力转移到基于复杂推理的分割任务中，我们提出了一个用于掩码生成和选择的两阶段框架Rea2Seg。具体而言，该框架首先基于分割多模态大语言模型的注意力图识别潜在区域作为候选掩码。然后，它利用多模态大语言模型对问题和候选掩码进行推理并分配分数。最终的分割结果是通过重新排序候选项并选择得分最高的掩码获得的，从而将图像分割重新定义为候选发现 followed by 判别性掩码选择。我们还注意到，现有基准测试中的大量问题集中在常识推理上，这些问题通常不需要联合视觉观察和推理。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个新的基准测试ReasonSeg-SGDR，该基准测试在多个维度上全面评估模型的感知、定位和推理能力，包括判别性识别、空间推理、几何推理和多步推理，并具有细粒度的掩码生成。此外，我们收集了训练数据以增强多模态大语言模型联合理解多模态查询和候选掩码并通过推理分配分数的能力。在提出的基准测试和ReasonSeg上的实验结果证明了统一的掩码生成和选择框架的有效性。

Abstract

The rapid development of pretrained foundation models has enabled more general image segmentation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have been widely explored for image segmentation with complex queries that require high-level reasoning. Despite promising progress, existing methods are often constrained by limited training data and the gap between MLLMs and mask generation modules. To better transfer MLLMs' perception and reasoning ability to complex reasoning-based segmentation tasks, we propose a two-stage framework Rea2Seg for mask generation and selection. Specifically, the framework first identifies potential regions as candidate masks based on the attention maps of a segmentation MLLM. It then employs an MLLM to reason over the question and candidate masks and assign scores to each mask. The final segmentation result is obtained by reranking the candidates and selecting the highest-scoring mask, reformulating image segmentation as candidate discovery followed by discriminative mask selection. We also notice that a large portion of questions in existing benchmarks focus on commonsense reasoning, and these questions usually do not fully require joint visual observation and reasoning. To address this issue, we introduce a new benchmark called ReasonSeg-SGDR that comprehensively evaluates a model's perception, grounding, and reasoning abilities across multiple dimensions, including discriminative recognition, spatial reasoning, geometric reasoning, and multi-step reasoning, with fine-grained mask generation. In addition, we collect training data to enhance MLLMs' ability to jointly understand multimodal queries and candidate masks, and to assign scores through reasoning. Experimental results on the proposed benchmark and ReasonSeg demonstrate the effectiveness of the unified mask generation and selection framework.

item.title: KPGrasp: Scalable Keypoint Flow Matching for Dexterous Grasp Generation
item.author: Yuansen Huang, Jiayi Chen, Haoran Liu, Yubin Ke, Bing Han, Jiangran Lyu, Mi Yan, Li Yi, He Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: KPGrasp 是一种基于流匹配框架的方法，通过学习大规模数据中的灵巧抓取先验，无需依赖接触损失或接触式测试时细化，即可生成高质量的灵巧抓取。

背景: 基于学习的方法在生成高质量灵巧抓取方面仍然具有挑战性，通常依赖于精心调整的接触损失或成本高昂的接触式测试时细化。

目的: 提出 KPGrasp 框架，以学习灵巧抓取先验，避免对接触损失或接触式测试时细化的依赖。

方法: KPGrasp 将全欧几里得三维手部关键点参数化与简单且可扩展的 Transformer 流模型相结合。参数化避免了传统混合 SE(3) 姿态和关节角输出空间的缺点，在同一坐标系中表达抓取，从而实现原生空间推理；Transformer 流模型仅使用标准流匹配损失进行训练，并能有效扩展。

主要发现: 在 Dexonomy 基准测试中，KPGrasp 达到 76.3% 的抓取成功率，比最强直接可比基线提高 47.4%，并将穿透深度降低至 2.4 毫米。在 DexGrasp Anything 基准测试中，无需微调即取得最佳平均性能。批量推理时，每次抓取仅需 0.032 秒。在 20 种不同物体的真实世界实验中，证明了该流程可部署于真实世界设置。

结论: KPGrasp 在仿真基准测试中达到最先进性能，并在真实世界实验中展示了其部署可行性。

翻译: Generating high-quality dexterous grasps remains challenging for learning-based methods, which often depend on carefully tuned contact losses or costly contact-based test-time refinement. We present KPGrasp, a flow-matching framework that learns dexterous grasp priors from large-scale data rather than relying on contact losses or contact-based test-time refinement. KPGrasp couples an all-Euclidean 3D hand-keypoint parameterization with a simple yet scalable Transformer flow model. The parameterization avoids the drawbacks of the conventional mixed SE(3) pose and joint-angle output space, expresses grasps in the same frame as the object point cloud, and thus enables native spatial reasoning; the Transformer flow model is trained with only the standard flow-matching loss and scales effectively with data, model capacity, and batch size. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on two simulation benchmarks. On the Dexonomy benchmark, it reaches a 76.3% grasp success rate, improving over the strongest directly comparable baseline by 47.4% while reducing penetration depth to 2.4 mm. The same model also achieves the best average performance on the DexGrasp Anything benchmark without fine-tuning. For batched inference, KPGrasp requires only 0.032 s per grasp. Finally, real-world experiments on 20 diverse objects demonstrate that the pipeline can be deployed in a real-world setup.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决基于学习的方法在生成灵巧抓取时，过度依赖复杂的人工接触损失或耗时的测试时优化调整的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为灵巧抓取是复杂机器人操作的核心前提，传统方法计算成本高且推理慢，而现有学习方法往往稳定性差或需要繁琐的参数调优。通过直接从大规模数据中学习抓取先验，该方法能够显著提升抓取质量与推理速度，为机器人高效、可靠的实际部署提供基础。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统抓取生成方法依赖复杂的接触损失或测试时优化，且传统的姿态与关节混合表示存在数学不连续和误差累积问题。为此他们提出直接利用大规模离线数据训练生成模型，采用全欧几里得空间的三维手关键点作为输出，使其更契合注意力网络架构并便于直接进行空间推理。该方法借鉴了计算机视觉中成熟的手关键点表示技术以及流匹配生成框架，同时延续了利用解析方法离线合成海量数据的研究思路，但摒弃了显式的物理接触约束和外部判别器。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是直接从大规模数据中学习抓取先验，摒弃传统方法中依赖人工设计的接触损失或测试时优化，转而采用全欧几里得空间的三维手关键点表示与基于注意力机制的流匹配模型相结合。整体流程为：首先将物体点云输入三维卷积网络提取几何特征；接着利用流匹配模型从噪声中逐步生成手关键点，并通过注意力机制建模手部结构与手物空间关系；最后根据模型计算的似然分数筛选最优关键点，再通过刚体配准与逆运动学将其转换为机器人可执行的腕部位姿与关节角度。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的核心创新在于提出全欧几里得三维手关键点参数化方法，并结合基于变换器的流匹配模型进行抓取生成。与以往依赖复杂接触损失惩罚或测试时接触优化等显式物理约束的工作不同，本方法完全摒弃了这些人工设计的辅助模块，仅依靠标准流匹配损失从大规模数据中直接学习抓取分布。关键点表示将抓取生成转化为标准的欧几里得空间学习问题，使模型能够直接进行空间推理并自然适配注意力机制，从而在无需额外判别器或测试时调整的情况下实现了更高的抓取成功率与推理效率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种基于全欧氏三维手部关键点参数化与流匹配模型的抓取生成框架，能够直接从大规模数据中学习抓取先验，无需依赖接触损失或测试时优化，即可在仿真与真实环境中实现高性能且高效的灵巧抓取。

Abstract

Generating high-quality dexterous grasps remains challenging for learning-based methods, which often depend on carefully tuned contact losses or costly contact-based test-time refinement. We present KPGrasp, a flow-matching framework that learns dexterous grasp priors from large-scale data rather than relying on contact losses or contact-based test-time refinement. KPGrasp couples an all-Euclidean 3D hand-keypoint parameterization with a simple yet scalable Transformer flow model. The parameterization avoids the drawbacks of the conventional mixed SE(3) pose and joint-angle output space, expresses grasps in the same frame as the object point cloud, and thus enables native spatial reasoning; the Transformer flow model is trained with only the standard flow-matching loss and scales effectively with data, model capacity, and batch size. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on two simulation benchmarks. On the Dexonomy benchmark, it reaches a 76.3% grasp success rate, improving over the strongest directly comparable baseline by 47.4% while reducing penetration depth to 2.4 mm. The same model also achieves the best average performance on the DexGrasp Anything benchmark without fine-tuning. For batched inference, KPGrasp requires only 0.032 s per grasp. Finally, real-world experiments on 20 diverse objects demonstrate that the pipeline can be deployed in a real-world setup.

item.title: TRL-Bench: Standardizing Cross-Paradigm Representation-Level Evaluation of Tabular Encoders
item.author: Wei Pang, Xiangru Jian, Hehan Li, Zhixuan Yu, Alex Xue, Jinyang Li, Zhengyuan Dong, Xinjian Zhao, Hao Xu, Chao Zhang, Reynold Cheng, M. Tamer Özsu, Tianshu Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了TRL-Bench，一个用于表格表示学习的多粒度基准测试，旨在标准化跨范式的表示级评估。

背景: 表格编码器通常在特定任务的端到端管道中进行评估，导致不同训练范式的模型即使处理相似的表格信号也难以直接比较。

目的: 提出一个标准化的多粒度表格表示学习基准，以支持跨范式的表示级评估。

方法: 通过支持的包装器导出行、列或表格嵌入，并使用共享的轻量级头部在三个套件中进行探测：TRL-CTbench（列/表格）、TRL-Rbench（行）和TRL-DLTE（跨所有粒度的组合数据湖表格增强）。

主要发现: 在标准化下游条件后，编码器质量是特定于能力的，而非由单一排行榜捕捉。通用文本编码器在具有强表面文本信号的任务中表现优异，而表格专家在预训练目标与任务对齐时胜出。行级预测和跨表链接偏好不同的训练范式。最强的管道结合了能力匹配的专业编码器，而非重用单一编码器。

结论: TRL-Bench提供了一个共同的协议，用于在共享下游条件下测量可重用信号在导出的表格表示中的表现。

翻译: unknown

Abstract

Tabular encoders are usually evaluated inside task-specific end-to-end pipelines, so models from different training paradigms are difficult to compare directly even when they operate on similar tabular signals. We introduce TRL-Bench, a multi-granular tabular representation learning (TRL) benchmark that standardizes cross-paradigm representation-level evaluation: each encoder exports row-, column-, or table embeddings through its supported wrapper, and shared lightweight heads probe them across three suites: TRL-CTbench (column/table), TRL-Rbench (row), and TRL-DLTE (compositional Data-Lake Table Enrichment spanning all three granularities). To support this standardized setting, we release curated benchmark assets and task reformulations, including 50 OpenML tables with 123 verified targets, 16 row-pair linkage rewrites, and a 47,772-table DLTE lake derived from 1,379 parent tables. Across 20 models and 16 tasks, TRL-Bench shows that once downstream conditions are standardized, encoder quality is capability-specific rather than captured by a single leaderboard. In TRL-CTbench, generic text encoders often lead on tasks with strong surface-text signal, while tabular specialists win where their pretraining objective aligns with the task. In TRL-Rbench, within-table prediction and cross-table linkage favor different training regimes, with atomic linkage performance correlating strongly with the row-matching stage of DLTE pipelines. In TRL-DLTE, the strongest pipelines combine capability-matched specialists rather than reuse a single encoder, and top end-to-end quality depends on non-additive compositional fit rather than per-stage marginal rank alone. TRL-Bench provides a common protocol for measuring reusable signal in exported tabular representations under shared downstream conditions. Code and data: https://github.com/LOGO-CUHKSZ/TRL-Bench

item.title: Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning for Automatic Speech Recognition
item.author: Steven Vander Eeckt, Hugo Van hamme
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于参数高效微调的持续学习方法，用于语音识别领域，旨在解决模型规模大和顺序微调导致的灾难性遗忘问题。

背景: 语音基础模型在通用语音识别方面表现强大，适合下游任务适配，但其庞大的参数量以及顺序微调引发的灾难性遗忘问题，使得参数高效且正则化的训练方法成为研究重点。参数高效持续学习在自然语言处理和视觉领域已有广泛研究，但在语音识别领域关注较少。

目的: 提出一种简单有效的参数高效持续学习方法，以解决语音识别中顺序微调导致的灾难性遗忘问题，并提升模型在后续任务中的性能保持能力。

方法: 根据奇异值将预训练权重矩阵划分为头部和尾部子空间，将适配限制在低能量尾部子空间内的近似旋转中，以保留主要成分并减少遗忘。对于后续任务，通过权重平均组合旋转操作，以进一步提高性能保持能力。

主要发现: 在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比近期的参数高效持续学习基线方法，能够有效减少灾难性遗忘，并在整体性能上表现更优。

结论: 所提出的参数高效持续学习方法在语音识别任务中是简单且有效的，能够平衡模型适配与知识保留，为语音基础模型的下游应用提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Speech foundation models enable strong general-purpose ASR and are attractive for downstream adaptation. However, their size and the catastrophic forgetting induced by sequential fine-tuning demand parameter-efficient and regularized training methods, motivating parameter-efficient continual learning (PECL). While PECL has been widely studied in NLP and vision, it has received less attention in ASR. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective PECL method based on recent advances in parameter-efficient fine-tuning for ASR. We partition pretrained weight matrices into head and tail subspaces according to singular values and restrict adaptation to approximate rotations within the low-energy tail subspace, preserving dominant components and reducing forgetting. For subsequent tasks, rotations are combined via weight averaging to further improve retention. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate reduced forgetting and superior overall performance compared to recent PECL baselines.

Abstract

Speech foundation models enable strong general-purpose ASR and are attractive for downstream adaptation. However, their size and the catastrophic forgetting induced by sequential fine-tuning demand parameter-efficient and regularized training methods, motivating parameter-efficient continual learning (PECL). While PECL has been widely studied in NLP and vision, it has received less attention in ASR. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective PECL method based on recent advances in parameter-efficient fine-tuning for ASR. We partition pretrained weight matrices into head and tail subspaces according to singular values and restrict adaptation to approximate rotations within the low-energy tail subspace, preserving dominant components and reducing forgetting. For subsequent tasks, rotations are combined via weight averaging to further improve retention. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate reduced forgetting and superior overall performance compared to recent PECL baselines.

item.title: PBSD: Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Credit Assignment
item.author: Tian, Yang, Wang, Rui, Wen, Xumeng, Li, Junjie, Sun, Shizhao, Song, Lei, Bian, Jiang, Zhao, Bo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PBSD（特权贝叶斯自蒸馏）的方法，用于在稀疏最终奖励下实现细粒度的信用分配。该方法通过贝叶斯校准将轨迹级奖励转化为回合级信用信号，从而提升强化学习在长视界代理任务中的表现。

背景: 长视界代理任务对基于结果的强化学习提出了根本性的信用分配挑战。轨迹级奖励仅验证最终正确性，对中间推理步骤或工具交互的贡献指导有限。在多轮搜索代理中，成功轨迹可能包含误导性动作，而失败轨迹可能包含有价值的证据收集步骤。

目的: 解决长视界代理任务中稀疏最终奖励下的细粒度信用分配问题，将稀疏的结果监督转化为更有效的策略学习信号。

方法: 提出PBSD（特权贝叶斯自蒸馏）方法。该方法通过验证答案的后验与先验概率比率来衡量轨迹质量，并利用贝叶斯规则将此比率转换为标准学生模型与特权答案条件教师模型之间的似然比率。通过对该贝叶斯证据得分进行自回归分解，生成回合级信号以识别每个中间回合是否支持或削弱已验证的结果。

主要发现: PBSD在域内和域外设置中均一致提升了性能，并有效实现了从短上下文训练到长上下文推理的知识迁移。

结论: PBSD提供的细粒度信用分配机制促进了更有效的策略学习，并带来了更好的泛化能力。该方法原则性强且优雅，完全兼容标准策略优化。

翻译: Long-horizon agentic tasks pose a fundamental credit assignment challenge for outcome-base reinforcement learning: trajectory-level rewards verify final correctness but provide limited guidance on which intermediate reasoning steps or tool interactions contribute to the outcome. The difficulty is especially pronounced in multi-turn search agents, where successful trajectories may contain misleading actions and failed trajectories may contain valuable evidence-gathering steps. We propose PBSD (Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation), a Bayes-calibrated self-distillation method for fine-grained credit assignment under sparse final rewards. PBSD measures trajectory quality through the posterior-to-prior probability ratio of the verified answer and applies Bayes' rule to convert this hard-to-estimate answer-side ratio into a tractable likelihood ratio between a standard student model and a privileged answer-conditioned teacher model. Autoregressive decomposition of this Bayesian evidence score yields turn-level signals that identify whether each intermediate turn supports or undermines the verified outcome. Consequently, PBSD provides a principled and elegant reweighting scheme that transforms sparse outcome supervision into Bayes-calibrated turn-level credit signals, while remaining fully compatible with standard policy optimization. Experiments demonstrate that PBSD consistently enhances performance across both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, and effectively transfers knowledge from short-context training to long-context inference, suggesting that its fine-grained credit assignment mechanism facilitates more effective policy learning and yields improved generalization.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决长程智能体任务中基于最终结果强化学习的信用分配难题，即如何准确判断长序列交互中哪些中间步骤真正促成了最终结果。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为长程任务的成功轨迹常混杂干扰动作，而失败轨迹也可能蕴含有效信息。若无法精细分配信用，模型训练将缺乏有效指导，导致学习效率低下且难以泛化到复杂场景中。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对长程智能体任务中最终奖励稀疏、难以判断中间步骤贡献的难题，提出通过贝叶斯规则将答案概率的先后变化转化为模型对观测轨迹的似然比，从而得到每一步的精细贡献信号。该方法并未直接模仿教师模型或引入外部评估器，而是用该信号对原有的轨迹级优势进行加权校准，既保留了强化学习的稳定性又实现了细粒度信用分配。在设计思路上，作者借鉴并改进了现有工作，针对传统过程奖励成本高或易被钻空子、树搜索计算昂贵、以及现有自蒸馏方法易导致信息泄露或策略不匹配等问题，提出了这种轻量且无需外部干预的贝叶斯校准方案。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是利用贝叶斯原理评估每个中间步骤对最终正确答案的支持程度，并将这种支持度转化为权重来精细调整强化学习的奖励信号，从而解决长序列任务中奖励稀疏的问题。整体流程首先让模型生成推理轨迹，接着对比模型在无答案和有标准答案条件下的生成概率差异，计算出每一步的贝叶斯证据分数。最后，将该分数与轨迹级优势信号结合进行加权校准，并以此更新模型策略。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于贝叶斯证据的自蒸馏方法，将稀疏的最终结果奖励转化为精细的逐轮信用分配信号。它通过贝叶斯公式将难以直接计算的轨迹支持度转化为特权教师模型与标准学生模型的似然比，并利用该证据分数对每步的学习优势进行动态校准。与以往依赖外部评估器、启发式规则或直接模仿特权策略的工作不同，该方法仅将特权信息作为加权证据，避免了信息泄露和策略对齐问题，同时保持了基于结果强化学习的稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯证据校准的自蒸馏方法，通过将稀疏的最终奖励转化为细粒度的回合级信用信号，有效解决了长程智能体训练中的信用分配难题，并显著提升了模型性能与跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract

Long-horizon agentic tasks pose a fundamental credit assignment challenge for outcome-base reinforcement learning: trajectory-level rewards verify final correctness but provide limited guidance on which intermediate reasoning steps or tool interactions contribute to the outcome. The difficulty is especially pronounced in multi-turn search agents, where successful trajectories may contain misleading actions and failed trajectories may contain valuable evidence-gathering steps. We propose PBSD (Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation), a Bayes-calibrated self-distillation method for fine-grained credit assignment under sparse final rewards. PBSD measures trajectory quality through the posterior-to-prior probability ratio of the verified answer and applies Bayes' rule to convert this hard-to-estimate answer-side ratio into a tractable likelihood ratio between a standard student model and a privileged answer-conditioned teacher model. Autoregressive decomposition of this Bayesian evidence score yields turn-level signals that identify whether each intermediate turn supports or undermines the verified outcome. Consequently, PBSD provides a principled and elegant reweighting scheme that transforms sparse outcome supervision into Bayes-calibrated turn-level credit signals, while remaining fully compatible with standard policy optimization. Experiments demonstrate that PBSD consistently enhances performance across both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, and effectively transfers knowledge from short-context training to long-context inference, suggesting that its fine-grained credit assignment mechanism facilitates more effective policy learning and yields improved generalization.

item.title: Taming Perception Jitter: Uncertainty-Aware LiDAR Object Detection for Reliable Motion Classification
item.author: Cornelius Schröder, Žygimantas Marcinkus, Markus Lienkamp
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种部署友好的缓解策略，通过增强三维物体检测器并引入偶然不确定性估计，结合短时观测窗口内的双样本z检验，有效区分真实运动与抖动，从而减少自动驾驶中因静态物体误判为动态物体而导致的规划器干预和虚假轨迹预测。

背景: 可靠的运动分类对自动驾驶至关重要，静态物体的虚假动态预测会引发不必要的规划器干预，不稳定的边界框预测会导致跟踪中的速度估计错误和虚假轨迹预测。

目的: 提出一种部署友好的缓解策略，以增强三维物体检测器，减少虚假动态预测和不必要的停止。

方法: 在三维物体检测器中引入偶然不确定性估计，并在短时观测窗口内应用双样本z检验来区分真实运动与抖动，该方法与Autoware集成，复用现有数据关联，计算开销极小。

主要发现: 在nuScenes数据集上性能与速度阈值法相当，但在真实世界测试中显著减少了虚假动态预测和不必要的停止，原因是记录数据中存在速度规则无法正确分类的中间抖动带。

结论: 不确定性感知检测和轻量级统计测试能够在噪声较大的真实世界环境中为自动驾驶带来实际性能提升。

翻译: 可靠的运动分类对自动驾驶至关重要，因为静态物体的虚假动态预测会引发不必要的规划器干预。不稳定的边界框预测会导致跟踪中的速度估计错误和虚假轨迹预测。我们提出了一种部署友好的缓解策略，通过增强三维物体检测器并引入偶然不确定性估计，结合短时观测窗口内的双样本z检验来区分真实运动与抖动。该方法与Autoware集成，仅需最小改动并复用现有数据关联，计算开销极小。实证结果显示，在nuScenes数据集上性能与速度阈值法相当，但在真实世界测试中显著减少了虚假动态预测和不必要的停止，这归因于记录数据中存在速度规则无法正确分类的中间抖动带。这表明不确定性感知检测和轻量级统计测试能够在噪声较大的真实世界环境中为自动驾驶带来实际性能提升。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决激光雷达目标检测中因传感器噪声和环境差异导致的边界框预测抖动问题。该问题在自动驾驶中至关重要，因为检测抖动会引发虚假的速度估计，导致系统误将静止物体识别为运动物体，进而触发不必要的规划干预（如无故刹车），严重影响行车安全与系统可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现激光雷达检测框的抖动会导致速度估计失真，进而引发自动驾驶规划模块的误判。为此，他们借鉴了现有研究中利用数据不确定性提升检测质量的方法，在检测模型中增加了方差预测头。在此基础上，他们设计了基于统计检验的运动分类器，通过对比短时间内位置变化的幅度与检测不确定性，来区分真实运动与传感器抖动。该方法直接复用了现有软件系统的协方差字段和数据关联结果，以极小的计算开销实现了可靠部署。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用三维激光雷达检测器输出的位置不确定性估计，结合短时观测窗口内的统计检验，有效区分目标的真实运动与检测器产生的定位抖动。整体实现流程为：首先为检测模型增加方差预测头以获取每帧的位置不确定性；接着将连续多帧的检测数据分为前后两段，通过统计检验判断两段平均位置差异是否超出不确定性范围；若差异不显著则判定为静态目标，将其速度置零并取窗口平均位置进行平滑，否则判定为动态目标；最后该模块直接复用现有自动驾驶系统的跟踪关联逻辑与数据接口，以极小计算开销完成部署。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种无需额外训练数据的运动分类策略，通过在目标检测器中引入随机不确定性估计，并利用短时观测窗口的双样本统计检验来区分真实运动与传感器抖动。与以往仅依赖速度阈值或需要大量特定领域数据微调的方法不同，该方案直接复用现有自动驾驶软件栈的数据关联与协方差字段，以极低的计算开销实现了基准性能，并在真实驾驶中显著减少了因抖动误判动态目标而导致的无效停车。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种部署友好的运动分类方法，通过结合三维目标检测的不确定性估计与双样本统计检验来区分真实运动与传感器抖动，并成功集成至自动驾驶软件栈中，有效减少了真实驾驶场景下的误判与无效制动。

Abstract

Reliable motion classification is critical for autonomous driving, as false dynamic predictions of static objects can cascade into unnecessary planner interventions. Unstable bounding box predictions can lead to spurious velocity estimates in tracking and falsely predicted trajectories. We present a deployment-friendly mitigation strategy that augments a 3D object detector with aleatoric uncertainty estimates and applies a two-sample z-test over short observation windows to separate true motion from jitter. Integrated into Autoware with minimal changes, the approach reuses existing data association for minimal compute overhead. Empirical results show parity with velocity thresholding on nuScenes, but substantially fewer false dynamic predictions and unnecessary stops in real-world test drives, explained by the presence of an intermediate jitter band in the recorded data that speed-only rules misclassify. This demonstrates that uncertainty-aware detection and lightweight statistical testing can deliver practical performance gains for autonomous driving in noisier real-world settings.

item.title: Beyond Humans: Multispecies Animal Face Recognition Using Transfer Learning
item.author: Maria De Marsico, Anil K. Jain, Annalaura Miglino
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究探讨了利用预训练深度学习模型进行个体动物面部识别的可行性，通过迁移学习在狗、灵长类动物和牛的面部数据集上进行实验，并与现有最先进方法进行了比较。

背景: 个体动物识别在寻找走失或被盗宠物、追踪濒危物种以及拥挤农场中的动物识别方面具有实用价值。现有的识别技术多依赖微芯片等物理设备，存在不切实际和应用困难的问题。基于面部的远程识别具有非侵入性、可远距离工作且难以伪造等优势。然而，现有的标注有单一动物身份的数据集规模不足以训练当前的深度学习架构。

目的: 调查利用预训练网络模型作为骨干进行迁移学习的可能性，以解决现有数据集规模不足的问题，并评估其在不同动物面部识别任务中的性能。

方法: 使用三个不同动物的面部数据集（狗、灵长类动物包括狐猴、金丝猴和黑猩猩、牛）进行实验。比较了专门在大型人类面部数据库上训练的FaceNet模型和在ImageNet对象类别上预训练的Vision Transformer模型。将实验结果与针对各数据集专门训练的最先进深度学习网络进行了对比。

主要发现: 不同数据集的捕获条件和质量存在差异，图像质量从狗到牛再到灵长类动物逐渐下降。在狗的数据集上取得了最佳性能，Vision Transformer达到了百分之九十六点八五的平均验证准确率和百分之八十四点三四的Rank-1识别率。对于濒危灵长类动物，结果令人鼓舞，但性能因动物类别和任务类型而异，且并不总是优于最先进方法。对于牛，Vision Transformer的结果优于最先进方法，而FaceNet仍具有竞争力。

结论: 利用预训练模型进行迁移学习在个体动物面部识别方面是可行的，特别是在狗和牛的数据集上表现良好，但在灵长类动物上的性能表现因情况而异，且并非在所有情况下都能超越现有的最先进方法。

翻译: Individual animal recognition can be useful in the search for lost or stolen pets, the tracking of individuals of endangered species, and the recognition of animals in crowded farms. Present recognition techniques mostly use physical devices, e.g., microchips, often impractical and difficult to apply. These could be replaced by remote recognition via the animal's face; if accurate enough, it provides several advantages: it is non-invasive, can work at a distance, and is difficult to counterfeit, as, for instance, in the case of substituting sick animals for healthy ones in the food industry. The few existing datasets with sufficient per-subject images annotated with a single animal identity are not large enough to train current deep learning architectures. We rather investigate the possibility of transfer learning, exploiting pre-trained network models as backbones. Our experiments compared FaceNet, which is specifically trained on large databases of human faces, with the Vision Transformer pre-trained on ImageNet, i.e., on object categories. We used three face datasets of very different animals: dogs, primates (lemurs, golden monkeys, and chimpanzees), and cattle. We report the results and, for each dataset, compare them with the state of the art ad hoc-trained deep networks. The capture conditions differ among the three datasets. Image quality decreases from dogs to cattle to primates. The best performance was achieved with dogs, where ViT reached a mean verification accuracy of 96.85% and a Rank-1 Identification Rate of 84.34%. The results for endangered primates are still encouraging, but performance varies across animal classes and tasks, and does not always outperform SOTA. For cattle, the ViT results outperform SOTA, while FaceNet is still competitive.

Abstract

Individual animal recognition can be useful in the search for lost or stolen pets, the tracking of individuals of endangered species, and the recognition of animals in crowded farms. Present recognition techniques mostly use physical devices, e.g., microchips, often impractical and difficult to apply. These could be replaced by remote recognition via the animal's face; if accurate enough, it provides several advantages: it is non-invasive, can work at a distance, and is difficult to counterfeit, as, for instance, in the case of substituting sick animals for healthy ones in the food industry. The few existing datasets with sufficient per-subject images annotated with a single animal identity are not large enough to train current deep learning architectures. We rather investigate the possibility of transfer learning, exploiting pre-trained network models as backbones. Our experiments compared FaceNet, which is specifically trained on large databases of human faces, with the Vision Transformer (ViT) pre-trained on ImageNet, i.e., on object categories. We used three face datasets of very different animals: dogs, primates (lemurs, golden monkeys, and chimpanzees), and cattle. We report the results and, for each dataset, compare them with the state of the art (SOTA) ad hoc-trained deep networks. The capture conditions differ among the three datasets. Image quality (resolution, motion blur, diverse poses, etc.) decreases from dogs to cattle to primates. The best performance was achieved with dogs, where ViT reached a mean verification accuracy of 96.85% and a Rank-1 Identification Rate of 84.34%. The results for endangered primates are still encouraging, but performance varies across animal classes and tasks (verification or identification), and does not always outperform SOTA. For cattle, the ViT results outperform SOTA, while FaceNet is still competitive.

item.title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
item.author: Sun, Haoran, Li, Wenjie, Zhang, Yujie, Lin, Zekai, Zhang, Fanrui, Chen, Kaitao, He, Xingqi, Li, Yichen, Liu, Mianxin, Liu, Lei, Jiang, Yankai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为SkeMex的后部署自我进化框架，旨在通过基于技能的记忆机制提升医疗智能体在交互式临床决策中的表现，而无需更新模型权重。该框架将交互轨迹提炼为结构化技能，并根据环境反馈评估记忆效用，实现持续进化。

背景: 医疗智能体系统日益被期望支持交互式临床决策，而不仅仅是静态问答。然而，现有的记忆机制通常保留冗余、嘈杂且难以管理的原始历史痕迹，且很少区分哪些记忆对未来的推理真正有用，这限制了其在长期临床推理中积累紧凑可靠经验的能力。

目的: 解决现有记忆机制在保留和利用经验方面的不足，提升医疗智能体在交互式临床决策中的性能，使其能够重用先前的经验并适应不断变化的病例。

方法: 提出SkeMex框架，通过基于技能的记忆进行自我进化。具体包括：将信息丰富的交互轨迹提炼为编码可重用程序知识的结构化技能；将这些技能组织到涵盖通用、任务特定和行动级别经验的多分支存储库中；利用环境反馈估计上下文相关的效用，以指导价值感知的检索和存储库治理；实施闭环的读写评估治理生命周期，以持续进化。

主要发现: 在多样化的临床任务实验中，SkeMex在离线和在线设置中均持续优于代表性的基于记忆的医疗智能体。该框架在不同模型骨干上具有泛化能力，并支持可转移的技能记忆。

结论: SkeMex框架通过基于技能的记忆和持续进化机制，有效提升了医疗智能体在临床决策中的性能，证明了其在不同设置和模型下的有效性和泛化能力。所有数据和代码将公开。

翻译: Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop Read-Write-Assess-Govern lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决现有医疗智能体记忆机制难以有效筛选和复用历史经验的问题。当前方法往往保留大量冗余且嘈杂的原始交互记录，且缺乏评估记忆长期价值的机制，导致智能体难以积累可靠经验以应对复杂的动态临床决策。这一问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为真实的临床诊疗是多步骤且高度依赖过往经验的，若智能体无法像医生一样抽象并复用有效经验，将严重限制其在跨场景泛化、长期推理及实际医疗辅助中的可靠性与实用性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有医疗智能体记忆机制冗余嘈杂且缺乏长期效用评估的问题，提出将交互轨迹提炼为结构化技能，并构建分层技能库。该方法借鉴了现有基于记忆增强和技能蒸馏的医疗智能体研究，但克服了以往方法需更新模型参数或难以跨任务泛化的局限。通过引入环境反馈评估技能效用，并采用闭环管理机制，实现了不更新模型权重的持续自我进化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是不更新模型参数，而是通过外部技能记忆库将历史交互经验提炼为可复用的结构化技能，从而提升医疗智能体的临床推理能力。整体实现流程遵循读取、写入、评估、治理的闭环生命周期：首先在任务初期根据语义匹配和历史效用检索相关技能，随后将成功的交互过程提炼为新技能并写入记忆库，接着依据临床环境反馈评估各项技能的实际价值，最后定期合并冗余条目并移除低质量内容以维持记忆库的紧凑与可靠。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种无需更新模型参数的部署后自我进化框架，通过将交互轨迹提炼为结构化技能并构建多层级记忆库来提升医疗智能体的推理能力。相比以往工作，它打破了记忆改进与模型训练绑定的传统做法，转而利用环境反馈动态评估技能效用，并设计了闭环机制持续治理记忆库。这一设计有效避免了历史经验的冗余与噪声积累，显著增强了模型在复杂临床场景中的泛化与适应能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种部署后自我进化框架，通过在不更新模型参数的前提下，将临床交互经验提炼为结构化技能，并基于环境反馈进行效用评估与仓库治理，从而持续提升医疗智能体的临床推理能力。

Abstract

Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop ``Read--Write--Assess--Govern" lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.

item.title: RT-SDGOD: Real-Time Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection
item.author: Yupeng Zhang, Fangzhuo Gao, Ruize Han, Wei Feng, Liang Wan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种实时单域泛化目标检测方法RT-SDGDet，旨在解决严格实时约束下因天气和成像变化导致的分布偏移问题。该方法通过训练时的表征学习实现跨域泛化，无需增加推理开销。

背景: 在严格实时约束的实际部署中，天气和成像变化会引起显著的分布偏移，严重降低检测器的性能。单域泛化目标检测旨在缓解这一问题，但现有方法很少从问题定义层面研究在受限推理预算下实时检测器的泛化能力。

目的: 研究实时检测器如何在不增加额外推理开销的情况下，仅依靠训练时的表征学习实现跨域泛化。

方法: 提出RT-SDGDet框架，采用多证据协同建模。具体包括：使用一对一监督构建稳定的特定对象查询组；设计判别证据多样性学习以扩展对象级证据覆盖范围；设计双视图证据一致性学习以提高外观扰动下证据的稳定性。

主要发现: 在域偏移下，基于DETR的实时检测器性能下降主要表现为漏检增加，其根源在于对象级判别证据有限且不稳定。

结论: 所提方法在多个未见目标域上实现了比现有方法更好的泛化性能，且所有组件仅在训练时引入，不增加推理开销。

翻译: In real-world deployment under strict real-time constraints, weather and imaging variations induce significant distribution shifts, severely degrading detectors. Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection aims to mitigate this issue, yet existing methods rarely investigate-at the level of problem formulation-the generalization capability of real-time detectors under such constrained inference budgets. To this end, we introduce Real-Time Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (RT-SDGOD), which focuses on how real-time detectors can achieve cross-domain generalization under zero extra inference overhead by relying solely on training-time representation learning. We observe that, under domain shift, DETR-based real-time detectors mainly degrade through increased missed detections, rooted in limited and unstable object-level discriminative evidence. Based on this, we propose RT-SDGDet, a multi-evidence collaborative modeling framework for RT-SDGOD. The core idea is to enable multiple queries of the same object to collaboratively cover more sufficient discriminative evidence while maintaining the stability of such evidence modeling across views. Specifically, we use one-to-many (O2M) supervision to construct stable object-specific query groups, and further design Discriminative Evidence Diversity Learning (DEDL) and Dual-view Evidence Consistency Learning (DvECL) to expand object-level evidence coverage and improve evidence stability under appearance perturbations, respectively. Since all components are introduced only during training, our method incurs no extra inference overhead. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method achieves better generalization performance than existing approaches across multiple unseen target domains.

Abstract

In real-world deployment under strict real-time constraints, weather and imaging variations induce significant distribution shifts, severely degrading detectors. Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection aims to mitigate this issue, yet existing methods rarely investigate-at the level of problem formulation-the generalization capability of real-time detectors under such constrained inference budgets. To this end, we introduce Real-Time Single-Domain Generalized Object Detection (RT-SDGOD), which focuses on how real-time detectors can achieve cross-domain generalization under zero extra inference overhead by relying solely on training-time representation learning. We observe that, under domain shift, DETR-based real-time detectors mainly degrade through increased missed detections, rooted in limited and unstable object-level discriminative evidence. Based on this, we propose RT-SDGDet, a multi-evidence collaborative modeling framework for RT-SDGOD. The core idea is to enable multiple queries of the same object to collaboratively cover more sufficient discriminative evidence while maintaining the stability of such evidence modeling across views. Specifically, we use one-to-many (O2M) supervision to construct stable object-specific query groups, and further design Discriminative Evidence Diversity Learning (DEDL) and Dual-view Evidence Consistency Learning (DvECL) to expand object-level evidence coverage and improve evidence stability under appearance perturbations, respectively. Since all components are introduced only during training, our method incurs no extra inference overhead. Extensive experiments show that the proposed method achieves better generalization performance than existing approaches across multiple unseen target domains.

item.title: LargeMonitor: Monitoring Online Task-Free Continual Learning via Large Pretrained Models
item.author: Mingqi Yuan, Xiaoquan Sun, Shihao Luo, Jiayu Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LargeMonitor的框架，用于解决在线无任务持续学习中的挑战。该框架利用大型预训练基础模型自主编排无任务连续适应过程，通过解耦的检测模块和上下文感知的诊断模块，实现对数据流漂移的鲁棒检测和语义解释，从而动态部署自适应优化策略。

背景: 在线无任务持续学习要求智能体在严格单次访问约束和无明确任务标识的情况下，从非平稳数据流中顺序积累知识。现有方法主要依赖参数高效提示调优或动态结构扩展，但这些方法受训练耦合优化动态驱动，无法识别分布漂移的结构起源，机械地应用固定策略。

目的: 解决现有在线无任务持续学习方法对分布漂移结构起源缺乏认知的问题，实现更精确、鲁棒的漂移检测和诊断，提升持续学习性能。

方法: 提出LargeMonitor框架，包含两个核心模块：一是利用大型视觉模型冻结稳定表示空间的解耦检测模块，实现零样本漂移检测；二是基于大型多模态模型的上下文感知诊断模块，解释数据流变化的语义原因。根据检测结果动态部署自适应优化策略。

主要发现: 在多个无任务持续学习设置和基准测试中，LargeMonitor实现了精确、鲁棒的复杂数据流检测和诊断，并持续提升现有在线无任务持续学习算法的性能。

结论: LargeMonitor通过解耦检测和诊断机制，有效应对数据流漂移，为在线无任务持续学习提供了新的解决方案，提升了模型适应性和性能。

翻译: Online task-free continual learning (TFCL) requires intelligent agents to sequentially accumulate knowledge from an unbounded, non-stationary data stream under strict single-pass constraints and without any explicit task identifiers. Existing online TFCL paradigms primarily rely on parameter-efficient prompt tuning or dynamic structure expansion driven by training-coupled optimization dynamics, such as empirical loss fluctuations or evolving latent distances. As a result, these training-coupled solvers remain agnostic to the structural origins of distribution drift, mechanically enforcing a fixed strategy across fundamentally distinct streaming variations. To address this gap, we propose LargeMonitor, a framework that leverages large pretrained foundation models to autonomously orchestrate task-free continuous adaptation. Specifically, LargeMonitor introduces a decoupled detection module utilizing the frozen, stable representation space of large vision models (LVMs) to achieve robust, zero-shot drift detection without training-dependent interference or brittle threshold tuning. Upon a confirmed drift, the framework activates a context-aware diagnostic module driven by large multimodal models (LMMs) to interpret the precise semantic etiologies of the stream variation (e.g., novel class emergence vs. environmental domain shift). This dual-stage capability empowers the continuous learner to dynamically deploy adaptive and shift-specific optimization strategies. Extensive experiments across multiple TFCL settings and benchmarks demonstrate that LargeMonitor achieves precise, robust detection and diagnosis of complex data streams while consistently improving the performance of existing online TFCL algorithms.

Abstract

Online task-free continual learning (TFCL) requires intelligent agents to sequentially accumulate knowledge from an unbounded, non-stationary data stream under strict single-pass constraints and without any explicit task identifiers. Existing online TFCL paradigms primarily rely on parameter-efficient prompt tuning or dynamic structure expansion driven by training-coupled optimization dynamics, such as empirical loss fluctuations or evolving latent distances. As a result, these training-coupled solvers remain agnostic to the structural origins of distribution drift, mechanically enforcing a fixed strategy across fundamentally distinct streaming variations. To address this gap, we propose LargeMonitor, a framework that leverages large pretrained foundation models to autonomously orchestrate task-free continuous adaptation. Specifically, LargeMonitor introduces a decoupled detection module utilizing the frozen, stable representation space of large vision models (LVMs) to achieve robust, zero-shot drift detection without training-dependent interference or brittle threshold tuning. Upon a confirmed drift, the framework activates a context-aware diagnostic module driven by large multimodal models (LMMs) to interpret the precise semantic etiologies of the stream variation (e.g., novel class emergence vs. environmental domain shift). This dual-stage capability empowers the continuous learner to dynamically deploy adaptive and shift-specific optimization strategies. Extensive experiments across multiple TFCL settings and benchmarks demonstrate that LargeMonitor achieves precise, robust detection and diagnosis of complex data streams while consistently improving the performance of existing online TFCL algorithms.

item.title: GD-MIL: Grade-Disentangled Multiple Instance Learning for Multimodal Biochemical Recurrence Prediction in Prostate Cancer
item.author: Dasari Naga Raju
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究构建了严格的基准测试，评估基于H&E全切片图像的预后信号，并提出了Grade-Disentangled MIL模型，该模型在预测前列腺癌根治术后生化复发方面显著优于临床基线和纯影像模型。

背景: 前列腺癌根治术后生化复发是关键终点，但风险分层主要依赖Gleason分级。H&E全切片图像是否携带超越分级的预后信号，以及多实例学习能否恢复该信号，尚不明确。现有方法常因在评估折中选择模型检查点而人为提高一致性。

目的: 评估H&E全切片图像是否包含超越Gleason分级的预后信息，并验证多实例学习能否有效提取该信息，同时提出一种新的模型以分离分级特征。

方法: 在TCGA-PRAD数据集上构建严格基准，使用五折交叉验证和五个随机种子，采用严格的折外评分。比较不同多实例学习聚合器和特征提取器的性能。提出Grade-Disentangled MIL模型，通过梯度反转分级对抗训练，使幻灯片表示在晚期与临床变量融合前对Gleason分级不变。

主要发现: 多实例学习聚合器的选择对性能影响较小，而特征提取器是主要影响因素。临床Cox模型（基于分级、分期和年龄）的C指数为0.687，纯影像模型未显著优于临床模型。Grade-Disentangled MIL模型C指数达0.704，显著优于临床基线和最佳纯影像模型。中位风险分割在生化无复发生存率上显示出显著分离（五年时约20%对比约70%）。

结论: H&E形态学包含与Gleason分级互补的预后信息。Grade-Disentangled MIL模型能有效提取该信息，显著提升预后预测性能。

翻译: Biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy is a critical endpoint in prostate cancer, yet risk stratification relies almost entirely on variables dominated by Gleason grade. Whether H&E whole slide images (WSIs) carry prognostic signal beyond grade, and whether multiple instance learning (MIL) can recover it, remains unsettled. A key obstacle is that many pipelines select model checkpoints on the evaluation fold, artificially inflating concordance. We construct a rigorous benchmark on TCGA-PRAD (487 patients, 101 BCR events) using strict out-of-fold scoring over five-fold cross-validation repeated across five seeds. The choice of MIL aggregator (ABMIL, CLAM, TransMIL, PatchGCN) has little effect (C-index 0.61-0.64 with UNI2-h), while the feature extractor is the dominant factor (ResNet50 0.566 versus pathology foundation models up to 0.639). A clinical Cox model on grade, stage, and age reaches 0.687; no imaging-only model significantly outperforms it (p > 0.10). We introduce Grade-Disentangled MIL (GD-MIL), a gated-attention MIL encoder trained with a gradient-reversal grade adversary that encourages the slide representation to be invariant to Gleason grade before late fusion with clinical variables. GD-MIL achieves C-index 0.704, significantly outperforming both the clinical baseline (delta-c = +0.029, p = 0.0005) and the best imaging-only model (delta-c = +0.062, p = 0.039), suggesting H&E morphology contains prognostic information complementary to grade. A median risk split yields log-rank p < 0.0001 separation in BCR-free survival (~20% vs ~70% at five years).

Abstract

Biochemical recurrence (BCR) after radical prostatectomy is a critical endpoint in prostate cancer, yet risk stratification relies almost entirely on variables dominated by Gleason grade. Whether H&E whole slide images (WSIs) carry prognostic signal beyond grade, and whether multiple instance learning (MIL) can recover it, remains unsettled. A key obstacle is that many pipelines select model checkpoints on the evaluation fold, artificially inflating concordance. We construct a rigorous benchmark on TCGA-PRAD (487 patients, 101 BCR events) using strict out-of-fold scoring over five-fold cross-validation repeated across five seeds. The choice of MIL aggregator (ABMIL, CLAM, TransMIL, PatchGCN) has little effect (C-index 0.61-0.64 with UNI2-h), while the feature extractor is the dominant factor (ResNet50 0.566 versus pathology foundation models up to 0.639). A clinical Cox model on grade, stage, and age reaches 0.687; no imaging-only model significantly outperforms it (p > 0.10). We introduce Grade-Disentangled MIL (GD-MIL), a gated-attention MIL encoder trained with a gradient-reversal grade adversary that encourages the slide representation to be invariant to Gleason grade before late fusion with clinical variables. GD-MIL achieves C-index 0.704, significantly outperforming both the clinical baseline (delta-c = +0.029, p = 0.0005) and the best imaging-only model (delta-c = +0.062, p = 0.039), suggesting H&E morphology contains prognostic information complementary to grade. A median risk split yields log-rank p < 0.0001 separation in BCR-free survival (~20% vs ~70% at five years).

item.title: Training-Free Generalized Few-Shot Segmentation through Open-Vocabulary Semantic Arbitration
item.author: Silas Kwabla Gah, Ebenezer Owusu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Open-V的训练无关的广义少样本语义分割框架，通过协调冻结的语义先验而非参数调整来解决该问题。

背景: 广义少样本语义分割传统上被视为需要任务特定适应的表示学习问题。近期基础模型已展现出强大的开放词汇识别和分割能力。

目的: 探讨是否可以通过推理时协调冻结的语义先验来解决广义少样本语义分割问题，而非进行参数适应。

方法: 提出Open-V框架，结合Segment Anything模型的提示概念分割与K-shot CLIP支持质心，通过校准的逐像素语义仲裁实现。该方法无 trainable 组件，支持推理时的任意语义类别。

主要发现: 1. 支持信息可通过推理时语义接地整合，且随着基础模型文本先验在标签不相交词汇表上减弱，其贡献增加。2. 发现基础模型分割中的可复现性混淆因素，预处理和评估空间的不匹配会无声地扭曲报告的性能。3. 在多个数据集上验证了Open-V的泛化能力。

结论: 训练无关的基础模型先验协调在常规广义少样本语义分割和开放词汇评估设置中均有效。在PASCAL-5i单样本设置下，Open-V的性能超过了最强的训练基线。

翻译: Generalized Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (GFSS) has traditionally been approached as a representation-learning problem, requiring task-specific adaptation to incorporate novel classes from limited support examples. Recent foundation models, however, already exhibit strong open-vocabulary recognition and segmentation capabilities, raising a different question: can GFSS be solved through inference-time coordination of frozen semantic priors rather than parameter adaptation? We answer this question with Open-V, a training-free GFSS framework that combines Segment Anything (SAM3) Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) with a K-shot CLIP support centroid through calibrated per-pixel semantic arbitration. OpenV introduces no trainable components and supports arbitrary semantic categories at inference time. Beyond segmentation performance, our study contributes three broader findings. First, we show that support information can be incorporated through inference-time semantic grounding, and that its contribution increases as foundation-model text priors weaken on label-disjoint vocabularies. Second, we identify a reproducibility confound in foundationmodel segmentation, demonstrating that preprocessing and evaluation-space mismatches can silently distort reported performance. Finally, we validate Open-V across PASCAL5i, COCO-20i, and ADE-OW, showing that training-free coordination of foundation-model priors generalizes across both conventional GFSS and open-vocabulary evaluation settings. On PASCAL-5i (1-shot), Open-V attains base/novel/harmonic mIoU of 78.4/77.5/77.9, without GFSS-specific training surpassing the strongest trained baseline by +17.7 HM.

Abstract

Generalized Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation (GFSS) has traditionally been approached as a representation-learning problem, requiring task-specific adaptation to incorporate novel classes from limited support examples. Recent foundation models, however, already exhibit strong open-vocabulary recognition and segmentation capabilities, raising a different question: can GFSS be solved through inference-time coordination of frozen semantic priors rather than parameter adaptation? We answer this question with Open-V, a training-free GFSS framework that combines Segment Anything (SAM3) Promptable Concept Segmentation (PCS) with a K-shot CLIP support centroid through calibrated per-pixel semantic arbitration. OpenV introduces no trainable components and supports arbitrary semantic categories at inference time. Beyond segmentation performance, our study contributes three broader findings. First, we show that support information can be incorporated through inference-time semantic grounding, and that its contribution increases as foundation-model text priors weaken on label-disjoint vocabularies. Second, we identify a reproducibility confound in foundationmodel segmentation, demonstrating that preprocessing and evaluation-space mismatches can silently distort reported performance. Finally, we validate Open-V across PASCAL5i, COCO-20i, and ADE-OW, showing that training-free coordination of foundation-model priors generalizes across both conventional GFSS and open-vocabulary evaluation settings. On PASCAL-5i (1-shot), Open-V attains base/novel/harmonic mIoU of 78.4/77.5/77.9, without GFSS-specific training surpassing the strongest trained baseline by +17.7 HM.

item.title: Loss-Guided Adaptive Scale Refinement for Molecular Force Prediction
item.author: Limin Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种用于分子力预测的基于损失引导的自适应尺度细化框架，通过插值、路由、可微尺度更新和尺度池细化，从预定义尺度中发现任务有效的分辨率，并在氯化钠水溶液离子系统中验证了其有效性。

背景: 分子系统涉及从局部配位、短程扰动到长程静电和溶剂介导效应的多空间尺度相互作用。然而，大多数分子表示学习方法依赖于手动预定义的尺度，任务最优的建模尺度可能与这些固定水平不一致。

目的: 解决分子表示学习中固定尺度建模不足的问题，通过自适应尺度细化框架发现任务有效的分辨率，以提高分子力预测的准确性。

方法: 提出基于损失引导的自适应尺度细化框架，将预定义尺度作为初始锚点，通过插值、路由、可微尺度更新和尺度池细化来发现任务有效的分辨率。以氯化钠水溶液离子系统为测试平台，构建短尺度和长程力预测分支并分析其互补性。

主要发现: 在氯化钠水溶液系统中，使用Oracle硬路由将整体力平均绝对误差从三百九十九点六五降低到三百八十二点六七，连续Oracle插值进一步降低到三百八十点九六。在最近离子距离低于零点六纳米的近距离区域，近距离平均绝对误差从三百二十七点二二降低到二百六十点五一。最小尺度池更新实验表明，从端点锚点开始，损失引导的更新自动生成中间尺度并恢复大部分连续Oracle性能，最终更新的尺度池实现整体平均绝对误差为三百八十一点二三。

结论: 自适应尺度细化是分子表示学习的一个有前景的方向，特别是在固定尺度建模不足的情况下。

翻译: Molecular systems involve interactions across multiple spatial scales, from local coordination and short-range perturbations to long-range electrostatic and solvent-mediated effects. However, most molecular representation learning methods rely on manually predefined scales, and the task-optimal modeling scale may not coincide with these fixed levels. This study introduces a loss-guided adaptive scale refinement framework for molecular force prediction, treating predefined scales as initial anchors and discovering task-effective resolutions through interpolation, routing, differentiable scale updates, and scale pool refinement. Using a NaCl aqueous ionic system as a minimal testbed, this study constructs short-scale and long-range force prediction branches and analyzes their complementarity. Oracle hard routing reduces the overall force MAE from 399.65 to 382.67, while continuous oracle interpolation further reduces it to 380.96. In close-contact regimes with nearest-ion distance below 0.6 nm, the close-contact MAE decreases from 327.22 to 260.51. A minimal scale pool update experiment shows that starting from endpoint anchors {0,1}, loss-guided updates automatically generate intermediate scales and recover most of the continuous oracle performance. The final updated scale pool {0,0.125,0.25,0.375,0.5,0.75,1} achieves an overall MAE of 381.23. These results support adaptive scale refinement as a promising direction for molecular representation learning, especially when fixed-scale modeling is insufficient.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决分子力预测中依赖人工预设固定尺度、难以自动匹配任务最优建模分辨率的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为分子相互作用跨越多个空间尺度，固定尺度往往无法兼顾局部精细结构与长程环境效应，导致预测精度受限。通过自适应尺度优化，模型能根据实际物理环境和任务需求动态调整建模粒度，从而显著提升分子力场预测的准确性与泛化能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者认为传统分子建模依赖人工预设的固定尺度，但实际任务的最优尺度往往不固定。因此，他们将预设尺度作为初始锚点，利用预测误差损失来动态指导尺度插值、路由选择和参数更新，从而自动发现更有效的建模分辨率。该方法的设计借鉴了条件计算与混合专家系统的思想，将不同尺度专家与局部环境特征结合，并通过损失函数实现可微分的自适应调整。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将人工预设的分子建模尺度视为初始锚点，利用任务预测误差动态发现并生成更适应当前任务的有效尺度。整体实现流程为：首先构建短程与长程两个基础预测分支，通过误差路由或连续插值机制融合两者的预测结果；接着以预测损失为导向更新尺度权重，并迭代生成新的中间尺度锚点加入尺度池；最终借助可学习的尺度门控网络实现自适应尺度选择与分子力预测。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种由任务损失引导的自适应尺度精炼框架。与以往依赖人工预设固定尺度的方法不同，该研究将预设尺度仅视为初始锚点，通过插值、路由和可微更新等机制，利用预测误差自动发现并生成最适合当前任务的有效尺度。这一转变使分子建模尺度从静态固定变为动态自适应，从而更精准地捕捉多尺度相互作用。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种由预测误差引导的自适应尺度优化框架，通过将人工预设的分子尺度作为初始锚点，利用损失函数自动发现并生成任务最优的中间尺度，从而有效提升了分子力预测的精度。

Abstract

Molecular systems involve interactions across multiple spatial scales, from local coordination and short-range perturbations to long-range electrostatic and solvent-mediated effects. However, most molecular representation learning methods rely on manually predefined scales, and the task-optimal modeling scale may not coincide with these fixed levels. This study introduces a loss-guided adaptive scale refinement framework for molecular force prediction, treating predefined scales as initial anchors and discovering task-effective resolutions through interpolation, routing, differentiable scale updates, and scale pool refinement. Using a NaCl aqueous ionic system as a minimal testbed, this study constructs short-scale and long-range force prediction branches and analyzes their complementarity. Oracle hard routing reduces the overall force MAE from 399.65 to 382.67, while continuous oracle interpolation further reduces it to 380.96. In close-contact regimes with nearest-ion distance below 0.6 nm, the close-contact MAE decreases from 327.22 to 260.51. A minimal scale pool update experiment shows that starting from endpoint anchors {0,1}, loss-guided updates automatically generate intermediate scales and recover most of the continuous oracle performance. The final updated scale pool {0,0.125,0.25,0.375,0.5,0.75,1} achieves an overall MAE of 381.23. These results support adaptive scale refinement as a promising direction for molecular representation learning, especially when fixed-scale modeling is insufficient.

item.title: Securing Self-supervised Data Curation for Foundation Models Robustness
item.author: Sandeep Gupta, Roberto Passerone
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为中毒数据检测器的主动防御机制，用于确保自监督学习策展数据集在基础模型训练前的完整性。

背景: 自监督学习数据策展为扩展和提高机器学习模型的泛化能力提供了途径，但依赖匿名和未经审查的外部来源会增加数据中毒的风险。

目的: 设计一种主动防御机制，确保自监督学习策展数据集在基础模型训练前的完整性。

方法: 结合预训练的图像绑定模型与传统分类器（包括随机森林、k近邻、朴素贝叶斯和支持向量机构建中毒数据检测器，并使用来自三个不同数据集和三种不同对抗攻击的十七万六千二百张图像进行严格评估。

主要发现: 支持向量机中毒数据检测器在分布内和分布外数据集上均表现出优越的性能，且该设计具有强大的可扩展性，能够通过集成方法快速整合新的对抗攻击检测器。

结论: 该设计展示了强大的可扩展性，并能够通过集成方法快速整合新的对抗攻击检测器。

翻译: Self-supervised data curation provides a pathway to scaling and improving the generalization capabilities of machine learning models. By leveraging self-supervised learning (SSL) for data curation, the demand for massive training datasets required by foundation models can be effectively met. SSL greatly alleviates the costs associated with annotation and manual dataset curation while minimizing the need for human oversight. However, the integrity of SSL-curated datasets must be rigorously checked, as reliance on anonymous and unvetted external sources can substantially increase the risk of data poisoning. In this paper, we propose a Poisoned Data Detector (PDD), an active defense mechanism designed to ensure the integrity of SSL-curated datasets prior to foundation model training.
