PDDs are designed using a combination of the pretrained ImageBind model and traditional classifiers, including Random Forest (RF), k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes (NB), and Support Vector Machines (SVM). We rigorously evaluated PDDs using 176,200 images from three diverse datasets and three different adversarial attacks encompassing both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios. Notably, SVM-PDD achieves superior performance for both in-distribution (Set3-Set5) and out-of-distribution (TrueFace and 140K RealFace) datasets. Our design demonstrates strong scalability and enables the rapid integration of new adversarial attack detectors through an ensemble approach.

Abstract

Self-supervised data curation provides a pathway to scaling and improving the generalization capabilities of machine learning models. By leveraging self-supervised learning (SSL) for data curation, the demand for massive training datasets required by foundation models can be effectively met. SSL greatly alleviates the costs associated with annotation and manual dataset curation while minimizing the need for human oversight. However, the integrity of SSL-curated datasets must be rigorously checked, as reliance on anonymous and unvetted external sources can substantially increase the risk of data poisoning. In this paper, we propose a Poisoned Data Detector (PDD), an active defense mechanism designed to ensure the integrity of SSL-curated datasets prior to foundation model training. PDDs are designed using a combination of the pretrained ImageBind model and traditional classifiers, including Random Forest (RF), k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes (NB), and Support Vector Machines (SVM). We rigorously evaluated PDDs using 176,200 images from three diverse datasets and three different adversarial attacks encompassing both in-distribution and out-of-distribution scenarios. Notably, SVM-PDD achieves superior performance for both in-distribution (Set3-Set5) and out-of-distribution (TrueFace and 140K RealFace) datasets. Our design demonstrates strong scalability and enables the rapid integration of new adversarial attack detectors through an ensemble approach.

item.title: Your U-Net Dereverberation Model is Secretly an RIR Encoder
item.author: Sina Khanagha, Timo Gerkmann
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究分析了基于NCSN++ U-Net的音频去混响模型在中间表示中捕捉全局房间特性的能力，并提出了一种显式条件训练策略。

背景: 音频去混响模型在处理房间混响时，其内部表示如何捕捉全局房间特性尚需进一步分析。

目的: 分析模型捕捉全局房间特性的能力，并探索如何通过改进训练策略提升去混响性能。

方法: 通过实证研究分析扩散模型和判别模型的中间表示，提出一种基于自监督对比学习获取预训练房间脉冲响应嵌入，并显式条件化网络的训练策略。

主要发现: 深层网络编码了结构化的房间脉冲响应依赖嵌入，这种隐式房间表示的判别能力与去混响性能相关；引入房间脉冲响应条件化可提升表示质量、加速收敛、增强去混响性能，并显著减少推理时所需的反向扩散步骤。

结论: 显式条件化房间脉冲响应嵌入能有效提升基于扩散模型的音频去混响性能及效率。

翻译: In this work, we analyze the ability of NCSN++ U-Net based audio dereverberation models to capture global room characteristics in their intermediate representations. Through an empirical study of both a state-of-the-art diffusion-based model and a discriminative counterpart, we show that deeper layers encode structured room impulse response (RIR)-dependent embeddings. Moreover, the discriminative ability of this implicit room representation correlates with dereverberation performance across objective metrics. Motivated by this observation, we propose a training strategy that explicitly conditions the network on pre-trained RIR embeddings, obtained via self-supervised contrastive learning. Incorporating RIR conditioning improves representation quality, accelerates convergence, and enhances dereverberation performance, while significantly reducing the number of reverse diffusion steps required by the diffusion-based model during inference.

Abstract

In this work, we analyze the ability of NCSN++ U-Net based audio dereverberation models to capture global room characteristics in their intermediate representations. Through an empirical study of both a state-of-the-art diffusion-based model and a discriminative counterpart, we show that deeper layers encode structured room impulse response (RIR)-dependent embeddings. Moreover, the discriminative ability of this implicit room representation correlates with dereverberation performance across objective metrics. Motivated by this observation, we propose a training strategy that explicitly conditions the network on pre-trained RIR embeddings, obtained via self-supervised contrastive learning. Incorporating RIR conditioning improves representation quality, accelerates convergence, and enhances dereverberation performance, while significantly reducing the number of reverse diffusion steps required by the diffusion-based model during inference.

item.title: Integrating gene regulatory priors into Transformer attention with scTransformer for interpretable scRNA-seq analysis
item.author: Mikele Milia, Louis Fabrice Tshimanga, Henning Mueller, Manfredo Atzori, Barbara Di Camillo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为scTransformer的基于Transformer的模型，该模型通过将已知的基因调控信息作为先验知识融入模型的注意力模式中，从而在单细胞转录组学分析中提升了模型性能与生物学可解释性。

背景: 基于Transformer的模型在大规模单细胞转录组学中应用广泛，通过自监督学习在数百万个细胞上展现出强大性能。然而，现有方法大多将基因视为独立特征，忽略了先验生物学知识，限制了模型的可解释性和鲁棒性。

目的: 探索显式整合基因调控信息是否能够同时提升模型性能和对生物学机制的洞察。

方法: 提出了scTransformer，这是首个将生物学机制先验知识构建到模型注意力模式中的基于Transformer的方法。通过根据已知的调控结构约束信息流，使模型学习到更具生物学意义的表示。在疾病相关的单核RNA测序数据集上，使用监督细胞类型分类任务进行评估。

主要发现: 与标准Transformer相比，该方法提高了分类准确率，增强了嵌入空间中细胞类型的分离度，并产生了与已知调控程序一致的注意力模式。

结论: 将生物学结构嵌入Transformer模型可以在不牺牲性能的情况下增强可解释性，为单细胞组学的生物学基础基础模型提供了一个原则性的步骤。

翻译: Motivation: Transformer-based models are increasingly applied to large-scale single-cell transcriptomics, showing strong performance through self-supervised learning on millions of cells. However, most existing approaches treat genes as independent features, and largely ignore prior biological knowledge, which limits interpretability and robustness. In this paper, we explore whether explicitly incorporating gene regulatory information can improve both model performance and biological insight. Results: We present scTransformer, the first Transformer-based approach that builds a priori knowledge of biological mechanisms into the model's attention patterns. By constraining information flow according to known regulatory structures, the model learns representations that are more biologically meaningful. We evaluate scTransformer on a disease-relevant single-nucleus RNA-seq dataset using supervised cell-type classification. Compared to standard Transformers, our approach improves classification accuracy, enhances separation of cell types in embedding space, and produces attention patterns consistent with known regulatory programs. Overall, our results demonstrate that embedding biological structure into Transformer models can enhance interpretability without sacrificing performance, offering a principled step toward biologically grounded foundation models for single-cell omics.

Abstract

Motivation: Transformer-based models are increasingly applied to large-scale single-cell transcriptomics, showing strong performance through self-supervised learning on millions of cells. However, most existing approaches treat genes as independent features, and largely ignore prior biological knowledge, which limits interpretability and robustness. In this paper, we explore whether explicitly incorporating gene regulatory information can improve both model performance and biological insight. Results: We present scTransformer, the first Transformer-based approach that builds a priori knowledge of biological mechanisms into the model's attention patterns. By constraining information flow according to known regulatory structures, the model learns representations that are more biologically meaningful. We evaluate scTransformer on a disease-relevant single-nucleus RNA-seq dataset using supervised cell-type classification. Compared to standard Transformers, our approach improves classification accuracy, enhances separation of cell types in embedding space, and produces attention patterns consistent with known regulatory programs. Overall, our results demonstrate that embedding biological structure into Transformer models can enhance interpretability without sacrificing performance, offering a principled step toward biologically grounded foundation models for single-cell omics.

item.title: Next-Token Prediction Learns Generalisable Representations of Sleep Physiology
item.author: Jonathan F. Carter, Lionel Tarassenko
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 Hypnos 的多模态睡眠基础模型，采用下一个词元预测作为自监督学习目标，通过残差向量量化将多种生理信号转化为离散词元流，并在大规模多导睡眠图数据上进行训练。该模型在睡眠分期分类等任务中显著优于现有模型，且仅需极少量标注数据即可达到强监督基线的性能，同时具备跨模态泛化能力。

背景: 基础模型为将多模态生理信号压缩为紧凑的人类健康表示提供了有前景的途径，广泛应用于睡眠医学、心脏病学、神经学等医疗领域。现有模型通常采用掩码重建或对比学习目标，但掩码重建可能不适合生理信号的随机性，而对比方法依赖于正样本对的定义，且生理信号的语义不变性尚不明确。

目的: 探索一种简单且可扩展的替代方案，以克服现有掩码重建和对比学习方法在生理信号处理中的局限性，提升多模态生理信号表示学习的效果。

方法: 开发名为 Hypnos 的多模态睡眠基础模型，使用残差向量量化将来自超过两万份整夜多导睡眠图记录的八种不同传感模态（如脑电图、心电图、呼吸信号等）转化为离散词元流。训练一个大型自回归 RQ-Transformer 模型，并行联合预测所有模态的下一个词元。训练完成后，该模型可处理任意支持模态子集的连续传感器数据流，生成用于下游任务的嵌入表示。

主要发现: 在多项基准测试中，Hypnos 显著优于现有基础模型。在睡眠分期分类任务中，仅使用百分之一的标注数据即可在保留测试集上达到强监督基线的性能。此外，该模型能泛化至日间生理数据，在检测心房颤动方面超越了专门的心电图基础模型。

结论: 下一个词元预测是用于从多模态生理信号中进行表示学习的一种强大的自监督目标。

翻译: Foundation models offer a promising route to compress multi-modal physiological signals into compact representations of human health, with broad applications across sleep medicine, cardiology, neurology and other healthcare domains. Existing models have typically been trained with masked-reconstruction or contrastive objectives. However, masked reconstruction may be poorly suited to the stochastic nature of these signals, while contrastive approaches rely on positive-pair definitions despite the semantic invariances of physiological signals being poorly understood. In this work, we show that next-token prediction is a simple and scalable alternative. We develop Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained using eight different sensing modalities (e.g. EEG, ECG, respiratory signals) drawn from over 20,000 overnight polysomnography recordings. We tokenize each modality into streams of discrete tokens using residual vector quantization, then train a large auto-regressive RQ-Transformer to jointly predict the next token across all modalities in parallel. After training, Hypnos can be applied to continuous streams of sensor data from any subset of supported modalities, generating embeddings for downstream tasks. Across a range of benchmarks, Hypnos significantly outperforms existing foundation models. In sleep stage classification, we match the performance of strong supervised baselines on held-out test sets whilst using 100 times less labelled data. Hypnos even generalises to daytime physiology, surpassing a dedicated ECG foundation model at detecting atrial fibrillation. Our results demonstrate that next-token prediction is a strong self-supervised objective for representation learning from multi-modal physiological signals.

Abstract

Foundation models offer a promising route to compress multi-modal physiological signals into compact representations of human health, with broad applications across sleep medicine, cardiology, neurology and other healthcare domains. Existing models have typically been trained with masked-reconstruction or contrastive objectives. However, masked reconstruction may be poorly suited to the stochastic nature of these signals, while contrastive approaches rely on positive-pair definitions despite the semantic invariances of physiological signals being poorly understood. In this work, we show that next-token prediction is a simple and scalable alternative. We develop Hypnos, a multi-modal sleep foundation model trained using eight different sensing modalities (e.g. EEG, ECG, respiratory signals) drawn from over 20,000 overnight polysomnography recordings. We tokenize each modality into streams of discrete tokens using residual vector quantization, then train a large auto-regressive RQ-Transformer to jointly predict the next token across all modalities in parallel. After training, Hypnos can be applied to continuous streams of sensor data from any subset of supported modalities, generating embeddings for downstream tasks. Across a range of benchmarks, Hypnos significantly outperforms existing foundation models. In sleep stage classification, we match the performance of strong supervised baselines on held-out test sets whilst using \(100\times\) less labelled data. Hypnos even generalises to daytime physiology, surpassing a dedicated ECG foundation model at detecting atrial fibrillation. Our results demonstrate that next-token prediction is a strong self-supervised objective for representation learning from multi-modal physiological signals.

item.title: ATN3D: Density-Aware LiDAR-Radar Early 3D Object Detection Under Extreme Sparsity
item.author: Debojyoti Biswas, Xianbiao Hu
item.description:
来源: arxiv | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 3D目标检测是自动驾驶汽车和智能交通系统感知的基础。远距离检测因感知证据稀疏而具有挑战性，但在交通场景中很常见。早期多模态融合倾向于丢弃稀疏信息并注入噪声，导致远距离召回率下降。上下文无关的均匀通道监督有利于密集和近距离样本，导致远距离和小物体优化不足。提出了一种名为ATN3D的激光雷达-雷达框架，针对稀疏范围条件进行了定制。该框架引入了密度感知早期融合、占据门控邻域聚合、证据条件通道自注意力和范围感知损失。在VoD基准测试中，ATN3D在清晰和雾天条件下均优于强基线，特别是在30米以上的远距离物体检测中取得了显著提升。

背景: 3D目标检测是自动驾驶汽车和智能交通系统感知的基础。远距离检测因感知证据稀疏而具有挑战性，但在交通场景中很常见。早期多模态融合倾向于丢弃稀疏信息并注入噪声，导致远距离召回率下降。上下文无关的均匀通道监督有利于密集和近距离样本，导致远距离和小物体优化不足。

目的: 提出一种名为ATN3D的激光雷达-雷达框架，针对稀疏范围条件进行了定制，以解决远距离检测中的挑战。

方法: ATN3D引入了密度感知早期融合，通过跨模态门控根据每个体素的密度/稀疏性和雷达证据进行融合；占据门控邻域聚合，使用圆形核仅从可信单元聚合；证据条件通道自注意力，根据天气/范围调整通道权重；范围感知损失，通过距离重新平衡分类和定位，使训练与距离分层评估对齐。

主要发现: 在VoD基准测试中，ATN3D在清晰和雾天条件下均优于强基线，在清晰天气下mAP提高了3.55%，在模拟大雾下提高了8.41%；对于30米以上的物体，增益分别为3.33%（清晰）和2.09%（大雾）。

结论: 这些结果表明，在道路交通的稀疏感知条件下，ATN3D能够实现更早、更可靠的远距离检测。

翻译: 3D目标检测是自动驾驶汽车和智能交通系统感知的基础。远距离检测因感知证据稀疏而具有挑战性，但在交通场景中很常见。早期多模态融合倾向于丢弃稀疏信息并注入噪声，导致远距离召回率下降。上下文无关的均匀通道监督有利于密集和近距离样本，导致远距离和小物体优化不足。提出了一种名为ATN3D的激光雷达-雷达框架，针对稀疏范围条件进行了定制。该框架引入了密度感知早期融合、占据门控邻域聚合、证据条件通道自注意力和范围感知损失。在VoD基准测试中，ATN3D在清晰和雾天条件下均优于强基线，特别是在30米以上的远距离物体检测中取得了显著提升。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决自动驾驶在远距离和恶劣天气下，激光雷达与毫米波雷达数据极度稀疏导致的三维目标检测性能下降问题。它旨在克服早期多模态融合时噪声注入以及统一监督机制对远距离小目标优化不足的挑战。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为三十米外的目标在常规车速下仅能提供一到两秒的反应时间，早期且可靠的远距离检测直接决定了自动驾驶系统的感知安全边界与行车可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先指出在数据稀疏条件下，早期融合容易引入噪声且统一监督会偏向近处目标。为此，他们设计了前端模块通过密度感知和占用门控进行早期融合与邻域聚合以抑制噪声，并设计后端模块利用证据条件注意力动态调整通道权重，同时引入距离感知损失来平衡远近目标的优化。在现有工作方面，作者参考了多种激光雷达与毫米波雷达的融合方法及稀疏场景检测策略，但指出这些方法未能有效处理恶劣天气下的体素稀疏性与远距离目标偏差，因此在此基础上提出了该全新框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在数据稀疏条件下，通过感知点云密度与空间占用情况来实现激光雷达与雷达的早期融合，从而避免噪声注入并保留远处物体的边界信息。整体实现流程首先根据局部密度和雷达证据进行跨模态门控融合；接着仅从可信的占用区域聚合上下文特征以防止噪声扩散；随后根据天气和距离动态调整特征通道权重以抑制背景干扰；最后通过按距离重新平衡分类与定位损失的训练策略，提升远距离目标的检测性能。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种专为远距离或恶劣天气下极端稀疏场景设计的激光雷达与毫米波雷达早期融合检测框架。相比以往忽略体素稀疏性且容易引入背景噪声的早期融合方法，以及偏向密集近处目标的均匀监督策略，该框架引入了密度感知融合、占用门控邻域聚合、证据条件通道自注意力以及距离感知损失计算四个核心模块。这些设计使得模型仅在可信区域聚合信息，自适应调整通道权重，并按距离重新平衡分类与定位损失，从而有效抑制噪声传播并显著提升远距离目标的早期检测性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种面向极度稀疏场景的激光雷达与毫米波雷达融合框架，通过密度感知早期融合、占据门控邻域聚合、证据自适应通道加权及距离感知损失，有效抑制了噪声传播并优化了远距离目标检测，显著提升了恶劣天气与长距离条件下的三维目标检测性能。

Abstract

3D object detection is the backbone of perception for automated vehicles (AV) and broader intelligent transportation systems applications. Long-range detection is challenging because sensing evidence is sparse; yet this ``long-range'' scenario is routine in traffic. Although >30m is often labeled long-range in computer vision, on roadways it affords only approx. 1-2s for perception and decision-making. Under such extreme sparsity, two core challenges arise. First, early multimodal fusion tends to discard sparsity information and inject noise from empty or falsely occupied cells, degrading long-range recall. Second, context-agnostic uniform channel supervision favors dense and near-range samples, leaving far and small objects under-optimized, delaying the earliest detection of distant objects. We propose ``Ask The Neighbor'' (ATN3D), a LiDAR-Radar framework tailored for sparse-range conditions. ATN3D introduces (i) Density-aware early fusion with cross-modal gating that conditions fusion on per-voxel density/sparsity and Radar evidence, (ii) Occupancy-gated neighborhood aggregation with circular kernels to aggregate only from credible cells, (iii) Evidence-conditioned channel self-attention to adapt channel weights with weather/range, and (iv) a Range-aware loss that re-balances classification and localization by distance, aligning training with distance-stratified evaluation. On the VoD benchmark across clear and foggy conditions, ATN3D surpasses strong baselines: +3.55% mAP in clear weather and +8.41% mAP under simulated heavy fog; for >30m objects, gains are +3.33% (clear) and +2.09% (heavy fog). These results indicate earlier and more reliable long-range detections under sparse sensing in on-road traffic.

item.title: MAVIS: Multi-Agent Video Retrieval via Structured Video Understanding
item.author: Jie Zhang, Qilang Ye, Hao Zhou, Haochen Liang, Fei Luo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: MAVIS是一个多智能体视频检索框架，通过结构化语义库和逻辑辩论机制，将检索视为协作推理而非暴力搜索，实现了高效且可解释的检索性能。

背景: 当前视频检索主要依赖基于嵌入的全语料库扫描方法，存在计算效率低下以及信息密集的视频与稀疏文本查询之间的语义不对称问题。

目的: 弥合视频与文本之间的粒度不匹配，并解决全语料库扫描的计算效率问题，提供一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

方法: 首先将原始视频解析为结构化语义库以实现属性级索引；在检索时，规划器将复杂用户意图分解为原子子任务，分派专门智能体独立提名候选项；采用逻辑辩论机制和严格否决协议，由智能体协作剔除逻辑不匹配的候选项，筛选出少量争议候选项进行细粒度验证。

主要发现: 在MSR-VTT、MSVD和ActivityNet数据集上的广泛实验表明，MAVIS在不进行特定任务微调的情况下实现了具有竞争力的性能。

结论: MAVIS通过智能体工作流有效规避了全库遍历的低效性，为传统双编码器方法提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

翻译: 当前视频检索的主导范式依赖于基于嵌入的全语料库扫描，这种方法存在固有的计算低效性以及信息密集的视频与稀疏文本查询之间的语义不对称问题。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了MAVIS，这是一种新颖的多智能体框架，将检索重新构想为协作推理而非暴力搜索。MAVIS首先通过将原始视频解析为结构化语义库来弥合粒度不匹配，从而实现显式的属性级索引。在检索过程中，规划器将复杂的用户意图分解为原子子任务，分派专门的智能体独立提名候选项。关键的是，MAVIS采用了一种带有严格否决协议的意识辩论机制，智能体协作剔除逻辑不匹配的项，以识别出一组紧凑的“争议”候选项进行细粒度验证。这种智能体工作流有效地规避了全库遍历的低效性。在MSR-VTT、MSVD和ActivityNet上的大量实验表明，MAVIS在不进行特定任务微调的情况下实现了具有竞争力的性能，为传统的双编码器方法提供了一种可扩展且可解释的替代方案。

Abstract

The dominant paradigm in video retrieval relies on embedding-based full-corpus scanning, which suffers from inherent computational inefficiency and the semantic asymmetry between information-dense videos and sparse textual queries. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{MAVIS}, a novel multi-agent framework that rethinks retrieval as cooperative reasoning rather than brute-force search. MAVIS first bridges the granularity mismatch by parsing raw videos into a \textbf{Structured Semantic Library}, enabling explicit attribute-level indexing. During retrieval, a planner decomposes complex user intents into atomic sub-tasks, dispatching specialized agents to independently nominate candidates. Crucially, MAVIS employs a \textbf{Logic-aware Debate} mechanism with a strict veto protocol, where agents collaboratively prune logical mismatches to identify a compact set of ``controversial'' candidates for fine-grained verification. This agentic workflow effectively bypasses the inefficiency of full-library traversal. Extensive experiments on MSR-VTT, MSVD, and ActivityNet demonstrate that MAVIS achieves competitive performance without task-specific fine-tuning, offering a scalable and interpretable alternative to traditional dual-encoder approaches.

item.title: FMplex: Model Virtualization for Serving Extensible Foundation Models
item.author: Hetvi Shastri, Pragya Sharma, Walid A. Hanafy, David Irwin, Mani Srivastava, Prashant Shenoy
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为FMplex的服务系统，该系统将基础模型作为虚拟化底层设施以实现部署共享，通过为每个任务提供虚拟基础模型实例，在保持任务隔离性的同时共享重型基础模型骨干，并结合公平队列调度器优化批处理，显著降低了延迟并提升了任务承载量。

背景: 基础模型正被广泛用作语言、视觉、时间序列和多模态应用等下游任务的骨干网络。然而，现有的模型服务系统将每个定制任务作为独立模型实例部署，导致重型骨干网络被重复复制，浪费加速器内存，并错失了分摊批处理和加载成本的机会。

目的: 旨在解决现有模型服务系统中因独立部署导致的资源浪费和成本高昂问题，实现基础模型骨干网络的共享部署，同时保持任务的独立性和隔离性。

方法: 提出FMplex系统，将基础模型骨干作为虚拟化底层设施。该系统为每个任务呈现一个虚拟基础模型，该虚拟实例在逻辑上私有但由共享的物理基础模型支持。此外，提出了一种感知批处理的公平队列调度器，结合任务级共享权重以及任务间和任务内的批处理。实现了涵盖任务构建、感知共享的部署和运行时执行的完整服务栈。

主要发现: 在七个基础模型骨干网络（共十六种变体）和九十二个下游任务的实验中，与空间分区相比，FMplex将延迟降低了高达百分之八十，与尽力而为的共存部署相比降低了百分之三十三点三，同时在集群规模下可托管多达六倍的任务数量。

结论: FMplex通过虚拟化抽象和共享机制，有效解决了基础模型服务中的资源冗余问题，显著提升了服务效率和系统扩展能力。

翻译: Foundation models are increasingly used as backbones for downstream tasks across language, vision, time-series, and multimodal applications. Yet existing model-serving systems deploy each customized task as an independent model instance, thereby replicating heavyweight backbones, wasting accelerator memory, and losing opportunities to amortize batching and loading costs. This paper presents FMplex, a serving system that treats FM backbones as a virtualization substrate for deployment sharing. FMplex presents each task with a virtual foundation model, a logically private FM instance backed by a shared physical FM. This abstraction lets independently customized tasks share a backbone while preserving task-specific extensions, independent lifecycles, and task-level isolation. In addition, we propose a batch-aware fair-queueing scheduler that combines weighted task-level sharing with inter- and intra-task batching across colocated tasks. We implement a FMplex-based serving stack spanning task construction, sharing-aware deployment, and runtime execution. Across 7 FM backbones and 92 downstream tasks, FMplex reduces latency by up to 80% over spatial partitioning and 33.3% over best-effort co-location, while hosting up to 6x more tasks at cluster scale.

Abstract

Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly used as backbones for downstream tasks across language, vision, time-series, and multimodal applications. Yet existing model-serving systems deploy each customized task as an independent model instance, thereby replicating heavyweight backbones, wasting accelerator memory, and losing opportunities to amortize batching and loading costs. This paper presents FMplex, a serving system that treats FM backbones as a virtualization substrate for deployment sharing. FMplex presents each task with a virtual foundation model (vFM), a logically private FM instance backed by a shared physical FM. This abstraction lets independently customized tasks share a backbone while preserving task-specific extensions, independent lifecycles, and task-level isolation. In addition, we propose a batch-aware fair-queueing scheduler that combines weighted task-level sharing with inter- and intra-task batching across colocated tasks. We implement a FMplex-based serving stack spanning task construction, sharing-aware deployment, and runtime execution. Across 7 FM backbones (16 variants) and 92 downstream tasks, FMplex reduces latency by up to 80% over spatial partitioning and 33.3% over best-effort co-location, while hosting up to 6x more tasks at cluster scale.

item.title: Do Video Foundation Models Understand Intuitive Physics? A Layerwise Probing Analysis
item.author: Samuele Punzo, Niccolò Caselli, Ippokratis Pantelidis, Francesco Massafra, Salvatore Lo Sardo, Mohammadreza Salehi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究探讨了预训练视频基础模型在冻结表示中是否编码了直觉物理信息，以及该信息在不同模型族、层和探针类型间的差异。通过冻结特征探针技术，比较了预测联合嵌入模型、掩码重建模型和基于扩散的视频生成器在直觉物理基准上的表现。研究发现直觉物理知识在预训练视频表示中可靠出现，但其可访问性强烈依赖于预训练范式、表示深度和读取机制。

背景: 预训练视频基础模型在冻结表示中是否编码直觉物理信息尚不明确，且该信息在不同模型族、层和探针类型间的变化规律有待研究。

目的: 研究预训练视频基础模型的冻结表示中是否编码直觉物理信息，并分析该信息在不同模型族、层和探针类型间的差异。

方法: 使用冻结特征探针技术，在直觉物理数据集和最小视频对数据集上，比较预测联合嵌入模型、掩码重建模型和基于扩散的视频生成器的性能。

主要发现: 预测联合嵌入模型在基准测试中整体表现最强，尤其在建模时间动态的探针中；掩码重建模型保持竞争力；基于扩散的视频生成器恢复的信号较弱但非平凡。逐层分析显示，物理相关信息在早期层最弱，在中间到后期层最易获取。时间控制实验表明，打乱帧顺序会显著降低性能，尤其是在最小视频对任务中。

结论: 直觉物理知识在预训练视频表示中可靠出现，但其可访问性强烈依赖于预训练范式、表示深度和读取机制。

翻译: We study whether pretrained video foundation models encode intuitive-physics information in their frozen representations, and how this information varies across model families, layers, and probe types. Using frozen-feature probing on IntPhys2 and Minimal Video Pairs (MVP), we compare predictive joint-embedding models (V-JEPA), masked reconstruction models (VideoMAE), and a diffusion-based video generator (LTX-Video). V-JEPA achieves the strongest overall results across benchmarks, especially with probes that model temporal dynamics, while VideoMAE remains competitive and LTX-Video recovers weaker but non-trivial signal. Layerwise analyses show that physics-relevant information is weakest in early layers and becomes most accessible at intermediate-to-late depth, and temporal controls show that disrupting frame order substantially reduces performance, especially on MVP. Together, these results suggest that intuitive-physics knowledge emerges reliably in pretrained video representations, but its accessibility depends strongly on pretraining paradigm, representational depth, and readout mechanism.

Abstract

We study whether pretrained video foundation models encode intuitive-physics information in their frozen representations, and how this information varies across model families, layers, and probe types. Using frozen-feature probing on IntPhys2 and Minimal Video Pairs (MVP), we compare predictive joint-embedding models (V-JEPA), masked reconstruction models (VideoMAE), and a diffusion-based video generator (LTX-Video). V-JEPA achieves the strongest overall results across benchmarks, especially with probes that model temporal dynamics, while VideoMAE remains competitive and LTX-Video recovers weaker but non-trivial signal. Layerwise analyses show that physics-relevant information is weakest in early layers and becomes most accessible at intermediate-to-late depth, and temporal controls show that disrupting frame order substantially reduces performance, especially on MVP. Together, these results suggest that intuitive-physics knowledge emerges reliably in pretrained video representations, but its accessibility depends strongly on pretraining paradigm, representational depth, and readout mechanism.

item.title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
item.author: Li, Ang, McLeish, Sean, Chen, Haozhe, Kalra, Nimit, Chen, Zaiqian, Gazizov, Artem, Morisetty, Venkata Anoop Suhas Kumar, Kailkhura, Bhavya, Menon, Harshitha, Liu, Zhuang, Bartoldson, Brian R., Goldstein, Tom, Lotfi, Sanae, Goldblum, Micah, Izmailov, Pavel
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为潜在上下文语言模型的压缩器家族，通过架构搜索和持续预训练，在通用任务性能、压缩速度和峰值内存使用方面优化了帕累托前沿，并展示了其在长视界智能体中的高效应用。

背景: 长上下文语言模型推理受限于内存，因为键值缓存随上下文长度增长。现有的键值缓存压缩技术要么严重降低模型质量，要么需要大量时间和计算资源来压缩单个长提示。许多方法还要求输入适应目标模型的上下文窗口，且通常与现代生产推理引擎不兼容。

目的: 重新审视编码器-解码器压缩方法，以弥补其在准确性与效率前沿方面与键值缓存压缩技术相比的不足。

方法: 首先进行架构搜索，从头预训练多种变体以确定最佳设计和训练编码器-解码器压缩器的方式。基于发现，在超过三千五百亿个令牌上持续预训练一个由零点六B编码器组成的模型家族，解码器为四十亿参数，压缩比为一比四、一比八和一比十六。

主要发现: 潜在上下文语言模型在通用任务性能、压缩速度和峰值内存使用方面改善了帕累托前沿。

结论: 潜在上下文语言模型可作为长视界智能体的高效骨干网络，使智能体能够扫描压缩的长上下文并根据需要自适应扩展相关片段。

翻译: Long-context language model inference is bottlenecked by memory, as the KV cache grows with context length. Recent techniques to compress the KV cache fall short: they either degrade model quality substantially or require considerable time and compute to compress a single long prompt. Furthermore, many methods require the input to fit within the target model's context window, and are generally incompatible with modern production inference engines. Encoder-decoder compressors, which map a long token sequence to a shorter sequence of latent embeddings consumed by a decoder, are an appealing alternative in principle. However, existing approaches are not competitive with KV cache compression on the accuracy-efficiency frontier. In this work, we revisit encoder-decoder compression and close this gap. We first perform an architecture search, pre-training many variants from scratch to determine how best to design and train encoder-decoder compressors. Guided by our findings, we continually pre-train a family of 0.6B-encoder, 4B-decoder models on over 350B tokens each, at compression ratios of 1:4, 1:8, and 1:16. We introduce Latent Context Language Models (LCLMs), a family of compressors that improve the Pareto frontier across general-task performance, compression speed, and peak memory usage. We demonstrate that LCLMs serve as efficient backbones for long-horizon agents, letting the agent skim through a compressed long context and adaptively expand relevant segments on demand.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决长上下文语言模型推理过程中因键值缓存无限增长而导致的内存瓶颈与推理延迟问题。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为大语言模型需处理超长文档、多轮对话及复杂智能体任务，但现有压缩方法往往严重损害模型质量、计算成本过高或与主流推理引擎不兼容。实现高效且高质量的上下文压缩，是突破长上下文部署限制、提升实际系统性能的关键。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有上下文压缩方法在质量、速度或兼容性上的不足，提出以编码器解码器架构为核心的软令牌压缩方案。设计时，他们通过大规模架构搜索确定最优结构，并借鉴视觉语言模型的训练思路，采用分阶段训练策略以保证模型稳定性并防止能力退化。该方法确实借鉴了先前的软令牌压缩与键值缓存压缩技术，但通过大规模通用数据预训练和辅助重建任务，克服了以往方法依赖特定领域或损害模型能力的缺陷。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用编码器将长文本压缩为极短的连续向量序列，再由解码器语言模型读取这些压缩向量作为上下文，从而在大幅降低内存占用和推理延迟的同时保留模型原有的长文本处理能力。整体实现流程分为架构设计与多阶段训练：首先将输入文本按固定窗口切分，由编码器生成压缩后的隐式标记，经维度适配后输入解码器；训练时采用分步策略，先单独训练适配器和编码器，再联合训练整个模型进行持续预训练，最后通过监督微调与辅助重建任务强化指令遵循与细节保留能力。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种端到端大规模训练的编码器与解码器结合的上下文压缩模型。相比以往方法，它通过精细的多阶段训练配方和大规模架构搜索，在海量数据上联合训练，实现了高压缩比下的高精度与低延迟。与传统的键值缓存压缩或软标记压缩不同，该方法无需预先填充完整上下文，不依赖特定领域数据，且完全兼容现代推理引擎，在内存占用、生成速度和模型性能之间取得了更优的平衡。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出并大规模训练了端到端的上下文压缩模型，通过创新的架构设计与多阶段训练方法，在保持语言模型原有能力的前提下显著提升了压缩速度并降低了内存占用，从而在任务性能、推理速度与内存消耗之间实现了新的最优平衡。

Abstract

Long-context language model inference is bottlenecked by memory, as the KV cache grows with context length. Recent techniques to compress the KV cache fall short: they either degrade model quality substantially or require considerable time and compute to compress a single long prompt. Furthermore, many methods require the input to fit within the target model's context window, and are generally incompatible with modern production inference engines. Encoder-decoder compressors, which map a long token sequence to a shorter sequence of latent embeddings consumed by a decoder, are an appealing alternative in principle. However, existing approaches are not competitive with KV cache compression on the accuracy-efficiency frontier. In this work, we revisit encoder-decoder compression and close this gap. We first perform an architecture search, pre-training many variants from scratch to determine how best to design and train encoder-decoder compressors. Guided by our findings, we continually pre-train a family of 0.6B-encoder, 4B-decoder models on over 350B tokens each, at compression ratios of 1:4, 1:8, and 1:16. We introduce Latent Context Language Models (LCLMs), a family of compressors that improve the Pareto frontier across general-task performance, compression speed, and peak memory usage. We demonstrate that LCLMs serve as efficient backbones for long-horizon agents, letting the agent skim through a compressed long context and adaptively expand relevant segments on demand.

item.title: In-Context Learning for Latent Space Bayesian Optimization
item.author: Tuan A. Vu, Harri Lähdesmäki, Julien Martinelli
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对表格基础模型代理的继续预训练方法，通过结合分子变分自编码器的潜在空间优化任务，解决了潜在空间贝叶斯优化中的分布不匹配问题，并在分子优化基准测试中取得了优异性能。

背景: 贝叶斯优化是样本高效设计的关键工具，潜在空间贝叶斯优化将其扩展至分子和蛋白质等结构化对象。同时，表格基础模型如TabPFN和TabICL在回归性能上达到最先进水平，并越来越多地被用作贝叶斯优化的代理模型。

目的: 解决表格基础模型代理在潜在空间贝叶斯优化应用中，其预训练分布与潜在代码到目标值映射之间的不匹配问题。

方法: 通过结合基于分子变分自编码器潜在空间定义的合成优化任务，对表格基础模型代理的预训练阶段进行补充。该方法采用了一个正则化器，将模型锚定到原始检查点，以保留其广泛的回归先验并避免对适应任务的过度专门化。

主要发现: 在保留的分子优化基准测试中，该模型实现了强大的性能，证明了针对潜在空间贝叶斯优化的特定适应对于上下文代理的相关性。

结论: 通过结合潜在空间优化任务进行继续预训练，可以有效解决表格基础模型在潜在空间贝叶斯优化中的分布不匹配问题，提升其作为代理模型的性能。

翻译: Bayesian optimization is a central tool for sample-efficient design, and latent-space Bayesian optimization extends it to structured objects such as molecules and proteins. In parallel, tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL now achieve state-of-the-art regression performance and are increasingly used as BO surrogates. Because their Bayesian behavior is induced by large synthetic pretraining collections, the composition of this pretraining distribution is crucial. LSBO creates a distinctive mismatch: the induced map from latent code to objective value differs markedly from the regression tasks used to train current in-context models. We address this mismatch by complementing the pretraining stage of tabular foundation model surrogates with synthetic optimization tasks defined on the latent space of a molecular VAE. The continued-pretraining objective features a regularizer that anchors the model to the original checkpoint, preserving its broad regression prior while avoiding overspecialization to the adaptation tasks. On held-out molecular optimization benchmarks, the resulting model achieves strong performance, supporting the relevance of LSBO-specific adaptation for in-context surrogates.

Abstract

Bayesian optimization (BO) is a central tool for sample-efficient design, and latent-space Bayesian optimization (LSBO) extends it to structured objects such as molecules and proteins. In parallel, tabular foundation models such as TabPFN and TabICL now achieve state-of-the-art regression performance and are increasingly used as BO surrogates. Because their Bayesian behavior is induced by large synthetic pretraining collections, the composition of this pretraining distribution is crucial. LSBO creates a distinctive mismatch: the induced map from latent code to objective value differs markedly from the regression tasks used to train current in-context models. We address this mismatch by complementing the pretraining stage of tabular foundation model surrogates with synthetic optimization tasks defined on the latent space of a molecular VAE. The continued-pretraining objective features a regularizer that anchors the model to the original checkpoint, preserving its broad regression prior while avoiding overspecialization to the adaptation tasks. On held-out molecular optimization benchmarks, the resulting model achieves strong performance, supporting the relevance of LSBO-specific adaptation for in-context surrogates.

item.title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks
item.author: Hongcheng Gao, Hailong Qu, Jingyi Tang, Jiahao Wang, Zihao Huang, Hengkang Qiao, Shihong Huang, Junming Yang, Yi Li, Hongyixuan Yuan, Wenjie Li, Bohan Zeng, Wenbo Li, Bo Wang, Jianhui Liu, Olive Huang, Haoyang Huang, Wentao Zhang, Guoqing Huang, Nan Duan, Yinpeng Dong
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出SpatialWorld基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在复杂真实任务中的交互式空间理解能力。

背景: 空间推理是多模态大语言模型感知和操作物理世界的基础能力。现有基准主要依赖被动评估或特定模拟器流程，无法评估通用交互式空间理解。

目的: 引入SpatialWorld，一个专为评估多模态智能体在复杂真实任务中交互式空间理解能力而设计的统一基准。

方法: 在共享的模拟器无关协议下整合八个异构模拟器后端，包含760个人类标注的任务。智能体需在仅视觉的部分可观测性下，主动收集第一人称视觉证据，并通过统一的文本动作接口表达决策。每个任务包含人类验证的初始状态、参考轨迹和终端状态验证器。

主要发现: 评估15个先进智能体发现，稳健的空间任务解决仍然具有挑战性。最强模型GPT-5的平均任务成功率仅为17.4%，领先开源模型Qwen-3.5为14.1%。分析揭示了任务成功与执行效率之间的明显不匹配，以及显著的领域特定性能差异。

结论: 主动探索和长期规划中的瓶颈使SpatialWorld成为未来空间智能体的严格测试平台。

翻译: Spatial reasoning is a foundational capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perceive and operate within the physical world. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on passive evaluation (e.g., static VQA) or simulator-specific pipelines, failing to assess general interactive spatial understanding. We introduce SpatialWorld, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks. Integrating eight heterogeneous simulation backends under a shared, simulator-agnostic protocol, SpatialWorld features 760 human-annotated tasks across diverse domains (e.g., household routines, travel, social collaboration). Agents must solve tasks under vision-only partial observability, actively gathering egocentric visual evidence and expressing decisions via a unified, text-based action interface native to MLLMs. For reliable evaluation, each task includes a human-validated initial state, a reference trajectory, and a terminal-state verifier. Evaluating 15 advanced agents reveals that robust spatial task solving remains challenging: the strongest model, GPT-5, achieves an average task success rate (TSR) of only 17.4%, while the leading open-source model, Qwen-3.5, reaches 14.1%. Further analysis exposes a clear mismatch between task success and execution efficiency, alongside substantial domain-specific performance variations. These bottlenecks in active exploration and long-horizon planning position SpatialWorld as a rigorous testbed for future spatial agents.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有评测方法无法有效检验多模态智能体在动态且信息不全的真实环境中进行主动探索与空间推理能力的问题。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为现实物理空间具有部分可观测性，智能体必须依靠视觉主动收集信息、更新空间认知并规划长期行动才能完成任务。建立统一的评测标准能够准确区分模型是否具备脱离特定模拟器依赖、真正适应复杂现实任务的通用交互能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有基准多依赖静态问答或特定模拟器、难以评估通用交互空间理解能力的问题，确立了纯视觉输入、跨平台统一接口、语言化动作输出和执行结果验证四大设计原则。通过模块化架构，他们将复杂环境抽象为标准化的观察与动作接口，使模型仅凭第一人称视觉和文本指令进行闭环交互。该方法明确借鉴并对比了多项现有图像问答、视频问答及具身智能基准，旨在克服其缺乏动态交互或受限于特定模拟器动作空间的不足。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是构建一个统一且与具体三维环境无关的评估框架，以测试智能体在仅凭第一人称视觉信息下的主动探索与动态空间推理能力。整体实现流程采用闭环架构，将多种异构环境封装为标准化的观察与动作接口；智能体接收自然语言任务指令和实时画面后生成高层文本决策，接口将其转换为对应环境的执行代码，环境执行后返回新画面，循环直至任务结束并通过终端状态验证是否成功。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了一个统一的交互式空间推理基准测试框架，专门用于评估多模态智能体在复杂真实任务中的能力。与以往依赖静态图像问答或特定模拟器绑定的被动评估方式不同，该框架要求智能体仅凭第一人称视觉信息进行主动探索，并通过统一的跨平台接口兼容多种异构仿真环境。这种设计剥离了底层模拟器的技术干扰，能够更客观地检验智能体在真实交互场景中的主动探索、长程规划及空间推理能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了SpatialWorld评测基准，通过统一不同仿真平台的交互标准并仅依赖第一视角画面，全面检验了多模态智能体在真实世界任务中主动探索与空间推理的实际能力。

Abstract

Spatial reasoning is a foundational capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perceive and operate within the physical world. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on passive evaluation (e.g., static VQA) or simulator-specific pipelines, failing to assess general interactive spatial understanding. We introduce SpatialWorld, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks. Integrating eight heterogeneous simulation backends under a shared, simulator-agnostic protocol, SpatialWorld features 760 human-annotated tasks across diverse domains (e.g., household routines, travel, social collaboration). Agents must solve tasks under vision-only partial observability, actively gathering egocentric visual evidence and expressing decisions via a unified, text-based action interface native to MLLMs. For reliable evaluation, each task includes a human-validated initial state, a reference trajectory, and a terminal-state verifier. Evaluating 15 advanced agents reveals that robust spatial task solving remains challenging: the strongest model, GPT-5, achieves an average task success rate (TSR) of only 17.4%, while the leading open-source model, Qwen-3.5, reaches 14.1%. Further analysis exposes a clear mismatch between task success and execution efficiency, alongside substantial domain-specific performance variations. These bottlenecks in active exploration and long-horizon planning position SpatialWorld as a rigorous testbed for future spatial agents.

item.title: Transition-Based Digital Twin Modelling for Alzheimer's Disease under Sparse Longitudinal Data
item.author: Yinyu Huang, Yilin Zhang, Sofia Michopoulou, Christopher Kipps, Rahman Attar
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于多模态纵向数据的个性化数字孪生框架，用于阿尔茨海默病的预测和情景分析。该框架整合了互补的建模策略，以捕捉临床转换和时间依赖性，并预测认知状态和诊断类别，同时量化预测不确定性。在阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议数据上的评估表明，基于相邻就诊的转换建模比基于序列的分支具有更高的预测准确性，表明局部转换建模在数据效率方面更具优势。

背景: 阿尔茨海默病的进展具有高度异质性，通常通过稀疏且不规则的纵向数据观察到，这对预测和个性化监测提出了挑战。现有的机器学习方法虽然利用多模态数据改进了阿尔茨海默病的预测，但往往侧重于静态分类或群体层面的风险估计，对个体特异性建模和不确定性推理的支持有限。

目的: 为了解决现有方法的局限性，提出一种基于多模态纵向数据的个性化数字孪生框架，用于阿尔茨海默病的预测和基于情景的分析。

方法: 该框架整合了互补的建模策略，以捕捉临床转换和就诊间的时间依赖性。使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像倡议数据，包括认知评估、临床变量和磁共振成像衍生的表型，预测认知状态和诊断类别，量化预测不确定性，并实现患者特定的假设轨迹分析。

主要发现: 在无需数据泄露的个体级别划分上，该框架在分数预测和诊断分类方面表现出强大的性能。在稀疏且不规则的数据设置中，基于相邻就诊的转换建模比基于序列的分支实现了更高的预测准确性，表明局部转换建模可能更具数据效率。虽然序列模型在不确定性感知轨迹预测方面仍然有价值，但局部转换建模提供了更数据高效且稳健的预测策略。

结论: 这些发现强调了将时间建模策略与临床数据结构对齐的重要性，并表明基于转换的数字孪生 formulations 可能为神经退行性疾病的个性化疾病预测提供一种实用且可解释的方法。

翻译: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression is highly heterogeneous and is typically observed through sparse and irregular longitudinal data, posing challenges for prediction and personalised monitoring. Existing machine learning approaches have improved AD prediction using multimodal data, yet often focus on static classification or cohort-level risk estimation, providing limited support for subject-specific modelling and uncertainty-aware reasoning. To address these limitations, we present a personalised digital twin framework for AD prediction and scenario-based analysis using multimodal longitudinal data. The proposed approach integrates complementary modelling strategies to capture clinical transitions and temporal dependencies across visits. Using data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), including cognitive assessments, clinical variables, and MRI-derived phenotypes, the framework predicts cognitive status and diagnostic categories while quantifying predictive uncertainty and enabling patient-specific what-if trajectory analysis. Evaluation on leak-free subject-level splits demonstrates strong performance in score forecasting and diagnosis classification. In this sparse and irregular ADNI setting, transition-based modelling of adjacent visits achieved higher predictive accuracy than the sequence-based branch, suggesting that local transition modelling may be more data-efficient. While sequence models remain valuable for uncertainty-aware trajectory forecasting, local transition modelling offers a more data-efficient and robust predictive strategy. These findings highlight the importance of aligning temporal modelling strategies with clinical data structure and suggest that transition-based digital twin formulations may provide a practical and interpretable approach for personalised disease forecasting in neurodegenerative disorders.

Abstract

Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression is highly heterogeneous and is typically observed through sparse and irregular longitudinal data, posing challenges for prediction and personalised monitoring. Existing machine learning approaches have improved AD prediction using multimodal data, yet often focus on static classification or cohort-level risk estimation, providing limited support for subject-specific modelling and uncertainty-aware reasoning. To address these limitations, we present a personalised digital twin framework for AD prediction and scenario-based analysis using multimodal longitudinal data. The proposed approach integrates complementary modelling strategies to capture clinical transitions and temporal dependencies across visits. Using data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), including cognitive assessments, clinical variables, and MRI-derived phenotypes, the framework predicts cognitive status and diagnostic categories while quantifying predictive uncertainty and enabling patient-specific what-if trajectory analysis. Evaluation on leak-free subject-level splits demonstrates strong performance in score forecasting and diagnosis classification. In this sparse and irregular ADNI setting, transition-based modelling of adjacent visits achieved higher predictive accuracy than the sequence-based branch, suggesting that local transition modelling may be more data-efficient. While sequence models remain valuable for uncertainty-aware trajectory forecasting, local transition modelling offers a more data-efficient and robust predictive strategy. These findings highlight the importance of aligning temporal modelling strategies with clinical data structure and suggest that transition-based digital twin formulations may provide a practical and interpretable approach for personalised disease forecasting in neurodegenerative disorders.

item.title: Correlation Is Not Enough: Embedding Human Metadata for Individual Causal Discovery
item.author: Suraj Biswas, Saurabh Gupta, Pritam Mukherjee
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文指出预训练生物医学语言模型在跨领域判别中存在严重缺陷，即错误地将无关概念视为高度相关，导致下游行为模型产生虚假因果推断。为解决此问题，作者提出了一种对比学习方法，通过两轮训练显著提升了模型的领域分离能力和判别准确性，并优化了推理速度。

背景: 预训练生物医学语言模型（如BioBERT、PubMedBERT等）在评估无关跨领域概念对时，会给出极高的余弦相似度分数，而正确答案应接近零。这种跨领域判别准确率为零的问题在现有模型中普遍存在。虽然检索系统能通过下游过滤噪声来缓解此问题，但大型行为模型（LBM）直接依赖嵌入相似度作为因果证据，导致虚假的因果边生成并传播错误。

目的: 修复预训练生物医学语言模型在嵌入几何结构上的缺陷，提高其跨领域判别能力和准确性，确保嵌入相似度能正确反映概念间的真实关系，而非虚假关联。

方法: 采用对比学习策略对模型进行训练。第一轮在72,034对数据上进行对比训练，提升模型性能。第二轮使用BODHI方法，从生物医学知识图中缺失的边中挖掘困难负样本，进一步优化领域分离和判别差距。同时，使用OpenVINO工具在Intel Xeon 6737P处理器上进行推理加速优化。

主要发现: 1. 第一轮对比训练将PubMedBERT的BIOSSES相关性从0.633提升至0.828，领域分离度从1.05倍提升至1.63倍。2. 第二轮BODHI训练将分离度提升至2.30倍，判别差距增加0.392，BIOSSES性能仅下降4.5%。3. 使用OpenVINO优化后，单查询延迟从1367毫秒降至10毫秒，推理速度达到每秒555个句子。4. FP16精度在该硬件上优于INT8精度。5. 无AMX指令集的Ice Lake实例运行速度慢13至27倍。

结论: 嵌入几何结构对模型正确性至关重要，不能仅作为调优参数。通过对比学习和困难负样本挖掘可以有效解决跨领域判别错误问题。同时，硬件加速和精度选择对推理性能有显著影响。作者公开了基准测试套件、训练语料库、BODHI生成器及OpenVINO脚本。

翻译: Ask a pretrained biomedical language model whether 'cortisol 28 ug/dL' and 'stock-market volatility' are related, and it returns a cosine similarity of 0.83 on a scale where 1.0 means identical. The two share no mechanism. This is not a corner case: every off-the-shelf biomedical encoder we tested (BioBERT, PubMedBERT, BioM-ELECTRA) scores unrelated cross-domain pairs between 0.76 and 0.92 when the answer should be near zero. Accuracy on cross-domain discrimination is 0%. Retrieval systems survive this, because a language model downstream filters the noise. A Large Behavioural Model (LBM), a foundation model whose subject is a person rather than a sentence, does not: it reasons over a graph of a user's life and treats embedding proximity as evidence that two events are causally linked. False proximity writes a false causal edge, and everything downstream inherits the error. Here, embedding geometry is not a tuning knob; it is correctness. We report the fix. A contrastive pass over 72,034 pairs raises PubMedBERT BIOSSES correlation from 0.633 to 0.828 and within-vs-across-domain separation from 1.05x to 1.63x. A second pass, BODHI, mines hard negatives from edges absent in a biomedical knowledge graph and lifts separation to 2.30x and the discrimination gap to +0.392, at a 4.5% BIOSSES cost. On an Intel Xeon 6737P with AMX, OpenVINO cuts single-query latency from 1367 ms to 10 ms (133x) and reaches 555 sentences/sec. One finding contradicts standard advice: FP16 beats INT8 on this silicon at every serving batch size, and we explain why. The same model on a no-AMX Ice Lake instance runs 13-27x slower. We release the benchmark suite, training corpora, the BODHI generator, and the OpenVINO scripts.

Abstract

Ask a pretrained biomedical language model whether "cortisol 28 ug/dL" and "stock-market volatility" are related, and it returns a cosine similarity of 0.83 on a scale where 1.0 means identical. The two share no mechanism. This is not a corner case: every off-the-shelf biomedical encoder we tested (BioBERT, PubMedBERT, BioM-ELECTRA) scores unrelated cross-domain pairs between 0.76 and 0.92 when the answer should be near zero. Accuracy on cross-domain discrimination is 0%. Retrieval systems survive this, because a language model downstream filters the noise. A Large Behavioural Model (LBM), a foundation model whose subject is a person rather than a sentence, does not: it reasons over a graph of a user's life and treats embedding proximity as evidence that two events are causally linked. False proximity writes a false causal edge, and everything downstream inherits the error. Here, embedding geometry is not a tuning knob; it is correctness. We report the fix. A contrastive pass over 72,034 pairs raises PubMedBERT BIOSSES correlation from 0.633 to 0.828 and within-vs-across-domain separation from 1.05x to 1.63x. A second pass, BODHI, mines hard negatives from edges absent in a biomedical knowledge graph and lifts separation to 2.30x and the discrimination gap to +0.392, at a 4.5% BIOSSES cost. On an Intel Xeon 6737P with AMX, OpenVINO cuts single-query latency from 1367 ms to 10 ms (133x) and reaches 555 sentences/sec. One finding contradicts standard advice: FP16 beats INT8 on this silicon at every serving batch size, and we explain why. The same model on a no-AMX Ice Lake instance runs 13-27x slower. We release the benchmark suite, training corpora, the BODHI generator, and the OpenVINO scripts.

item.title: What Makes Synthetic Speech Sound Sarcastic? A Prosody-Controlled Perception Study
item.author: Zhu Li, Shekhar Nayak, Matt Coler
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究利用可控的神经文本转语音技术，通过控制语音速率、音高变化和响度，探究了韵律线索在讽刺感知中的作用及其权重分配模式。

背景: 韵律在讽刺感知中起核心作用，但以往研究依赖自然语音，缺乏对单个声学维度的精细控制，且自然数据中韵律线索共变，难以隔离其独立贡献。

目的: 构建一个可控框架，以测试韵律线索对讽刺感知的因果影响，并比较人类与基础模型在韵律线索权重分配上的差异。

方法: 使用基于提示的韵律条件控制的神经文本转语音技术，构建正交刺激集以操纵语音速率、音高变化和响度；人类听者对讽刺程度和自然度进行评分，并与能处理音频输入的基础模型的预测结果进行比较。

主要发现: 响度主要驱动人类的讽刺感知，而模型将更大的权重分配给语音速率，导致两者在线索权重分配模式上存在显著差异。

结论: 可控的神经文本转语音技术使得调查语音感知中韵律线索的权重分配成为可能。

翻译: Prosody plays a central role in sarcasm perception, yet previous studies have relied on naturally produced speech that lacks fine-grained control over individual acoustic dimensions. As prosodic cues co-vary in natural data, isolating their independent contributions remains challenging. We introduce a controlled framework using neural text-to-speech (TTS) with prompt-based prosodic conditioning to manipulate speech rate, pitch variation, and loudness. An orthogonal stimulus set was constructed to enable causal testing of prosodic cue effects. Human listeners rated sarcasm and naturalness, and their judgments were compared with predictions from a foundation model capable of processing audio input. Results show that loudness primarily drives human sarcasm perception, whereas the model assigns greater weight to speech rate, leading to distinct cue-weighting patterns. This study shows how controllable neural TTS enables investigation of prosodic cue weighting in speech perception.

Abstract

Prosody plays a central role in sarcasm perception, yet previous studies have relied on naturally produced speech that lacks fine-grained control over individual acoustic dimensions. As prosodic cues co-vary in natural data, isolating their independent contributions remains challenging. We introduce a controlled framework using neural text-to-speech (TTS) with prompt-based prosodic conditioning to manipulate speech rate, pitch variation, and loudness. An orthogonal stimulus set was constructed to enable causal testing of prosodic cue effects. Human listeners rated sarcasm and naturalness, and their judgments were compared with predictions from a foundation model capable of processing audio input. Results show that loudness primarily drives human sarcasm perception, whereas the model assigns greater weight to speech rate, leading to distinct cue-weighting patterns. This study shows how controllable neural TTS enables investigation of prosodic cue weighting in speech perception.

item.title: Evaluating the Representation Space of Diffusion Models via Self-Supervised Principles
item.author: Xiao Li, Yixuan Jia, Zekai Zhang, Xiang Li, Lianghe Shi, Jinxin Zhou, Zhihui Zhu, Liyue Shen, Qing Qu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种联合评估扩散模型表示能力和生成能力的框架，通过分解特征为不变分量和残差分量，并推导基于费希尔的不变污染比率指标，揭示了模型在表示和生成行为上的特性。

背景: 扩散模型展现出强大的生成能力，同时也成为强大的自监督表示学习者，但这两种能力之间的联系尚未得到充分探索。

目的: 旨在联合评估扩散模型的表示能力和生成能力，并从自监督学习的角度监控扩散模型。

方法: 借鉴自监督学习，将特征分解为不变分量和残差分量，推导不变污染比率这一基于费希尔的指标，用于量化残差变化对特征空间中不变信号的污染程度，并以此分析扩散模型的判别性和生成性行为。

主要发现: 在表示方面，不变性在中等噪声水平达到峰值，此时下游分类性能最佳；在生成方面，训练从真实泛化过渡到数据受限情况下的记忆化，不变污染比率可作为早期学习的敏感训练时指标，费希尔方向上残差能量的增加标志着记忆化的开始，且仅凭训练特征即可检测。

结论: 扩散模型可以通过其学习表示的几何结构从自监督角度进行监控。

翻译: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable generative capabilities and have also emerged as powerful self-supervised representation learners, yet the connection between these two abilities remains less explored. Drawing inspiration from self-supervised learning (SSL), we introduce a framework for jointly evaluating the representation and generation capabilities of diffusion models. Specifically, we decompose features into invariant and residual components and derive the Invariant Contamination Ratio (ICR), a Fisher-based metric that quantifies how residual variation contaminates invariant signal in feature space. We use this framework to analyze both discriminative and generative behavior of diffusion models. On the representation side, we find that invariance peaks at intermediate noise levels, which also yield the best downstream classification performance. On the generative side, we study how training transitions from genuine generalization to memorization in data-limited regimes, and show that ICR serves as a sensitive training-time indicator of early learning: increasing residual energy along Fisher directions marks the onset of memorization, detectable from training features alone without external evaluators or held-out test sets. Overall, our results show that diffusion models can be monitored from a self-supervised perspective through the geometry of their learned representations.

Abstract

Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable generative capabilities and have also emerged as powerful self-supervised representation learners, yet the connection between these two abilities remains less explored. Drawing inspiration from self-supervised learning (SSL), we introduce a framework for jointly evaluating the representation and generation capabilities of diffusion models. Specifically, we decompose features into invariant and residual components and derive the Invariant Contamination Ratio (ICR), a Fisher-based metric that quantifies how residual variation contaminates invariant signal in feature space. We use this framework to analyze both discriminative and generative behavior of diffusion models. On the representation side, we find that invariance peaks at intermediate noise levels, which also yield the best downstream classification performance. On the generative side, we study how training transitions from genuine generalization to memorization in data-limited regimes, and show that ICR serves as a sensitive training-time indicator of early learning: increasing residual energy along Fisher directions marks the onset of memorization, detectable from training features alone without external evaluators or held-out test sets. Overall, our results show that diffusion models can be monitored from a self-supervised perspective through the geometry of their learned representations.

item.title: Disentanglement with Holographic Reduced Representations
item.author: Jhonny J. Velasquez Olivera, Christo K. Thomas, Walid Saad
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于全息约简表示的无监督学习算法，用于神经解耦。

背景: 使用神经网络分离数据中的变化因子是机器学习中的长期挑战。

目的: 提出一种将解耦表示视为符号结构的设计，以应对连续表示方法的局限性。

方法: 引入全息约简表示用于神经解耦，利用其解绑操作提供分离因子的归纳偏置。

主要发现: 全息约简表示在潜变量遍历和解耦指标上表现良好，且对噪声更具鲁棒性。

结论: 该表示法通过近似独立的符号值对和每槽容量界限，提供了对解耦归纳偏置的定量解释。

翻译: Disentanglement, the separation of factors of variation in data using neural networks, remains a long-standing challenge in machine learning. Prior work has addressed this problem with variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks that incorporate ideas from variational inference and information-theoretic constraints. In contrast to methods that rely on continuous representations, we propose a design that treats disentangled representations as symbolic structures, motivated by the compositional relationships among the concepts that make up samples from a distribution. However, learning discrete symbolic structures with neural networks while maintaining differentiability is difficult and often requires complex architectures. To address this, we introduce an unsupervised learning algorithm that uses holographic reduced representations for neural disentanglement. We show that the HRR unbinding operation provides an inductive bias for separating factors and yields competitive results against baselines, as measured by latent traversals and disentanglement metrics. We complement these empirical findings with an information-theoretic analysis of the HRR unbinding channel. We prove that unbinding induces approximately independent symbol-value pairs and derive a per-slot capacity bound that quantifies how many distinct symbolic concepts can be reliably encoded, giving a quantitative account of the inductive bias toward disentanglement. The resulting representations differ from standard autoencoder-based models, in that their latent units are vectors that are summed together, rather than scalar dimensions of a low-dimensional latent vector. We show that this HRR representation is more robust to noise than other disentangled representations and maintains reconstruction quality across a range of SNRs.

Abstract

Disentanglement, the separation of factors of variation in data using neural networks, remains a long-standing challenge in machine learning. Prior work has addressed this problem with variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks that incorporate ideas from variational inference and information-theoretic constraints. In contrast to methods that rely on continuous representations, we propose a design that treats disentangled representations as symbolic structures, motivated by the compositional relationships among the concepts that make up samples from a distribution. However, learning discrete symbolic structures with neural networks while maintaining differentiability is difficult and often requires complex architectures. To address this, we introduce an unsupervised learning algorithm that uses holographic reduced representations (HRR) for neural disentanglement. We show that the HRR unbinding operation provides an inductive bias for separating factors and yields competitive results against baselines, as measured by latent traversals and disentanglement metrics. We complement these empirical findings with an information-theoretic analysis of the HRR unbinding channel. We prove that unbinding induces approximately independent symbol-value pairs and derive a per-slot capacity bound that quantifies how many distinct symbolic concepts can be reliably encoded, giving a quantitative account of the inductive bias toward disentanglement. The resulting representations differ from standard autoencoder-based models, in that their latent units are vectors that are summed together, rather than scalar dimensions of a low-dimensional latent vector. We show that this HRR representation is more robust to noise than other disentangled representations and maintains reconstruction quality across a range of SNRs.

item.title: Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol (CHAP)
item.author: Arsalan Shahid, Gordon Suttie, Philip Black
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了协作式人机协议（CHAP），旨在解决人机协作中缺乏共享工作空间标准的问题。

背景: 基础模型正从响应生成转向运营角色，涉及多人类、多智能体的跨团队、跨时区协作。当前实践中，人类判断和干预的记录分散在应用代码、聊天线程等地方，缺乏统一标准。现有的MCP和A2A标准分别规范了工具访问和智能体互操作性，但未定义人机共同工作的共享空间。

目的: 提出CHAP协议，为人类和智能体在 accountable work（可问责工作）中提供一个结构化的共享工作空间，使人类干预、交接和审批等关键操作变得结构化、可追溯和可审计。

方法: 设计CHAP协议，包含核心组件（工作空间、参与者、任务、工件和追加式证据日志）以及可组合的配置档案（如审查、模式、路由、审议、交接、身份、签名和基于透明度的审计等）。

主要发现: CHAP将原本散落在聊天线程中的覆盖操作转化为携带差异、理由和内容哈希的结构化事件；将班次交接转化为可携带的信封；将人类对智能体草稿的审批转化为不可抵赖的签名决策，支持多年后回放。

结论: CHAP通过核心组件和可组合配置，为多人类多智能体协作提供了标准化的共享工作空间协议，增强了人机协作的可追溯性、透明度和审计能力。

翻译: Foundation models are moving from response generation into operational roles. They plan across steps, call tools, request human input, coordinate with other agents, and increasingly carry responsibility for work that affects customers, claims, code, contracts, and clinical decisions. Production deployments are no longer one human supervising one model. They are multi-human, multi-agent collaborations that cross teams, time zones, and trust boundaries. The technical surface for this collaboration remains weakly specified. When an agent drafts a response and a human edits it before it ships, the moment of human judgement is the most valuable signal in the system. In current practice it is recorded, if at all, in application code, chat threads, ticket comments, and tribal memory. Two protocol standards address adjacent concerns: MCP standardises agent access to tools and data, and A2A standardises agent-to-agent interoperability. Neither defines the shared workspace in which humans and agents perform accountable work together. This paper presents CHAP, the Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol. Under CHAP, the override that used to vanish into a chat thread becomes a structured event carrying a diff, a rationale, and a content hash. The handoff between shifts becomes a portable envelope rather than a pinned message. The human approval of an agent's draft becomes a non-repudiable signed decision that can be replayed years later. The protocol achieves this through a small Core (workspaces, participants, tasks, artefacts, and an append-only evidence log) together with composable profiles that add review, modes, routing, deliberation, handoff, identity, signatures, and transparency-backed audit as deployments require them. Specification, reference implementation, conformance suite, and worked examples are available at: https://github.com/BrightbeamAI/chap

They plan across steps, call tools, request human input, coordinate with other agents, and increasingly carry responsibility for work that affects customers, claims, code, contracts, and clinical decisions. Production deployments are no longer one human supervising one model. They are multi-human, multi-agent collaborations that cross teams, time zones, and trust boundaries. The technical surface for this collaboration remains weakly specified. When an agent drafts a response and a human edits it before it ships, the moment of human judgement is the most valuable signal in the system. In current practice it is recorded, if at all, in application code, chat threads, ticket comments, and tribal memory. Two protocol standards address adjacent concerns: MCP standardises agent access to tools and data, and A2A standardises agent-to-agent interoperability. Neither defines the shared workspace in which humans and agents perform accountable work together. This paper presents CHAP, the Collaborative Human-Agent Protocol. Under CHAP, the override that used to vanish into a chat thread becomes a structured event carrying a diff, a rationale, and a content hash. The handoff between shifts becomes a portable envelope rather than a pinned message. The human approval of an agent's draft becomes a non-repudiable signed decision that can be replayed years later. The protocol achieves this through a small Core (workspaces, participants, tasks, artefacts, and an append-only evidence log) together with composable profiles that add review, modes, routing, deliberation, handoff, identity, signatures, and transparency-backed audit as deployments require them. item.title: Discovering Functionally Selective Brain Regions with a Deep Topographic Multimodal Model
item.author: Badr AlKhamissi, Johannes Mehrer, Lara Marinov, Ahmed Abdelaal, Abdulkadir Gokce, Martin Schrimpf
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Topo-Omni的拓扑多模态模型，该模型将视觉、听觉和语言认知处理整合在一个连续的虚拟皮层片上，通过微调预训练基础模型并引入空间平滑目标，实现了跨模态和跨处理阶段的统一空间组织。

背景: 皮层中邻近神经元具有相似的响应特征，形成系统性的空间组织。现有的拓扑模型虽能重现部分结构，但局限于单模态且各层空间约束分离，导致地图碎片化，无法反映皮层处理流的连续性和跨模态整合。

目的: 构建一个能够整合多模态信息并反映皮层连续空间组织的模型，以验证单一空间原则是否组织跨模态和跨处理阶段的表征。

方法: 通过微调预训练基础模型，引入空间平滑目标，构建Topo-Omni模型，将视觉、听觉和语言认知处理整合在单一连续的虚拟皮层片上。

主要发现: 模型在不同模态中发展出与人类神经影像一致的聚类；选择性驱动或抑制聚类可偏倚或损害感知，与人类干预研究结果平行；通过模型筛选发现新的自然景观和动物网络聚类，并在人类数据中验证。

结论: 单一空间原则组织跨模态和跨处理阶段的表征，为皮层组织提供了可检验的假设。

翻译: Nearby neurons in cortex share similar response profiles, producing systematic spatial organization across sensory and cognitive systems. Recent topographic models reproduce aspects of this structure but remain unimodal and spatially constrain each layer separately, yielding fragmented maps that capture neither the contiguity of cortical processing streams nor their integration across modalities. We introduce Topo-Omni, a topographic multimodal model in which visual, auditory, and language/cognitive processing share a single contiguous in-silico sheet. Built by fine-tuning a pretrained foundation model with a spatial smoothness objective, this architecture develops clusters across modalities that are consistent with human neuroimaging, from sensory to cognitive systems. Driving or suppressing a cluster selectively biases or impairs perception, paralleling human intervention studies. Finally, we use our model to screen for novel clusters in-silico and discover new natural landscape and animal networks which we validate in human data. A single spatial principle thus organizes representations across modalities and processing stages, yielding testable hypotheses about cortical organization.

Abstract

Nearby neurons in cortex share similar response profiles, producing systematic spatial organization across sensory and cognitive systems. Recent topographic models reproduce aspects of this structure but remain unimodal and spatially constrain each layer separately, yielding fragmented maps that capture neither the contiguity of cortical processing streams nor their integration across modalities. We introduce Topo-Omni, a topographic multimodal model in which visual, auditory, and language/cognitive processing share a single contiguous in-silico sheet. Built by fine-tuning a pretrained foundation model with a spatial smoothness objective, this architecture develops clusters across modalities that are consistent with human neuroimaging, from sensory to cognitive systems. Driving or suppressing a cluster selectively biases or impairs perception, paralleling human intervention studies. Finally, we use our model to screen for novel clusters in-silico and discover new natural landscape and animal networks which we validate in human data. A single spatial principle thus organizes representations across modalities and processing stages, yielding testable hypotheses about cortical organization.

item.title: AetheRock: An Arm-Worn Robot Teaching System for Force-Guided Vision-Tactile Learning
item.author: Hong Li, Yue Xu, Yihan Tang, Yankang Dong, Chenyuan Liu, Chenyang Yu, Xuyang Li, Siyuan Huang, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Yong-Lu Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于抓取力、视觉和触觉数据采集的穿戴式设备AetheRock，以及一个利用力和视觉引导触觉学习的表示学习框架ForceVT，以解决接触丰富操作中力感知机器人学习的挑战。

背景: 力和触觉传感在接触丰富的操作中不可或缺，但手持或可穿戴设备中触觉和力传感器的不兼容组装给力感知机器人学习带来了关键挑战。

目的: 解决上述传感器组装不兼容的限制，实现更有效的抓取力、视觉和触觉数据采集及学习。

方法: 首先介绍AetheRock设备，包括模块化易制造的指端视觉触觉传感器GelSlim-MiniFab、人体手指接触区域的电阻压力传感器、定制PCB模块和可穿戴套件；其次提出ForceVT框架，使用力和视觉引导保真度无关的触觉学习。

主要发现: 现实世界实验表明，AetheRock实现了合格的数据效率，ForceVT有效缓解了视觉触觉传感器在制造和使用不一致时的低效问题。

结论: 通过创新的硬件设计和算法，我们的工作减轻了抓取力视觉触觉机器人学习的局限性。

翻译: Force and tactile sensing are indispensable in contact-rich manipulation. However, force-aware robot learning faces critical challenges due to the incompatible assembly of tactile and force sensors in handheld or wearable devices. To address these limitations, we first introduce AetheRock for gripper-force, vision, and tactile data collection, which is an arm-worn device featuring a modular and easily manufactured visuo-tactile sensor, GelSlim-MiniFab, at the fingertip, a resistive pressure sensor at the human finger contact region, a customized PCB module, and a wearable kit for comfortable and robust collection. Building on this, we propose ForceVT, a representation learning framework that uses force and vision to guide fidelity-agnostic tactile learning, enabling robust inference in any tactile situation. Real-world experiments show that AetheRock achieves qualified data efficiency and that ForceVT effectively alleviates inefficiencies when visuo-tactile sensors exhibit manufacturing and utilization inconsistencies. Overall, our work mitigates the limitations of gripper-force vision-tactile robot learning through innovative hardware design and algorithms.

Abstract

Force and tactile sensing are indispensable in contact-rich manipulation. However, force-aware robot learning faces critical challenges due to the incompatible assembly of tactile and force sensors in handheld or wearable devices. To address these limitations, we first introduce AetheRock for gripper-force, vision, and tactile data collection, which is an arm-worn device featuring a modular and easily manufactured visuo-tactile sensor, GelSlim-MiniFab, at the fingertip, a resistive pressure sensor at the human finger contact region, a customized PCB module, and a wearable kit for comfortable and robust collection. Building on this, we propose ForceVT, a representation learning framework that uses force and vision to guide fidelity-agnostic tactile learning, enabling robust inference in any tactile situation. Real-world experiments show that AetheRock achieves qualified data efficiency and that ForceVT effectively alleviates inefficiencies when visuo-tactile sensors exhibit manufacturing and utilization inconsistencies. Overall, our work mitigates the limitations of gripper-force vision-tactile robot learning through innovative hardware design and algorithms.

item.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
item.author: King, Wayne, Xue, Zeyue, Bian, Yuxuan, Huang, Jie, Li, Haoran, Li, Yaowei, Su, Yaofeng, Li, Yuming, Wang, Haoyu, Zhang, Shiyi, Zhang, Songchun, Niu, Yuwei, Xu, Sihan, Zhuang, Junhao, Huang, Haoyang, Duan, Nan
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Echo-Memory 是一项针对动作条件世界模型中记忆机制的受控研究，旨在解决模型在相机离开并返回时场景或显著物体发生无声变化的问题。

背景: 现有的记忆设计难以比较，因为性能提升往往与骨干网络、训练、检索和评估差异纠缠在一起。

目的: 通过固定动作到视频的接口，仅改变生成器存储和读取历史的方式，来比较不同的记忆机制。

方法: 在共享视频扩散骨干网络、优化器、相机动作表示、采样器和评估管道的条件下，比较原始上下文、基于压缩的记忆、具有不同读取路径的空间摘要以及状态空间递归。

主要发现: 原始上下文是强大的容量基线，能显著改善开放域返回；紧凑性不能替代容量，激进的压缩会丢失关键证据；块状状态空间递归是开放域返回的最强机制。

结论: 隐式记忆的结构与是否使用记忆同样重要，研究世界模型记忆需要超越孤立的重放指标。

翻译: We present Echo-Memory, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: capacity, compression, read-out, and recurrence. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决动作条件视频生成模型中历史记忆存储与读取机制难以公平对比，以及摄像机离开后返回时场景和物体容易失真的问题。研究通过固定模型骨干与训练流程，专门隔离并测试不同记忆设计的效果。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为可靠的记忆能力是模型从简单拼接视频片段升级为构建连贯、可重访虚拟世界的关键，直接决定了此类技术在实际内容创作、仿真模拟等领域的落地价值。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有记忆机制的研究往往因骨干网络、训练策略和评估标准不同而难以直接比较。为此，他们采用控制变量思路，固定视频生成模型、数据接口和评估流程，仅改变历史信息的存储与读取方式。该方法借鉴了现有的上下文拼接、信息压缩、空间摘要和状态空间循环等设计思路，将其统一纳入同一框架进行公平对比。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是固定视频生成模型的基础架构、训练配置与评估标准，仅改变历史信息的存储与读取方式，从而隔离并对比不同记忆机制对场景重现能力的真实影响。整体实现流程为：模型接收首帧、文本提示与相机动作序列，通过固定策略获取历史画面，并将其转化为原始上下文、压缩特征、空间摘要或状态空间隐式记忆等不同形式。这些记忆信息随后与当前生成片段一同输入共享的视频扩散网络进行训练与推理，最终通过回放质量、域内闭环与开放域返回测试三大分支全面评估记忆效果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一套严格控制的记忆机制对比框架，而非提出新的算法模块。与以往工作不同，它固定了视频生成骨干网络、训练流程、采样器及评估标准，仅改变历史信息的存储与读取方式，从而公平比较原始上下文、压缩记忆、空间摘要和状态空间递归四种设计。此外，论文引入了包含回放质量、域内循环重访和开放域返回探测的三分支评估协议，有效揭示了单纯依赖局部图像质量指标无法真实反映模型长期记忆能力的缺陷。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文通过固定生成骨干与评估流程，仅改变历史信息的存储与读取方式，系统对比了四种记忆机制，并提出了包含回放质量、域内循环和开放域返回的三个评估分支，揭示了记忆结构对保持场景一致性的关键作用。

Abstract

We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: \emph{capacity}, \emph{compression}, \emph{read-out}, and \emph{recurrence}. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

item.title: Evaluation Cards: An Interpretive Layer for AI Evaluation Reporting
item.author: Ghosh, Avijit, Reuel, Anka, Chim, Jenny, Kennedy, Wm. Matthew, Yadav, Srishti, Mickel, Jennifer, Long, Yanan, Tran, Andrew, Kornilova, Anastassia, Stachura, Damian, Klyman, Kevin, Friedrich, Felix, Sania, Jeba, Lamparth, Max, Batzner, Jan, Mishra, Anoop, Habba, Eliya, Hao, Yixiong, Heath, Nathan, Rismani, Shalaleh, Gohar, Usman, Loehr, Andrea, Manheim, David, Dhar, Ruchira, Nelaturu, Sree Harsha, Sinha, Aarush, Choshen, Leshem, Sharma, Drishti, Khire, Ishan, Saha, Amit, Sahoo, Subramanyam, Hardy, Michael, Riegler, Michael Alexander, Manghnani, Kabir, Lin, Michelle, Jiang, Yanan, Huang, Yilin, Yehudai, Asaf, Ji, Jessica, Hofmann, Aris, Akhtar, Mubashara, Moniz, Nuno, Jernite, Yacine, Biderman, Stella, Talat, Zeerak, Koyejo, Sanmi, Kochenderfer, Mykel, Solaiman, Irene
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: AI评估结果规模庞大但报告方式不一致，导致读者难以比较和追溯。现有方法存在覆盖范围窄、表示静态且缺乏大规模提取基础设施的不足。本文提出EvalCards，一个将基准元数据、评估运行数据和模型元数据整合为统一记录的操作性报告层。

背景: AI评估结果规模庞大，但在排行榜、模型卡片、基准论文和公司博客中报告方式不一致。这导致读者无法可靠地比较结果、识别报告遗漏或追溯综合声明的底层证据。

目的: 解决现有评估报告方法覆盖范围窄、无法区分不同利益相关者对同一证据的问题，以及缺乏大规模采用所需提取基础设施的不足，提供一个统一的、可解释的评估记录。

方法: 1. 通过对52篇论文和10次利益相关者访谈的结构化审查，推导出报告模式。2. 实现四种解释性信号（可复现性、文档完整性、来源与风险、分数可比性），并通过针对研究和非研究受众的读者模式呈现。3. 部署监控工具，将EvalCards应用于5816个模型、635个基准和101843个结果。

主要发现: EvalCards成功整合了基准元数据、评估运行数据和模型元数据。通过监控工具的应用，揭示了当前报告实践中的系统性差距。

结论: EvalCards作为一个操作性报告层，通过统一记录和多种解释性信号，提高了AI评估结果的可解释性和可比性，并揭示了现有报告实践的不足。

翻译: AI evaluation results are produced at scale but reported inconsistently across leaderboards, model cards, benchmark papers, and company blogs. The cost is interpretive: readers cannot reliably compare results across sources, identify what a report omits, or trace an aggregate claim to its underlying evidence. Recent efforts address isolated components but leave three gaps: they cover only narrow slices of the evaluation lifecycle and do not compose into a single interpretable record; they specify static representations that do not differentiate the questions different stakeholders bring to the same evidence; and they remain proposals on paper, lacking the extraction infrastructure required for adoption at scale. We present EvalCards, an operational reporting layer that composes benchmark metadata, evaluation run data, and model metadata into a unified record. We (1) derive a reporting schema from a structured review of 52 papers and 10 stakeholder interviews, (2) implement four interpretive signals (reproducibility, documentation completeness, provenance and risk, and score comparability), rendered through reader modes calibrated to research and non-research audiences, and (3) deploy a monitoring tool that applies EvalCards across 5,816 models, 635 benchmarks, and 101,843 results, surfacing systematic gaps in current reporting practice.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决人工智能评估结果在不同平台中报告格式不统一、关键信息缺失且难以相互比较的问题。该问题之所以重要，是因为研究人员、监管机构和决策者高度依赖这些评估结果来做出模型部署、合规审查和科学论断。如果评估报告缺乏透明度和标准化，读者将无法准确判断结果的可靠性与完整性，从而导致技术判断失误或政策制定偏差。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过系统梳理大量相关学术论文，并结合对技术、开发与政策领域从业者的访谈，提炼出评估报告的核心需求。在此基础上，他们借鉴了先前关于基准元数据、运行数据模式及报告清单的孤立研究成果，针对其覆盖范围有限且缺乏统一基础设施的不足，将评估过程划分为五个阶段。最终，作者将这些要素整合，设计出一个能够统一记录评估信息、提供层级化证据路径与多维度解读信号的综合报告框架。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个统一的解释性报告层，将基准元数据、评估运行数据和模型元数据整合为结构化记录，并用五层层级结构替代传统的扁平化报告，以实现评估结果的可追溯、可复现和可比较。整体实现流程首先通过系统文献综述和专家访谈构建报告框架，随后将多源评估数据提取并标准化为统一格式。接着系统会自动计算可复现性、完整性、来源和可比性等解释性信号，最后通过适配不同受众的阅读模式将结果可视化呈现。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套名为评估卡片的交互式报告层，将基准元数据、评估运行数据和模型元数据整合为统一记录。相比以往工作仅覆盖评估生命周期片段、停留在纸面提案或缺乏规模化基础设施，该框架首次实现了跨层级数据组合，并设计了五层递进结构以替代扁平化的报告形式。此外，它内置了四项可解释信号并针对科研与非科研读者提供差异化展示模式，同时配套了大规模公开评估报告的持续监测工具。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为评估卡片的统一报告框架与工具，通过整合基准元数据、评估运行记录与模型信息，并设计分层结构与可解释信号，实现了对人工智能评估结果的标准化管理、跨源对比与大规模实证分析。

Abstract

AI evaluation results are produced at scale but reported inconsistently across leaderboards, model cards, benchmark papers, and company blogs. The cost is interpretive: readers cannot reliably compare results across sources, identify what a report omits, or trace an aggregate claim to its underlying evidence. Recent efforts address isolated components but leave three gaps: they cover only narrow slices of the evaluation lifecycle and do not compose into a single interpretable record; they specify static representations that do not differentiate the questions different stakeholders bring to the same evidence; and they remain proposals on paper, lacking the extraction infrastructure required for adoption at scale. We present \EvalCards{}, an operational reporting layer that composes benchmark metadata, evaluation run data, and model metadata into a unified record. We (1) derive a reporting schema from a structured review of 52 papers and 10 stakeholder interviews, (2) implement four interpretive signals (reproducibility, documentation completeness, provenance and risk, and score comparability), rendered through reader modes calibrated to research and non-research audiences, and (3) deploy a monitoring tool that applies \EvalCards{} across 5,816 models, 635 benchmarks, and 101,843 results, surfacing systematic gaps in current reporting practice.

item.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
item.author: Cai, Jisong, Ling, Long, Chu, Shiwei, Liu, Zhongshan, Kang, Jiayue, Liang, Zhixuan, Xu, Wenjie, Mao, Yinan, Zhang, Weinan, Yang, Xiaokang, Ying, Ru, Zheng, Ran, Mu, Yao
item.description:
来源: hf | ⭐ 与研究主题相关

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为 AHA-WAM 的异步视界自适应世界动作模型，该模型基于双扩散变换器架构，通过解耦世界预测与动作执行的时间分辨率，实现了机器人操作中的状态-of-the-art 性能。

背景: 世界动作模型通过将物理先验注入策略学习来联合建模视觉场景动态和动作，但现有模型将世界预测与动作执行耦合在同一时间分辨率上，导致世界分支需要建模冗余且信息量弱的近期帧变化，可能未充分利用视频分支在具身控制中的潜力。

目的: 解决现有世界动作模型中世界预测与动作执行时间分辨率绑定过紧的问题，以更好地利用视频分支的潜力进行具身控制。

方法: 提出 AHA-WAM 模型，采用双扩散变换器架构，将视频扩散变换器作为低频世界规划器，维护滚动键值记忆并编码长视界场景演变；将动作扩散变换器作为高频执行器，通过层间联合注意力查询上下文执行短动作块。引入视界自适应偏移训练和观察引导视频上下文路由技术，支持异步执行。

主要发现: 在 RoboTwin 和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，AHA-WAM 无需任何机器人数据预训练即可达到最先进性能，在 RoboTwin 上平均成功率为百分之九十二点八零，在四个真实世界任务上平均成功率为百分之七十八，闭环控制频率达到每秒二十四点一七次，相比 Fast-WAM 速度提升四点五九倍。
